i0001.text: 夫子温、良、恭、俭、让以得之。
i0001.gloss: Confucius gentleness, goodness, respectfulness, frugality, humility with DE 3.OBJ
i0001.translation: Confucius acquired it with gentleness, goodness, respectfulness, frugality, and humility.
i0001.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Xue'er|夫子温、良、恭、俭、让以得之。#1

i0002.text: 管氏有三归，官事不摄，焉得俭？
i0002.gloss: Guan clan have three vault, official duty NEG perform, how DE frugal?
i0002.translation: The Guan clan has three vaults and performs no official duties, how can they lead a frugal life?
i0002.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Bayi|管氏有三归，官事不摄，焉得俭？#1

i0003.text: 君子之至于斯也，吾未尝不得见也。
i0003.gloss: gentleman GEN arrive at PROX TOP, 1SG never NEG DE see SFP
i0003.translation: Whenever a gentleman visited this place, I had never failed to see him.
i0003.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Bayi|君子之至于斯也，吾未尝不得见也。#1

i0004.text: 里仁为美。择不处仁，焉得知？
i0004.gloss: live.near virtuous be beauty. choose NEG dwell virtuous, how DE wise?
i0004.translation: Living near those who are virtuous is true beauty. If one chooses not to dwell among the virtuous, how can one be called wise?
i0004.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Liren|里仁为美。择不处仁，焉得知？#1

i0005.text: 富与贵是人之所欲也，不以其道得之，不处也。
i0005.gloss: wealth and rank PROX people GEN NMLZ desire SFP, NEG by 3.GEN means DE 3.OBJ, NEG dwell SFP
i0005.translation: Wealth and rank are what people desire, but if they are not obtained by proper means, one should not dwell in them.
i0005.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Liren|富与贵是人之所欲也，不以其道得之，不处也。#1

i0006.text: 贫与贱是人之所恶也，不以其道得之，不去也。
i0006.gloss: poverty and low.status PROX people GEN NMLZ detest SFP, NEG by 3.GEN means DE 3.OBJ, NEG avoid SFP
i0006.translation: Poverty and low status are what people detest, but if one cannot get rid of them by proper means, one should not avoid them.
i0006.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Liren|贫与贱是人之所恶也，不以其道得之，不去也。#1

i0007.gloss: Cheng TOP desire, how DE resolute?
i0007.translation: If Cheng gives in to desire, how can he be resolute?
i0007.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Gongye Chang|枨也欲，焉得刚？#1

i0008.text: 夫子之文章，可得而闻也
i0008.gloss: Master GEN refined.speech.and.writing, can DE CONJ hear SFP
i0008.translation: The Master’s refined speech and writings can be heard (and understood).
i0008.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Gongye Chang|夫子之文章，可得而闻也#1

i0009.text: 夫子之言性与天道，不可得而闻也。
i0009.gloss: Master GEN word human.nature and Way.of.Heaven, NEG can DE CONJ hear SFP
i0009.translation: The Master’s words on human nature and the Way of Heaven cannot be heard (and understood).
i0009.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Gongye Chang|夫子之言性与天道，不可得而闻也。#1

i0010.translation: If one does not understand (something), how can one attain benevolence?

i0011.translation: Have you got any talented people there?
i0011.note: is DE used as a simple possessive verb here?

i0012.gloss: seek benevolence CONJ DE benevolence, further what resent
i0012.translation: One who seeks benevolence and attains it—what is there to resent?
i0012.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Shuer|求仁而得仁，又何怨。#1

i0013.gloss: sage, 1SG NEG DE CONJ see 3.OBJ PRF
i0013.translation: As for the sage, I do not think I can see one.
i0013.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Shuer|圣人，吾不得而见之矣#1

i0014.gloss: DE see gentleman NMLZ, PROX enough PRF
i0014.translation: To be able to see a gentleman—that is enough.
i0014.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Shuer|得见君子者，斯可矣。#1

i0015.gloss: kind person, 1SG NEG DE CONJ see 3.OBJ PRF
i0015.translation: As for kind people, I do not think I can see one.
i0015.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Shuer|善人，吾不得而见之矣#1

i0016.gloss: DE see have resolution NMLZ, PROX enough PRF
i0016.translation: To be able to see someone with resolution—that is enough.
i0016.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Shuer|得见有恒者，斯可矣#1

i0017.text: 躬行君子，则吾未之有得。
i0017.gloss: personally practice gentleman, then 1SG not.yet 3.OBJ have DE
i0017.translation: As for practicing the way of the gentleman—I have not yet succeeded in doing so.
i0017.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Shuer|躬行君子，则吾未之有得。#1

i0018.text: 三以天下让，民无得而称焉。
i0018.gloss: three.times with empire yield, people not.have DE CONJ praise 3.OBJ
i0018.translation: Three times he yielded the empire, and the people cannot find any way to praise him verbally.
i0018.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Taibo|三以天下让，民无得而称焉。#1

i0019.text: 三年学，不至于谷，不易得也。
i0019.gloss: three year study, NEG reach to officer.position, NEG easy DE SFP
i0019.translation: To study for three years without advancing to the position of officer, such cases are rare to find.
i0019.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Taibo|三年学，不至于谷，不易得也。#1

i0020.text: 天之将丧斯文也，后死者不得与于斯文也。
i0020.gloss: Heaven GEN about.to extinguish PROX culture TOP, later die NMLZ NEG DE take.part in PROX culture SFP
i0020.translation: If Heaven were about to extinguish this culture, then those who die later would no longer be able to take part in it.
i0020.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Zihan|天之将丧斯文也，后死者不得与于斯文也。#1

i0021.text: 且予纵不得大葬，予死于道路乎？
i0021.gloss: moreover 1SG even.if NEG DE grand burial, 1SG die by roadside Q?
i0021.translation: Even if I do not get a grand burial, would I die by the roadside?
i0021.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Zihan|且予纵不得大葬，予死于道路乎？#1

i0022.text: 吾自卫反鲁，然后乐正，雅颂各得其所。
i0022.gloss: 1SG from Wei return Lu, only.then music set.in.order, Ya Song each DE 3.GEN place
i0022.translation: Only after I returned to Lu from Wei were the musical arrangements set in order, and the Ya and Song each get their proper place.
i0022.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Zihan|吾自卫反鲁，然后乐正，雅颂各得其所。#1

i0023.translation: (Talking about food) If not getting its proper sauce, one does not eat it.

i0024.text: 回也视予犹父也，予不得视犹子也。
i0024.gloss: Hui TOP treat 1SG like father SFP, 1SG NEG DE treat like son SFP
i0024.translation: Hui treated me like his father, but I cannot treat him like my son.
i0024.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Xianjin|回也视予犹父也，予不得视犹子也。#1

i0025.gloss: as.for Zilu TOP, NEG DE 3.GEN death P
i0025.translation: As for Zilu, I fear he will not die a natural death (lit. get his proper death).
i0025.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Xianjin|若由也，不得其死然。#1

i0026.gloss: do 3.OBJ difficult, speak 3.OBJ DE not.have difficulty Q?
i0026.translation: Acting on it is certainly difficult; but is it the case that speaking of it can be free of any difficulty?
i0026.note: complicated: meaning could be interpreted as having modality in it, DP complement, unless "wu" (neg.exist) is interpreted as verbal. if that's the case, no modal use.
i0026.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Yanyuan|为之难，言之得无訒乎？#1

i0027.text: 必不得已而去，于斯三者何先？
i0027.gloss: must NEG DE stop CONJ discard, among PROX three NMLZ what first?
i0027.translation: If you had no choice but to discard one, which of these three would you discard first?
i0027.note: NEG DE yi' - has no choice but to
i0027.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Yanyuan|必不得已而去，于斯三者何先？#1

i0028.text: 必不得已而去，于斯二者何先？
i0028.gloss: must NEG DE stop CONJ discard, among PROX two NMLZ what first?
i0028.translation: If you had no choice but to discard one, which of these two would you discard first?
i0028.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Yanyuan|必不得已而去，于斯二者何先？#1

i0029.gloss: although have grain, 1SG DE CONJ eat 3.OBJ.Q?
i0029.translation: Although there is grains, can I get and then eat them?
i0029.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Yanyuan|虽有粟，吾得而食诸？#1

i0030.gloss: put.first duty put.after DE, NEG.COP honor virtue Q?
i0030.translation: To put duty before reward—is that not the mark of one who honors virtue?
i0030.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Yanyuan|先事后得，非崇德与？#1

i0031.text: 不得中行而与之，必也狂狷乎！
i0031.gloss: NEG DE middle.way CONJ associate 3.OBJ, must P bold cautious EXCL!
i0031.translation: If I cannot associate with those who follow the middle way, then let it be with the bold or the cautious!
i0031.note: complicated; 'the middle way' is the right way to engage with the society according to Confucius philosophy.
i0031.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Zilu|不得中行而与之，必也狂狷乎！#1

i0032.text: 羿善射，奡荡舟，俱不得其死然
i0032.gloss: Yi good.at archery, Ao navigate boat, both NEG DE 3.GEN death P
i0032.translation: Yi was skilled in archery, and Ao in navigating the waters, yet neither met a good end (lit. got their proper death).
i0032.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Xianwen|羿善射，奡荡舟，俱不得其死然#1

i0033.translation: Although getting it (initially), they are bound to lose it (afterwards).
i0033.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Wei Linggong|虽得之，必失之。#1

i0034.text: 及其老也，血气既衰，戒之在得。
i0034.gloss: reach 3.GEN old TOP, blood vital.force already decline, guard.against 3.OBJ lie.in DE
i0034.translation: When he grows old and his blood and vital force have declined, what he must guard against is acquisitiveness.
i0034.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Jishi|及其老也，血气既衰，戒之在得。#1

i0035.translation: When he sees a chance for gain, he thinks of what is right.

i0036.text: 问一得三，闻诗，闻礼，又闻君子之远其子也。
i0036.gloss: ask one DE three, learn Odes, learn rites, also learn gentleman GEN keep.distant 3.GEN son SFP
i0036.translation: I asked about one thing and obtained three: I learned about the Odes, I learned about the rites, and I also learned that the gentleman keeps his son at a proper distance.
i0036.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Jishi|问一得三，闻诗，闻礼，又闻君子之远其子也。#1

i0037.gloss: respectful then NEG insult, generous then DE multitude
i0037.translation: If you are respectful, you will not be insulted; if you are generous, you will win the multitude.
i0037.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Yanghuo|恭则不侮，宽则得众#1

i0038.text: 其未得之也，患得之；既得之，患失之。
i0038.gloss: 3.GEN not.yet DE 3.OBJ TOP, anxious DE 3.OBJ; already DE 3.OBJ, anxious lose 3.OBJ
i0038.translation: Before he has obtained it, he is anxious to obtain it; once he has obtained it, he is anxious lest he lose it.
i0038.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Yanghuo|其未得之也，患得之；既得之，患失之。#1

i0039.text: 孔子下，欲与之言。趋而辟之，不得与之言。
i0039.gloss: Confucius get.down, wish with 3.OBJ speak. hurry CONJ avoid 3.OBJ, NEG DE with 3.OBJ speak
i0039.translation: Confucius got down, wishing to speak with him; but the man hurried off to avoid him, so Confucius was unable to speak with him.
i0039.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Weizi|孔子下，欲与之言。趋而辟之，不得与之言。#1

i0040.text: 士见危致命，见得思义，祭思敬，丧思哀，其可已矣。
i0040.gloss: officer see danger give life, see DE think right, sacrifice think reverence, mourning think grief, perhaps may sufficient PRF
i0040.translation: When the officer sees danger he is ready to give his life; when he sees a chance for gain he thinks of what is right; at sacrifice he thinks of reverence, in mourning of grief—then he may be deemed sufficient.
i0040.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Zizhang|士见危致命，见得思义，祭思敬，丧思哀，其可已矣。#1

i0041.text: 如得其情，则哀矜而勿喜。
i0041.gloss: if DE 3.GEN true.facts, then grieve pity CONJ PROH rejoice
i0041.translation: If you ascertain the true facts of their cases, then feel grief and compassion, and do not rejoice.
i0041.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Zizhang|如得其情，则哀矜而勿喜。#1

i0042.text: 夫子之墙数仞，不得其门而入，不见宗庙之美，百官之富。
i0042.gloss: Master GEN wall several fathom, NEG DE 3.GEN gate CONJ enter, NEG see ancestral.temple GEN beauty, hundred officer GEN richness
i0042.translation: The Master's wall is many fathoms high; if one does not find its gate to enter, one does not see the beauty of the ancestral temple or the richness of its many officers.
i0042.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Zizhang|夫子之墙数仞，不得其门而入，不见宗庙之美，百官之富。#1

i0043.gloss: DE 3.GEN gate NMLZ perhaps few PRF
i0043.translation: Those who find its gate are perhaps few.

i0044.text: 仲尼，日月也，无得而逾焉。
i0044.gloss: Zhongni, sun moon SFP, not.have DE CONJ climb.beyond 3.OBJ
i0044.translation: Zhongni is the sun and the moon; there is no way one can climb beyond him.
i0044.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Zizhang|仲尼，日月也，无得而逾焉。#1

i0045.text: 夫子之得邦家者，所谓立之斯立
i0045.gloss: Master GEN DE state great.house TOP, NMLZ say set.up 3.OBJ then stand
i0045.translation: Were the Master to obtain a state or a great house, it would be as they say: he sets the people up and they stand.
i0045.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Zizhang|夫子之得邦家者，所谓立之斯立#1

i0046.gloss: generous then DE multitude, trustworthy then people entrust 3.OBJ
i0046.translation: If you are generous, you win the multitude; if you are trustworthy, the people give you their charge.
i0046.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Yaoyue|宽则得众，信则民任焉#1

i0047.gloss: desire benevolence CONJ DE benevolence, further how greedy?
i0047.translation: He desires benevolence and attains benevolence—how, then, is he greedy?
i0047.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Lunyu|Yaoyue|欲仁而得仁，又焉贪？#1

i0048.text: 临财毋茍得，临难毋茍免。
i0048.gloss: face wealth PROH improperly DE, face danger PROH improperly escape
i0048.translation: Facing wealth, do not obtain it improperly; facing danger, do not escape it improperly.
i0048.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Quli Shang|临财毋茍得，临难毋茍免。#1

i0049.text: 若不得谢，则必赐之几杖，行役以妇人。
i0049.gloss: if NEG DE retirement, then must present 3.OBJ stool staff, travel duty with woman
i0049.translation: If he does not obtain (permission of) retirement (from the ruler), then the ruler must present him with a stool and a staff, and when he travels on duty he is to be attended by women.
i0049.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Quli Shang|若不得谢，则必赐之几杖，行役以妇人。#1

i0050.gloss: Confucius already DE jointly bury at Fang
i0050.translation: When Confucius had been able to bury his parents together at Fang,
i0050.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Shang|孔子既得合葬于防#1

i0051.gloss: only.then DE jointly bury at Fang
i0051.translation: —and only then was he able to bury them together at Fang.
i0051.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Shang|然后得合葬于防。#1

i0052.gloss: 1SG DE correct CONJ die SFP then enough PRF
i0052.translation: If I attain what is correct and then die, that will be enough.
i0052.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Shang|吾得正而毙焉斯已矣。#1

i0053.text: 既殡，瞿瞿如有求而弗得
i0053.gloss: already coffin, distractedly like have seek CONJ NEG DE
i0053.translation: After the coffining, he gazes about distractedly, as if seeking something and not finding it.
i0053.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Shang|既殡，瞿瞿如有求而弗得#1

i0054.gloss: although wish weep 3.OBJ, how DE CONJ weep 3.OBJ?
i0054.translation: Though I wish to weep for him, how can I weep for him?
i0054.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Shang|虽欲哭之，安得而哭之？#1

i0055.gloss: although wish NEG weep, how DE CONJ NEG weep?
i0055.translation: Though I wish not to weep, how can I refrain from weeping?
i0055.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Shang|虽欲勿哭，焉得而弗哭？#1

i0056.text: 藏也者，欲人之弗得见也。
i0056.gloss: burial TOP, wish others GEN NEG DE see SFP
i0056.translation: Burial means wishing that others should not be able to see the dead.
i0056.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Shang|藏也者，欲人之弗得见也。#1

i0057.text: 亡国恒于斯，得国恒于斯。
i0057.gloss: lose state always at PROX, DE state always at PROX
i0057.translation: The losing of a state always comes about here; the gaining of a state always comes about here.
i0057.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Xia|亡国恒于斯，得国恒于斯。#1

i0058.text: 不得与于哭泣之哀，以为君忧。
i0058.gloss: NEG DE share in wailing GEN grief, thereby make ruler sorrow
i0058.translation: —unable to share in the grief of the wailing, and thereby causing the ruler sorrow.
i0058.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Xia|不得与于哭泣之哀，以为君忧。#1

i0059.text: 始死，皇皇焉如有求而弗得
i0059.gloss: begin die, restless ADVZ like have seek CONJ NEG DE
i0059.translation: When death first comes, he is restless, as if seeking something and not finding it.
i0059.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Xia|始死，皇皇焉如有求而弗得#1

i0060.translation: If it can be left undone, then I would wish to leave it undone.
i0060.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Xia|得已，则吾欲已#1

i0061.text: 不得已，则吾欲以二子者之为之也
i0061.gloss: NEG DE stop, then 1SG wish use two person NMLZ GEN do 3.OBJ SFP
i0061.translation: If it cannot be avoided, then I would have the two of them do it.
i0061.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Xia|不得已，则吾欲以二子者之为之也#1

i0062.text: 吾得已乎哉？鲁人以妻我。
i0062.gloss: 1SG DE stop Q EXCL? Lu people use give.as.wife 1SG
i0062.translation: Can I desist? The people of Lu gave me a wife.
i0062.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Xia|吾得已乎哉？鲁人以妻我。#1

i0063.gloss: what do CONJ DE PROX from people SFP?
i0063.translation: What did he do to win this from the people?
i0063.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Xia|何施而得斯于民也？#1

i0064.text: 武也得歌于斯，哭于斯，聚国族于斯
i0064.gloss: Wu TOP DE sing at PROX, weep at PROX, gather state clan at PROX
i0064.translation: Here I, Wu, shall be able to sing here, to weep here, and to gather the clans of the state here.
i0064.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Xia|武也得歌于斯，哭于斯，聚国族于斯#1

i0065.text: 吾悔之，自吾母而不得吾情，吾恶乎用吾情！
i0065.gloss: 1SG regret 3.OBJ, since 1SG mother CONJ NEG DE 1SG feeling, 1SG how use 1SG feeling!
i0065.translation: I regret it: ever since my mother's case I did not attain the full expression of my feelings—so how should I now give vent to my feelings?
i0065.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Tangong Xia|吾悔之，自吾母而不得吾情，吾恶乎用吾情！#1

i0066.gloss: land, settlement, people, dwelling, must mutually each.other DE SFP
i0066.translation: Land, settlement, people, and dwelling must all be brought into mutual correspondence.
i0066.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Wangzhi|地、邑、民、居，必参相得也。#1

i0067.gloss: ninety, although DE person NEG warm PRF
i0067.translation: At ninety, even if he gets people to attend him, he will not be warm.
i0067.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Wangzhi|九十，虽得人不暖矣。#1

i0068.text: 省妇事毋得淫，虽有贵戚近习，毋有不禁。
i0068.gloss: oversee woman affair PROH DE excess, although have noble relative close attendant, PROH have NEG prohibit
i0068.translation: In overseeing women’s affairs, there must be no excess or impropriety; even when dealing with noble relatives or close attendants, there must be no exception to the rules.
i0068.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueling|省妇事毋得淫，虽有贵戚近习，毋有不禁。#1

i0069.text: 水泉必香，陶器必良，火齐必得，兼用六物。
i0069.gloss: water spring must fragrant, pottery must fine, fire.regulation must DE, together use six material
i0069.translation: The water and spring must be fragrant, the pottery must be of fine quality, the fire must be properly regulated—thus all six materials are employed together in harmony.
i0069.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueling|水泉必香，陶器必良，火齐必得，兼用六物。#1

i0070.text: 某之子有父母之丧，不得嗣为兄弟，使某致命。
i0070.gloss: so.and.so GEN son have parent GEN mourning, NEG DE succeed be elder.brother, send so.and.so deliver mandate
i0070.translation: If a son is in mourning for his parents, he may not succeed to the role of his elder brother, and thus a representative must be appointed to deliver the mandate on his behalf.
i0070.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zengzi Wen|某之子有父母之丧，不得嗣为兄弟，使某致命。#1

i0071.text: 卫君请吊，哀公辞不得命，公为主，客人吊。
i0071.gloss: Wei ruler request condole, Duke.Ai decline NEG DE consent, duke be host, guest condole
i0071.translation: When the Duke of Wei sought to offer condolences, Duke Ai tried to decline but could not refuse the formal protocol; being the host, he received the condolences of the guest.
i0071.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zengzi Wen|卫君请吊，哀公辞不得命，公为主，客人吊。#1

i0072.text: 诸侯旅见天子，入门，不得终礼，废者几？
i0072.gloss: feudal.lord together visit monarch, enter gate, NEG DE complete rite, omit NMLZ how.many?
i0072.translation: When feudal lords visit the monarch and enter the gate, (in some occasions they are not allowed to complete the full ceremonial rites — how many such rite-omitting occasions are there?
i0072.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zengzi Wen|诸侯旅见天子，入门，不得终礼，废者几？#1

i0073.text: 诸侯相见，揖让入门，不得终礼，废者几？
i0073.gloss: feudal.lord mutually meet, bow yield enter gate, NEG DE complete rite, omit NMLZ how.many?
i0073.translation: When feudal lords meet each other, they exchange a bow and allow one another to enter, but (in some occasions) they are not allowed to complete the full ceremonial rites — how many such rite-omitting occasions are there?
i0073.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zengzi Wen|诸侯相见，揖让入门，不得终礼，废者几？#1

i0074.text: 大夫之祭，鼎俎既陈，笾豆既设，不得成礼，废者几？
i0074.gloss: great.minister GEN sacrifice, cauldron vessel already arrange, basket bowl already set, NEG DE complete rite, omit NMLZ how.many?
i0074.translation: In the ritual of the great minister, once the cauldron and sacrificial vessels are arranged, and the baskets and bowls are set, but (in some occasions) the full rites are not allowed to be completed — how many such rite-omitting occasions are there?
i0074.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zengzi Wen|大夫之祭，鼎俎既陈，笾豆既设，不得成礼，废者几？#1

i0075.text: 行一物而三善皆得者，唯世子而已。
i0075.gloss: perform one act CONJ three virtue all DE NMLZ, only heir.apparent only
i0075.translation: The only one who can get all three virtues by performing a single act is the heir apparent.
i0075.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Wenwang Shizi|行一物而三善皆得者，唯世子而已。#1

i0076.text: 父子、君臣、长幼之道得，而国治。
i0076.gloss: father son, ruler subject, elder younger GEN way DE, CONJ state govern
i0076.translation: When the relationships between father and son, ruler and subject, and elder and younger are properly maintained, the state will be well governed.
i0076.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Wenwang Shizi|父子、君臣、长幼之道得，而国治。#1

i0077.text: 古之君子，举大事，必慎其终始，而众安得不喻焉？
i0077.gloss: ancient GEN gentleman, undertake great matter, always cautious 3.GEN end beginning, CONJ multitude how DE NEG understand 3.OBJ?
i0077.translation: The gentlemen of ancient times, when undertaking great matters, were always cautious in both their beginnings and endings. How could the people not understand and follow their example?
i0077.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liyun|古之君子，举大事，必慎其终始，而众安得不喻焉？#1

i0078.gloss: therefore lose 3.OBJ NMLZ die, DE 3.OBJ NMLZ live
i0078.translation: Thus, those who lose it will die, and those who get it will live.
i0078.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liyun|故失之者死，得之者生。#1

i0079.text: 故圣人以礼示之，故天下国家可得而正也。
i0079.gloss: therefore sage with rite show 3.OBJ, therefore world state can DE CONJ set.right SFP
i0079.translation: Thus, the sage demonstrates through rites, and therefore, the world and the state can be set right.
i0079.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liyun|故圣人以礼示之，故天下国家可得而正也。#1

i0080.text: 夫子之极言礼也，可得而闻与？
i0080.gloss: Master GEN utmost speak rite TOP, can DE CONJ hear Q?
i0080.translation: Can the Master’s most profound teachings on rites be heard?
i0080.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liyun|夫子之极言礼也，可得而闻与？#1

i0081.text: 我欲观夏道，是故之杞，而不足徵也；吾得夏时焉。
i0081.gloss: 1SG wish observe Xia Way, so go Qi, CONJ NEG sufficient confirm SFP; 1SG DE Xiashi there
i0081.translation: I wish to observe the Way of the Xia dynasty, so I went to Qi, but it was not sufficient to confirm it; I have only gained a book named Xiashi.
i0081.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liyun|我欲观夏道，是故之杞，而不足徵也；吾得夏时焉。#1

i0082.text: 我欲观殷道，是故之宋，而不足徵也；吾得坤乾焉。
i0082.gloss: 1SG wish observe Yin Way, so go Song, CONJ NEG sufficient confirm SFP; 1SG DE Kunqian there
i0082.translation: I wish to observe the Way of the Yin Shang dynasty, so I went to Song, but it was not sufficient to confirm it; I have only gained a book named Kunqian.
i0082.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liyun|我欲观殷道，是故之宋，而不足徵也；吾得坤乾焉。#1

i0083.text: 协于艺，讲于仁，得之者强。
i0083.gloss: harmonize with arts, study in benevolence, DE 3.OBJ NMLZ strong
i0083.translation: In harmony with the arts and devoted to the study of benevolence—those who attain such qualities are truly strong.
i0083.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liyun|协于艺，讲于仁，得之者强。#1

i0084.text: 仁者，义之本也，顺之体也，得之者尊。
i0084.gloss: benevolence TOP, righteousness GEN root SFP, harmony GEN embodiment SFP, DE 3.OBJ NMLZ honored
i0084.translation: Benevolence is the root of righteousness and the embodiment of harmony; those who attain it are held in honor.
i0084.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liyun|仁者，义之本也，顺之体也，得之者尊。#1

i0085.text: 如此，则得不以多为贵乎？
i0085.gloss: like PROX, then DE NEG take abundance as prized Q?
i0085.translation: This being so, is it not, then, that abundance is what is prized?
i0085.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liqi|如此，则得不以多为贵乎？#1

i0086.text: 如此则得不以少为贵乎？
i0086.gloss: like PROX then DE NEG take fewness as prized Q?
i0086.translation: This being so, is it not, then, that fewness is what is prized?
i0086.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liqi|如此则得不以少为贵乎？#1

i0087.translation: This is presumably to have attained the proper way of it.

i0088.text: 欲察物而不由礼，弗之得矣。
i0088.gloss: wish examine thing CONJ NEG follow rite, NEG 3.OBJ DE PRF
i0088.translation: If one wishes to examine things yet does not proceed by the rites, one will not attain it.
i0088.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liqi|欲察物而不由礼，弗之得矣。#1

i0089.text: 三诏皆不同位，盖道求而未之得也。
i0089.gloss: three summons all NEG same rank, presumably Way seek CONJ not.yet 3.OBJ DE SFP
i0089.translation: The three summonses were each at a different rank—presumably the Way was sought but had not yet been attained.
i0089.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liqi|三诏皆不同位，盖道求而未之得也。#1

i0090.gloss: this.is.why DE 3.GEN person GEN be valued SFP
i0090.translation: This is why obtaining the right person is what is valued.
i0090.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Liqi|是以得其人之为贵也。#1

i0091.gloss: yin yang harmonious CONJ myriad thing DE
i0091.translation: Yin and yang are in harmony, and the myriad things attain their fulfillment.

i0092.gloss: seek master 3.GEN will, NEG covet 3.GEN DE
i0092.translation: One seeks to master one's will and does not covet one's gains.
i0092.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Jiaotesheng|求服其志，不贪其得#1

i0093.text: 敬而亲之，先王之所以得天下也。
i0093.gloss: revere CONJ hold.dear 3.OBJ, former king GEN NMLZ by DE all.under.heaven SFP
i0093.translation: To revere him and hold him dear—this is how the former kings won all under heaven.
i0093.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Jiaotesheng|敬而亲之，先王之所以得天下也。#1

i0094.text: 不说，与其得罪于乡党州闾，宁孰谏。
i0094.gloss: NEG pleased, rather.than DE blame from village district, better earnestly remonstrate
i0094.translation: If the parent is not pleased, rather than incur blame from the village and district, it is better to remonstrate earnestly.
i0094.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Neize|不说，与其得罪于乡党州闾，宁孰谏。#1

i0095.text: 如新受赐，若反赐之则辞，不得命，如更受赐，藏以待乏。
i0095.gloss: like new receive gift, if return gift 3.OBJ then decline, NEG DE consent, like again receive gift, store to await need
i0095.translation: He treats it as a newly received gift; if he tries to return it he declines to keep it, but failing to obtain consent he accepts it again as a new gift and stores it against a time of need.
i0095.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Neize|如新受赐，若反赐之则辞，不得命，如更受赐，藏以待乏。#1

i0096.text: 八十非人不暖，九十虽得人不暖矣。
i0096.gloss: eighty without person NEG warm, ninety although DE person NEG warm PRF
i0096.translation: At eighty, one is not warm without others; at ninety, even with people to attend, one is not warm.
i0096.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Neize|八十非人不暖，九十虽得人不暖矣。#1

i0097.text: 土功不兴，大夫不得造车马。
i0097.gloss: earthwork NEG start, great.officer NEG DE make carriage horse
i0097.translation: When earthworks are not under way, great officers may not have carriages and horses made.
i0097.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yuzao|土功不兴，大夫不得造车马。#1

i0098.gloss: officer great.officer NEG DE jointly.enshrine with feudal.lord
i0098.translation: Officers and great officers may not be jointly enshrined with the feudal lords.
i0098.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sangfu Xiaoji|士大夫不得祔于诸侯#1

i0099.gloss: feudal.lord NEG DE jointly.enshrine with Son.of.Heaven
i0099.translation: Feudal lords may not be jointly enshrined with the Son of Heaven.
i0099.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sangfu Xiaoji|诸侯不得祔于天子#1

i0100.text: 五者一得于天下，民无不足、无不赡者。
i0100.gloss: five NMLZ one DE in world, people not.have NEG sufficient, not.have NEG provided NMLZ
i0100.translation: If even one of the five is realized throughout the world, then there are none of the people who are not sufficiently provided for.
i0100.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Dazhuan|五者一得于天下，民无不足、无不赡者。#1

i0101.text: 五者，一物纰缪，民莫得其死。
i0101.gloss: five NMLZ, one element go.awry, people none DE 3.GEN death
i0101.translation: Among the five, if one element goes awry, none of the people will meet a natural death.
i0101.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Dazhuan|五者，一物纰缪，民莫得其死。#1

i0102.text: ...异器械，别衣服，此其所得与民变革者也。
i0102.gloss: differ implement, distinguish dress, PROX DIST NMLZ DE with people alter NMLZ SFP
i0102.translation: …differing in implements and distinguishing in dress—these are the things that the rulers may alter along with the people.
i0102.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Dazhuan|...异器械，别衣服，此其所得与民变革者也。#1

i0103.text: 其不可得变革者则有矣：亲亲也，尊尊也，长长也…
i0103.gloss: DIST NEG can DE alter NMLZ then have PRF: love kin SFP, honor honored SFP, respect elder SFP
i0103.translation: But there are indeed things that cannot get alternation: loving one's kin, honoring the honored, respecting elders…
i0103.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Dazhuan|其不可得变革者则有矣：亲亲也，尊尊也，长长也…#1

i0104.text: 此其不可得与民变革者也。
i0104.gloss: PROX DIST NEG can DE with people alter NMLZ SFP
i0104.translation: These are the things that cannot be altered along with the people.
i0104.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Dazhuan|此其不可得与民变革者也。#1

i0105.text: 君有合族之道，族人不得以其戚戚君，位也。
i0105.gloss: ruler have unite clan GEN way, clansman NEG DE use 3.GEN kinship treat.as.relative ruler, rank SFP
i0105.translation: The ruler has a way of uniting the clan; the clansmen may not presume on their kinship to treat the ruler as a relative—this is a matter of rank.
i0105.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Dazhuan|君有合族之道，族人不得以其戚戚君，位也。#1

i0106.text: 庶子不得为长子三年，不继祖也。
i0106.gloss: concubine.son NEG DE for eldest.son three year, NEG continue grandfather SFP
i0106.translation: A son by a concubine may not observe the three years' mourning for his own eldest son, since he does not continue the grandfather's line.
i0106.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Dazhuan|庶子不得为长子三年，不继祖也。#1

i0107.text: 辞曰：“某固愿闻名于将命者。”不得阶主。
i0107.gloss: phrasing say: so.and.so earnestly wish make.known name to convey message NMLZ. NEG DE approach host
i0107.translation: The phrasing is: 'I earnestly wish to make my name known to the one who conveys messages.' One may not approach the host directly.
i0107.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Shaoyi|辞曰：“某固愿闻名于将命者。”不得阶主。#1

i0108.text: 鼓无当于五声，五声弗得不和。
i0108.gloss: drum not.have correspond to five note, five note NEG DE NEG harmony
i0108.translation: The drum corresponds to none of the five notes, yet if the five notes do not obtain it, they are not in harmony.
i0108.note: I don't understand the translation with "obtain" (here and below)
i0108.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Xueji|鼓无当于五声，五声弗得不和。#1

i0109.text: 水无当于五色，五色弗得不章。
i0109.gloss: water not.have correspond to five color, five color NEG DE NEG display
i0109.translation: Water corresponds to none of the five colors, yet if the five colors do not obtain it, they are not displayed.
i0109.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Xueji|水无当于五色，五色弗得不章。#1

i0110.text: 学无当于五官。五官弗得不治。
i0110.gloss: learning not.have correspond to five office. five office NEG DE NEG govern
i0110.translation: Learning corresponds to none of the five offices, yet if the five offices do not obtain it, they are not well governed.
i0110.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Xueji|学无当于五官。五官弗得不治。#1

i0111.text: 师无当于五服，五服弗得不亲。
i0111.gloss: teacher not.have correspond to five mourning.degree, five mourning.degree NEG DE NEG affection
i0111.translation: The teacher corresponds to none of the five degrees of mourning kinship, yet if the five degrees do not obtain him, they are not drawn into affection.
i0111.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Xueji|师无当于五服，五服弗得不亲。#1

i0112.text: 礼乐皆得，谓之有德。德者得也。
i0112.gloss: rite music both DE, call 3.OBJ have virtue. virtue TOP DE SFP
i0112.translation: When rites and music are both attained, this is called having virtue. Virtue is attainment.
i0112.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|礼乐皆得，谓之有德。德者得也。#1

i0113.text: 老幼孤独不得其所，此大乱之道也。
i0113.gloss: old young orphaned solitary NEG DE 3.GEN place, PROX great disorder GEN road SFP
i0113.translation: When the old, the young, the orphaned, and the solitary do not find their proper place—this is the road to great disorder.
i0113.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|老幼孤独不得其所，此大乱之道也。#1

i0114.gloss: whole day drink wine CONJ NEG DE drunk SFP
i0114.translation: They drink all day long and yet cannot become drunk.
i0114.note: ambiguous between modal and non-modal; circumstantial or ability
i0114.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|终日饮酒而不得醉焉#1

i0115.text: 八风从律而不奸，百度得数而有常。
i0115.gloss: eight wind follow pitch.pipe CONJ NEG disorder, hundred measure DE number CONJ have regularity
i0115.translation: The eight winds follow the pitch-pipes without disorder, and the hundred measures attain their proper numbers and so have regularity.
i0115.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|八风从律而不奸，百度得数而有常。#1

i0116.text: 君子乐得其道，小人乐得其欲。
i0116.gloss: gentleman delight DE 3.GEN Way, small.man delight DE 3.GEN desire
i0116.translation: The gentleman delights in attaining the Way; the small man delights in attaining his desires.
i0116.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|君子乐得其道，小人乐得其欲。#1

i0117.gloss: heaven earth joyfully join, yin yang mutually DE
i0117.translation: Heaven and earth join in joy; yin and yang attain mutual accord.
i0117.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|天地欣合，阴阳相得#1

i0118.text: 所以官序贵贱各得其宜也
i0118.gloss: so.that office rank noble base each DE 3.GEN fitness SFP
i0118.translation: …so that offices and ranks, the noble and the base, each attain what is fitting for them.
i0118.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|所以官序贵贱各得其宜也#1

i0119.text: 曰：“夫《武》之备戒之已久，何也？”对曰：“病不得众也。”
i0119.gloss: say: TOP Wu GEN warning.posture GEN already long, what SFP? reply say: anxious NEG DE multitude SFP
i0119.translation: He asked: 'In the Wu dance, why is the warning-posture held so long?' The reply was: 'It expresses the anxiety of not winning the multitude.'
i0119.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|曰：“夫《武》之备戒之已久，何也？”对曰：“病不得众也。”#1

i0120.translation: When the rites attain their due response, there is joy.

i0121.translation: When music attains its return to the root, there is repose.

i0122.text: 不使放心邪气得接焉，是先王立乐之方也。
i0122.gloss: NEG let wayward heart perverse spirit DE take.hold 3.OBJ, PROX former king establish music GEN means SFP
i0122.translation: …not allowing a wayward heart or a perverse spirit to be able to take hold—this is the means by which the former kings established music.
i0122.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|不使放心邪气得接焉，是先王立乐之方也。#1

i0123.text: 故听其雅、颂之声，志意得广焉
i0123.gloss: therefore hear 3.GEN Ya, Song GEN sound, will intent DE broad SFP
i0123.translation: Therefore, on hearing the sounds of the Ya and the Song, the will and intent attain breadth.
i0123.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|故听其雅、颂之声，志意得广焉#1

i0124.text: 执其干戚，习其俯仰诎伸，容貌得庄焉
i0124.gloss: grasp 3.GEN shield axe, practice 3.GEN bow rise bend stretch, bearing DE grave SFP
i0124.translation: Grasping shields and axes and practicing the bowing and rising, bending and stretching, the bearing attains gravity.
i0124.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|执其干戚，习其俯仰诎伸，容貌得庄焉#1

i0125.text: 行其缀兆，要其节奏，行列得正焉…
i0125.gloss: move 3.GEN formation, match 3.GEN rhythm, rank DE correct SFP
i0125.translation: Moving through the formations and matching the rhythm, the ranks attain correct order.
i0125.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|行其缀兆，要其节奏，行列得正焉…#1

i0126.translation: …and the advancing and retreating attain uniformity.

i0127.text: 故先王之喜怒，皆得其侪焉。
i0127.gloss: therefore former king GEN joy anger, all DE 3.GEN measure SFP
i0127.translation: Thus the joy and anger of the former kings each attained their proper measure.
i0127.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Yueji|故先王之喜怒，皆得其侪焉。#1

i0128.text: 寡君有宗庙之事，不得承事
i0128.gloss: our.ruler have ancestral.temple GEN service, NEG DE attend matter
i0128.translation: Our ruler has services at the ancestral temple, and so is unable to attend to the matter.
i0128.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zaji Shang|寡君有宗庙之事，不得承事#1

i0129.gloss: not.yet 3.OBJ hear, fret NEG DE hear SFP
i0129.translation: Before he has heard it, he frets that he will be unable to hear it.
i0129.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zaji Xia|未之闻，患弗得闻也#1

i0130.gloss: already hear 3.OBJ, fret NEG DE learn SFP
i0130.translation: Once he has heard it, he frets that he will be unable to learn it.
i0130.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zaji Xia|既闻之，患弗得学也#1

i0131.text: 既得之而又失之，君子耻之
i0131.gloss: already DE 3.OBJ CONJ again lose 3.OBJ, gentleman ashamed 3.OBJ
i0131.translation: To have obtained it and then to lose it again—the gentleman is ashamed of this.
i0131.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zaji Xia|既得之而又失之，君子耻之#1

i0132.text: 著存不忘乎心，夫安得不敬乎？
i0132.gloss: keep present NEG forget in heart, TOP how DE NEG reverent Q?
i0132.translation: Keeping their living presence unforgotten in the heart—how then can one fail to be reverent?
i0132.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Jiyi|著存不忘乎心，夫安得不敬乎？#1

i0133.text: 礼得其报则乐，乐得其反则安。
i0133.gloss: rite DE 3.GEN requital then joy, music DE 3.GEN return then repose
i0133.translation: When the rites attain their requital, there is joy; when music attains its return, there is repose.
i0133.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Jiyi|礼得其报则乐，乐得其反则安。#1

i0134.text: 轻其志而求外之重也，虽圣人弗能得也。
i0134.gloss: make.light 3.GEN purpose CONJ seek external GEN weight TOP, even sage NEG can DE SFP
i0134.translation: To make light of one's purpose and seek weight in externals—even a sage cannot obtain it.
i0134.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Jitong|轻其志而求外之重也，虽圣人弗能得也。#1

i0135.gloss: make 3.OBJ necessarily reverent TOP, NEG can DE PRF
i0135.translation: To make them necessarily reverent—this (situation) cannot be obtained.
i0135.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Jitong|使之必敬也，弗可得已。#1

i0136.text: 夫铭者，壹称而上下皆得焉耳矣。
i0136.gloss: TOP inscription TOP, single commend CONJ above below all DE SFP only PRF
i0136.translation: As for the inscription, with a single act of commendation both ancestors and descendants alike attain their due.
i0136.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Jitong|夫铭者，壹称而上下皆得焉耳矣。#1

i0137.text: 居处有礼，进退有度，百官得其宜，万事得其序。
i0137.gloss: dwelling have rite, advance retreat have measure, hundred office DE 3.GEN fitness, myriad affair DE 3.GEN order
i0137.translation: Dwelling has its rites and movement has its measure; the hundred offices attain what is fitting, and the myriad affairs attain their order.
i0137.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Jingjie|居处有礼，进退有度，百官得其宜，万事得其序。#1

i0138.text: 民不求其所欲而得之，谓之信
i0138.gloss: people NEG seek 3.GEN NMLZ desire CONJ DE 3.OBJ, call 3.OBJ good.faith
i0138.translation: When the people obtain what they desire without having to seek it, this is called good faith.
i0138.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Jingjie|民不求其所欲而得之，谓之信#1

i0139.gloss: seek DE accord desire, NEG by 3.GEN proper.means
i0139.translation: What is sought and obtained accords with mere desire, but not by the proper means.
i0139.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Aigong Wen|求得当欲，不以其所。#1

i0140.text: 愿闻所以行三言之道，可得闻乎？
i0140.gloss: wish hear NMLZ by practice three saying GEN way, can DE hear Q?
i0140.translation: I wish to hear the way to practice these three sayings—may it be heard?
i0140.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Aigong Wen|愿闻所以行三言之道，可得闻乎？#1

i0141.text: 寡人固！不固，焉得闻此言也。
i0141.gloss: 1SG.HUM dull! NEG dull, how DE hear PROX word SFP
i0141.translation: I am dull indeed! Were I not dull, how could I come to hear such words?
i0141.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Aigong Wen|寡人固！不固，焉得闻此言也。#1

i0142.text: 寡人欲问，不得其辞，请少进！
i0142.gloss: 1SG.HUM wish ask, NEG DE 3.GEN word, please little proceed!
i0142.translation: I wish to ask, but I cannot find the words for it; pray, go on a little.
i0142.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Aigong Wen|寡人欲问，不得其辞，请少进！#1

i0143.translation: Thus the palace attains its proper measure...
i0143.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zhongni Yanju|是故，宫室得其度...#1

i0144.translation: the measuring-vessels and cauldrons attain their proper form

i0148.translation: the spirits attain their proper offerings

i0149.translation: the mourning observances attain their proper grief

i0151.translation: the officials attain their proper substance

i0152.translation: the affairs of government attain their proper execution

i0153.text: 加于身而错于前，凡众之动得其宜。
i0153.gloss: apply to self CONJ set.out at front, every multitude GEN movement DE 3.GEN fitness
i0153.translation: applied to oneself and set out before one, every movement of the multitude attains its fitness.
i0153.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zhongni Yanju|加于身而错于前，凡众之动得其宜。#1

i0154.text: 三子者，既得闻此言也于夫子，昭然若发蒙矣。
i0154.gloss: three person NMLZ, already DE hear PROX word P from Master, enlightened like lift veil PRF
i0154.translation: The three, having been able to hear these words from the Master, were suddenly enlightened, as if a veil had been lifted.
i0154.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zhongni Yanju|三子者，既得闻此言也于夫子，昭然若发蒙矣。#1

i0155.text: 民之父母，既得而闻之矣
i0155.gloss: people GEN father mother, already DE CONJ hear 3.OBJ PRF
i0155.translation: Concerning 'the father and mother of the people,' we have now been able to hear it explained.
i0155.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Kongzi Xianju|民之父母，既得而闻之矣#1

i0156.text: 正明目而视之，不可得而见也
i0156.gloss: squarely open eye CONJ look 3.OBJ, NEG can DE CONJ see SFP
i0156.translation: Though one opens one's eyes wide and looks for it, it cannot be seen.
i0156.note: modality expressed by ke preceding de
i0156.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Kongzi Xianju|正明目而视之，不可得而见也#1

i0157.text: 倾耳而听之，不可得而闻也
i0157.gloss: incline ear CONJ listen 3.OBJ, NEG can DE CONJ hear SFP
i0157.translation: Though one inclines one's ear and listens for it, it cannot be heard.
i0157.note: modality expressed by ke preceding de
i0157.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Kongzi Xianju|倾耳而听之，不可得而闻也#1

i0158.text: 五至既得而闻之矣，敢问何谓三无？
i0158.gloss: five arrival already DE CONJ hear 3.OBJ PRF, dare ask what call three absence?
i0158.translation: Having now been able to hear of the 'five arrivals,' may I ask what is meant by the 'three absences'?
i0158.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Kongzi Xianju|五至既得而闻之矣，敢问何谓三无？#1

i0159.text: 三无既得略而闻之矣，敢问何诗近之？
i0159.gloss: three absence already DE outline CONJ hear 3.OBJ PRF, dare ask what ode near 3.OBJ?
i0159.translation: Having now been able to hear the 'three absences' in outline, may I ask which ode comes near to them?
i0159.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Kongzi Xianju|三无既得略而闻之矣，敢问何诗近之？#1

i0160.gloss: not.have sound GEN music, breath will already DE
i0160.translation: In the music that has no sound, the breath and the will are fulfilled.
i0160.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Kongzi Xianju|无声之乐，气志既得#1

i0161.text: 以此坊民，民犹得同姓以弑其君。
i0161.gloss: with PROX safeguard people, people still DE same surname to assassinate 3.GEN ruler
i0161.translation: Even with this safeguard, the people still obtained (hired) a kinsman of the same surname (as their ruler's) and used him to assassinate their ruler.
i0161.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Fangji|以此坊民，民犹得同姓以弑其君。#1

i0162.gloss: take wife like 3.OBJ what? without matchmaker NEG DE
i0162.translation: How does one take a wife? Without a matchmaker, one does not obtain her.
i0162.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Fangji|取妻如之何？匪媒不得#1

i0163.text: 回之为人也，择乎中庸，得一善，则拳拳服膺而弗失之矣。
i0163.gloss: Hui GEN character TOP, choose in Mean, DE one good, then firmly hold.to.breast CONJ NEG lose 3.OBJ PRF
i0163.translation: Hui's character was such that he chose the Mean, and whenever he grasped one good thing, he held it firmly to his breast and never let it go.
i0163.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zhongyong|回之为人也，择乎中庸，得一善，则拳拳服膺而弗失之矣。#1

i0164.text: 素患难，行乎患难：君子无入而不自得焉。
i0164.gloss: placed.in adversity, act in adversity: gentleman not.have enter CONJ NEG REFL DE SFP
i0164.translation: Placed in adversity, he does what befits adversity: there is no situation the gentleman enters into in which he is not self-possessed.
i0164.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zhongyong|素患难，行乎患难：君子无入而不自得焉。#1

i0165.text: 故大德必得其位，必得其禄，必得其名，必得其寿。
i0165.gloss: therefore great virtue surely DE 3.GEN position, surely DE 3.GEN emolument, surely DE 3.GEN renown, surely DE 3.GEN longevity
i0165.translation: Therefore one of great virtue will surely attain his proper position, surely attain his emolument, surely attain his renown, and surely attain his full span of years.
i0165.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zhongyong|故大德必得其位，必得其禄，必得其名，必得其寿。#1

i0166.text: 在下位不获乎上，民不可得而治矣！
i0166.gloss: at low position NEG win from superior, people NEG can DE CONJ govern PRF!
i0166.translation: If one in a low position does not win the trust of superiors, the people cannot be governed.
i0166.note: modality expressed by ke preceding de
i0166.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zhongyong|在下位不获乎上，民不可得而治矣！#1

i0167.text: 诚者不勉而中，不思而得，从容中道，圣人也。
i0167.gloss: sincere NMLZ NEG strive CONJ hit.mark, NEG think CONJ DE, calmly accord Way, sage SFP
i0167.translation: He who is sincere hits the mark without striving and attains it without thinking, calmly according with the Way—such is the sage.
i0167.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zhongyong|诚者不勉而中，不思而得，从容中道，圣人也。#1

i0168.text: 有弗思，思之弗得，弗措也
i0168.gloss: have NEG consider, think 3.OBJ NEG DE, NEG set.aside SFP
i0168.translation: If there is something not yet considered, then once he thinks about it and does not grasp it, he does not set it aside.
i0168.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Zhongyong|有弗思，思之弗得，弗措也#1

i0169.text: 小心而畏义，求以事君，得之自是…
i0169.gloss: cautious CONJ awe righteousness, seek thereby serve ruler, DE 3.OBJ REFL right
i0169.translation: Cautious and standing in awe of what is right, he seeks thereby to serve his ruler; if he obtains the post, he takes it as a matter of course;
i0169.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Biaoji|小心而畏义，求以事君，得之自是…#1

i0170.gloss: NEG DE REFL right, to submit.to Heaven decree
i0170.translation: …and if he does not obtain it, that too he takes as a matter of course, and so submits to the decree of Heaven.
i0170.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Biaoji|...不得自是，以听天命。#1

i0171.text: 故君使其臣得志，则慎虑而从之
i0171.gloss: therefore ruler make 3.GEN minister DE purpose, then carefully deliberate CONJ follow 3.OBJ
i0171.translation: Thus, when the ruler enables his minister to attain his purpose, the minister deliberates carefully and follows him.
i0171.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Biaoji|故君使其臣得志，则慎虑而从之#1

i0172.text: 故君子寡言，而行以成其信，则民不得大其美而小其恶。
i0172.gloss: therefore gentleman sparing word, CONJ act to establish 3.GEN trustworthiness, then people NEG DE magnify 3.GEN virtue CONJ make.light 3.GEN fault
i0172.translation: Thus the gentleman is sparing of words and acts so as to establish his trustworthiness; then the people cannot magnify his virtues nor make light of his faults.
i0172.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Ziyi|故君子寡言，而行以成其信，则民不得大其美而小其恶。#1

i0173.text: 若未得行，则成服而后行。
i0173.gloss: if not.yet DE set.out, then complete mourning.dress CONJ only.then set.out
i0173.translation: If he is not yet able to set out, he completes the mourning dress and only then sets out.
i0173.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Bensang|若未得行，则成服而后行。#1

i0174.gloss: hear death NEG DE hasten.to funeral, weep exhaust grief
i0174.translation: If, on hearing of a death, one is unable to hasten to the funeral, one weeps until grief is exhausted.
i0174.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Bensang|闻丧不得奔丧，哭尽哀#1

i0175.text: 其反哭也，皇皇然若有求而弗得也。
i0175.gloss: 3.GEN return wail TOP, restless ADVZ like have seek CONJ NEG DE SFP
i0175.translation: When he returns to wail, he is restless, as if seeking something and not finding it.
i0175.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Wensang|其反哭也，皇皇然若有求而弗得也。#1

i0176.text: 求而无所得之也，入门而弗见也
i0176.gloss: search CONJ not.have NMLZ DE 3.OBJ SFP, enter gate CONJ NEG see SFP
i0176.translation: He searches but there is nothing he obtains; he enters the gate but does not see him.
i0176.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Wensang|求而无所得之也，入门而弗见也#1

i0177.text: 若将复生然，安可得夺而敛之也。
i0177.gloss: like about.to again live thus, how can DE take.away CONJ encoffin 3.OBJ SFP
i0177.translation: As though he were about to live again—how could one bear to take him away and encoffin him?
i0177.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Wensang|若将复生然，安可得夺而敛之也。#1

i0178.text: 某固辞不得命，敢不敬从？
i0178.gloss: so.and.so firmly decline NEG DE consent, dare NEG respectfully comply?
i0178.translation: I firmly declined but did not obtain your consent—how dare I not respectfully comply?
i0178.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Touhu|某固辞不得命，敢不敬从？#1

i0179.text: 难得而易禄也，易禄而难畜也…
i0179.gloss: hard DE CONJ easy maintain SFP, easy maintain CONJ hard retain SFP
i0179.translation: He is hard to win over yet easy to maintain, easy to maintain yet hard to retain…
i0179.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Ruxing|难得而易禄也，易禄而难畜也…#1

i0180.gloss: NEG.COP time NEG present, NEG also hard DE Q?
i0180.translation: …except at the proper time he does not present himself—is he not hard to win over?
i0180.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Ruxing|...非时不见，不亦难得乎？#1

i0181.text: 君得其志，茍利国家，不求富贵。
i0181.gloss: ruler DE 3.GEN purpose, if benefit state house, NEG seek wealth rank
i0181.translation: When he attains his purpose, if it benefits the state and house, he does not seek wealth or rank.
i0181.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Ruxing|君得其志，茍利国家，不求富贵。#1

i0182.text: 知止而后有定，定而后能静，静而后能安，安而后能虑，虑而后能得。
i0182.gloss: know rest CONJ afterwards have stability, stable CONJ afterwards can still, still CONJ afterwards can peace, peace CONJ afterwards can deliberate, deliberate CONJ afterwards can DE
i0182.translation: Knowing where to rest, one then has stability; with stability one can be still; being still, one can be at peace; being at peace, one can deliberate; and after deliberation one can attain the good.
i0182.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Daxue|知止而后有定，定而后能静，静而后能安，安而后能虑，虑而后能得。#1

i0183.text: 无情者不得尽其辞，大畏民志。此谓知本。
i0183.gloss: not.have fact NMLZ NEG DE exhaust 3.GEN plea, greatly awe people will. PROX call know root
i0183.translation: Those who lack the facts are not able to press their pleas to the full, for the sage holds the people's will in great awe. This is called knowing the root.
i0183.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Daxue|无情者不得尽其辞，大畏民志。此谓知本。#1

i0184.text: 身有所忿懥，则不得其正
i0184.gloss: self have NMLZ anger, then NEG DE 3.GEN rectitude
i0184.translation: When the self harbors anger, then it does not attain its rectitude.
i0184.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Daxue|身有所忿懥，则不得其正#1

i0185.gloss: have NMLZ fear, then NEG DE 3.GEN rectitude
i0185.translation: When there is fear, then it does not attain its rectitude.
i0185.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Daxue|有所恐惧，则不得其正#1

i0186.gloss: have NMLZ fondness.delight, then NEG DE 3.GEN rectitude
i0186.translation: When there is fondness and delight, then it does not attain its rectitude.
i0186.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Daxue|有所好乐，则不得其正#1

i0187.gloss: have NMLZ worry, then NEG DE 3.GEN rectitude
i0187.translation: When there is worry, then it does not attain its rectitude.
i0187.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Daxue|有所忧患，则不得其正#1

i0188.text: 道得众则得国，失众则失国。
i0188.gloss: way DE multitude then DE state, lose multitude then lose state
i0188.translation: The way is this: win the multitude and you win the state; lose the multitude and you lose the state.
i0188.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Daxue|道得众则得国，失众则失国。#1

i0189.text: 道善则得之，不善则失之矣。
i0189.gloss: course good then DE 3.OBJ, NEG good then lose 3.OBJ PRF
i0189.translation: If the course is good, you gain it; if not good, you lose it.
i0189.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Daxue|道善则得之，不善则失之矣。#1

i0190.text: 是故君子有大道，必忠信以得之，骄泰以失之。
i0190.gloss: therefore gentleman have great way, must loyalty good.faith by DE 3.OBJ, arrogance excess by lose 3.OBJ
i0190.translation: Therefore the gentleman has a great way: by loyalty and good faith he gains it, by arrogance and excess he loses it.
i0190.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Daxue|是故君子有大道，必忠信以得之，骄泰以失之。#1

i0191.text: 是故男教不修，阳事不得，适见于天，日为之食
i0191.gloss: therefore man instruction NEG cultivate, yang work NEG DE, portent appear in heaven, sun for 3.OBJ eclipse
i0191.translation: Thus, when the instruction of men is not cultivated, the work of yang is not fulfilled, and a portent appears in the heavens: the sun is eclipsed for it.
i0191.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Hunyi|是故男教不修，阳事不得，适见于天，日为之食#1

i0192.text: 妇顺不修，阴事不得，适见于天，月为之食
i0192.gloss: woman compliance NEG cultivate, yin work NEG DE, portent appear in heaven, moon for 3.OBJ eclipse
i0192.translation: When women's compliance is not cultivated, the work of yin is not fulfilled, and a portent appears in the heavens: the moon is eclipsed for it.
i0192.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Hunyi|妇顺不修，阴事不得，适见于天，月为之食#1

i0193.gloss: virtue TOP, DE in self SFP
i0193.translation: Virtue is that which is obtained within the self.

i0194.text: 故曰：古之学术道者，将以得身也。
i0194.gloss: therefore say: ancient GEN study art Way NMLZ, in.order.to DE self SFP
i0194.translation: Therefore it is said: the ancients who studied the arts and the Way did so in order to perfect their own persons.
i0194.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Xiangyinjiuyi|故曰：古之学术道者，将以得身也。#1

i0195.text: 其容体比于礼，其节比于乐，而中多者，得与于祭。
i0195.gloss: 3.GEN bodily.carriage conform to rule, 3.GEN measure accord with music, CONJ hit many NMLZ, DE take.part in sacrifice
i0195.translation: Those of them whose bodily carriage was in conformity with the rules, and whose shooting was in agreement with the music, and who hit the mark most frequently, were allowed to take part at the sacrifices.
i0195.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sheyi|其容体比于礼，其节比于乐，而中多者，得与于祭。#1

i0196.text: 其容体不比于礼，其节不比于乐，而中少者，不得与于祭。
i0196.gloss: 3.GEN bodily.carriage NEG conform to rule, 3.GEN measure NEG accord with music, CONJ hit few NMLZ, NEG DE take.part in sacrifice
i0196.translation: Those of them whose bodily carriage was not  in conformity with the rules, and whose shooting was not in agreement with the music, and who hit the mark least frequently, were not allowed to take part at the sacrifices.
i0196.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sheyi|其容体不比于礼，其节不比于乐，而中少者，不得与于祭。#1

i0197.gloss: shoot hit then DE be lord
i0197.translation: He who hit the mark was permitted to be a lord.

i0198.gloss: shoot NEG hit then NEG DE be lord
i0198.translation: He who did not hit the mark was not permitted to be a lord.
i0198.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sheyi|射不中则不得为诸侯。#1

i0199.gloss: shoot hit NMLZ DE attend in sacrifice
i0199.translation: He who hit the mark was permitted to attend the sacrifices.

i0200.gloss: NEG hit NMLZ NEG DE attend in sacrifice
i0200.translation: He who did not hit the mark was not permitted to attend the sacrifices.
i0200.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sheyi|不中者不得与于祭。#1

i0201.text: 不得与于祭者有让，削以地；
i0201.gloss: NEG DE attend in sacrifice NMLZ have reprimand, cut by territory
i0201.translation: He who was not permitted to attend the sacrifices was reprimanded, and had part of his territory taken from him.
i0201.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sheyi|不得与于祭者有让，削以地；#1

i0202.text: 得与于祭者有庆，益以地。
i0202.gloss: DE attend in sacrifice NMLZ have congratulation, add by territory
i0202.translation: He who was permitted to attend the sacrifices was congratulated, and received an addition to his territory.
i0202.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sheyi|得与于祭者有庆，益以地。#1

i0203.text: 夫礼，吉凶异道，不得相干，取之阴阳也
i0203.gloss: TOP usage, felicitous unfortunate differ application, NEG DE mutually collide, take 3.OBJ yin yang SFP
i0203.translation: Those usages are different in their applications to felicitous and unfortunate occurrences; in which they should not come into collision with one another - this is derived from (their pattern as given by) the contracting and developing movements in nature.
i0203.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sangfu Sizhi|夫礼，吉凶异道，不得相干，取之阴阳也#1

i0204.text: 贤者不得过，不肖者不得不及
i0204.gloss: worthy NMLZ NEG DE go.beyond, inferior NMLZ NEG DE NEG reach
i0204.translation: The worthiest were not permitted to go beyond this period, nor those who were inferior to them to fall short of it.
i0204.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sangfu Sizhi|贤者不得过，不肖者不得不及#1

i0205.text: 礼以治之，义以正之，孝子弟弟贞妇，皆可得而察焉。
i0205.gloss: rite by regulate 3.OBJ, righteousness by rectify 3.OBJ, filial son respectful younger.brother faithful wife, all can DE CONJ discern there
i0205.translation: The rites regulate the mourning and righteousness rectifies it; in it the filial son, the respectful younger brother, and the faithful wife can all be discerned.
i0205.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Liji|Sangfu Sizhi|礼以治之，义以正之，孝子弟弟贞妇，皆可得而察焉。#1

i0206.text: 世有三亡，而天下得之，其此之謂乎！
i0206.gloss: world have three destruction, CONJ all.under.heaven DE 3.OBJ, surely PROX GEN mean EXCL!
i0206.translation: There are three roads to destruction, and the lords of All-under-Heaven have acquired every one of them — surely this is what that saying means!
i0206.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Chu Jian Qin|世有三亡，而天下得之，其此之謂乎！#1

i0207.text: 令荆人得收亡國，聚散民，立社稷主，置宗廟，令率天下西面以與秦爲難。
i0207.gloss: let Jing people DE recover fallen state, gather scattered populace, set.up altar lord, establish ancestral.temple, let lead all.under.heaven west face to with Qin make trouble
i0207.translation: It let the men of Jing be able to recover their fallen state, gather their scattered populace, set up a lord over the altars of soil and grain, and re-establish the ancestral temple, and it let them lead All-under-Heaven to face west and make trouble for Qin.
i0207.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Chu Jian Qin|令荆人得收亡國，聚散民，立社稷主，置宗廟，令率天下西面以與秦爲難。#1

i0208.text: 夫以大王之明，秦兵之强，弃霸王之業，地曾不可得，乃取欺於亡國，是謀臣之拙也。
i0208.gloss: TOP with great.king GEN brilliance, Qin troop GEN strength, cast.aside hegemon king GEN enterprise, territory even NEG can DE, instead incur deception from doomed state, PROX planning minister GEN ineptitude SFP
i0208.translation: Now, with Your Majesty's brilliance and the strength of Qin's troops, the enterprise of hegemon and king was cast aside, not even territory was obtained, and instead you incurred deception at the hands of a doomed state — this is the ineptitude of your planning ministers.
i0208.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Chu Jian Qin|夫以大王之明，秦兵之强，弃霸王之業，地曾不可得，乃取欺於亡國，是謀臣之拙也。#1

i0209.text: 於是乃潜行而出，反知伯之約，得兩國之衆，以攻知伯，禽其身，以復襄主之初。
i0209.gloss: thereupon then secretly go CONJ exit, reverse Zhibo GEN pact, DE two state GEN force, to attack Zhibo, capture 3.GEN person, to restore Lord.Xiang GEN original.standing
i0209.translation: Thereupon he slipped out in secret, reversed the pact with Zhibo, obtained the forces of the two states, attacked Zhibo with them, took him prisoner, and so restored Lord Xiang to his original standing.
i0209.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Chu Jian Qin|於是乃潜行而出，反知伯之約，得兩國之衆，以攻知伯，禽其身，以復襄主之初。#1

i0210.text: 荆人不動，魏不足患也，則諸侯可蠶食而盡，趙氏可得與敵矣。
i0210.gloss: Jing people NEG stir, Wei NEG sufficient concern SFP, then feudal.lord can piecemeal.devour CONJ exhaust, Zhao clan can DE with adversary PRF
i0210.translation: If the men of Jing do not stir and Wei is no cause for concern, then the feudal lords can be devoured piecemeal until none is left, and Zhao can then be engaged as an adversary.
i0210.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Cun Han|荆人不動，魏不足患也，則諸侯可蠶食而盡，趙氏可得與敵矣。#1

i0211.text: 李斯往詔韓王，未得見，因上書曰：「昔秦、韓勠力一意，以不相侵，天下莫敢犯，如此者數世矣。
i0211.gloss: Li.Si go deliver.edict Han king, not.yet DE see, thereupon submit letter say: formerly Qin, Han join strength one purpose, so.that NEG mutually encroach, world nobody dare offend, like PROX NMLZ several generation PRF
i0211.translation: Li Si went to deliver the royal edict to the King of Han but was not yet able to see him, and so submitted a letter saying: "In former times Qin and Han joined their strength and made their purposes one, so that neither encroached on the other; no one in the world dared offend them, and it has been so for generations now."
i0211.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Cun Han|李斯往詔韓王，未得見，因上書曰：「昔秦、韓勠力一意，以不相侵，天下莫敢犯，如此者數世矣。#1

i0212.text: 韓居中國，地不能滿千里，而所以得與諸侯班位於天下，君臣相保者，以世世相教事秦之力也。
i0212.gloss: Han lie central.land, territory NEG can fill thousand li, CONJ the.reason DE with feudal.lord rank position in world, ruler minister mutually preserve NMLZ, by generation generation mutually teach serve Qin GEN effect SFP
i0212.translation: Han lies in the central lands, its territory not enough to fill a thousand li, and the reason it has been able to hold a place in the ranks of the feudal lords of All-under-Heaven, with ruler and minister preserving each other, is the effect of generation after generation teaching one another to serve Qin.
i0212.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Cun Han|韓居中國，地不能滿千里，而所以得與諸侯班位於天下，君臣相保者，以世世相教事秦之力也。#1

i0213.text: 夫秦、韓不得無同憂，其形可見。
i0213.gloss: TOP Qin, Han NEG DE not.have same anxiety, 3.GEN shape can see
i0213.translation: Qin and Han cannot but share one and the same anxiety; the shape of it can be plainly seen.
i0213.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Cun Han|夫秦、韓不得無同憂，其形可見。#1

i0214.text: 今秦王使臣斯來而不得見，恐左右襲曩姦臣之計，使韓復有亡地之患。
i0214.gloss: now Qin king send servant Si come CONJ NEG DE see, fear attendant revive former treacherous minister GEN scheme, make Han again have lose territory GEN calamity
i0214.translation: Now the King of Qin has sent me, his servant Si, and I have not been able to see Your Majesty; I fear that those around you are reviving the scheme of the treacherous ministers of former days, which would bring upon Han once more the calamity of lost territory.
i0214.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Cun Han|今秦王使臣斯來而不得見，恐左右襲曩姦臣之計，使韓復有亡地之患。#1

i0215.text: 臣斯不得見，請歸報，秦韓之交必絶矣。
i0215.gloss: servant Si NEG DE see, ask return report, Qin Han GEN tie surely sever PRF
i0215.translation: If I, your servant Si, am not able to see Your Majesty and must ask leave to go back and report, the ties between Qin and Han will surely be severed.
i0215.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Cun Han|臣斯不得見，請歸報，秦韓之交必絶矣。#1

i0216.text: 臣斯願得一見，前進道愚計，退就葅戮，願陛下有意焉。
i0216.gloss: servant Si wish DE one audience, forward advance state foolish counsel, withdraw go.to mince execute, hope Your.Majesty have thought there
i0216.translation: I, your servant Si, wish to be allowed a single audience, to come forward and set out my foolish counsel and then withdraw to be minced and put to death; I hope Your Majesty will give the matter thought.
i0216.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Cun Han|臣斯願得一見，前進道愚計，退就葅戮，願陛下有意焉。#1

i0217.text: 臣斯暴身於韓之市，則雖欲察賤臣愚忠之計，不可得已。
i0217.gloss: servant Si expose body in Han GEN market, then although wish examine lowly servant foolish loyal GEN counsel, NEG can DE PRF
i0217.translation: Once your servant Si's body lies exposed in the marketplace of Han, then though you might wish to examine the foolishly loyal counsel of your lowly servant, it could no longer be obtained.
i0217.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Cun Han|臣斯暴身於韓之市，則雖欲察賤臣愚忠之計，不可得已。#1

i0218.text: 若臣斯之所言有不應事實者，願大王幸使得畢辭於前，乃就吏誅不晩也。
i0218.gloss: if servant Si GEN NMLZ say have NEG match fact NMLZ, hope great.king graciously let DE finish word at front, then go.to officer execute NEG late SFP
i0218.translation: If anything I, your servant Si, have said fails to match the facts, I ask that Your Majesty graciously let me be permitted to finish my words in your presence; handing me over to the officers for execution after that would not be too late.
i0218.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Cun Han|若臣斯之所言有不應事實者，願大王幸使得畢辭於前，乃就吏誅不晩也。#1

i0219.text: 秦王飲食不甘，遊觀不樂，意專在圖趙，使臣斯來言，願得身見，因急與陛下有計也。
i0219.gloss: Qin king food drink NEG savor, outing NEG pleasure, mind wholly at plot Zhao, send servant Si come speak, wish DE personally see, because urgent with Your.Majesty have plan SFP
i0219.translation: The King of Qin takes no savor in his food and drink and no pleasure in his outings, his mind fixed wholly on the design against Zhao; he has sent me, his servant Si, to speak, and I wish to be able to see Your Majesty in person, there being an urgent matter to settle with you.
i0219.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Cun Han|秦王飲食不甘，遊觀不樂，意專在圖趙，使臣斯來言，願得身見，因急與陛下有計也。#1

i0220.text: 此四美者，不求諸外，不請於人，議之而得之矣。
i0220.gloss: PROX four excellence NMLZ, NEG seek 3.OBJ.from outside, NEG beg from others, deliberate 3.OBJ CONJ DE 3.OBJ PRF
i0220.translation: These four excellences are not sought from outside and not begged from others: deliberate over them properly and you obtain them.
i0220.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Ai Chen|此四美者，不求諸外，不請於人，議之而得之矣。#1

i0221.text: 是故大臣之禄雖大，不得藉威城市；黨與雖衆，不得臣士卒。
i0221.gloss: therefore high.minister GEN emolument although great, NEG DE use authority city market; faction associate although numerous, NEG DE make.subject officer troop
i0221.translation: Hence, however great a high minister's emolument, he may not use it to build up authority in the cities and markets; however numerous his faction and associates, he may not make subjects of the officers and troops.
i0221.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Ai Chen|是故大臣之禄雖大，不得藉威城市；黨與雖衆，不得臣士卒。#1

i0222.text: 故人臣處國無私朝，居軍無私交，其府庫不得私貸於家。
i0222.gloss: therefore minister dwell state not.have private court, stay army not.have private connection, 3.GEN treasury storehouse NEG DE privately lend to household
i0222.translation: Therefore a minister holds no private court while in the state and keeps no private connections while with the army, and the contents of his treasuries and storehouses may not be lent out privately to households.
i0222.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Ai Chen|故人臣處國無私朝，居軍無私交，其府庫不得私貸於家。#1

i0223.text: 是故不得四從，不載奇兵；非傳非遽，載奇兵革，罪死不赦。
i0223.gloss: therefore NEG DE four retinue, NEG carry irregular weapon; NEG.COP post.relay NEG.COP express, carry irregular weapon armor, crime death NEG pardon
i0223.translation: Hence they may not travel with a retinue of four, nor carry irregular weapons; and if, on business that is neither post-relay nor express, they carry irregular weapons or armor, the crime is death without pardon.
i0223.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Ai Chen|是故不得四從，不載奇兵；非傳非遽，載奇兵革，罪死不赦。#1

i0224.text: 故曰：寂乎其無位而處，漻乎莫得其所。
i0224.gloss: therefore say: still ADVZ 3.GEN not.have position CONJ dwell, limpid ADVZ nobody DE 3.GEN place
i0224.translation: Hence it is said: still, he dwells without occupying any position; limpid, and no one grasps where he is.
i0224.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Zhu Dao|故曰：寂乎其無位而處，漻乎莫得其所。#1

i0225.text: 是故人主有五壅：臣閉其主曰壅，臣制財利曰壅，臣擅行令曰壅，臣得行義曰壅，臣得樹人曰壅。
i0225.gloss: therefore ruler have five obstruction: minister shut.off 3.GEN ruler call obstruction, minister control wealth profit call obstruction, minister arbitrarily issue order call obstruction, minister DE practice righteousness call obstruction, minister DE plant men call obstruction
i0225.translation: Hence the ruler faces five obstructions: when a minister shuts off his ruler, that is an obstruction; when a minister controls wealth and profit, that is an obstruction; when a minister issues orders on his own, that is an obstruction; when a minister is able to practice righteousness on his own account, that is an obstruction; when a minister is able to plant his own men in office, that is an obstruction.
i0225.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Zhu Dao|是故人主有五壅：臣閉其主曰壅，臣制財利曰壅，臣擅行令曰壅，臣得行義曰壅，臣得樹人曰壅。#1

i0226.text: 臣閉其主，則主失位；臣制財利，則主失德；臣擅行令，則主失制；臣得行義，則主失明；臣得樹人，則主失黨。
i0226.gloss: minister shut.off 3.GEN ruler, then ruler lose position; minister control wealth profit, then ruler lose bestowal; minister arbitrarily issue order, then ruler lose control; minister DE practice righteousness, then ruler lose discernment; minister DE plant men, then ruler lose following
i0226.translation: When a minister shuts off his ruler, the ruler loses his position; when a minister controls wealth and profit, the ruler loses the power to bestow; when a minister issues orders on his own, the ruler loses control; when a minister is able to practice righteousness on his own account, the ruler loses his discernment; when a minister is able to plant his own men in office, the ruler loses his following.
i0226.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Zhu Dao|臣閉其主，則主失位；臣制財利，則主失德；臣擅行令，則主失制；臣得行義，則主失明；臣得樹人，則主失黨。#1

i0227.text: 此人主之所以獨擅也，非人臣之所以得操也。
i0227.gloss: PROX ruler GEN NMLZ by alone monopolize SFP, NEG.COP minister GEN NMLZ by DE wield SFP
i0227.translation: These are what the ruler alone monopolizes; they are not what a minister may wield.
i0227.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Zhu Dao|此人主之所以獨擅也，非人臣之所以得操也。#1

i0228.text: 明君之道，臣不得陳言而不當。
i0228.gloss: enlightened ruler GEN way, minister NEG DE set.forth proposal CONJ NEG match
i0228.translation: It is the way of an enlightened ruler that his minister may not set forth a proposal that then fails to match the result.
i0228.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Zhu Dao|明君之道，臣不得陳言而不當。#1

i0229.text: 故審得失有法度之制者，加以羣臣之上，則主不可欺以詐僞；審得失有權衡之稱者，以聽遠事，則主不可欺以天下之輕重。
i0229.gloss: therefore examine DE lose have law measure GEN standard NMLZ, place with assembled.minister GEN above, then ruler NEG can deceive by fraud falsehood; examine DE lose have scale balance GEN weighing NMLZ, to judge distant affair, then ruler NEG can deceive by world GEN light heavy
i0229.translation: Therefore, if one who examines gain and loss by the standard of law and measure is placed above the assembled ministers, the ruler cannot be deceived by fraud and falsehood; and if one who examines gain and loss by the weighing of scale and balance is set to judge distant affairs, the ruler cannot be deceived about the weight of anything in the world.
i0229.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|You Du|故審得失有法度之制者，加以羣臣之上，則主不可欺以詐僞；審得失有權衡之稱者，以聽遠事，則主不可欺以天下之輕重。#1

i0230.text: 爲人臣者，譬之若手，上以脩頭，下以脩足；清暖寒熱，不得不救；鏌鋣傅體，不敢弗搏。
i0230.gloss: be minister NMLZ, liken 3.OBJ like hand, above to tend head, below to tend foot; cool warm cold hot, NEG DE NEG rescue; Moye touch body, NEG dare NEG strike
i0230.translation: One who serves as a minister may be likened to the hands: above they tend the head, below they tend the feet; in cool or warm, cold or heat, they cannot but come to the rescue; and when a Moye blade touches the body, they do not dare fail to strike at it.
i0230.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|You Du|爲人臣者，譬之若手，上以脩頭，下以脩足；清暖寒熱，不得不救；鏌鋣傅體，不敢弗搏。#1

i0231.text: 獨制四海之内，聰智不得用其詐，險躁不得關其佞，姦邪無所依。
i0231.gloss: alone rule four sea GEN within, keen clever NEG DE deploy 3.GEN deceit, treacherous rash NEG DE insinuate 3.GEN flattery, wicked crooked not.have NMLZ rely
i0231.translation: Ruling alone within the four seas, the keen and clever cannot deploy their deceits, the treacherous and rash cannot insinuate their flatteries, and the wicked and crooked have nothing to rely on.
i0231.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|You Du|獨制四海之内，聰智不得用其詐，險躁不得關其佞，姦邪無所依。#1

i0232.text: 故世之姦臣則不然，所惡，則能得之其主而罪之；所愛，則能得之其主而賞之。
i0232.gloss: therefore age GEN treacherous minister then NEG so, NMLZ hate, then can DE 3.OBJ 3.GEN ruler CONJ punish 3.OBJ; NMLZ favor, then can DE 3.OBJ 3.GEN ruler CONJ reward 3.OBJ
i0232.translation: The treacherous ministers of this age, however, are not like that: those they hate, they can obtain the power from their ruler and punish; those they favor, they can obtain the power from their ruler and reward.
i0232.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Er Bing|故世之姦臣則不然，所惡，則能得之其主而罪之；所愛，則能得之其主而賞之。#1

i0233.text: 故明主之畜臣，臣不得越官而有功，不得陳言而不當。
i0233.gloss: therefore enlightened ruler GEN keep minister, minister NEG DE overstep office CONJ have merit, NEG DE set.forth proposal CONJ NEG match
i0233.translation: Therefore, in an enlightened ruler's keeping of ministers, a minister may not overstep his office to achieve merit, and may not set forth a proposal that then fails to match the result.
i0233.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Er Bing|故明主之畜臣，臣不得越官而有功，不得陳言而不當。#1

i0234.text: 守業其官，所言者貞也，則羣臣不得朋黨相爲矣。
i0234.gloss: keep duty 3.GEN office, NMLZ say NMLZ true SFP, then assembled.minister NEG DE clique faction mutually act PRF
i0234.translation: If each keeps to the duties of his office and what he says is true, then the assembled ministers cannot form cliques and factions to act on one another's behalf.
i0234.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Er Bing|守業其官，所言者貞也，則羣臣不得朋黨相爲矣。#1

i0235.text: 人主欲見，則羣臣之情態得其資矣。
i0235.gloss: ruler desire show, then assembled.minister GEN feeling display DE 3.GEN material PRF
i0235.translation: Once the ruler lets his desires show, the ministers' displays of feeling obtain the material they need to work on (the ministers get cues to flatter and deceive the ruler for their own benefits).
i0235.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Er Bing|人主欲見，則羣臣之情態得其資矣。#1

i0236.text: 欲治其内，置而勿親；欲治其外，官置一人；不使自恣，安得移并？
i0236.gloss: wish govern 3.GEN inner, appoint CONJ PROH intimate; wish govern 3.GEN outer, office set one person; NEG let REFL indulge, how DE shift engross?
i0236.translation: If you wish to govern the inner court, appoint men and do not grow intimate with them; if you wish to govern the outer court, set one man over each office; and if none of them is left to act as he pleases, how could they ever shift or engorss your authority?
i0236.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Yang Quan|欲治其内，置而勿親；欲治其外，官置一人；不使自恣，安得移并？#1

i0237.gloss: every government GEN utmost, below NEG can DE
i0237.translation: At the utmost of good government, those below the ruler cannot get illegitimate power or benefit.
i0237.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Yang Quan|凡治之極，下不能得。#1

i0238.gloss: therefore above lose hand.breadth, below DE fathom
i0238.translation: Thus, when the ruler loses a hand's breadth, those below his gain a fathom of power and benefit.
i0238.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Yang Quan|故上失扶寸，下得尋常。#1

i0239.text: 感得大石摇动，百草亚身，瑞鸟灵禽，皆来赞叹。
i0239.gloss: move DE great rock tremble, hundred grass bend body, auspicious bird spiritual creature, all come praise
i0239.translation: (Talking about recitation of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra) Everything was so moved that the great rock trembled, the hundred grasses bent low, and auspicious birds and spiritual creatures all came to offer praise.
i0239.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Lushan Yuangong Hua|感得大石摇动，百草亚身，瑞鸟灵禽，皆来赞叹。#1

i0240.text: 弟子未委和尚从何方而来，得至此间，欲求何事？
i0240.gloss: disciple not.yet understand monk from what place CONJ come, DE arrive PROX place, wish seek what matter?
i0240.translation: I, the diciple, haven't understood where you, the monk, came from; now that you were able to arrive here, what would you want to do?
i0240.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Lushan Yuangong Hua|弟子未委和尚从何方而来，得至此间，欲求何事？#1

i0241.text: 但贫道若得一寺舍伽蓝住持，以免风霜，便是贫道所愿也。
i0241.gloss: just 1SG.HUM if DE one temple serve.as.abbot, to avoid wind frost, then COP 1SG.HUM NMLZ wish SFP
i0241.translation: If I, the humble priest, could obtain a temple to serve as abbot and shelter from the wind and frost, that would be my humble wish.
i0241.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Lushan Yuangong Hua|但贫道若得一寺舍伽蓝住持，以免风霜，便是贫道所愿也。#1

i0242.text: 直至天明，造得一寺，非常有异。
i0242.gloss: right.until dawn, build DE one temple, extraordinary have strange
i0242.translation: By dawn, a temple had been built—truly extraordinary and unlike anything seen before.
i0242.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Lushan Yuangong Hua|直至天明，造得一寺，非常有异。#1

i0243.text: 远公遂以锡杖撅之，方得其水，从地而涌出
i0243.gloss: Yuangong then with staff strike 3.OBJ, only.then DE 3.GEN water, from ground CONJ spring.forth
i0243.translation: Master Yuangong then struck the ground with his staff, and only then did water spring forth from the earth.
i0243.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Lushan Yuangong Hua|远公遂以锡杖撅之，方得其水，从地而涌出#1

i0244.text: 弟子虽听一年，并不会他涅槃经中之义，终也不能说得姓名。
i0244.gloss: disciple although listen one year, at.all NEG understand DIST Nirvana.Sutra within GEN meaning, in.the.end also NEG can say DE name
i0244.translation: Though I, the disciple, have listened for a year, I still do not understand the meaning of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra, and in the end, I cannot even state its name.
i0244.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Lushan Yuangong Hua|弟子虽听一年，并不会他涅槃经中之义，终也不能说得姓名。#1

i0245.text: 何况卒悟众生，闻者如何得会。
