i0300.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|法华和尚闻语，忆得龙王委嘱，不敢久住。#1

i0301.text: 使君忽思量得法华和尚委嘱，限百日之内，合有天分，进一日亡，退一日伤。
i0301.gloss: governor suddenly think DE Fahua monk instruction, limit hundred day GEN within, should have destiny, advance one day die, retreat one day harm
i0301.translation: The governor suddenly remembered the Fahua Monk’s instructions: within one hundred days, destiny would unfold—advance a day too soon, and death would follow; delay a day too long, and harm would be done.
i0301.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|使君忽思量得法华和尚委嘱，限百日之内，合有天分，进一日亡，退一日伤。#1

i0302.text: 我为皇后，荣得奚为，不如服毒先死，免见使君受苦。
i0302.gloss: 1SG be empress, honor DE what do, NEG as.good.as take poison first die, avoid see lord suffer hardship
i0302.translation: I am the empress—what honor is there in that sort of behavior? Better to take poison and die first, than to live to see my lord suffer.
i0302.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|我为皇后，荣得奚为，不如服毒先死，免见使君受苦。#1

i0303.text: 圣人若饮，改卻酒名，唤即甚得，号曰万岁杯
i0303.gloss: sage if drink, change away wine name, call then very DE, name say Ten.Thousand.Years cup
i0303.translation: If a sage were to drink, the name of the wine would be changed; the new name would be most fitting—it would be called the “Cup of Ten Thousand Years.”
i0303.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|圣人若饮，改卻酒名，唤即甚得，号曰万岁杯#1

i0304.text: 皇帝不知药酒，捻得便饮。
i0304.gloss: emperor NEG know medicinal wine, pick.up DE then drink
i0304.translation: The emperor, unaware that it was medicinal wine, picked it up and drank it straight away.
i0304.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|皇帝不知药酒，捻得便饮。#1

i0305.text: 杨妃亦见，拽得灵榇，在龙床底下。
i0305.gloss: Lady.Yang also see, pull DE sacred coffin, at imperial.couch bottom under
i0305.translation: Lady Yang also saw it and pulled out the sacred coffin from beneath the imperial couch.
i0305.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|杨妃亦见，拽得灵榇，在龙床底下。#1

i0306.text: 使君得对，趍过箫墙，拜舞吋呼万岁。
i0306.gloss: governor DE face, hurry pass palace.wall, bow dance shout long.live
i0306.translation: The governor was allowed to face (the emperor); he hurried past the jade-inlaid wall, bowed and danced, and cried out, “Long live the Emperor!”
i0306.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|使君得对，趍过箫墙，拜舞吋呼万岁。#1

i0307.gloss: COP 1SG today NEG escape DE PROX calamity
i0307.translation: It is I who cannot escape this calamity today.
i0307.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|是我今日莫逃得此难。#1

i0308.text: 册立则得，争况合朝大臣，如何即是？
i0308.gloss: invest then DE, how.much.more whole court great.minister, how then right?
i0308.translation: If it were by rightful investiture, then it is proper (justified)—but even the highest ministers of court oppose it. How, then, can it be justified?
i0308.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|册立则得，争况合朝大臣，如何即是？#1

i0309.text: 将军今夜点检御军五百，须得阔刃陌刀，甲幕下埋伏。
i0309.gloss: general tonight muster imperial troop five hundred, must DE broad blade sword, armor tent under ambush
i0309.translation: Tonight, you, the general, summon five hundred imperial troops—broad-bladed swords should be acquired (by the troops), and they are to lie in ambush beneath the armored tents.
i0309.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|将军今夜点检御军五百，须得阔刃陌刀，甲幕下埋伏。#1

i0310.text: 感得四夷归顺，八蛮来降。
i0310.gloss: move DE four border.tribe submit, eight southern.tribe come surrender
i0310.translation: Moved by divine favor, the four border tribes submitted, and the eight southern tribes came to offer surrender.
i0310.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|感得四夷归顺，八蛮来降。#1

i0311.text: 今拟拜将出师剪戮，甚人去得？
i0311.gloss: now plan appoint general dispatch troop suppress, what person go DE?
i0311.translation: Now that a general is to be appointed and troops dispatched to suppress the rebellion—who can take on such a task?
i0311.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|今拟拜将出师剪戮，甚人去得？#1

i0312.text: 启言陛下：“臣愿请军去得。”
i0312.gloss: address say Your.Majesty: servant wish request troop go DE
i0312.translation: He addressed the emperor, saying, “Your Majesty, I wish to request command of the troops so I can undertake the mission.”
i0312.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|启言陛下：“臣愿请军去得。”#1

i0313.text: 有先锋马探得箫磨呵领军二十餘万
i0313.gloss: have vanguard horse scout DE Xiao.Mohe lead army twenty more ten.thousand
i0313.translation: The vanguard scouts reported that Xiao Mohe was leading over two hundred thousand troops.
i0313.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|有先锋马探得箫磨呵领军二十餘万#1

i0314.text: 如今贼军府迫，甚人去得？
i0314.gloss: now rebel army press.close, what person go DE?
i0314.translation: Now that the rebel forces are pressing close, who can go (and face them)?
i0314.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|如今贼军府迫，甚人去得？#1

i0315.text: 若也得胜回过，具表奏闻。
i0315.gloss: if DE victory return, prepare memorial report
i0315.translation: If I obtain victory and return, I will submit a full memorial to report it.
i0315.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|若也得胜回过，具表奏闻。#1

i0316.text: 韩衾虎越班便出，启言将军：“衾虎去得。”
i0316.gloss: Han.Qinhu cross rank then exit, address say general: Qinhu go DE
i0316.translation: Han Qinhu stepped out from the ranks and addressed the general, saying, “Qinhu can go (and face the enemy)!”
i0316.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|韩衾虎越班便出，启言将军：“衾虎去得。”#1

i0317.text: 衾虎得兵，进军便起，迅速不停。
i0317.gloss: Qinhu DE troop, advance army then rise, swift NEG stop
i0317.translation: Once Han Qinhu received the troops, he immediately advanced the army, moving swiftly without pause.
i0317.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|衾虎得兵，进军便起，迅速不停。#1

i0318.text: 探得军机，速便早回，与公重赏。
i0318.gloss: scout DE military.intelligence, quickly then early return, give 2SG.HON heavy reward
i0318.translation: Go acquire intelligence on enemy movements, and return swiftly. You will be richly rewarded.
i0318.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|探得军机，速便早回，与公重赏。#1

i0319.text: 改换衣装，作一百姓装裹，担得一栲栳馒头，直到箫磨呵寨内
i0319.gloss: change clothes, make one commoner dress, carry DE one basket steamed.bun, straight reach Xiao.Mohe camp inside
i0319.translation: He changed his clothes, dressed as a commoner, and carried a basket of steamed buns all the way into Xiao Mohe’s camp.
i0319.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|改换衣装，作一百姓装裹，担得一栲栳馒头，直到箫磨呵寨内#1

i0320.gloss: scout DE military.intelligence, immediately return come
i0320.translation: Having acquired the military intelligence, he returned immediately.
i0320.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|探得军机，即便回来。#1

i0321.text: 到得南岸，应是舟舡，溺在水中，遂卻继自家旗号，显起衾虎之名。
i0321.gloss: arrive DE south shore, should COP boat, drown at water inside, then back continue REFL banner, display rise Qinhu GEN name
i0321.translation: Upon reaching the southern shore, he should have found boats—but was instead cast into the water. He then raised his own banner once more, showing the name of Han Qinhu.
i0321.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|到得南岸，应是舟舡，溺在水中，遂卻继自家旗号，显起衾虎之名。#1

i0322.text: 今有随驾兵仕到来，甚人敌得？
i0322.gloss: now have imperial.guard soldier arrive come, what person resist DE?
i0322.translation: Now that the imperial guard has arrived—who could possibly stand against them?
i0322.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|今有随驾兵仕到来，甚人敌得？#1

i0323.translation: He recalled the instructions entrusted to him by his late father.
i0323.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|忆得亡父委嘱#1

i0324.text: 但衾虎三扙在身，拜跪不得，乞将军不怪。
i0324.gloss: but Qinhu three wound at body, bow kneel NEG DE, beg general NEG blame
i0324.translation: But as Han Qinhu bore three wounds upon his body, he could not bow or kneel, and begged the general not to take offense.
i0324.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|但衾虎三扙在身，拜跪不得，乞将军不怪。#1

i0325.gloss: father NEG DE with son engage.battle
i0325.translation: A father must not engage in battle against his son.
i0325.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|父不得与子交战。#1

i0326.text: 一事未成，回去须得三般之物，进上随文皇帝，即便卻回。
i0326.gloss: one task not.yet complete, return go must DE three CLF GEN item, present up Suiwen emperor, immediately back return
i0326.translation: Since the task is not yet complete, I must return with three specific items to present to Emperor Suiwen, and then I shall come back immediately.
i0326.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|一事未成，回去须得三般之物，进上随文皇帝，即便卻回。#1

i0327.text: 里有硇勾搭索，不得打著，切须记。
i0327.gloss: inside have sulfur hook snare, NEG DE strike touch, earnestly must remember
i0327.translation: Inside there is a sulfur-triggered snare—you must not touch it. You must remember this well.
i0327.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|里有硇勾搭索，不得打著，切须记。#1

i0328.text: 蛮奴领得战残兵士，便入城来。
i0328.gloss: barbarian.servant lead DE battle remnant soldier, then enter city come
i0328.translation: The barbarian servant, leading the remaining battle-worn soldiers, entered the city at once.
i0328.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|蛮奴领得战残兵士，便入城来。#1

i0329.text: 臣愿请军，敢与随驾兵士交战，得胜回过
i0329.gloss: servant wish request troop, dare with imperial.guard soldier engage.battle, DE victory return
i0329.translation: I humbly request command of the troops, and dare to engage the imperial guard in battle—if I obtain victory, I shall return in triumph.
i0329.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|臣愿请军，敢与随驾兵士交战，得胜回过#1

i0330.text: 有先锋使探得周罗侯领军二十餘万，拟劫本主。
i0330.gloss: have vanguard envoy scout DE Zhou.Luohou lead army twenty more ten.thousand, plan raid own lord
i0330.translation: The vanguard scout reported that Zhou Luo Hou was leading over two hundred thousand troops, intending to launch an assault on his own lord.
i0330.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|有先锋使探得周罗侯领军二十餘万，拟劫本主。#1

i0331.text: 当下擒将，假饶卿虽自权军，不得与随驾交战。
i0331.gloss: right.then seize general, even.if 2SG.HON although REFL command army, NEG DE with imperial.guard engage.battle
i0331.translation: The general was immediately seized. Even though you hold command of the troops, you are not permitted to engage the imperial guard in battle.
i0331.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|当下擒将，假饶卿虽自权军，不得与随驾交战。#1

i0332.gloss: Luohou DE letter, full eye tear flow
i0332.translation: When Luo Hou got the letter, his eyes filled with tears.
i0332.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|罗侯得书，满目泪流#1

i0333.text: 我主上犹自擒将，假饶得胜回戈，功归何处？
i0333.gloss: 1SG superior still REFL seize general, even.if DE victory return, merit belong what place?
i0333.translation: If my superior still captures generals himself, then even if I obtain victory and return, to whom would the credit belong?
i0333.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|我主上犹自擒将，假饶得胜回戈，功归何处？#1

i0334.text: 既得主将二人，登途进发，星夜不停，同朝随文皇帝。
i0334.gloss: already DE commanding.general two person, mount road set.off, star night NEG stop, together court Suiwen emperor
i0334.translation: Having obtained the two commanding generals, they set out on their journey, traveling day and night without rest, to accompany Emperor Suiwen.
i0334.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|既得主将二人，登途进发，星夜不停，同朝随文皇帝。#1

i0335.text: 衾虎得对，先进上主将二人，然后迻过箫墙，拜舞吋呼万岁。
i0335.gloss: Qinhu DE face, first present up commanding.general two person, afterwards step pass palace.wall, bow dance shout long.live
i0335.translation: Han Qinhu was allowed to face (the emperor); he first presented the two commanding commanders, then stepped past the inlaid wall, bowed and danced, and cried out, “Long live the Emperor!”
i0335.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|衾虎得对，先进上主将二人，然后迻过箫墙，拜舞吋呼万岁。#1

i0336.text: 前后不经旬日，杨素战箫磨呵得胜回过，直诣閤门。
i0336.gloss: before after NEG pass ten.days, Yang.Su fight Xiao.Mohe DE victory return, straight go palace.gate
i0336.translation: In less than ten days, Yang Su defeated Xiao Mohe in battle and obtained victory and returned, proceeding straight to the palace gates.
i0336.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|前后不经旬日，杨素战箫磨呵得胜回过，直诣閤门。#1

i0337.text: 杨素得对，趍过箫墙，拜舞吋呼万岁。
i0337.gloss: Yang.Su DE face, hurry pass palace.wall, bow dance shout long.live
i0337.translation: Yangsu was allowed to face (the emperor); he stepped past the inlaid wall, bowed and danced, and cried out, “Long live the emperor!"
i0337.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|杨素得对，趍过箫墙，拜舞吋呼万岁。#1

i0338.text: 若解微臣箭得，年年送贡，累岁称臣。
i0338.gloss: if solve humble.servant arrow DE, year year send tribute, many year call servant
i0338.translation: If (someone from your court) can beat me in archery, then our country shall offer tribute year after year and pledge our allegiance for generations to come.
i0338.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|若解微臣箭得，年年送贡，累岁称臣。#1

i0339.text: 若也解箭不得，只在殿前，定其社稷。
i0339.gloss: if solve arrow NEG DE, just at hall front, decide 3.GEN state
i0339.translation: If no one from your court can beat me in archery, then let the matter be decided here and now, before the court, sealing the fate of our state and nation.
i0339.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|若也解箭不得，只在殿前，定其社稷。#1

i0340.text: 皇帝亦见，宣问大臣：“甚人解得？”
i0340.gloss: emperor also see, summon ask minister: what person solve DE?
i0340.translation: The emperor also saw it and summoned his ministers, asking, “Who among you can beat (the envoy in archery)?”
i0340.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|皇帝亦见，宣问大臣：“甚人解得？”#1

i0341.text: 单于接得天使，昇帐而坐
i0341.gloss: Chanyu receive DE imperial.envoy, ascend tent CONJ sit
i0341.translation: The Chanyu received the imperial envoy and ascended to his command tent, where he took his seat.
i0341.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|单于接得天使，昇帐而坐#1

i0342.text: 衾虎接得，思惟中间，忽有双雕，争食飞来。
i0342.gloss: Qinhu catch DE, ponder middle, suddenly have pair eagle, fight food fly come
i0342.translation: Han Qinhu caught it and was deep in thought when suddenly a pair of eagles came flying, fighting over food.
i0342.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|衾虎接得，思惟中间，忽有双雕，争食飞来。#1

i0343.text: 衾虎得对，趍过箫墙，拜舞吋呼万岁。
i0343.gloss: Qinhu DE face, hurry pass palace.wall, bow dance shout long.live
i0343.translation: Qinhu was allowed to face (the emperor); he stepped past the inlaid wall, bowed and danced, and cried out, “Long live the emperor!"
i0343.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|衾虎得对，趍过箫墙，拜舞吋呼万岁。#1

i0344.text: 或遇五道大神，但某请假三日，得之已否？
i0344.gloss: perhaps meet Five.Paths great spirit, only so.and.so request leave three day, DE 3.OBJ already NEG?
i0344.translation: In case I encounter the Great Spirit of the Five Paths, I only ask for three days’ leave—is this allowed or not?
i0344.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|或遇五道大神，但某请假三日，得之已否？#1

i0345.text: 缘鬼神阴司，无人主管，一时一刻不得。
i0345.gloss: because ghost spirit underworld, not.have person supervise, one moment one instant NEG DE
i0345.translation: Because (this is) about the affairs of ghosts, spirits and the underworld, it cannot be allowed that there is no one to supervise, not event for a single moment.
i0345.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|缘鬼神阴司，无人主管，一时一刻不得。#1

i0346.text: 五道将军闻语，哧得浃背汗流。
i0346.gloss: Five.Paths general hear word, frighten DE soak back sweat flow
i0346.translation: Upon hearing the words, the General of the Five Paths broke into a sweat, with perspiration streaming down his back.
i0346.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|五道将军闻语，哧得浃背汗流。#1

i0347.text: 莫道三日，请假一月已来总得。
i0347.gloss: PROH say three day, request leave one month within entirely DE
i0347.translation: Not to mention just three days—requesting leave for one month can also be fully granted.
i0347.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanqinhu Huaben|莫道三日，请假一月已来总得。#1

i0348.text: 傥若得称圣情，万国和光善事。
i0348.gloss: if DE please sovereign heart, ten.thousand realm harmony light good matter
i0348.translation: Should she be able to please the sovereign's heart, all the realms will share in harmony and blessing
i0348.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|傥若得称圣情，万国和光善事。#1

i0349.text: 陛下是万人之主，统领诸邦，何得信受魏陵之言！
i0349.gloss: Your.Majesty COP ten.thousand person GEN lord, rule all realm, how DE believe accept Wei.Ling GEN word!
i0349.translation: Your Majesty, lord of ten thousand men, ruler over all the realms—how can you accept and believe the words of Wei Ling!
i0349.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|陛下是万人之主，统领诸邦，何得信受魏陵之言！#1

i0350.text: 事意不得久停，愿弟急须装束。
i0350.gloss: affair NEG DE long delay, wish brother urgently must make.ready
i0350.translation: This affair cannot be delayed; I beg you, brother, make ready at once.
i0350.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|事意不得久停，愿弟急须装束。#1

i0351.text: 使人得语，便即却回，将绳自缚，乃见平王。
i0351.gloss: messenger DE word, then immediately back return, take rope REFL bind, then see King.Ping
i0351.translation: When the messenger had received the word, he turned straight back, bound himself with rope, and so came before King Ping.
i0351.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|使人得语，便即却回，将绳自缚，乃见平王。#1

i0352.gloss: 1SG die GEN after, wish brother DE survive
i0352.translation: After I die, I wish that my brother may live on.
i0352.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|吾死之后，愿弟得存。#1

i0353.text: 穷洲旅际绝舟船，若为得达江南岸，上苍傥若逆人心，不免此处生留难。
i0353.gloss: desolate sandbar travel edge lack boat, how DE reach river south bank, high.Heaven if oppose human heart, NEG avoid PROX place produce hold.back trouble
i0353.translation: Stranded at the edge of a desolate sandbar with no boat to be had—how can I ever reach the southern bank of the Yangtze? If high Heaven should turn against men's hopes, I shall not escape being held back and beset right here.
i0353.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|穷洲旅际绝舟船，若为得达江南岸，上苍傥若逆人心，不免此处生留难。#1

i0354.text: 黄雀得药封疮，衔白环而相报。
i0354.gloss: yellow sparrow DE medicine seal wound, hold white ring CONJ mutually repay
i0354.translation: The yellow sparrow, having gotten medicine to dress its wound, carried back a white jade ring in repayment.
i0354.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|黄雀得药封疮，衔白环而相报。#1

i0355.text: 我虽贞洁，质素无亏，今于水上泊纱，有幸得逢君子，虽即家中不被备，何惜此之一餐。
i0355.gloss: 1SG although chaste, plain.virtue not.have flaw, today at water on rinse silk, have fortune DE meet gentleman, although home inside NEG PASS provide, why grudge PROX GEN one meal
i0355.translation: Though I am chaste and of unblemished plain virtue, today, rinsing silk here at the water's edge, I have had the good fortune to be able to meet a gentleman; even if my home is ill-provided, why should I grudge this one meal?
i0355.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|我虽贞洁，质素无亏，今于水上泊纱，有幸得逢君子，虽即家中不被备，何惜此之一餐。#1

i0356.text: 及与梁郑二国计会军国，乘肥却返，行至小江，遂被狂贼侵欺，有幸得存。
i0356.gloss: when with Liang Zheng two state concert army state, ride fat back return, go reach small river, then PASS violent bandit invade bully, have fortune DE survive
i0356.translation: When he had finished concerting affairs of state and army with the two states of Liang and Zheng and was riding back on a well-fed horse, he came to a small river, where he fell prey to violent bandits—and only by good fortune was he able to survive.
i0356.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|及与梁郑二国计会军国，乘肥却返，行至小江，遂被狂贼侵欺，有幸得存。#1

i0357.text: 蒙赐一餐堪充饱，未审将何得相报！
i0357.gloss: receive grant one meal enough fill full, not.yet know use what DE mutually repay!
i0357.translation: I have been granted a meal enough to fill me—yet I do not know with what I shall ever be able to repay you!
i0357.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|蒙赐一餐堪充饱，未审将何得相报！#1

i0358.text: 傥若在后得高迁，唯赠百金相殡葬！
i0358.gloss: if at after DE high promote, only give hundred gold mutually bury!
i0358.translation: Should I in days to come be able to rise to high office, I will give a hundred [pieces of] gold to see you properly buried!
i0358.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|傥若在后得高迁，唯赠百金相殡葬！#1

i0359.text: 阿姊抱得弟头，哽咽声嘶，不敢大哭
i0359.gloss: elder.sister hold DE younger.brother head, choke voice hoarse, NEG dare loud weep
i0359.translation: The elder sister cradled her brother's head, choking and hoarse with sobs; not daring to wail aloud.
i0359.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|阿姊抱得弟头，哽咽声嘶，不敢大哭#1

i0360.text: 虽得人身有富贵，父南子北各分张。
i0360.gloss: although DE human body have wealth rank, father south son north each separate
i0360.translation: Though they were able to endow their bodies with wealth and rank, the father and the son were torn apart, one to the south and one to the north.
i0360.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|虽得人身有富贵，父南子北各分张。#1

i0361.text: 行得廿馀里，遂乃眼耳热，遂即画地而卜，占见外甥来趁。
i0361.gloss: walk DE twenty more li, then eye ear hot, then immediately draw ground CONJ divine, divine see nephew come pursue
i0361.translation: When he had walked some twenty-odd li, his eyes and ears grew hot; so he traced [a diagram] on the ground and cast lots, and the divination showed his nephews coming in pursuit.
i0361.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|行得廿馀里，遂乃眼耳热，遂即画地而卜，占见外甥来趁。#1

i0362.text: 我若见楚帝取赏，必得高迁。
i0362.gloss: 1SG if see Chu emperor take reward, surely DE high promote
i0362.translation: If I take the reward from the king of Chu, I shall surely get a high position in the court/government (or 'be able to be promoted to a high position').
i0362.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|我若见楚帝取赏，必得高迁。#1

i0363.text: 葳蕤怯弱，石胆难当，夫怕逃人，茱萸得脱。
i0363.gloss: Solomon's.seal timid frail, stone.gall hard face, P fear fugitive, cornel DE escape
i0363.translation: The Solomon's-seal is timid and frail, the stone-gall hard to face; fearing the fugitive, the cornel managed to slip free.
i0363.note: part of a poem that is very hard to understand
i0363.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|葳蕤怯弱，石胆难当，夫怕逃人，茱萸得脱。#1

i0364.text: 红颜憔悴不如常，相思落泪何曾歇，年光虚掷守空闺，谁能渡得芳菲节。
i0364.gloss: rosy face haggard NEG like usual, mutual longing fall tear when ever cease, year light vainly throw keep empty chamber, who can cross DE fragrant season
i0364.translation: Her rosy face is worn, no longer as it was; pining, her tears fall—when have they ever ceased? The years are squandered as she keeps a lonely chamber: who can endure her way through the season of blossoms [alone]?
i0364.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|红颜憔悴不如常，相思落泪何曾歇，年光虚掷守空闺，谁能渡得芳菲节。#1

i0365.text: 今缘事急往江东，不得停留复日夜。
i0365.gloss: now because matter urgent go Jiangdong, NEG DE linger again day night
i0365.translation: Now, because the matter is urgent, I go to Jiangdong; I cannot linger here another day or night.
i0365.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|今缘事急往江东，不得停留复日夜。#1

i0366.text: 忽忆父兄枉被诛，即得五内心肠烂。
i0366.gloss: suddenly recall father brother wrongly PASS execute, then DE five viscera heart bowel rot
i0366.translation: Suddenly recalling that his father and brother had been wrongly put to death, he was thereupon so [consumed with grief] that his five viscera and his very bowels seemed to rot away.
i0366.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|忽忆父兄枉被诛，即得五内心肠烂。#1

i0367.text: 悲歌已了，行至江边远盼，唯见江潭广阔，如何得渡！
i0367.gloss: sad song already finish, walk reach river side far gaze, only see river pool broad, how DE cross!
i0367.translation: His song of grief once ended, he walked to the riverside and gazed into the distance; he saw only the broad expanse of the river—how can he ever cross it!
i0367.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|悲歌已了，行至江边远盼，唯见江潭广阔，如何得渡！#1

i0368.text: 吾闻麒麟得食，日行千里。
i0368.gloss: 1SG hear qilin DE food, day travel thousand li
i0368.translation: I have heard that when the qilin gets food, it travels a thousand li in a day.
i0368.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|吾闻麒麟得食，日行千里。#1

i0369.gloss: phoenix DE food, fly soar four sea
i0369.translation: When the phoenix gets food, it soars across the four seas.
i0369.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|凤凰得食，飞腾四海。#1

i0370.text: 子胥闻得此语，即与鱼人看船。
i0370.gloss: Zixu hear DE PROX word, immediately with fisherman look boat
i0370.translation: When Zixu had taken in these words, he went with the fisherman to look at the boat.
i0370.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|子胥闻得此语，即与鱼人看船。#1

i0371.text: 其鱼人乃取得美酒一榼，鱼肉五斤，薄饼十番，饭携一罐
i0371.gloss: DIST fisherman then fetch DE fine wine one flask, fish meat five catty, flatcake ten CLF, rice carry one jar
i0371.translation: The fisherman then fetched a flask of fine wine, five catties of fish and meat, ten flatcakes, and a jar of rice
i0371.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|其鱼人乃取得美酒一榼，鱼肉五斤，薄饼十番，饭携一罐#1

i0372.text: 子胥得食吃足，心自思惟
i0372.gloss: Zixu DE food eat full, heart REFL ponder
i0372.translation: Zixu got food and ate his fill, and in his heart he pondered to himself.
i0372.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|子胥得食吃足，心自思惟#1

i0373.text: 凡人得他一食，惭人一色
i0373.gloss: ordinary person DE other one meal, ashamed person one share
i0373.translation: When an ordinary man gets a single meal from another, he owes that person a debt of gratitude.
i0373.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|凡人得他一食，惭人一色#1

i0374.gloss: DE person two meal, for 3SG exert.effort
i0374.translation: Get two meals from someone, and you exert yourself on his behalf.
i0374.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|得人两食，为他著力。#1

i0375.gloss: 2SG.HON defect Wu state, surely DE pass.through
i0375.translation: If you defect the state of Wu, you will surely be able to make your way through.
i0375.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|子投吴国，必得流通。#1

i0376.text: 吴与楚国数为征战，无有贤臣，得子甚要。
i0376.gloss: Wu and Chu state repeatedly make war, not.have worthy minister, DE 2SG.HON very vital
i0376.translation: Wu and Chu have warred again and again, and [Wu] has no worthy minister; to obtain you would be most vital.
i0376.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|吴与楚国数为征战，无有贤臣，得子甚要。#1

i0377.gloss: Wu state how can defect DE?
i0377.translation: The state of Wu—how can one manage to defect to it?
i0377.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|吴国如何可投得？#1

i0378.text: 虑恐楚使相逢，不得久停，至岸即发。
i0378.gloss: worry fear Chu envoy mutually meet, NEG DE long linger, reach bank immediately set.off
i0378.translation: Fearing he might run into envoys of Chu, he could not linger long, and set off the moment he reached the bank.
i0378.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|虑恐楚使相逢，不得久停，至岸即发。#1

i0379.text: 望吴邦兮不可到，思帝乡兮怀恨深，傥值明主得迁达，施展英雄一片心。
i0379.gloss: gaze Wu land SFP NEG can reach, long sovereign country SFP harbor regret deep, if meet enlightened lord DE advance, unfold hero one CLF heart
i0379.translation: I gaze toward the land of Wu, which I cannot reach; I long for my sovereign's country, harboring deep regret. Should I meet an enlightened lord and be able to advance, I would unfold the whole heart of a hero.
i0379.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|望吴邦兮不可到，思帝乡兮怀恨深，傥值明主得迁达，施展英雄一片心。#1

i0380.text: 愿我平安达前所，行无滞碍得通流；傥若吴中遇明主，兴兵先斩魏陵头。
i0380.gloss: wish 1SG safe reach front place, journey not.have hindrance DE flow.onward; if Wu within meet enlightened lord, raise troop first cut Wei.Ling head
i0380.translation: May I reach my destination in safety, my journey free of all hindrance and able to flow onward; should I meet an enlightened lord in Wu, I will raise troops and first strike off Wei Ling's head.
i0380.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|愿我平安达前所，行无滞碍得通流；傥若吴中遇明主，兴兵先斩魏陵头。#1

i0381.text: 为朕传语，虽不先相识，欲得相见，面申怀抱。
i0381.gloss: for 1SG.HON convey word, although NEG before mutually know, wish DE mutually see, face express heart
i0381.translation: Convey word for me: though we have not been acquainted before, I wish to be able to see him face to face and lay open what is in my heart.
i0381.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|为朕传语，虽不先相识，欲得相见，面申怀抱。#1

i0382.text: 使人得其又敕，走马直入市中，见子胥具说吴王又敕。
i0382.gloss: messenger DE 3.GEN further decree, gallop horse straight enter market inside, see Zixu fully tell Wu king further decree
i0382.translation: When the messenger had received this further decree, he galloped straight into the marketplace, found Zixu, and recounted in full the king of Wu's further decree.
i0382.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|使人得其又敕，走马直入市中，见子胥具说吴王又敕。#1

i0383.text: 治国四年，感得景龙应瑞，赤雀衔书，芝草并生，嘉禾合秀。
i0383.gloss: govern state four year, move DE radiant dragon answer portent, red sparrow hold writing, magic.fungus together grow, fine grain together flower
i0383.translation: After he had governed the realm four years, [his rule] so moved [Heaven] that radiant dragons answered with portents: red sparrows held writings in their beaks, magic fungus sprang up, and fine grain flowered in clusters.
i0383.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|治国四年，感得景龙应瑞，赤雀衔书，芝草并生，嘉禾合秀。#1

i0384.text: 榜示七日，募得九十万精兵。
i0384.gloss: post.notice show seven day, recruit DE ninety ten.thousand crack troop
i0384.translation: He posted notices for seven days and recruited nine hundred thousand crack troops.
i0384.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|榜示七日，募得九十万精兵。#1

i0385.text: 西军大败，遍野横尸，干戈不得施张，人马重重相压。
i0385.gloss: west army greatly defeat, all.over field strewn corpse, shield spear NEG DE deploy, man horse layer layer mutually crush
i0385.translation: The western army was utterly routed; corpses lay strewn across the open country. Shield and spear could not be brought to bear, and men and horses, piled layer upon layer, crushed one another.
i0385.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|西军大败，遍野横尸，干戈不得施张，人马重重相压。#1

i0386.text: 今取你父骸骨，及你生身，祭我父兄灵魂始得。
i0386.gloss: now take 2SG father bone, and 2SG living body, sacrifice 1SG father brother soul only.then DE
i0386.translation: Now I will take your father's bones, and your own living body, and offer them in sacrifice to the souls of my father and brother—only then will I be satisfied.
i0386.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|今取你父骸骨，及你生身，祭我父兄灵魂始得。#1

i0387.text: 子胥捉得魏陵，脔割捥取心肝，万斩一身，并诛九族。
i0387.gloss: Zixu seize DE Wei.Ling, slice cut gouge take heart liver, ten.thousand hack one body, also execute nine kindred
i0387.translation: Zixu seized Wei Ling, sliced and gouged out his heart and liver, hacked his body ten thousand times, and put his nine kindred to death.
i0387.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|子胥捉得魏陵，脔割捥取心肝，万斩一身，并诛九族。#1

i0388.text: 遂乃偃息停流，取得平王骸骨。
i0388.gloss: then subside stop current, take DE King.Ping bone
i0388.translation: Then he made [the river] subside and its current cease, and recovered the bones of King Ping.
i0388.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|遂乃偃息停流，取得平王骸骨。#1

i0389.text: 子胥祭了，发声大哭，感得日月无光，江河混沸。
i0389.gloss: Zixu sacrifice finish, utter voice loud weep, move DE sun moon not.have light, river turbid boil
i0389.translation: When Zixu had finished the sacrifice, he lifted his voice in loud weeping, [and his grief] so moved [Heaven] that the sun and moon lost their light and the rivers boiled in turmoil.
i0389.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|子胥祭了，发声大哭，感得日月无光，江河混沸。#1

i0390.text: 子胥寻觅父兄骸不得，立树乃作父兄
i0390.gloss: Zixu search father brother bone NEG DE, set.up tree then make father brother
i0390.translation: When Zixu searched for his father and brother's bones but could not find them, he set up trees [in effigy] to stand for father and brother.
i0390.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|子胥寻觅父兄骸不得，立树乃作父兄#1

i0391.text: 郑王得信，忙怕异常，莫知何计。
i0391.gloss: Zheng king DE news, alarm fear extraordinary, NEG know what plan
i0391.translation: When the king of Zheng got the news, he was thrown into extraordinary alarm and knew not what to do.
i0391.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|郑王得信，忙怕异常，莫知何计。#1

i0392.text: 遂召秘略之人：“止得吴军兵者，分国共治，更赐千金。”
i0392.gloss: then summon secret stratagem GEN person: stop DE Wu army troop NMLZ, divide state jointly rule, further grant thousand gold
i0392.translation: Then he summoned men of secret stratagems: "Whoever can halt the troops of the Wu army, I will share the realm with him to rule jointly, and grant him a thousand [pieces of] gold besides."
i0392.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|遂召秘略之人：“止得吴军兵者，分国共治，更赐千金。”#1

i0393.text: 臣能止得吴军，不须寸兵尺剑，唯须小船一只，棹椑一枚，鲍鱼一双，麦饭一瓯，美酒一榼，放在城东水中，臣自有其方法。
i0393.gloss: servant can stop DE Wu army, NEG need inch weapon foot sword, only need small boat one CLF, oar one CLF, salted.fish one pair, barley rice one bowl, fine wine one flask, put at city east water inside, servant REFL have 3.GEN method
i0393.translation: I can halt the Wu army with not an inch of blade nor a foot of sword. I need only a single small boat, one oar[-cask], a pair of salted fish, a bowl of barley rice, and a flask of fine wine, set in the water east of the city; I have my own method.
i0393.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|臣能止得吴军，不须寸兵尺剑，唯须小船一只，棹椑一枚，鲍鱼一双，麦饭一瓯，美酒一榼，放在城东水中，臣自有其方法。#1

i0394.text: 其郑王闭却城西门，城头遥看，设何方计，却得吴军。
i0394.gloss: DIST Zheng king shut away city west gate, wall top far watch, devise what scheme, repel DE Wu army
i0394.translation: The king of Zheng shut the western gate of the city and watched from afar atop the wall, [wondering] by what scheme he could drive the Wu army back.
i0394.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|其郑王闭却城西门，城头遥看，设何方计，却得吴军。#1

i0395.text: 我有冤雠，至当相灭，因他得活，岂得辜恩！
i0395.gloss: 1SG have grievance, ought.by.rights mutually destroy, because 3SG DE live, how DE betray kindness!
i0395.translation: I have a grievance to avenge and ought by rights to destroy my foes—but because of him I was able to live; how could I betray such kindness!
i0395.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|(1)我有冤雠，至当相灭，因他得活，岂得辜恩！#1

i0396.text: 我有冤雠，至当相灭，因他得活，岂得辜恩！
i0396.gloss: 1SG have grievance, ought.by.rights mutually destroy, because 3SG DE live, how DE betray kindness!
i0396.translation: I have a grievance to avenge and ought by rights to destroy my foes—but because of him I was able to live; how could I betray such kindness!
i0396.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|(2)我有冤雠，至当相灭，因他得活，岂得辜恩！#1

i0397.text: 子胥控马笼鞭，就水抱得小儿，拍搦悲啼吊问：“汝父沈溺深江，荼毒奈何奈何，愿子莫怀雠恨！”
i0397.gloss: Zixu rein horse gather whip, approach water scoop DE little child, pat clasp sad weep console: 2SG father sink drown deep river, bitter.sorrow what.to.do what.to.do, wish 2SG.HON PROH harbor rancor!
i0397.translation: Zixu reined in his horse and gathered his whip, approached the water, and scooped up the little boy; patting and clasping him, weeping in grief, he consoled him: "Your father drowned in the deep river—what bitter sorrow, what bitter sorrow! I beg you, child, harbor no rancor!"
i0397.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|子胥控马笼鞭，就水抱得小儿，拍搦悲啼吊问：“汝父沈溺深江，荼毒奈何奈何，愿子莫怀雠恨！”#1

i0398.text: 郑王怕惧，乃出城迎拜子胥，向前言曰："臣闻将军雠冤得达，憙贺快哉！"
i0398.gloss: Zheng king fear dread, then exit city greet bow Zixu, toward front speak say: servant hear general vengeance DE fulfill, joy congratulate glad EXCL!
i0398.translation: The king of Zheng, in dread, came out of the city to greet and bow to Zixu, and addressing him said: "I have heard that the general's vengeance has been able to be fulfilled—what joyful, gladdening news!"
i0398.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|郑王怕惧，乃出城迎拜子胥，向前言曰："臣闻将军雠冤得达，憙贺快哉！"#1

i0399.text: 大将军得充雠心，灭其宗庙，快哉踊跃，憙贺不胜！
i0399.gloss: great general DE fill vengeful heart, raze 3.GEN ancestral.shrine, glad EXCL leap, joy congratulate NEG bear!
i0399.translation: The great general has been able to glut his vengeful heart and to raze their ancestral shrines—what gladness, leaping with joy, congratulations beyond measure!
i0399.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|大将军得充雠心，灭其宗庙，快哉踊跃，憙贺不胜！#1

i0400.text: 我被郑王召募，被吴军来伐，能却得吴军兵者，赐金千斤、封邑万户。
i0400.gloss: 1SG PASS Zheng king call.up, PASS Wu army come attack, can repel DE Wu army troop NMLZ, grant gold thousand catty, enfeoff town ten.thousand household
i0400.translation: I have been called up by the king of Zheng [now that he is] under attack by the Wu army: whoever can repel the troops of the Wu army will be granted a thousand catties of gold and a fief of ten thousand households.
i0400.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|我被郑王召募，被吴军来伐，能却得吴军兵者，赐金千斤、封邑万户。#1

i0401.gloss: DE other one meal, ashamed person one share
i0401.translation: Get a single meal from another, and you owe that person your gratitude.
i0401.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|得他一食，惭人一色#1

i0402.gloss: DE other two meal, thank 3SG NEG enough
i0402.translation: Get two meals from someone, and no thanks you give will be enough.
i0402.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|得他两食，谢他不足。#1

i0403.text: 子胥心又思量：“我有冤雠，端心相灭，因他得活，岂得孤恩。”
i0403.gloss: Zixu heart again ponder: 1SG have grievance, set.heart mutually destroy, because 3SG DE live, how DE betray kindness
i0403.translation: In his heart Zixu pondered once more: "I have a grievance to avenge and have set my heart on destroying my foes—but because of him I was able to live; how could I betray such kindness."
i0403.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|(1)子胥心又思量：“我有冤雠，端心相灭，因他得活，岂得孤恩。”#1

i0404.text: 子胥心又思量：“我有冤雠，端心相灭，因他得活，岂得孤恩。”
i0404.gloss: Zixu heart again ponder: 1SG have grievance, set.heart mutually destroy, because 3SG DE live, how DE betray kindness
i0404.translation: In his heart Zixu pondered once more: "I have a grievance to avenge and have set my heart on destroying my foes—but because of him I was able to live; how could I betray such kindness."
i0404.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|(2)子胥心又思量：“我有冤雠，端心相灭，因他得活，岂得孤恩。”#1

i0405.text: 吴王闻子胥得胜，遂即从骑迎来。
i0405.gloss: Wu king hear Zixu DE victory, then immediately follow ride greet come
i0405.translation: When the king of Wu heard that Zixu had won the victory, he at once came riding with his retinue to greet him.
i0405.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|吴王闻子胥得胜，遂即从骑迎来。#1

i0406.text: 俗捧昆仑之压卵，何得不摧；执炬火以焚毛，如何不尽？
i0406.gloss: common.folk hold Kunlun GEN press egg, how DE NEG crush; hold torch fire to burn hair, how NEG exhaust?
i0406.translation: It is as when the common folk set Mount Kunlun to press upon an egg—how could it not be crushed? Or take a blazing torch to burn off hair—how should it not be wholly consumed?
i0406.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|俗捧昆仑之压卵，何得不摧；执炬火以焚毛，如何不尽？#1

i0407.gloss: servant see PROX wound, vengeful heart DE stop
i0407.translation: Now that I have seen this wound, my vengeful heart can be at rest.
i0407.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|臣见此伤，雠心得止。#1

i0408.gloss: king GEN power, DE satisfy vengeful heart
i0408.translation: By the king's power, I am able to satisfy my vengeful heart.
i0408.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|王之势力，得惬雠心。#1

i0409.text: 天道相助，得已灭楚归吴；所有功勋，朕自优加处分。
i0409.gloss: Heaven Way mutually help, DE already destroy Chu return Wu; all merit, 1SG.HON REFL generously add reward
i0409.translation: With the Way of Heaven to aid me, I was able to destroy Chu and return to Wu; as for all the merit earned, I will myself reward it generously.
i0409.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|天道相助，得已灭楚归吴；所有功勋，朕自优加处分。#1

i0410.text: 子胥得王之剑，报诸百官等：“我死之后，割取我头，悬安城东门上，我当看越军来伐吴国者哉！”
i0410.gloss: Zixu DE king GEN sword, announce all hundred official PL: 1SG die GEN after, cut take 1SG head, hang place city east gate on, 1SG shall watch Yue army come attack Wu state NMLZ EXCL!
i0410.translation: Zixu received the king's sword and announced to the assembled officials: "After I die, cut off my head and mount it above the eastern gate of the city, so that I may watch the army of Yue come to attack the state of Wu!"
i0410.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|子胥得王之剑，报诸百官等：“我死之后，割取我头，悬安城东门上，我当看越军来伐吴国者哉！”#1

i0411.text: 今有佞臣宰彼，可以货求必得。
i0411.gloss: now have sycophantic minister Zai.Pi, can with bribe seek surely DE
i0411.translation: Now there is the sycophantic minister Zai Pi: he can be sought after with bribes and is sure to be won over.
i0411.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|今有佞臣宰彼，可以货求必得。#1

i0412.text: 范蠡启言王曰：“宰彼好之金宝，好之美女，得此物必是开路，更无疑虑。”
i0412.gloss: Fan.Li address say king say: Zai.Pi love P gold treasure, love P beautiful woman, DE PROX thing surely COP open road, further not.have doubt
i0412.translation: Fan Li addressed the king: "Zai Pi loves gold and treasure, loves beautiful women; obtaining these things will surely open the way, with nothing further to doubt."
i0412.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|范蠡启言王曰：“宰彼好之金宝，好之美女，得此物必是开路，更无疑虑。”#1

i0413.text: 越王取得此物，即差勇猛之人，往向吴国，赠与宰彼。
i0413.gloss: Yue king obtain DE PROX thing, immediately dispatch bold fierce GEN person, go toward Wu state, present to Zai.Pi
i0413.translation: Once the king of Yue had procured these things, he dispatched bold and fierce men to go to the state of Wu and present them to Zai Pi.
i0413.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|越王取得此物，即差勇猛之人，往向吴国，赠与宰彼。#1

i0414.text: 其兵总饮河水，例闻水中有酒气味，兵吃河水，皆得醉。
i0414.gloss: 3.GEN soldier all drink river water, as.a.rule smell water inside have wine aroma, soldier drink river water, all DE drunk
i0414.translation: His soldiers all drank the river water—as a rule they could smell a wine-like aroma in it—and when the soldiers drank the river water, they all got drunk.
i0414.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Wuzixu Bianwen|其兵总饮河水，例闻水中有酒气味，兵吃河水，皆得醉。#1

i0415.text: 二将当时夜半越对，謼得皇帝洽背汗流。
i0415.gloss: two general at.time midnight present.audience, shout DE emperor drench back sweat flow
i0415.translation: At midnight the two generals presented themselves for an audience, [and their] shouting so [startled] the emperor that sweat streamed down and drenched his back.
i0415.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|二将当时夜半越对，謼得皇帝洽背汗流。#1

i0416.text: 汉帝谓二人曰：“朕之无其诏命，何得夜半二人越对！”
i0416.gloss: Han emperor tell two person say: 1SG.HON GEN not.have 3.GEN summons, how DE midnight two person present.audience!
i0416.translation: The Han emperor said to the two men: "Without any summons from me, how can two men present themselves for an audience in the dead of night!"
i0416.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|汉帝谓二人曰：“朕之无其诏命，何得夜半二人越对！”#1

i0417.text: 遂诏二大臣，附近殿前：“莫朕无天分，一任上殿，摽寡人首，送与西楚霸王亦得！”
i0417.gloss: then summon two great minister, near hall front: if 1SG.HON not.have mandate, freely ascend hall, strike 1SG.HUM head, send to Western.Chu Hegemon-King also DE!
i0417.translation: Then he summoned the two great ministers near the front of the hall: "If I lack the Mandate of Heaven, then by all means come up into the hall, strike off my head, and send it to the Hegemon-King of Western Chu—that too would be acceptable!"
i0417.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|遂诏二大臣，附近殿前：“莫朕无天分，一任上殿，摽寡人首，送与西楚霸王亦得！”#1

i0418.text: 陵语：“大夫今夜出，楚家军号总须翻，选拣诸臣去不得，将军掼甲速攀鞍。”
i0418.gloss: Ling say: grandee tonight go.out, Chu side army password all must switch, select all official go NEG DE, general don armor quickly mount saddle
i0418.translation: Ling said: "Grandee, going out tonight, the Chu army's passwords will all have to be switched; the officials picked [for it] cannot go. General, don your armor and mount with all speed."
i0418.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|陵语：“大夫今夜出，楚家军号总须翻，选拣诸臣去不得，将军掼甲速攀鞍。”#1

i0419.gloss: two general hear DE PROX matter
i0419.translation: The two generals heard this matter.
i0419.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|二将听得此事。#1

i0420.gloss: because what matter DE reach PROX place?
i0420.translation: "On what business were you able to get here?"
i0420.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|“缘甚事得到此间？”#1

i0421.gloss: Ji.Bu answer say: have password outside show DE
i0421.translation: Ji Bu answered: "I have the password—it may be shown from outside."
i0421.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|季布答曰：“有号外示得。”#1

i0422.gloss: camp already enter DE, password also steal DE
i0422.translation: The camp had already been broken into, and the password had been filched as well.
i0422.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|营已入得，号又偷得。#1

i0423.text: 凡人斫营，捉得个知更官健，斩为三段，唤作厌兵之法
i0423.gloss: whenever person raid camp, catch DE CLF night.watch officer, cut into three piece, call as cow.enemy GEN method
i0423.translation: When a man raids a camp and catches a night-watch officer, he cuts him into three pieces—this is called the method for cowing the enemy.
i0423.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|凡人斫营，捉得个知更官健，斩为三段，唤作厌兵之法#1

i0424.text: 若捉他知更官健不得，火急出营，莫落他楚家奸。
i0424.gloss: if catch DIST night.watch officer NEG DE, fire urgent exit camp, PROH fall DIST Chu side trap
i0424.translation: If you cannot catch that night-watch officer, get out of the camp in all haste, and do not fall into the Chu side's trap.
i0424.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|若捉他知更官健不得，火急出营，莫落他楚家奸。#1

i0425.text: 便遂乃揭却一幕，捉得知更官健，横驼竖拽，到王陵面前。
i0425.gloss: then thereupon lift away one tent.flap, catch DE night.watch officer, sideways carry upright drag, reach Wang.Ling face front
i0425.translation: Then they lifted aside a tent-flap, caught the night-watch officer, hauled him this way and that, and brought him before Wang Ling.
i0425.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|便遂乃揭却一幕，捉得知更官健，横驼竖拽，到王陵面前。#1

i0426.text: 王陵谓灌婴曰：“大难过了，更有小难，如何过得？”
i0426.gloss: Wang.Ling tell Guan.Ying say: great peril pass PFV, still have small peril, how pass DE?
i0426.translation: Wang Ling said to Guan Ying: "The great peril is past, but there is still a lesser one—how can we get through it?"
i0426.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|王陵谓灌婴曰：“大难过了，更有小难，如何过得？”#1

i0427.text: 灌婴答曰：“大夫斫营得胜，却归汉朝，何者以为小难？”
i0427.gloss: Guan.Ying answer say: grandee raid camp DE victory, then return Han court, what NMLZ take.as small peril?
i0427.translation: Guan Ying answered: "Grandee, we raided the camp and won the victory, then return to the Han court—what is there to count as a lesser peril?"
i0427.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|灌婴答曰：“大夫斫营得胜，却归汉朝，何者以为小难？”#1

i0428.text: 陵当有其一计，必合过得！
i0428.gloss: Ling indeed have 3.GEN one plan, surely should pass DE!
i0428.translation: Ling does have a plan for it—we are sure to be able to get through!
i0428.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|陵当有其一计，必合过得！#1

i0429.text: 见有三十六人斫营，捉得三十四人，更少二人，便须捉得。

i0429.translation: It was seen that thirty-six men raided the camp; thirty-four had been caught, two still short, so the rest had to be caught.
i0429.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|见有三十六人斫营，捉得三十四人，更少二人，便须捉得。#1

i0430.text: 更须捉得两人，便请同行
i0430.gloss: further must catch DE two person, then invite together go
i0430.translation: Two more men had to be caught, then we would have them come along
i0430.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|更须捉得两人，便请同行#1

i0431.text: 兵马挍多，趁到界首，归去不得，便往却回
i0431.gloss: troop horse rather many, pursue reach border edge, return go NEG DE, then go back return
i0431.translation: The troops and horses being rather many, they pursued [them] to the edge of the border, but could not get back; so they turned around and went back
i0431.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|兵马挍多，趁到界首，归去不得，便往却回#1

i0432.text: 二将答曰：“又称四更已来捉得。”
i0432.gloss: two general answer say: also report fourth.watch around catch DE
i0432.translation: The two generals answered: "[They] further reported that around the fourth watch he had been caught."
i0432.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|二将答曰：“又称四更已来捉得。”#1

i0433.gloss: Hegemon-King ask say: catch DE NEG DE?
i0433.translation: The Hegemon-King asked: "Did you capture him, or not?"
i0433.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|霸王问曰：“捉得不得？”#1

i0434.text: 楚王曰：“王陵斫营得胜却归汉朝，甚处捉他？”
i0434.gloss: Chu king say: Wang.Ling raid camp DE victory back return Han court, what place catch 3SG?
i0434.translation: The king of Chu said: "Wang Ling raided the camp, won the victory, and returned to the Han court—where would we catch him?"
i0434.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|楚王曰：“王陵斫营得胜却归汉朝，甚处捉他？”#1

i0435.text: 将来营内，若楚蒸煮疗治，待捉王陵不得之时，取死不晚。
i0435.gloss: bring.come camp inside, if Chu steam boil torment, wait catch Wang.Ling NEG DE GEN time, take death NEG late
i0435.translation: Bring her into the camp; if Chu should boil her in torment, then by the time they still cannot capture Wang Ling, it will not be too late to put her to death.
i0435.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|将来营内，若楚蒸煮疗治，待捉王陵不得之时，取死不晚。#1

i0436.text: 三魂真遣掌前飞，收什精神听我语：“何得交儿仕汉王，窃盗偷踪斫营去！
i0436.gloss: three soul truly send palm front fly, gather wits spirit listen 1SG word: how DE let son serve Han king, steal sneak track raid camp go!
i0436.translation: Her three souls were truly sent flying before his palm; gather your wits and hear my words: "How could you let your son serve the king of Han, stealing about in secret and going off to raid the camp!"
i0436.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|三魂真遣掌前飞，收什精神听我语：“何得交儿仕汉王，窃盗偷踪斫营去！#1

i0437.text: 若不得王陵入楚来，常向此间为受苦。
i0437.gloss: if NEG DE Wang.Ling enter Chu come, always at PROX place be suffer hardship
i0437.translation: If I cannot bring Wang Ling over into Chu, she will be made to suffer here forever.
i0437.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|若不得王陵入楚来，常向此间为受苦。#1

i0438.text: 交卿绥州茶城村捉得王陵母到来，儿又不招，更出无限言语，抵忤寡人。
i0438.gloss: let 2SG.HON Suizhou Chacheng village catch DE Wang.Ling mother arrive come, son still NEG submit, further utter endless word, defy 1SG.HUM
i0438.translation: I bade you capture Wang Ling's mother at Chacheng village in Suizhou and bring her here, yet the son still will not submit, and pours out endless words to defy and affront me.
i0438.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|交卿绥州茶城村捉得王陵母到来，儿又不招，更出无限言语，抵忤寡人。#1

i0439.text: 回头乃报楚家将：“大须归家著乡土，一朝儿郎偷得高皇号，还解捉你儿郎母。”
i0439.gloss: turn head then declare Chu side general: greatly must return home to native soil, one morning lad steal DE emperor sign, still able catch 2SG lad mother
i0439.translation: Turning her head, she then declared to the Chu generals: "You had best go home to your native soil; the moment my lad has filched the emperor's pass-sign, he will yet be able to seize you lads' mothers."
i0439.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|回头乃报楚家将：“大须归家著乡土，一朝儿郎偷得高皇号，还解捉你儿郎母。”#1

i0440.text: 卢绾得对，拜舞礼讫，霸王便问：“汉主来时万福？”
i0440.gloss: Lu.Wan DE face, bow dance rite finish, Hegemon-King then ask: Han lord come time well?
i0440.translation: Lu Wan was allowed audience (with the King); when the rites of bowing and the ceremonial dance were done, the Hegemon-King then asked: "Was the lord of Han in good health when he set out?"
i0440.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|卢绾得对，拜舞礼讫，霸王便问：“汉主来时万福？”#1

i0441.text: 卢绾接得金十斤，便辞楚王：“臣当送书，甚有严限，望大王进止。”
i0441.gloss: Lu.Wan receive DE gold ten catty, then take.leave Chu king: servant should deliver letter, very have strict deadline, hope great.king instruct
i0441.translation: Lu Wan received ten catties of gold, then took his leave of the king of Chu: "I am to deliver the letter, and the deadline is most strict; I await Your Majesty's word."
i0441.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|卢绾接得金十斤，便辞楚王：“臣当送书，甚有严限，望大王进止。”#1

i0442.text: 取得谋臣锺离末言，绥州茶城村捉得王陵母，见在营中，受其苦楚。
i0442.gloss: take DE strategist Zhongli.Mo word, Suizhou Chacheng village catch DE Wang.Ling mother, now at camp inside, suffer 3.GEN torment
i0442.translation: He extracted the testimony of the strategist Zhongli Mo, and at Chacheng village in Suizhou captured Wang Ling's mother, who is now in the camp, suffering bitter torment.
i0442.key: 9-10th Century CE|Dunhuang Bianwen Ji|Hanjiang Wangling Bian|取得谋臣锺离末言，绥州茶城村捉得王陵母，见在营中，受其苦楚。#1

i0443.text: 陵母得剑，去霸王三十馀步，“为报我王知，”陵母遂乃自刎，身终。
i0443.gloss: Ling mother DE sword, depart Hegemon-King thirty more pace, for report 1SG king know, Ling mother thereupon REFL cut.throat, body end
i0443.translation: Ling's mother received the sword, [moved off] some thirty paces from the Hegemon-King, and saying, "Let this report be made known to my king," she thereupon cut her own throat and died.

i0709.text: 众猴脚屣实地，认得是家乡，个个欢喜
i0709.gloss: crowd monkey foot tread solid ground, recognize-DE COP homeland, CLF CLF joyful
i0709.translation: The monkeys now felt solid ground beneath their feet and recognized it as their homeland—each and every one of them was filled with joy.
i0709.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|2|众猴脚屣实地，认得是家乡，个个欢喜#1

i0710.text: 大王去到那方，不意学得这般手段。

i0710.translation: Great King, after traveling to that distant place, you would surprisingly return having learned such skills!
i0710.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|2|大王去到那方，不意学得这般手段。#1

i0711.translation: You’ll need to get sharp swords and halberds for that.

i0712.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|三街六巿，都慌得关门闭户，无人敢走。#1

i0713.translation: Suddenly, they heard the sound of wind rushing by.

i0714.text: 无边无岸的猴精，諕得都乱跑乱躲。

i0714.translation: Counteless monkeys were so scared that they scattered in panic, running and hiding in all directions.

i0715.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|把一座花果山造得似铁桶金城。#1

i0716.text: 但不知大王水里可能去得？
i0716.gloss: but NEG know great.king water inside Q can go DE?
i0716.translation: But we don’t know—Great King, are you able to go into the water?
i0716.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|但不知大王水里可能去得？#1

i0717.translation: What place could I possibly not go?

i0718.translation: When did you, exalted immortal, attain the Way?

i0719.text: 我自生身之后，出家修行，得一个无生无灭之体。
i0719.gloss: 1SG since born body GEN after, leave.home cultivate, DE one CLF not.have birth not.have death GEN body
i0719.translation: Since the day I was born, I left the worldly life to cultivate the Way, and attained a body that neither lives nor dies.
i0719.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|我自生身之后，出家修行，得一个无生无灭之体。#1

i0720.gloss: frighten DE old Dragon.King gall tremble heart startle
i0720.translation: So frightened was the old Dragon King that his heart trembled and his courage fled.
i0720.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|諕得老龙王胆战心惊#1

i0721.translation: Here stands an iron drum and a golden bell—whenever there is an urgent matter, strike the drum…
i0721.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|这里有一面铁鼓、一口金钟，凡有紧急事，擂得鼓响…#1

i0722.text: 撞得钟鸣，舍弟们就顷刻而至

i0722.translation: And when the bell is rung, my younger brothers will arrive in an instant.
i0722.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|撞得钟鸣，舍弟们就顷刻而至#1

i0723.gloss: frighten DE crowd monkey together kneel down say
i0723.translation: So terrified were the monkeys that they all dropped to their knees and said…
i0723.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|諕得众猴一齐跪下道#1

i0724.text: 把些虎豹狼虫、满山群怪、七十二洞妖王，都諕得磕头礼拜

i0724.translation: All the tigers, leopards, wolves, insects—the mountain’s swarming beasts—and the seventy-two cave-dwelling demon kings were so frightened they fell to their knees, bowing their heads in reverence.
i0724.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|把些虎豹狼虫、满山群怪、七十二洞妖王，都諕得磕头礼拜#1

i0725.text: 慌得那各洞妖王，都来参贺。
i0725.gloss: panic DE DIST each cave demon.king, all come pay.congratulation
i0725.translation: In a panic, all the demon kings from the various caves came forth to offer their congratulations.
i0725.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|慌得那各洞妖王，都来参贺。#1

i0726.text: 著众怪跳舞欢歌，俱吃得酩酊大醉。

i0726.translation: The assembled monsters broke into dance and joyful song, all drinking until they were thoroughly drunk.
i0726.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|著众怪跳舞欢歌，俱吃得酩酊大醉。#1

i0727.text: 諕得那牛头鬼东躲西藏，马面鬼南奔北跑。
i0727.gloss: frighten DE DIST ox-head ghost east dodge west hide, horse-face ghost south rush north run
i0727.translation: So terrifying was the scene that the ox-headed demons fled and hid, while the horse-faced spirits scattered, running non-stop.
i0727.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|諕得那牛头鬼东躲西藏，马面鬼南奔北跑。#1

i0728.translation: So alarmed were the Tenth King of the Underworld that they hurriedly dressed to investigate, only to find him fierce and fearsome in appearance.
i0728.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|3|慌得那十代冥王急整衣来看，见他相貌凶恶#1

i0729.text: 你既认不得我，怎么差人来勾我？

i0729.translation: Since you don’t even recognize me, why did you send someone to drag me here?

i0731.translation: The Handsome Monkey King heard this and was overjoyed.

i0732.translation: That Sun Wukong is a demon-immortal from the mortal realm, newly attained human form and unfamiliar with court etiquette—let his offense be forgiven for now.
i0732.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|那孙悟空乃下界妖仙，初得人身，不知朝礼，且姑恕罪。#1

i0733.text: 那些天马见了他，泯耳攒蹄。倒养得肉肥膘满。

i0733.translation: When the heavenly horses saw him, they pinned back their ears and pawed the ground—but under his care, they grew plump and well-fed.
i0733.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|那些天马见了他，泯耳攒蹄。倒养得肉肥膘满。#1

i0734.translation: It’s just like when Your Lordship took office—with such diligence and care, even the horses grew fat…
i0734.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|似堂尊到任之后，这等殷勤，喂得马肥…#1

i0735.gloss: only end.up DE say CLF good word
i0735.translation: …and all that you got in the end was just one word: “Excellent.”

i0736.text: 恭喜大王，上界去十数年，想必得意荣归也？

i0736.translation: Congratulations, Great King! You’ve been in the heavens for over a decade—surely you’ve attained glory and returned in triumph?
i0736.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|恭喜大王，上界去十数年，想必得意荣归也？#1

i0737.gloss: come DE good, come DE good

i0738.translation: I’ve long heard that the Great King was seeking worthy talents, but I was not able to meet you without a proper reason.
i0738.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|久闻大王招贤，无由得见#1

i0739.text: 今见大王授了天籙，得意荣归，特献赭黄袍一件

i0739.translation: Now that I see the Great King has received the heavenly register, attained glory and returned in triumph, I offer this ochre-yellow robe as a special tribute.
i0739.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|今见大王授了天籙，得意荣归，特献赭黄袍一件#1

i0740.text: 肯不弃鄙贱，收纳小人，亦得效犬马之劳。

i0740.translation: If you would not disdain my humble status and are willing to take me in, I then would be allowed to serve with the unwavering loyalty.
i0740.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|肯不弃鄙贱，收纳小人，亦得效犬马之劳。#1

i0741.text: 巨灵神得令，结束整齐，抡著宣花斧，到了水帘洞外。

i0741.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|巨灵神得令，结束整齐，抡著宣花斧，到了水帘洞外。#1

i0742.translation: You wretched monkey! Do you recognize who I am?
i0742.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|那泼猴！你认得我么？#1

i0744.text: 你快卸了装束，归顺天恩，免得这满山诸畜遭诛

i0744.translation: Quickly lay down your arms and surrender to Heaven’s grace, so that the beasts of this mountain might be spared from slaughter.
i0744.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|你快卸了装束，归顺天恩，免得这满山诸畜遭诛#1

i0745.text: 弼马温果是神通广大，末将战他不得，败阵回来请罪。

i0745.translation: The Monkey King truly possesses vast magical powers—I could not defeat him in battle and now return in defeat to beg forgiveness.
i0745.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|弼马温果是神通广大，末将战他不得，败阵回来请罪。#1

i0746.translation: You vile demon monkey! Do you not recognize me?
i0746.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|泼妖猴！岂不认得我？#1

i0747.text: 諕得各洞妖王都闭户，遍山鬼怪尽藏头。
i0747.gloss: frighten DE each cave demon.king all shut door, all.over mountain ghost monster entirely hide head
i0747.translation: So terrifying was the sight that all the demon kings of the caves shut their doors, and every ghost and monster on the mountain hid their heads in fear.
i0747.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|諕得各洞妖王都闭户，遍山鬼怪尽藏头。#1

i0748.text: 哪吒正使法间，听得棒头风响

i0748.translation: Just as Nezha was casting his spell, he heard the whooshing wind of the staff approaching.
i0748.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|哪吒正使法间，听得棒头风响#1

i0749.text: 你看那猴王得胜归山，那七十二洞妖王与那六弟兄，俱来贺喜

i0749.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|你看那猴王得胜归山，那七十二洞妖王与那六弟兄，俱来贺喜#1

i0750.text: 庶乾坤安靖，海宇得清宁也。
i0750.gloss: so.that heaven earth peaceful, sea realm DE clear tranquil SFP
i0750.translation: Thus may Heaven and Earth be at peace, and the realm within the four seas attain tranquility and harmony.
i0750.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|庶乾坤安靖，海宇得清宁也。#1

i0751.text: 却也天上走了一次，认得那天门内外之路。
i0751.gloss: but also heaven on walk PFV one time, recognize-DE DIST Heaven.Gate inside outside GEN road
i0751.translation: Having once journeyed through the heavens, he now knew well the roads within and beyond the Celestial Gates.
i0751.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|4|却也天上走了一次，认得那天门内外之路。#1

i0752.text: 哥啊，我两个手段不见怎的，还得你先下水。

i0752.translation: Brother, neither of us seems to be showing our skills—looks like you’ll have to go into the water first.
i0752.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|哥啊，我两个手段不见怎的，还得你先下水。#1

i0753.gloss: water inside GEN matter, 1SG go NEG DE
i0753.translation: For matters in the water—I cannot go (and solve them).
i0753.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|水中之事，我去不得。#1

i0754.text: 就是下海行江，我须要捻著避水诀，或者变化甚么鱼蟹之形，才去得

i0754.translation: Even when venturing into the sea or traveling through rivers, I must recite the Water-Avoiding Charm or transform into some fish or crab form—only then can I go.
i0754.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|就是下海行江，我须要捻著避水诀，或者变化甚么鱼蟹之形，才去得#1

i0755.text: 若是那般捻诀，却抡不得铁棒
i0755.gloss: if COP DIST way recite charm, then wield NEG DE iron staff
i0755.translation: But if I have to recite the charm like that, I won’t be able to wield my iron staff.
i0755.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|若是那般捻诀，却抡不得铁棒#1

i0756.translation: I won’t be able to use my magical powers.

i0757.translation: I won’t be able to beat the monsters.

i0758.text: 哥啊，小弟虽是去得，但不知水底如何。

i0758.translation: Brother, though I can go, I do not know what lies beneath the water.
i0758.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|哥啊，小弟虽是去得，但不知水底如何。#1

i0759.text: 贤弟说得有理。你们那个驮我？
i0759.gloss: worthy.brother say DE have reason. 2PL which CLF carry 1SG?
i0759.translation: Well said, dear brother. Now—who among you will carry me?
i0759.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|贤弟说得有理。你们那个驮我？#1

i0760.text: 八戒正行，忽然打个躘踵，得故子把行者往前一掼，扑的跌了一跤
i0760.gloss: Bajie PROG walk, suddenly make CLF stumble, DE chance BA Pilgrim toward front one fling, thud ADV fall PFV one CLF
i0760.translation: Just as Bajie was walking, he suddenly stumbled and, using the moment to get an advantage, flung the Monkey King forward—causing him to fall flat on his face.
i0760.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|八戒正行，忽然打个躘踵，得故子把行者往前一掼，扑的跌了一跤#1

i0761.translation: No good—it has to be him after all.

i0762.translation: When Sha Monk heard this, he laughed and said…

i0763.text: 如今弄得闻声不见面，却怎是好？

i0763.translation: Now we can hear each other's voice but cannot see each other—what are we to do about that?
i0763.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|如今弄得闻声不见面，却怎是好？#1

i0764.text: 八戒慌得跪在泥里磕头道
i0764.gloss: Bajie panic DE kneel at mud inside kowtow say
i0764.translation: Panicked, Bajie dropped to his knees in the mud and kowtowed, saying…
i0764.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|八戒慌得跪在泥里磕头道#1

i0765.text: 只听得三藏在里面嘤嘤的哭哩。
i0765.gloss: only hear DE Tripitaka at inside softly ADV cry SFP
i0765.translation: All they could hear was Tripitaka inside, sobbing softly.
i0765.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|只听得三藏在里面嘤嘤的哭哩。#1

i0766.text: 行者不言语，侧耳再听，那师父锉得牙响
i0766.gloss: Pilgrim NEG speak, tilt ear again listen, DIST master grind DE tooth sound
i0766.translation: Wukong said nothing, but tilted his head to listen again—inside, his master was grinding his teeth.
i0766.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|行者不言语，侧耳再听，那师父锉得牙响#1

i0767.text: 不知徒弟能来否，可得真经返故园？
i0767.gloss: NEG know disciple can come NEG, Q DE true scripture return homeland?
i0767.translation: I wonder if my disciple will come—will he be able to retrieve the true scriptures and return home?
i0767.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|不知徒弟能来否，可得真经返故园？#1

i0769.translation: If you can capture him, then do so.

i0770.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|擒不得，做个佯输，引他出水#1

i0771.translation: The little demon inside the gate, in a panic, rushed to report.
i0771.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|慌得那门里小妖急报#1

i0772.translation: The demon came out through the gate, followed by a hundred or so little fiends.
i0772.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|妖邪出得门来，随后有百十个小妖#1

i0773.translation: I was once Yichengjin from the household of Chen Qing—don’t you recognize me?
i0773.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|我本是陈清家一秤金，你不认得我么？#1

i0775.translation: If you can withstand me for three rounds, I’ll return your master to you.
i0775.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|三合敌得我过，还你师父#1

i0776.text: 怎么就晓得我是半路出家的？
i0776.gloss: how then know-DE 1SG COP halfway leave.home SFP?
i0776.translation: How did you know I took up the monastic life halfway through?
i0776.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|怎么就晓得我是半路出家的？#1

i0777.translation: How did you recognize that I became a spirit halfway through my journey?
i0777.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|49|你怎么认得我是半路上成精的？#1

i0778.text: 你会使铜锤，想是雇在那个银匠家扯炉，被你得了手，偷将出来的。

i1285.gloss: autumn present.at.court, then can DE Jidong.Taiwu.Lin circuit
i1285.translation: If (you) are presented (at court) in the autumn, (you) can get the 'Jidong-Taiwu-Lin' official rank.
i1285.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|秋天引见，就可得济东泰武临道。#1

i1286.text: 如老兄可以照应他得两个保举，这捐宫之费，李兄可以拿出奉借。
i1286.gloss: if elder.brother can look.after 3SG DE two CLF recommendation, PROX purchase office GEN fee, Li brother can take out respectfully.lend
i1286.translation: If you, elder brother, can look after him (and get) two recommendations, this fee for purchasing office, Brother Li can take it out to lend (you).
i1286.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|如老兄可以照应他得两个保举，这捐宫之费，李兄可以拿出奉借。#1

i1287.text: 等老兄得了优差，再还不迟。
i1287.gloss: wait elder.brother DE PFV fine post, then repay NEG late
i1287.translation: Wait until you, elder brother, have obtained a fine post, it won't be too late to repay (it) then.
i1287.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|等老兄得了优差，再还不迟。#1

i1288.text: 自从黄河并了，虽仍有货船来往，究竟不过十分之一二，差得远了。
i1288.gloss: since Yellow.River merge CRS, although still have cargo.boat come go, after.all no.more.than ten part GEN one two, fall.short DE far CRS
i1288.translation: Since the Yellow River (course) merged, although there are still cargo boats coming and going, in the end it's only one or two tenths (of what it was); it's far worse.
i1288.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|自从黄河并了，虽仍有货船来往，究竟不过十分之一二，差得远了。#1

i1289.text: 上得厅房里，父子三个跪下，已经是飒飒的抖
i1289.gloss: go.up DE hall inside, father son three CLF kneel down, already COP violent ADV tremble
i1289.translation: (They) went up into the main hall, the father and two sons knelt down, already trembling violently.
i1289.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|上得厅房里，父子三个跪下，已经是飒飒的抖#1

i1290.text: 这几件衣服，我记得彷佛是前天城里失盗那一家子的。
i1290.gloss: PROX several CLF clothes, 1SG remember-DE seemingly COP day.before.yesterday city inside suffer.robbery DIST one family NMLZ
i1290.translation: These clothes, I seem toremember, are from that family in the city that was robbed the day before yesterday.
i1290.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|这几件衣服，我记得彷佛是前天城里失盗那一家子的。#1

i1291.text: 这衣服实在不晓得那里来的。
i1291.gloss: PROX clothes really NEG know-DE where come SFP
i1291.translation: I truly don't know where these clothes came from.
i1291.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|这衣服实在不晓得那里来的。#1

i1292.text: 大人的脾气谁不知道，越迟去越不得了。
i1292.gloss: master ATTR temper who NEG know, more late go more NEG DE finish
i1292.translation: Who doesn't know the Master's temper? The later (you) go, the more terrible (it will be). (lit. 'the more difficult things can be smoothly taken care of')
i1292.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|大人的脾气谁不知道，越迟去越不得了。#1

i1293.text: 这些管庄子的都是乡下老儿，就差几个去，到得城里也跟傻子一样，没有用处的
i1293.gloss: PROX some manage estate NMLZ all COP countryside old.fellow, even send several CLF go, arrive DE city inside also with fool same, not.have use SFP
i1293.translation: These stewards are all country bumpkins; even if (you) send a few, when they get to the city they are just like fools, (they are) useless.
i1293.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|这些管庄子的都是乡下老儿，就差几个去，到得城里也跟傻子一样，没有用处的#1

i1294.gloss: 2PL still have DE say NMLZ Q?
i1294.translation: Do you still have anything you got to say?
i1294.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|你们还有得说的吗？#1

i1295.text: 于家父子方说得一声『冤枉』
i1295.gloss: Yu family father son just.then say DE one CLF injustice
i1295.translation: The Yu father and sons then made one cry of 'Injustice!'…
i1295.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|4|于家父子方说得一声『冤枉』#1

i1296.gloss: also count DE CLF special.class careless CRS!
i1296.translation: (That) can be counted as a special-class (case of) carelessness!
i1296.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|也算得个特等马虎了！#1

i1297.text: 但能救得三人性命，无论花多少钱都愿意
i1297.gloss: if.only can save DE three person life, regardless spend how.much money all willing
i1297.translation: If (I) can just save the three of them, (I'm) willing to spend any amount of money.
i1297.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|但能救得三人性命，无论花多少钱都愿意#1

i1298.text: 我去替少奶奶设法，做得成也别欢喜，做不成也别埋怨
i1298.gloss: 1SG go for young.mistress find.way, do DE succeed also PROH happy, do NEG succeed also PROH complain
i1298.translation: I will go try to find a way for the young mistress; if (I) succeed, don't be (too) happy, if (I) fail, don't complain. (Two 'linker' uses)
i1298.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|我去替少奶奶设法，做得成也别欢喜，做不成也别埋怨#1

i1299.text: 胡说！我这两天记得没有站甚么人，怎会没有空子呢？
i1299.gloss: nonsense! 1SG PROX two day remember-DE not.have stand what person, how can not.have empty.spot SFP?
i1299.translation: Nonsense! I remember these past two days there were not many people standing there, how can there not be an empty spot?
i1299.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|胡说！我这两天记得没有站甚么人，怎会没有空子呢？#1

i1300.text: 如能救得他们三人性命，一则是件好事，二则大家也可沾润几两银子。
i1300.gloss: if can save DE 3PL three person life, first COP CLF good matter, second everyone also can moisten several tael silver
i1300.translation: If (we) can save their three lives, first, it's a good deed, second, everyone can also get (to 'be moistened by') a few taels of silver.
i1300.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|如能救得他们三人性命，一则是件好事，二则大家也可沾润几两银子。#1

i1301.text: 那知每人不消得几十板子，那四个人就都死了。
i1301.gloss: who know each person NEG need DE several ten board, DIST four CLF person then all die CRS
i1301.translation: Who could have know that each person didn't even endure to get a few dozen strokes (of the rod) before all four of them died.
i1301.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|那知每人不消得几十板子，那四个人就都死了。#1

i1302.text: 响头不知磕了几千，总没有人挽回得动这玉大人的牛性。
i1302.gloss: loud kowtow NEG know knock PFV several thousand, still not.have person turn.back DE move PROX Yu master ATTR ox nature
i1302.translation: (They) kowtowed who-knows-how-many-thousand times, but no one changed this Master Yu's 'ox-like' stubbornness.
i1302.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|响头不知磕了几千，总没有人挽回得动这玉大人的牛性。#1

i1303.text: 诸位，这吴少奶奶的节烈，可以请得旌表的。
i1303.gloss: everyone, PROX Wu young.mistress ATTR chastity, can request DE official.honor SFP
i1303.translation: Everyone, this Young Mistress Wu's chastity is (something) that can (be) requested an official honoring for.
i1303.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|诸位，这吴少奶奶的节烈，可以请得旌表的。#1

i1304.text: 况这吴氏尤其可恨，他一肚子觉得我冤枉了他一家子。
i1304.gloss: moreover PROX Wu clan especially hateful, 3SG whole.belly feel-DE 1SG wrong PFV 3SG whole family
i1304.translation: Moreover, this Mrs. Wu is especially hateful; she's completely convinced I wronged her family.
i1304.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|况这吴氏尤其可恨，他一肚子觉得我冤枉了他一家子。#1

i1305.text: 你传话出去，谁要再来替于家求情，就是得贿的凭据。
i1305.gloss: 2SG pass word out go, who want again come for Yu family plead, then COP DE bribe ATTR proof
i1305.translation: You pass this word out: anyone who comes again to plead for the Yu family, that will be the proof (they) have received a bribe.
i1305.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|你传话出去，谁要再来替于家求情，就是得贿的凭据。#1

i1306.text: 大奶奶是去不得的，倘若是姑老爷去走一趟，到没有什么不可。
i1306.gloss: Big.Mistress COP go NEG DE SFP, if COP master.in.law go walk one CLF, rather not.have what NEG may
i1306.translation: The 'Big Mistress' cannot go; if, however, the 'Master-in-law' were to make a trip, there's nothing against it.
i1306.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|大奶奶是去不得的，倘若是姑老爷去走一趟，到没有什么不可。#1

i1307.text: 你说，这官事打得赢打不赢呢？
i1307.gloss: 2SG say, PROX lawsuit fight DE win fight NEG win SFP?
i1307.translation: You tell me, can this lawsuit be won or not? (Two 'linker' uses)
i1307.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|你说，这官事打得赢打不赢呢？#1

i1308.text: 后来听得他们说，那移赃的强盗，听见这样，都后悔的了不得
i1308.gloss: later hear DE 3PL say, DIST plant loot ATTR robber, hear PROX.way, all regret LNK finish NEG DE
i1308.translation: Later (I) heard them say, that the robbers who planted the stolen goods, (when) they heard this, all felt 'no end' of regret. (Two 'de's: 1. Linker, 2. Linker)
i1308.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|后来听得他们说，那移赃的强盗，听见这样，都后悔的了不得#1

i1309.text: 老董在各处算饭钱，招呼生意，正忙得有劲。
i1309.gloss: Old.Dong at every place reckon meal money, attend business, PROG busy DE have vigor
i1309.translation: Old Dong was everywhere, calculating meal tabs, attending to business, (he was) just 'busy with vigor'.
i1309.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|老董在各处算饭钱，招呼生意，正忙得有劲。#1

i1310.text: 衙门口有十二架站笼，天天不得空
i1310.gloss: yamen gate have twelve CLF standing.cage, every.day NEG DE empty
i1310.translation: At the yamen gate there are twelve 'standing cages', every day (they) are not empty. (lit. do not get any emptiness)
i1310.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|衙门口有十二架站笼，天天不得空#1

i1311.text: 难得有天把空得一个两个的。
i1311.gloss: hard DE have day.or.so empty DE one CLF two CLF SFP
i1311.translation: It's rare to get a day where one or two (of them) are empty.
i1311.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|难得有天把空得一个两个的。#1

i1312.gloss: fear mostly COP wrongful DE many SFP?
i1312.translation: I'm afraid it's mostly wrongful (cases), isn't it?
i1312.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|恐怕总是冤枉得多罢？#1

i1313.text: 或者说话说的不得法，犯到他手里，也是一个死
i1313.gloss: or speak speak LNK NEG DE method, fall to 3SG hand inside, also COP one CLF death
i1313.translation: Or (if their) speaking is not 'of the method' (i.e. improper), (and they) fall into his hands, that's also a death (sentence).
i1313.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|或者说话说的不得法，犯到他手里，也是一个死#1

i1314.text: 只是觉得那人一面答话，那脸就渐渐发青
i1314.gloss: only feel-DE DIST person one side answer word, DIST face then gradually turn pale
i1314.translation: (I) just felt that as that person was answering, his face gradually turned pale.
i1314.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|只是觉得那人一面答话，那脸就渐渐发青#1

i1315.gloss: or speak speak LNK NEG DE method
i1315.translation: Or (their) speaking is not 'of the method' (i.e. improper).
i1315.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|或者说话说的不得法#1

i1316.text: 你这东西谣言惑众，还了得吗！
i1316.gloss: 2SG PROX thing rumor deceive crowd, still finish DE Q!
i1316.translation: You spread rumors to confuse the masses - can you be let off the hook? (lit. can this matterd be settled?)
i1316.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|你这东西谣言惑众，还了得吗！#1

i1317.text: 欲往别家，已无隙地，不得已，同他再三商议。
i1317.gloss: want go other house, already not.have spare ground, NEG DE stop, with 3SG again.and.again negotiate
i1317.translation: (I) wanted to go to another inn, (but) there was no space left; (I) had no choice, (and) negotiated with him again and again.
i1317.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|欲往别家，已无隙地，不得已，同他再三商议。#1

i1318.text: 劳驾，劳驾！行路的人怎样将就都行得的。
i1318.gloss: trouble.you, trouble.you! travel road ATTR person how make.do all work DE SFP
i1318.translation: Excuse me, excuse me! A traveler can make do with anything.
i1318.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|劳驾，劳驾！行路的人怎样将就都行得的。#1

i1319.text: 俺们这个玉大人真是了不得！
i1319.gloss: 1PL PROX CLF Yu master really COP finish NEG DE!
i1319.translation: This Master Yu of ours is truly 'no end' (remarkable)!
i1319.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|5|俺们这个玉大人真是了不得！#1

i1320.text: 俺掌柜的妹夫，曾在他家卖过两回布，认得他家
i1320.gloss: 1SG boss ATTR younger.sister.husband, once at 3SG house sell EXP two time cloth, recognize-DE 3SG house
i1320.translation: My boss's younger-sister's-husband once sold cloth at his house twice, (he) recognizes his family.
i1320.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|俺掌柜的妹夫，曾在他家卖过两回布，认得他家#1

i1321.text: 那张二秃子也是个不知利害的人，听得高兴，尽往下问
i1321.gloss: DIST Zhang.Second.Baldy also COP CLF NEG know benefit.harm ATTR person, listen DE excited, keep toward down ask
i1321.translation: That 'Zhang the Second Baldy' was also a person who didn't know (what's) good for him; (he) got excited from listening, and kept asking (more)."
i1321.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|那张二秃子也是个不知利害的人，听得高兴，尽往下问#1

i1322.text: 二人谈得高兴，不知早被他们团里朋友报给王三
i1322.gloss: two person talk DE excited, NEG know early PASS 3PL group inside friend report to Wang.San
i1322.translation: The two were talking excitedly, not knowing (they) had already been reported to Wang San by a friend in their group.
i1322.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|二人谈得高兴，不知早被他们团里朋友报给王三#1

i1323.text: 把他们两人面貌记得烂熟。
i1323.gloss: BA 3PL two person face remember DE thoroughly.familiar
i1323.translation: (He) had memorized their two faces perfectly.
i1323.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|把他们两人面貌记得烂熟。#1

i1324.text: 因虽会过两三次，未曾多馀接谈，故记不得了。
i1324.gloss: because although meet EXP two three time, not.yet ever much converse, therefore remember NEG DE CRS
i1324.translation: Because, although (we) had met two or three times, (we) had not spoken much, so (I) don't remember.
i1324.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|因虽会过两三次，未曾多馀接谈，故记不得了。#1

i1325.text: 反心内照，愈觉得龌龊不堪了！
i1325.gloss: turn heart inside reflect, more feel-DE filthy NEG bear CRS!
i1325.translation: (I) reflected inwardly, and felt even more that (I was) unbearably filthy!
i1325.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|反心内照，愈觉得龌龊不堪了！#1

i1326.text: 弟等耳目有所隔阂，先生布衣游历，必可得其实在情形。
i1326.gloss: 1PL.HUM ear eye have NMLZ obstruction, sir commoner.cloth travel, surely can DE 3.GEN real situation
i1326.translation: Our (lit. 'younger brothers') eyes and ears are obstructed; you, sir, travel as a commoner, (you) can certainly obtain the true situation.
i1326.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|弟等耳目有所隔阂，先生布衣游历，必可得其实在情形。#1

i1327.text: 说得一半的时候，家人来请吃饭。
i1327.gloss: speak DE one half ATTR time, servant come invite eat meal
i1327.translation: When (he) had spoken halfway, a servant came to invite (him) to eat.
i1327.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|说得一半的时候，家人来请吃饭。#1

i1328.text: 听说太尊是因为晚日得了院上行知
i1328.gloss: hear say prefect COP because recent day DE PFV governor.office notice
i1328.translation: (I) heard the Prefect, because (he) had recently received a notice from the provincial (court)...
i1328.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|听说太尊是因为晚日得了院上行知#1

i1329.text: 弟有极难处置之事，要得领教，还望不弃才好。
i1329.gloss: 1SG.HUM have extremely hard handle GEN matter, want DE receive.instruction, still hope NEG abandon only.then good
i1329.translation: I (your younger brother) have an extremely difficult matter to handle, (I) need to (get to) receive (your) instruction, I hope (you) will not abandon me.
i1329.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|弟有极难处置之事，要得领教，还望不弃才好。#1

i1330.text: 西北风虽不甚大，觉得棉袍子在身上有飘飘欲仙之致
