i1330.gloss: northwest wind although NEG very big, feel-DE cotton robe at body on have float float want immortal GEN air
i1330.translation: Although the northwest wind was not very strong, (he) felt his cotton robe on his body had a 'floating-like-an-immortal' quality.
i1330.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|西北风虽不甚大，觉得棉袍子在身上有飘飘欲仙之致#1

i1331.text: 房里便觉得阴风森森，异常惨淡。
i1331.gloss: room inside then feel-DE gloomy wind chilly, unusually dismal
i1331.translation: In the room, (one) then felt a gloomy wind, (it was) unusually dismal.
i1331.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|房里便觉得阴风森森，异常惨淡。#1

i1332.text: 得失沦肌髓，因之急事功。
i1332.gloss: DE lose soak flesh marrow, because 3.OBJ anxious deed merit
i1332.translation: Gain and loss soak into the bones and marrow, because of this (one) is anxious for merit.
i1332.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|得失沦肌髓，因之急事功。#1

i1333.text: 饭后，那雪越发下得大了。
i1333.gloss: meal after, DIST snow all.the.more fall DE big CRS
i1333.translation: After the meal, the snow fell even harder.
i1333.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|饭后，那雪越发下得大了。#1

i1334.text: 想到这里，觉得替这些鸟雀愁苦的受不得。
i1334.gloss: think reach here, feel-DE for PROX some bird sparrow worry LNK bear NEG DE
i1334.translation: Thinking of this, (he) felt so worried for these birds that (it was) unbearable.
i1334.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|想到这里，觉得替这些鸟雀愁苦的受不得。#1

i1335.text: 想到此处，不觉怒发冲冠，恨不得立刻将玉贤杀掉，方出心头之恨。
i1335.gloss: think reach PROX place, NEG feel angry hair pierce cap, hate NEG DE immediately BA Yu.Xian kill off, only.then vent heart head GEN hatred
i1335.translation: Thinking of this, he unknowingly became furious, and hated the fact that he couldn't kill Yu Xian immediately, only then would the hate in his heart be vented.
i1335.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|想到此处，不觉怒发冲冠，恨不得立刻将玉贤杀掉，方出心头之恨。#1

i1336.text: 因为阴天，所以比平常更黑得早
i1336.gloss: because overcast day, therefore than usual more dark DE early
i1336.translation: Because it was overcast, it therefore got dark earlier than usual.
i1336.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|因为阴天，所以比平常更黑得早#1

i1337.text: 起初灯光不过有大黄豆大，渐渐的得了油，就有小蚕豆大了
i1337.gloss: at.first lamp light no.more.than have big soybean big, gradually ADV DE PFV oil, then have small fava.bean big CRS
i1337.translation: At first the lamplight was only as big as a large soybean; gradually, (it) 'got' oil, and became as big as a small fava bean.
i1337.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|起初灯光不过有大黄豆大，渐渐的得了油，就有小蚕豆大了#1

i1338.text: 那屋子里有大火盆，有这屋里火盆四五个大，暖和得多呢。
i1338.gloss: DIST room inside have big brazier, have PROX room inside brazier four five CLF big, warm DE much SFP
i1338.translation: That room has a big brazier, as big as four or five of this room's braziers, (it's) much warmer.
i1338.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|那屋子里有大火盆，有这屋里火盆四五个大，暖和得多呢。#1

i1339.text: 家人们又得伺候，请你老成全家人罢！
i1339.gloss: servant-PL also DE serve, please 2SG.HON accommodate household SFP!
i1339.translation: The servants also get to serve (you); please, you sir, accommodate the whole family!
i1339.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|家人们又得伺候，请你老成全家人罢！#1

i1340.text: 先生吃得出有点异味吗？
i1340.gloss: sir eat DE out have bit strange flavor Q?
i1340.translation: Sir, can you taste that (there is) a bit of an unusual flavor?
i1340.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|先生吃得出有点异味吗？#1

i1341.text: 虽在此地，亦很不容易得的。
i1341.gloss: although at PROX place, also very NEG easy DE SFP
i1341.translation: Even though (we are) at this place, (it is) still very not easy to get.
i1341.key: 19th Century CE|Journey of Laocan|6|虽在此地，亦很不容易得的。#1

i1342.text: 虽申商督刑，挠首总算，亦不可得而详矣。
i1342.gloss: even.if Shen Shang supervise punishment, scratch head total calculate, also NEG can DE CONJ detail PRF
i1342.translation: Even if Shen and Shang (two famous officials) supervised the punishments and scratched their heads in exhaustive calculation,  it still would not be possible to grasp the details.
i1342.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|虽申商督刑，挠首总算，亦不可得而详矣。#1

i1343.text: 夫春秋之义，诸侯不得专封…
i1343.gloss: TOP Chunqiu GEN norm, feudal.lord NEG DE alone enfeoff
i1343.translation: Following the norms set by the Chunqiu peoriod, feudal lords may not grant fiefs on their own authority…
i1343.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|夫春秋之义，诸侯不得专封…#1

i1344.translation: ...and ministers may not claim land on their own accord.
i1344.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|...大夫不得专地。#1

i1345.text: 陶唐以前，法制简略，不可得而详也。
i1345.gloss: Taotang before, law institution simple sparse, NEG can DE CONJ detail SFP
i1345.translation: Before the time of Emperor Yao of the Taotang clan, laws and institutions were simple and sparse, and cannot be known in detail.
i1345.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|陶唐以前，法制简略，不可得而详也。#1

i1346.text: 四都方八十里，旁加十里，乃得方百里，为一同也。
i1346.gloss: four capital square eighty li, side add ten li, then DE square hundred li, be one unit SFP
i1346.translation: Each of the four capitals measured eighty li on each side; adding ten li on each side made it one hundred li square, thus forming a complete unit.
i1346.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|四都方八十里，旁加十里，乃得方百里，为一同也。#1

i1347.text: 地之形实不方平如图，受田邑者远近不得尽如制
i1347.gloss: land GEN shape really NEG square level like diagram, receive field settlement NMLZ far near NEG DE fully like regulation
i1347.translation: The actual shape of the land was not square and level like in the diagrams, and that those who received fields and settlements could not fully conform to the prescribed distances.
i1347.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|地之形实不方平如图，受田邑者远近不得尽如制#1

i1348.text: 细大之义，吾未能得其中。
i1348.gloss: fine great GEN principle, 1SG not.yet can DE 3.GEN middle
i1348.translation: As for the principles of the fine and the great, I have not yet been able to grasp the essence of them.
i1348.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|细大之义，吾未能得其中。#1

i1349.text: 腹饥不得食，肤寒不得衣
i1349.gloss: belly hungry NEG DE food, skin cold NEG DE clothes
i1349.translation: (Talking about peasants) When hungry, they cannot get food; when cold, they cannot get clothes.
i1349.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|腹饥不得食，肤寒不得衣#1

i1350.text: 故务民于农桑，薄赋敛，广畜积，以实仓廪，备水旱，故民可得而有也。
i1350.gloss: therefore engage people in farming sericulture, lighten tax levy, broaden store accumulate, to fill granary, prepare flood drought, therefore people can DE CONJ have SFP
i1350.translation: Therefore, by engaging the people in farming and sericulture, lightening taxes and levies, expanding reserves, and filling the granaries to prepare for floods and droughts— the people can thus get property and be well off.
i1350.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|故务民于农桑，薄赋敛，广畜积，以实仓廪，备水旱，故民可得而有也。#1

i1351.gloss: spring NEG DE avoid wind dust
i1351.translation: (Talking about peasants) In spring, they cannot avoid wind and sand.
i1351.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|春不得避风尘#1

i1352.gloss: summer NEG DE avoid summer heat
i1352.translation: (Talking about peasants) In summer, they cannot avoid hot weather.
i1352.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|夏不得避暑热#1

i1353.gloss: autumn NEG DE avoid overcast rain
i1353.translation: (Talking about peasants) In autumn, they cannot avoid rainy weather.
i1353.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|秋不得避阴雨#1

i1354.gloss: winter NEG DE avoid cold freeze
i1354.translation: (Talking about peasants) In winter, they cannot avoid bitter cold.
i1354.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|冬不得避寒冻#1

i1355.text: 当具有者半价而卖，本直千钱者，价得五百。
i1355.gloss: ought possess NMLZ half price CONJ sell, originally worth thousand coin NMLZ, price DE five hundred
i1355.translation: Items that ought to be available were to be sold at half price—if the original value was one thousand coins, the price was set at five hundred.
i1355.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|当具有者半价而卖，本直千钱者，价得五百。#1

i1356.gloss: water spring beneficial, CONJ NEG DE relocate
i1356.translation: Though the spring water is beneficial, the people are not allowed to relocate to it.
i1356.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|水泉利，而不得徙。#1

i1357.text: 其令郡国务劝农桑，益种树，可得衣食物。
i1357.gloss: let order commandery state strive encourage farming sericulture, increase plant tree, can DE clothes food thing
i1357.translation: Let the counties be ordered to diligently promote farming and to increase the planting of trees, so that clothing and food can be obtained.
i1357.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|其令郡国务劝农桑，益种树，可得衣食物。#1

i1358.text: 秦用商鞅之法，改帝王之制，除井田，民得卖买
i1358.gloss: Qin use Shang.Yang GEN law, change emperor king GEN institution, abolish well field, people DE sell buy
i1358.translation: Qin adopted the laws of Shang Yang, altering the institutions of former kings: the well-field system was abolished, and the people were allowed to buy and sell land.
i1358.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|秦用商鞅之法，改帝王之制，除井田，民得卖买#1

i1359.text: 古百步为亩，汉时二百四十步为亩，古千二百亩，则得今五顷也。
i1359.gloss: ancient hundred pace be mu, Han time two hundred forty pace be mu, ancient thousand two hundred mu, then DE now five qing SFP
i1359.translation: In ancient times, one mu was one hundred paces; in the Han period, it was two hundred and forty paces. Thus, what was twelve hundred mu in antiquity would equal five qing today.
i1359.note: mu, qing and paces are area units in ancient China
i1359.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|古百步为亩，汉时二百四十步为亩，古千二百亩，则得今五顷也。#1

i1360.text: 课得谷皆多其旁田亩一斛以上。
i1360.gloss: assess DE grain all exceed 3.GEN side field mu one hu above
i1360.translation: The assessed grain yield always exceeded that of the surrounding fields by at least one hu per mu.
i1360.note: hu is a weight unit in ancient China
i1360.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|课得谷皆多其旁田亩一斛以上。#1

i1361.text: 是后边城、河东、弘农、三辅、太常民皆便代田，用力少而得谷多。
i1361.gloss: PROX after Biancheng, Hedong, Hongnong, Three.Adjuncts, Taichang people all find.convenient replacement.field, use strength little CONJ DE grain much
i1361.translation: From then on, the people of Biancheng, Hedong, Hongnong, the Three Adjuncts, and the Taichang region all found the replacement-field system convenient—requiring less labor while yielding more grain.
i1361.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|是后边城、河东、弘农、三辅、太常民皆便代田，用力少而得谷多。#1

i1362.text: 诸侯王、列侯皆得名田国中。
i1362.gloss: feudal king, ranked marquis all DE name field domain inside
i1362.translation: All the feudal lords and marquises are permitted to name fields within their own domains.
i1362.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|诸侯王、列侯皆得名田国中。#1

i1363.text: 据元始二年户一千二百二十三万三千，每户合得田六十七亩百四十六步有奇。
i1363.gloss: according.to Yuanshi second year household 12,233,000, each household amount DE field sixty-seven mu hundred forty-six pace have surplus
i1363.translation: By the second year of Yuanshi, there were 12,233,000 households; on average, each household was allotted sixty-seven mu and one hundred forty-six paces of land, with some excess.
i1363.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|据元始二年户一千二百二十三万三千，每户合得田六十七亩百四十六步有奇。#1

i1364.text: 于是“更名天下田曰‘王田’，奴婢曰‘私属’，皆不得买卖。
i1364.gloss: thereupon change name under.heaven field call royal.field, slave call private.dependent, all NEG DE buy sell
i1364.translation: Thereupon, all land under heaven was renamed “royal land,” and slaves were called “private dependents”; none of these were permitted to be bought or sold.
i1364.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|于是“更名天下田曰‘王田’，奴婢曰‘私属’，皆不得买卖。#1

i1365.text: 据建康元年户九百九十四万六千九百九十，每户合得田七十亩有奇。
i1365.gloss: according.to Jiankang first year household 9,946,990, each household amount DE field seventy mu have surplus
i1365.translation: By the first year of Jiankang, there were 9,946,990 households; on average, each household was allotted slightly more than seventy mu of land.
i1365.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|据建康元年户九百九十四万六千九百九十，每户合得田七十亩有奇。#1

i1366.text: 至哀帝时，乃限人占田不得过三十顷，虽有其制，卒难施行。
i1366.gloss: reach Ai emperor time, then limit person occupy field NEG DE exceed thirty qing, although have 3.GEN regulation, ultimately hard implement
i1366.translation: By the time of Emperor Ai, a limit was set prohibiting individuals from holding more than thirty qing of land; yet although the regulation existed, it was ultimately difficult to enforce.
i1366.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|至哀帝时，乃限人占田不得过三十顷，虽有其制，卒难施行。#1

i1367.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|人得耕种…#1

i1368.translation: …but they are not allowed to sell or buy the land.
i1368.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|...不得卖买。#1

i1369.text: 是以景帝六年，下诏郡国，令人得去硗狭，就宽肥。
i1369.gloss: therefore Jing emperor six year, issue edict commandery state, make person DE leave barren narrow, go.to broad fertile
i1369.translation: Thus, in the sixth year of Emperor Jing’s reign, an edict was issued to the counties allowing people to leave barren and narrow lands and move to broad and fertile ones.
i1369.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|是以景帝六年，下诏郡国，令人得去硗狭，就宽肥。#1

i1370.text: 今可限之，国王公侯，京城得有宅一处。
i1370.gloss: now may limit 3.OBJ, state king duke marquis, capital DE have residence one place
i1370.translation: It is now appropriate to set limits: kings, dukes, and marquises may have only one residence within the capital.
i1370.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|今可限之，国王公侯，京城得有宅一处。#1

i1371.text: 而又得荫人以为衣食客及佃客，量其官品以为差降。
i1371.gloss: CONJ also DE shelter person to be clothing.food retainer and tenant retainer, measure 3.GEN official rank to be gradation
i1371.translation: Moreover, they were also permitted to shelter retainers and tenant farmers for their livelihood, with the number allowed determined in proportion to their official rank.
i1371.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|而又得荫人以为衣食客及佃客，量其官品以为差降。#1

i1372.gloss: if before already claim mountain, NEG DE further claim
i1372.translation: If one had already claimed a mountain previously, no additional claims were permitted.
i1372.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|若先已占山，不得更占。#1

i1373.text: 若非前条旧业，一不得禁。
i1373.gloss: if NEG.COP previous article old holding, at.all NEG DE prohibit
i1373.translation: If the claim did not fall under the previously stated provisions or established holdings, it was not to be prohibited.
i1373.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|若非前条旧业，一不得禁。#1

i1374.text: 良畴委而不开，柔桑枯而不采，欲令家丰岁储，人给资用，其可得乎！
i1374.gloss: good field abandon CONJ NEG open, tender mulberry wither CONJ NEG pick, wish make household abundant year reserve, person supply means use, how can DE Q!
i1374.translation: Good fields are left untilled, tender mulberry trees wither without being harvested—if one wishes for households to be abundant in yearly reserves and for people to have the means for daily use, how can that be attained?
i1374.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|良畴委而不开，柔桑枯而不采，欲令家丰岁储，人给资用，其可得乎！#1

i1375.text: 于分虽盈，没则还田，不得以充露田之数
i1375.gloss: in share although surplus, die then return field, NEG DE use fill open field GEN number
i1375.translation: Even if the allotted portion was in excess, the land was to be returned upon confiscation and shall not be counted toward the total of open land.
i1375.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|于分虽盈，没则还田，不得以充露田之数#1

i1376.text: 诸应还之田，不得种桑榆枣果，种者以违令论，地入还分。
i1376.gloss: all should return GEN field, NEG DE plant mulberry elm jujube fruit, plant NMLZ by violate order judge, land enter return share
i1376.translation: All land designated for return was not to be planted with mulberry, elm, jujube, or fruit trees; those who did so were to be treated as having violated the laws, and the land was to be reclaimed and returned to its designated allotment.
i1376.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|诸应还之田，不得种桑榆枣果，种者以违令论，地入还分。#1

i1377.translation: Those with surplus were permitted to sell the excess…
i1377.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|盈者得卖其盈…#1

i1378.gloss: NEG enough NMLZ DE buy NMLZ NEG enough
i1378.translation: and those with shortages were permitted to purchase what they lacked
i1378.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|...不足者得买所不足。#1

i1379.translation: No one was permitted to sell their allotted share…
i1379.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|不得卖其分…#1

i1380.gloss: also NEG DE buy exceed NMLZ enough
i1380.translation: nor to purchase beyond what was needed to meet the prescribed amount.
i1380.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|亦不得买过所足。#1

i1381.text: 若始受田而身亡及卖买奴婢、牛者，皆至明年正月乃得还受。
i1381.gloss: if just receive field CONJ body die and sell buy slave, ox NMLZ, all reach next year first month only.then DE return receive
i1381.translation: If a person who had just received land died, or engaged in the purchase or sale of slaves or cattle, they were only permitted to return or receive land again in the following year’s first month.
i1381.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|若始受田而身亡及卖买奴婢、牛者，皆至明年正月乃得还受。#1

i1382.text: 其地足之处，不得无故而移。
i1382.gloss: DIST land sufficient GEN place, NEG DE not.have cause CONJ move
i1382.translation: In areas where the land was sufficient, relocation was not permitted without just cause.
i1382.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|其地足之处，不得无故而移。#1

i1383.text: 诸一人之分，正从正，倍从倍，不得隔越他畔。
i1383.gloss: all one person GEN share, primary follow primary, double follow double, NEG DE separate cross other boundary
i1383.translation: For each individual’s land allotment, primary shares were to follow primary, and double shares to follow double; crossing over to non-adjacent plots was not permitted.
i1383.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 1 - Tianzhi Shang|诸一人之分，正从正，倍从倍，不得隔越他畔。#1

i1384.text: 人有人力无牛，或有牛无人力者，须令相便，皆得纳种。
i1384.gloss: person have manpower not.have ox, or have ox not.have manpower NMLZ, must make mutual convenient, all DE put.in seed
i1384.translation: If someone had manpower but no oxen, or oxen but no manpower, arrangements were to be made for mutual convenience, so that all could proceed with planting.
i1384.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|人有人力无牛，或有牛无人力者，须令相便，皆得纳种。#1

i1385.text: 自宣武出猎以来，始以永赐，得听卖买。
i1385.gloss: from Xuanwu go.out hunt onward, first by perpetual grant, DE allow sell buy
i1385.translation: Since the time of Emperor Xuanwu’s hunting expedition, land granted in perpetuity was, for the first time, permitted to be bought and sold.
i1385.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|自宣武出猎以来，始以永赐，得听卖买。#1

i1386.text: 迁邺之始，滥职众多，所得公田，悉从货易。
i1386.gloss: move Ye GEN beginning, excess office numerous, NMLZ DE public field, all follow sale exchange
i1386.translation: At the beginning of the move to Ye, many held office without merit, and the public land they obtained was entirely subject to purchase and exchange.
i1386.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|迁邺之始，滥职众多，所得公田，悉从货易。#1

i1387.text: 又河渚山泽有可耕垦肥饶之处，悉是豪势，或借或请，编户之人不得一垄。
i1387.gloss: also river islet mountain marsh have can plough reclaim fertile rich GEN place, all COP powerful influential, or borrow or request, registered household GEN person NEG DE one ridge
i1387.translation: Moreover, fertile and arable lands along river islets and in mountain marshes were entirely occupied by powerful elites—whether under the guise of loans or requests—such that the registered commoners could not obtain even a single ridge.
i1387.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|又河渚山泽有可耕垦肥饶之处，悉是豪势，或借或请，编户之人不得一垄。#1

i1388.text: 假使蹔还，即卖所得之地，地尽还走
i1388.gloss: if temporarily return, then sell NMLZ DE GEN land, land exhausted again flee
i1388.translation: If the land is temporarily returned, then they sell the land they had obtained, and once the land is gone, they flee.
i1388.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|假使蹔还，即卖所得之地，地尽还走#1

i1389.text: 按其时有户八百九十万七千五百三十六，则每户合得垦田五顷馀，恐本史之非实。
i1389.gloss: according.to DIST time have household 8,907,536, then each household amount DE cultivated field five qing more, fear original history GEN NEG.COP real
i1389.translation: According to records of the time, there were 8,907,536 households, which would mean that each household was allotted over five qing of cultivated land—raising concerns that the original historical account may not be accurate.
i1389.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|按其时有户八百九十万七千五百三十六，则每户合得垦田五顷馀，恐本史之非实。#1

i1390.text: 所给五品以上永业田，皆不得狭乡受
i1390.gloss: NMLZ give five rank above perpetual.holding field, all NEG DE narrow township receive
i1390.translation: Perpetual land grants given to officials of the fifth rank and above were not to be received in narrow or confined townships.
i1390.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|所给五品以上永业田，皆不得狭乡受#1

i1391.text: 应赐人田，非指的处所者，不得狭乡给。
i1391.gloss: should grant person field, NEG.COP designate precise place NMLZ, NEG DE narrow township give
i1391.translation: For land to be granted to individuals, if no specific location was designated, it was not to be allocated within narrow or limited townships.
i1391.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|应赐人田，非指的处所者，不得狭乡给。#1

i1392.text: 其因官爵应得永业，未请及未足而身亡者，子孙不合追请也。
i1392.gloss: DIST because office rank should DE perpetual.holding, not.yet request and not.yet sufficient CONJ body die NMLZ, son grandson NEG proper retroactively request SFP
i1392.translation: Those who, by virtue of official rank, were entitled to perpetual landholdings but died before requesting or receiving the full allotment— their descendants were not to make retroactive claims.
i1392.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|其因官爵应得永业，未请及未足而身亡者，子孙不合追请也。#1

i1393.text: 诸袭爵者，唯得承父祖永业，不合别请。
i1393.gloss: all inherit rank NMLZ, only DE succeed father grandfather perpetual.holding, NEG proper separately request
i1393.translation: All who inherited noble titles were permitted only to succeed to the perpetual holdings of their fathers or grandfathers and were not to submit separate requests.
i1393.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|诸袭爵者，唯得承父祖永业，不合别请。#1

i1394.gloss: all buy land NMLZ, NEG DE exceed original regulation
i1394.translation: All those purchasing land were not permitted to exceed the limits set by existing regulations.
i1394.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|诸买地者，不得过本制#1

i1395.text: 虽居狭乡，亦听依宽制，其卖者不得更请。
i1395.gloss: although live narrow township, also allow follow broad regulation, DIST sell NMLZ NEG DE again request
i1395.translation: Even if residing in a narrow township, one was still permitted to follow the broader allocation standards, and those who had sold their land were not allowed to make another request.
i1395.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|虽居狭乡，亦听依宽制，其卖者不得更请。#1

i1396.text: 诸田不得贴赁及质，违者财没不追，地还本主。
i1396.gloss: all field NEG DE sublease rent and pledge, violate NMLZ money confiscate NEG pursue, land return original owner
i1396.translation: All land was not to be subleased or pledged; violators would forfeit the proceeds without recovery, and the land would be returned to its original owner.
i1396.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|诸田不得贴赁及质，违者财没不追，地还本主。#1

i1397.text: 诸给口分田，务从便近，不得隔越。
i1397.gloss: all give per.capita.share field, strive follow convenient near, NEG DE separate cross
i1397.translation: All household allotments of land were to be assigned as conveniently and nearby as possible, without crossing over to non-adjacent areas.
i1397.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|诸给口分田，务从便近，不得隔越。#1

i1398.text: 其价六斗以下者，依旧定；以上者，不得过六斗。
i1398.gloss: DIST price six dou below NMLZ, follow old fix; above NMLZ, NEG DE exceed six dou
i1398.translation: For prices of six dou or less, the original rate applied; for prices above that, they were not permitted to exceed six dou.
i1398.note: dou is a volume unit in acient China
i1398.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|其价六斗以下者，依旧定；以上者，不得过六斗。#1

i1399.gloss: all take willing, NEG DE force assign
i1399.translation: All was to be based on voluntary consent; coercion or forced assignments were not permitted.
i1399.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|并取情愿，不得抑配。#1

i1400.text: 至建中初，分遣黜陟使按比垦田田数，都得百十馀万顷。
i1400.gloss: reach Jianzhong beginning, separately dispatch demote.promote commissioner inspect compare cultivated field field number, total DE hundred ten more ten.thousand qing
i1400.translation: By the beginning of the Jianzhong reign, commissioners were dispatched to inspect and verify cultivated landholdings, totaling more than eleven million qing in all.
i1400.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tianzhi Xia|至建中初，分遣黜陟使按比垦田田数，都得百十馀万顷。#1

i1401.text: 渠下民田万馀顷，又可得以溉田
i1401.gloss: canal below people field ten.thousand more qing, also can DE use irrigate field
i1401.translation: The land of the common people below the canal amounted to over ten thousand qing, and it could also be irrigated using the canal.
i1401.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|渠下民田万馀顷，又可得以溉田#1

i1402.gloss: increase fertile Guanzhong GEN land, DE grain
i1402.translation: This further enriched the fertile lands of Guanzhong, yielding grain.
i1402.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|益肥关中之地，得谷。#1

i1403.gloss: canal below people largely DE use irrigate field PRF
i1403.translation: The common people below the canal were largely able to irrigate their fields.
i1403.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|渠下民颇得以溉田矣。#1

i1404.gloss: estimate can DE five thousand qing
i1404.translation: It is estimated that five thousand qing could be obtained.
i1404.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|度可得五千顷。#1

i1405.text: 今溉田之，度可得谷二百万石以上
i1405.gloss: now irrigate field 3.OBJ, estimate can DE grain two hundred ten.thousand shi above
i1405.translation: Now that the land is being irrigated, it is estimated that over two million shi of grain can be obtained.
i1405.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|今溉田之，度可得谷二百万石以上#1

i1406.gloss: truly DE water, can make mu ten shi
i1406.translation: If water is truly obtained, each mu could yield ten dan of grain.
i1406.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|诚得水，可令亩十石。#1

i1407.text: 穿渠得龙骨，故名曰龙首渠。
i1407.gloss: dig canal DE dragon bone, therefore name call Longshou canal
i1407.translation: A dragon bone was unearthed during the excavation of the canal, hence it was named Longshou Canal (“Dragon Head Canal”).
i1407.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|穿渠得龙骨，故名曰龙首渠。#1

i1408.text: 作之十馀岁，渠颇通，犹未得其饶。
i1408.gloss: make 3.OBJ ten more year, canal fairly through, still not.yet DE 3.GEN abundance
i1408.translation: After more than ten years of construction, the canal was largely functional, yet its full benefits had not yet been obtained.
i1408.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|作之十馀岁，渠颇通，犹未得其饶。#1

i1409.gloss: formerly NEG DE Zheng.Guo GEN irrigation NMLZ
i1409.translation: Previously, they had not benefited from the irrigation provided by the Zheng Guo Canal.
i1409.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|素不得郑国之溉灌者。#1

i1410.text: 平徭者，均齐渠堰之力役，谓俱得水之利。
i1410.gloss: equalize corvée TOP, even level canal weir GEN labor service, mean all DE water GEN benefit
i1410.translation: To equalize corvée labor meant to distribute fairly the work on canals and weirs, with the understanding that all would share equally in the benefits of the water.
i1410.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|平徭者，均齐渠堰之力役，谓俱得水之利。#1

i1411.text: 民得其饶，歌之曰：“田于何所？池阳、谷口…
i1411.gloss: people DE 3.GEN abundance, sing 3.OBJ say: field at what place? Chiyang, Gukou
i1411.translation: The people, having gained abundance from it, sang: “Where do we till the fields? In Chiyang and Gukou…”
i1411.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|民得其饶，歌之曰：“田于何所？池阳、谷口…#1

i1412.text: 广溉灌，岁岁增多，至三万顷，人得其利。
i1412.gloss: broaden irrigation, year year increase more, reach three ten.thousand qing, people DE 3.GEN benefit
i1412.translation: As irrigation expanded year by year, it eventually reached thirty thousand qing, and the people obtained its benefits.
i1412.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|广溉灌，岁岁增多，至三万顷，人得其利。#1

i1413.text: 臣愚谓既以水为田，当恃鱼菜螺蚌，而洪波泛滥，贫弱者终不能得。
i1413.gloss: servant foolish say since by water make field, should rely fish vegetable snail clam, CONJ great wave flood, poor weak NMLZ ultimately NEG can DE
i1413.translation: In my humble opinion, since water has been designated as farmland, the people should rely on fish, vegetables, snails, and clams; yet when great waves flood the area, the poor and weak ultimately cannot obtain them.
i1413.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|臣愚谓既以水为田，当恃鱼菜螺蚌，而洪波泛滥，贫弱者终不能得。#1

i1414.text: 令饥者尽得水产之饶，百姓不出境界之内，朝暮野食，此目下日给之益也。
i1414.gloss: make hungry NMLZ fully DE water product GEN abundance, common.people NEG exit boundary GEN inside, morning evening wild eat, PROX at.present daily supply GEN benefit SFP
i1414.translation: Let the hungry fully share in the abundance of aquatic resources, so that the common people need not leave their own localities, and may forage in the wild morning and evening—this is the immediate, daily benefit they receive.
i1414.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|令饥者尽得水产之饶，百姓不出境界之内，朝暮野食，此目下日给之益也。#1

i1415.text: 往者东南草创人稀，故得火田之利。
i1415.gloss: formerly southeast newly.founded person sparse, therefore DE fire field GEN benefit
i1415.translation: In earlier times, when the southeast was newly settled and sparsely populated, people were able to benefit from slash-and-burn agriculture.
i1415.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|往者东南草创人稀，故得火田之利。#1

i1416.text: 长吏二千石躬先劝功，诸食力之人并一时附功令，比及水冻，得粗枯涸。
i1416.gloss: senior official two thousand shi personally first encourage labor, all eat strength GEN person together one time attach labor order, by.the.time water freeze, DE roughly dry drained
i1416.translation: Senior officials should personally lead the effort and encourage labor, while all able-bodied workers should be mobilized at once under unified orders. By the time the waters freeze, a rough draining and drying of the land should be accomplished.
i1416.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|长吏二千石躬先劝功，诸食力之人并一时附功令，比及水冻，得粗枯涸。#1

i1417.text: 今因其所患而宣泻之，迹古事以明近，大理昭然，可坐论而得。
i1417.gloss: now follow 3.GEN NMLZ trouble CONJ open drain 3.OBJ, trace ancient matter to clarify recent, great principle evident ADVZ, can sit discuss CONJ DE
i1417.translation: Now, by responding to the present troubles through opening and draining, and by tracing ancient precedents to clarify current practices, the underlying principles become plainly evident—so clear that they can be understood easily.
i1417.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|今因其所患而宣泻之，迹古事以明近，大理昭然，可坐论而得。#1

i1418.text: 伐木开榛，水得通泾，由是遂丰稔。
i1418.gloss: cut tree open thicket, water DE flow.through Jing, from PROX thereupon abundant harvest
i1418.translation: Trees were chopped down and undergrowth cleared, allowing the water to flow into the Jing River; as a result, the harvests became abundant.
i1418.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|伐木开榛，水得通泾，由是遂丰稔。#1

i1419.text: 渠既高悬，水不得上，虽复诸处按旧引水，水亦难求。
i1419.gloss: canal since high hang, water NEG DE rise, although again all place according.to old draw water, water also hard seek
i1419.translation: Since the canal was on a high elevation, the water could not rise to it; thus, even if water was redirected from former sources elsewhere, it remained difficult to obtain.
i1419.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|渠既高悬，水不得上，虽复诸处按旧引水，水亦难求。#1

i1420.text: 计用四千人，四十日功，渠得成就。
i1420.gloss: estimate use four thousand person, forty day labor, canal DE complete
i1420.translation: With four thousand workers over forty days of labor, the canal was able to be completed.
i1420.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|计用四千人，四十日功，渠得成就。#1

i1421.text: 所欲凿新渠口，河下五尺，水不得入。
i1421.gloss: NMLZ want dig new canal mouth, river below five chi, water NEG DE enter
i1421.translation: The proposed new canal opening lay five feet below the riverbed, preventing water from entering.
i1421.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|所欲凿新渠口，河下五尺，水不得入。#1

i1422.text: 二十日功，计得成毕，合计用功六十日。
i1422.gloss: twenty day labor, estimate DE complete finish, total use labor sixty day
i1422.translation: With twenty days of additional work, completion was expected—bringing the total estimated labor to sixty days.
i1422.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|二十日功，计得成毕，合计用功六十日。#1

i1423.text: 旬日之闲，则水一遍，水凡四溉，谷得成实。
i1423.gloss: ten.day GEN interval, then water one time, water in.all four irrigate, grain DE become ripe
i1423.translation: Water (the crops) once every ten days; with four rounds of irrigation in total, the grain would reach full maturity.
i1423.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|旬日之闲，则水一遍，水凡四溉，谷得成实。#1

i1424.text: 加以壅遏耗竭，所以得利遂少。
i1424.gloss: add.to.that block obstruct consume exhaust, therefore DE benefit thereupon few
i1424.translation: Moreover, due to blockages and depletion, the benefits obtained gradually diminished.
i1424.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|加以壅遏耗竭，所以得利遂少。#1

i1425.text: 至大历中，水田才得六千二百馀顷。
i1425.gloss: reach Dali middle, water field only DE six thousand two hundred more qing
i1425.translation: By the Dali era, irrigated fields amounted to only about 6,200 qing.
i1425.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Shuili Tian|至大历中，水田才得六千二百馀顷。#1

i1426.text: 得谷百万斛。郡国例置田官，数年之中，所在积粟，仓廪皆满。
i1426.gloss: DE grain hundred ten.thousand hu. commandery state customarily set.up field official, several year GEN within, everywhere accumulate millet, granary all full
i1426.translation: A yield of one million hu of grain was obtained. As a standard practice, local field officials were appointed in each commandery and kingdom, and within a few years, grain had been stockpiled everywhere, with granaries filled to capacity.
i1426.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tun Tian|得谷百万斛。郡国例置田官，数年之中，所在积粟，仓廪皆满。#1

i1427.text: 长城左右营屯，岁收稻粟数十万石，北境得以周赡。
i1427.gloss: Great.Wall left right camp garrison, year harvest rice millet several ten ten.thousand shi, north border DE use fully supply
i1427.translation: The garrisons stationed along both sides of the Great Wall harvested several hundred thousand shi of rice and millet annually, enabling the northern frontier to be fully supplied.
i1427.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 2 - Tun Tian|长城左右营屯，岁收稻粟数十万石，北境得以周赡。#1

i1428.text: 是以情性可得而亲，生产可得而均
i1428.gloss: therefore feeling nature can DE CONJ intimate, production can DE CONJ equal
i1428.translation: Thus, human nature could be approached with intimacy, and production could be equitably distributed.
i1428.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|是以情性可得而亲，生产可得而均#1

i1429.text: 不求而得，不召而来，故人无流亡之意，吏无备追之忧。
i1429.gloss: NEG seek CONJ DE, NEG summon CONJ come, therefore person not.have drift flee GEN intent, official not.have prepare pursue GEN worry
i1429.translation: What was needed was obtained without seeking, and what was desired came without being summoned; thus, the people had no thought of fleeing, and officials had no fear of pursuing fugitives.
i1429.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|不求而得，不召而来，故人无流亡之意，吏无备追之忧。#1

i1430.text: 使其邻比相保爱，赏罚相延及，故出入存亡臧否逆顺可得而知也。
i1430.gloss: make 3.GEN neighbor mutually guarantee care, reward punish mutually extend reach, therefore exit enter survive perish good bad rebel obey can DE CONJ know SFP
i1430.translation: Neighbors were made to mutually guarantee and care for one another, with rewards and punishments extending from one to others; thus, matters of coming and going, life and death, good and bad conduct, loyalty and rebellion—all could be known.
i1430.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|使其邻比相保爱，赏罚相延及，故出入存亡臧否逆顺可得而知也。#1

i1431.text: 比年虽却改籍书，终无得实。
i1431.gloss: recent year although repeatedly revise register, ultimately not.have DE truth
i1431.translation: Though in recent years household registers have been repeatedly revised, they ultimately failed to reflect the actual situation.
i1431.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|比年虽却改籍书，终无得实。#1

i1432.text: 乃别置校籍官，置令史，限人一日得数巧，以防懈怠。
i1432.gloss: then separately set.up check register official, set.up clerk, limit person one day DE several fraud, to prevent slack
i1432.translation: Thus, separate officials were appointed to inspect the registers, along with clerks, and individuals were given daily quotas to complete a certain number of entries in order to guard against negligence.
i1432.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|乃别置校籍官，置令史，限人一日得数巧，以防懈怠。#1

i1433.text: 景平以前，既不系检，凡此诸籍，得无巧换。
i1433.gloss: Jingping before, since NEG tie check, all PROX all register, DE not.have fraud change
i1433.translation: Before the Jingping era, since there was no system of verification, all such registers were prone to fraudulent alteration.
i1433.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|景平以前，既不系检，凡此诸籍，得无巧换。#1

i1434.text: 今虽遗落，所存尚多，宜有徵验，可得信实。
i1434.gloss: now although lose drop, NMLZ remain still many, should have verify test, can DE reliable true
i1434.translation: Though many records have been lost, a substantial number still remain; they ought to be examined and verified, then we obtain reliable evidence.
i1434.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|今虽遗落，所存尚多，宜有徵验，可得信实。#1

i1435.text: 齐王俭复加，得繁省之衷。
i1435.gloss: Qi Wang.Jian again add, DE complex simple GEN middle
i1435.translation: Qi Wang Jian introduced further adjustments, thereby obtaining a balance between thoroughness and simplicity.
i1435.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|齐王俭复加，得繁省之衷。#1

i1436.text: 既识其事，又得其利，因人之欲，为之易行。
i1436.gloss: since know 3.GEN matter, also DE 3.GEN benefit, follow person GEN desire, make 3.OBJ easy implement
i1436.translation: Having understood the matter and acquired its benefits, the policy aligned with people’s desires, making it easy to implement.
i1436.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|既识其事，又得其利，因人之欲，为之易行。#1

i1437.text: 隅老四人，非是官府，私充事力，坊事亦得取济。
i1437.gloss: corner elder four person, NEG.COP COP government, privately serve affair labor, ward affair also DE take aid
i1437.translation: The four elderly men stationed at the corners were not government officials but privately served as assistants; local affairs were also able to benefit from their efforts.
i1437.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|隅老四人，非是官府，私充事力，坊事亦得取济。#1

i1438.text: 乃欲于一乡之内选一人能理五百家者，必恐难得。
i1438.gloss: then want in one township GEN inside choose one person can manage five hundred household NMLZ, surely fear hard DE
i1438.translation: It must be hard to get someone within a small town who can manage five hundred households.
i1438.key: 9-10th Century CE|Tongdian|Shihuo 3 - Xiangdang|乃欲于一乡之内选一人能理五百家者，必恐难得。#1

i1439.text: 太祖虽在甥馆，每有大志，乃归乡里，募兵得七百人
i1439.gloss: Taizu although at son-in-law lodging, always have great ambition, then return home village, recruit soldier DE seven hundred person
i1439.translation: Though the future Ming Taizu Emperor resided in his father-in-law’s household, he harbored great ambitions. He returned to his native village and raised a force of seven hundred men.
i1439.note: (Mingshi Jishi Benmo: Descriptive history of Ming Dynasty)
i1439.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|太祖虽在甥馆，每有大志，乃归乡里，募兵得七百人#1

i1440.gloss: DE strong soldier three thousand person
i1440.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|得壮士三千人。#1

i1441.text: 又招降秦把头，得八百馀人。
i1441.gloss: also summon surrender Qin chief, DE eight hundred more person
i1441.translation: He also secured the surrender of the rebel leader Qin, gaining over eight hundred more men.
i1441.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|又招降秦把头，得八百馀人。#1

i1442.text: 得濠而踞其上，更欲害之，背德不祥。
i1442.gloss: DE Hao CONJ occupy 3.GEN top, further want harm 3.OBJ, betray virtue NEG auspicious
i1442.translation: Having taken possession of Hao and established himself there, he then sought to do harm—such betrayal of virtue brings misfortune.
i1442.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|得濠而踞其上，更欲害之，背德不祥。#1

i1443.text: 子兴乃得帅所部归滁，称滁阳王。
i1443.gloss: Zixing then DE lead NMLZ command return Chu, call Chuyang king
i1443.translation: Zixing then was able to order his troops to return to Chuzhou, where he proclaimed himself the King of Chuyang.
i1443.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|子兴乃得帅所部归滁，称滁阳王。#1

i1444.text: 自是征讨之权，太祖皆不得与，且日疏远，而事之愈恭。
i1444.gloss: from PROX campaign punish GEN authority, Taizu all NEG DE participate, moreover daily estranged, CONJ serve 3.OBJ more respectful
i1444.translation: From that point on, the future Taizu Emperor was not allowed to be given any military authority. Though he was increasingly distanced, he served with ever greater loyalty.
i1444.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|自是征讨之权，太祖皆不得与，且日疏远，而事之愈恭。#1

i1445.text: 太祖所至，禁剽掠，有得即分部下，无所献。
i1445.gloss: Taizu NMLZ arrive, forbid plunder loot, have DE then divide subordinate, not.have NMLZ offer
i1445.translation: Wherever Taizu went, he forbade looting. Whatever was acquired was distributed among his subordinates, and nothing was kept as tribute.
i1445.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|太祖所至，禁剽掠，有得即分部下，无所献。#1

i1446.text: 伏发，城中鼓噪而出，元兵败走，滁得完。
i1446.gloss: ambush launch, city inside drum shout CONJ exit, Yuan soldier defeated flee, Chu DE intact
i1446.translation: Lying in ambush, they launched a sudden attack—the city rang with drums and cries as they charged forth. The Yuan forces were routed, and Chuzhou was able to be secured.
i1446.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|伏发，城中鼓噪而出，元兵败走，滁得完。#1

i1447.text: 攻民寨时，得兵三千，号庐州路义兵。
i1447.gloss: attack people stockade time, DE soldier three thousand, name Luzhou circuit righteous soldier
i1447.translation: When attacking the local stockades, he gained three thousand troops, who were named the Righteous Army of Luzhou Circuit.
i1447.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|攻民寨时，得兵三千，号庐州路义兵。#1

i1448.text: 诸军自滁来多，掠人妻女，军中无纪律，何以安众？凡所得妇女悉还之。
i1448.gloss: all army from Chu come many, plunder person wife daughter, army inside not.have discipline, what by pacify crowd? all NMLZ DE woman all return 3.OBJ
i1448.translation: Many of the troops coming from Chuzhou had seized other men’s wives and daughters, and discipline within the army was lacking—how could the people be pacified this way? Therefore, all women who had been taken were returned.
i1448.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|诸军自滁来多，掠人妻女，军中无纪律，何以安众？凡所得妇女悉还之。#1

i1449.text: 刚毅多智勇，膂力绝人，年二十三，为群雄刘聚所得。
i1449.gloss: firm resolute much wisdom courage, strength surpass person, age twenty-three, PASS warlord Liu.Ju NMLZ DE
i1449.translation: He was resolute, full of wisdom and courage, with extraordinary strength. At the age of twenty-three, he was taken into service by the warlord Liu Ju.
i1449.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|刚毅多智勇，膂力绝人，年二十三，为群雄刘聚所得。#1

i1450.text: 尔饥故来归耳，且有故主在，吾安得夺之！
i1450.gloss: 2SG hungry therefore come submit only, moreover have former lord exist, 1SG how DE seize 3.OBJ!
i1450.translation: You came to me out of hunger. But since your former lord is still around, how could I possibly take you from him?
i1450.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|尔饥故来归耳，且有故主在，吾安得夺之！#1

i1451.text: 傥得效力于智者，虽死犹生。
i1451.gloss: if DE serve to wise NMLZ, although die still live
i1451.translation: If I am able to serve one of the wise, then even in death, it would be as if I still lived.
i1451.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|傥得效力于智者，虽死犹生。#1

i1452.text: 众恐舟大不能渡，比至，才馀分寸，永安等遂得入大江
i1452.gloss: crowd fear boat big NEG can cross, by.the.time arrive, only spare fraction inch, Yong'an PL thereupon DE enter great river
i1452.translation: People feared that the boat was too large to cross; when they arrived, there was barely an inch to spare, and then Yong’an and the others was able to enter the Yangtze River.
i1452.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|众恐舟大不能渡，比至，才馀分寸，永安等遂得入大江#1

i1453.text: 汝等攻集庆，毋力战，俟我得脱还
i1453.gloss: 2PL attack Jiqing, PROH strenuous fight, wait 1SG DE escape return
i1453.translation: You are to attack Jiqing, but do not engage in full battle—wait until I'm able to escape and return.
i1453.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|汝等攻集庆，毋力战，俟我得脱还#1

i1454.gloss: Ye first DE letter, trick NEG go
i1454.translation: Ye received the letter beforehand, so the trick would not go through.
i1454.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|埜先得书，诈不行。#1

i1455.text: 得儒士夏煜、孙炎、杨宪等十馀人，皆录用之。
i1455.gloss: DE Confucian scholar Xia.Yu, Sun.Yan, Yang.Xian PL ten more person, all appoint use 3.OBJ
i1455.translation: He acquired the service of over ten Confucian scholars, including Xia Yu, Sun Yan, and Yang Xian—all of whom were appointed to official positions.
i1455.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|得儒士夏煜、孙炎、杨宪等十馀人，皆录用之。#1

i1456.text: 则但知其得天，而不考其顺人，良足哂也。
i1456.gloss: then only know 3.GEN DE heaven, CONJ NEG examine 3.GEN accord people, truly enough laugh SFP
i1456.translation: Such a view acknowledges only that he obtained Heaven’s favor, without examining how he won the support of the people—that is truly something to be laughed at.
i1456.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|1|则但知其得天，而不考其顺人，良足哂也。#1

i1457.text: 徐达等至镇江，得从龙，还报
i1457.gloss: Xu.Da PL reach Zhenjiang, DE Cong.Long, return report
i1457.translation: Xu Da and his army arrived at Zhenjiang, acquired the service of Cong Long and then returned to report.
i1457.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|徐达等至镇江，得从龙，还报#1

i1458.text: 擒其将朱亮祖，得军士十馀万，马二千匹。
i1458.gloss: capture 3.GEN general Zhu.Liangzu, DE soldier ten more ten.thousand, horse two thousand CLF
i1458.translation: They captured the enemy general Zhu Liangzu, acquired more than 100 thousand troops and 2 thousand horses.
i1458.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|擒其将朱亮祖，得军士十馀万，马二千匹。#1

i1459.text: 是非得已。生则尽力，死则死耳
i1459.gloss: PROX NEG.COP DE stop. live then exhaust strength, die then die only
i1459.translation: This is not what I can choose my own. While alive, I give my utmost; if I die, so be it.
i1459.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|是非得已。生则尽力，死则死耳#1

i1460.text: 明鉴等不能支，乃出降，得其众数万，马二千匹。
i1460.gloss: Mingjian PL NEG can hold, then exit surrender, DE 3.GEN crowd several ten.thousand, horse two thousand CLF
i1460.translation: Mingjian and his army cannot hold up anymore, so they came out of the city and surrendered. (The Yuan army) then acquired tens of thousands of surrendering troops and also two thousand horses.
i1460.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|明鉴等不能支，乃出降，得其众数万，马二千匹。#1

i1461.text: 按籍城中居民，仅得十八家。
i1461.gloss: check register city inside resident, only DE eighteen household
i1461.translation: According to the household registers, there remained only eighteen families among the city’s residents.
i1461.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|按籍城中居民，仅得十八家。#1

i1462.text: 故命尔此职，分巡各处，俾高无患乾，卑不病潦，务在蓄泄得宜。
i1462.gloss: therefore appoint 2SG PROX office, divide patrol each place, make high not.have suffer drought, low NEG suffer flood, strive at store drain DE proper
i1462.translation: Thus, you are appointed to this office, to patrol and inspect various regions—so that the highlands may be free from drought and the lowlands spared from flooding, with the utmost attention paid to ensuring storage and drainage get their proper arrangements.
i1462.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|故命尔此职，分巡各处，俾高无患乾，卑不病潦，务在蓄泄得宜。#1

i1463.translation: After I acquire Maozhou, I will put you in charge of the city.
i1463.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|我得婺州，命汝作知府。#1

i1464.text: 吾每闻诸将下一城，得一郡，不妄杀人，喜不自胜。
i1464.gloss: 1SG every hear all general take one city, DE one commandery, NEG wantonly kill person, joy NEG REFL bear
i1464.translation: Every time I hea that r the generals don't arbitrarily kill people when they conquer a city and acquire a county, I am utmostly pleased.
i1464.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|吾每闻诸将下一城，得一郡，不妄杀人，喜不自胜。#1

i1465.text: 中途闻变，驰至李文忠所，得再成旧部曲朱绚等
i1465.gloss: midway hear upheaval, gallop reach Li.Wenzhong place, DE again form old troop Zhu.Xuan PL
i1465.translation: Midway, upon hearing of the upheaval, he rushed to the residence of Li Wenzhong and was able to reassemble his former troops, including Zhu Xuan and others.
i1465.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|中途闻变，驰至李文忠所，得再成旧部曲朱绚等#1

i1466.text: 其令今岁农民毋得种秫。
i1466.gloss: P order this year peasant PROH DE plant glutinous.millet
i1466.translation: He ordered that this year, the peasants were not permitted to plant glutinous millet.
i1466.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|其令今岁农民毋得种秫。#1

i1467.text: 吾昔在军中，尝乏粮，空腹出战，得食粗粝，颇亦甘之。
i1467.gloss: 1SG formerly at army inside, once lack provision, empty belly go.out fight, DE eat coarse rough, quite also relish 3.OBJ
i1467.translation: In the past, when I was in the army, I often lacked provisions and went into battle on an empty stomach. When I finally had coarse and rough food to eat, I found it quite satisfying.
i1467.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|吾昔在军中，尝乏粮，空腹出战，得食粗粝，颇亦甘之。#1

i1468.text: 常笑陈友谅初得一隅，妄自尊大
i1468.gloss: often laugh Chen.Youliang just DE one corner, presumptuously REFL exalt great
i1468.translation: I often laughed at Chen Youliang—having barely secured a corner of land, he arrogantly exalted himself.
i1468.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|常笑陈友谅初得一隅，妄自尊大#1

i1469.translation: How could I possibly follow in his footsteps and make the same mistake?
i1469.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|吾岂得更自蹈之！#1

i1470.text: 若旦夕不能缓者，势有所不得已也。
i1470.gloss: if morning evening NEG can delay NMLZ, circumstance have NMLZ NEG DE stop SFP
i1470.translation: If something cannot be delayed even for a day or night, it is because circumstances leave no other choice.
i1470.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|若旦夕不能缓者，势有所不得已也。#1

i1471.text: 我有遗利，彼将乘之，我有弃货，彼将资之，顾安得而不汲汲耶！
i1471.gloss: 1SG have leave profit, DIST will exploit 3.OBJ, 1SG have discard goods, DIST will use 3.OBJ, but how DE CONJ NEG urgent Q!
i1471.translation: If I leave behind profit, they will seize it; if I cast away supplies, they will make use of them—how could they not be urgently pressing forward?
i1471.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|2|我有遗利，彼将乘之，我有弃货，彼将资之，顾安得而不汲汲耶！#1

i1472.text: 客惧来归，尽得普胜平日所为。
i1472.gloss: defector fear come submit, fully DE Pusheng ordinary.day NMLZ do
i1472.translation: A defector, fearful, came to surrender and revealed everything Pu Sheng had done in the past.
i1472.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|客惧来归，尽得普胜平日所为。#1

i1473.gloss: three day, Youliang NEG DE enter
i1473.translation: For three days, Youliang was not able to enter.
i1473.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|三日，友谅不得入#1

i1474.text: 江中得断木，附之入芦渚中
i1474.gloss: river inside DE broken wood, cling 3.OBJ enter reed islet inside
i1474.translation: He got a piece of drifting wood in the river, clung to it, and floated into a reed marsh.
i1474.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|江中得断木，附之入芦渚中#1

i1475.gloss: since DE Taiping urgently plot usurp false title
i1475.translation: Having secured a measure of peace, he immediately plotted to usurp authority and proclaim a false title.
i1475.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|既得太平亟谋僭伪号#1

i1476.translation: Youliang was very happy getting the letter.
i1476.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|友谅得书甚喜#1

i1477.text: 港狭，仅容三舟入，友谅以舟不得竝进
i1477.gloss: channel narrow, only hold three boat enter, Youliang because boat NEG DE side.by.side advance
i1477.translation: The channel was narrow, allowing only three boats to enter; Youliang was thus unable to advance on his boat.
i1477.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|港狭，仅容三舟入，友谅以舟不得竝进#1

i1478.text: 收得巨舰百馀艘，战舸数百
i1478.gloss: collect DE huge warship hundred more CLF, battle boat several hundred
i1478.translation: They captured over a hundred large warships and several hundred battle boats.
i1478.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|收得巨舰百馀艘，战舸数百#1

i1479.text: 友谅乘别舸脱走，于所乘舟中得茂才书。
i1479.gloss: Youliang ride other boat escape, in NMLZ ride boat inside DE Maocai letter
i1479.translation: Chen Youliang escaped in a separate boat and, aboard the vessel he took, got a letter from Mao Cai.
i1479.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|友谅乘别舸脱走，于所乘舟中得茂才书。#1

i1480.text: 吾起兵十年，奇才英士，得之四方
i1480.gloss: 1SG raise troop ten year, extraordinary talent heroic man, DE 3.OBJ four direction
i1480.translation: I have raised troops for ten years, and I have acquired (the service of) men of extraordinary talent and heroism from all corners of the realm.
i1480.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|吾起兵十年，奇才英士，得之四方#1

i1481.text: 得失之机，间不容发，其早为之计。
i1481.gloss: DE lose GEN juncture, gap NEG hold hair, let early make 3.OBJ plan
i1481.translation: The margin between gaining and losing is as narrow as a hair’s breadth—make plans early while there is still time.
i1481.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|得失之机，间不容发，其早为之计。#1

i1482.text: 廷瑞得书，遣康泰诣九江降
i1482.gloss: Tingrui DE letter, send Kang.Tai go.to Jiujiang surrender
i1482.translation: Tingrui got the letter and sent Kangtai to order the surrender of Jiujiang.
i1482.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|廷瑞得书，遣康泰诣九江降#1

i1483.text: 最后得养子所乘马，走还建康。
i1483.gloss: finally DE adopted.son NMLZ ride horse, flee return Jiankang
i1483.translation: Finally, he got the horse that his adopted son was riding and escaped to Jiankang.
i1483.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|最后得养子所乘马，走还建康。#1

i1484.text: 南昌控引荆、越，西南之藩屏，得南昌，去陈氏一臂矣
i1484.gloss: Nanchang control draw Jing, Yue, southwest GEN fence screen, DE Nanchang, remove Chen clan one arm PRF
i1484.translation: Nanchang commands access to Jing and Yue, serving as the southwestern shield—getting Nanchang will be as if one arm of the Chen regime has been severed.
i1484.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|南昌控引荆、越，西南之藩屏，得南昌，去陈氏一臂矣#1

i1485.text: 文正乃命煅铁戟铁钩，穿栅复刺，敌复来夺，手皆灼烂，不得进。
i1485.gloss: Wenzheng then order forge iron halberd iron hook, pierce barricade again stab, enemy again come seize, hand all burn rot, NEG DE advance
i1485.translation: Wenzheng thus ordered iron halberds and hooks to be forged and heated, to pierce and repel the enemy through the barricades. When the enemy tried to seize them again, their hands were burned and blistered, making it impossible to advance.
i1485.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|文正乃命煅铁戟铁钩，穿栅复刺，敌复来夺，手皆灼烂，不得进。#1

i1486.text: 我师先至罂子口，横截湖面，邀友谅，不得出，乃敛舟自守，不敢更战。
i1486.gloss: 1PL army first reach Yingzikou, across cut lake surface, intercept Youliang, NEG DE exit, then gather boat REFL defend, NEG dare again fight
i1486.translation: Our forces first arrived at Yingzikou, cutting across the lake to intercept Chen Youliang. Unable to escape, he withdrew his boats and fortified his position, not daring to reengage in battle.
i1486.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|我师先至罂子口，横截湖面，邀友谅，不得出，乃敛舟自守，不敢更战。#1

i1487.text: 时水路狭隘，舟不得并进，恐为敌所乘
i1487.gloss: time water road narrow, boat NEG DE together advance, fear PASS enemy NMLZ exploit
i1487.translation: At the time, the waterway was narrow, and the boats were unable to advance side by side, raising fears that the enemy might exploit this vulnerability.
i1487.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|时水路狭隘，舟不得并进，恐为敌所乘#1

i1488.text: 友谅得书，怒，留使者不遣，尽杀所获我战士。
i1488.gloss: Youliang DE letter, angry, detain envoy NEG send, all kill NMLZ capture 1PL soldier
i1488.translation: Upon receiving the letter, Chen Youliang flew into a rage, detained the envoy without release, and executed all the captured soldiers from our side.
i1488.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|友谅得书，怒，留使者不遣，尽杀所获我战士。#1

i1489.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|公之土地，吾已得之#1

i1490.text: 纵力驱残兵，来死城下，不可再得也。
i1490.gloss: even.if force drive remnant soldier, come die city below, NEG can again DE SFP
i1490.translation: Even if he were to force his remaining troops forward to perish beneath the city walls, he would not have another chance.
i1490.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|纵力驱残兵，来死城下，不可再得也。#1

i1491.text: 明日，平章陈荣等悉舟师来降，得士卒五万馀人。
i1491.gloss: next day, Pingzhang Chen.Rong PL all boat army come surrender, DE soldier five ten.thousand more person
i1491.translation: The next day, Pingzhang's Chenrong and others surrendered their navy; (Taizu's army) got more than 50 thousand troops.
i1491.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|明日，平章陈荣等悉舟师来降，得士卒五万馀人。#1

i1492.text: 主上推好生之德，惠此一方，使陈氏之孤得保首领
i1492.gloss: sovereign extend love life GEN virtue, favor PROX one region, make Chen clan GEN orphan DE preserve head neck
i1492.translation: His Majesty, upholding the virtue of cherishing life, showed mercy to this region, allowing the remaining followers of the Chen clan to preserve their lives.
i1492.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|主上推好生之德，惠此一方，使陈氏之孤得保首领#1

i1493.gloss: exhaust luxury extreme extravagance, how DE NEG perish
i1493.translation: Given his utter indulgence in extravagance and excess, how could he not have met his downfall?
i1493.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|穷奢极侈，安得不亡。#1

i1494.gloss: if DE land not.have people, will how use 3.OBJ!
i1494.translation: If one gains territory but has no people, of what use is it?
i1494.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|苟得地无民，将安用之！#1

i1495.text: 一者士不伤，一者生灵获全，所得不已多乎？
i1495.gloss: one TOP soldier NEG harm, one TOP living.being obtain whole, NMLZ DE NEG already much Q?
i1495.translation: First, our soldiers are unharmed; second, the common people are spared—are these gains not already more than enough?
i1495.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|3|一者士不伤，一者生灵获全，所得不已多乎？#1

i1496.gloss: nature light wealth love give, quite DE crowd heart
i1496.translation: He was generous with wealth and fond of giving, thereby winning much of the people’s support.
i1496.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|性轻财好施，颇得众心。#1

i1497.text: 士诚得书，以太祖比之隗嚣，不悦
i1497.gloss: Shicheng DE letter, by Taizu compare 3.OBJ Wei.Xiao, NEG pleased
i1497.translation: When Shicheng got the letter, which compared Taizu to Wei Xiao, he was displeased.
i1497.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|士诚得书，以太祖比之隗嚣，不悦#1

i1498.translation: Shicheng got the letter but did not report (to his superior).
i1498.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|士诚得书不报。#1

i1499.text: 得长兴则士诚步骑不敢出广德，窥宣、歙
i1499.gloss: DE Changxing then Shicheng infantry cavalry NEG dare exit Guangde, spy Xuan, She
i1499.translation: Once Changxing is secured, Shicheng’s infantry and cavalry will no longer dare to venture out to Guangde or spy upon Xuancheng and Shexian.
i1499.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|得长兴则士诚步骑不敢出广德，窥宣、歙#1

i1500.text: 得江阴则士诚舟师不敢溯大江，上金、焦。
i1500.gloss: DE Jiangyin then Shicheng boat army NEG dare go.upstream great river, ascend Jin, Jiao
i1500.translation: Once Jiangyin is secured, Shicheng's navy will not dare to cruise on Dajiang or reach Jin and Jiao.
i1500.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|得江阴则士诚舟师不敢溯大江，上金、焦。#1

i1501.text: 时胡德济得李文忠檄，自信州率兵来援
i1501.gloss: time Hu.Deji DE Li.Wenzhong declaration, from Xinzhou lead soldier come reinforce
i1501.translation: At that time, Hu Deji got Li Wenzhong's declaration and brought troops from Xinzhou to reinforce.
i1501.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|时胡德济得李文忠檄，自信州率兵来援#1

i1502.text: 有降卒言贼情，具得虚实。
i1502.gloss: have surrender soldier tell bandit situation, fully DE empty solid
i1502.translation: A surrendered soldier revealed the enemy’s situation, from which the full intellegence—both real and feigned—was obtained.
i1502.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|有降卒言贼情，具得虚实。#1

i1503.text: 会左、右军败，阻于堑，不得出。
i1503.gloss: coincide left, right army defeat, block by trench, NEG DE exit
i1503.translation: Coinciding with the defeat of the Left and Right Armies, they were blocked by a trench and could not escape.
i1503.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|会左、右军败，阻于堑，不得出。#1

i1504.gloss: 1SG head can cut, seal NEG can DE SFP!
i1504.translation: My head may be taken, but the seal you shall not have!
i1504.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|我头可断，印不可得也！#1

i1505.text: 达得书，遂会兵进攻，一鼓克之
i1505.gloss: Da DE letter, thereupon gather soldier advance attack, one drum conquer 3.OBJ
i1505.translation: Upon receiving the letter, Xu Da gathered the troops and launched an attack—defeating the enemy in a single charge.
i1505.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|达得书，遂会兵进攻，一鼓克之#1

i1506.text: 遇春进击宝，败之，宝走入城，阻桥不得济
i1506.gloss: Yuchun advance attack Bao, defeat 3.OBJ, Bao flee enter city, block bridge NEG DE cross
i1506.translation: Yu Chun advanced and attacked Bao, defeating him. Bao fled into the city but was blocked at the bridge and could not cross.
i1506.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|遇春进击宝，败之，宝走入城，阻桥不得济#1

i1507.text: 遇春令勇士乘划舟数百突击之，擒志坚，得众二千馀人。
i1507.gloss: Yuchun order brave soldier ride row boat several hundred sudden attack 3.OBJ, capture Zhijian, DE crowd two thousand more person
i1507.translation: Yu Chun ordered his brave soldiers to launch a sudden assault using several hundred small boats, capturing Zhi Jian and seizing over two thousand of his men.
i1507.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|遇春令勇士乘划舟数百突击之，擒志坚，得众二千馀人。#1

i1508.text: 将还报，常遇春扼归路，不得出。
i1508.gloss: general return report, Chang.Yuchun block return road, NEG DE exit
i1508.translation: As the general attempted to return with his report, Chang Yuchun blocked the route of retreat, making him unable to pass.
i1508.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|将还报，常遇春扼归路，不得出。#1

i1509.text: 义始得脱，与潘元绍率赤龙船兵屯于平望
i1509.gloss: Yi only.then DE escape, with Pan.Yuanshao lead Red.Dragon ship soldier station at Pingwang
i1509.translation: Yi was able to escape and joined Pan Yuanshao in leading the Red Dragon Fleet to station at Pingwang.
i1509.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|义始得脱，与潘元绍率赤龙船兵屯于平望#1

i1510.text: 五太子、朱暹、吕珍等以旧馆降，得兵六万人。
i1510.gloss: Fifth.Prince, Zhu.Xian, Lü.Zhen PL with Jiuguan surrender, DE soldier six ten.thousand person
i1510.translation: The Fifth Prince, Zhu Xian, Lü Zhen, and others surrendered along with their former garrison, bringing over sixty thousand troops.
i1510.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|五太子、朱暹、吕珍等以旧馆降，得兵六万人。#1

i1511.text: 抽刀欲自杀，为左右抱持，得不死。
i1511.gloss: draw sword want REFL kill, PASS left right hold grasp, DE NEG die
i1511.translation: He drew his sword to take his own life, but was held back by his attendants and thus was able to survive.
i1511.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|抽刀欲自杀，为左右抱持，得不死。#1

i1512.text: 尔，我之戚臣，若降，可得不死。
i1512.gloss: 2SG, 1SG GEN relative minister, if surrender, can DE NEG die
i1512.translation: You are my relative and minister—if you surrender, your life can be spared.
i1512.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|尔，我之戚臣，若降，可得不死。#1

i1513.text: 吾兵远来，胜负未可知，而遽约降，得无以计缓我乎？
i1513.gloss: 1SG soldier far come, win lose not.yet can know, CONJ hastily propose surrender, DE not.have by plan delay 1SG Q?
i1513.translation: My troops have come from afar, and the outcome of battle is still uncertain—if you propose surrender so hastily, might it not be a ploy to delay me?
i1513.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|吾兵远来，胜负未可知，而遽约降，得无以计缓我乎？#1

i1514.text: 达纵茂出入往来，因得其彼此所遗蜡书，悉知士诚、天佑虚实
i1514.gloss: Da allow Mao exit enter go come, thereby DE 3.GEN each.other NMLZ send wax letter, fully know Shicheng, Tianyou empty solid
i1514.translation: Xu Da allowed Mao to move freely between camps, and through this gained access to the wax-sealed letters exchanged between the two sides, thereby coming to fully understand the true and false intentions of Shi Cheng and Tianyou.
i1514.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|达纵茂出入往来，因得其彼此所遗蜡书，悉知士诚、天佑虚实#1

i1515.gloss: Da DE letter, knock head accept command
i1515.translation: Upon receiving the letter, Xu Da bowed his head in submission and accepted the command.
i1515.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|达得书，顿首受命。#1

i1516.text: 吾此时虽有言，亦不得闻也。
i1516.gloss: 1SG PROX time although have word, also NEG DE hear SFP
i1516.translation: Even if I were to speak now, my words could not be heard.
i1516.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|吾此时虽有言，亦不得闻也。#1

i1517.text: 公此时欲死不得，生无所归。
i1517.gloss: 2SG.HON PROX time want die NEG DE, live not.have NMLZ return
i1517.translation: At this moment, you cannot die, yet in life you have nowhere to turn.
i1517.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|公此时欲死不得，生无所归。#1

i1518.text: 且公之地，譬如博者，得人之物而复失之，何损！
i1518.gloss: moreover 2SG.HON GEN land, like gamble NMLZ, DE person GEN thing CONJ again lose 3.OBJ, what harm!
i1518.translation: As for your territory, it is like that of a gambler—gaining something from another only to lose it again—what harm is there in that?
i1518.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|且公之地，譬如博者，得人之物而复失之，何损！#1

i1519.text: 徐达令军中架木若屋状，承以竹笆，伏兵其下，载以攻城矢石不得伤。
i1519.gloss: Xu.Da order army inside frame wood like house shape, support with bamboo screen, hide soldier 3.GEN below, carry by.it attack city arrow stone NEG DE harm
i1519.translation: Xu Da ordered the troops to construct wooden frames in the shape of houses, topped with bamboo screens, and concealed soldiers beneath them. These mobile structures were used to attack the city, protecting the troops so arrows and stones cannot hurt them.
i1519.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|徐达令军中架木若屋状，承以竹笆，伏兵其下，载以攻城矢石不得伤。#1

i1520.text: 所得城中兵民二十馀万。
i1520.gloss: NMLZ DE city inside soldier civilian twenty more ten.thousand
i1520.translation: Over two hundred thousand soldiers and civilians were captured within the city.
i1520.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|4|所得城中兵民二十馀万。#1

i1521.text: 所得府库，还封识之，以奉其主
i1521.gloss: NMLZ DE treasury storehouse, return seal mark 3.OBJ, to offer 3.GEN lord
i1521.translation: The seized contents of the government treasury were preserved and sealed, to be returned in service to their rightful ruler.
i1521.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|5|所得府库，还封识之，以奉其主#1

i1522.text: 和分徇定海、慈溪等县，得军士三千人
i1522.gloss: He divide pacify Dinghai, Cixi PL county, DE soldier three thousand person
i1522.translation: He and his forces pacified the counties of Dinghai, Cixi, and others, gaining three thousand soldiers.
i1522.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|5|和分徇定海、慈溪等县，得军士三千人#1

i1523.text: 国珍不得已，遣郎中承广、员外郎陈永乞降
i1523.gloss: Guozhen NEG DE stop, send director Cheng.Guang, assistant.director Chen.Yong beg surrender
i1523.translation: Guo Zhen, having no other choice, sent Director Cheng Guang and Assistant Director Chen Yong to sue for surrender.
i1523.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|5|国珍不得已，遣郎中承广、员外郎陈永乞降#1

i1524.text: 国珍及其弟国珉率部属谒见汤和于军门，得士马舟楫数万计。
i1524.gloss: Guozhen and 3.GEN younger.brother Guomin lead subordinate visit Tang.He at army gate, DE soldier horse boat oar several ten.thousand count
i1524.translation: Guo Zhen and his brother Guo Min, along with their subordinates, came to present themselves before Tang He at the military camp, bringing with them tens of thousands of soldiers, horses, boats, and supplies.
i1524.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|5|国珍及其弟国珉率部属谒见汤和于军门，得士马舟楫数万计。#1

i1525.text: 故先平吴、汉，后议国珍，缓急之势所不得混也。
i1525.gloss: therefore first pacify Wu, Han, later discuss Guozhen, slow urgent GEN situation NMLZ NEG DE confuse SFP
i1525.translation: Thus it was necessary first to pacify Wu and Han before turning to Guo Zhen—the urgency and sequence of events shall not be confused.
i1525.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|5|故先平吴、汉，后议国珍，缓急之势所不得混也。#1

i1526.text: 因失鹅而奔于邻，邻家梦虎踞门，得友定，大喜
i1526.gloss: because lose goose CONJ run to neighbor, neighbor family dream tiger crouch door, DE Youding, greatly happy
i1526.translation: Having lost a goose, Youding ran to his neighbor’s home. The neighbor, who dreamed of a tiger crouching at the door in the previous night, was overjoyed when he obtained (the service of) Youding.
i1526.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|6|因失鹅而奔于邻，邻家梦虎踞门，得友定，大喜#1

i1527.gloss: staff.officer how DE by disaster be excuse!
i1527.translation: How could you, a staff office, use natural disaster as an excuse (to avoid fighting)!
i1527.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|6|参军何得以灾为解！#1

i1528.text: 足下所收复郡邑，得其仓库，入为家资。
i1528.gloss: 2SG.HON NMLZ recover commandery town, DE 3.GEN granary treasury, enter be family property
i1528.translation: The prefectures and counties you have reclaimed, along with getting their granaries and treasuries, have been taken as your personal property.
i1528.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|6|足下所收复郡邑，得其仓库，入为家资。#1

i1529.text: 十长石古违良节制，友定兵得渡柳营江。
i1529.gloss: squad.leader Shi.Gu violate Liang command, Youding soldier DE cross Liuying river
i1529.translation: Officer Shi Gu disobeyed Liang's command, so that Youding’s troops were able to cross the Liuying River.
i1529.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|6|十长石古违良节制，友定兵得渡柳营江。#1

i1530.text: 战守非吾得为，无以报国。
i1530.gloss: fight defend NEG.COP 1SG DE do, not.have by.which repay state
i1530.translation: Now that fighting or defending is not something I can do, I have no way to serve the nation any more.
i1530.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|6|战守非吾得为，无以报国。#1

i1531.gloss: 1SG thereby CONJ exploit 3.OBJ, can DE ambition
i1531.translation: If I take advantage of this moment, I can fulfill my ambition.
i1531.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|6|吾因而乘之，可以得志。#1

i1532.text: 日夜勒吏士击刁斗，被甲偶立，不得更番休息，守者怨甚。
i1532.gloss: day night force officer soldier beat signal.pot, wear armor pair stand, NEG DE alternate shift rest, guard NMLZ resent extremely
i1532.translation: Day and night, the officers and soldiers were forced to beat the signal drums and stand guard in armor, and were not allowed to rest in shifts—those on duty grew deeply resentful.
i1532.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|6|日夜勒吏士击刁斗，被甲偶立，不得更番休息，守者怨甚。#1

i1533.text: 已矣，毋多谈，安得加我死乎！
i1533.gloss: stop PRF, PROH much talk, how DE add 1SG death Q!
i1533.translation: Enough—no more words. What more could you impose on me besides my death?
i1533.key: 16-17th Century CE|Mingshi Jishi Benmo|6|已矣，毋多谈，安得加我死乎！#1

i1534.text: 我转荐足下与小苏学士处，久后也得个出身
i1534.gloss: 1SG transfer recommend 2SG.HON to Little Su scholar place, long after also DE CLF career
i1534.translation: I’ll recommend you to Scholar Xiao Su; in time you’ll also obtain a respectable position.
i1534.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||我转荐足下与小苏学士处，久后也得个出身#1

i1535.text: 把梯子上去拆了，也得耳根清净。
i1535.gloss: BA ladder go.up dismantle PFV, also DE ear root clean quiet
i1535.translation: Pull the ladder up and dismantle it, and you’ll have peace and quiet.
i1535.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||把梯子上去拆了，也得耳根清净。#1

i1536.text: 管营把五两银子与他，差拨也得五两银子送他。
i1536.gloss: warden BA five tael silver give 3SG, officer also DE five tael silver give 3SG
i1536.translation: The warden gave him five taels of silver, and the officer in charge also got five taels to give him to send him off.
i1536.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||管营把五两银子与他，差拨也得五两银子送他。#1

i1537.text: 便逃得性命时，烧了大军草料场，也得个死罪。
i1537.gloss: even escape DE life time, burn PFV great army fodder depot, also DE CLF death crime
i1537.translation: Although we can manage to escape with our life, by burning the army’s forage depot we still got (committed) a capital crime.
i1537.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||便逃得性命时，烧了大军草料场，也得个死罪。#1

i1538.text: 这婆子也得了些钱物，没奈何，只得依允了。
i1538.gloss: PROX old.woman also DE PFV some money thing, not.have what.to.do, only DE comply agree CRS
i1538.translation: This old woman also received some money and goods, and having no alternative, had to agree.
i1538.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||这婆子也得了些钱物，没奈何，只得依允了。#1

i1539.text: 若得娘子贵手做时，老身便死来也得好处去。
i1539.gloss: if DE lady noble hand make time, 1SG.HUM even die come also DE good place go
i1539.translation: If I can obtain the gracious help of you, my lady, then even if my old body dies, I will still gain some benefit.
i1539.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||若得娘子贵手做时，老身便死来也得好处去。#1

i1540.text: 那妇人拜谢了下山，两个轿夫也得了性命。
i1540.gloss: DIST woman bow thank PFV descend mountain, two CLF sedan.bearer also DE PFV life
i1540.translation: The woman bowed in thanks and went down the mountain, and the two sedan bearers also preserved their lives.
i1540.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||那妇人拜谢了下山，两个轿夫也得了性命。#1

i1541.text: 日后归来，也得早晚伏侍父亲终身。
i1541.gloss: day after return come, also DE morning evening serve father whole.life
i1541.translation: In the future, I'll be able to once again serve you, my father, day and night for my whole life.
i1541.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||日后归来，也得早晚伏侍父亲终身。#1

i1542.text: 先生何不将带几个人去，一发就搬取老尊堂上山，早晚也得侍奉。
i1542.gloss: sir why NEG take bring several CLF person go, at.once then move fetch old honored.mother up mountain, morning evening also DE serve
i1542.translation: Sir, why not take a few men and at once move your honored elder up to the family hall on the mountain, so you can serve her morning and evening?
i1542.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||先生何不将带几个人去，一发就搬取老尊堂上山，早晚也得侍奉。#1

i1543.text: 急待回来，也得三四个月。
i1543.gloss: urgently want return come, also DE three four CLF month
i1543.translation: Urgently returning will also need three to four months.
i1543.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||急待回来，也得三四个月。#1

i1544.text: 若是射得下来，村坊人家，讨些水，煮瀑得熟，也得充饥。
i1544.gloss: if COP shoot DE down come, village household, ask some water, boil scald DE cooked, also DE fill hunger
i1544.translation: If we manage to shoot it down, we can request some water from the village households and cook it until done, and it can fill their bellies.
i1544.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||若是射得下来，村坊人家，讨些水，煮瀑得熟，也得充饥。#1

i1545.text: 久后纵无功赏，也得青史上留名。
i1545.gloss: long after even.if not.have merit reward, also DE green history on leave name
i1545.translation: Even if there is no reward later, I can still have my name recorded in the annals of history.
i1545.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||久后纵无功赏，也得青史上留名。#1

i1546.text: 我想也得好一片地来排陷他。
i1546.gloss: 1SG think also DE good one CLF ground come array trap 3SG
i1546.translation: I think it needs a large field to encircle the army.
i1546.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||我想也得好一片地来排陷他。#1

i1547.text: 到那里去也是死，要打便和你厮打，死在这里，也得一口好棺材。
i1547.gloss: go there go also COP die, want fight then with 2SG fight, die at here, also DE one CLF good coffin
i1547.translation: If I go there I may die anyway; if you want to fight, come at me and I’ll fight you to the end - if I die here, at least I’ll get a proper coffin.
i1547.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||到那里去也是死，要打便和你厮打，死在这里，也得一口好棺材。#1

i1548.text: 若是我四个要做官时，方腊手下，也得个统制做了多时。
i1548.gloss: if COP 1PL four CLF want be official time, Fang.La under.hand, also DE CLF commander be PFV long time
i1548.translation: If the four of us were to become officials under Fang La, we’d long ago have been made commanders.
i1548.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||若是我四个要做官时，方腊手下，也得个统制做了多时。#1

i1549.text: 我如此行计，也得他四将之首，活捉了茅迪，将来解赴张招讨军前，斩首施行。
i1549.gloss: 1SG like.this carry.out plan, also DE 3SG four general GEN head, alive capture PFV Mao.Di, take come escort go.to Zhang recruiter army front, behead execute
i1549.translation: If I carry out this plan, I’ll get the heads of his four generals, capture Mao Di alive, bring him before Zhang the recruiter’s army, and have him executed by beheading.
i1549.key: 15th Century CE|Water Margin||我如此行计，也得他四将之首，活捉了茅迪，将来解赴张招讨军前，斩首施行。#1

i1550.text: 假似你说这般到官，倒也得些状告
i1550.gloss: if 2SG say PROX.way reach court, rather also DE some charge accuse
i1550.translation: If what you says reaches the court, you get some charges to charge against me.
i1550.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||假似你说这般到官，倒也得些状告#1

i1551.text: 一顿要吃三五斗米饭，早间点心也得百十个烧饼才够。
i1551.gloss: one meal want eat three five dou rice, morning snack also DE hundred ten CLF baked.cake only.then enough
i1551.translation: One meal requires three to five dǒu of rice, and for breakfast snacks, a hundred or so pancakes are needed.
i1551.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||一顿要吃三五斗米饭，早间点心也得百十个烧饼才够。#1

i1552.text: 拜谢了众圣，隐姓修行，后来也得了正果
i1552.gloss: bow thank PFV crowd saint, hide surname cultivate, later also DE PFV true fruit
i1552.translation: After paying respects to all the saints, he concealed his name and practiced cultivation, and later attained true enlightenment.
i1552.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||拜谢了众圣，隐姓修行，后来也得了正果#1

i1553.text: 若要吃人啊，一顿也得五百个，还不饱足。
i1553.gloss: if want eat person TOP, one meal also DE five hundred CLF, still NEG full satisfied
i1553.translation: If the demon were to eat people, a single meal would need five hundred of them - and that still wouldn’t be enough.
i1553.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||若要吃人啊，一顿也得五百个，还不饱足。#1

i1554.text: 那些妖精点卯也得七八日，怎么就打得罄尽？
i1554.gloss: DIST some demon roll.call also DE seven eight day, how then fight DE exhausted?
i1554.translation: Even if those demons were counted day by day, it would need seven or eight days - how could they be completely exterminated so quickly?
i1554.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||那些妖精点卯也得七八日，怎么就打得罄尽？#1

i1555.text: 四众食毕，那女子也得些食力。
i1555.gloss: four crowd eat finish, DIST woman also DE some food strength
i1555.translation: After the group of four finished eating, that young woman also got some to eat.
i1555.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||四众食毕，那女子也得些食力。#1

i1556.text: 香喷喷的大家吃一块儿，也得个延年长寿。
i1556.gloss: fragrant ATTR everyone eat one piece, also DE CLF extend year long life
i1556.translation: Everyone eats a piece of the fragrant food and also gets longevity.
i1556.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||香喷喷的大家吃一块儿，也得个延年长寿。#1

i1557.text: 倘或皇天见怜，有人救得，收养此子，他日还得相逢。
i1557.gloss: if august heaven PASS pity, have person save DE, take.in raise PROX child, other day still DE mutually meet
i1557.translation: If Heaven shows mercy, and someone manages to rescue and take in this child, we can still meet him one day.
i1557.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||倘或皇天见怜，有人救得，收养此子，他日还得相逢。#1

i1558.text: 教我跟随那取经人往西天拜佛求经，将功折罪，还得正果。
i1558.gloss: make 1SG follow DIST fetch scripture person toward West.Heaven worship Buddha seek scripture, use merit offset crime, still DE true fruit
i1558.translation: Ordered me to follow the pilgrim to the West to pay homage to the Buddha and seek the scriptures, so that my past misdeeds are expiated and I may attain true fruition.
i1558.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||教我跟随那取经人往西天拜佛求经，将功折罪，还得正果。#1

i1559.text: 千万还得我保你西天去也。
i1559.gloss: by.all.means still DE 1SG protect 2SG West.Heaven go SFP
i1559.translation: Please (forgive me) so I can still make sure you make it safely to the Western Heaven.
i1559.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||千万还得我保你西天去也。#1

i1560.text: 万岁，虽有锦衣卫，还得小徒去方可。
i1560.gloss: Your.Majesty, although have brocade.guard, still DE little disciple go only.then acceptable
i1560.translation: Your Majesty, even with your royal guards, it still requires my humble disciple to go personally.
i1560.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||万岁，虽有锦衣卫，还得小徒去方可。#1

i1561.text: 若要我师父过去，还得我们著力，你们都成不得。
i1561.gloss: if want 1SG master cross go, still DE 1PL exert strength, 2PL all accomplish NEG DE
i1561.translation: If our master is to get across, it will still require our effort - none of you alone can manage it.
i1561.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||若要我师父过去，还得我们著力，你们都成不得。#1

i1562.text: 徒弟啊，速来救我，还得见面
i1562.gloss: disciple VOC, quickly come save 1SG, still DE see face
i1562.translation: My disciple, come quickly to save me, so you can still see me.
i1562.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||徒弟啊，速来救我，还得见面#1
