i1563.text: 没饭吃，饿死了，还得个完全身体归阴。
i1563.gloss: not.have food eat, starve die PFV, still DE CLF complete body return underworld
i1563.translation: If she dies of hunger with no food to eat, at least she’ll still get a whole body to return to the underworld.
i1563.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||没饭吃，饿死了，还得个完全身体归阴。#1

i1564.text: 打虎还得亲兄弟，上阵须教父子兵。
i1564.gloss: fight tiger still DE own brother, go.to battle must make father son soldier
i1564.translation: To fight a tiger, you need your own brother; to go into battle, it must be with father and son as soldiers.
i1564.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||打虎还得亲兄弟，上阵须教父子兵。#1

i1565.text: 此酒果是素酒，弟子勉强吃了，还得见佛成功
i1565.gloss: PROX wine truly COP vegetarian wine, disciple reluctantly drink PFV, still DE see Buddha succeed
i1565.translation: If this wine truly is vegetarian wine, I will reluctantly drink it and can still see the Buddha and achieve enlightenment.
i1565.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||此酒果是素酒，弟子勉强吃了，还得见佛成功#1

i1566.text: 但愿应时还得见，须知胜似岳阳金。
i1566.gloss: only wish timely still DE see, must know surpass Yueyang gold
i1566.translation: I only hope that in due time I may see you again - for that would be better than all the gold of Yueyang.
i1566.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||但愿应时还得见，须知胜似岳阳金。#1

i1567.text: 种瓜还得瓜，种豆还得豆。
i1567.gloss: plant melon still DE melon, plant bean still DE bean
i1567.translation: If you plant melons, you’ll get melons; if you plant beans, you’ll get beans.
i1567.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||种瓜还得瓜，种豆还得豆。#1

i1568.text: 只还得原借三百金回家，也好过日。
i1568.gloss: only return DE original borrow three hundred gold return home, also good pass day
i1568.translation: Please only collect the repayment of the originally borrowed three hundred taels and return home - that would at least allow us to get by.
i1568.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||只还得原借三百金回家，也好过日。#1

i1569.text: 拜了四拜，学士只还得两个揖，甚不过意。
i1569.gloss: bow PFV four bow, scholar only return DE two CLF salute, very NEG feel.right
i1569.translation: He bowed four times, while the scholar merely returned two salutes — which he found quite improper.
i1569.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||拜了四拜，学士只还得两个揖，甚不过意。#1

i1570.text: 既是小姐的东西，还得小姐来讨，方才还他。
i1570.gloss: since COP young.lady ATTR thing, still DE young.lady come claim, only.then return 3SG
i1570.translation: Since it belongs to the young lady, she must come to claim it herself before it can be returned to her.
i1570.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||既是小姐的东西，还得小姐来讨，方才还他。#1

i1571.text: 这银两须要仔细，请收过了，只要还得价钱公道便好。
i1571.gloss: PROX silver must careful, please receive over PFV, only.if return DE price fair then good
i1571.translation: Please handle this sum of silver carefully and accept it; as long as the repayment is at a fair price, that’s all that matters.
i1571.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||这银两须要仔细，请收过了，只要还得价钱公道便好。#1

i1572.text: 应时还得见，胜是岳阳金。
i1572.gloss: timely still DE see, surpass COP Yueyang gold
i1572.translation: I only hope that in due time I may see you again - for that would be better than all the gold of Yueyang.
i1572.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||应时还得见，胜是岳阳金。#1

i1573.text: 正是投瓜还得报，善人不负善心人。
i1573.gloss: exactly COP throw melon still DE repay, good person NEG fail good heart person
i1573.translation: Truly, when you offer a melon, you’ll be repaid in kind — a good person never fails one with a kind heart.
i1573.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||正是投瓜还得报，善人不负善心人。#1

i1574.text: 临终还得个好断送，只怕你老人家没福。
i1574.gloss: near end still DE CLF good send.off, only fear 2SG.HON not.have fortune
i1574.translation: At least when you die, you will get a proper send-off; I just fear that you may not have such good fortune.
i1574.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||临终还得个好断送，只怕你老人家没福。#1

i1575.text: 种麻还得麻，种豆还得豆。
i1575.gloss: plant hemp still DE hemp, plant bean still DE bean
i1575.translation: Plant hemp and you get hemp; plant beans and you get beans. (Proverb: You reap what you sow.)
i1575.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||种麻还得麻，种豆还得豆。#1

i1576.text: 也得老身见他一见，与他讲道方好。
i1576.gloss: also DE 1SG.HUM see 3SG one see, with 3SG talk reason only.then good
i1576.translation: I must see him myself and speak some reason to him; only then will it be proper.
i1576.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||也得老身见他一见，与他讲道方好。#1

i1577.text: 况孩儿新娶媳妇，也得他拜见公公方是。
i1577.gloss: moreover child newly marry wife, also DE 3SG pay.respect father-in-law only.then right
i1577.translation: Moreover, my son has just taken a wife; it is necessary for her to pay respects to her father-in-law. That is the proper way.
i1577.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||况孩儿新娶媳妇，也得他拜见公公方是。#1

i1578.text: 所以有这样事，也得他经一遭儿，警戒下次。
i1578.gloss: therefore have PROX.kind matter, also DE 3SG undergo one time, warn next time
i1578.translation: So this happened... it was necessary for him to experience it once, as a warning for the future.
i1578.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||所以有这样事，也得他经一遭儿，警戒下次。#1

i1579.text: 奶奶这里收拾起来，也得好几日。
i1579.gloss: madam here tidy start, also DE quite several day
i1579.translation: For you to tidy your things here, madam, it will need quite a few days.
i1579.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||奶奶这里收拾起来，也得好几日。#1

i1580.text: 也得他趁少年美貌，别寻头路。
i1580.gloss: also DE 3SG take.advantage young beautiful.looks, separately seek way
i1580.translation: He should, while still young and beautiful, find another path for himself.
i1580.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||也得他趁少年美貌，别寻头路。#1

i1581.text: 弹琴时也得个知音的人儿在傍喝采方好。
i1581.gloss: play qin time also DE CLF know music ATTR person at side cheer only.then good
i1581.translation: When playing the qin, it would be truly good to get a connoisseur nearby to applaud.
i1581.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||弹琴时也得个知音的人儿在傍喝采方好。#1

i1582.text: 仙姑卧房何处？是什么纸帐？也得小生认一认。
i1582.gloss: immortal.lady bedroom what place? COP what paper curtain? also DE 1SG.HUM recognize one recognize
i1582.translation: Where is the immortal lady's bedchamber? What kind of paper bed-curtains does it have? I must go and take a look.
i1582.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||仙姑卧房何处？是什么纸帐？也得小生认一认。#1

i1583.text: 我们人众，分不来，极少也得二十两。
i1583.gloss: 1PL person many, divide NEG come, at.least also DE twenty tael
i1583.translation: There are many of us; it's not enough to divide. At the very least, we must have twenty taels of silver.
i1583.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||我们人众，分不来，极少也得二十两。#1

i1584.text: 若在外恁般游荡，也得好些银子使费，他却从何而来？
i1584.gloss: if at outside such loaf, also DE many silver spend, 3SG but from where CONJ come?
i1584.translation: If one were to live so dissolutely outside, it would require a great deal of silver for expenses. Where, then, does he get it from?
i1584.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||若在外恁般游荡，也得好些银子使费，他却从何而来？#1

i1585.text: 小妇人嫁与刘贵，虽是做小老婆，却也得他看承得好
i1585.gloss: 1SG.HUM marry to Liu.Gui, although COP be concubine, but also DE 3SG treat DE good
i1585.translation: Although I married Liu Gui as a concubine, I also got to be treated well by him.
i1585.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||小妇人嫁与刘贵，虽是做小老婆，却也得他看承得好#1

i1586.text: 做个小小经纪，也得过养身活命。
i1586.gloss: do CLF small small broker, also DE pass nourish body live life
i1586.translation: Working as a small broker, one can also get by and make enough to live on.
i1586.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||做个小小经纪，也得过养身活命。#1

i1587.text: 你快快说来，也得我心下明白。
i1587.gloss: 2SG quickly say come, also DE 1SG heart below clear
i1587.translation: Hurry up and tell me, so that I can understand what is going on.
i1587.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||你快快说来，也得我心下明白。#1

i1588.text: 连那鸡儿狗儿，餂了鼎中药末，也得相随而去
i1588.gloss: even DIST chicken dog, lick PFV cauldron inside medicine powder, also DE mutually follow CONJ go
i1588.translation: Even the chickens and dogs, having licked the medicinal powder in the cauldron, also got to ascend (to heaven) along with them.
i1588.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||连那鸡儿狗儿，餂了鼎中药末，也得相随而去#1

i1589.text: 不如还了俗去，娶个老婆，生男育女，也得夫妻团聚。
i1589.gloss: NEG as.good.as return PFV lay.life go, marry CLF wife, bear son raise daughter, also DE husband wife reunite
i1589.translation: It would be better to return to secular life, marry a wife, have children, and also get to enjoy the life of a family.
i1589.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||不如还了俗去，娶个老婆，生男育女，也得夫妻团聚。#1

i1590.text: 哥哥，既然放他不得，抛在湖中，也得个全尸而死。
i1590.gloss: elder.brother, since release 3SG NEG DE, throw at lake inside, also DE CLF whole corpse CONJ die
i1590.translation: Brother, since we cannot let him go, if we throw him in the lake, he will at least get an intact body when dying.
i1590.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||哥哥，既然放他不得，抛在湖中，也得个全尸而死。#1

i1591.text: 今日是初五、也得做兄弟的发个利市。
i1591.gloss: today COP fifth, also DE be brother NMLZ give CLF good.luck.gift
i1591.translation: Today is the fifth (of the month); I, as your brother, must give you a gift for good luck.
i1591.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||今日是初五、也得做兄弟的发个利市。#1

i1592.text: 小夫人要来张胜家中，也得我娘肯时方可。
i1592.gloss: young mistress want come Zhang.Sheng home inside, also DE 1SG mother willing time only.then acceptable
i1592.translation: If the young mistress wants to come to Zhang Sheng's home, it must be when my mother agrees.
i1592.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||小夫人要来张胜家中，也得我娘肯时方可。#1

i1593.text: 德称口如悬河，宾主颇也得合。
i1593.gloss: Decheng mouth like hanging river, guest host quite also DE harmony
i1593.translation: De Cheng spoke with great eloquence, and the guest and host also got harmony (got along quite well).
i1593.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||德称口如悬河，宾主颇也得合。#1

i1594.text: 我今日为求嗣而来，做一件好事回去，也得神天知道。
i1594.gloss: 1SG today for seek heir CONJ come, do one CLF good matter return go, also DE god heaven know
i1594.translation: I came today to pray for an heir; I will do a good deed before I leave, so that it can be the case the the gods of heavan knows of the good deed.
i1594.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||我今日为求嗣而来，做一件好事回去，也得神天知道。#1

i1595.text: 我两口儿老来也得所靠。
i1595.gloss: 1PL two mouth old come also DE NMLZ rely
i1595.translation: The two of us (husband and wife), when we are old, will also get someone to rely on.
i1595.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||我两口儿老来也得所靠。#1

i1596.text: 列位，你既劝我不要到官，也得我骂他几句，出这口气。
i1596.gloss: everyone, 2SG since persuade 1SG NEG want go official, also DE 1SG curse 3SG several CLF, vent PROX CLF anger
i1596.translation: Everyone, since you've persuaded me not to report this to the authorities, you must at least let me curse him a few times to vent my anger.
i1596.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||列位，你既劝我不要到官，也得我骂他几句，出这口气。#1

i1597.text: 倒不如自眼里看他结末了，也得明白。
i1597.gloss: rather NEG as.good.as own eye inside watch 3SG end PFV, also DE clear
i1597.translation: It would be better to watch with my own eyes how he meets his end; that way, I can have a clear understanding.
i1597.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||倒不如自眼里看他结末了，也得明白。#1

i1598.gloss: 1SG nine spring GEN below, also DE close eye
i1598.translation: In my grave, I will be able to rest in peace.
i1598.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||我九泉之下，也得瞑目。#1

i1599.text: 要备起送文书，府县公门也得些使用。
i1599.gloss: need prepare dispatch document, prefecture county yamen also DE some expense
i1599.translation: We need to prepare the official documents, and the government offices will also acquire some 'expenses' (i.e., bribes).
i1599.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||要备起送文书，府县公门也得些使用。#1

i1600.gloss: why NEG demand? also DE 3SG willing return!
i1600.translation: (You asked) Why not demand it back? (Even if I did,) it would still depend on him being willing to return it!
i1600.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||怎么不讨？也得他肯还！#1

i1601.text: 你便早死，我们也得早早回京。
i1601.gloss: 2SG if early die, 1PL also DE early early return capital
i1601.translation: (Your death is certain) If you die early, we can also return to the capital at once.
i1601.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||你便早死，我们也得早早回京。#1

i1602.text: 讨这花枝般的女儿，自家也得精神对付他
i1602.gloss: marry PROX flower branch like ATTR girl, REFL also DE energy handle 3SG
i1602.translation: To marry such a beautiful (flower-like) girl, one must have the energy to handle her.
i1602.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||讨这花枝般的女儿，自家也得精神对付他#1

i1603.text: 若遇著这二位官人，也得他些资助，好无福分！
i1603.gloss: if meet bump.into PROX two CLF gentleman, also DE 3SG some aid, very not.have fortune!
i1603.translation: If only I had met these two gentlemen, I could have at least gotten some financial help from them. What terrible luck!
i1603.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||若遇著这二位官人，也得他些资助，好无福分！#1

i1604.text: 若是小心与他相好，钱财也得了他的。
i1604.gloss: if COP careful with 3SG mutually good, money also DE PFV 3SG NMLZ
i1604.translation: If I had been careful and gotten on good terms with him, I would have gotten his money too.
i1604.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||若是小心与他相好，钱财也得了他的。#1

i1605.text: 拚些上下使用，身上也得干净。
i1605.gloss: risk some up down expense, body on also DE clean
i1605.translation: If you're willing to spend some money on bribes (for 'expenses' up and down the ladder), your criminal charges can be cleared up.
i1605.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||拚些上下使用，身上也得干净。#1

i1606.text: 不如挺身首官，便吃了一剐，也得名扬于后世。
i1606.gloss: NEG as.good.as stand.forward confess official, even suffer PFV one slicing, also DE name spread to later generation
i1606.translation: It would be better to turn myself in. Even if I am executed, my name can at least be known to posterity.
i1606.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||不如挺身首官，便吃了一剐，也得名扬于后世。#1

i1607.text: 虽然董四哥吃了些亏，也得了个好消息。
i1607.gloss: although Dong fourth.brother eat PFV some loss, also DE PFV CLF good news
i1607.translation: Although Fourth Brother Dong suffered a bit of a loss, he also received some good news.
i1607.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||虽然董四哥吃了些亏，也得了个好消息。#1

i1608.text: 取得这项银两，一路上盘缠，也得宽裕，免致吃苦。
i1608.gloss: take DE PROX CLF silver, whole.way on travel.money, also DE ample, avoid cause eat bitterness
i1608.translation: Once we get this silver, our travel expenses for the journey can be sufficient, and we can avoid suffering hardship.
i1608.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||取得这项银两，一路上盘缠，也得宽裕，免致吃苦。#1

i1609.text: 论理我们里头也得他来整治整治，都忒不像了。
i1609.gloss: by reason 1PL inside also DE 3SG come discipline discipline, all too NEG proper CRS
i1609.translation: Logically, he ought to come and sort us out, too; we've all become too improper.

i1640.translation: ...so that we can cheer up a bit.

pmw82vhsqdmct.text: 是故人主有五壅：臣閉其主曰壅，臣制財利曰壅，臣擅行令曰壅，臣得行義曰壅，臣得樹人曰壅。

pmw82vhsqdmct.translation: Hence the ruler faces five obstructions: when a minister shuts off his ruler, that is an obstruction; when a minister controls wealth and profit, that is an obstruction; when a minister issues orders on his own, that is an obstruction; when a minister is able to practice righteousness on his own account, that is an obstruction; when a minister is able to plant his own men in office, that is an obstruction.
pmw82vhsqdmct.key: 5-3rd Century BCE|Han Fei Zi|Zhu Dao|是故人主有五壅：臣閉其主曰壅，臣制財利曰壅，臣擅行令曰壅，臣得行義曰壅，臣得樹人曰壅。#2

pmw82vhsreqyy.text: 臣閉其主，則主失位；臣制財利，則主失德；臣擅行令，則主失制；臣得行義，則主失明；臣得樹人，則主失黨。

pmw82vhsreqyy.translation: When a minister shuts off his ruler, the ruler loses his position; when a minister controls wealth and profit, the ruler loses the power to bestow; when a minister issues orders on his own, the ruler loses control; when a minister is able to practice righteousness on his own account, the ruler loses his discernment; when a minister is able to plant his own men in office, the ruler loses his following.

pmw82vhsrf159.text: 故審得失有法度之制者，加以羣臣之上，則主不可欺以詐僞；審得失有權衡之稱者，以聽遠事，則主不可欺以天下之輕重。

pmw9w8sf1avof.text: 眾老人答曰：「督郵逼勒縣吏，欲害劉公；我等皆來苦告，不得放入，反遭把門人趕打！」
pmw9w8sf1avof.gloss: all old.man answer say : inspector coerce county.official , want harm Lord.Liu ; 1PL all come bitterly.plead , NEG DE let.enter , instead suffer gatekeeper chase.beat !
pmw9w8sf1avof.translation: The old men all answered, "The inspector is coercing the county officials and wants to harm Lord Liu; we all came to plead bitterly, but were not allowed to enter; instead we were chased and beaten by the gatekeepers!"
pmw9w8sf1avof.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|2|眾老人答曰：「督郵逼勒縣吏，欲害劉公；我等皆來苦告，不得放入，反遭把門人趕打！」#1

pmw9w8sf1bfef.text: 張飛大怒，睜圓環眼，咬碎鋼牙，滾鞍下馬，逕入館驛，把門人那裏阻擋得住。
pmw9w8sf1bfef.gloss: Zhang.Fei great angry, open round ring.eye, bite broken steel.tooth, roll saddle down horse, straight enter post.station, gatekeeper how DE block hold?
pmw9w8sf1bfef.translation: Zhang Fei flew into a rage; he opened wide his round eyes, ground his steel teeth, rolled off the saddle and dismounted, and went straight into the post station—how could the gatekeeper stop (him)?
pmw9w8sf1bfef.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|2|張飛大怒，睜圓環眼，咬碎鋼牙，滾鞍下馬，逕入館驛，把門人那裏阻擋得住。#1

pmw9w8sf1c19f.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|2|認得我麼？」#1

pmw9w8sf1djz5.text: 玄德正納悶間，聽得縣前喧鬧，問左右，答曰：「張將軍綁一人在縣前痛打。」
pmw9w8sf1djz5.gloss: Xuande just feel.vexed while, hear DE county.office.front clamor, ask attendant, answer say: General.Zhang bind one person at county.office.front severely.beat.
pmw9w8sf1djz5.translation: Just as Xuande was feeling vexed, he heard a clamor in front of the county office; he asked his attendants, and they replied: 'General Zhang has tied up a man and is beating him severely in front of the county office.'
pmw9w8sf1djz5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|2|玄德正納悶間，聽得縣前喧鬧，問左右，答曰：「張將軍綁一人在縣前痛打。」#1

pmw9w8sf1eqmo.text: 傍邊轉過關公來，曰：「兄長建許多大功，僅得縣尉，今反被督郵侮辱。
pmw9w8sf1eqmo.gloss: from.the.side turn.past Guan.Gong come, say: elder.brother establish many great.merit, only DE county.commandant, now instead PASS inspector insult.
pmw9w8sf1eqmo.translation: Guan Gong stepped forward from the side and said, “Elder brother, you have established so many great achievements, yet only obtained the post of county commandant; now instead you are insulted by the inspector.”
pmw9w8sf1eqmo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|2|傍邊轉過關公來，曰：「兄長建許多大功，僅得縣尉，今反被督郵侮辱。#1

pmw9w8sf1fzo0.text: 武士擁陶出，方欲行刑，一大臣喝住曰：「勿得下手，待我諫去。」
pmw9w8sf1fzo0.gloss: warrior escort Tao out, just want carry.out.execution, one great.minister shout stop say: do.not DE lay.hand, wait 1SG remonstrate go.
pmw9w8sf1fzo0.translation: The guards seized Tao and dragged him out, and just as they were about to carry out the execution, a high minister shouted for them to stop, saying: “Do not lay a hand on him; wait for me to go and remonstrate.”
pmw9w8sf1fzo0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|2|武士擁陶出，方欲行刑，一大臣喝住曰：「勿得下手，待我諫去。」#1

pmw9w8sf2gvy9.text: 逕入室中來諫帝曰：「劉諫議得何罪而受誅？」
pmw9w8sf2gvy9.gloss: directly enter room inside come remonstrate emperor say: Liu Remonstrance.Official DE what crime CONJ receive execution?
pmw9w8sf2gvy9.translation: He went straight into the chamber and came to remonstrate with the emperor, saying: “What crime has Liu the Remonstrance Official committed that he should suffer execution?”
pmw9w8sf2gvy9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|2|逕入室中來諫帝曰：「劉諫議得何罪而受誅？」#1

pmw9w8sf2hhd4.text: 那何進起身屠家；因妹入宮為貴人，生皇子辯，遂立為皇后，進由是得權重任。
pmw9w8sf2hhd4.gloss: DEM He.Jin rise butcher household ; because younger.sister enter palace become noble.consort , give.birth prince Bian , then install as empress , He.Jin thereby DE power heavy.responsibility .
pmw9w8sf2hhd4.translation: That He Jin rose from a butcher's household; because (his) younger sister entered the palace and became a noble consort, gave birth to the imperial prince Bian, and was then made empress, He Jin thereby gained power and heavy responsibility.
pmw9w8sf2hhd4.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|2|那何進起身屠家；因妹入宮為貴人，生皇子辯，遂立為皇后，進由是得權重任。#1

pmw9w8sf2i3du.text: 張讓、段珪見董后一枝已廢，遂皆以金珠玩好結搆何進弟何曲並其母舞陽君，令早晚入何太后處，善言遮蔽：因此十常侍又得近幸。
pmw9w8sf2i3du.gloss: Zhang.Rang, Duan.Gui see Empress.Dong one.branch already ruin, then all with gold.pearl curio win.over He.Jin younger.brother He.Qu and 3SG mother Wuyang.Lady, cause morning.evening enter Empress.He place, good.words shield: therefore Ten.Attendants again DE near.favor.
pmw9w8sf2i3du.translation: Zhang Rang and Duan Gui, seeing that Empress Dong's faction had already been ruined, then all used gold, pearls, and curios to win over He Jin's younger brother He Qu and his mother Lady Wuyang, and had them go morning and evening to Empress He's quarters, to shield (them) with fair words: because of this the Ten Regular Attendants once again gained favor.
pmw9w8sf2i3du.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|2|張讓、段珪見董后一枝已廢，遂皆以金珠玩好結搆何進弟何曲並其母舞陽君，令早晚入何太后處，善言遮蔽：因此十常侍又得近幸。#1

pmw9w8sf2jct1.text: 微物尚不可欺以得志，況國家大事乎？
pmw9w8sf2jct1.gloss: small creature still NEG can deceive thereby DE ambition, how.much.more state great affair Q?
pmw9w8sf2jct1.translation: Even a small creature cannot be deceived in order to achieve one's aim—how much less can one do so in the great affairs of state?
pmw9w8sf2jct1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|2|微物尚不可欺以得志，況國家大事乎？#1

pmwa1ngpo177ga.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpo177ga.text: 汝得之，當代天宣化，普救世人。
pmwa1ngpo177ga.gloss: 2SG DE 3SG, should on.behalf.of Heaven proclaim.transformation, universally save world.people.
pmwa1ngpo177ga.translation: Once you have obtained it, you should proclaim transforming influence on behalf of Heaven and universally save the people of the world.
pmwa1ngpo177ga.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|汝得之，當代天宣化，普救世人。#1

pmwa1ngpo1867f.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpo1867f.text: 角得此書，曉夜功習，能呼風喚雨，號為「太平道人」。
pmwa1ngpo1867f.gloss: Zhang.Jiao DE this book, day.and.night diligently.practice, can summon.wind call.rain, title.as Great.Peace.Taoist.
pmwa1ngpo1867f.translation: Zhang Jiao obtained this book, practiced it diligently day and night, could summon the wind and call the rain, and was titled the 'Taoist of Great Peace'.
pmwa1ngpo1867f.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|角得此書，曉夜功習，能呼風喚雨，號為「太平道人」。#1

pmwa1ngpo19irj.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpo19irj.text: 角與二弟商議曰：「至難得者，民心也。
pmwa1ngpo19irj.gloss: Jiao with two.younger.brothers discuss say: most hard DE NMLZ, people heart COP.
pmwa1ngpo19irj.translation: Zhang Jiao discussed with his two younger brothers, saying, "What is hardest to obtain is the hearts of the people."
pmwa1ngpo19irj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|角與二弟商議曰：「至難得者，民心也。#1

pmwa1ngpo1ax94.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpo1ax94.text: 幽州太守劉焉，乃江夏竟陵人氏，漢魯恭王之後也；當時聞得賊兵將至，召校尉鄒靖計議。
pmwa1ngpo1ax94.gloss: Youzhou governor Liu.Yan, COP Jiangxia Jingling native, Han Lu.Prince.Gong descendant SFP; at.that.time hear DE rebel.troops about.to arrive, summon colonel Zou.Jing discuss.
pmwa1ngpo1ax94.translation: Liu Yan, the governor of Youzhou, was a native of Jingling in Jiangxia and a descendant of Prince Gong of Lu of the Han; at that time, when he heard that the rebel troops were about to arrive, he summoned the colonel Zou Jing to discuss plans.
pmwa1ngpo1ax94.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幽州太守劉焉，乃江夏竟陵人氏，漢魯恭王之後也；當時聞得賊兵將至，召校尉鄒靖計議。#1

pmwa1ngpo1bj8u.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpo1bj8u.text: 那人不甚好讀書；性寬和，寡言語，喜怒不言於色；素有大志，專好結交天下豪傑；生得身長七尺五寸，兩耳垂肩，雙手過膝，目能自顧其耳，面如冠玉，唇如塗脂；中山靖王劉勝之後，漢景帝閣下玄孫：姓劉，名備，字玄德。
pmwa1ngpo1bj8u.gloss: DEM person NEG very like read book; nature lenient.gentle, few speech, joy.anger NEG speak in countenance; always have great.ambition, especially like make.friends world heroes; born DE body long seven chi five cun, two ear hang shoulder, both hand pass knee, eye can self look.at 3SG ear, face like cap.jade, lip like smear rouge; Zhongshan.Jing.Prince Liu.Sheng GEN descendant, Han.Jing.Emperor HON great.great.grandson: surname Liu, name Bei, courtesy.name Xuande.
pmwa1ngpo1bj8u.translation: That man did not much care for reading books; his nature was lenient and gentle, he was sparing of words, and did not show joy or anger in his expression; he had always had great ambitions and was especially fond of making friends with heroes of the world; he was born with a body seven chi five cun tall, ears that hung to his shoulders, hands that passed his knees, eyes that could look back at his own ears, a face like jade on a cap, and lips as if smeared with rouge; he was a descendant of Liu Sheng, Prince Jing of Zhongshan, and a great-great-grandson of Emperor Jing of Han: surname Liu, given name Bei, courtesy name Xuande.
pmwa1ngpo1bj8u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|那人不甚好讀書；性寬和，寡言語，喜怒不言於色；素有大志，專好結交天下豪傑；生得身長七尺五寸，兩耳垂肩，雙手過膝，目能自顧其耳，面如冠玉，唇如塗脂；中山靖王劉勝之後，漢景帝閣下玄孫：姓劉，名備，字玄德。#1

pmwa1ngpo1cqvh.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpo1cqvh.text: 祭罷天地，復宰牛設酒，聚鄉中勇士，得三百餘人，就桃園中痛飲一醉。
pmwa1ngpo1cqvh.gloss: sacrifice finish heaven earth, again slaughter ox set.out wine, gather village middle brave.man, DE three.hundred surplus person, at Peach.Garden middle drink.deeply one drunk.
pmwa1ngpo1cqvh.translation: After the sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was finished, they again slaughtered an ox and set out wine, gathered the brave men from the village, obtaining more than three hundred men, and in the Peach Garden drank deeply until drunk.
pmwa1ngpo1cqvh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|祭罷天地，復宰牛設酒，聚鄉中勇士，得三百餘人，就桃園中痛飲一醉。#1

pmwa1ngpp1d390.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpp1d390.text: 次日，接得青州太守龔景牒文，言黃巾賊圍城將陷，乞賜救援。
pmwa1ngpp1d390.gloss: next day, receive DE Qingzhou governor Gong.Jing dispatch, say Yellow.Turban bandit surround city FUT fall, beg bestow rescue.
pmwa1ngpp1d390.translation: The next day, (Liu Yan) received a dispatch from Gong Jing, governor of Qingzhou, saying that the Yellow Turban rebels had surrounded the city and it was about to fall, and begging for relief.
pmwa1ngpp1d390.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|次日，接得青州太守龔景牒文，言黃巾賊圍城將陷，乞賜救援。#1

pmwa1ngpp1eqp5.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpp1eqp5.translation: Because of this, Cao was able to indulge himself and act without restraint.
pmwa1ngpp1eqp5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|因此，操得恣意放蕩。#1

pmwa1ngpp1flfu.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpp1flfu.text: 正值張梁、張寶敗走，曹操攔住，大殺一陣，斬首萬餘級，奪得旗旌、金鼓、馬匹極多。
pmwa1ngpp1flfu.gloss: just.when Zhang.Liang, Zhang.Bao defeated.flee, Cao.Cao block.stop, great.kill one.bout, behead ten.thousand.more CLF, seize DE banners, gongs.drums, horses extremely.many.
pmwa1ngpp1flfu.translation: Just as Zhang Liang and Zhang Bao were fleeing in defeat, Cao Cao intercepted them and slaughtered (them) in one bout, cutting off more than ten thousand heads and seizing an extremely large number of banners, gongs and drums, and horses.
pmwa1ngpp1flfu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|正值張梁、張寶敗走，曹操攔住，大殺一陣，斬首萬餘級，奪得旗旌、金鼓、馬匹極多。#1

pmwa1ngpp1gspc.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpp1gspc.translation: Zhang Liang and Zhang Bao fought desperately and managed to escape.
pmwa1ngpp1gspc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張梁、張寶死戰得脫。#1

pmwa1ngpp1h28u.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpp1h28u.text: 卻說玄德引關、張來潁川，聽得喊殺之聲，又望見火光燭天，急引兵來時，賊已敗散。
pmwa1ngpp1h28u.gloss: now Xuan.De lead Guan.Zhang come Ying.Chuan, hear DE shout.kill GEN sound, also see firelight illuminate sky, urgently lead troops come time, bandit already defeated.scatter.
pmwa1ngpp1h28u.translation: Now Xuande led Guan (Yu) and Zhang (Fei) to Yingchuan. Hearing the sounds of shouting and killing, and also seeing the firelight lighting up the sky, he urgently led his troops over, but the bandits had already been defeated and scattered.
pmwa1ngpp1h28u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說玄德引關、張來潁川，聽得喊殺之聲，又望見火光燭天，急引兵來時，賊已敗散。#1

pmwa1ngpp1ikq0.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpp1ikq0.text: 到得半路，只見一簇軍馬，護送一輛檻車；車中之囚，乃盧植也。
pmwa1ngpp1ikq0.gloss: arrive DE halfway, only see one cluster troop.horse, escort one CLF prison.cart; cart inside GEN prisoner, COP Lu.Zhi SFP.
pmwa1ngpp1ikq0.translation: When (Liu Bei and his men) reached halfway, they saw a cluster of soldiers and horses escorting a prison cart; the prisoner in the cart was Lu Zhi.
pmwa1ngpp1ikq0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|到得半路，只見一簇軍馬，護送一輛檻車；車中之囚，乃盧植也。#1

pmwa1ngpp1jaw4.section: 第一回　　　　　宴桃園豪傑三結義　　斬黃巾英雄首立功
pmwa1ngpp1jaw4.text: 安得快人如翼德，盡誅世上負心人！
pmwa1ngpp1jaw4.gloss: how DE forthright.person like Yide, all execute world ungrateful.person!
pmwa1ngpp1jaw4.translation: How could one get a forthright man like Yide to slaughter all the ungrateful people in the world!
pmwa1ngpp1jaw4.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|安得快人如翼德，盡誅世上負心人！#1

pmwa1ngpp1kgg2.section: 第三回　　　　　議溫明董卓叱丁原　　餽金珠李肅說呂布
pmwa1ngpp1kgg2.text: 是時得詔大喜，點起軍馬，陸續便行；使其婿中郎將牛輔，守住陝西，自己卻帶李傕、郭汜、張濟、樊稠等提兵望洛陽進發。
pmwa1ngpp1kgg2.gloss: at.that.time DE edict greatly.joy, muster.up troops.horses, one.after.another then set.out; order 3SG son-in-law general.of.the.household Niu.Fu, guard.hold Shaanxi, self instead lead Li.Jue, Guo.Si, Zhang.Ji, Fan.Chou etc lead.troops towards Luoyang advance.
pmwa1ngpp1kgg2.translation: At that time, having received the edict, he was overjoyed; he mustered the troops and horses and set out one after another. He ordered his son-in-law, the General of the Household Niu Fu, to hold Shaanxi, while he himself led Li Jue, Guo Si, Zhang Ji, Fan Chou and others, commanding troops and advancing toward Luoyang.
pmwa1ngpp1kgg2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|是時得詔大喜，點起軍馬，陸續便行；使其婿中郎將牛輔，守住陝西，自己卻帶李傕、郭汜、張濟、樊稠等提兵望洛陽進發。#1

pmwa1ngpp1lu7n.section: 第三回　　　　　議溫明董卓叱丁原　　餽金珠李肅說呂布
pmwa1ngpp1lu7n.translation: He Jin received the memorial and showed it to the high ministers.
pmwa1ngpp1lu7n.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|何進得表，出示大臣。#1

pmwa1ngpp1mhv0.section: 第三回　　　　　議溫明董卓叱丁原　　餽金珠李肅說呂布
pmwa1ngpp1mhv0.translation: He Jin received the edict and immediately set out.
pmwa1ngpp1mhv0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|進得詔便行。#1

pmwa1ngpp1nb3m.section: 第三回　　　　　議溫明董卓叱丁原　　餽金珠李肅說呂布
pmwa1ngpp1nb3m.text: 太后從窗中跳出，植急救得免。
pmwa1ngpp1nb3m.gloss: Empress.Dowager from window middle jump out, Lu.Zhi urgent rescue DE escape
pmwa1ngpp1nb3m.translation: The Empress Dowager jumped out through the window; Lu Zhi hurriedly came to her rescue, and she escaped harm.

pmwa1ngpr2fne7.translation: Fortunately, the two armies of Qiao Mao and Yuan Yi both arrived and came to rescue Wang Kuang; only then did Lü Bu retreat.
pmwa1ngpr2fne7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幸得喬瑁、袁遺兩軍皆至，來救王匡，呂布方退。#1

pmwa1ngpr2gc5k.section: 第五回　　　　　發矯詔諸鎮應曹公　　破關兵三英戰呂布
pmwa1ngpr2gc5k.gloss: eight route troop, all watch DE dumbfounded CRS
pmwa1ngpr2gc5k.translation: The troops of the eight routes all watched until they were dumbfounded.
pmwa1ngpr2gc5k.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|八路人馬，都看得呆了。#1

pmwa1ngpr2hdiz.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngpr2hdiz.text: 卻說張飛拍馬趕到關下，關上矢石如雨，不得進而回。
pmwa1ngpr2hdiz.gloss: now Zhang.Fei spur.horse hurry.arrive pass.under, pass.top arrow.stone like.rain, NEG DE advance CONJ return.
pmwa1ngpr2hdiz.translation: Now Zhang Fei spurred his horse and hurried to the pass; arrows and stones came from the pass like rain, and he could not advance and turned back.
pmwa1ngpr2hdiz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說張飛拍馬趕到關下，關上矢石如雨，不得進而回。#1

pmwa1ngpr2ispb.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngpr2ispb.text: 但是袁紹等門下，殺其宗黨而抄其家貲，必得巨萬。」
pmwa1ngpr2ispb.gloss: but Yuan.Shao etc retainer, kill their clan.partisans and confiscate their family.property, certainly DE huge.ten.thousand.
pmwa1ngpr2ispb.translation: But as for the retainers of Yuan Shao and the others, kill their clan partisans and confiscate their family property, and (we) will certainly obtain enormous wealth.
pmwa1ngpr2ispb.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|但是袁紹等門下，殺其宗黨而抄其家貲，必得巨萬。」#1

pmwa1ngpr2jdos.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngpr2jdos.text: 如有行得遲者，背後三千軍催督，軍手執白刃，於路殺人。
pmwa1ngpr2jdos.gloss: if have walk DE slow NMLZ, behind three thousand troops urge.supervise, troops hand hold bare.blade, on road kill people
pmwa1ngpr2jdos.translation: If there were any who walked slowly, three thousand soldiers behind (them) urged them on; the soldiers held bare blades and killed people along the road.
pmwa1ngpr2jdos.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|如有行得遲者，背後三千軍催督，軍手執白刃，於路殺人。#1

pmwa1ngpr2kue2.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngpr2kue2.text: 呂布罵曰：「背主懦夫，何得妄言！」
pmwa1ngpr2kue2.gloss: Lü.Bu scold say: betray lord coward, how DE speak.nonsense!
pmwa1ngpr2kue2.translation: Lü Bu cursed: "You lord-betraying coward, how can you speak such nonsense!"
pmwa1ngpr2kue2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|呂布罵曰：「背主懦夫，何得妄言！」#1

pmwa1ngpr2lzqw.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngpr2lzqw.text: 正欲埋鍋造飯，只聽得四圍喊聲，徐榮伏兵盡出。
pmwa1ngpr2lzqw.gloss: just about.to set.up.pot cook.meal , only hear DE all.around shout , Xu.Rong ambush.troops all come.out .
pmwa1ngpr2lzqw.translation: Just as (Cao Cao’s men) were about to set up the cooking pots and prepare a meal, they only heard shouts from all around, and Xu Rong’s ambush troops all came out.
pmwa1ngpr2lzqw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|正欲埋鍋造飯，只聽得四圍喊聲，徐榮伏兵盡出。#1

pmwa1ngpr2mxum.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngpr2mxum.text: 操曰：「命已至此，不得復活矣！」
pmwa1ngpr2mxum.gloss: Cao say: fate already reach this, NEG DE revive SFP!
pmwa1ngpr2mxum.translation: Cao said, “Fate has come to this; (I) cannot live again!”
pmwa1ngpr2mxum.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操曰：「命已至此，不得復活矣！」#1

pmwa1ngpr2nrse.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngpr2nrse.gloss: Sun.Jian DE seal, then ask Cheng.Pu.
pmwa1ngpr2nrse.translation: Sun Jian obtained the seal, and then asked Cheng Pu.
pmwa1ngpr2nrse.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|堅得璽，乃問程普。#1

pmwa1ngpr2o6c3.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngpr2o6c3.translation: When (they) cut it open, (he) indeed obtained jade.
pmwa1ngpr2o6c3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|解之，果得玉。#1

pmwa1ngpr2pac6.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngpr2pac6.text: 光武得此寶於宜陽，傳位至今。
pmwa1ngpr2pac6.gloss: Guang.Wu DE PROX treasure at Yiyang, pass.throne until.now.
pmwa1ngpr2pac6.translation: Emperor Guangwu obtained this treasure at Yiyang, and passed the throne down to the present day.
pmwa1ngpr2pac6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|光武得此寶於宜陽，傳位至今。#1

pmwa1ngps2qdp9.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngps2qdp9.text: 商議已定，密諭軍士勿得洩漏。
pmwa1ngps2qdp9.gloss: deliberate already settle, secretly.instruct soldier PROH DE leak.
pmwa1ngps2qdp9.translation: The deliberation having been settled, (he) secretly instructed the soldiers not to leak (it).
pmwa1ngps2qdp9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|商議已定，密諭軍士勿得洩漏。#1

pmwa1ngps2rl64.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngps2rl64.text: 玉璽乃朝廷之寶，公既獲得，當對眾留盟主處，候誅了董卓，復歸朝廷。
pmwa1ngps2rl64.gloss: jade.seal COP court GEN treasure, lord since obtain DE, ought toward crowd leave alliance.leader place, wait execute PFV Dong.Zhuo, again return court
pmwa1ngps2rl64.translation: The jade seal is a treasure of the imperial court; since you have obtained it, you ought, in front of everyone, to leave it with the leader of the alliance, and wait until Dong Zhuo has been executed, then return it to the court.
pmwa1ngps2rl64.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玉璽乃朝廷之寶，公既獲得，當對眾留盟主處，候誅了董卓，復歸朝廷。#1

pmwa1ngps2sn2e.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngps2sn2e.text: 堅指天為誓曰：「吾若果得此寶，私自藏匿，異日不得善終，死於刀箭之下！」
pmwa1ngps2sn2e.gloss: Jian point heaven make oath say: I if really DE this treasure, secretly conceal, another.day NEG DE good.end, die at blade arrow under!
pmwa1ngps2sn2e.translation: Sun Jian pointed to heaven and made an oath, saying: “If I really obtain this treasure and secretly conceal it, in the future I will not meet a good end, (and) die beneath blades and arrows!”
pmwa1ngps2sn2e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|堅指天為誓曰：「吾若果得此寶，私自藏匿，異日不得善終，死於刀箭之下！」#1

pmwa1ngps2t6wc.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngps2t6wc.text: 堅指天為誓曰：「吾若果得此寶，私自藏匿，異日不得善終，死於刀箭之下！」
pmwa1ngps2t6wc.gloss: Jian point heaven make oath say: I if really DE this treasure, secretly conceal, another.day NEG DE good.end, die at blade arrow under!
pmwa1ngps2t6wc.translation: Sun Jian pointed to heaven and made an oath, saying: “If I really obtain this treasure and secretly conceal it, in the future I will not meet a good end, (and) die beneath blades and arrows!”
pmwa1ngps2t6wc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|堅指天為誓曰：「吾若果得此寶，私自藏匿，異日不得善終，死於刀箭之下！」#2

pmwa1ngps2uxm3.section: 第六回　　　　　焚金闕董卓行兇　　　匿玉璽孫堅背約
pmwa1ngps2uxm3.text: 玉璽得來無用處，反因此寶動刀兵。
pmwa1ngps2uxm3.gloss: jade.seal get DE come not.have use place, instead because DEM treasure move knife soldier
pmwa1ngps2uxm3.translation: The jade seal, once obtained, has no use; instead, because of this treasure, weapons are taken up.
pmwa1ngps2uxm3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玉璽得來無用處，反因此寶動刀兵。#1

pmwa1ngps2v7js.section: 第七回　　　　　袁紹磐河戰公孫　　　孫堅跨江擊劉表
pmwa1ngps2v7js.text: 卻說孫堅被劉表圍住，虧得程普、黃蓋、韓當三將死救得脫，折兵大半，奪路引兵回江東。
pmwa1ngps2v7js.gloss: meanwhile say Sun.Jian PASS Liu.Biao surround.hold, thanks.to DE Cheng.Pu, Huang.Gai, Han.Dang three general desperately rescue DE escape, lose troops more.than.half, seize.road lead troops return Jiangdong.
pmwa1ngps2v7js.translation: Meanwhile, Sun Jian was surrounded by Liu Biao. Thanks to the three generals Cheng Pu, Huang Gai, and Han Dang desperately rescuing him, he got free; he lost more than half his troops, forced a way through, and led his troops back to Jiangdong.
pmwa1ngps2v7js.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說孫堅被劉表圍住，虧得程普、黃蓋、韓當三將死救得脫，折兵大半，奪路引兵回江東。#1

pmwa1ngps2w9ya.section: 第七回　　　　　袁紹磐河戰公孫　　　孫堅跨江擊劉表
pmwa1ngps2w9ya.text: 卻說孫堅被劉表圍住，虧得程普、黃蓋、韓當三將死救得脫，折兵大半，奪路引兵回江東。
pmwa1ngps2w9ya.gloss: meanwhile say Sun.Jian PASS Liu.Biao surround.hold, thanks.to DE Cheng.Pu, Huang.Gai, Han.Dang three general desperately rescue DE escape, lose troops more.than.half, seize.road lead troops return Jiangdong.
pmwa1ngps2w9ya.translation: Meanwhile, Sun Jian was surrounded by Liu Biao. Thanks to the three generals Cheng Pu, Huang Gai, and Han Dang desperately rescuing him, he got free; he lost more than half his troops, forced a way through, and led his troops back to Jiangdong.
pmwa1ngps2w9ya.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說孫堅被劉表圍住，虧得程普、黃蓋、韓當三將死救得脫，折兵大半，奪路引兵回江東。#2

pmwa1ngps2x7i4.section: 第七回　　　　　袁紹磐河戰公孫　　　孫堅跨江擊劉表
pmwa1ngps2x7i4.text: 韓馥無謀之輩，必請將軍領州事；就中取事，唾手可得。」
pmwa1ngps2x7i4.gloss: Han.Fu no.strategy ATTR sort, surely ask general take.charge province.affairs; therein take.action, spit.hands can DE obtain.
pmwa1ngps2x7i4.translation: Han Fu is a man without strategy; he will certainly ask the General to take charge of the province's affairs. Take action therein, and (it) can be obtained as easily as spitting on one's hands.
pmwa1ngps2x7i4.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|韓馥無謀之輩，必請將軍領州事；就中取事，唾手可得。」#1

pmwa1ngps2ykk5.section: 第七回　　　　　袁紹磐河戰公孫　　　孫堅跨江擊劉表
pmwa1ngps2ykk5.text: 瓚得書，見說共攻冀州，平分其地，大喜，即日興兵。
pmwa1ngps2ykk5.gloss: Zan receive DE letter, see say jointly.attack Ji.Province, equally.divide 3SG territory, great.joy, same.day raise.troops.
pmwa1ngps2ykk5.translation: Zan received the letter, saw that it said (they) would jointly attack Ji Province and divide its territory equally, was overjoyed, and raised troops that very day.
pmwa1ngps2ykk5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瓚得書，見說共攻冀州，平分其地，大喜，即日興兵。#1

pmwa1ngps2z2ek.section: 第七回　　　　　袁紹磐河戰公孫　　　孫堅跨江擊劉表
pmwa1ngps2z2ek.text: 公孫瓚爬上坡去，看那少年：生得身長八尺，濃眉大眼，闊面重頤，威風凜凜，與文醜大戰五六十合，勝負未分。
pmwa1ngps2z2ek.gloss: Gongsun.Zan climb up slope go, look DEM youth: born DE body length eight chi, thick eyebrow big eye, broad face double chin, awe.inspiring, with Wen.Chou great fight five six ten bout, victory defeat NEG divide.
pmwa1ngps2z2ek.translation: Gongsun Zan climbed up the slope and looked at that youth: he had been born with a body eight chi tall, thick brows and big eyes, a broad face and a heavy jowl, and an awe-inspiring presence; he fought a great battle with Wen Chou for fifty or sixty bouts, and victory and defeat were not yet decided.
pmwa1ngps2z2ek.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|公孫瓚爬上坡去，看那少年：生得身長八尺，濃眉大眼，闊面重頤，威風凜凜，與文醜大戰五六十合，勝負未分。#1

pmwa1ngps307pp.section: 第七回　　　　　袁紹磐河戰公孫　　　孫堅跨江擊劉表
pmwa1ngps307pp.text: 公孫瓚初得趙雲，不知心腹，令其另領一軍在後。
pmwa1ngps307pp.gloss: Gongsun.Zan newly DE Zhao.Yun, NEG know heart.belly, order 3SG separately lead one army at rear.
pmwa1ngps307pp.translation: Gongsun Zan had just obtained Zhao Yun and, not knowing his true intentions, ordered him to lead a separate force in the rear.
pmwa1ngps307pp.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|公孫瓚初得趙雲，不知心腹，令其另領一軍在後。#1

pmwa1ngps31t9d.section: 第七回　　　　　袁紹磐河戰公孫　　　孫堅跨江擊劉表
pmwa1ngps31t9d.text: 嚴綱鼓譟吶喊，直取麴義，義軍見嚴綱兵來，都伏而不動；直到來得至近，一聲砲響，八百弓弩手一齊俱發。
pmwa1ngps31t9d.gloss: Yan.Gang beat.drums.shout, straight.charge Qu.Yi, Qu.Yi.army see Yan.Gang.troops come, all lie.low CONJ NEG move; until come DE extremely.close, one CLF cannon.sound, eight.hundred bow.crossbow.soldier together all release.
pmwa1ngps31t9d.translation: Yan Gang beat the drums and shouted, charging straight at Qu Yi. When Qu Yi's troops saw Yan Gang's soldiers coming, they all lay low and did not stir; only when (the attackers) came very close, at a single cannon report, the eight hundred archers and crossbowmen all loosed (their arrows) together.
pmwa1ngps31t9d.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|嚴綱鼓譟吶喊，直取麴義，義軍見嚴綱兵來，都伏而不動；直到來得至近，一聲砲響，八百弓弩手一齊俱發。#1

pmwa1ngps32pef.section: 第七回　　　　　袁紹磐河戰公孫　　　孫堅跨江擊劉表
pmwa1ngps32pef.text: 綱急得回，被麴義拍馬舞刀，斬於馬下，瓚軍大敗。
pmwa1ngps32pef.gloss: Gāng ADV urgently DE return, P Qū.Yì attack with horse and knife, kill at under horse, Hǔ.army great defeat.
pmwa1ngps32pef.translation: Yan Gang urgently returned, was attacked by Qu Yi with a horse and knife, and killed under the horse, resulting in Han's army being greatly defeated.
pmwa1ngps32pef.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|綱急得回，被麴義拍馬舞刀，斬於馬下，瓚軍大敗。#1

pmwa1ngps339ye.section: 第七回　　　　　袁紹磐河戰公孫　　　孫堅跨江擊劉表
pmwa1ngps339ye.text: 袁紹當先趕來，不到五里，只聽得山背後喊聲大起，閃出一彪人馬，為首三員大將，乃是劉玄德、關雲長、張翼德。
pmwa1ngps339ye.gloss: Yuan.Shao in.the.lead rush.come, not.reach five li, only hear DE mountain behind shout sound greatly rise, flash.out one CLF troops, at.the.head three CLF great.generals, COP Liu.Xuande, Guan.Yunchang, Zhang.Yide.
pmwa1ngps339ye.translation: Yuan Shao came rushing in the lead; before he had gone five li, he only heard a great shout rise from behind the mountain, and a body of troops flashed out, with three great generals at their head—Liu Xuande, Guan Yunchang, and Zhang Yide.
pmwa1ngps339ye.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|袁紹當先趕來，不到五里，只聽得山背後喊聲大起，閃出一彪人馬，為首三員大將，乃是劉玄德、關雲長、張翼德。#1

pmwa1ngps347ii.section: 第七回　　　　　袁紹磐河戰公孫　　　孫堅跨江擊劉表
pmwa1ngps347ii.text: 紹驚得魂飛天外，手中寶刀墜於馬下，忙撥馬而逃，眾人死救過橋。
pmwa1ngps347ii.gloss: Shao startle DE soul fly beyond.heaven, in.hand precious.sword fall at under.horse, hurriedly turn.horse CONJ flee, crowd desperately.rescue cross bridge.

pmwa1ngpt3xlxt.text: 一連如此幾日，欲戰不得，欲止不得。
pmwa1ngpt3xlxt.gloss: one.continuous like.this several.day, want fight NEG DE, want stop NEG DE.
pmwa1ngpt3xlxt.translation: For several days in a row it was like this: (he) wanted to fight but could not, (and) wanted to stop but could not.
pmwa1ngpt3xlxt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|一連如此幾日，欲戰不得，欲止不得。#2

pmwa1ngpt3ygb2.section: 第九回　　　　　除暴徒呂布助司徒　　犯長安李傕聽賈詡
pmwa1ngpt3ygb2.text: 允曰：「若蒙社稷之靈，得安國家，吾之願也；若不獲已，則允奉身以死。
pmwa1ngpt3ygb2.gloss: Yun say: if receive state GEN spirit, DE pacify state, 1SG GEN wish SFP; if NEG obtain stop, then Yun offer body CONJ die.
pmwa1ngpt3ygb2.translation: Yun said: “If I receive the blessing of the spirits of the state and can bring peace to the realm, that is my wish; if that cannot be avoided, then I, Yun, will give my body to death.
pmwa1ngpt3ygb2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|允曰：「若蒙社稷之靈，得安國家，吾之願也；若不獲已，則允奉身以死。#1

pmwa1ngpt3zowc.section: 第九回　　　　　除暴徒呂布助司徒　　犯長安李傕聽賈詡
pmwa1ngpt3zowc.text: 不一時，各門火燄竟天，呂布只得棄卻家小，引百餘騎飛奔出關，投袁術去了。
pmwa1ngpt3zowc.gloss: before.long, each gate flame reach sky, Lü.Bu only DE abandon family, lead hundred.odd rider gallop out pass, join Yuan.Shu go CRS.
pmwa1ngpt3zowc.translation: Before long, flames from every gate reached the sky; Lü Bu had no choice but to abandon his family, and leading over a hundred riders he galloped out of the pass and went to join Yuan Shu.
pmwa1ngpt3zowc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|不一時，各門火燄竟天，呂布只得棄卻家小，引百餘騎飛奔出關，投袁術去了。#1

pmwa1ngpt40275.section: 第十回　　　　　勤王室馬騰舉義　　　報父讎曹操興師
pmwa1ngpt40275.text: 帝只得從之，封李傕為車騎將軍池陽侯，領司隸校尉，假節鉞；郭汜為後將軍，假節鉞：同秉朝政；樊稠為右將軍萬年侯；張濟為驃騎將軍平陽侯，領兵屯弘農。
pmwa1ngpt40275.gloss: emperor only DE follow 3SG, enfeoff Li.Jue as chariot.cavalry.general Chiyang.marquis, hold colonel.director.retainers, grant tally.axe; Guo.Si as rear.general, grant tally.axe: together wield court.government; Fan.Chou as right.general Wannian.marquis; Zhang.Ji as agile.cavalry.general Pingyang.marquis, lead troops station Hongnong.
pmwa1ngpt40275.translation: The Emperor had no choice but to follow (their request), and enfeoffed Li Jue as General of Chariots and Cavalry and Marquis of Chiyang, holding the post of Colonel-Director of Retainers and granted the tally and axe; Guo Si as General of the Rear, granted the tally and axe: together they administered court affairs; Fan Chou as General of the Right and Marquis of Wannian; Zhang Ji as General of Agile Cavalry and Marquis of Pingyang, leading troops stationed at Hongnong.
pmwa1ngpt40275.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|帝只得從之，封李傕為車騎將軍池陽侯，領司隸校尉，假節鉞；郭汜為後將軍，假節鉞：同秉朝政；樊稠為右將軍萬年侯；張濟為驃騎將軍平陽侯，領兵屯弘農。#1

pmwa1ngpt41bfk.section: 第十回　　　　　勤王室馬騰舉義　　　報父讎曹操興師
pmwa1ngpt41bfk.text: 又下令追尋董卓屍首，獲得些零碎皮骨，以香木雕成形體，安湊停當，大設祭祀，用王者衣冠棺槨，選擇吉日，遷葬郿塢。
pmwa1ngpt41bfk.gloss: again issue.order search.for Dong.Zhuo corpse , obtain-DE some fragmented skin.bone , with fragrant.wood carve.into body , fit.together properly , great set.up sacrifice , use king clothing.cap coffin.outer.coffin , choose auspicious.day , relocate.bury Mei.Wu .
pmwa1ngpt41bfk.translation: He again issued orders to search for Dong Zhuo’s corpse; they obtained some fragmented skin and bones, carved a body from fragrant wood, fitted it together properly, made great sacrificial offerings, used the garments, cap, and inner and outer coffins of a king, chose an auspicious day, and reburied (him) at Mei Wu.
pmwa1ngpt41bfk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|又下令追尋董卓屍首，獲得些零碎皮骨，以香木雕成形體，安湊停當，大設祭祀，用王者衣冠棺槨，選擇吉日，遷葬郿塢。#1

pmwa1ngpt424f5.section: 第十回　　　　　勤王室馬騰舉義　　　報父讎曹操興師
pmwa1ngpt424f5.text: 馬騰、韓遂見軍糧已盡，內應又泄，只得拔寨退軍。
pmwa1ngpt424f5.gloss: Ma.Teng, Han.Sui see army.provisions already exhausted, internal.response also leak, only DE pull.up camp withdraw.troops.
pmwa1ngpt424f5.translation: Ma Teng and Han Sui saw that the army provisions were already exhausted and that the internal collaborators had also been exposed, and had no choice but to strike camp and withdraw their troops.
pmwa1ngpt424f5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|馬騰、韓遂見軍糧已盡，內應又泄，只得拔寨退軍。#1

pmwa1ngpu43z57.section: 第十回　　　　　勤王室馬騰舉義　　　報父讎曹操興師
pmwa1ngpu43z57.gloss: frighten DE Zhang.Ji prostrate at ground
pmwa1ngpu43z57.translation: This frightened Zhang Ji so much that he fell prostrate on the ground.
pmwa1ngpu43z57.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|嚇得張濟俯伏於地。#1

pmwa1ngpu44n6o.section: 第十回　　　　　勤王室馬騰舉義　　　報父讎曹操興師
pmwa1ngpu44n6o.text: 訪得他在山中讀書，操拜請之。
pmwa1ngpu44n6o.gloss: seek DE 3SG at mountain middle read book, Cao.Cao respectfully.invite 3SG.OBJ
pmwa1ngpu44n6o.translation: They sought him out and found him studying in the mountains, and Cao Cao respectfully invited him.
pmwa1ngpu44n6o.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|訪得他在山中讀書，操拜請之。#1

pmwa1ngpu45v7v.section: 第十回　　　　　勤王室馬騰舉義　　　報父讎曹操興師
pmwa1ngpu45v7v.text: 曹嵩率家小行到華、費間，時夏末秋初，大雨驟至，只得投一古寺歇宿。
pmwa1ngpu45v7v.gloss: Cao.Song lead family travel.to Hua, Fei between, time late.summer early.autumn, heavy.rain suddenly arrive, only DE seek.shelter one old temple rest.overnight.
pmwa1ngpu45v7v.translation: Cao Song led his family as far as the area between Hua and Fei. It was late summer and early autumn, and a heavy rainstorm suddenly came, so he had no choice but to take shelter in an old temple for the night.
pmwa1ngpu45v7v.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹嵩率家小行到華、費間，時夏末秋初，大雨驟至，只得投一古寺歇宿。#1

pmwa1ngpu463in.section: 第十回　　　　　勤王室馬騰舉義　　　報父讎曹操興師
pmwa1ngpu463in.text: 張闓喚手下頭目於靜處商議曰：「我們本是黃巾餘黨，勉強降順陶謙，未有好處；如今曹嵩輜重車輛無數，你們欲得富貴不難，只就今夜三更，大家砍將入去，把曹嵩一家殺了，取了財物，同往山中落草。
pmwa1ngpu463in.gloss: Zhang.Kai call subordinate headman at quiet.place discuss say: 1PL originally COP Yellow.Turban remnant.party, reluctantly surrender.submit Tao.Qian, NEG.have good.benefit; now Cao.Song baggage cart countless, 2PL want DE wealth.rank NEG difficult, only at tonight third.watch, everyone cut P go.in, BA Cao.Song whole.family kill PFV, take PFV valuables, together go mountain.in become.bandits.
pmwa1ngpu463in.translation: Zhang Kai summoned his subordinate leaders to a quiet place to discuss, saying: We were originally remnants of the Yellow Turbans; we reluctantly submitted to Tao Qian and have gained no advantage. Now Cao Song's baggage carts are countless. It would not be difficult for you to obtain wealth and rank; just tonight at the third watch, let us all cut our way in, kill Cao Song's whole family, seize the valuables, and go together into the mountains to become bandits.
pmwa1ngpu463in.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張闓喚手下頭目於靜處商議曰：「我們本是黃巾餘黨，勉強降順陶謙，未有好處；如今曹嵩輜重車輛無數，你們欲得富貴不難，只就今夜三更，大家砍將入去，把曹嵩一家殺了，取了財物，同往山中落草。#1

pmwa1ngpu47w2o.section: 第十回　　　　　勤王室馬騰舉義　　　報父讎曹操興師
pmwa1ngpu47w2o.text: 操令但得城池，將城中百姓，盡行屠戮，以雪父讎。
pmwa1ngpu47w2o.gloss: Cao.Cao order but DE city, BA city.in common.people, completely massacre, in.order.to wipe.away father enmity.
pmwa1ngpu47w2o.translation: Cao Cao ordered that whenever a city was taken, all the common people in the city were to be massacred, in order to wipe out (the wrong done to) his father.
pmwa1ngpu47w2o.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操令但得城池，將城中百姓，盡行屠戮，以雪父讎。#1

pmwa1ngpu484bj.section: 第十回　　　　　勤王室馬騰舉義　　　報父讎曹操興師
pmwa1ngpu484bj.text: 操知是為陶謙作說客，欲待不見，又滅不過舊恩，只得請入帳中相見。
pmwa1ngpu484bj.gloss: Cao.Cao know COP for Tao.Qian act.as lobbyist, want.to NEG see, again wipe.out cannot old kindness, only DE invite enter tent inside meet.
pmwa1ngpu484bj.translation: Cao Cao knew that he was acting as a lobbyist for Tao Qian; he wanted to refuse to see him, but could not wipe out their old kindness, so he had no choice but to invite him into the tent to meet.
pmwa1ngpu484bj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操知是為陶謙作說客，欲待不見，又滅不過舊恩，只得請入帳中相見。#1

pmwa1ngpu491ey.section: 第十回　　　　　勤王室馬騰舉義　　　報父讎曹操興師
pmwa1ngpu491ey.text: 陶謙只得引兵出迎，遠望操軍如鋪霜湧雪，中軍豎起白旗二面，大書「報讎雪恨」四字。
pmwa1ngpu491ey.gloss: Tao.Qian only DE lead troops out meet, far gaze Cao army like spread frost surge snow, central.army erect.up white.flag two CLF, big write avenge.enmity wipe.hatred four character.
pmwa1ngpu491ey.translation: Tao Qian had no choice but to lead his troops out to meet (the enemy). Gazing into the distance, he saw Cao Cao's army like spreading frost and surging snow; in the central army two white flags were set up, and on them were written in large characters: 'Avenge the enmity and wipe out the hatred'.
pmwa1ngpu491ey.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|陶謙只得引兵出迎，遠望操軍如鋪霜湧雪，中軍豎起白旗二面，大書「報讎雪恨」四字。#1

pmwa1ngpu4ad5u.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpu4ad5u.text: 當日獻計曰：「某願親往北海郡，求孔融起兵救援；更得一人往青州田楷處求救：若二處軍馬齊來，操必退兵矣。」
pmwa1ngpu4ad5u.gloss: that.day offer.plan say : 1SG willing personally go Beihai.Commandery, ask Kong.Rong raise.troops rescue ; more DE one person go Qingzhou Tian.Kai place seek.help : if two place troops together.come, Cao.Cao surely withdraw.troops SFP
pmwa1ngpu4ad5u.translation: That day he offered a plan, saying: 'I am willing to go personally to Beihai Commandery to ask Kong Rong to raise troops for rescue; and (if we) get one more person to go to Tian Kai's place in Qingzhou to seek help: if the troops from both places come together, Cao Cao will surely withdraw his troops.'
pmwa1ngpu4ad5u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|當日獻計曰：「某願親往北海郡，求孔融起兵救援；更得一人往青州田楷處求救：若二處軍馬齊來，操必退兵矣。」#1

pmwa1ngpu4bnwo.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpu4bnwo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|自此得名。#1

pmwa1ngpu4cxug.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpu4cxug.gloss: at Beihai six year, very DE people heart
pmwa1ngpu4cxug.translation: During (his) six years at Beihai, he greatly won the hearts of the people.
pmwa1ngpu4cxug.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|在北海六年，甚得民心。#1

pmwa1ngpu4d2g0.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpu4d2g0.text: 原來孔融與太史慈，雖未識面，卻曉得他是個英雄。
pmwa1ngpu4d2g0.gloss: originally Kong.Rong with Taishi.Ci, although not.yet meet.face, yet know DE 3SG COP CLF hero.
pmwa1ngpu4d2g0.translation: It turned out that although Kong Rong and Taishi Ci had never met, (Kong Rong) knew that he was a hero.
pmwa1ngpu4d2g0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|原來孔融與太史慈，雖未識面，卻曉得他是個英雄。#1

pmwa1ngpu4eidg.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpu4eidg.text: 融曰：「吾聞劉玄德乃當世英雄，若請得他來相救此圍自解；只無人可使耳。」
pmwa1ngpu4eidg.gloss: Kong.Rong say : 1SG hear Liu.Xuande COP present.age hero , if invite DE 3SG come OBJ rescue PROX siege self lift ; only not.have person can send SFP.
pmwa1ngpu4eidg.translation: Kong Rong said: “I have heard that Liu Xuande is a hero of the present age. If (we) can invite him to come to the rescue, this siege will naturally lift; it is only that there is no one to send.”
pmwa1ngpu4eidg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|融曰：「吾聞劉玄德乃當世英雄，若請得他來相救此圍自解；只無人可使耳。」#1

pmwa1ngpu4fx2z.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpu4fx2z.text: 太史慈得脫，星夜投平原來見劉玄德。
pmwa1ngpu4fx2z.gloss: Taishi.Ci DE escape, starry.night head.for Pingyuan come see Liu.Xuande.
pmwa1ngpu4fx2z.translation: Taishi Ci managed to escape and, traveling by night, headed for Pingyuan to see Liu Xuande.
pmwa1ngpu4fx2z.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|太史慈得脫，星夜投平原來見劉玄德。#1

pmwa1ngpu4gn74.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpu4gn74.text: 兩馬相交，眾軍大喊；量管亥怎敵得雲長，數十合之間，青龍刀起，劈管亥於馬下。
pmwa1ngpu4gn74.gloss: Two.horses cross.paths, great.army shout.loud; how Guan.Hai how contend DE Yun.Chang, several.ten movement P between, Green.Dragon.blade rise, slash Guan.Hai at under.horse.
pmwa1ngpu4gn74.translation: The two horses clashed, and the armies shouted loudly; how could Guanhai possibly contend with Yun Chang? Within a few dozen movements, the Green Dragon blade rose and struck Guanhai under the horse.
pmwa1ngpu4gn74.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|兩馬相交，眾軍大喊；量管亥怎敵得雲長，數十合之間，青龍刀起，劈管亥於馬下。#1

pmwa1ngpv4h6d6.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4h6d6.text: 劉備借得軍，或借不得軍，必然親至。」
pmwa1ngpv4h6d6.gloss: Liu.Bei borrow DE army, or borrow NEG DE army, certainly in.person arrive.
pmwa1ngpv4h6d6.translation: Whether Liu Bei can borrow troops or cannot borrow troops, he will certainly come in person.
pmwa1ngpv4h6d6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|劉備借得軍，或借不得軍，必然親至。」#1

pmwa1ngpv4ig4i.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4ig4i.text: 劉備借得軍，或借不得軍，必然親至。」
pmwa1ngpv4ig4i.gloss: Liu.Bei borrow DE army, or borrow NEG DE army, certainly in.person arrive.
pmwa1ngpv4ig4i.translation: Whether Liu Bei can borrow troops or cannot borrow troops, he will certainly come in person.
pmwa1ngpv4ig4i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|劉備借得軍，或借不得軍，必然親至。」#2

pmwa1ngpv4jqta.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4jqta.text: 卻說糜竺回報陶謙，言北海又請得劉玄德來助；陳元龍也回報青州田楷欣然領兵來救；陶謙心安。
pmwa1ngpv4jqta.gloss: meanwhile say Mi.Zhu report.back Tao.Qian, say Beihai again invite DE Liu.Xuande come assist; Chen.Yuanlong also report.back Qingzhou Tian.Kai gladly lead troops come rescue; Tao.Qian heart at.ease.
pmwa1ngpv4jqta.translation: Mi Zhu reported back to Tao Qian, saying that Beihai (Kong Rong) had again invited Liu Xuande to come to his aid; Chen Yuanlong also reported back that Tian Kai of Qingzhou had gladly led troops to come to the rescue; Tao Qian was reassured.
pmwa1ngpv4jqta.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說糜竺回報陶謙，言北海又請得劉玄德來助；陳元龍也回報青州田楷欣然領兵來救；陶謙心安。#1

pmwa1ngpv4klaw.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4klaw.text: 書略曰：「備自關外得拜君顏，嗣後天各一方，不及趨侍。
pmwa1ngpv4klaw.gloss: letter briefly say: Bei from outside.pass DE bow lord.face, thereafter heaven each one.direction, not.reach hasten.serve.
pmwa1ngpv4klaw.translation: The letter said in brief: 'I, Bei, have been able from outside the passes to bow before your countenance; afterwards, heaven (places us) each in a different direction, and I cannot hasten to attend upon (you).'
pmwa1ngpv4klaw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|書略曰：「備自關外得拜君顏，嗣後天各一方，不及趨侍。#1

pmwa1ngpv4lnqf.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4lnqf.text: 投袁紹，紹納之，與布共破張燕於常山；布自以為得志，傲慢袁紹手下將士。
pmwa1ngpv4lnqf.gloss: go.join Yuan.Shao, Shao take.in 3SG.OBJ, with Bu together defeat Zhang.Yan at Changshan; Bu self consider DE ambition, arrogant.to Yuan.Shao subordinate officers.and.soldiers.
pmwa1ngpv4lnqf.translation: (Lü Bu) went to join Yuan Shao; Yuan Shao took him in, and together with Bu defeated Zhang Yan at Changshan; Bu considered himself to have achieved his ambition and was arrogant toward Yuan Shao’s officers and soldiers.
pmwa1ngpv4lnqf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|投袁紹，紹納之，與布共破張燕於常山；布自以為得志，傲慢袁紹手下將士。#1

pmwa1ngpv4m4ro.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4m4ro.text: 止有鄄城，東阿，范縣三處，被荀彧、程昱設計死守得全，其餘俱破。
pmwa1ngpv4m4ro.gloss: only have Juancheng, Dong'e, Fan.County three place, PASS Xun.Yu, Cheng.Yu devise.plan defend.to.death DE intact, the.rest all broken
pmwa1ngpv4m4ro.translation: Only three places—Juancheng, Dong'e, and Fan County—were kept intact by Xun Yu and Cheng Yu, who devised a plan and defended them to the death; all the rest were captured.
pmwa1ngpv4m4ro.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|止有鄄城，東阿，范縣三處，被荀彧、程昱設計死守得全，其餘俱破。#1

pmwa1ngpv4nben.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4nben.text: 曹操笑曰：「呂布無謀之輩，故教薛蘭守兗州，自往濮陽；安得此處有埋伏耶？
pmwa1ngpv4nben.gloss: Cao.Cao laugh say: Lü.Bu not.have strategy GEN sort, therefore order Xue.Lan guard Yanzhou, himself go Puyang; how DE this.place have ambush Q?
pmwa1ngpv4nben.translation: Cao Cao laughed and said, "Lü Bu is a man without strategy; that is why he ordered Xue Lan to defend Yanzhou and went himself to Puyang. How could there be an ambush here?"
pmwa1ngpv4nben.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操笑曰：「呂布無謀之輩，故教薛蘭守兗州，自往濮陽；安得此處有埋伏耶？#1

pmwa1ngpv4oy5k.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4oy5k.text: 操指呂布而言曰：「吾與汝自來無讎，何得奪吾州郡？」
pmwa1ngpv4oy5k.gloss: Cao point Lü.Bu CONJ say say: 1SG with 2SG all.along not.have enmity, how DE seize 1SG province.commandery?
pmwa1ngpv4oy5k.translation: Cao pointed at Lü Bu and said: "You and I have never had any enmity, how is it that you get to seize my province and commanderies?"
pmwa1ngpv4oy5k.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操指呂布而言曰：「吾與汝自來無讎，何得奪吾州郡？」#1

pmwa1ngpv4pqp5.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4pqp5.text: 布曰：「漢家城池，諸人有分，偏爾合得？」
pmwa1ngpv4pqp5.gloss: Bu say: Han.house city.wall, all.people have share, only 2SG should DE?
pmwa1ngpv4pqp5.translation: Lü Bu said, "The cities of the Han house—everyone has a share; why should only you get them?"
pmwa1ngpv4pqp5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|布曰：「漢家城池，諸人有分，偏爾合得？」#1

pmwa1ngpv4q4u2.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4q4u2.text: 惱得呂布性起，挺戟驟馬，衝出陣來，夏侯惇、樂進皆走。
pmwa1ngpv4q4u2.gloss: anger DE Lü.Bu temper.flare, level halberd spur horse, charge out formation come, Xiahou.Dun, Yue.Jin both flee
pmwa1ngpv4q4u2.translation: This so angered Lü Bu that his temper flared; he leveled his halberd, spurred his horse, and charged out of the formation, and Xiahou Dun and Yue Jin both fled.
pmwa1ngpv4q4u2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|惱得呂布性起，挺戟驟馬，衝出陣來，夏侯惇、樂進皆走。#1

pmwa1ngpv4rgn4.section: 第十一回　　　　劉皇叔北海救孔融　　呂溫侯濮陽破曹操
pmwa1ngpv4rgn4.text: 今夜彼將謂我軍敗走，必不準備，可引兵擊之；若得寨，布軍必懼：此為上策。」
pmwa1ngpv4rgn4.gloss: tonight 3PL FUT think 1PL army defeated.flee, certainly NEG prepare, can lead troops attack 3PL; if DE camp, Bu army certainly fear: this COP best.strategy.
pmwa1ngpv4rgn4.translation: Tonight they will think our army has been defeated and has fled, and will certainly not be prepared; we can lead troops to attack them. If we take the camp, Lü Bu's army will certainly be afraid: this is the best strategy.
pmwa1ngpv4rgn4.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今夜彼將謂我軍敗走，必不準備，可引兵擊之；若得寨，布軍必懼：此為上策。」#1

pmwa1ngpv4sft0.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv4sft0.text: 曹操雖有經天緯地之才，到此安能得脫也？」
pmwa1ngpv4sft0.gloss: Cao.Cao although have warp.heaven.weave.earth GEN talent, arrive here how can DE escape SFP?
pmwa1ngpv4sft0.translation: Although Cao Cao has the talent to warp heaven and weave earth, when he arrives here, how can he get away?
pmwa1ngpv4sft0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操雖有經天緯地之才，到此安能得脫也？」#1

pmwa1ngpv4tcx3.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv4tcx3.text: 操大喜曰：「天使吾得濮陽也！」
pmwa1ngpv4tcx3.gloss: Cao great.delight say: heaven send 1SG DE Puyang SFP!
pmwa1ngpv4tcx3.translation: Cao was overjoyed and said, "Heaven is causing me to gain Puyang!"
pmwa1ngpv4tcx3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操大喜曰：「天使吾得濮陽也！」#1

pmwa1ngpv4u1jm.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv4u1jm.text: 只聽得西門上吹蠃殼聲，喊聲忽起，門上火把燎亂，城門大開，弔橋放落。
pmwa1ngpv4u1jm.gloss: only hear DE west.gate on blow conch.shell sound, shout.sound suddenly rise, gate on torch blaze.chaotically, city.gate wide.open, drawbridge let.down
pmwa1ngpv4u1jm.translation: (They) only heard the sound of conch shells being blown at the west gate; shouts suddenly arose, torches flared wildly on the gate, the city gate opened wide, and the drawbridge was let down.
pmwa1ngpv4u1jm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只聽得西門上吹蠃殼聲，喊聲忽起，門上火把燎亂，城門大開，弔橋放落。#1

pmwa1ngpv4vfud.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv4vfud.text: 卻說曹操見典韋殺出去了，四下裏人馬截來，不得出南門；再轉北門，火光裏正撞見呂布挺戟躍馬而來。
pmwa1ngpv4vfud.gloss: now.say Cao.Cao see Dian.Wei fight go.out PFV, all.around troops intercept come, NEG DE exit south.gate; again turn north.gate, firelight inside just encounter Lü.Bu brandish halberd spur horse CONJ come.
pmwa1ngpv4vfud.translation: Now, Cao Cao saw that Dian Wei had fought his way out; troops came cutting in from all sides, and he could not get out through the south gate. He turned again to the north gate, and in the firelight he happened to run right into Lü Bu, who came brandishing his halberd and spurring his horse.
pmwa1ngpv4vfud.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說曹操見典韋殺出去了，四下裏人馬截來，不得出南門；再轉北門，火光裏正撞見呂布挺戟躍馬而來。#1

pmwa1ngpv4wk9o.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv4wk9o.text: 呂布死戰得脫，折了好些人馬；敗回濮陽，堅守不出。
pmwa1ngpv4wk9o.gloss: Lü.Bu fight.to.death DE escape, lose PFV quite.a.few men.and.horses; defeated return Puyang, hold.firm NEG come.out
pmwa1ngpv4wk9o.translation: Lü Bu fought desperately and managed to escape, losing quite a few men and horses; he retreated in defeat to Puyang and held firm, not coming out.
pmwa1ngpv4wk9o.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|呂布死戰得脫，折了好些人馬；敗回濮陽，堅守不出。#1

pmwa1ngpv4xrn3.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv4xrn3.text: 操在鄄城，知陶謙已死，劉玄德領徐州牧，大怒曰：「我讎未報，汝不費半箭之功，坐得徐州！
pmwa1ngpv4xrn3.gloss: Cao.Cao at Juancheng, know Tao.Qian already die, Liu.Xuande hold Xu.province.governor, greatly angry say: 1SG vengeance not.yet repay, you NEG spend half arrow GEN effort, sit DE Xu.province!
pmwa1ngpv4xrn3.translation: Cao Cao was at Juancheng; learning that Tao Qian had already died and that Liu Xuande was holding the post of Governor of Xu province, he was furious and said: 'I have not yet taken my revenge; you, without spending the effort of half an arrow, have sat and obtained Xu province!'
pmwa1ngpv4xrn3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操在鄄城，知陶謙已死，劉玄德領徐州牧，大怒曰：「我讎未報，汝不費半箭之功，坐得徐州！#1

pmwa1ngpv4ypkf.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv4ypkf.text: 若徐州不得，明公安所歸乎？
pmwa1ngpv4ypkf.gloss: if Xuzhou NEG DE, my.lord where return Q?
pmwa1ngpv4ypkf.translation: If Xuzhou cannot be taken, where will you, my lord, return to?
pmwa1ngpv4ypkf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若徐州不得，明公安所歸乎？#1

pmwa1ngpv4zryd.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv4zryd.text: 壯士曰：「你若贏得手中寶刀，我便獻出！」
pmwa1ngpv4zryd.gloss: strong.man say: 2SG if win DE hand in precious.saber, 1SG then offer out!
pmwa1ngpv4zryd.translation: The strong man said, "If you win the precious sword in my hand, then I will hand it over!"
pmwa1ngpv4zryd.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|壯士曰：「你若贏得手中寶刀，我便獻出！」#1

pmwa1ngpv508jm.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv508jm.text: 曹操班師，曹仁、夏侯惇接見，言近日細作報說：兗州薛蘭、李封軍士皆出擄掠，城邑空虛，可引得勝之兵攻之，一鼓可下。
pmwa1ngpv508jm.gloss: Cao.Cao return.army, Cao.Ren, Xiahou.Dun receive.meet, say recent.days spy report.say: Yan.Province Xue.Lan, Li.Feng soldier all go.out plunder, city.town empty, can lead DE victory ATTR troop attack 3PL, one drum can down.
pmwa1ngpv508jm.translation: Cao Cao withdrew his troops; Cao Ren and Xiahou Dun received him and said, “Recent spies report: the soldiers of Xue Lan and Li Feng in Yan Province have all gone out plundering, and the city is empty. We can lead the victorious troops to attack them; with a single drumbeat we can take it.”
pmwa1ngpv508jm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操班師，曹仁、夏侯惇接見，言近日細作報說：兗州薛蘭、李封軍士皆出擄掠，城邑空虛，可引得勝之兵攻之，一鼓可下。#1

pmwa1ngpv51fqt.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv51fqt.text: 薛蘭、李封出其不意，只得引兵出城迎戰。
pmwa1ngpv51fqt.gloss: Xue.Lan, Li.Feng caught.off.guard, only DE lead troops exit city meet.battle.
pmwa1ngpv51fqt.translation: Xue Lan and Li Feng were caught off guard, and had no choice but to lead their troops out of the city to meet the enemy in battle.
pmwa1ngpv51fqt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|薛蘭、李封出其不意，只得引兵出城迎戰。#1

pmwa1ngpv5261r.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv5261r.text: 曹操復得兗州，程昱便請進兵取濮陽。
pmwa1ngpv5261r.gloss: Cao.Cao again DE Yan.Zhou, Cheng.Yu then request advance.troops take Pu.Yang.
pmwa1ngpv5261r.translation: Cao Cao recovered Yanzhou, and Cheng Yu then requested to advance troops to take Puyang.
pmwa1ngpv5261r.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操復得兗州，程昱便請進兵取濮陽。#1

pmwa1ngpv53gs2.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv53gs2.text: 操遂得濮陽，恕田氏舊日之罪。
pmwa1ngpv53gs2.gloss: Cao.Cao then DE Puyang, forgive Tian.clan former.days GEN crime.
pmwa1ngpv53gs2.translation: Cao Cao then obtained Puyang and pardoned the Tian clan’s former offenses.
pmwa1ngpv53gs2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操遂得濮陽，恕田氏舊日之罪。#1

pmwa1ngpv54s3e.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv54s3e.text: 曹操將得勝之兵，殺入城中，勢如破竹。
pmwa1ngpv54s3e.gloss: Cao.Cao lead DE victory ATTR troops, kill enter city inside, momentum like split bamboo.
pmwa1ngpv54s3e.translation: Cao Cao led his victorious troops and cut his way into the city, with the momentum of splitting bamboo.
pmwa1ngpv54s3e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操將得勝之兵，殺入城中，勢如破竹。#1

pmwa1ngpv559e2.section: 第十二回　　　　陶恭祖三讓徐州　　　曹孟德大戰呂布
pmwa1ngpv559e2.text: 山東一境，盡被曹操所得。
pmwa1ngpv559e2.gloss: Shandong one territory, all PASS Cao.Cao P DE.
pmwa1ngpv559e2.translation: The whole territory of Shandong was taken by Cao Cao.
pmwa1ngpv559e2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|山東一境，盡被曹操所得。#1

pmwa1ngpw566px.section: 第十三回　　　　李傕郭汜大交兵　　　楊奉董承雙救駕
pmwa1ngpw566px.text: 且說袁紹在冀州，聞知曹操與呂布相持，謀士審配進曰：「呂布，豺虎也：若得兗州，必圖冀州。
pmwa1ngpw566px.gloss: moreover say Yuan.Shao at Jizhou, learn Cao.Cao with Lü.Bu face.off, adviser Shen.Pei come.forward say: Lü.Bu, jackal.tiger SFP: if DE Yanzhou, certainly plot Jizhou.
pmwa1ngpw566px.translation: Moreover, Yuan Shao was in Jizhou; when he learned that Cao Cao and Lü Bu were locked in a standoff, his adviser Shen Pei came forward and said, 'Lü Bu is a jackal and a tiger: if he obtains Yanzhou, he will certainly plot against Jizhou.'
pmwa1ngpw566px.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|且說袁紹在冀州，聞知曹操與呂布相持，謀士審配進曰：「呂布，豺虎也：若得兗州，必圖冀州。#1

pmwa1ngpw57aun.section: 第十三回　　　　李傕郭汜大交兵　　　楊奉董承雙救駕
pmwa1ngpw57aun.text: 太尉楊彪、大司農朱雋暗奏獻帝曰：「今曹操擁兵二十餘萬，謀臣武將數十員，若得此人扶持社稷，剿除奸黨，天下幸甚。」
pmwa1ngpw57aun.gloss: Grand.Marshal Yang.Biao, Grand.Minister.of.Agriculture Zhu.Jun secretly memorialize Emperor.Xian say: now Cao.Cao command.troops twenty.odd.ten.thousand, strategist.minister military.general several.tens CLF, if DE this person support state, exterminate treacherous.faction, all.under.heaven fortunate.greatly.

pmwa1ngpw5dtb5.text: 賊軍漸近，只聽得一派鼓聲，山背後轉出一將，當先一面大旗，上書「大漢楊奉」四字，引軍千餘殺來。
