pmwa1ngpx5yt67.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|關公大喝曰：「匹夫休得逞強！」#1

pmwa1ngpx5zgs2.section: 第十四回　　　　曹孟德移駕幸許都　　呂奉先乘夜襲徐郡
pmwa1ngpx5zgs2.gloss: Bao fear, only DE drink PFV one cup.
pmwa1ngpx5zgs2.translation: Cao Bao was afraid, and had no choice but to drink one cup.
pmwa1ngpx5zgs2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|豹懼怕，只得飲了一盃。#1

pmwa1ngpx60dtc.section: 第十四回　　　　曹孟德移駕幸許都　　呂奉先乘夜襲徐郡
pmwa1ngpx60dtc.text: 曹豹無奈，只得告求曰：「翼德公，看我女婿之面，且恕我罷。」
pmwa1ngpx60dtc.gloss: Cao.Bao have.no.way, only DE plead say: Yide.gong, look 1SG son-in-law GEN face, for.now forgive 1SG SFP.
pmwa1ngpx60dtc.translation: Cao Bao had no way out and had no choice but to plead: 'Lord Yide, for the sake of my son-in-law, forgive me for now.'
pmwa1ngpx60dtc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹豹無奈，只得告求曰：「翼德公，看我女婿之面，且恕我罷。」#1

pmwa1ngpx61uqw.section: 第十四回　　　　曹孟德移駕幸許都　　呂奉先乘夜襲徐郡
pmwa1ngpx61uqw.text: 張飛大怒，慌忙披挂，綽了丈八蛇矛；纔出府門，上得馬時，呂布軍馬已到，正與相迎。
pmwa1ngpx61uqw.gloss: Zhang.Fei great angry, hurriedly don.armor, seize PFV ten.eight.foot.serpent.spear; just exit residence gate, mount DE horse time, Lü.Bu army.troops already arrive, exactly with meet.
pmwa1ngpx61uqw.translation: Zhang Fei flew into a rage, hurriedly put on his armor, and seized his ten-eight-foot serpent spear; just as he left the residence gate and mounted his horse, Lü Bu’s troops had already arrived and were coming straight to meet him.
pmwa1ngpx61uqw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張飛大怒，慌忙披挂，綽了丈八蛇矛；纔出府門，上得馬時，呂布軍馬已到，正與相迎。#1

pmwa1ngpx62xwm.section: 第十四回　　　　曹孟德移駕幸許都　　呂奉先乘夜襲徐郡
pmwa1ngpx62xwm.text: 玄德歎曰：「得何足喜，失何足憂！」
pmwa1ngpx62xwm.gloss: Xuande sigh say: DE what sufficient rejoice, lose what sufficient worry!
pmwa1ngpx62xwm.translation: Xuande sighed and said, "What is there to be glad about in gaining? What is there to worry about in losing?"
pmwa1ngpx62xwm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德歎曰：「得何足喜，失何足憂！」#1

pmwa1ngpx63i3f.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx63i3f.text: 玄德聞得此信，乘陰雨撤兵，棄盱眙而走，思欲東取廣陵。
pmwa1ngpx63i3f.gloss: Xuande hear DE this news, take.advantage.of rainy.weather withdraw.troops, abandon Xuyi CONJ flee, intend east take Guangling.
pmwa1ngpx63i3f.translation: Xuande heard this news, took advantage of the rainy weather to withdraw his troops, abandoned Xuyi and fled, intending to go east to take Guangling.
pmwa1ngpx63i3f.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德聞得此信，乘陰雨撤兵，棄盱眙而走，思欲東取廣陵。#1

pmwa1ngpx64y63.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx64y63.text: 甘、糜二夫人見玄德，具說呂布令兵把定宅門，禁諸人不得入；又常使侍妾送物，未嘗有缺。
pmwa1ngpx64y63.gloss: Gan, Mi two lady see Xuan.De, fully say Lü.Bu order soldier guard fixed residence gate, forbid all person NEG DE enter; also often send serving.woman deliver thing, never have lack.
pmwa1ngpx64y63.translation: Lady Gan and Lady Mi, the two ladies, came to see Xuande and told him in full how Lü Bu had ordered soldiers to guard the gate of the residence, forbidding anyone to enter; and that he had also regularly sent his serving women to deliver goods, so that there was never any shortage.
pmwa1ngpx64y63.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|甘、糜二夫人見玄德，具說呂布令兵把定宅門，禁諸人不得入；又常使侍妾送物，未嘗有缺。#1

pmwa1ngpx655co.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx655co.text: 人報孫策征廬江太守陸康，得勝而回。
pmwa1ngpx655co.gloss: person report Sun.Ce attack Lujiang governor Lu.Kang, DE victory CONJ return.
pmwa1ngpx655co.translation: Someone reported that Sun Ce had attacked Lu Kang, the governor of Lujiang, and returned victorious.
pmwa1ngpx655co.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|人報孫策征廬江太守陸康，得勝而回。#1

pmwa1ngpx66vl9.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx66vl9.text: 因使為懷義校尉，引兵攻涇縣，太師祖郎得勝。
pmwa1ngpx66vl9.gloss: therefore make be Huaiyi Colonel, lead troops attack Jing.County, greatly.defeat Zu.Lang DE victory
pmwa1ngpx66vl9.translation: So (Yuan Shu) made him Colonel of Huaiyi; (Sun Ce) led troops to attack Jing County, badly defeated Zu Lang, and won.
pmwa1ngpx66vl9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|因使為懷義校尉，引兵攻涇縣，太師祖郎得勝。#1

pmwa1ngpx67r0m.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx67r0m.text: 術見策勇，復使攻陸康，今又得勝而回。
pmwa1ngpx67r0m.gloss: Yuan.Shu see Sun.Ce brave, again send attack Lu.Kang, now again DE victory CONJ return.
pmwa1ngpx67r0m.translation: Yuan Shu saw that Sun Ce was brave, and again sent (him) to attack Lu Kang; now he had won again and returned.
pmwa1ngpx67r0m.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|術見策勇，復使攻陸康，今又得勝而回。#1

pmwa1ngpx68vc7.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx68vc7.gloss: Fan say: Gonglu want DE PROX long.time CRS!
pmwa1ngpx68vc7.translation: Fan said: "Gonglu has long wanted to obtain this!"
pmwa1ngpx68vc7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|範曰：「公路欲得此久矣！#1

pmwa1ngpx69avl.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx69avl.text: 策喜曰：「吾得公瑾，大事諧矣。」
pmwa1ngpx69avl.gloss: Ce happy say: 1SG DE Gongjin, great affair harmonize CRS
pmwa1ngpx69avl.translation: Ce was delighted and said: "Now that I have Gongjin, the great enterprise will succeed."
pmwa1ngpx69avl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|策喜曰：「吾得公瑾，大事諧矣。」#1

pmwa1ngpx6adlv.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx6adlv.text: 當日聽得孫策來到，願為前部先鋒。
pmwa1ngpx6adlv.gloss: that.day hear DE Sun.Ce arrive, wish be front.unit vanguard.
pmwa1ngpx6adlv.translation: That day, hearing that Sun Ce had arrived, (Tai Shi Ci) wished to be the vanguard of the advance troops.
pmwa1ngpx6adlv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|當日聽得孫策來到，願為前部先鋒。#1

pmwa1ngpx6bus9.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx6bus9.text: 策大喜，用為車前校尉，收得牛渚邸閣糧食、軍器，並降卒四千餘人，遂進兵神亭。
pmwa1ngpx6bus9.gloss: Sun.Ce greatly.rejoice , appoint.as chariot.front.captain , take DE Niuzhu depot grain , weapon , and surrendered.soldier four.thousand.more person , then advance.troops Shenting .
pmwa1ngpx6bus9.translation: Sun Ce was overjoyed, appointed (them) as Captains of the Chariot Front, took the grain and weapons of the Niuzhu depot, along with more than four thousand surrendered soldiers, and then advanced troops to Shenting.
pmwa1ngpx6bus9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|策大喜，用為車前校尉，收得牛渚邸閣糧食、軍器，並降卒四千餘人，遂進兵神亭。#1

pmwa1ngpx6c631.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx6c631.text: 正行過嶺，只聽得嶺上叫：「孫策休走！」
pmwa1ngpx6c631.gloss: just travel cross ridge, only hear DE ridge on call: Sun.Ce PROH flee!
pmwa1ngpx6c631.translation: Just as he was crossing the ridge, he only heard a shout from atop the ridge: “Sun Ce, don’t run away!”
pmwa1ngpx6c631.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|正行過嶺，只聽得嶺上叫：「孫策休走！」#1

pmwa1ngpx6d02n.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx6d02n.text: 兩個棄了槍，揪住廝打，戰袍扯得粉碎。
pmwa1ngpx6d02n.gloss: two CLF abandon PFV spear, grab.hold mutual.fight, battle.robe tear DE shattered
pmwa1ngpx6d02n.translation: The two threw away their spears, grappled and fought, and their battle robes were torn to shreds.
pmwa1ngpx6d02n.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|兩個棄了槍，揪住廝打，戰袍扯得粉碎。#1

pmwa1ngpx6epte.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx6epte.text: 孫策的馬，卻是程普收得，策亦取槍上馬。
pmwa1ngpx6epte.gloss: Sun.Ce GEN horse, however COP Cheng.Pu collect DE, Ce also take spear mount horse.
pmwa1ngpx6epte.translation: Sun Ce's horse, however, was recovered by Cheng Pu; Ce also took a spear and mounted his horse.
pmwa1ngpx6epte.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孫策的馬，卻是程普收得，策亦取槍上馬。#1

pmwa1ngpx6f5f0.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx6f5f0.text: 卻說孫策又得陳武為輔：其人身長七尺，面黃睛赤，形容古怪。
pmwa1ngpx6f5f0.gloss: meanwhile say Sun.Ce also DE Chen.Wu serve.as aide: 3SG person body tall seven chi, face yellow eyes red, appearance strange.
pmwa1ngpx6f5f0.translation: Meanwhile, Sun Ce also gained Chen Wu as an aide: the man was seven chi tall, with a yellow face and red eyes, and a strange appearance.
pmwa1ngpx6f5f0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說孫策又得陳武為輔：其人身長七尺，面黃睛赤，形容古怪。#1

pmwa1ngpx6gnva.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx6gnva.text: 卻說太史慈招得精壯二千餘人，并所部兵，正要來與劉繇報讎。
pmwa1ngpx6gnva.gloss: now Taishi.Ci recruit DE able.bodied two.thousand.odd people, and subordinate troops, just.about.to come for Liu.Yao avenge.
pmwa1ngpx6gnva.translation: Now, Taishi Ci had recruited more than two thousand able-bodied men, and together with the troops under his command, was just about to come to avenge Liu Yao.
pmwa1ngpx6gnva.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說太史慈招得精壯二千餘人，并所部兵，正要來與劉繇報讎。#1

pmwa1ngpx6hkco.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx6hkco.text: 既得吳郡，而又強併吾界！
pmwa1ngpx6hkco.gloss: already DE Wu.commandery, CONJ also forcibly annex my territory!
pmwa1ngpx6hkco.translation: You have already obtained Wu Commandery, and yet you also forcibly annex my territory!
pmwa1ngpx6hkco.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|既得吳郡，而又強併吾界！#1

pmwa1ngpx6iyk6.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx6iyk6.text: 帳下董襲曰：「某曾與海寇相持，身遭數槍，得會稽一個賢郡吏虞翻薦一醫者，半月而愈。」
pmwa1ngpx6iyk6.gloss: tent.under Dong.Xi say: 1SG once with sea.pirate confront, body suffer several spear, DE Kuaiji one CLF worthy commandery.official Yu.Fan recommend one physician, half.month CONJ recover.
pmwa1ngpx6iyk6.translation: Dong Xi, (an officer) under his command, said: 'I once faced the sea pirates and suffered several spear wounds; I got Yu Fan, a worthy commandery official of Kuaiji, to recommend a physician, and recovered in half a month.'
pmwa1ngpx6iyk6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|帳下董襲曰：「某曾與海寇相持，身遭數槍，得會稽一個賢郡吏虞翻薦一醫者，半月而愈。」#1

pmwa1ngpx6jzzj.section: 第十五回　　　　太史慈酣鬥小霸王　　孫伯符大戰嚴白虎
pmwa1ngpx6jzzj.text: 卻說袁術暗有稱帝之心，乃回書推託不還；急聚長史楊大將、都督張勳、紀靈、橋蕤、上將雷薄、陳蘭等三十餘人，商議曰：「孫策借我軍馬起事，今日盡得江東地面，乃不思報本，而反來索璽，殊為無禮。
pmwa1ngpx6jzzj.gloss: now Yuan.Shu secretly have proclaim.emperor GEN heart, then reply.letter make.excuses not return; urgently gather chief.clerk Yang.Dajiang, commander Zhang.Xun, Ji.Ling, Qiao.Rui, senior.general Lei.Bo, Chen.Lan etc thirty more person, discuss say: Sun.Ce borrow 1SG army.horse start.uprising, today all DE Jiangdong territory, yet not think repay.origin, but instead come demand seal, extremely COP rude.
pmwa1ngpx6jzzj.translation: Now, Yuan Shu secretly harbored the intention of proclaiming himself emperor, so he replied by letter with excuses and did not return (the seal); he urgently assembled Chief Clerk Yang Dajiang, Commanders Zhang Xun, Ji Ling, and Qiao Rui, senior generals Lei Bo and Chen Lan, and more than thirty others, and discussed (the matter), saying: 'Sun Ce borrowed my troops to start his uprising; today he has gained all the territory of Jiangdong, yet he does not think of repaying his debt, but instead comes to demand the seal—this is extremely rude.'
pmwa1ngpx6jzzj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說袁術暗有稱帝之心，乃回書推託不還；急聚長史楊大將、都督張勳、紀靈、橋蕤、上將雷薄、陳蘭等三十餘人，商議曰：「孫策借我軍馬起事，今日盡得江東地面，乃不思報本，而反來索璽，殊為無禮。#1

pmwa1ngpx6k5m7.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpx6k5m7.text: 先擒劉備，後圖呂布，徐州可得也。」
pmwa1ngpx6k5m7.gloss: first capture Liu.Bei, after plan Lü.Bu, Xu.Province can DE SFP.
pmwa1ngpx6k5m7.translation: First capture Liu Bei, and afterwards make plans against Lü Bu; then Xu Province can be obtained.
pmwa1ngpx6k5m7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|先擒劉備，後圖呂布，徐州可得也。」#1

pmwa1ngpx6l1af.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpx6l1af.text: 晝列旌旗，遮映山川；夜設火鼓，震崩天地，玄德縣中，止有五千餘人，也只得勉強領兵出縣，布陣安營。
pmwa1ngpx6l1af.gloss: by.day array banner.flag, cover.shade mountain.river; by.night set fire.drum, shake.collapse heaven.earth, Xuande county.inside, only have five.thousand more person, also only DE reluctantly lead.troops exit county, deploy.formation pitch.camp.
pmwa1ngpx6l1af.translation: By day they arrayed banners and flags, shading the mountains and rivers; by night they set up torches and drums, shaking and shattering heaven and earth. Xuande, in the county, had only a little more than five thousand men, and he too had no choice but to reluctantly lead his troops out of the county, deploy in formation, and pitch camp.
pmwa1ngpx6l1af.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|晝列旌旗，遮映山川；夜設火鼓，震崩天地，玄德縣中，止有五千餘人，也只得勉強領兵出縣，布陣安營。#1

pmwa1ngpx6m9mk.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpx6m9mk.text: 布曰：「吾今特解公之危，異日得志，不可相忘。」
pmwa1ngpx6m9mk.gloss: Bu say: 1SG now specially resolve lord GEN danger, other.day DE ambition, cannot OBJ forget.
pmwa1ngpx6m9mk.translation: Bu said: "Today I have specially resolved your danger; another day when you achieve your ambition, do not forget me."
pmwa1ngpx6m9mk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|布曰：「吾今特解公之危，異日得志，不可相忘。」#1

pmwa1ngpx6npm9.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpx6npm9.text: 布曰：「吾特請你二人來會議，勿得生疑。」
pmwa1ngpx6npm9.gloss: Bu say: 1SG specially invite 2SG two person come discuss, do.not DE become.suspicious.
pmwa1ngpx6npm9.translation: Lü Bu said, "I have specially invited you two to come and discuss; do not become suspicious."
pmwa1ngpx6npm9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|布曰：「吾特請你二人來會議，勿得生疑。」#1

pmwa1ngpx6oqxz.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水

pmwa1ngpx6oqxz.gloss: Ling say: 1SG receive lord GEN command, lead ten.myriad GEN troops, specially capture Liu.Bei, how stop DE?
pmwa1ngpx6oqxz.translation: Ling said: "I have received my lord's command and am leading a hundred thousand troops specifically to capture Liu Bei; how can (I) stop?"

pmwa1ngpx6pjh4.translation: Besides, I might as well agree; wait until he misses, and then I can fight as I please.

pmwa1ngpx6qjgt.gloss: Xuande secretly pray say: only wish 3SG shoot DE hit then good!
pmwa1ngpx6qjgt.translation: Xuande secretly prayed, saying, "I only hope he shoots and hits; that would be good!"

pmwa1ngpx6shjl.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpx6shjl.text: 正話間，宋憲、魏續至，告布曰：「我二人奉明公之命，往山東買馬，買得好馬三百餘匹；回至沛縣界首，被強寇劫去一半，打聽得是劉備之弟張飛，詐裝山賊，搶劫馬匹去了。」
pmwa1ngpx6shjl.gloss: just talk interval, Song.Xian, Wei.Xu arrive, tell Bu say: 1PL two person receive enlightened.lord GEN command, go.to Shandong buy horse, buy DE good horse three.hundred odd CLF; return arrive Pei.County border, PASS violent.bandit seize.away half, inquire DE COP Liu.Bei GEN younger.brother Zhang.Fei, pretend mountain.bandit, rob horse go CRS.
pmwa1ngpx6shjl.translation: Just as they were speaking, Song Xian and Wei Xu arrived and reported to Lü Bu: 'We two, by the command of the enlightened lord, went to Shandong to buy horses and bought over three hundred fine horses; on returning to the border of Pei County, half were carried off by violent bandits. On inquiry, it was Liu Bei's younger brother Zhang Fei, pretending to be a mountain bandit, who robbed us and took the horses away.'
pmwa1ngpx6shjl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|正話間，宋憲、魏續至，告布曰：「我二人奉明公之命，往山東買馬，買得好馬三百餘匹；回至沛縣界首，被強寇劫去一半，打聽得是劉備之弟張飛，詐裝山賊，搶劫馬匹去了。」#1

pmwa1ngpx6uq5q.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpx6uq5q.text: 當夜三更，乘著月明出北門而走，正遇宋憲、魏續，被翼德一陣殺退，得出重圍。
pmwa1ngpx6uq5q.gloss: that.night third.watch, take.advantage.of ASP moonlight exit north.gate CONJ flee, just encounter Song.Xian, Wei.Xu, PASS Yide one.CLF rout, DE out heavy.encirclement.
pmwa1ngpx6uq5q.translation: That night at the third watch, taking advantage of the moonlight, they went out by the north gate and fled. Just then they encountered Song Xian and Wei Xu; (the latter) were routed by Yide in a single charge, and (Liu Bei's party) got out of the heavy encirclement.
pmwa1ngpx6uq5q.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|當夜三更，乘著月明出北門而走，正遇宋憲、魏續，被翼德一陣殺退，得出重圍。#1

pmwa1ngpy6vxd9.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpy6vxd9.text: 詡曰：「某昔從李榷，得罪天下；今從張繡，言聽計從，未忍棄之。」
pmwa1ngpy6vxd9.gloss: Jia.Xu say: 1SG formerly follow Li.Que, DE guilt world; now follow Zhang.Xiu, words listen plans follow, NEG bear abandon 3SG.
pmwa1ngpy6vxd9.translation: Jia Xu said: 'I formerly followed Li Que and offended the world; now I follow Zhang Xiu—my words are heeded and my plans followed—and I cannot bear to abandon him.'
pmwa1ngpy6vxd9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|詡曰：「某昔從李榷，得罪天下；今從張繡，言聽計從，未忍棄之。」#1

pmwa1ngpy6w4ym.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpy6w4ym.text: 操之兄子曹安民，知操意，乃密對曰：「昨晚小姪兒窺見館舍之側，有一婦人，生得十分美麗。
pmwa1ngpy6w4ym.gloss: Cao.Cao GEN elder.brother son Cao.Anmin, know Cao.Cao intention, then secretly reply say: last.night little.nephew glimpse guesthouse GEN side, have one woman, born DE very beautiful.
pmwa1ngpy6w4ym.translation: Cao Anmin, the son of Cao Cao’s elder brother, understood Cao Cao’s intention, so he secretly replied: ‘Last night your little nephew caught a glimpse of a woman beside the guesthouse, and she was very beautiful.

pmwa1ngpy6x0xe.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpy6x0xe.text: 鄒氏曰：「久聞丞相威名，今夕幸得瞻拜。」
pmwa1ngpy6x0xe.gloss: Zou.clan say: long hear chancellor prestige.name, this.evening fortunate DE look.up.pay.respects.
pmwa1ngpy6x0xe.translation: Lady Zou said: “I have long heard of the Chancellor’s prestige; tonight I am fortunate to get to look upon you and pay my respects.”
pmwa1ngpy6x0xe.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|鄒氏曰：「久聞丞相威名，今夕幸得瞻拜。」#1

pmwa1ngpy6y1ne.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpy6y1ne.text: 操曰：「今日得見夫人，乃天幸也。
pmwa1ngpy6y1ne.gloss: Cao say: today DE see lady, COP heaven.sent.fortune SFP.
pmwa1ngpy6y1ne.translation: Cao said: "Today, being able to see you, madam, is a heaven-sent fortune."
pmwa1ngpy6y1ne.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操曰：「今日得見夫人，乃天幸也。#1

pmwa1ngpy6znfe.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpy6znfe.text: 操曰：「軍中失火，勿得驚動。」
pmwa1ngpy6znfe.gloss: Cao say: army within lose.fire, PROH DE alarm.disturb.
pmwa1ngpy6znfe.translation: Cao said, "There is a fire in the camp; do not cause a disturbance."
pmwa1ngpy6znfe.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操曰：「軍中失火，勿得驚動。」#1

pmwa1ngpy70g6z.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpy70g6z.text: 韋方醉臥，睡夢中聽得金鼓喊殺之聲，便跳起身來，卻尋不見了雙戟。
pmwa1ngpy70g6z.gloss: Wei just drunk lie.down, sleep.dream midst hear DE gong.drum shout.kill GEN sound, then jump get.up come, but seek NEG see PFV pair halberd
pmwa1ngpy70g6z.translation: Wei had just lain down drunk; in his sleep he heard the sound of gongs, drums, and shouts of killing, so he leapt up, but could not find his pair of halberds.
pmwa1ngpy70g6z.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|韋方醉臥，睡夢中聽得金鼓喊殺之聲，便跳起身來，卻尋不見了雙戟。#1

pmwa1ngpy71evg.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpy71evg.text: 卻說曹操賴典韋當住寨門，乃得從寨後上馬逃奔，只有曹安民步隨，操右臂中了一箭，馬亦中了三箭。
pmwa1ngpy71evg.gloss: meanwhile say Cao.Cao rely.on Dian.Wei hold.back camp.gate, then DE from camp.rear mount.horse flee, only Cao.Anmin follow.on.foot, Cao.Cao right.arm hit PFV one arrow, horse also hit PFV three arrow.
pmwa1ngpy71evg.translation: Meanwhile, Cao Cao relied on Dian Wei to hold the camp gate, and so was able to mount his horse behind the camp and flee; only Cao Anmin followed on foot. Cao Cao was struck by an arrow in his right arm, and his horse was also struck by three arrows.
pmwa1ngpy71evg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說曹操賴典韋當住寨門，乃得從寨後上馬逃奔，只有曹安民步隨，操右臂中了一箭，馬亦中了三箭。#1

pmwa1ngpy7278j.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpy7278j.text: 虧得那馬是大宛良馬，熬得痛，走得快。
pmwa1ngpy7278j.gloss: fortunately-DE that horse COP Dayuan fine.horse, endure-DE pain, run-DE fast
pmwa1ngpy7278j.translation: Fortunately, that horse was a fine Dayuan horse: it could endure pain and run fast.

pmwa1ngpy753dt.section: 第十六回　　　　呂奉先射戟轅門　　　曹孟德敗師淯水
pmwa1ngpy753dt.text: 操急驟馬衝波過河，纔上得岸，賊兵一箭射來，正中馬眼，那馬撲地倒了。
pmwa1ngpy753dt.gloss: Cao.Cao urgently gallop horse dash.waves cross river, just get.onto DE bank, rebel.soldier one arrow shoot come, exactly hit horse eye, that horse pitch.to.ground fall PFV
pmwa1ngpy753dt.translation: Cao Cao urgently spurred his horse, dashed through the waves and crossed the river; he had just gotten onto the bank when a rebel soldier shot an arrow, which hit the horse right in the eye, and the horse fell to the ground.
pmwa1ngpy753dt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操急驟馬衝波過河，纔上得岸，賊兵一箭射來，正中馬眼，那馬撲地倒了。#1

pmwa1ngpy762az.section: 第十七回　　　　袁公路大起七軍　　　曹孟德會合三將
pmwa1ngpy762az.text: 呂布使人探聽得張勳一軍從大路逕取徐州，橋蕤一軍取小沛，陳紀一軍取沂都，雷薄一軍取瑯琊，陳蘭一軍取碣石，韓暹一軍取下邳，楊奉一軍取浚山，七路軍馬，日行五十里，於路劫掠將來，乃急召眾謀士商議，陳宮與陳珪父子俱至。
pmwa1ngpy762az.gloss: Lü.Bu send person spy.listen DE Zhang.Xun one army from big.road directly take Xu.Province, Qiao.Rui one army take Xiao.Pei, Chen.Ji one army take Yi.Du, Lei.Bo one army take Lang.Ya, Chen.Lan one army take Jie.Shi, Han.Xian one army take Xia.Pi, Yang.Feng one army take Jun.Shan, seven route troops, day travel fifty li, on.road plunder come, then urgently.summon all strategist discuss, Chen.Gong and Chen.Gui father.son all arrive.
pmwa1ngpy762az.translation: Lü Bu sent someone to spy and learned that Zhang Xun’s army was taking Xu Province directly by the main road, Qiao Rui’s army was taking Xiaopei, Chen Ji’s army was taking Yidu, Lei Bo’s army was taking Langya, Chen Lan’s army was taking Jieshi, Han Xian’s army was taking Xiapi, and Yang Feng’s army was taking Junshan; the seven columns of troops marched fifty li a day and plundered as they came, so he urgently summoned his strategists to discuss (the matter), and Chen Gong and Chen Gui and his son all arrived.
pmwa1ngpy762az.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|呂布使人探聽得張勳一軍從大路逕取徐州，橋蕤一軍取小沛，陳紀一軍取沂都，雷薄一軍取瑯琊，陳蘭一軍取碣石，韓暹一軍取下邳，楊奉一軍取浚山，七路軍馬，日行五十里，於路劫掠將來，乃急召眾謀士商議，陳宮與陳珪父子俱至。#1

pmwa1ngpy775nu.section: 第十七回　　　　袁公路大起七軍　　　曹孟德會合三將
pmwa1ngpy775nu.text: 呂布得勝，邀請雲長並楊奉、韓暹等一行人馬到徐州，大排筵宴款待。
pmwa1ngpy775nu.gloss: Lü.Bu DE victory, invite Yun.Chang CONJ Yang.Feng, Han.Xian etc a.group.of.troops to Xuzhou, grandly.arrange banquet entertain.
pmwa1ngpy775nu.translation: Lü Bu was victorious; he invited Yun Chang, along with Yang Feng, Han Xian and their party of troops, to Xuzhou, where he grandly arranged a banquet to entertain them.
pmwa1ngpy775nu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|呂布得勝，邀請雲長並楊奉、韓暹等一行人馬到徐州，大排筵宴款待。#1

pmwa1ngpy79v83.section: 第十七回　　　　袁公路大起七軍　　　曹孟德會合三將
pmwa1ngpy79v83.text: 操軍相拒月餘，糧食將盡，致書於孫策，借得糧米十萬斛，不敷支散。

pmwa1ngpy79v83.translation: Cao Cao's army faced off for over a month, and provisions were about to run out; (Cao Cao) sent a letter to Sun Ce and borrowed 100,000 hu of grain, (which was) not enough to distribute.
pmwa1ngpy79v83.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操軍相拒月餘，糧食將盡，致書於孫策，借得糧米十萬斛，不敷支散。#1

pmwa1ngpy7ajgc.section: 第十七回　　　　袁公路大起七軍　　　曹孟德會合三將
pmwa1ngpy7ajgc.text: 方今麥熟之時，不得已而起兵，大小將校，凡過麥田，但有踐踏者，並皆斬首。
pmwa1ngpy7ajgc.gloss: now wheat ripe GEN time, NEG DE stop CONJ raise.troops, great small officer, all pass wheat field, if have trample NMLZ, all.together behead.
pmwa1ngpy7ajgc.translation: At present, when the wheat is ripe, I have no choice but to raise troops. All officers, great and small, whoever passes through the wheat fields—if anyone tramples (the wheat), all shall be beheaded.
pmwa1ngpy7ajgc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|方今麥熟之時，不得已而起兵，大小將校，凡過麥田，但有踐踏者，並皆斬首。#1

pmwa1ngpy7b0wf.section: 第十七回　　　　袁公路大起七軍　　　曹孟德會合三將
pmwa1ngpy7b0wf.text: 軍法甚嚴，爾民勿得驚疑。」
pmwa1ngpy7b0wf.gloss: military.law very strict, you people PROH DE alarmed.doubtful
pmwa1ngpy7b0wf.translation: Military law is very strict; you common folk must not be alarmed or doubtful.
pmwa1ngpy7b0wf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|軍法甚嚴，爾民勿得驚疑。」#1

pmwa1ngpy7cr2v.section: 第十八回　　　　賈文和料敵決勝　　　夏侯惇拔矢啖睛
pmwa1ngpy7cr2v.text: 只聽得一聲砲響，伏兵四起。
pmwa1ngpy7cr2v.gloss: only hear DE one CLF cannon.sound, ambush.troops rise.on.all.sides
pmwa1ngpy7cr2v.translation: They only heard a single cannon blast, and ambush troops sprang up on all sides.
pmwa1ngpy7cr2v.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只聽得一聲砲響，伏兵四起。#1

pmwa1ngpy7drz3.section: 第十八回　　　　賈文和料敵決勝　　　夏侯惇拔矢啖睛
pmwa1ngpy7drz3.text: 表得書，即欲起兵，忽探馬報孫策屯兵湖口。
pmwa1ngpy7drz3.gloss: Liu.Biao DE letter, immediately want raise.troops, suddenly mounted.scout report Sun.Ce station.troops Hukou.
pmwa1ngpy7drz3.translation: Liu Biao received the letter and immediately wanted to raise troops, when suddenly a scout reported that Sun Ce was stationing troops at Hukou.
pmwa1ngpy7drz3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|表得書，即欲起兵，忽探馬報孫策屯兵湖口。#1

pmwa1ngpy7eub4.section: 第十八回　　　　賈文和料敵決勝　　　夏侯惇拔矢啖睛
pmwa1ngpy7eub4.gloss: Cao DE letter heart flustered, same.day return army.
pmwa1ngpy7eub4.translation: Cao (Cao Cao) received the letter and was alarmed; the same day he turned his troops back.
pmwa1ngpy7eub4.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操得書心慌，即日回兵。#1

pmwa1ngpy7fx64.section: 第十八回　　　　賈文和料敵決勝　　　夏侯惇拔矢啖睛
pmwa1ngpy7fx64.text: 紹多謀少決，公得策輒行，此謀勝也；
pmwa1ngpy7fx64.gloss: Shao many plan few decision, lord DE plan immediately act, this strategy win SFP;
pmwa1ngpy7fx64.translation: Yuan Shao has many plans but is short on decisions; when you, my lord, obtain a plan, you act on it at once—this is your superiority in strategy.
pmwa1ngpy7fx64.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|紹多謀少決，公得策輒行，此謀勝也；#1

pmwa1ngpy7gx7z.section: 第十八回　　　　賈文和料敵決勝　　　夏侯惇拔矢啖睛
pmwa1ngpy7gx7z.text: 紹得書大喜，便進兵攻公孫瓚。
pmwa1ngpy7gx7z.gloss: Shao DE letter great joy, then advance.troops attack Gongsun.Zan.
pmwa1ngpy7gx7z.translation: Yuan Shao received the letter and was overjoyed, and at once advanced his troops to attack Gongsun Zan.
pmwa1ngpy7gx7z.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|紹得書大喜，便進兵攻公孫瓚。#1

pmwa1ngpy7h17b.section: 第十八回　　　　賈文和料敵決勝　　　夏侯惇拔矢啖睛
pmwa1ngpy7h17b.text: 陳宮令搜其身，得玄德回答曹操密書一封。
pmwa1ngpy7h17b.gloss: Chen.Gong order search 3SG body, DE Xuande reply Cao.Cao secret.letter one CLF.
pmwa1ngpy7h17b.translation: Chen Gong ordered (his men) to search his person, and obtained a secret letter from Xuande in reply to Cao Cao.
pmwa1ngpy7h17b.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|陳宮令搜其身，得玄德回答曹操密書一封。#1

pmwa1ngpy7i40f.section: 第十八回　　　　賈文和料敵決勝　　　夏侯惇拔矢啖睛
pmwa1ngpy7i40f.text: 來使曰：「曹丞相差我往劉豫州處下書，今得回書，不知書中所言何事。」
pmwa1ngpy7i40f.gloss: arriving.envoy say: Cao.Chancellor send 1SG go.to Liu.Yuzhou place deliver.letter, now DE reply.letter, NEG know letter.in NMLZ say what matter.
pmwa1ngpy7i40f.translation: The envoy said: “Chancellor Cao sent me to Liu Yuzhou’s place to deliver a letter; now I have gotten the reply, and I do not know what is said in the letter.”
pmwa1ngpy7i40f.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|來使曰：「曹丞相差我往劉豫州處下書，今得回書，不知書中所言何事。」#1

pmwa1ngpy7j916.section: 第十八回　　　　賈文和料敵決勝　　　夏侯惇拔矢啖睛
pmwa1ngpy7j916.text: 陣上曹性看見，暗地拈弓搭箭，覷得真切，一箭射去，正中夏侯惇左目，惇大叫一聲，急用手拔箭，不想連眼珠拔出，乃大呼曰：「父精母血，不可棄也！」
pmwa1ngpy7j916.gloss: battle.line.on Cao.Xing see, secretly take.bow fit.arrow, look DE clear, one.arrow shoot go, hit.exactly Xiahou.Dun left.eye, Dun loudly.shout one CLF, hurriedly use hand pull.arrow, unexpectedly along.with eyeball pull.out, then loudly.call say: father.essence mother.blood, cannot discard SFP!
pmwa1ngpy7j916.translation: Cao Xing on the battle line saw this; secretly he took up his bow and fitted an arrow, took careful aim, and shot an arrow, striking Xiahou Dun squarely in the left eye. Dun gave a loud shout and hurriedly pulled the arrow out with his hand; unexpectedly he pulled the eyeball out along with it, so he cried out loudly: 'Father's essence and mother's blood cannot be discarded!'
pmwa1ngpy7j916.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|陣上曹性看見，暗地拈弓搭箭，覷得真切，一箭射去，正中夏侯惇左目，惇大叫一聲，急用手拔箭，不想連眼珠拔出，乃大呼曰：「父精母血，不可棄也！」#1

pmwa1ngpy7kjk1.section: 第十八回　　　　賈文和料敵決勝　　　夏侯惇拔矢啖睛
pmwa1ngpy7kjk1.text: 高順得勝，引軍回擊玄德，恰好呂布大軍亦至。
pmwa1ngpy7kjk1.gloss: Gao.Shun DE victory, lead army return.attack Xuande, just.happen Lü.Bu great.army also arrive.
pmwa1ngpy7kjk1.translation: Gao Shun won a victory and led his troops back to attack Xuande; just then Lü Bu’s main army also arrived.
pmwa1ngpy7kjk1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|高順得勝，引軍回擊玄德，恰好呂布大軍亦至。#1

pmwa1ngpy7lir0.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpy7lir0.text: 玄德見勢已急，到家不及，只得棄了妻小，穿城而過，走出西門，匹馬逃難。
pmwa1ngpy7lir0.gloss: Xuande see situation already urgent, reach home not.in.time, only DE abandon PFV wife.children, pass.through city CONJ cross, walk out west.gate, CLF horse flee.disaster.
pmwa1ngpy7lir0.translation: Xuande saw that the situation was already urgent and that he could not get home in time, so he had no choice but to abandon his wife and children, pass through the city, go out the west gate, and flee alone on horseback.
pmwa1ngpy7lir0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德見勢已急，到家不及，只得棄了妻小，穿城而過，走出西門，匹馬逃難。#1

pmwa1ngpy7m7tu.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpy7m7tu.text: 今不得已而投曹公，惟將軍憐之。」
pmwa1ngpy7m7tu.gloss: now NEG DE stop CONJ join Cao.Lord, only general pity 3SG
pmwa1ngpy7m7tu.translation: Now, with no choice but to throw himself on Lord Cao's mercy, (I) only hope the General will take pity on him.
pmwa1ngpy7m7tu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今不得已而投曹公，惟將軍憐之。」#1

pmwa1ngpy7n2rv.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpy7n2rv.text: 關、張二人亦各自收得些人馬，往山中住劄。
pmwa1ngpy7n2rv.gloss: Guan.Zhang two person also each.self gather DE some men.horses, go mountain.in encamp
pmwa1ngpy7n2rv.translation: Guan and Zhang, the two men, also each gathered some troops and horses and went into the mountains to encamp.
pmwa1ngpy7n2rv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|關、張二人亦各自收得些人馬，往山中住劄。#1

pmwa1ngpz7ob5e.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7ob5e.text: 當下劉安聞豫州牧至，欲尋野味供食，一時不能得，乃殺其妻以食之。
pmwa1ngpz7ob5e.gloss: at.that.moment Liu.An hear Yuzhou.governor arrive, want seek game provide.food, for.a.time NEG can DE, then kill 3SG.GEN wife in.order.to feed 3SG.OBJ.
pmwa1ngpz7ob5e.translation: At that moment Liu An heard that the Governor of Yuzhou had arrived; he wanted to find game to serve as food, but for the moment could not get any, so he killed his wife to feed him.
pmwa1ngpz7ob5e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|當下劉安聞豫州牧至，欲尋野味供食，一時不能得，乃殺其妻以食之。#1

pmwa1ngpz7pc10.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7pc10.text: 到得城邊叫門時，城上亂箭射下。
pmwa1ngpz7pc10.gloss: arrive DE city.side call.at.gate time, city.top random.arrows shoot.down.
pmwa1ngpz7pc10.translation: When (Lü Bu and Chen Gong) reached the edge of the city wall and called at the gate, a volley of arrows was shot down from the top of the wall.
pmwa1ngpz7pc10.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|到得城邊叫門時，城上亂箭射下。#1

pmwa1ngpz7qf6a.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7qf6a.text: 糜竺在敵樓上喝曰：「汝奪吾主城池，今當仍還吾主，汝不得復入此城也。」
pmwa1ngpz7qf6a.gloss: Mi.Zhu at watchtower top shout say: 2SG seize 1SG lord city, now should still return 1SG lord, 2SG NEG DE again enter PROX city SFP.
pmwa1ngpz7qf6a.translation: Mi Zhu shouted from the watchtower: 'You seized my lord's city; now it should be returned to my lord; you must not enter this city again.'
pmwa1ngpz7qf6a.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|糜竺在敵樓上喝曰：「汝奪吾主城池，今當仍還吾主，汝不得復入此城也。」#1

pmwa1ngpz7rxt2.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7rxt2.gloss: Lü.Bu flee DE men exhausted horse weary
pmwa1ngpz7rxt2.translation: Lü Bu fled until his men were exhausted and his horses weary.
pmwa1ngpz7rxt2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|呂布走得人困馬乏。#1

pmwa1ngpz7squh.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7squh.text: 雲長曰：「我在海州路上住紮，探得消息，故來至此。」
pmwa1ngpz7squh.gloss: Yun.chang say: 1SG at Haizhou road.on be.stationed, seek.out DE news, therefore come arrive here.
pmwa1ngpz7squh.translation: Yun-chang said: "I was stationed on the road at Haizhou, learned the news, and so came here."
pmwa1ngpz7squh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雲長曰：「我在海州路上住紮，探得消息，故來至此。」#1

pmwa1ngpz7twhc.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7twhc.text: 張飛曰：「弟在芒碭山住了這幾時，今日幸得相遇。」
pmwa1ngpz7twhc.gloss: Zhang.Fei say: younger.brother at Mount.Mangdang stay PFV this while, today fortunate DE meet.
pmwa1ngpz7twhc.translation: Zhang Fei said, "I have stayed at Mount Mangdang all this while; today I am fortunate to meet you."
pmwa1ngpz7twhc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張飛曰：「弟在芒碭山住了這幾時，今日幸得相遇。」#1

pmwa1ngpz7u3wu.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7u3wu.text: 且說曹操得了徐州，心中大喜，商議起兵攻下邳。
pmwa1ngpz7u3wu.gloss: now.speak.of Cao.Cao DE PFV Xu.Province, heart.middle greatly.rejoice, discuss raise.troops attack Xiapi.
pmwa1ngpz7u3wu.translation: Now to speak of Cao Cao: having obtained Xu Province, he was greatly delighted at heart and discussed raising troops to attack Xiapi.
pmwa1ngpz7u3wu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|且說曹操得了徐州，心中大喜，商議起兵攻下邳。#1

pmwa1ngpz7v9sm.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7v9sm.text: 嚴氏曰：「君委全城，捐妻子，孤軍遠出，倘一旦有變，妾豈得為將軍之妻乎？」
pmwa1ngpz7v9sm.gloss: Yan.clan say: you abandon whole city, forsake wife.children, lone army far go.out, if one.day have change, 1SG.HUM how DE be general GEN wife Q?
pmwa1ngpz7v9sm.translation: Lady Yan said: You abandon the whole city and forsake your wife and children, and go far away with a lone army; if one day there is a change, how could I be the general's wife?
pmwa1ngpz7v9sm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|嚴氏曰：「君委全城，捐妻子，孤軍遠出，倘一旦有變，妾豈得為將軍之妻乎？」#1

pmwa1ngpz7w9zu.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7w9zu.text: 妾昔在長安，已為將軍所棄，幸賴龐舒私藏妾身，再得與將軍相聚；孰知今又棄妾而去乎？
pmwa1ngpz7w9zu.gloss: 1SG formerly at Chang'an, already PASS general PASS abandon, fortunate rely.on Pang.Shu secretly.hide 1SG, again DE with general together.gather; who.know now again abandon 1SG CONJ go Q?
pmwa1ngpz7w9zu.translation: Formerly, when I was in Chang'an, I had already been abandoned by you, General. Fortunately, thanks to Pang Shu secretly sheltering me, I was able to be reunited with you again. Who would have thought that now you would abandon me and leave again?
pmwa1ngpz7w9zu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|妾昔在長安，已為將軍所棄，幸賴龐舒私藏妾身，再得與將軍相聚；孰知今又棄妾而去乎？#1

pmwa1ngpz7x9ie.section: 第十九回 下邳城曹操鏖兵 白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7x9ie.text: 許汜曰：「須得一軍引路衝出方好。」
pmwa1ngpz7x9ie.gloss: Xu.Si say: must DE one army lead.way charge.out then good
pmwa1ngpz7x9ie.translation: Xu Si said, "We must get a body of troops to lead the way and break out through (the pass) — only then will it be all right."
pmwa1ngpz7x9ie.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|許汜曰：「須得一軍引路衝出方好。」#1

pmwa1ngpz7ysbl.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7ysbl.text: 許汜、王楷只得拜辭，和郝萌回來。
pmwa1ngpz7ysbl.gloss: Xu.Si, Wang.Kai only DE bid.farewell, with Hao.Meng return.
pmwa1ngpz7ysbl.translation: Xu Si and Wang Kai had no choice but to take their leave and return together with Hao Meng.
pmwa1ngpz7ysbl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|許汜、王楷只得拜辭，和郝萌回來。#1

pmwa1ngpz7z2rv.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz7z2rv.text: 且說許汜，王楷，回見呂布，具言袁術先欲得婦，然後起兵救援。
pmwa1ngpz7z2rv.gloss: moreover say Xu.Si, Wang.Kai, return see Lu.Bu, fully say Yuan.Shu first want DE woman, then raise troops rescue
pmwa1ngpz7z2rv.translation: Moreover, Xu Si and Wang Kai returned to see Lü Bu and reported in full that Yuan Shu first wanted to get the woman, and then (he would) raise troops to rescue.
pmwa1ngpz7z2rv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|且說許汜，王楷，回見呂布，具言袁術先欲得婦，然後起兵救援。#1

pmwa1ngpz80ngc.section: 第十九回　　　　下邳城曹操鏖兵　　　白門樓呂布殞命
pmwa1ngpz80ngc.text: 布見軍來太急，只得仍退入城。
pmwa1ngpz80ngc.gloss: Bu see army come too urgent, only DE still retreat enter city.
pmwa1ngpz80ngc.translation: Lü Bu saw that the troops were coming too urgently, and had no choice but to retreat back into the city.

pmwa1ngpz89zk2.translation: The Emperor secretly thought: 'Cao Cao wields power; state affairs are all not decided by me. Now that I have gained this heroic uncle, I have help!'

pmwa1ngpz8f8cg.text: 騰曰：「許田射獵之事，吾尚氣滿胸膛；公乃國之至戚，猶自滯於酒色，而不思討賊，安得為皇家救難扶災之人乎！」

pmwa1ngpz8f8cg.translation: Teng said: "As for the affair of the hunt at Xu Field, my breast is still full of anger; you are the closest kin of the state, yet you still wallow in wine and women and do not think of attacking the rebels—how can you be one who saves the imperial family from danger and supports it in disaster?"

pmwa1ngq08gfk3.translation: (Ma Teng) pointed at the five men seated (there) and said, “If we get ten men, the great undertaking will succeed.”

pmwa1ngq08hfry.section: 第二十回　　　　曹阿瞞許田打圍　　　董國舅內閣受詔

pmwa1ngq08lli7.section: 第二十一回　　　曹操煮酒論英雄　　　關公賺城斬車胄

pmwa1ngq08poci.text: 原來二人從城外射箭方回，聽得玄德被許褚、張遼請將去了，慌忙來相府打聽；聞說在後園，只恐有失，故衝突而入。

pmwa1ngq08poci.translation: It turned out that the two men had just returned from shooting arrows outside the city. When they heard that Xuande had been invited away by Xu Chu and Zhang Liao, they hurried to the prime minister's residence to make inquiries; hearing that he was in the rear garden, and fearing that something might go wrong, they therefore rushed in.

pmwa1ngq093m0x.text: 宜先遣人獻捷天子，若不得通，乃表稱曹操隔我王路，然後提兵屯黎陽，更於河內增益舟楫，繕置軍器，分遣精兵，屯劄邊鄙。

pmwa1ngq093m0x.translation: It would be best first to send someone to report the victory to the Emperor. If (the messenger) cannot get through, then submit a memorial claiming that Cao Cao is blocking our royal road. After that, lead troops to camp at Liyang, and further, in Henei, increase boats and oars, repair and set out weapons, separately dispatch elite troops, and station (them) at the border.

pmwa1ngq09cjzn.section: 第二十三回　　　禰正平裸衣罵賊　　　吉太醫下毒遭刑
pmwa1ngq09cjzn.text: 詡曰：「從操其便有三：夫曹公奉天子明詔，征伐天下，其宜從一也；紹強盛，我以少從之，必不以我為重，操雖弱，得我必喜，其宜從二也；曹公王霸之志，必釋私怨，以明德於四海，其宜從三也。
pmwa1ngq09cjzn.gloss: Jia.Xu say: follow Cao.Cao 3SG benefit have three: P Cao.Gong uphold Son.of.Heaven clear.edict, campaign.against world, 3SG fitting follow one SFP; Yuan.Shao strong.prosperous, 1PL with few follow 3SG, must NEG take 1PL as important, Cao.Cao although weak, DE 1PL must pleased, 3SG fitting follow two SFP; Cao.Gong king.hegemon ATTR ambition, must release private.grudge, in.order.to display virtue to four.seas, 3SG fitting follow three SFP.
pmwa1ngq09cjzn.translation: Jia Xu said: 'Following Cao Cao has three advantages: Cao Gong upholds the Son of Heaven's clear edict and campaigns against the realm—this is the first reason to follow him. Yuan Shao is strong and prosperous; if we follow him with a small force, he will certainly not regard us as important, whereas Cao Cao, though weak, will certainly be pleased to get us—this is the second reason. Cao Gong has the ambition of a king and hegemon; he will surely set aside private grudges to display his virtue to the four seas—this is the third reason.'

pmwa1ngq09d137.translation: Jia Xu came forward and said: 'Liu Jingsheng (Liu Biao) likes to make connections with famous people; now we must obtain a scholar with a literary reputation to go and persuade him; only then can he be made to surrender.'

pmwa1ngq1abku2.translation: Lord Guan said: "I know this horse covers a thousand li in a day. Today I am fortunate enough to get it; if I learn of my elder brother's whereabouts, then I can see him within a single day."

pmwa1ngq1acu2p.section: 第二十五回　　　屯土山關公約三事　　救白馬曹操解重圍

pmwa1ngq1adoz4.translation: One man from under the tent answered and stepped forward, saying: Yan Liang and I were like brothers; now that he has been killed by the Cao thief, how can I not avenge his grievance?

pmwa1ngq1afm9k.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金
pmwa1ngq1afm9k.text: 文醜軍既得糧草車仗，又來搶馬。
pmwa1ngq1afm9k.gloss: Wen.Chou army already DE grain.fodder cart.gear, again come seize horse.

pmwa1ngq1agwkz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|軍士自相踐踏，文醜止遏不住，只得撥馬回走。#1

pmwa1ngq2ahm0x.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金
pmwa1ngq2ahm0x.text: 欲待招呼相見，被曹兵大隊擁來，只得收兵回去。

pmwa1ngq2aifu2.translation: Yuan Shao was overjoyed and said, "If I obtain Yun Chang, (he) is ten times better than Yan Liang and Wen Chou."

pmwa1ngq2ajwnl.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金

pmwa1ngq2al6i8.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金
pmwa1ngq2al6i8.text: 乾曰：「近聞玄德公在袁紹處，欲往投之，未得其便。
pmwa1ngq2al6i8.gloss: Qian say: recently hear Xuande.Lord at Yuan.Shao place, want go join 3SG, not.yet DE 3SG opportunity.
pmwa1ngq2al6i8.translation: Qian said, "Recently I heard that Lord Xuande is at Yuan Shao's place; I wanted to go and join him, but have not yet had the opportunity."

pmwa1ngq2amol2.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金
pmwa1ngq2amol2.text: 又幸得將軍到此，因特令小軍引路，教某為細作，來報將軍。
pmwa1ngq2amol2.gloss: moreover fortunate DE general arrive here, therefore specially order minor.troops guide.way, tell me act.as spy, come report general.
pmwa1ngq2amol2.translation: Moreover, fortunately the General has arrived here, so (they) specially ordered minor troops to lead the way and told me to act as a spy and come report to the General.

pmwa1ngq2anpkn.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金

pmwa1ngq2anpkn.translation: Yunchang captured the prefectures and counties, and once the people had been pacified, he withdrew his troops and returned to Xuchang.

pmwa1ngq2aob52.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金

pmwa1ngq2aob52.gloss: just weep interval, have one accompany old.soldier, hear DE weep NEG cease, at door.outside announce say: lady stop weep.
pmwa1ngq2aob52.translation: Just as (she) was weeping, one of the old soldiers in the escort heard the weeping continue without cease and said from outside the door, 'Madam, do not weep.'
pmwa1ngq2aob52.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|正哭間，有一隨行老軍，聽得哭不絕，於門外告曰：「夫人休哭。#1

pmwa1ngq2apluh.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金
pmwa1ngq2apluh.text: 關公曰：「故主雖在，未得一見，何喜之有？」

pmwa1ngq2apluh.translation: Lord Guan said: "Though my former lord is alive, I have not yet been able to see him once; what is there to rejoice about?"

pmwa1ngq2aq0vb.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金
pmwa1ngq2aq0vb.translation: Chen Zhen received the letter and returned on his own.
pmwa1ngq2aq0vb.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|陳震得書自回。#1

pmwa1ngq2ard68.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金
pmwa1ngq2ard68.text: 關公一連去了數次，皆不得見；乃往張遼家相探，欲言其事，遼亦託疾不出。
pmwa1ngq2ard68.gloss: Lord.Guan in.succession go PFV several.times, all NEG DE see; then go.to Zhang.Liao home visit, want speak that matter, Liao also plead.illness NEG come.out.
pmwa1ngq2ard68.translation: Lord Guan went several times in succession, but each time could not get to see (Cao Cao); then he went to Zhang Liao's house to visit (him), intending to speak of the matter, but Zhang Liao too pleaded illness and did not come out.

pmwa1ngq2asrdz.section: 第二十六回　　　袁本初敗兵折將　　　關雲長掛印封金
pmwa1ngq2asrdz.text: 關公既出門，謂從者曰：「汝等護立車仗先行，但有追趕者，吾自當之，勿得驚動二位夫人。」
pmwa1ngq2asrdz.gloss: Guan.Gong after leave gate, say follower say: 2PL guard.keep carriage.convoy go.first, if have pursue-NMLZ, 1SG self handle 3SG.OBJ, PROH DE alarm two CLF lady.
pmwa1ngq2asrdz.translation: After Lord Guan had gone out the gate, he said to his followers: “You escort the carriages and go on ahead. If anyone pursues us, I myself will deal with him. Do not alarm the two ladies.”

pmwa1ngq2atvbk.section: 第二十七回　　　美髯公千里走單騎　　漢壽侯五關斬六將
pmwa1ngq2atvbk.text: 累次造府，不得參見，故拜書告辭，封金挂印，納還丞相。

pmwa1ngq2atvbk.translation: I repeatedly called at your residence but could not get an audience, so I respectfully wrote a letter to take my leave, sealed up the gold and hung up the seal, and returned them to the Chancellor.

pmwa1ngq2aupn5.section: 第二十七回　　　美髯公千里走單騎　　漢壽侯五關斬六將
pmwa1ngq2aupn5.text: 操笑曰：「雲長天下義士，恨吾福薄，不得相留。

pmwa1ngq2aupn5.translation: Cao laughed and said, 'Yunchang is a righteous man of the world; I regret that my fortune is thin, and (I) cannot keep you.'
pmwa1ngq2aupn5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操笑曰：「雲長天下義士，恨吾福薄，不得相留。#1

pmwa1ngq2avikl.section: 第二十七回　　　美髯公千里走單騎　　漢壽侯五關斬六將
pmwa1ngq2avikl.text: 雲長恐有他變，不敢下馬，用青龍刀尖挑錦袍披於身上，勒馬回頭稱謝曰：「蒙丞相賜袍，異日更得相會。」

pmwa1ngq2avikl.translation: Yunchang feared there might be some other trick, and did not dare dismount; he used the tip of his Green Dragon blade to lift the brocade robe and drape it over his body, then reined in his horse, turned his head, and expressed his thanks, saying: 'Having received a robe bestowed by the Chancellor, on another day I shall get to meet (you) again.'
pmwa1ngq2avikl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雲長恐有他變，不敢下馬，用青龍刀尖挑錦袍披於身上，勒馬回頭稱謝曰：「蒙丞相賜袍，異日更得相會。」#1

pmwa1ngq2awapw.section: 第二十七回　　　美髯公千里走單騎　　漢壽侯五關斬六將

pmwa1ngq2awapw.translation: Cao (Cao Cao) said, "He is one man on a single horse, while we are several dozen men — how could he not be suspicious?"

pmwa1ngq2axkpt.section: 第二十七回　　　美髯公千里走單騎　　漢壽侯五關斬六將

pmwa1ngq4cjxsi.translation: Cao Cao won a complete victory, and distributed the gold, treasures, satins and cloths he had obtained as rewards to the soldiers.

pmwa1ngq4ckfhg.text: 吾若早得足下，天下不足慮也。」
pmwa1ngq4ckfhg.gloss: 1SG if early DE 2SG.HON, world NEG sufficient worry SFP.
pmwa1ngq4ckfhg.translation: If I had obtained you earlier, the realm would give no cause for worry.

pmwa1ngq4cl4nh.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cl4nh.text: 紹所生三子，長子袁譚字顯忠，出守青州；次子袁熙字顯奕，出守幽州；三子袁尚字顯甫，是紹後妻劉氏所出，生得形貌俊偉，紹甚愛之，因此留在身邊。
pmwa1ngq4cl4nh.gloss: Shao NMLZ bear three son, eldest.son Yuan.Tan courtesy.name Xianzhong, go.out guard Qingzhou; second.son Yuan.Xi courtesy.name Xianyi, go.out guard Youzhou; third.son Yuan.Shang courtesy.name Xianfu, COP Shao second.wife Liu clan NMLZ bear, born DE appearance handsome.grand, Shao very love 3SG.OBJ, therefore keep at side.
pmwa1ngq4cl4nh.translation: Shao had three sons born to him: the eldest, Yuan Tan, courtesy name Xianzhong, was posted out to guard Qingzhou; the second, Yuan Xi, courtesy name Xianyi, was posted out to guard Youzhou; the third, Yuan Shang, courtesy name Xianfu, was born of Shao's second wife, Lady Liu, and was born with a handsome, imposing appearance, so Shao loved him greatly and for that reason kept him at his side.
pmwa1ngq4cl4nh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|紹所生三子，長子袁譚字顯忠，出守青州；次子袁熙字顯奕，出守幽州；三子袁尚字顯甫，是紹後妻劉氏所出，生得形貌俊偉，紹甚愛之，因此留在身邊。#1

pmwa1ngq4cm7ow.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cm7ow.text: 時操引得勝之兵，陳列於河上，有土人簞食壺漿以迎之。
pmwa1ngq4cm7ow.gloss: time Cao lead DE victory ATTR troops, array at river on, have local.people basket.food pot.drink CONJ welcome OBJ
pmwa1ngq4cm7ow.translation: At that time Cao (Cao Cao) led his victorious troops and drew them up in ranks on the riverbank; there were local people (bringing) baskets of food and pots of drink to welcome them.
pmwa1ngq4cm7ow.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|時操引得勝之兵，陳列於河上，有土人簞食壺漿以迎之。#1

pmwa1ngq4cn3mi.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cn3mi.text: 人報袁紹聚四州之兵，得二三十萬，前至倉亭下寨。
pmwa1ngq4cn3mi.gloss: person report Yuan.Shao gather four province GEN troop , DE twenty.thirty ten.thousand , advance arrive Cangting pitch.camp .
pmwa1ngq4cn3mi.translation: Someone reported that Yuan Shao had gathered the troops of the four provinces, amounting to two or three hundred thousand, and had advanced to Cangting to pitch camp.
pmwa1ngq4cn3mi.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|人報袁紹聚四州之兵，得二三十萬，前至倉亭下寨。#1

pmwa1ngq4copgr.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4copgr.text: 袁紹見子得勝，揮鞭一指，大隊人馬，擁將過來混戰。
pmwa1ngq4copgr.gloss: Yuan.Shao see son DE victory, wave whip one point, great troop men.horse, surge P come.over melee.
pmwa1ngq4copgr.translation: Yuan Shao saw his son gain victory, waved his whip and pointed, and the great army surged over and joined the melee.
pmwa1ngq4copgr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|袁紹見子得勝，揮鞭一指，大隊人馬，擁將過來混戰。#1

pmwa1ngq4cplg1.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cplg1.text: 又行不到十里，左邊樂進、右邊于禁殺出，殺得袁軍屍橫遍野，血流成渠。
pmwa1ngq4cplg1.gloss: again go NEG reach ten li, left.side Yue.Jin, right.side Yu.Jin charge.out, kill DE Yuan.army corpse lie.across all.fields, blood flow become channel.
pmwa1ngq4cplg1.translation: Before they had gone another ten li, Yue Jin on the left and Yu Jin on the right charged out, cutting down the Yuan army so that corpses lay across the fields and blood flowed in channels.
pmwa1ngq4cplg1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|又行不到十里，左邊樂進、右邊于禁殺出，殺得袁軍屍橫遍野，血流成渠。#1

pmwa1ngq4cqon4.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cqon4.translation: He fought with all his strength to break through and managed to escape the tight encirclement.
pmwa1ngq4cqon4.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|奮力衝突，得脫重圍。#1

pmwa1ngq4cr14d.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cr14d.text: 正議間，忽荀彧有書到，報說：「劉備在汝南得劉辟、龔都數萬之眾。
pmwa1ngq4cr14d.gloss: just discuss while, suddenly Xun.Yu have letter arrive, report say: Liu.Bei at Runan DE Liu.Pi, Gong.Du several ten.thousand GEN troops.
pmwa1ngq4cr14d.translation: Just as they were deliberating, a letter from Xun Yu suddenly arrived, reporting: 'Liu Bei in Runan has gained Liu Pi, Gong Du, and tens of thousands of troops.
pmwa1ngq4cr14d.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|正議間，忽荀彧有書到，報說：「劉備在汝南得劉辟、龔都數萬之眾。#1

pmwa1ngq4cs2i9.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cs2i9.translation: Xuande won the victory and returned to camp.
pmwa1ngq4cs2i9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德得勝回營。#1

pmwa1ngq4cthe7.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cthe7.text: 聽得背後喊聲漸遠，玄德望深山僻路，單馬逃生。
pmwa1ngq4cthe7.gloss: hear DE behind shout.sound gradually far, Xuande toward deep.mountain remote.path, single.horse escape.life
pmwa1ngq4cthe7.translation: Hearing the shouts behind gradually grow distant, Xuande headed toward the deep mountains and remote paths, fleeing alone on horseback.
pmwa1ngq4cthe7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|聽得背後喊聲漸遠，玄德望深山僻路，單馬逃生。#1

pmwa1ngq4cujbn.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cujbn.text: 曹兵趕來，幸得雲長當住，因此得脫。」
pmwa1ngq4cujbn.gloss: Cao.soldiers chase.come, fortunate DE Yunzhang block.hold, therefore DE escape.
pmwa1ngq4cujbn.translation: The Cao soldiers came in pursuit; fortunately Yunzhang (Guan Yu) held them off, and so (we) escaped.
pmwa1ngq4cujbn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹兵趕來，幸得雲長當住，因此得脫。」#1

pmwa1ngq4cvma4.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cvma4.text: 曹兵趕來，幸得雲長當住，因此得脫。」
pmwa1ngq4cvma4.gloss: Cao.soldiers chase.come, fortunate DE Yunzhang block.hold, therefore DE escape.
pmwa1ngq4cvma4.translation: The Cao soldiers came in pursuit; fortunately Yunzhang (Guan Yu) held them off, and so (we) escaped.

pmwa1ngq4cwz19.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cwz19.text: 雲乘勢衝殺，卻被郃兵守住山隘，路窄不得出。
pmwa1ngq4cwz19.gloss: Zhao.Yun seize.momentum charge.and.kill, but PASS He.troops guard.hold mountain.pass, road.narrow NEG DE exit.
pmwa1ngq4cwz19.translation: Zhao Yun seized the momentum to charge and kill, but the mountain pass was held by Zhang He's troops; the road was narrow, and (he) could not get out.
pmwa1ngq4cwz19.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雲乘勢衝殺，卻被郃兵守住山隘，路窄不得出。#1

pmwa1ngq4cxfwu.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cxfwu.gloss: long.time want meet, CONJ NEG can DE
pmwa1ngq4cxfwu.translation: I have long wished to meet him, but have not been able to.
pmwa1ngq4cxfwu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|久欲相會，而不可得。#1

pmwa1ngq4cylpo.section: 第三十一回　　　曹操倉亭破本初　　　玄德荊州依劉表
pmwa1ngq4cylpo.gloss: previously follow, NEG DE stop SFP
pmwa1ngq4cylpo.translation: His following (them) previously was because he had no choice.
pmwa1ngq4cylpo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|前此相從，不得已也。#1

pmwa1ngq4czdp3.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq4czdp3.text: 尚曰：「吾亦欲仗此二人早晚畫策，如何離得？」
pmwa1ngq4czdp3.gloss: Shang say: 1SG also want rely.on PROX two person morning.evening devise.plan, how leave DE?
pmwa1ngq4czdp3.translation: Shang said, "I too want to rely on these two men to devise plans morning and evening; how can I leave (them)?"
pmwa1ngq4czdp3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|尚曰：「吾亦欲仗此二人早晚畫策，如何離得？」#1

pmwa1ngq4d0x91.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq4d0x91.text: 尚不得已，乃令二人拈鬮，拈著者便去。
pmwa1ngq4d0x91.gloss: Shang NEG DE stop, then order two man draw.lots, draw.get NMLZ then go
pmwa1ngq4d0x91.translation: Shang had no choice, so he ordered the two men to draw lots; whoever drew (the lot) would go.
pmwa1ngq4d0x91.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|尚不得已，乃令二人拈鬮，拈著者便去。#1

pmwa1ngq4d1w18.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq4d1w18.text: 今與他人爭鬥，自斷其手，而曰我必勝，安可得乎？
pmwa1ngq4d1w18.gloss: now with other.people fight, self cut.off 3SG hand, CONJ say 1SG certainly win, how can DE Q?
pmwa1ngq4d1w18.translation: Now, fighting with others and cutting off one's own hand, and then saying 'I will surely win'—how can that be achieved?
pmwa1ngq4d1w18.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今與他人爭鬥，自斷其手，而曰我必勝，安可得乎？#1

pmwa1ngq4d2uui.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq4d2uui.text: 程昱曰：「袁譚被袁尚攻擊太急，不得已而來降，不可准信。」
pmwa1ngq4d2uui.gloss: Cheng.Yu say: Yuan.Tan PASS Yuan.Shang attack too urgent, NEG DE stop CONJ come surrender, NEG can trust.
pmwa1ngq4d2uui.translation: Cheng Yu said, "Yuan Tan has been attacked by Yuan Shang too fiercely and has no choice but to come surrender; (it) cannot be trusted."
pmwa1ngq4d2uui.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|程昱曰：「袁譚被袁尚攻擊太急，不得已而來降，不可准信。」#1

pmwa1ngq4d35dj.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq4d35dj.text: 操曰：「吾今番必得冀州矣。」
pmwa1ngq4d35dj.gloss: Cao say: 1SG this.time certainly DE Jizhou SFP
pmwa1ngq4d35dj.translation: Cao said, "This time I will certainly obtain Jizhou."
pmwa1ngq4d35dj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操曰：「吾今番必得冀州矣。」#1

pmwa1ngq4d474c.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq4d474c.text: 審配認得是李孚聲音，於入城中，說：「袁尚已陳兵在陽平亭，等候接應；若城中兵出，亦舉火為號。」
pmwa1ngq4d474c.gloss: Shen.Pei recognize-DE COP Li.Fu voice, then enter city inside, say: Yuan.Shang already deploy.troops at Yangping.Pavilion, wait.for support; if city inside soldiers come.out, also raise.fire as signal.
pmwa1ngq4d474c.translation: Shen Pei recognized that it was Li Fu's voice, then entered the city and said: 'Yuan Shang has already deployed troops at Yangping Pavilion and is waiting to support (us); if the troops in the city come out, also light a fire as a signal.'
pmwa1ngq4d474c.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|審配認得是李孚聲音，於入城中，說：「袁尚已陳兵在陽平亭，等候接應；若城中兵出，亦舉火為號。」#1

pmwa1ngq4d5cjg.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq4d5cjg.text: 操教將紅旗一招，張遼、徐晃兩路兵齊出亂殺，城中兵只得復回。
pmwa1ngq4d5cjg.gloss: Cao.Cao order take red.flag one wave, Zhang.Liao, Xu.Huang two route soldier together come.out indiscriminately.kill, city inside soldier only DE return.back.
pmwa1ngq4d5cjg.translation: Cao Cao ordered (them) to wave the red flag once; the two armies under Zhang Liao and Xu Huang came out together and slaughtered indiscriminately, and the soldiers in the city had no choice but to fall back.
pmwa1ngq4d5cjg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操教將紅旗一招，張遼、徐晃兩路兵齊出亂殺，城中兵只得復回。#1

pmwa1ngq5d63n1.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq5d63n1.text: 尚軍大潰，退走五十里，勢窮力極，只得遣豫州刺史陰夔至操營請降。
pmwa1ngq5d63n1.gloss: Yuan.Shang army greatly rout, retreat flee fifty li, situation exhausted strength extreme, only DE send Yu.Province inspector Yin.Kui to Cao.Cao camp request.surrender.
pmwa1ngq5d63n1.translation: Yuan Shang's army was utterly routed and retreated fifty li; with its situation desperate and its strength exhausted, he had no choice but to send Yin Kui, Inspector of Yu Province, to Cao Cao's camp to ask for surrender.
pmwa1ngq5d63n1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|尚軍大潰，退走五十里，勢窮力極，只得遣豫州刺史陰夔至操營請降。#1

pmwa1ngq5d7ayi.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq5d7ayi.text: 審配在城上見操軍在城外掘塹，卻掘得甚淺。
pmwa1ngq5d7ayi.gloss: Shen.Pei at city.top see Cao.Cao.army at city.outside dig trench, yet dig DE very shallow.
pmwa1ngq5d7ayi.translation: Shen Pei, on the city wall, saw Cao Cao's army outside the city digging a trench, but (they) were digging it very shallow.
pmwa1ngq5d7ayi.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|審配在城上見操軍在城外掘塹，卻掘得甚淺。#1

pmwa1ngq5d8p03.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq5d8p03.text: 操先下令：如入冀州，休得殺害袁氏一門老小；軍民降者免死。
pmwa1ngq5d8p03.gloss: Cao first issue.order: if enter Jizhou, PROH DE kill Yuan.clan one.household old.and.young; soldiers.and.civilians surrender-NMLZ exempt.death.
pmwa1ngq5d8p03.translation: Cao first issued an order: if (we) enter Jizhou, do not kill the old and young of the entire Yuan household; soldiers and civilians who surrender are spared death.
pmwa1ngq5d8p03.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操先下令：如入冀州，休得殺害袁氏一門老小；軍民降者免死。#1

pmwa1ngq5d9su7.section: 第三十二回　　　奪冀州袁尚爭鋒　　　決漳河許攸獻計
pmwa1ngq5d9su7.text: 琳答曰：「箭在弦上，不得不發耳。」

pmwa1ngq5d9su7.translation: Lin answered: "The arrow is on the bowstring; it cannot but be released."

pmwa1ngq5dkkv4.text: 時天氣寒且旱，二百里無水，軍又乏糧，殺馬為食；鑿地三四丈，方得水。

pmwa1ngq5dkkv4.translation: At that time the weather was cold and dry; for two hundred li there was no water, and the army was also short of provisions, so they killed horses for food; after digging the ground three or four zhang, they finally got water.

pmwa1ngq5dlayv.gloss: although DE victory, heaven NMLZ bless SFP, NEG can use as rule.

pmwa1ngq5dpife.section: 第三十四回　　　蔡夫人隔屏聽密語　　劉皇叔躍馬過檀溪

pmwa1ngq5dpife.translation: Cao Cao led the troops of Yuan Shao that he had taken, five or six hundred thousand in all, withdrew his army and returned to Xu capital, and greatly enfeoffed the meritorious officials; he also sent up a memorial to confer on Guo Jia (the title of) Marquis Zhen, and kept his son Yi in his own mansion.

pmwa1ngq5dqrwy.text: 表曰：「吾有心事，前者欲訴與賢弟，未得其便。」

pmwa1ngq5drazp.section: 第三十四回　　　蔡夫人隔屏聽密語　　劉皇叔躍馬過檀溪
pmwa1ngq5drazp.text: 蔡夫人曰：「適間我於屏後聽得劉備之言，甚輕覷人，足見其有吞併荊州之意。
pmwa1ngq5drazp.gloss: Lady.Cai say: just.now 1SG at screen behind hear DE Liu.Bei GEN words, very look.down.on people, enough.see 3SG have annex Jingzhou GEN intention.
pmwa1ngq5drazp.translation: Lady Cai said: "Just now I heard Liu Bei's words from behind the screen; he greatly looks down on others, which is enough to show that he has the intention of annexing Jingzhou."

pmwa1ngq5ds9je.section: 第三十四回　　　蔡夫人隔屏聽密語　　劉皇叔躍馬過檀溪
pmwa1ngq5ds9je.text: 蔡瑁在外收拾得鐵桶相似，將玄德帶來三百軍，都遣歸館舍，只待半酣，號起下手。

pmwa1ngq5ds9je.translation: Cai Mao had things arranged outside as tight as an iron barrel; he sent all three hundred soldiers Xuande had brought back to the guest quarters, only waiting for (them) to be half drunk, to give the signal and make their move.
pmwa1ngq5ds9je.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|蔡瑁在外收拾得鐵桶相似，將玄德帶來三百軍，都遣歸館舍，只待半酣，號起下手。#1

pmwa1ngq5dtpfo.section: 第三十五回　　　玄德南漳逢隱淪　　　單福新野遇英主
pmwa1ngq5dtpfo.text: 雲大驚，出投館舍，聽得人說：「蔡瑁引軍望西趕去了。」
pmwa1ngq5dtpfo.gloss: Yun great alarmed, exit head.for guest.house, hear DE person say: Cai.Mao lead army toward west chase go PFV
pmwa1ngq5dtpfo.translation: Yun was greatly alarmed; he went out and made for the guest house, where he heard people say: "Cai Mao has led his troops westward in pursuit."
pmwa1ngq5dtpfo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雲大驚，出投館舍，聽得人說：「蔡瑁引軍望西趕去了。」#1

pmwa1ngq5duh32.section: 第三十五回　　　玄德南漳逢隱淪　　　單福新野遇英主
pmwa1ngq5duh32.text: 玄德曰：「偶爾經由此地，因小童相指，得拜尊顏，不勝欣幸。」
pmwa1ngq5duh32.gloss: Xuande say: by.chance pass.through DEM place, because young.boy point.out, DE pay.respects.to honored.face, not.bear joy.fortunate
pmwa1ngq5duh32.translation: Xuande said: "By chance I was passing through this place, and because a young boy pointed the way, I got to pay my respects to your honored face; I am overwhelmed with joy and feel most fortunate."
pmwa1ngq5duh32.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德曰：「偶爾經由此地，因小童相指，得拜尊顏，不勝欣幸。」#1

pmwa1ngq5dwy0d.section: 第三十五回　　　玄德南漳逢隱淪　　　單福新野遇英主

pmwa1ngq5dxu19.section: 第三十五回　　　玄德南漳逢隱淪　　　單福新野遇英主
pmwa1ngq5dxu19.text: 孫乾呈上書札，具言蔡瑁設謀相害，賴躍馬檀溪得脫。

pmwa1ngq5dxu19.translation: Sun Qian presented the letter and stated in full that Cai Mao had devised a plot to harm (him), and that (he) had escaped thanks to (his) horse leaping over the Tan Creek.

pmwa1ngq5dylgx.section: 第三十五回　　　玄德南漳逢隱淪　　　單福新野遇英主
pmwa1ngq5dylgx.text: 典不得已，只得與曹仁點起二萬五千軍馬，渡河投新野而來。

pmwa1ngq6er7es.section: 第三十七回　　　司馬徽再薦名士　　　劉玄德三顧草廬
pmwa1ngq6er7es.text: 豈不聞『順天者逸，逆天者勞』；『數之所在，理不得而奪之；命之所在，人不得而強之』乎？」
pmwa1ngq6er7es.gloss: Q NEG hear follow heaven person at.ease, defy heaven person toil; fate GEN NMLZ be.at, reason NEG DE CONJ seize 3SG.OBJ; destiny GEN NMLZ be.at, person NEG DE CONJ force 3SG.OBJ Q?
pmwa1ngq6er7es.translation: Have you not heard: 'Those who follow Heaven are at ease; those who defy Heaven toil'; 'Where fate lies, reason cannot wrest it away; where destiny lies, man cannot force it'?
pmwa1ngq6er7es.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|豈不聞『順天者逸，逆天者勞』；『數之所在，理不得而奪之；命之所在，人不得而強之』乎？」#1

pmwa1ngq6etlbx.text: 玄德喜曰：「備久聞二公大名，幸得邂逅。
pmwa1ngq6etlbx.gloss: Xuande delighted say: Bei long hear two gentleman great.name, fortunate DE meet.by.chance.
pmwa1ngq6etlbx.translation: Xuande was delighted and said, "I have long heard of the great names of you two gentlemen, and am fortunate to meet you by chance."

pmwa1ngq6euozx.section: 第三十七回　　　司馬徽再薦名士　　　劉玄德三顧草廬
pmwa1ngq6euozx.text: 今特冒風雪而來，得瞻道貌，實為萬幸！」

pmwa1ngq6evkc9.section: 第三十七回　　　司馬徽再薦名士　　　劉玄德三顧草廬
pmwa1ngq6evkc9.text: 因問諸葛均曰：「聞令兄臥龍先生熟諳韜略，日看兵書，可得聞乎？」
pmwa1ngq6evkc9.gloss: thereupon ask Zhuge.Jun say: hear your.elder.brother Wolong.Master thoroughly.know military.strategy, daily read military.book, can DE hear Q?
pmwa1ngq6evkc9.translation: Thereupon he asked Zhuge Jun: 'I have heard that your elder brother, Master Wolong, is thoroughly versed in military strategy and reads military books daily; may I hear (about it)?'
pmwa1ngq6evkc9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|因問諸葛均曰：「聞令兄臥龍先生熟諳韜略，日看兵書，可得聞乎？」#1

pmwa1ngq6ewgat.section: 第三十七回　　　司馬徽再薦名士　　　劉玄德三顧草廬
pmwa1ngq6ewgat.text: 承彥曰：「老夫在小婿家觀《梁父吟》，記得這一篇；適過小橋，偶見籬落間梅花，故感而誦之。
pmwa1ngq6ewgat.gloss: Cheng.Yan say: old.man at son.in.law house read Liangfu.Yin, remember DE PROX one CLF; just.now cross small.bridge, by.chance see hedge among plum.blossom, therefore moved CONJ recite 3SG
pmwa1ngq6ewgat.translation: Chengyan said: 'I was at my son-in-law's house reading the Liangfu Yin, and I remember this piece; just now I crossed the little bridge and happened to see plum blossoms among the hedges, so I was moved and recited it.'
pmwa1ngq6ewgat.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|承彥曰：「老夫在小婿家觀《梁父吟》，記得這一篇；適過小橋，偶見籬落間梅花，故感而誦之。#1

pmwa1ngq6ex6xb.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq6ex6xb.text: 昔齊桓公欲見東郭野人，五反而方得一面。
pmwa1ngq6ex6xb.gloss: formerly Duke.Huan.of.Qi want see Dongguo rustic, five return CONJ only.then DE one meeting.
pmwa1ngq6ex6xb.translation: Formerly, Duke Huan of Qi wished to see a rustic of Dongguo, and only after turning back five times did he get one meeting.
pmwa1ngq6ex6xb.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|昔齊桓公欲見東郭野人，五反而方得一面。#1

pmwa1ngq6eyfos.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq6eyfos.text: 玄德曰：「今番僥倖，得見先生矣！」
pmwa1ngq6eyfos.gloss: Xuan.De say: this.time fortunate, DE see master SFP!
pmwa1ngq6eyfos.translation: Xuande said, "This time I am fortunate; I get to see the master!"
pmwa1ngq6eyfos.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德曰：「今番僥倖，得見先生矣！」#1

pmwa1ngq6ezkgr.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq6ezkgr.text: 昨兩次晉謁，不得一見，已書賤名於文几，未審得入覽否？」
pmwa1ngq6ezkgr.gloss: yesterday two CLF pay.respects, NEG DE one see, already write humble.name at writing.desk, not.sure DE enter.view Q?
pmwa1ngq6ezkgr.translation: Yesterday I paid my respects twice and could not get a single meeting; I have already written my humble name on the writing desk—I am not sure whether it has come into your view?
pmwa1ngq6ezkgr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|昨兩次晉謁，不得一見，已書賤名於文几，未審得入覽否？」#1

pmwa1ngq6f08zl.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq6f08zl.text: 昨兩次晉謁，不得一見，已書賤名於文几，未審得入覽否？」
pmwa1ngq6f08zl.gloss: yesterday two CLF pay.respects, NEG DE one see, already write humble.name at writing.desk, not.sure DE enter.view Q?
pmwa1ngq6f08zl.translation: Yesterday I paid my respects twice and could not get a single meeting; I have already written my humble name on the writing desk—I am not sure whether it has come into your view?

pmwa1ngq6f1i1j.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq6f1i1j.text: 今劉璋闇弱，民殷國富，而不知存恤，智能之士，思得明君。
pmwa1ngq6f1i1j.gloss: now Liu.Zhang ignorant.weak, people prosperous state rich, CONJ not.know care.for.relieve, wisdom.and.ability LNK men, long.for DE enlightened.lord.
pmwa1ngq6f1i1j.translation: Now Liu Zhang is ignorant and weak; the people are prosperous and the state is rich, yet he does not know how to care for and relieve (the people); men of wisdom and ability long to find an enlightened lord.
pmwa1ngq6f1i1j.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今劉璋闇弱，民殷國富，而不知存恤，智能之士，思得明君。#1

pmwa1ngq6f249g.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq6f249g.text: 汝可躬耕於此，勿得荒蕪田畝。
pmwa1ngq6f249g.gloss: 2SG can personally.cultivate at PROX, PROH DE let.become.overgrown field
pmwa1ngq6f249g.translation: You may farm here in person; do not let the fields become overgrown.
pmwa1ngq6f249g.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|汝可躬耕於此，勿得荒蕪田畝。#1

pmwa1ngq6f39gl.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq6f39gl.text: 曹操專權得天時，江東孫氏開鴻業。
pmwa1ngq6f39gl.gloss: Cao.Cao monopolize power DE Heaven time, Jiangdong Sun clan open great enterprise.
pmwa1ngq6f39gl.translation: Cao Cao monopolised power and gained Heaven's favouring timing; the Sun clan of Jiangdong laid the foundations of a great enterprise.
pmwa1ngq6f39gl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操專權得天時，江東孫氏開鴻業。#1

pmwa1ngq6f4ik9.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq6f4ik9.text: 又得良將數人，乃汝陽呂蒙，字子明；吳郡陸遜，字伯言；瑯琊徐盛，字文嚮；東郡潘璋，字文珪；廬江丁奉，字承淵。
pmwa1ngq6f4ik9.gloss: also DE good general several CLF, COP Ruyang.Lü.Meng, courtesy.name Zi.Ming; Wu.commandery Lu.Xun, courtesy.name Bo.Yan; Langya Xu.Sheng, courtesy.name Wen.Xiang; Dong.commandery Pan.Zhang, courtesy.name Wen.Gui; Lujiang Ding.Feng, courtesy.name Cheng.Yuan.
pmwa1ngq6f4ik9.translation: He also obtained several good generals, namely Lü Meng of Ruyang, courtesy name Ziming; Lu Xun of Wu commandery, courtesy name Boyan; Xu Sheng of Langya, courtesy name Wenxiang; Pan Zhang of Dong commandery, courtesy name Wengui; and Ding Feng of Lujiang, courtesy name Chengyuan.
pmwa1ngq6f4ik9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|又得良將數人，乃汝陽呂蒙，字子明；吳郡陸遜，字伯言；瑯琊徐盛，字文嚮；東郡潘璋，字文珪；廬江丁奉，字承淵。#1

pmwa1ngq6f5nm1.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq6f5nm1.gloss: from.this Jiangdong repute DE people GEN flourishing
pmwa1ngq6f5nm1.translation: Hence Jiangdong was reputed for its abundance of talented people.
pmwa1ngq6f5nm1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|由此江東稱得人之盛。#1

pmwa1ngq6f6v17.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq6f6v17.text: 質一入，不得不與曹氏連和；彼有命召，不得不往；如此則見制於人也。
pmwa1ngq6f6v17.gloss: hostage once enter, NEG DE NEG with Cao.clan make.peace; that.side have order summon, NEG DE NEG go; like.this then PASS control by person SFP.
pmwa1ngq6f6v17.translation: Once the hostage enters, (we) cannot but make peace with the Cao clan; if that side has an order summoning (us), (we) cannot but go; if so, then (we) will be controlled by others.
pmwa1ngq6f6v17.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|質一入，不得不與曹氏連和；彼有命召，不得不往；如此則見制於人也。#1

pmwa1ngq7f8gxu.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq7f8gxu.text: 「前東吳破祖時，祖得甘寧之力，救回夏口；乃待寧甚薄。
pmwa1ngq7f8gxu.gloss: before Eastern.Wu defeat Zu time, Zu DE Gan.Ning GEN strength, rescue back Xiakou; yet treat Ning very poorly.
pmwa1ngq7f8gxu.translation: Previously, when Eastern Wu defeated Zu, Zu had Gan Ning's strength and was rescued back to Xiakou; yet he treated Ning very poorly.
pmwa1ngq7f8gxu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|「前東吳破祖時，祖得甘寧之力，救回夏口；乃待寧甚薄。#1

pmwa1ngq7f9tbz.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq7f9tbz.text: 寧因此得過夏口，欲投江東，恐江東恨其救黃祖殺凌操之事。
pmwa1ngq7f9tbz.gloss: Ning therefore DE pass Xiakou, want defect Jiangdong, fear Jiangdong hate 3SG save Huang.Zu kill Ling.Cao GEN matter.
pmwa1ngq7f9tbz.translation: Because of this, Ning managed to get past Xiakou; he wanted to go over to Jiangdong, but feared that Jiangdong resented him for saving Huang Zu and killing Ling Cao.
pmwa1ngq7f9tbz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|寧因此得過夏口，欲投江東，恐江東恨其救黃祖殺凌操之事。#1

pmwa1ngq7fatqw.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq7fatqw.text: 孫權大喜曰：「吾得興霸，破黃祖必矣。」
pmwa1ngq7fatqw.gloss: Sun.Quan great joy say: 1SG DE Xingba, defeat Huang.Zu certain SFP
pmwa1ngq7fatqw.translation: Sun Quan was overjoyed and said, "Now that I have Xingba, defeating Huang Zu is certain."
pmwa1ngq7fatqw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孫權大喜曰：「吾得興霸，破黃祖必矣。」#1

pmwa1ngq7fbmtu.section: 第三十八回　　　定三分隆中決策　　　戰長江孫氏報讎
pmwa1ngq7fbmtu.text: 甘寧謂董襲曰：「事已至此，不得不進。」
pmwa1ngq7fbmtu.gloss: Gan.Ning say.to Dong.Xi say: matter already reach this, NEG DE NEG advance.
pmwa1ngq7fbmtu.translation: Gan Ning said to Dong Xi: "The matter has already come to this; (we) cannot but advance."
pmwa1ngq7fbmtu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|甘寧謂董襲曰：「事已至此，不得不進。」#1

pmwa1ngq7fc5y8.section: 第三十九回　　　荊州城公子三求計　　博望坡軍師初用兵
pmwa1ngq7fc5y8.text: 甘寧料得黃祖必走荊州，乃於東門外伏兵等候。
pmwa1ngq7fc5y8.gloss: Gan.Ning anticipate DE Huang.Zu must flee Jingzhou, then at east.gate outside ambush.troops wait.
pmwa1ngq7fc5y8.translation: Gan Ning anticipated that Huang Zu would certainly flee to Jingzhou, so he lay troops in ambush outside the east gate and waited.
pmwa1ngq7fc5y8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|甘寧料得黃祖必走荊州，乃於東門外伏兵等候。#1

pmwa1ngq7fdooa.section: 第三十九回　　　荊州城公子三求計　　博望坡軍師初用兵
pmwa1ngq7fdooa.text: 甘寧衝開士卒，直趕將來，只聽得後面喊聲起處，又有數騎趕來。
pmwa1ngq7fdooa.gloss: Gan.Ning break.through soldier, straight chase come, only hear DE behind shout.sound rise place, again have several rider chase come.
pmwa1ngq7fdooa.translation: Gan Ning broke through the soldiers and came straight on in pursuit; he only heard a shout arise behind him, and several riders came chasing up.
pmwa1ngq7fdooa.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|甘寧衝開士卒，直趕將來，只聽得後面喊聲起處，又有數騎趕來。#1

pmwa1ngq7femod.section: 第三十九回　　　荊州城公子三求計　　博望坡軍師初用兵
pmwa1ngq7femod.text: 表敗而後乘勢攻之，荊襄可得也。」
pmwa1ngq7femod.gloss: Biao be.defeated and.then seize.momentum attack 3SG, Jing.Xiang can DE SFP
pmwa1ngq7femod.translation: Once Biao is defeated, we then seize the momentum and attack him; Jing and Xiang can be obtained.
pmwa1ngq7femod.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|表敗而後乘勢攻之，荊襄可得也。」#1

pmwa1ngq7ffn2g.section: 第三十九回　　　荊州城公子三求計　　博望坡軍師初用兵
pmwa1ngq7ffn2g.text: 甘寧乃入見權，頓首哭告曰：「某向日若不得蘇飛，則骨填溝壑矣，安能效命將軍麾下哉？
pmwa1ngq7ffn2g.gloss: Gan.Ning then enter see Quan, kowtow weep tell say: 1SG formerly if NEG DE Su.Fei, then bone fill ditch SFP, how can devote.life general under.command Q?
pmwa1ngq7ffn2g.translation: Gan Ning then went in to see Quan, kowtowed, wept, and said: 'If in the past I had not had Su Fei (to help me), my bones would have filled the ditches; how could I have served under the General's command?'

pmwa1ngq7fvs67.text: 曹仁等方纔脫得火厄，背後一聲喊起，趙雲引軍趕來混戰，敗軍各逃性命，誰肯回身廝殺。

pmwa1ngq7fx2sc.text: 黃昏時分，望見新野火起，至四更，忽聽得下流頭人喊馬嘶，急令軍士一齊掣起布袋，水勢滔天，望下流衝去，曹軍人馬俱溺於水中，死者極多。

pmwa1ngq7fx2sc.translation: At dusk, he saw fire rising at Xinye; by the fourth watch, he suddenly heard people shouting and horses neighing downstream, and urgently ordered the soldiers to pull up the cloth bags together. The water surged to the heavens and rushed downstream; the Cao army’s men and horses all drowned in the water, and there were very many dead.
