pmwa1ngq7g68r6.gloss: just.at critical GEN moment, fortunate DE Zhang.Fei lead army arrive, cut.open one CLF blood.road, rescue Xuande toward east CONJ flee.
pmwa1ngq7g68r6.translation: Just as he was in imminent danger, fortunately Zhang Fei arrived with troops, cut open a bloody path, and rescued Xuande, fleeing eastward.
pmwa1ngq7g68r6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|正在危迫之際，幸得張飛引軍至，殺開一條血路，救玄德望東而走。#1

pmwa1ngq7g75qg.section: 第四十一回　　　劉玄德攜民渡江　　　趙子龍單騎救主
pmwa1ngq7g75qg.gloss: 1SG fight NEG DE, therefore lie at PROX
pmwa1ngq7g75qg.translation: I could not (keep) fighting, so I am lying here.
pmwa1ngq7g75qg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|我爭鬥不得，故臥在此。」#1

pmwa1ngq7g8mdk.section: 第四十一回　　　劉玄德攜民渡江　　　趙子龍單騎救主
pmwa1ngq7g8mdk.text: 導抵敵不住，被雲一槍刺落馬下，向前救了糜竺，奪得馬二匹。
pmwa1ngq7g8mdk.gloss: Dao resist enemy NEG hold, PASS Yun one spear stab fall horse below, go.forward save PFV Mi.Zhu, seize DE two CLF horse.
pmwa1ngq7g8mdk.translation: Chunyu Dao could not hold his own; he was pierced by a single thrust of Yun's (Zhao Yun's) spear and fell from his horse, and (Yun) went forward and rescued Mi Zhu, seizing two horses.
pmwa1ngq7g8mdk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|導抵敵不住，被雲一槍刺落馬下，向前救了糜竺，奪得馬二匹。#1

pmwa1ngq7g9qjd.section: 第四十一回　　　劉玄德攜民渡江　　　趙子龍單騎救主
pmwa1ngq7g9qjd.text: 雲插劍提槍，復殺入重圍；回顧手下從騎，已沒一人，只剩得孤身。
pmwa1ngq7g9qjd.gloss: Yun sheathe sword raise spear, again charge enter heavy.encirclement; look.back subordinate mounted.follower, already not.have one person, only remain DE lone.body
pmwa1ngq7g9qjd.translation: Yun sheathed his sword and raised his spear, then charged back into the thick encirclement; looking back at the mounted followers under his command, there was already no one left—only he himself remained alone.
pmwa1ngq7g9qjd.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雲插劍提槍，復殺入重圍；回顧手下從騎，已沒一人，只剩得孤身。#1

pmwa1ngq7gaj16.section: 第四十一回　　　劉玄德攜民渡江　　　趙子龍單騎救主
pmwa1ngq7gaj16.text: 忽一人指曰：「夫人抱著孩兒，左腿上著了槍，行走不得，只在前面牆缺內坐地。」
pmwa1ngq7gaj16.gloss: suddenly one person point say: lady hold DUR child, left leg on get.hit PFV spear, walk NEG DE, only at front wall.gap inside sit.ground.
pmwa1ngq7gaj16.translation: Suddenly someone pointed and said, 'The lady is holding the child; she has been hit by a spear on her left leg and cannot walk; she is just sitting inside the gap in the wall ahead.'
pmwa1ngq7gaj16.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忽一人指曰：「夫人抱著孩兒，左腿上著了槍，行走不得，只在前面牆缺內坐地。」#1

pmwa1ngq7gbjis.section: 第四十一回　　　劉玄德攜民渡江　　　趙子龍單騎救主
pmwa1ngq7gbjis.text: 夫人曰：「妾得見將軍，阿斗有命矣。
pmwa1ngq7gbjis.gloss: lady say: 1SG.HUM DE see general, A.Dou have life CRS
pmwa1ngq7gbjis.translation: The lady said: "That I have been able to see you, General, means A-Dou's life is saved.
pmwa1ngq7gbjis.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|夫人曰：「妾得見將軍，阿斗有命矣。#1

pmwa1ngq7gc590.section: 第四十一回　　　劉玄德攜民渡江　　　趙子龍單騎救主
pmwa1ngq7gc590.text: 將軍可護持此子，教他得見父面，妾死無恨！」
pmwa1ngq7gc590.gloss: general please protect DEM child, let 3SG DE see father face, 1SG.HUM die not.have regret!
pmwa1ngq7gc590.translation: General, please protect this child and let him get to see his father's face; I will die without regret!
pmwa1ngq7gc590.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|將軍可護持此子，教他得見父面，妾死無恨！」#1

pmwa1ngq7gdcdm.section: 第四十一回　　　劉玄德攜民渡江　　　趙子龍單騎救主
pmwa1ngq7gdcdm.text: 糜夫人曰：「妾身委實難去，休得兩誤。」
pmwa1ngq7gdcdm.gloss: Mi.Lady say: 1SG.HUM truly hard go, PROH DE two err.
pmwa1ngq7gdcdm.translation: Lady Mi said: "I truly cannot go; do not let it go wrong for both of us."
pmwa1ngq7gdcdm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|糜夫人曰：「妾身委實難去，休得兩誤。」#1

pmwa1ngq8geccg.section: 第四十一回　　　劉玄德攜民渡江　　　趙子龍單騎救主
pmwa1ngq8geccg.text: 四十二年真命主，將軍因得顯神威。
pmwa1ngq8geccg.gloss: forty.two year true.destiny.lord, general thereby DE display divine.might.
pmwa1ngq8geccg.translation: The true lord of forty-two years—thereby the general was able to display his divine might.
pmwa1ngq8geccg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|四十二年真命主，將軍因得顯神威。#1

pmwa1ngq8gf9vs.section: 第四十一回　　　劉玄德攜民渡江　　　趙子龍單騎救主
pmwa1ngq8gf9vs.gloss: therefore Zhao.Yun DE escape PROX calamity
pmwa1ngq8gf9vs.translation: Because of this, Zhao Yun was able to escape this peril.
pmwa1ngq8gf9vs.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|因此趙雲得脫此難。#1

pmwa1ngq8ggj6y.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8ggj6y.text: 趙雲得脫，望長阪橋而走。
pmwa1ngq8ggj6y.gloss: Zhao.Yun DE escape, toward Changban.Bridge CONJ go.
pmwa1ngq8ggj6y.translation: Zhao Yun managed to escape and headed toward Changban Bridge.
pmwa1ngq8ggj6y.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|趙雲得脫，望長阪橋而走。#1

pmwa1ngq8ghdxv.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8ghdxv.text: 趙雲到得橋邊，人困馬乏。
pmwa1ngq8ghdxv.gloss: Zhao.Yun arrive DE bridge.side, person weary horse exhausted
pmwa1ngq8ghdxv.translation: Zhao Yun reached the bridge, (he) was weary and (his) horse was exhausted.
pmwa1ngq8ghdxv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|趙雲到得橋邊，人困馬乏。#1

pmwa1ngq8gigry.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gigry.text: 雲只得推土牆掩之；懷抱公子，身突重圍；賴主公洪福，幸而得脫。
pmwa1ngq8gigry.gloss: Yun only DE push earth wall cover 3SG.OBJ; bosom embrace young.master, body break heavy siege; rely lord great fortune, fortunate DE escape.
pmwa1ngq8gigry.translation: Zhao Yun had no choice but to push over the earthen wall to cover her; carrying the young master in his arms, he broke through the heavy encirclement himself; relying on my lord's great fortune, he was fortunate enough to escape.
pmwa1ngq8gigry.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雲只得推土牆掩之；懷抱公子，身突重圍；賴主公洪福，幸而得脫。#1

pmwa1ngq8gjxzt.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gjxzt.text: 雲只得推土牆掩之；懷抱公子，身突重圍；賴主公洪福，幸而得脫。
pmwa1ngq8gjxzt.gloss: Yun only DE push earth wall cover 3SG.OBJ; bosom embrace young.master, body break heavy siege; rely lord great fortune, fortunate DE escape.
pmwa1ngq8gjxzt.translation: Zhao Yun had no choice but to push over the earthen wall to cover her; carrying the young master in his arms, he broke through the heavy encirclement himself; relying on my lord's great fortune, he was fortunate enough to escape.
pmwa1ngq8gjxzt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雲只得推土牆掩之；懷抱公子，身突重圍；賴主公洪福，幸而得脫。#2

pmwa1ngq8gka41.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gka41.gloss: Yun happy say: fortunate DE young.master unharmed!
pmwa1ngq8gka41.translation: Yun said joyfully: "Fortunately the young master is unharmed!"
pmwa1ngq8gka41.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雲喜曰：「幸得公子無恙！」#1

pmwa1ngq8glu0m.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8glu0m.text: 張飛圓睜環眼，隱隱見後軍青羅傘蓋、旄鉞旌旗來到，料得是曹操心疑，親自來看。
pmwa1ngq8glu0m.gloss: Zhang.Fei round.open ring.eyes, faintly see rear.army blue.silk.canopy, banner.halberd.flag arrive, reckon DE COP Cao.Cao suspect, personally come look.
pmwa1ngq8glu0m.translation: Zhang Fei opened his round eyes wide and dimly saw the blue silk canopy and the banners and halberds of the rear army approaching; he guessed that Cao Cao was suspicious and had come in person to look.
pmwa1ngq8glu0m.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張飛圓睜環眼，隱隱見後軍青羅傘蓋、旄鉞旌旗來到，料得是曹操心疑，親自來看。#1

pmwa1ngq8gm3um.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gm3um.text: 喊聲未絕，曹操身邊夏侯傑驚得肝膽碎裂，倒撞於馬下。
pmwa1ngq8gm3um.gloss: shout not.yet cease, Cao.Cao side Xiahou.Jie frightened DE liver.gall shatter, topple.crash at horse under.
pmwa1ngq8gm3um.translation: Before the shout had died away, Xiahou Jie at Cao Cao’s side was so frightened that his liver and gall shattered, and he crashed down from his horse.
pmwa1ngq8gm3um.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|喊聲未絕，曹操身邊夏侯傑驚得肝膽碎裂，倒撞於馬下。#1

pmwa1ngq8gnq2h.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gnq2h.text: 原來是關雲長，去江夏惜得軍馬一萬，探知當陽長阪大戰，特地從此路截出。
pmwa1ngq8gnq2h.gloss: turn.out COP Guan.Yunchang, go Jiangxia borrow DE troops one ten.thousand, learn Dangyang Changban great battle, specially from PROX road cut.off.out
pmwa1ngq8gnq2h.translation: It turned out to be Guan Yunchang, who had gone to Jiangxia and borrowed ten thousand troops, and having learned of the great battle at Changban in Dangyang, had purposely come out to intercept (the enemy) along this road.
pmwa1ngq8gnq2h.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|原來是關雲長，去江夏惜得軍馬一萬，探知當陽長阪大戰，特地從此路截出。#1

pmwa1ngq8goxio.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8goxio.translation: Your nephew has offended (you) by coming late!
pmwa1ngq8goxio.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|小姪得罪來遲！」#1

pmwa1ngq8gpc9d.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gpc9d.text: 孔明笑曰：「今操引百萬之眾，虎踞江漢，江東安得不使人來探聽虛實？
pmwa1ngq8gpc9d.gloss: Kongming laugh say: now Cao.Cao lead million GEN host, tiger.crouch Jiang.Han, Jiangdong how DE NEG send person come spy.out true.false?
pmwa1ngq8gpc9d.translation: Kongming laughed and said: 'Now Cao Cao leads a million-strong host and crouches like a tiger over the Jiang and Han; how could Jiangdong not send someone to come investigate the actual situation?'
pmwa1ngq8gpc9d.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明笑曰：「今操引百萬之眾，虎踞江漢，江東安得不使人來探聽虛實？#1

pmwa1ngq8gqlwf.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gqlwf.gloss: but how DE Jiangdong person arrive?
pmwa1ngq8gqlwf.translation: But how are we to get someone from Jiangdong to come?
pmwa1ngq8gqlwf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|但如何得江東人到？」#1

pmwa1ngq8gruxd.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gruxd.text: 琦曰：「江東與我家有殺父之讎，安得通慶弔之禮？」
pmwa1ngq8gruxd.gloss: Qi say: Jiangdong with 1SG family have kill father GEN enmity, how DE communicate congratulation.condolence GEN rite?
pmwa1ngq8gruxd.translation: Qi said, 'Jiangdong and my family have a feud over a father's killing; how can we exchange congratulatory and condolence courtesies?'
pmwa1ngq8gruxd.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|琦曰：「江東與我家有殺父之讎，安得通慶弔之禮？」#1

pmwa1ngq8gsgor.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gsgor.text: 肅曰：「久聞皇叔大名，無緣拜會；今幸得見，實為欣慰。
pmwa1ngq8gsgor.gloss: Su say: long hear Imperial.Uncle great.name, not.have.chance call.on; now fortunate DE see, truly COP gratified
pmwa1ngq8gsgor.translation: Su said: 'I have long heard of the Imperial Uncle's great name, but have had no opportunity to call on (you); today I am fortunate to get to see (you), and truly feel gratified.'
pmwa1ngq8gsgor.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|肅曰：「久聞皇叔大名，無緣拜會；今幸得見，實為欣慰。#1

pmwa1ngq8gt8jq.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gt8jq.text: 魯肅曰：「聞皇叔用諸葛孔明之謀，兩場火燒得曹操魂亡膽落，何言不知耶？」
pmwa1ngq8gt8jq.gloss: Lu.Su say: hear Imperial.Uncle use Zhuge.Kongming GEN plan, two CLF fire burn DE Cao.Cao soul.flee.gall.drop, what say NEG know Q?
pmwa1ngq8gt8jq.translation: Lu Su said, "I have heard that the Imperial Uncle used Zhuge Kongming's plan; two fires burned Cao Cao till his soul fled and his gall dropped — how can you say you do not know?"
pmwa1ngq8gt8jq.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|魯肅曰：「聞皇叔用諸葛孔明之謀，兩場火燒得曹操魂亡膽落，何言不知耶？」#1

pmwa1ngq8gud1x.section: 第四十二回　　　張翼德大鬧長阪橋　　劉豫州敗走漢津口
pmwa1ngq8gud1x.text: 肅見孔明禮畢，問曰：「向慕先生才德，未得拜晤；今幸相遇，願聞目今安危之事。」
pmwa1ngq8gud1x.gloss: Su see Kongming ceremony finish, ask say: long.admire sir talent virtue, not.yet DE meet; now fortunately meet, wish hear present safety danger GEN matter.
pmwa1ngq8gud1x.translation: Lu Su saw Kongming; after the ceremony was over, he asked: I have long admired your talent and virtue, but have not yet been able to meet you; today I am fortunate to meet you, and I wish to hear about current matters of safety and danger.
pmwa1ngq8gud1x.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|肅見孔明禮畢，問曰：「向慕先生才德，未得拜晤；今幸相遇，願聞目今安危之事。」#1

pmwa1ngq8gvxbf.section: 第四十三回　　　諸葛亮舌戰群儒　　　魯子敬力排眾議
pmwa1ngq8gvxbf.text: 今操既得荊州，長江之險，已與我共之矣，勢不可敵。
pmwa1ngq8gvxbf.gloss: now Cao.Cao already DE Jingzhou, Yangtze.River GEN danger, already with 1PL share 3SG CRS, momentum NEG can oppose.
pmwa1ngq8gvxbf.translation: Now that Cao Cao has already obtained Jingzhou, the Yangtze River’s natural barrier is already shared with us; his momentum cannot be resisted.
pmwa1ngq8gvxbf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今操既得荊州，長江之險，已與我共之矣，勢不可敵。#1

pmwa1ngq8gwmk8.section: 第四十三回　　　諸葛亮舌戰群儒　　　魯子敬力排眾議
pmwa1ngq8gwmk8.text: 位不過封侯，車不過一乘，騎不過一匹，從不過數人，豈得南面稱孤哉？
pmwa1ngq8gwmk8.gloss: rank not.exceed enfeoff.marquis, carriage not.exceed one.CLF, mount not.exceed one.CLF, attendant not.exceed several person, how DE face.south call lone SFP?
pmwa1ngq8gwmk8.translation: His rank would not exceed that of an enfeoffed marquis; his carriages would not exceed one; his mounts would not exceed one; his attendants would not exceed a few men. How then could he get to face south and style himself 'the lone one'?
pmwa1ngq8gwmk8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|位不過封侯，車不過一乘，騎不過一匹，從不過數人，豈得南面稱孤哉？#1

pmwa1ngq8gxt8s.section: 第四十三回　　　諸葛亮舌戰群儒　　　魯子敬力排眾議
pmwa1ngq8gxt8s.text: 但操新得袁紹之眾，近又得荊州之兵，恐勢大難以抵敵。」

pmwa1ngq8h35gv.section: 第四十三回　　　諸葛亮舌戰群儒　　　魯子敬力排眾議
pmwa1ngq8h35gv.text: 且劉豫州未得先生之時，尚且縱橫寰宇，割據城池；今得先生，人皆仰望；雖三尺童蒙，亦謂彪虎生翼，將見漢室復興，曹氏即滅矣；朝廷舊臣，山林隱士，無不拭目而待：以為拂高天之雲翳，仰日月之光輝，拯斯民於水火之中，措天下於衽席之上，在此時也。
pmwa1ngq8h35gv.gloss: moreover Liu.Yuzhou NEG DE sir LNK time , still roam world , hold.by.force cities ; now DE sir , people all look.up.to ; although three.foot children also say fierce.tiger grow wings , FUT see Han.house revive , Cao.clan immediately destroy CRS ; court old.minister , mountain.forest recluse , none NEG wipe.eyes CONJ wait : believe brush.away high.heaven GEN cloud.veil , look.up.at sun.and.moon GEN radiance , rescue this.people from water.and.fire GEN midst , place realm on sleeping.mat GEN top , be.at PROX time SFP .
pmwa1ngq8h35gv.translation: Moreover, before Liu Yuzhou obtained you, sir, he still roamed the world and held cities by force; now that he has obtained you, everyone looks up to (him); even three-foot-tall children also say that a fierce tiger has grown wings and that (we) will soon see the Han house restored and the Cao clan immediately destroyed; the old ministers of the court and the recluses of the mountains and forests all wipe their eyes and wait, believing that the time to brush away the clouds veiling the high heaven, to look up at the radiance of the sun and moon, to rescue these people from fire and water, and to place the realm upon a sleeping mat is now.

pmwa1ngq9h68x6.text: 譬如人染沈痾，當先用糜粥以飲之，和藥以服之；待其腑臟調和，形體漸安，然後用肉食以補之，猛藥以治之；則病根盡去，人得全生也。
pmwa1ngq9h68x6.gloss: for.example person contract severe.illness, should first use gruel to give.drink 3SG, mild.medicine to take 3SG; wait 3SG.GEN internal.organs harmonize, body gradually at.ease, then use meat.food to nourish 3SG, strong.medicine to treat 3SG; then root.of.illness completely go.away, person DE preserve.life SFP
pmwa1ngq9h68x6.translation: For example, when a person contracts a severe illness, one should first give him gruel to drink and mild medicine to take; wait until his internal organs are harmonized and his body gradually settles, then use meat to nourish him and strong medicine to treat him; then the root of the illness is completely gone, and the person can preserve his life.

pmwa1ngq9hgr50.gloss: Cao if DE DEM two CLF person, hundred myriad ATTR troops, all unload armour roll banner CONJ retreat SFP
pmwa1ngq9hgr50.translation: If Cao gets these two men, then his host of a million will all doff their armour, roll up their banners and withdraw.
pmwa1ngq9hgr50.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操若得此兩人，百萬之眾，皆卸甲捲旗而退矣。」#1

pmwa1ngq9hhuc8.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hhuc8.gloss: CONJ Cao DE 3.OBJ, necessarily great rejoice CONJ leave
pmwa1ngq9hhuc8.translation: And if Cao (Cao Cao) obtains these two men, he will certainly be greatly delighted and withdraw.
pmwa1ngq9hhuc8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|而操得之，必大喜而去。」#1

pmwa1ngq9hiz0e.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hiz0e.text: 操曾發誓曰：『吾一願掃平四海，以成帝業；一願得江東二喬，置之銅雀臺，以樂晚年，雖死無恨矣。』
pmwa1ngq9hiz0e.gloss: Cao.Cao once swear say: 1SG one.wish sweep.level four.seas, in.order.to complete imperial.enterprise; one.wish DE Jiangdong two.Qiao, place 3PL in Bronze.Sparrow.Terrace, in.order.to enjoy late.years, although die not.have regret SFP.
pmwa1ngq9hiz0e.translation: Cao Cao once swore, saying: 'One wish of mine is to sweep the four seas level and complete the imperial enterprise; another wish is to obtain the two Qiao of Jiangdong and place them in the Bronze Sparrow Terrace, so as to enjoy my late years; even if I die, I shall have no regrets.'
pmwa1ngq9hiz0e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操曾發誓曰：『吾一願掃平四海，以成帝業；一願得江東二喬，置之銅雀臺，以樂晚年，雖死無恨矣。』#1

pmwa1ngq9hjn2o.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hjn2o.text: 操得二女，稱心滿意，必班師矣。
pmwa1ngq9hjn2o.gloss: Cao.Cao DE two woman, be.fully.satisfied, surely return.army SFP
pmwa1ngq9hjn2o.translation: If Cao Cao gets the two women, he will be fully satisfied and will surely withdraw his army.
pmwa1ngq9hjn2o.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操得二女，稱心滿意，必班師矣。#1

pmwa1ngq9hkqiu.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hkqiu.text: 瑜曰：「操欲得二喬，有何證驗？」
pmwa1ngq9hkqiu.gloss: Zhou.Yu say: Cao.Cao desire DE two Qiao, have what evidence?
pmwa1ngq9hkqiu.translation: Zhou Yu said: “Cao Cao wants to get the two Qiao sisters—what evidence is there?”
pmwa1ngq9hkqiu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瑜曰：「操欲得二喬，有何證驗？」#1

pmwa1ngq9hlpoz.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hlpoz.text: 雲天亙其既立兮，家願得乎雙逞。
pmwa1ngq9hlpoz.gloss: cloud.sky stretch.across P already stand EXCL, family wish DE P both fulfill
pmwa1ngq9hlpoz.translation: The clouds and sky stretch across; once [the tower] has been established, our family’s wish attains both fulfillments.
pmwa1ngq9hlpoz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雲天亙其既立兮，家願得乎雙逞。#1

pmwa1ngq9hma1x.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hma1x.text: 昭曰：「曹操挾天子而征四方，動以朝廷為名；近又得荊州，威勢愈大。
pmwa1ngq9hma1x.gloss: Zhao say: Cao.Cao coerce Son.of.Heaven CONJ campaign four.directions, always take imperial.court as name; recently also DE Jingzhou, power.prestige more great.
pmwa1ngq9hma1x.translation: Zhao said: Cao Cao coerces the Son of Heaven and campaigns in all directions, always acting in the name of the imperial court; recently he has also gained Jingzhou, and his power and prestige are ever greater.
pmwa1ngq9hma1x.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|昭曰：「曹操挾天子而征四方，動以朝廷為名；近又得荊州，威勢愈大。#1

pmwa1ngq9hn9f1.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hn9f1.text: 瑜請得精兵數千，進屯夏口，為將軍破之！」
pmwa1ngq9hn9f1.gloss: Zhou.Yu request DE elite.troop several.thousand, advance station Xiakou, for general defeat 3SG!
pmwa1ngq9hn9f1.translation: I, Yu, ask to obtain several thousand elite troops, advance and station at Xiakou, and defeat him for you, General!
pmwa1ngq9hn9f1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瑜請得精兵數千，進屯夏口，為將軍破之！」#1

pmwa1ngq9houna.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9houna.text: 今以實較之：彼將中國之兵，不過十五六萬，且已久疲；所得袁氏之眾，亦止七八萬耳，尚多懷疑未服。
pmwa1ngq9houna.gloss: now with reality compare 3SG : 3SG lead Central.Plain GEN troops , not.exceed fifteen.six.myriad , and already long exhausted ; NMLZ DE Yuan.clan GEN masses , also only seven.eight.myriad SFP , still many doubt not.yet submit .
pmwa1ngq9houna.translation: Now, comparing (it) with the actual situation: the troops he leads from the Central Plains are no more than 150,000 or 160,000, and are already long exhausted; those he has obtained from the Yuan clan also amount to only 70,000 or 80,000, and many of them still harbor doubts and have not submitted.
pmwa1ngq9houna.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今以實較之：彼將中國之兵，不過十五六萬，且已久疲；所得袁氏之眾，亦止七八萬耳，尚多懷疑未服。#1

pmwa1ngq9hp0df.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hp0df.gloss: Yu DE five ten.thousand soldier, self sufficient defeat 3SG.OBJ
pmwa1ngq9hp0df.translation: If I, Yu, obtain fifty thousand troops, that of itself will be enough to defeat them.
pmwa1ngq9hp0df.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瑜得五萬兵，自足破之。#1

pmwa1ngq9hqi05.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hqi05.translation: Wherever the great army arrives, it must not disturb the people.
pmwa1ngq9hqi05.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|大軍到處，不得擾民。#1

pmwa1ngq9hrz5n.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hrz5n.text: 今幸至江東，欲煩先生不惜齒牙餘論，使令弟棄劉備而事東吳，則主公既得良輔，而先生兄弟又得相見，豈不美哉？
pmwa1ngq9hrz5n.gloss: now fortunately arrive Jiangdong, wish trouble sir not spare teeth.and.jaw.remaining.words, cause your.younger.brother abandon Liu.Bei CONJ serve Eastern.Wu, then lord already DE good.assistant, CONJ sir brothers again DE see.each.other, how NEG fine SFP?
pmwa1ngq9hrz5n.translation: Now that (he) has fortunately arrived in Jiangdong, I wish to trouble you, sir, not to grudge your words, and to make your younger brother abandon Liu Bei and serve Eastern Wu. Then my lord will have gained a good assistant, and you and your brother will also be able to meet—would that not be wonderful?
pmwa1ngq9hrz5n.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今幸至江東，欲煩先生不惜齒牙餘論，使令弟棄劉備而事東吳，則主公既得良輔，而先生兄弟又得相見，豈不美哉？#1

pmwa1ngq9hsct3.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9hsct3.text: 今幸至江東，欲煩先生不惜齒牙餘論，使令弟棄劉備而事東吳，則主公既得良輔，而先生兄弟又得相見，豈不美哉？
pmwa1ngq9hsct3.gloss: now fortunately arrive Jiangdong, wish trouble sir not spare teeth.and.jaw.remaining.words, cause your.younger.brother abandon Liu.Bei CONJ serve Eastern.Wu, then lord already DE good.assistant, CONJ sir brothers again DE see.each.other, how NEG fine SFP?
pmwa1ngq9hsct3.translation: Now that (he) has fortunately arrived in Jiangdong, I wish to trouble you, sir, not to grudge your words, and to make your younger brother abandon Liu Bei and serve Eastern Wu. Then my lord will have gained a good assistant, and you and your brother will also be able to meet—would that not be wonderful?
pmwa1ngq9hsct3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今幸至江東，欲煩先生不惜齒牙餘論，使令弟棄劉備而事東吳，則主公既得良輔，而先生兄弟又得相見，豈不美哉？#2

pmwa1ngq9ht1nk.section: 第四十四回　　　孔明用智激周瑜　　　孫權決計破曹操
pmwa1ngq9ht1nk.text: 今劉皇叔乃漢室之冑，兄若能去東吳，而與弟同事劉皇叔，則上不愧為漢臣，而骨肉又得相聚，此情義兩全之策也。
pmwa1ngq9ht1nk.gloss: now Liu.Uncle COP Han.house GEN descendant, elder.brother if can leave Eastern.Wu, CONJ with younger.brother together serve Liu.Uncle, then above NEG ashamed COP Han.subject, CONJ flesh.and.blood again DE each.other gather, this affection.and.righteousness both.complete GEN plan SFP.
pmwa1ngq9ht1nk.translation: Now Uncle Liu is a descendant of the Han house. If you, elder brother, can leave Eastern Wu and serve Uncle Liu together with me, then above (you) will not be ashamed to be a Han subject, and (our) flesh and blood will again be able to gather together; this is a plan by which both affection and righteousness are complete.
pmwa1ngq9ht1nk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今劉皇叔乃漢室之冑，兄若能去東吳，而與弟同事劉皇叔，則上不愧為漢臣，而骨肉又得相聚，此情義兩全之策也。#1

pmwa1ngq9hu4wl.section: 第四十五回　　　三江口曹操折兵　　　群英會蔣幹中計
pmwa1ngq9hu4wl.text: 從巳時直殺到未時，周瑜雖得利，只恐寡不敵眾，遂下令鳴金收住船隻。
pmwa1ngq9hu4wl.gloss: from Si.hour straight fight arrive Wei.hour, Zhou.Yu although DE advantage, only fear few NEG match many, then issue.order beat.gong halt boats.
pmwa1ngq9hu4wl.translation: They fought straight on from the si hour (9–11 a.m.) until the wei hour (1–3 p.m.). Although Zhou Yu gained the advantage, he feared that the few could not match the many, so he gave the order to beat the gong and halt the boats.
pmwa1ngq9hu4wl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|從巳時直殺到未時，周瑜雖得利，只恐寡不敵眾，遂下令鳴金收住船隻。#1

pmwa1ngq9hv9to.section: 第四十五回　　　三江口曹操折兵　　　群英會蔣幹中計
pmwa1ngq9hv9to.text: 至晚點上燈火，照得天心水面通紅。
pmwa1ngq9hv9to.gloss: toward.evening light.up lamp.fire, shine DE sky.middle water.surface all.red.
pmwa1ngq9hv9to.translation: When evening came, they lit the lamps and torches, so that the middle of the sky and the water’s surface were all red.
pmwa1ngq9hv9to.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|至晚點上燈火，照得天心水面通紅。#1

pmwa1ngq9hwyup.section: 第四十五回　　　三江口曹操折兵　　　群英會蔣幹中計
pmwa1ngq9hwyup.text: 卻說周瑜得勝回寨，犒賞三軍，一面差人到吳侯處報捷。
pmwa1ngq9hwyup.gloss: meanwhile say Zhou.Yu DE victory return camp, reward three army, meanwhile send person to Wu.Marquis place report victory.
pmwa1ngq9hwyup.translation: Meanwhile, Zhou Yu returned to camp victorious, rewarded the three armies, and at the same time sent someone to the Marquis of Wu to report the victory.
pmwa1ngq9hwyup.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說周瑜得勝回寨，犒賞三軍，一面差人到吳侯處報捷。#1

pmwa1ngq9hxiwo.section: 第四十五回　　　三江口曹操折兵　　　群英會蔣幹中計
pmwa1ngq9hxiwo.text: 瑜暗窺他水寨，大驚曰：「此深得水軍之妙也！」
pmwa1ngq9hxiwo.gloss: Yu secretly spy 3SG water.camp, greatly.startled say: PROX deeply DE water.army GEN subtlety SFP!
pmwa1ngq9hxiwo.translation: Zhou Yu secretly spied on his (Cao Cao’s) water camp, was greatly startled, and said: “This (camp) has deeply grasped the subtleties of naval warfare!”
pmwa1ngq9hxiwo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瑜暗窺他水寨，大驚曰：「此深得水軍之妙也！」#1

pmwa1ngq9hyki4.section: 第四十五回　　　三江口曹操折兵　　　群英會蔣幹中計
pmwa1ngq9hyki4.text: 瑜都教相見畢，就列於兩傍而坐，大張筵席，奏軍中得勝之樂，輪換行酒。
pmwa1ngq9hyki4.gloss: Zhou.Yu all order meet.each.other finish, then line.up at both.sides CONJ sit, greatly spread banquet, play army.within DE victory GEN music, take.turns serve.wine.
pmwa1ngq9hyki4.translation: Zhou Yu had them all meet one another; when that was done, they took their places and sat on both sides. A great banquet was laid out, the army’s victory music was played, and they took turns serving wine.
pmwa1ngq9hyki4.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瑜都教相見畢，就列於兩傍而坐，大張筵席，奏軍中得勝之樂，輪換行酒。#1

pmwa1ngq9hzpvx.section: 第四十五回　　　三江口曹操折兵　　　群英會蔣幹中計
pmwa1ngq9hzpvx.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|蔣幹如何睡得著？#1

pmwa1ngq9i0afj.section: 第四十五回　　　三江口曹操折兵　　　群英會蔣幹中計
pmwa1ngq9i0afj.text: 今已賺北軍困於寨中，但得其便，即將操賊之首，獻於麾下。
pmwa1ngq9i0afj.gloss: now already lure north.army trap at camp.inside, only DE 3SG.GEN convenience, then BA Cao.traitor GEN head, present to banner.under.
pmwa1ngq9i0afj.translation: Now we have already lured the northern army into being trapped in the camp; as soon as we get the opportunity, we will take the traitor Cao’s head and present it beneath your banner.
pmwa1ngq9i0afj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今已賺北軍困於寨中，但得其便，即將操賊之首，獻於麾下。#1

pmwa1ngq9i16vm.section: 第四十五回　　　三江口曹操折兵　　　群英會蔣幹中計
pmwa1ngq9i16vm.text: 幹伏於床上，將近四更，只聽得有人入帳喚曰：「都督醒否？」
pmwa1ngq9i16vm.gloss: Gan lie.on.bed near.fourth.watch only hear DE have.person enter.tent call.say Commander.wake.Q
pmwa1ngq9i16vm.translation: Gan was lying on the bed, near the fourth watch, when he only heard someone enter the tent and call out, "Are you awake, Commander?"
pmwa1ngq9i16vm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幹伏於床上，將近四更，只聽得有人入帳喚曰：「都督醒否？」#1

pmwa1ngq9i2g67.section: 第四十五回　　　三江口曹操折兵　　　群英會蔣幹中計
pmwa1ngq9i2g67.text: 幹竊聽之，只聞有人在外曰：「張、蔡二都督道：『急切不得下手。』」
pmwa1ngq9i2g67.gloss: Gan secretly.listen 3SG.OBJ, only hear have person at outside say: Zhang , Cai two commander say: ' urgent NEG DE strike.hand. '
pmwa1ngq9i2g67.translation: Gan secretly listened to them, and heard only someone outside saying: "The two commanders Zhang and Cai say: '(We) cannot make a move in haste.'"
pmwa1ngq9i2g67.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幹竊聽之，只聞有人在外曰：「張、蔡二都督道：『急切不得下手。』」#1

pmwa1ngq9i31iu.section: 第四十五回　　　三江口曹操折兵　　　群英會蔣幹中計
pmwa1ngq9i31iu.text: 幹曰：「雖不能說周瑜，卻與丞相打聽得一件事。
pmwa1ngq9i31iu.gloss: Gan say: although NEG can persuade Zhou.Yu, yet for Chancellor find.out DE one CLF matter.
pmwa1ngq9i31iu.translation: Gan said, "Although I could not persuade Zhou Yu, I have nevertheless found out one thing for the Chancellor."
pmwa1ngq9i31iu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幹曰：「雖不能說周瑜，卻與丞相打聽得一件事。#1

pmwa1ngq9i4jjt.section: 第四十六回　　　用奇謀孔明借箭　　　獻密計黃蓋受刑
pmwa1ngq9i4jjt.text: 諕得魯肅失色問曰：「先生何由知之？」
pmwa1ngq9i4jjt.gloss: frighten DE Lu.Su lose.color ask say: sir how know it?
pmwa1ngq9i4jjt.translation: Lu Su was so startled that he turned pale and asked, “Sir, how do you know this?”
pmwa1ngq9i4jjt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|諕得魯肅失色問曰：「先生何由知之？」#1

pmwa1ngq9i5ylo.section: 第四十六回　　　用奇謀孔明借箭　　　獻密計黃蓋受刑
pmwa1ngq9i5ylo.text: 魯肅聽了，開口不得，把些言語支吾了半晌，別孔明而回。
pmwa1ngq9i5ylo.gloss: Lu.Su hear PFV, open.mouth NEG DE, BA some words prevaricate PFV a.while, take.leave Kongming CONJ return.
pmwa1ngq9i5ylo.translation: When Lu Su heard this, he could not open his mouth; he prevaricated with a few words for a good while, then took leave of Kongming and went back.

Looking all around at the vast openness, he was delighted at heart and said to the assembled officials: 'Ever since I raised righteous troops, I have for the state removed the fierce and eliminated harm, vowing to sweep the Four Seas clean and level the world; what I have not yet obtained is Jiangnan.'

pmwa1ngqbje5ww.text: 黃蓋跳在小船上，背後數人駕舟，冒煙突火，來尋曹操，操見勢急，方欲跳上岸，忽張遼駕一小腳船，扶操下得船時，那隻大船，已自著了。

Cao Cao saw that the situation was urgent and was just about to jump ashore when Zhang Liao suddenly rowed up a small boat and helped Cao Cao down into it; by that time that big boat had already caught fire.

pmwa1ngqcjlctx.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqcjlctx.text: 操此時指望合淝有兵救應，不想孫權在合淝路口，望見江中火光，知是我軍得勝，便教陸遜舉火為號；太史慈見了，與陸遜合兵一處，衝殺將來。

Taishi Ci saw it, joined forces with Lu Xun in one place, and came charging in to attack.

pmwa1ngqcjnzey.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqcjnzey.text: 說猶未了，兩邊鼓聲震響，火光沖天而起，驚得曹操幾乎墜馬。
pmwa1ngqcjnzey.gloss: speak still not.yet finish, two side drum sound shake resound, fire light rush sky and rise, startle DE Cao.Cao almost fall horse
pmwa1ngqcjnzey.translation: Before he had finished speaking, the sound of drums crashed on both sides and flames shot up into the sky, startling Cao Cao so much that he nearly fell from his horse.
pmwa1ngqcjnzey.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|說猶未了，兩邊鼓聲震響，火光沖天而起，驚得曹操幾乎墜馬。#1

pmwa1ngqcjo688.text: 子龍不來追趕，只顧搶奪旗幟，曹操得脫。
pmwa1ngqcjo688.gloss: Zilong NEG come pursue, only.care seize banner, Cao.Cao DE escape.
pmwa1ngqcjo688.translation: Zilong did not come in pursuit, but only busied himself with seizing the banners; Cao Cao managed to escape.

pmwa1ngqcjplee.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqcjplee.text: 馬上有帶得鑼鍋的，也有村中掠得糧米的，便就山邊揀乾處埋鍋造飯，割馬肉燒吃，盡皆脫去濕衣，於風頭吹晒。
pmwa1ngqcjplee.gloss: on.horseback have bring DE cooking.pot NMLZ, also have in.village plunder DE grain.rice NMLZ, then at mountain.side choose dry.place set.up pot cook.meal, cut horse.meat roast eat, all take.off wet.clothes, in windward blow dry.
pmwa1ngqcjplee.translation: Some on horseback had brought cooking pots, and some had plundered grain and rice from the villages; then they went to the mountain side, chose dry spots, set up pots and cooked food, cut horse meat and roasted it to eat, and all took off their wet clothes and dried them in the wind.
pmwa1ngqcjplee.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|馬上有帶得鑼鍋的，也有村中掠得糧米的，便就山邊揀乾處埋鍋造飯，割馬肉燒吃，盡皆脫去濕衣，於風頭吹晒。#1

pmwa1ngqcjrd38.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqcjrd38.text: 若是我用兵時，就這個去處，也埋伏一彪軍馬，以逸待勞；我等縱然脫得性命，也不免重傷矣。
pmwa1ngqcjrd38.gloss: if COP 1SG use.troops time, at PROX CLF place, also ambush one CLF army.troops, with ease wait fatigue; 1PL even.if escape DE life, also not.avoid serious.wound SFP.
pmwa1ngqcjrd38.translation: If it were I commanding the troops, at this very place I would also ambush a detachment of troops, waiting at ease for the exhausted; even if we escaped with our lives, we would still not avoid serious injury.
pmwa1ngqcjrd38.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若是我用兵時，就這個去處，也埋伏一彪軍馬，以逸待勞；我等縱然脫得性命，也不免重傷矣。#1

pmwa1ngqcjsjwj.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqcjsjwj.text: 大半皆是彝陵道上被趕得慌，只騎得禿馬，鞍轡衣服，盡皆拋棄。
pmwa1ngqcjsjwj.gloss: most all COP Yiling road.on PASS chase DE panicked, only ride DE bare.horse, saddle.bridle clothing, all discard
pmwa1ngqcjsjwj.translation: Most of them had been chased into a panic on the Yiling road and could only ride bare horses; saddles, bridles, and clothing were all thrown away.
pmwa1ngqcjsjwj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|大半皆是彝陵道上被趕得慌，只騎得禿馬，鞍轡衣服，盡皆拋棄。#1

pmwa1ngqcjtobf.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操

pmwa1ngqcjunri.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqcjunri.text: 眾軍只得都下馬，就路旁砍伐竹木，填塞山路。
pmwa1ngqcjunri.gloss: troops only DE all dismount, at roadside cut.down bamboo tree, fill.block mountain road.
pmwa1ngqcjunri.translation: The troops had no choice but to all dismount, cut down bamboo and trees by the roadside, and fill up the mountain road.
pmwa1ngqcjunri.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾軍只得都下馬，就路旁砍伐竹木，填塞山路。#1

pmwa1ngqcjvoze.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqcjvoze.text: 操曰：「既到此處，只得決一死戰！」
pmwa1ngqcjvoze.gloss: Cao say: since arrive PROX place, only DE decide one death battle!
pmwa1ngqcjvoze.translation: Cao said, "Since (we) have come to this place, (we) have no choice but to fight a battle to the death!"
pmwa1ngqcjvoze.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操曰：「既到此處，只得決一死戰！」#1

pmwa1ngqcjwej1.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqcjwej1.text: 只見一群哨馬衝到，方認得是曹仁軍馬。
pmwa1ngqcjwej1.gloss: only see one CLF scout.cavalry charge arrive, only.then recognize-DE COP Cao.Ren army.troops
pmwa1ngqcjwej1.translation: All (he) saw was a group of scout cavalry come charging up, and only then did (he) recognize that it was Cao Ren's troops.
pmwa1ngqcjwej1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只見一群哨馬衝到，方認得是曹仁軍馬。#1

pmwa1ngqcjx22u.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqcjx22u.text: 曹仁接著，言：「雖知兵敗，不敢遠離，只得在附近迎接。」
pmwa1ngqcjx22u.gloss: Cao.Ren receive DUR, say: "though know army defeat, NEG dare far.leave, only DE at nearby welcome."
pmwa1ngqcjx22u.translation: Cao Ren met him and said, "Although I knew the army had been defeated, I did not dare go far away, and had no choice but to welcome (you) nearby."
pmwa1ngqcjx22u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹仁接著，言：「雖知兵敗，不敢遠離，只得在附近迎接。」#1

pmwa1ngqcjybbv.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqcjybbv.text: 眾謀士曰：「丞相於虎窟中逃難之時，全無懼怯；今到城中，人已得食，馬已得料，正須整頓軍馬復仇，何反痛哭？」
pmwa1ngqcjybbv.gloss: many adviser say: Chancellor in tiger.den inside flee.disaster LNK time, completely not.have fear.timidity; now arrive city inside, people already DE food, horse already DE fodder, just need reorganize army.horse revenge, why instead weep.bitterly?
pmwa1ngqcjybbv.translation: The assembled advisers said: 'When the Chancellor was fleeing danger in the tiger's den, (you) showed no fear at all; now that (you) have arrived in the city, the men have already gotten food and the horses have already gotten fodder, and (you) should be reorganizing the troops and horses to take revenge—why instead are (you) weeping bitterly?'
pmwa1ngqcjybbv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾謀士曰：「丞相於虎窟中逃難之時，全無懼怯；今到城中，人已得食，馬已得料，正須整頓軍馬復仇，何反痛哭？」#1

pmwa1ngqck0uoy.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqck0uoy.text: 此時諸路軍馬，皆得馬匹、器械、錢糧，已回夏口；獨雲長不獲一人一騎，空身回見玄德。
pmwa1ngqck0uoy.gloss: this time various route troops, all DE horses, weapons, money.grain, already return Xiakou; only Yun.Chang NEG capture one person one mount, empty.body return see Xuande.
pmwa1ngqck0uoy.translation: At this time the troops of the various routes had all obtained horses, weapons, and supplies, and had already returned to Xiakou; only Yun Chang had not captured a single man or horse, and returned empty-handed to see Xuande.
pmwa1ngqck0uoy.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|此時諸路軍馬，皆得馬匹、器械、錢糧，已回夏口；獨雲長不獲一人一騎，空身回見玄德。#1

pmwa1ngqck12h0.gloss: Kong.Ming say: capture DE what general.soldier come?
pmwa1ngqck12h0.translation: Kongming said, "What officers and soldiers did (you) capture and bring here?"
pmwa1ngqck12h0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明曰：「拏得甚將士來？」#1

pmwa1ngqck22h2.section: 第五十回　　　　諸葛亮智算華容　　　關雲長義釋曹操
pmwa1ngqck22h2.text: 但既有軍令狀在此，不得不按軍法。」
pmwa1ngqck22h2.gloss: but since have military.order.pledge be.here, NEG DE NEG according.to military.law.
pmwa1ngqck22h2.translation: But since the military order (pledge) is here, (I) have no choice but to act according to military law.
pmwa1ngqck22h2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|但既有軍令狀在此，不得不按軍法。」#1

pmwa1ngqck3gl4.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqck3gl4.text: 所得降卒，盡皆發付渡江。
pmwa1ngqck3gl4.gloss: P DE surrender soldier, all all dispatch cross river
pmwa1ngqck3gl4.translation: The surrendered soldiers that were taken were all dispatched across the river.
pmwa1ngqck3gl4.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|所得降卒，盡皆發付渡江。#1

pmwa1ngqck4hl2.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqck4hl2.text: 我等費了許多軍馬，用了許多錢糧，目下南郡唾手可得；彼等心懷不仁，要就現成，須放著周瑜不死！」
pmwa1ngqck4hl2.gloss: 1PL spend PFV many troops.horses, use PFV much money.grain, at.present Nanjun spit.hand can DE; 3PL harbor not.benevolent, want take ready.made, must leave Zhou.Yu not.die!
pmwa1ngqck4hl2.translation: We have spent many troops and horses and used much money and grain; at present Nanjun is within easy reach. They harbor unkind intentions and want to take what is ready-made; they must be leaving Zhou Yu alive!
pmwa1ngqck4hl2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|我等費了許多軍馬，用了許多錢糧，目下南郡唾手可得；彼等心懷不仁，要就現成，須放著周瑜不死！」#1

pmwa1ngqck5xzb.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqck5xzb.text: 瑜曰：「吾若取不得，那時任從公取。」
pmwa1ngqck5xzb.gloss: Zhou.Yu say: 1SG if take NEG DE, then let sir take.
pmwa1ngqck5xzb.translation: Zhou Yu said, "If I cannot take it, then you may take it as you please, sir."
pmwa1ngqck5xzb.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瑜曰：「吾若取不得，那時任從公取。」#1

pmwa1ngqck6pxn.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqck6pxn.text: 我今孤窮一身，無置足之地，欲得南郡，權且容身；若先教周瑜取了，城池已屬東吳矣，卻如何得住？」
pmwa1ngqck6pxn.gloss: 1SG now isolated.poor one.body, not.have set.foot ATTR place, want DE Nanjun, temporarily shelter.oneself; if first let Zhou.Yu take PFV, city already belong Eastern.Wu CRS, then how DE stay?
pmwa1ngqck6pxn.translation: I am now all alone and destitute, with no place to set foot; I want to get Nanjun just to shelter myself for the time being. If (we) let Zhou Yu take it first, the city will already belong to Eastern Wu—then how can (I) stay (there)?
pmwa1ngqck6pxn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|我今孤窮一身，無置足之地，欲得南郡，權且容身；若先教周瑜取了，城池已屬東吳矣，卻如何得住？」#1

pmwa1ngqdk8vq0.gloss: Yu say: 1SG snap.fingers can DE Nanjun, end.up DE empty do favor.

pmwa1ngqdkazra.translation: Niu Jin charged left and right but could not get out.
pmwa1ngqdkazra.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|金左右衝突，不能得出。#1

pmwa1ngqdkbtuc.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqdkbtuc.text: 曹仁殺到垓心，救出牛金，回顧尚有數十騎在陣，不能得出，遂復翻身殺入，救出重圍。
pmwa1ngqdkbtuc.gloss: Cao.Ren cut.to encirclement.center, rescue.out Niu.Jin, look.back still have several.tens rider at formation, NEG can DE out, then again turn.around cut.enter, rescue.out heavy.encirclement.
pmwa1ngqdkbtuc.translation: Cao Ren cut his way to the center of the encirclement and rescued Niu Jin; looking back, he saw that there were still several dozen riders in the formation who could not get out, so he turned around and charged in again, rescuing them from the heavy encirclement.
pmwa1ngqdkbtuc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹仁殺到垓心，救出牛金，回顧尚有數十騎在陣，不能得出，遂復翻身殺入，救出重圍。#1

pmwa1ngqdkcijh.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqdkcijh.text: 混殺一陣，吳軍敗走，曹仁得勝而回。
pmwa1ngqdkcijh.gloss: chaotic.fight one CLF, Wu.army defeated.flee, Cao.Ren DE victory CONJ return.
pmwa1ngqdkcijh.translation: After a bout of confused fighting, the Wu army was defeated and fled, and Cao Ren won the victory and returned.
pmwa1ngqdkcijh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|混殺一陣，吳軍敗走，曹仁得勝而回。#1

pmwa1ngqdkdh40.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqdkdh40.text: 馬不能行，必棄馬而走，吾可得其馬也。」
pmwa1ngqdkdh40.gloss: horse NEG can walk, surely abandon horse CONJ flee, 1SG can DE 3PL horse SFP
pmwa1ngqdkdh40.translation: The horses will not be able to go (along that road); they will surely abandon the horses and flee, and I can get their horses.
pmwa1ngqdkdh40.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|馬不能行，必棄馬而走，吾可得其馬也。」#1

pmwa1ngqdke4er.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqdke4er.gloss: Wu soldiers DE horse five.hundred more CLF
pmwa1ngqdke4er.translation: The Wu soldiers obtained more than five hundred horses.
pmwa1ngqdke4er.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吳兵得馬五百餘匹。#1

pmwa1ngqdkfzag.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqdkfzag.text: 瑜暗忖曹仁必先準備走路，遂下將臺號令，分布兩軍為左右翼；如前軍得勝，只顧向前追趕，直待鳴金，方許退步。
pmwa1ngqdkfzag.gloss: Zhou.Yu secretly.reckon Cao.Ren must first prepare run.away, then descend command.platform issue.orders, deploy two armies as left.and.right.wings; if front.army DE victory, only forward pursue, until sound.gong, only.then permit retreat.
pmwa1ngqdkfzag.translation: Zhou Yu secretly judged that Cao Ren must be preparing to flee first, so he descended from the command platform and issued orders, deploying the two armies as left and right wings; if the front army won, they were to keep pursuing forward, and only when the gongs sounded were they permitted to retreat.
pmwa1ngqdkfzag.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瑜暗忖曹仁必先準備走路，遂下將臺號令，分布兩軍為左右翼；如前軍得勝，只顧向前追趕，直待鳴金，方許退步。#1

pmwa1ngqdkgxwn.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqdkgxwn.text: 幸得凌統引一軍從刺斜裏殺來，敵住曹兵。
pmwa1ngqdkgxwn.gloss: fortunately DE Ling.Tong lead one army from flank charge.come, hold.off Cao.troops.
pmwa1ngqdkgxwn.translation: Fortunately, Ling Tong led a force and came charging in from the flank, holding off Cao’s troops.
pmwa1ngqdkgxwn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幸得凌統引一軍從刺斜裏殺來，敵住曹兵。#1

pmwa1ngqdkh0in.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqdkh0in.text: 曹仁引得勝軍進城，程普收敗軍回寨。
pmwa1ngqdkh0in.gloss: Cao.Ren lead DE victorious.army enter.city, Cheng.Pu gather defeated.army return.camp.
pmwa1ngqdkh0in.translation: Cao Ren led the victorious army into the city, and Cheng Pu gathered the defeated troops and returned to camp.
pmwa1ngqdkh0in.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹仁引得勝軍進城，程普收敗軍回寨。#1

pmwa1ngqdkibyx.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqdkibyx.text: 丁、徐二將救得周瑜到帳中，喚行軍醫者用鐵鉗子拔出箭頭，將金瘡藥敷掩瘡口，疼不可當，飲食俱廢。
pmwa1ngqdkibyx.gloss: Ding, Xu two general rescue DE Zhou.Yu arrive tent inside, call army.doctor use iron pincers pull.out arrowhead, BA metal.wound medicine apply.cover wound opening, pain not can bear, food.drink all abandon.
pmwa1ngqdkibyx.translation: The two generals Ding and Xu rescued Zhou Yu into the tent and called the army doctor to pull out the arrowhead with iron pincers and apply wound medicine to cover the wound; the pain was unbearable, and he abandoned food and drink entirely.
pmwa1ngqdkibyx.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|丁、徐二將救得周瑜到帳中，喚行軍醫者用鐵鉗子拔出箭頭，將金瘡藥敷掩瘡口，疼不可當，飲食俱廢。#1

pmwa1ngqdkjs1h.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqdkjs1h.text: 正分撥間，忽然探馬飛來報說：「諸葛亮自得了南郡，遂用兵符，星夜詐調荊州守城軍馬來救，卻教張飛襲了荊州。」
pmwa1ngqdkjs1h.gloss: just deploy time, suddenly scout come.flying report say: Zhuge.Liang since DE PFV Nan.Commandery, then use military.tally, overnight falsely.transfer Jingzhou defend.city troops come.rescue, but cause Zhang.Fei raid PFV Jingzhou.
pmwa1ngqdkjs1h.translation: Just as they were deploying (the troops), a scout suddenly came flying in and reported: 'As soon as Zhuge Liang obtained Nan Commandery, he then used the military tally to falsely transfer the Jingzhou city-defending troops overnight to come to the rescue, but had Zhang Fei make a surprise attack on Jingzhou.'
pmwa1ngqdkjs1h.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|正分撥間，忽然探馬飛來報說：「諸葛亮自得了南郡，遂用兵符，星夜詐調荊州守城軍馬來救，卻教張飛襲了荊州。」#1

pmwa1ngqdkkzb7.section: 第五十一回　　　曹仁大戰東吳兵　　　孔明一氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqdkkzb7.text: 周瑜曰：「諸葛亮怎得兵符？」
pmwa1ngqdkkzb7.gloss: Zhou.Yu say: Zhuge.Liang how DE military.tally?
pmwa1ngqdkkzb7.translation: Zhou Yu said, "How did Zhuge Liang get the military tally?"
pmwa1ngqdkkzb7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|周瑜曰：「諸葛亮怎得兵符？」#1

pmwa1ngqdkl003.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkl003.text: 況劉玄德舊曾曹操相厚，若逼得緊急，獻了城池，一同攻打東吳，如之奈何？」
pmwa1ngqdkl003.gloss: moreover Liu.Xuande formerly once Cao.Cao mutually.close, if press DE urgent, hand.over PFV city, together attack Eastern.Wu, what.to.do.about.it?
pmwa1ngqdkl003.translation: Moreover, Liu Xuande was formerly on close terms with Cao Cao; if (he) is hard-pressed, (he) will hand over the city and together (with Cao Cao) attack Eastern Wu—what then?
pmwa1ngqdkl003.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|況劉玄德舊曾曹操相厚，若逼得緊急，獻了城池，一同攻打東吳，如之奈何？」#1

pmwa1ngqdkmtwe.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkmtwe.text: 前者，操引百萬之眾，名下江南，實欲來圖皇叔；幸得東吳殺退曹兵，救了皇叔，所有荊州九郡，合當歸於東吳。
pmwa1ngqdkmtwe.gloss: formerly, Cao.Cao lead million LNK troops, name descend Jiangnan, actually want come plot.against Imperial.Uncle; fortunate DE Eastern.Wu defeat.repel Cao troops, save PFV Imperial.Uncle, all Jingzhou nine commanderies, ought belong.to Eastern.Wu.
pmwa1ngqdkmtwe.translation: Formerly, Cao Cao led a million troops and, under the name of descending on Jiangnan, actually wanted to come and plot against the Imperial Uncle; fortunately Eastern Wu defeated and drove back Cao's troops and saved the Imperial Uncle, and all nine commanderies of Jingzhou ought to belong to Eastern Wu.
pmwa1ngqdkmtwe.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|前者，操引百萬之眾，名下江南，實欲來圖皇叔；幸得東吳殺退曹兵，救了皇叔，所有荊州九郡，合當歸於東吳。#1

pmwa1ngqdknk1s.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdknk1s.text: 瑜曰：「劉琦正青春年少，如何便得他死？
pmwa1ngqdknk1s.gloss: Zhou.Yu say: Liu.Qi just youth young, how then DE 3SG die?
pmwa1ngqdknk1s.translation: Zhou Yu said, "Liu Qi is just in the flower of youth; how can (we) get him to die (anytime soon)?"
pmwa1ngqdknk1s.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瑜曰：「劉琦正青春年少，如何便得他死？#1

pmwa1ngqdkoa7o.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkoa7o.translation: When will (we) get this Jingzhou back?
pmwa1ngqdkoa7o.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|這荊州何日得還？」#1

pmwa1ngqdkp7sc.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkp7sc.text: 那時往取荊州，劉備須無得推故。」
pmwa1ngqdkp7sc.gloss: that time go take Jingzhou, Liu.Bei must not.have DE make.excuse.
pmwa1ngqdkp7sc.translation: At that time, when (we) go to take Jingzhou, Liu Bei will surely have no excuse to make.
pmwa1ngqdkp7sc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|那時往取荊州，劉備須無得推故。」#1

pmwa1ngqdkqjrg.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkqjrg.text: 周瑜只得班師回柴桑養病，令程普部領戰船士卒，來合肥聽孫權調用。
pmwa1ngqdkqjrg.gloss: Zhou.Yu only DE withdraw.troops return Chaisang recuperate, order Cheng.Pu lead warship soldier, come Hefei await Sun.Quan deploy.
pmwa1ngqdkqjrg.translation: Zhou Yu had no choice but to withdraw his troops and return to Chaisang to recover from illness, and ordered Cheng Pu to lead the warships and soldiers to come to Hefei to await Sun Quan’s deployment.
pmwa1ngqdkqjrg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|周瑜只得班師回柴桑養病，令程普部領戰船士卒，來合肥聽孫權調用。#1

pmwa1ngqdkr6ex.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkr6ex.text: 卻說劉玄德自得荊州、南郡、襄陽，心中大喜，商議久遠之計。
pmwa1ngqdkr6ex.gloss: meanwhile Liu.Xuande since DE Jingzhou, Nanjun, Xiangyang, heart inside greatly rejoice, discuss long.term GEN plan.
pmwa1ngqdkr6ex.translation: Meanwhile, Liu Xuande, having obtained Jingzhou, Nanjun, and Xiangyang, was overjoyed and discussed long-term plans.
pmwa1ngqdkr6ex.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說劉玄德自得荊州、南郡、襄陽，心中大喜，商議久遠之計。#1

pmwa1ngqdkseh7.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkseh7.text: 曹操引百萬之眾，被吾聊施小計，殺得片甲不回。
pmwa1ngqdkseh7.gloss: Cao.Cao lead million GEN multitude, PASS 1SG merely employ small.stratagem, kill DE piece.armor NEG return.
pmwa1ngqdkseh7.translation: Cao Cao led a million-strong host; by my merely employing a small stratagem, (I) killed them so that not a single piece of armor returned.
pmwa1ngqdkseh7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操引百萬之眾，被吾聊施小計，殺得片甲不回。#1

pmwa1ngqdktwa5.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdktwa5.text: 道榮捨死衝過，前面一員大將，攔住去路，大叫：「認得常山趙子龍否？」
pmwa1ngqdktwa5.gloss: Dao.Rong risk.death charge.through, front one CLF great.general, block way, loudly.shout: recognize-DE Chang.Shan Zhao.Zilong Q?
pmwa1ngqdktwa5.translation: Dao Rong risked death and charged through; ahead was a great general who blocked the way and shouted loudly: 'Do you recognize Zhao Zilong of Changshan?'
pmwa1ngqdktwa5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|道榮捨死衝過，前面一員大將，攔住去路，大叫：「認得常山趙子龍否？」#1

pmwa1ngqdku8pg.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdku8pg.text: 道榮料敵不過，又無處奔走，只得下馬請降。
pmwa1ngqdku8pg.gloss: Dao.Rong reckon enemy not.match, also no.place run.flee, only DE dismount.horse request.surrender.
pmwa1ngqdku8pg.translation: Dao Rong judged that he was no match for the enemy and had nowhere to flee, so he had no choice but to dismount and ask to surrender.
pmwa1ngqdku8pg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|道榮料敵不過，又無處奔走，只得下馬請降。#1

pmwa1ngqdkvhm2.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkvhm2.text: 道榮得放回寨，將前事實訴劉賢。
pmwa1ngqdkvhm2.gloss: Dao.Rong DE release return camp, BA previous matter truthfully tell Liu.Xian.
pmwa1ngqdkvhm2.translation: Dao Rong was released and returned to camp, and truthfully told Liu Xian what had happened before.
pmwa1ngqdkvhm2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|道榮得放回寨，將前事實訴劉賢。#1

pmwa1ngqdkwfot.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkwfot.gloss: if NEG DE city, willing receive military.order.
pmwa1ngqdkwfot.translation: If (I) do not take the city, (I) am willing to receive military punishment.
pmwa1ngqdkwfot.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|如不得城，願受軍令。」#1

pmwa1ngqdkxo62.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkxo62.text: 若擒不得趙雲，那時任太守投降不遲。」
pmwa1ngqdkxo62.gloss: if capture NEG DE Zhao.Yun, that.time let governor surrender NEG late.
pmwa1ngqdkxo62.translation: If (I) cannot capture Zhao Yun, then it will not be too late to let the governor surrender.
pmwa1ngqdkxo62.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若擒不得趙雲，那時任太守投降不遲。」#1

pmwa1ngqdkyaoo.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqdkyaoo.gloss: Zhao.Fan oppose NEG pass, only DE agree
pmwa1ngqdkyaoo.translation: Zhao Fan could not hold out against it, and had no choice but to agree.
pmwa1ngqdkyaoo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|趙範拗不過，只得應允。#1

pmwa1ngqekz127.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqekz127.text: 倘得不棄，結為兄弟，實為萬幸。」
pmwa1ngqekz127.gloss: if DE NEG reject, form COP brothers, truly COP great.fortune.
pmwa1ngqekz127.translation: If (you) do not reject (me), (and we) become sworn brothers, it would truly be a great fortune.
pmwa1ngqekz127.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|倘得不棄，結為兄弟，實為萬幸。」#1

pmwa1ngqel07jc.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqel07jc.text: 二人同鄉，同年，又同姓，十分相得。
pmwa1ngqel07jc.gloss: two person same hometown, same year, also same surname, very get.along DE
pmwa1ngqel07jc.translation: The two men were from the same hometown, were the same age, and also had the same surname, and they got along very well.
pmwa1ngqel07jc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|二人同鄉，同年，又同姓，十分相得。#1

pmwa1ngqel1j4i.section: 第五十二回　　　諸葛亮智辭魯肅　　　趙子龍計取桂陽
pmwa1ngqel1j4i.text: 嫂曰：『若得三件事兼全之人，我方嫁之：第一要文武雙全，名聞天下；第二要相貌堂堂，威儀出眾；第三要與家兄同姓。』

pmwa1ngqgmpt2q.translation: They saw another general come galloping out from the red-robed ranks and say in a stern voice: 'Wen Lie shot first; how do you get to contend for it?'

pmwa1ngqgmrrit.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾

pmwa1ngqgmseiu.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqgmseiu.text: 不意朝廷徵孤為點軍校尉，遂更其意，專欲為國家討賊立功，圖死後得題墓道曰：『漢故征西將軍曹侯之墓』，平生願足矣。

pmwa1ngqgmseiu.translation: I did not expect that the court would summon me to be Commandant of the Army; thereupon I changed my intention and wished only to attack rebels and establish merit for the state, planning that after my death I might have inscribed on my tomb path: 'The tomb of the late General Who Conquers the West of Han, Marquis Cao'—then my lifelong wish would be satisfied.

pmwa1ngqgmtydo.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqgmtydo.text: 誠恐一解兵柄，為人所害；孤敗則國家傾危，是以不得慕虛名而處實禍也。

pmwa1ngqgmtydo.translation: I truly fear that once I release military authority, I will be harmed by others; if I am defeated, the state will be in peril. That is why I cannot covet empty fame and put myself in real disaster.
pmwa1ngqgmtydo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|誠恐一解兵柄，為人所害；孤敗則國家傾危，是以不得慕虛名而處實禍也。#1

pmwa1ngqgmutis.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqgmutis.text: 程昱曰：「丞相在萬軍之中，矢石交攻之際，未嘗動心；今聞劉備得了荊州，何故如此失驚？」
pmwa1ngqgmutis.gloss: Cheng.Yu say: Chancellor be.at ten.thousand army GEN midst, arrow stone mutually attack GEN occasion, never move heart; now hear Liu.Bei DE PFV Jingzhou, what reason like.this lose.startle?
pmwa1ngqgmutis.translation: Cheng Yu said: "Chancellor, amid ten thousand troops, in the midst of arrows and stones flying back and forth, you have never been shaken; now on hearing that Liu Bei has got Jingzhou, why are you so startled?"
pmwa1ngqgmutis.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|程昱曰：「丞相在萬軍之中，矢石交攻之際，未嘗動心；今聞劉備得了荊州，何故如此失驚？」#1

pmwa1ngqgmvqny.gloss: Cao say: Liu.Bei person among GEN dragon COP, life never DE water.
pmwa1ngqgmvqny.translation: Cao said, 'Liu Bei is a dragon among men; in all his life he has never yet obtained water.'

pmwa1ngqgmwswu.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqgmwswu.text: 今得荊州，是困龍入大海矣。
pmwa1ngqgmwswu.gloss: now DE Jingzhou, COP trapped dragon enter great sea SFP

pmwa1ngqgmwswu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今得荊州，是困龍入大海矣。#1

pmwa1ngqgmx37c.translation: How could I not be moved by this!

pmwa1ngqgmy70w.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾

pmwa1ngqgmy70w.translation: Su said, "It is clearly written in the document: once (Liu Bei) has obtained Xichuan, then (he) will return (Jingzhou)."
pmwa1ngqgmy70w.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|肅曰：「文書上明白寫著，得了西川便還。」#1

pmwa1ngqgmz7xt.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾

pmwa1ngqgmz7xt.translation: Originally, when my master borrowed Jingzhou, he promised that once he had taken Xichuan he would return it.

pmwa1ngqgn0llg.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqgn0llg.text: 孔明曰：「吳侯既以親妹聘嫁皇叔，安得不從乎？

pmwa1ngqgn0llg.translation: Kongming said, "Since the Marquis of Wu has given his own younger sister to the Imperial Uncle in marriage, how could he not agree?"

pmwa1ngqgn1086.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾

pmwa1ngqgn1086.translation: Lu Su was a magnanimous and benevolent elder; seeing Xuande so grief-stricken, he had no choice but to agree.

pmwa1ngqgn2php.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqgn2php.text: 瑜曰：「子敬不必去見吳侯，再去荊州對劉備說：孫，劉兩家，既結為親，便是一家；若劉氏不忍去取西川，我東吳起兵去取；取得西川時，以作嫁資，卻把荊州交還東吳。」
pmwa1ngqgn2php.gloss: Yu say: Zijing need.not go see Marquis.of.Wu, again go Jingzhou to Liu.Bei say: Sun, Liu two family, since form kin, then COP one family; if Liu clan not.bear go take Xichuan, 1SG Eastern.Wu raise.troops go take; take DE Xichuan time, use.as dowry, then BA Jingzhou return Eastern.Wu.
pmwa1ngqgn2php.translation: Yu said: "Zijing, you need not go to see the Marquis of Wu; go again to Jingzhou and say to Liu Bei: 'The Sun and Liu families, since they have become relatives by marriage, are one family. If the Liu clan cannot bear to go and take Xichuan, my Eastern Wu will raise troops and go take it. When (we) have taken Xichuan, (we) will use it as a dowry and then return Jingzhou to Eastern Wu.'"

pmwa1ngqgn3hyo.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqgn3hyo.text: 孔明聽了，忙點頭曰：「難得吳侯好心！」

pmwa1ngqgn3hyo.translation: When Kongming heard this, he hurriedly nodded and said, "It is rare for Marquis Wu to be so kind-hearted!"
pmwa1ngqgn3hyo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明聽了，忙點頭曰：「難得吳侯好心！」#1

pmwa1ngqgn4inn.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqgn4inn.text: 瑜曰：「今為汝家之事，出兵遠征；勞軍之禮，休得輕易。」

pmwa1ngqgn4inn.translation: Yu said, 'Now, for your family's affair, (I) am sending troops on a distant expedition; do not take the ceremony of comforting the troops lightly.'
pmwa1ngqgn4inn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瑜曰：「今為汝家之事，出兵遠征；勞軍之禮，休得輕易。」#1

pmwa1ngqgn53n8.section: 第五十六回　　　曹操大宴銅雀臺　　　孔明三氣周公瑾
pmwa1ngqgn53n8.text: 只見一人打著令字旗，於馬前報說：「探得四路軍馬，一齊殺到：關某從江陵殺來，張飛從秭歸殺來，黃忠從公安殺來，魏延從彝陵小路殺來：四路正不知多少軍馬。
pmwa1ngqgn53n8.gloss: only see one person hold DUR command character flag , at horse.front report say : scout DE four route troops , all.together kill arrive : Guan.someone from Jiangling kill come , Zhang.Fei from Zigui kill come , Huang.Zhong from Gongan kill come , Wei.Yan from Yiling small road kill come : four route really not.know how.many troops .
pmwa1ngqgn53n8.translation: He only saw one man bearing a command-character flag, reporting before his horse: We have scouted four columns of troops all charging in together: a certain Guan is attacking from Jiangling, Zhang Fei from Zigui, Huang Zhong from Gong'an, and Wei Yan along the small road from Yiling: (we) really do not know how many troops are in these four columns.
pmwa1ngqgn53n8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只見一人打著令字旗，於馬前報說：「探得四路軍馬，一齊殺到：關某從江陵殺來，張飛從秭歸殺來，黃忠從公安殺來，魏延從彝陵小路殺來：四路正不知多少軍馬。#1

pmwa1ngqgn6weh.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事

pmwa1ngqgn6weh.translation: Yu was furious, gnashed his teeth, and said: “You say I cannot take Xichuan; I swear to take it!”
pmwa1ngqgn6weh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|瑜大怒，咬牙切齒曰：「你道我取不得西川，吾誓取之！」#1

pmwa1ngqgn7zqv.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqgn7zqv.text: 於路探聽得孫權已令魯肅為都督，周瑜靈柩已回柴桑。
