pmwa1ngqgn8sja.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqgn8sja.text: 統思玄德待我何薄，欲以才學動之；見孔明不在，只得勉強相辭而去。
pmwa1ngqgn8sja.gloss: Tong think Xuande treat 1SG how shabby, want with talent.learning move 3SG.OBJ; see Kongming NEG be.present, only DE reluctant take.leave CONJ go.
pmwa1ngqgn8sja.translation: Tong thought, 'How shabbily Xuande treats me,' and wanted to use his talent and learning to move him; seeing that Kongming was not there, he had no choice but to reluctantly take his leave and go.
pmwa1ngqgn8sja.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|統思玄德待我何薄，欲以才學動之；見孔明不在，只得勉強相辭而去。#1

pmwa1ngqgn9m6i.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqgn9m6i.text: 飛曰：「汝到任百餘日，終日在醉鄉，安得不廢政事？」
pmwa1ngqgn9m6i.gloss: Fei say: 2SG assume.post hundred.and.more day, all.day at drunk.land, how DE NEG neglect government.affair?
pmwa1ngqgn9m6i.translation: Fei said, "You have been in office for over a hundred days, spending all your days in the land of drunkenness; how could you not neglect government affairs?"
pmwa1ngqgn9m6i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|飛曰：「汝到任百餘日，終日在醉鄉，安得不廢政事？」#1

pmwa1ngqgnaq18.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqgnaq18.text: 玄德曰：「今日方得子敬書，卻未見先生之書。」
pmwa1ngqgnaq18.gloss: Xuande say: today only.then DE Zijing letter, but NEG see sir GEN letter.
pmwa1ngqgnaq18.translation: Xuande said, "Today I have just obtained Zijing's letter, but I have not yet seen your letter, sir."
pmwa1ngqgnaq18.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德曰：「今日方得子敬書，卻未見先生之書。」#1

pmwa1ngqgnbk8p.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqgnbk8p.text: 玄德喜曰：「昔司馬德操言：『伏龍、鳳雛，兩人得一，可安天下。』
pmwa1ngqgnbk8p.gloss: Xuande joy say: past Sima.Decao say: Crouching.Dragon, Fledgling.Phoenix, two person DE one, can peace world.
pmwa1ngqgnbk8p.translation: Xuande said with delight: "Long ago Sima Decao said: 'Crouching Dragon and Fledgling Phoenix — if you get one of the two, you can bring peace to the realm.'"
pmwa1ngqgnbk8p.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德喜曰：「昔司馬德操言：『伏龍、鳳雛，兩人得一，可安天下。』#1

pmwa1ngqgncwg8.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqgncwg8.text: 今吾二人皆得，漢室可興矣。」
pmwa1ngqgncwg8.gloss: now 1SG two person both DE, Han house can rise CRS
pmwa1ngqgncwg8.translation: Now that I have obtained both men, the Han house can rise again.
pmwa1ngqgncwg8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今吾二人皆得，漢室可興矣。」#1

pmwa1ngqgndk9u.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqgndk9u.text: 今聞玄德已得荊州，我正欲展昔日之志，而曹操反來召我，當是如何？」
pmwa1ngqgndk9u.gloss: now hear Xuande already DE Jingzhou, I just want unfold former.days GEN ambition, CONJ Cao.Cao instead come summon 1SG, should COP how?
pmwa1ngqgndk9u.translation: Now I hear Xuande has already obtained Jingzhou; I was just wanting to realize my former ambition, but Cao Cao instead comes to summon me—what should (I) do?
pmwa1ngqgndk9u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今聞玄德已得荊州，我正欲展昔日之志，而曹操反來召我，當是如何？」#1

pmwa1ngqgnenef.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqgnenef.text: 騰恐是操使來相探，急止之曰：「耳目較近，休得亂言。」
pmwa1ngqgnenef.gloss: Teng fear COP Cao.Cao envoy come probe, hurriedly stop 3SG say: ears.and.eyes relatively close, PROH DE speak.recklessly.
pmwa1ngqgnenef.translation: Teng, fearing that (the visitor) was an envoy of Cao Cao come to sound him out, hastily stopped him, saying, "Eyes and ears are close by; do not speak recklessly."
pmwa1ngqgnenef.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|騰恐是操使來相探，急止之曰：「耳目較近，休得亂言。」#1

pmwa1ngqgnf06d.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqgnf06d.text: 澤欲得春香，正無計可施。
pmwa1ngqgnf06d.gloss: Ze want DE Chunxiang, just not.have plan can.apply.
pmwa1ngqgnf06d.translation: Ze wanted to obtain Chunxiang, but was just unable to devise a plan.
pmwa1ngqgnf06d.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|澤欲得春香，正無計可施。#1

pmwa1ngqhng7kw.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqhng7kw.text: 忽聽得一聲砲響，紅旗開處，弓弩齊發。
pmwa1ngqhng7kw.gloss: suddenly hear DE one CLF cannon.boom, red.flag open place, bow.crossbow together shoot.
pmwa1ngqhng7kw.translation: Suddenly (he) heard a cannon boom; where the red flags parted, bows and crossbows all fired at once.
pmwa1ngqhng7kw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忽聽得一聲砲響，紅旗開處，弓弩齊發。#1

pmwa1ngqhnh6s3.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqhnh6s3.text: 馬休隨著馬騰左衝右突，不能得出。
pmwa1ngqhnh6s3.gloss: Ma.Xiu follow Ma.Teng left charge right dash, NEG can DE exit.
pmwa1ngqhnh6s3.translation: Ma Xiu followed Ma Teng, charging left and dashing right, but could not break out.
pmwa1ngqhnh6s3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|馬休隨著馬騰左衝右突，不能得出。#1

pmwa1ngqhni0on.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqhni0on.text: 苗澤因私害藎臣，春香未得反傷身。
pmwa1ngqhni0on.gloss: Miao.Ze because private harm loyal.minister, Chunxiang NEG DE instead harm body
pmwa1ngqhni0on.translation: Miao Ze, for private reasons, harmed a loyal minister; Chunxiang did not get (what she sought) and instead brought harm upon herself.
pmwa1ngqhni0on.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|苗澤因私害藎臣，春香未得反傷身。#1

pmwa1ngqhnjbed.section: 第五十七回　　　柴桑口臥龍弔喪　　　耒陽縣鳳雛理事
pmwa1ngqhnjbed.text: 岱大驚，只得棄了兵馬，扮作客商，連夜逃遁去了。
pmwa1ngqhnjbed.gloss: Ma.Dai greatly alarm, only DE abandon PFV troops, disguise.as merchant, same.night flee go CRS
pmwa1ngqhnjbed.translation: Ma Dai was greatly alarmed and had no choice but to abandon his troops, disguise himself as a merchant, and flee away that same night.
pmwa1ngqhnjbed.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|岱大驚，只得棄了兵馬，扮作客商，連夜逃遁去了。#1

pmwa1ngqhnkhat.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnkhat.text: 備意在西川，必無心救權；權無救則力乏兵衰，江東之地，必為丞相所得。
pmwa1ngqhnkhat.gloss: Liu.Bei intention be.at Xichuan, certainly no.mind rescue Sun.Quan; Sun.Quan no rescue then strength.exhausted troops.decline, Jiangdong GEN land, certainly PASS chancellor P DE.
pmwa1ngqhnkhat.translation: Liu Bei's intention is in Xichuan; he will certainly have no mind to rescue Sun Quan. If Sun Quan receives no rescue, then his strength will be exhausted and his troops weakened, and the land of Jiangdong will certainly be obtained by the Chancellor.
pmwa1ngqhnkhat.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|備意在西川，必無心救權；權無救則力乏兵衰，江東之地，必為丞相所得。#1

pmwa1ngqhnlvhw.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnlvhw.text: 若得江東，則荊州一鼓可平也。
pmwa1ngqhnlvhw.gloss: if DE Jiangdong, then Jingzhou one.drum can pacify SFP
pmwa1ngqhnlvhw.translation: If (we) obtain Jiangdong, then Jingzhou can be pacified at one stroke.
pmwa1ngqhnlvhw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若得江東，則荊州一鼓可平也。#1

pmwa1ngqhnmcsf.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnmcsf.text: 只須如此如此，長安唾手可得。」
pmwa1ngqhnmcsf.gloss: only need thus thus, Chang.an spit hand DE obtain.
pmwa1ngqhnmcsf.translation: (You) need only do such and such, and Chang'an can be taken with ease.
pmwa1ngqhnmcsf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只須如此如此，長安唾手可得。」#1

pmwa1ngqhnnb0q.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnnb0q.text: 馬超、韓遂得了城池，賞勞三軍。
pmwa1ngqhnnb0q.gloss: Ma.Chao, Han.Sui DE PFV city, reward three army
pmwa1ngqhnnb0q.translation: Ma Chao and Han Sui obtained the city and rewarded the three armies.
pmwa1ngqhnnb0q.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|馬超、韓遂得了城池，賞勞三軍。#1

pmwa1ngqhnov1f.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnov1f.text: 又見馬超生得面如傅粉，脣若抹硃；腰細膀寬，聲雄力猛；白袍銀鎧，手執長鎗，立馬陣前；上首龐德，下首馬岱。
pmwa1ngqhnov1f.gloss: also see Ma.Chao born DE face like apply.powder, lip like smear.vermilion; waist slender shoulder broad, voice powerful strength fierce; white.robe silver.armor, hand hold long.spear, rein.horse formation.front; upper.side Pang.De, lower.side Ma.Dai.
pmwa1ngqhnov1f.translation: (Cao Cao) also saw that Ma Chao was born with a face like applied powder and lips as if smeared with vermilion; a slender waist and broad shoulders, a powerful voice and fierce strength; in a white robe and silver armor, holding a long spear in his hand, reining his horse before the formation; Pang De on his upper side and Ma Dai on his lower side.
pmwa1ngqhnov1f.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|又見馬超生得面如傅粉，脣若抹硃；腰細膀寬，聲雄力猛；白袍銀鎧，手執長鎗，立馬陣前；上首龐德，下首馬岱。#1

pmwa1ngqhnpplu.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnpplu.text: 兩馬交戰，鬥得八九合，于禁敗走。
pmwa1ngqhnpplu.gloss: two horse engage.in.battle, fight DE eight.nine round, Yu.Jin defeated flee
pmwa1ngqhnpplu.translation: The two horses engaged in battle; they fought eight or nine rounds, and Yu Jin was defeated and fled.
pmwa1ngqhnpplu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|兩馬交戰，鬥得八九合，于禁敗走。#1

pmwa1ngqhnqh3b.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnqh3b.text: 西涼兵來得勢猛，左右將佐皆抵擋不住。
pmwa1ngqhnqh3b.gloss: Xiliang troops come DE force.fierce, left.right generals.officers all withstand NEG hold.
pmwa1ngqhnqh3b.translation: The Xiliang troops came on with such fierce force that the generals and officers on either side could not withstand them.
pmwa1ngqhnqh3b.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|西涼兵來得勢猛，左右將佐皆抵擋不住。#1

pmwa1ngqhnrpa9.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnrpa9.text: 操在亂軍中，只聽得西涼軍大叫：「穿紅袍的是曹操！」
pmwa1ngqhnrpa9.gloss: Cao at chaotic.army middle, only hear DE Xiliang.army loudly.shout: wear red robe NMLZ COP Cao.Cao!
pmwa1ngqhnrpa9.translation: Cao (Cao), amid the routed troops, only heard the Xiliang soldiers shout loudly: “The one in the red robe is Cao Cao!”
pmwa1ngqhnrpa9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操在亂軍中，只聽得西涼軍大叫：「穿紅袍的是曹操！」#1

pmwa1ngqhnsou2.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnsou2.text: 操就馬上急脫下紅袍，又聽得大叫：「長髯者是曹操！」
pmwa1ngqhnsou2.gloss: Cao.Cao then on.horseback urgently take.off red.robe, again hear DE loud.shout: long.beard one.who COP Cao.Cao!
pmwa1ngqhnsou2.translation: Cao Cao then hurriedly took off his red robe on horseback, and again heard a loud shout: "The one with the long beard is Cao Cao!"
pmwa1ngqhnsou2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操就馬上急脫下紅袍，又聽得大叫：「長髯者是曹操！」#1

pmwa1ngqhnth46.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnth46.gloss: Cao.Cao startled DE horsewhip fall ground
pmwa1ngqhnth46.translation: Cao Cao was so startled that his horsewhip fell to the ground.
pmwa1ngqhnth46.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操驚得馬鞭墜地。#1

pmwa1ngqhnumc3.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnumc3.translation: Cao Cao escaped with his life.
pmwa1ngqhnumc3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操得命走脫。#1

pmwa1ngqhnvsco.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnvsco.text: 曹操回寨，卻得曹仁死據定了寨柵，因此不曾多折軍馬。
pmwa1ngqhnvsco.gloss: Cao.Cao return camp, yet DE Cao.Ren to.death defend firm PFV stockade, therefore not.ever much lose army.horse.
pmwa1ngqhnvsco.translation: Cao Cao returned to the camp; but Cao Ren had defended the stockade to the death and held it firm, so he had not lost many troops.
pmwa1ngqhnvsco.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操回寨，卻得曹仁死據定了寨柵，因此不曾多折軍馬。#1

pmwa1ngqhnw781.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnw781.text: 徐晃進曰：「今丞相盛兵在此，賊亦全部見屯關上，此去河西，必無準備；若得一軍暗渡蒲阪津，先截賊歸路，丞相逕發河北擊之，賊兩不相應，勢必危矣。」
pmwa1ngqhnw781.gloss: Xu.Huang step.forward say : now chancellor mass.troops at here , rebel also all currently station pass.top , this go Hexi , surely not.have preparation ; if DE one army secretly cross Puban.Ford , first cut.off rebel return.road , chancellor directly dispatch Hebei attack 3PL , rebel two NEG support.each.other , situation surely perilous SFP .
pmwa1ngqhnw781.translation: Xu Huang stepped forward and said, "Now the Chancellor has massed his troops here, and the rebels have also all their forces currently stationed at the pass. The route from here to Hexi is surely unprepared. If we can get one army to secretly cross Puban Ford and first cut off the rebels' retreat, while the Chancellor directly sends forth (troops) from Hebei to attack them, the rebels will be unable to support each other, and their situation will surely be perilous."
pmwa1ngqhnw781.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|徐晃進曰：「今丞相盛兵在此，賊亦全部見屯關上，此去河西，必無準備；若得一軍暗渡蒲阪津，先截賊歸路，丞相逕發河北擊之，賊兩不相應，勢必危矣。」#1

pmwa1ngqhnx2am.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnx2am.text: 操兵不得渡，不消二十日，河東糧盡，操兵必亂，卻循河南而擊之，操可擒矣。」
pmwa1ngqhnx2am.gloss: Cao troops NEG DE cross, less.than twenty day, Hedong grain exhaust, Cao troops surely be.in.disorder, then follow river south CONJ attack 3PL, Cao can capture SFP.
pmwa1ngqhnx2am.translation: Cao's troops will be unable to cross; in less than twenty days the grain in Hedong will be exhausted, and Cao's troops will surely fall into disorder. Then (we) go along the south of the river and attack them, and Cao can be captured.
pmwa1ngqhnx2am.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操兵不得渡，不消二十日，河東糧盡，操兵必亂，卻循河南而擊之，操可擒矣。」#1

pmwa1ngqhnyb1c.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnyb1c.text: 眾皆認得是馬超，一擁下船。
pmwa1ngqhnyb1c.gloss: crowd all recognize-DE COP Ma.Chao, swarm go.down boat
pmwa1ngqhnyb1c.translation: Everyone recognized that it was Ma Chao, and they rushed down to the boats in a swarm.
pmwa1ngqhnyb1c.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾皆認得是馬超，一擁下船。#1

pmwa1ngqhnzcj9.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqhnzcj9.text: 只聽得人喊馬嘶，蜂擁而來，船上一將躍身上岸，呼曰：「賊至矣！
pmwa1ngqhnzcj9.gloss: only hear DE man shout horse neigh, swarm CONJ come, boat on one general leap body go.ashore, shout say: bandit arrive SFP!
pmwa1ngqhnzcj9.translation: Only the shouts of men and the neighing of horses were heard as (they) came swarming; a general on the boat leapt ashore and shouted: "The bandits have arrived!"
pmwa1ngqhnzcj9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只聽得人喊馬嘶，蜂擁而來，船上一將躍身上岸，呼曰：「賊至矣！#1

pmwa1ngqho0bhn.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqho0bhn.text: 回頭視之，馬超已離不得百餘步。
pmwa1ngqho0bhn.gloss: turn.around look 3SG, Ma.Chao already be.away NEG DE hundred.odd pace.
pmwa1ngqho0bhn.translation: He turned his head to look: Ma Chao was already no more than a hundred-odd paces away.
pmwa1ngqho0bhn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|回頭視之，馬超已離不得百餘步。#1

pmwa1ngqho1jjy.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqho1jjy.text: 西涼兵見之，都回身爭取牛馬，無心追趕，曹操因此得脫。
pmwa1ngqho1jjy.gloss: Xiliang soldier see 3SG, all turn.around scramble.for cattle.horse, no.mind pursue, Cao.Cao therefore DE escape.
pmwa1ngqho1jjy.translation: When the Xiliang soldiers saw this, they all turned around and scrambled for the cattle and horses, with no mind to pursue; Cao Cao thus managed to escape.
pmwa1ngqho1jjy.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|西涼兵見之，都回身爭取牛馬，無心追趕，曹操因此得脫。#1

pmwa1ngqho2fnr.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqho2fnr.text: 諸將聽得曹操在河中逃難，急來救時，操已登岸。
pmwa1ngqho2fnr.gloss: all.generals hear DE Cao.Cao at.river.middle escape.flee, rush.come.save when, Cao already get.onto.shore
pmwa1ngqho2fnr.translation: The generals heard that Cao Cao was escaping in the river, and when they rushed to save him, Cao Cao had already gotten onto the shore.
pmwa1ngqho2fnr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|諸將聽得曹操在河中逃難，急來救時，操已登岸。#1

pmwa1ngqho3apc.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqho3apc.text: 超曰：「以姪愚意，還只拒住北岸，使彼不得渡河，乃為上策。」
pmwa1ngqho3apc.gloss: Ma.Chao say: according.to nephew foolish opinion, just block.hold north bank, cause 3PL NEG DE cross river, then COP best.plan.
pmwa1ngqho3apc.translation: Ma Chao said, “In your nephew’s foolish opinion, just holding the north bank and preventing them from crossing the river would be the best plan.”
pmwa1ngqho3apc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|超曰：「以姪愚意，還只拒住北岸，使彼不得渡河，乃為上策。」#1

pmwa1ngqho46s9.section: 第五十八回　　　馬孟起興兵雪恨　　　曹阿瞞割鬚棄袍
pmwa1ngqho46s9.text: 四面伏兵皆出，只圍得三十騎。
pmwa1ngqho46s9.gloss: four side ambush.soldier all come.out, only surround DE thirty rider
pmwa1ngqho46s9.translation: The ambush soldiers on all four sides all came out, and only surrounded thirty riders.
pmwa1ngqho46s9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|四面伏兵皆出，只圍得三十騎。#1

pmwa1ngqho5c6v.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqho5c6v.text: 馬超得書，謂韓遂曰：「曹操雖然許和，奸雄難測。
pmwa1ngqho5c6v.gloss: Ma.Chao DE letter, say Han.Sui say: Cao.Cao although permit peace, villain.hero hard fathom.
pmwa1ngqho5c6v.translation: Ma Chao received the letter and said to Han Sui: "Although Cao Cao has agreed to peace, a treacherous hero is hard to fathom.
pmwa1ngqho5c6v.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|馬超得書，謂韓遂曰：「曹操雖然許和，奸雄難測。#1

pmwa1ngqho6eb5.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqho6eb5.gloss: how DE realm peaceful together rejoice Q!
pmwa1ngqho6eb5.translation: How can we have the realm at peace and rejoice together!
pmwa1ngqho6eb5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|安得天下清平共樂耶！」#1

pmwa1ngqho75qs.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqho75qs.gloss: Ma.Chao say: how DE NEG speak military.affairs Q?
pmwa1ngqho75qs.translation: Ma Chao said, "How could (he) not speak of military affairs?"
pmwa1ngqho75qs.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|超曰：「安得不言軍務乎？」#1

pmwa1ngqho8b3b.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqho8b3b.text: 超聽得大怒，挺鎗驟馬，便刺韓遂。
pmwa1ngqho8b3b.gloss: Chao hear DE furious, raise spear spur horse, then stab Han.Sui
pmwa1ngqho8b3b.translation: When Chao (Ma Chao) heard this he was furious; he raised his spear, spurred on his horse, and then stabbed at Han Sui.
pmwa1ngqho8b3b.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|超聽得大怒，挺鎗驟馬，便刺韓遂。#1

pmwa1ngqho9g85.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqho9g85.text: 楊秋曰：「馬超倚仗勇武，常有欺凌主公之心，便勝得曹操，怎肯相讓？
pmwa1ngqho9g85.gloss: Yang.Qiu say: Ma.Chao rely.on brave.martial, often have bully lord GEN heart, even.if win DE Cao.Cao, how willing yield?
pmwa1ngqho9g85.translation: Yang Qiu said: 'Ma Chao relies on his martial bravery and often harbors the intention of bullying his lord; even if he can defeat Cao Cao, how could he be willing to yield (to him)?'
pmwa1ngqho9g85.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|楊秋曰：「馬超倚仗勇武，常有欺凌主公之心，便勝得曹操，怎肯相讓？#1

pmwa1ngqhoahy3.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqhoahy3.text: 楊秋曰：「事已至此，不得不然。」
pmwa1ngqhoahy3.gloss: Yang.Qiu say: matter already reach this, NEG DE NEG so.
pmwa1ngqhoahy3.translation: Yang Qiu said: "The matter has already come to this; (we) have no choice but to do so."
pmwa1ngqhoahy3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|楊秋曰：「事已至此，不得不然。」#1

pmwa1ngqhob7xz.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqhob7xz.text: 超潛入韓遂帳中，只見五將與韓遂密語，只聽得楊秋口中說道：「事不宜遲，可速行之！」
pmwa1ngqhob7xz.gloss: Chao secretly enter Han.Sui tent.inside, only see five general with Han.Sui whisper, only hear DE Yang.Qiu mouth.in say: matter NEG should delay, can quickly do OBJ!
pmwa1ngqhob7xz.translation: Ma Chao stealthily entered Han Sui’s tent, where he just saw five generals whispering with Han Sui, and he only heard Yang Qiu say aloud: 'The matter should not be delayed; (we) can carry it out quickly!'
pmwa1ngqhob7xz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|超潛入韓遂帳中，只見五將與韓遂密語，只聽得楊秋口中說道：「事不宜遲，可速行之！」#1

pmwa1ngqhocqta.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqhocqta.text: 恰好于禁從馬超背後趕來，禁開弓射馬超，超聽得背後弦響，急閃過，卻射中前面李堪，落馬而死。
pmwa1ngqhocqta.gloss: just.then Yu.Jin from Ma.Chao behind come.hurrying, Yu.Jin draw.bow shoot Ma.Chao, Ma.Chao hear DE behind bowstring sound, quickly dodge.aside, but shoot.hit in.front Li.Kan, fall.from.horse CONJ die.
pmwa1ngqhocqta.translation: Just then Yu Jin came up from behind Ma Chao; Yu Jin drew his bow and shot at Ma Chao. Ma Chao heard the bowstring sound behind him and quickly dodged aside, but (the arrow) struck Li Kan in front, (who) fell from his horse and died.
pmwa1ngqhocqta.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|恰好于禁從馬超背後趕來，禁開弓射馬超，超聽得背後弦響，急閃過，卻射中前面李堪，落馬而死。#1

pmwa1ngqhodl2i.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqhodl2i.text: 如得首級者賞千金，封萬戶侯。
pmwa1ngqhodl2i.gloss: if DE head NMLZ reward thousand.gold, enfeoff ten.thousand.household.marquis.
pmwa1ngqhodl2i.translation: Whoever obtains (his) head will be rewarded with a thousand pieces of gold and enfeoffed as a marquis of ten thousand households.
pmwa1ngqhodl2i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|如得首級者賞千金，封萬戶侯。#1

pmwa1ngqhoej4i.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqhoej4i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾將得令。#1

pmwa1ngqhofxic.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqhofxic.text: 馬超顧不得人馬困乏，只顧奔走。
pmwa1ngqhofxic.gloss: Ma.Chao attend NEG DE men.horses exhausted, only.care flee
pmwa1ngqhofxic.translation: Ma Chao could not spare a thought for his exhausted men and horses, and only cared about fleeing.
pmwa1ngqhofxic.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|馬超顧不得人馬困乏，只顧奔走。#1

pmwa1ngqhogar6.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqhogar6.text: 止剩得三十餘騎，與龐德、馬岱望隴西、臨洮而去。
pmwa1ngqhogar6.gloss: only remain DE thirty odd rider, with Pang.De, Ma.Dai toward Longxi, Lintao CONJ go.
pmwa1ngqhogar6.translation: Only thirty-odd horsemen remained, and (Ma Chao) headed with Pang De and Ma Dai toward Longxi and Lintao.
pmwa1ngqhogar6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|止剩得三十餘騎，與龐德、馬岱望隴西、臨洮而去。#1

pmwa1ngqhohi20.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqhohi20.text: 楊阜曰：「馬超有呂布之勇，深得羌人之心。
pmwa1ngqhohi20.gloss: Yang.Fu say: Ma.Chao have Lü.Bu GEN courage, deeply DE Qiang.people GEN heart.
pmwa1ngqhohi20.translation: Yang Fu said: "Ma Chao has the bravery of Lü Bu and has deeply won the hearts of the Qiang people.
pmwa1ngqhohi20.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|楊阜曰：「馬超有呂布之勇，深得羌人之心。#1

pmwa1ngqhoi9wu.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqhoi9wu.text: 吾故盛兵皆聚於潼關前，使賊盡南守，而河西不準備，故徐晃、朱靈得渡也。
pmwa1ngqhoi9wu.gloss: 1SG therefore mass.troops all gather at Tong.Pass front, make bandit all south guard, and west.of.river NEG prepare, therefore Xu.Huang, Zhu.Ling DE cross SFP
pmwa1ngqhoi9wu.translation: So I massed all the troops in front of Tong Pass, making the rebels guard entirely to the south while the west of the river was unprepared; therefore Xu Huang and Zhu Ling were able to cross.
pmwa1ngqhoi9wu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吾故盛兵皆聚於潼關前，使賊盡南守，而河西不準備，故徐晃、朱靈得渡也。#1

pmwa1ngqhojzt3.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqhojzt3.gloss: NMLZ DE surrendered.troops, distribute each unit.
pmwa1ngqhojzt3.translation: The surrendered troops that were obtained were distributed among the various units.
pmwa1ngqhojzt3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|所得降兵，分撥各部。#1

pmwa1ngqiok7bq.section: 第五十九回　　　許褚裸衣鬥馬超　　　曹操抹書間韓遂
pmwa1ngqiok7bq.text: 璋平生懦弱，聞得此信，心中大憂，急聚眾官商議。
pmwa1ngqiok7bq.gloss: Zhang all.life cowardly, hear DE this news, heart.inside greatly.worry, urgently gather many.official discuss.
pmwa1ngqiok7bq.translation: Zhang had been cowardly all his life; when he heard this news, he was greatly worried at heart and urgently gathered the assembled officials to discuss it.
pmwa1ngqiok7bq.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|璋平生懦弱，聞得此信，心中大憂，急聚眾官商議。#1

pmwa1ngqiolzjp.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqiolzjp.text: 其人生得額钁頭尖，鼻偃齒露，身短不滿五尺，言語有若銅鐘。
pmwa1ngqiolzjp.gloss: DEM person born DE forehead hoe head pointed, nose flat teeth exposed, body short NEG full five chi, speech be.like bronze.bell.
pmwa1ngqiolzjp.translation: The man had a hoe-like forehead and a pointed head, a flat nose and protruding teeth; his body was short, not quite five chi, and his voice was like a bronze bell.
pmwa1ngqiolzjp.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|其人生得額钁頭尖，鼻偃齒露，身短不滿五尺，言語有若銅鐘。#1

pmwa1ngqiomdnn.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqiomdnn.text: 原來曹操自破馬超回，傲睨得志，每日飲宴，無事少出，國政皆在相府商議。
pmwa1ngqiomdnn.gloss: turn.out Cao.Cao after defeat Ma.Chao return, look.disdainfully DE ambition, every.day drink.feast, no.affair seldom go.out, state.affairs all at chancellor.residence discuss.
pmwa1ngqiomdnn.translation: It turned out that, after Cao Cao defeated Ma Chao and returned, he was arrogant and self-satisfied; every day he drank and feasted, and when there was no business he seldom went out, and all state affairs were discussed in the Chancellor's residence.
pmwa1ngqiomdnn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|原來曹操自破馬超回，傲睨得志，每日飲宴，無事少出，國政皆在相府商議。#1

pmwa1ngqions6a.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqions6a.text: 張松候了三日，方得通過姓名。
pmwa1ngqions6a.gloss: Zhang.Song wait PFV three day, only.then DE pass.through name
pmwa1ngqions6a.translation: Zhang Song waited three days, and only then managed to have his name passed in (announced).
pmwa1ngqions6a.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張松候了三日，方得通過姓名。#1

pmwa1ngqiooxu0.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqiooxu0.text: 松曰：「南有孫權，北有張魯，西有劉備，至少者亦帶甲十餘萬，豈得謂太平耶？」
pmwa1ngqiooxu0.gloss: Song say: south have Sun.Quan, north have Zhang.Lu, west have Liu.Bei, at.least NMLZ also wear.armor ten.odd ten.thousand, how DE call great.peace Q?
pmwa1ngqiooxu0.translation: Zhang Song said: 'In the south there is Sun Quan, in the north there is Zhang Lu, in the west there is Liu Bei; the least of them also has more than a hundred thousand armored troops—how can (you) call it Great Peace?'
pmwa1ngqiooxu0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|松曰：「南有孫權，北有張魯，西有劉備，至少者亦帶甲十餘萬，豈得謂太平耶？」#1

pmwa1ngqiop45v.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqiop45v.text: 幸得丞相看汝遠來之面，不見罪責。
pmwa1ngqiop45v.gloss: fortunately DE chancellor see 2SG far.come GEN face, NEG see blame.punish
pmwa1ngqiop45v.translation: Fortunately, the Chancellor, out of consideration for your having come from afar, has not blamed and punished (you).
pmwa1ngqiop45v.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幸得丞相看汝遠來之面，不見罪責。#1

pmwa1ngqioq99b.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqioq99b.gloss: regret cloud mountain distant, NEG DE hear teaching.
pmwa1ngqioq99b.translation: I regret that the clouds and mountains are distant, (so I) have not been able to hear your teachings.
pmwa1ngqioq99b.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|恨雲山遙遠，不得聽教。#1

pmwa1ngqior0t1.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqior0t1.text: 玄德舉酒酌松曰：「甚荷大夫不棄，留敘三日；今日相別，不知何時再得聽教。」
pmwa1ngqior0t1.gloss: Xuande raise wine pour Song say: very be.grateful grand.master NEG reject, keep converse three day; today each.other part, NEG know what.time again DE hear teaching.
pmwa1ngqior0t1.translation: Xuande raised his wine and toasted Song, saying, "I am greatly indebted to you, Grand Master, for not rejecting me and keeping me to converse for three days; now that we part today, I do not know when I shall again be able to hear your instructions."
pmwa1ngqior0t1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德舉酒酌松曰：「甚荷大夫不棄，留敘三日；今日相別，不知何時再得聽教。」#1

pmwa1ngqioske0.gloss: other.people how can DE CONJ shake Q ?

pmwa1ngqiotr8i.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqiotr8i.text: 劉季玉雖有益州之地，稟性暗弱，不能任賢用能；加之張魯在北，時思侵犯，人心離散，思得明主。
pmwa1ngqiotr8i.gloss: Liu.Jiyu although have Yizhou GEN land, innate.nature dim.weak, NEG can employ worthy use capable; in.addition Zhang.Lu at north, often think invade, people heart scattered, long.for DE enlightened.lord.
pmwa1ngqiotr8i.translation: Although Liu Jiyu possesses the land of Yizhou, his natural disposition is dim and weak, and he cannot employ the worthy and use the capable; moreover, Zhang Lu is in the north and often thinks of invading, the people's hearts are scattered, and they long for an enlightened lord.
pmwa1ngqiotr8i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|劉季玉雖有益州之地，稟性暗弱，不能任賢用能；加之張魯在北，時思侵犯，人心離散，思得明主。#1

pmwa1ngqiou696.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqiou696.text: 松曰：「松遇明主，不得不盡情相告，豈敢望報乎？」
pmwa1ngqiou696.gloss: Song say: Song meet wise.lord, NEG DE NEG fully tell.you, how dare hope reward Q?
pmwa1ngqiou696.translation: Song said, "I, Song, have met a wise lord; I have no choice but to tell (you) everything—how would I dare hope for a reward?"
pmwa1ngqiou696.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|松曰：「松遇明主，不得不盡情相告，豈敢望報乎？」#1

pmwa1ngqiovomk.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqiovomk.gloss: far DE people.heart, near DE people.support
pmwa1ngqiovomk.translation: (Liu Bei) wins people's hearts from afar and popular support near at hand.

pmwa1ngqiowbj3.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqiowbj3.gloss: far DE people.heart, near DE people.support
pmwa1ngqiowbj3.translation: (Liu Bei) wins people's hearts from afar and popular support near at hand.

pmwa1ngqioxp66.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqioxp66.text: 豈不聞『逐兔先得』之語乎？
pmwa1ngqioxp66.gloss: Q NEG hear chase rabbit first DE ATTR saying Q?
pmwa1ngqioxp66.translation: Have you not heard the saying 'he who chases the rabbit first gets it'?
pmwa1ngqioxp66.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|豈不聞『逐兔先得』之語乎？#1

pmwa1ngqioy5p0.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqioy5p0.text: 統曰：「荊州東有孫權，北有曹操難以得志。
pmwa1ngqioy5p0.gloss: Tong say: Jingzhou east have Sun.Quan, north have Cao.Cao hard.to DE aim.
pmwa1ngqioy5p0.translation: Pang Tong said: "To the east of Jingzhou there is Sun Quan, to the north there is Cao Cao; it is hard to achieve one's aim.
pmwa1ngqioy5p0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|統曰：「荊州東有孫權，北有曹操難以得志。#1

pmwa1ngqioz7l5.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqioz7l5.text: 張松曰：「今蜀中文官各顧妻子，不復為主公效力；諸將恃功驕傲，各有外意；不得劉皇叔，則敵攻於外，民攻於內，必敗之道也。」
pmwa1ngqioz7l5.gloss: Zhang.Song say: now Shu.within civil.official each look.after wife.children, NEG again for lord exert.effort; PL general rely.on merit arrogant, each have outside.intention; NEG DE Liu.Imperial.Uncle, then enemy attack at outside, people attack at inside, necessarily defeat ATTR way SFP.
pmwa1ngqioz7l5.translation: Zhang Song said: Now the civil officials in Shu each look after their wives and children and no longer exert themselves for the lord; the generals, relying on their merits, are arrogant and each has outside intentions. If we do not get Imperial Uncle Liu, then enemies will attack from outside and the people will attack from within; this is the way to certain defeat.
pmwa1ngqioz7l5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張松曰：「今蜀中文官各顧妻子，不復為主公效力；諸將恃功驕傲，各有外意；不得劉皇叔，則敵攻於外，民攻於內，必敗之道也。」#1

pmwa1ngqip0kci.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqip0kci.text: 吾得他為外援，又何慮曹操、張魯耶？
pmwa1ngqip0kci.gloss: 1SG DE 3SG as outside.support, again what worry Cao.Cao, Zhang.Lu Q?
pmwa1ngqip0kci.translation: I have him as outside support — so what do I have to worry about from Cao Cao and Zhang Lu?
pmwa1ngqip0kci.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吾得他為外援，又何慮曹操、張魯耶？#1

pmwa1ngqip12ss.section: 第六十回　　　　張永年反難楊修　　　龐士元議取西蜀
pmwa1ngqip12ss.text: 統曰：「此非統之謀，是法孝直得張松密書，言事不宜遲，只在早晚當圖之。」
pmwa1ngqip12ss.gloss: Pang.Tong say: PROX NEG Pang.Tong GEN plan, COP Fa.Xiaozhi DE Zhang.Song secret.letter, say matter NEG suitable delay, only at morning.evening should plot 3SG.OBJ.
pmwa1ngqip12ss.translation: Pang Tong said, 'This is not my plan; it was Fa Xiaozhi who received Zhang Song's secret letter, saying the matter should not be delayed and should be acted on at once.'
pmwa1ngqip12ss.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|統曰：「此非統之謀，是法孝直得張松密書，言事不宜遲，只在早晚當圖之。」#1

pmwa1ngqip22wy.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqip22wy.text: 卻說龐統、法正二人，勸玄德就席間殺劉璋，西川唾手可得。
pmwa1ngqip22wy.gloss: meanwhile say Pang.Tong, Fa.Zheng two person, urge Xuande at banquet kill Liu.Zhang, Xichuan spit.hand can DE.
pmwa1ngqip22wy.translation: Meanwhile, Pang Tong and Fa Zheng urged Xuande to kill Liu Zhang right at the banquet; Western Chuan could be obtained easily.
pmwa1ngqip22wy.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說龐統、法正二人，勸玄德就席間殺劉璋，西川唾手可得。#1

pmwa1ngqip3ghr.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqip3ghr.text: 次日，復與劉璋宴於城中，彼此細敘衷曲，情好甚密，酒至半酣，龐統與法正商議曰：「事已至此，由不得主公了。」
pmwa1ngqip3ghr.gloss: next.day, again with Liu.Zhang banquet at city.inside, each.other in.detail.recount inner.feelings, affection very close, wine reach half.tipsy, Pang.Tong with Fa.Zheng discuss say: matter already reach this, up.to NEG DE lord CRS.
pmwa1ngqip3ghr.translation: The next day, (he) again feasted with Liu Zhang in the city; they recounted their innermost feelings to each other in detail, and their affection was very close. When the wine was half drunk, Pang Tong and Fa Zheng conferred, saying: 'The matter has already come to this; it is no longer up to our lord (to decide).'
pmwa1ngqip3ghr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|次日，復與劉璋宴於城中，彼此細敘衷曲，情好甚密，酒至半酣，龐統與法正商議曰：「事已至此，由不得主公了。」#1

pmwa1ngqip4nbi.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqip4nbi.text: 孫權立於軒下，自思：「此機會一失，荊襄何日可得？」
pmwa1ngqip4nbi.gloss: Sun.Quan stand at porch.under, REFL think: PROX opportunity once lose, Jing.Xiang what.day can DE?
pmwa1ngqip4nbi.translation: Sun Quan stood beneath the porch and thought to himself: "If this opportunity is lost, what day can Jing and Xiang be obtained?"
pmwa1ngqip4nbi.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孫權立於軒下，自思：「此機會一失，荊襄何日可得？」#1

pmwa1ngqip51tn.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqip51tn.gloss: if go DE late, fear NEG can see.each.other
pmwa1ngqip51tn.translation: If you go (there) late, I fear you will not be able to see her.
pmwa1ngqip51tn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|倘去得遲，恐不能相見。#1

pmwa1ngqip6w8e.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqip6w8e.text: 周善方欲開船，只聽得岸上有人大叫：「且休開船，容與夫人餞行！」
pmwa1ngqip6w8e.gloss: Zhou.Shan just be.about.to set.sail, only hear DE bank.on someone loudly.shout: for.now don't set.sail, allow for lady farewell.feast!
pmwa1ngqip6w8e.translation: Zhou Shan was just about to set sail when he only heard someone on the bank shout loudly: “Do not set sail yet; let (me) give the lady a farewell send-off!”
pmwa1ngqip6w8e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|周善方欲開船，只聽得岸上有人大叫：「且休開船，容與夫人餞行！」#1

pmwa1ngqip7s3b.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqip7s3b.text: 原來趙雲巡哨方回，聽得這個消息，吃了一驚，只帶四五騎旋風般沿江趕來。
pmwa1ngqip7s3b.gloss: turn.out Zhao.Yun patrol just return, hear DE this news, suffer PFV one fright, only bring four five rider whirlwind like along.river hurry come.
pmwa1ngqip7s3b.translation: It turned out that Zhao Yun had just returned from patrol; when he heard this news he was startled, and bringing only four or five riders he came hurrying along the river like a whirlwind.
pmwa1ngqip7s3b.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|原來趙雲巡哨方回，聽得這個消息，吃了一驚，只帶四五騎旋風般沿江趕來。#1

pmwa1ngqip8ij6.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqip8ij6.text: 欲要傍岸，又無幫手；欲要行兇，又恐礙於道理，進退不得。
pmwa1ngqip8ij6.gloss: want.to pull.in.to.bank, but not.have helper; want.to commit.violence, but fear be.hindered.by propriety, advance.and.retreat NEG DE.
pmwa1ngqip8ij6.translation: (Zhao Yun) wanted to pull in to the bank, but had no helpers; (he) wanted to commit violence, but feared that propriety would stand in the way; (he) could neither advance nor retreat.
pmwa1ngqip8ij6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|欲要傍岸，又無幫手；欲要行兇，又恐礙於道理，進退不得。#1

pmwa1ngqip9j8o.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqip9j8o.text: 趙雲孤掌難鳴，只護得阿斗，安能移舟傍岸？
pmwa1ngqip9j8o.gloss: Zhao.Yun lone.palm difficult sound, only protect DE A.Dou, how can move boat approach shore?
pmwa1ngqip9j8o.translation: Zhao Yun, with a single palm unable to make a sound (i.e. alone and powerless), could only protect A Dou; how could he move the boat to the shore?
pmwa1ngqip9j8o.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|趙雲孤掌難鳴，只護得阿斗，安能移舟傍岸？#1

pmwa1ngqipa4tp.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqipa4tp.text: 原來張飛巡哨，聽得這個消息，急來油江夾口，正撞著吳船，急忙截住。
pmwa1ngqipa4tp.gloss: turn.out Zhang.Fei patrol, hear DE this news, hurriedly come Youjiang fork.mouth, just bump.into Wu boat, hurriedly intercept stop.
pmwa1ngqipa4tp.translation: It turned out that Zhang Fei was on patrol and heard this news; he hurried to the mouth of the You River fork and happened to run into the Wu boats, and hastily intercepted them.
pmwa1ngqipa4tp.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|原來張飛巡哨，聽得這個消息，急來油江夾口，正撞著吳船，急忙截住。#1

pmwa1ngqipbeao.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqipbeao.translation: Everyone recognized that it was precisely Sun Quan.
pmwa1ngqipbeao.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾人認得正是孫權。#1

pmwa1ngqipc5pe.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqipc5pe.text: 操背後許褚縱馬舞刀，敵住二將，曹操得脫歸寨。
pmwa1ngqipc5pe.gloss: Cao.Cao behind Xu.Chu spur.horse brandish.blade, hold.off two general, Cao.Cao DE escape return camp.
pmwa1ngqipc5pe.translation: Xu Chu, behind Cao Cao, spurred his horse and brandished his blade, holding off the two generals, and Cao Cao escaped and returned to camp.
pmwa1ngqipc5pe.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操背後許褚縱馬舞刀，敵住二將，曹操得脫歸寨。#1

pmwa1ngqipdo3r.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqipdo3r.text: 丞相起兵，遷延日久，故孫權得以準備。
pmwa1ngqipdo3r.gloss: chancellor raise.troops, delay days.long, therefore Sun.Quan DE able prepare.
pmwa1ngqipdo3r.translation: The Chancellor raised troops, and the delay dragged on for many days, so Sun Quan was able to prepare.
pmwa1ngqipdo3r.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|丞相起兵，遷延日久，故孫權得以準備。#1

pmwa1ngqipedrr.section: 第六十一回　　　趙雲截江奪阿斗　　　孫權遺書退老瞞
pmwa1ngqipedrr.text: 書背後又批兩行云：「足下不死，孤不得安。」
pmwa1ngqipedrr.gloss: letter back also write two line say: you NEG die, 1SG NEG DE peaceful.
pmwa1ngqipedrr.translation: On the back of the letter he also wrote two lines: "If you do not die, I cannot be at peace."
pmwa1ngqipedrr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|書背後又批兩行云：「足下不死，孤不得安。」#1

pmwa1ngqipfxg5.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqipfxg5.text: 且說玄德在葭萌關日久，甚得民心。
pmwa1ngqipfxg5.gloss: moreover say Xuande at Jiameng.Pass time.long, very DE people heart
pmwa1ngqipfxg5.translation: Moreover, Xuande had been at Jiameng Pass for a long time and had greatly won the people's hearts.
pmwa1ngqipfxg5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|且說玄德在葭萌關日久，甚得民心。#1

pmwa1ngqipgk01.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqipgk01.text: 忽接得孔明文書，知孫夫人已回東吳。
pmwa1ngqipgk01.gloss: suddenly receive DE Kongming document, know Lady.Sun already return Eastern.Wu.
pmwa1ngqipgk01.translation: Suddenly (he) received Kongming's document and learned that Lady Sun had already returned to Eastern Wu.
pmwa1ngqipgk01.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忽接得孔明文書，知孫夫人已回東吳。#1

pmwa1ngqiph9q5.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqiph9q5.text: 若得軍馬錢糧，卻另作商議。」
pmwa1ngqiph9q5.gloss: if DE army horse money grain, then another make discuss
pmwa1ngqiph9q5.translation: If (I) obtain troops, horses, money and grain, then (we) will make other plans.
pmwa1ngqiph9q5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若得軍馬錢糧，卻另作商議。」#1

pmwa1ngqipihyt.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqipihyt.text: 書至成都，張松聽得說劉玄德欲回荊州，只道是真心，乃修書一封，欲令人送與玄德。
pmwa1ngqipihyt.gloss: letter arrive Chengdu, Zhang.Song hear DE say Liu.Xuande want return Jingzhou, only say COP true.heart, then write letter one CLF, want cause person send give Xuande.
pmwa1ngqipihyt.translation: When the letter reached Chengdu, Zhang Song heard it said that Liu Xuande wished to return to Jingzhou, and took it to be his true intention; so he wrote a letter and wanted to have someone deliver it to Xuande.
pmwa1ngqipihyt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|書至成都，張松聽得說劉玄德欲回荊州，只道是真心，乃修書一封，欲令人送與玄德。#1

pmwa1ngqipje6o.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqipje6o.text: 獻酬之間，忽落此書於地，被肅從人拾得。
pmwa1ngqipje6o.gloss: toast.exchange between, suddenly drop this letter on ground, PASS Zhang.Su attendant pick.up DE.
pmwa1ngqipje6o.translation: In the midst of the exchange of toasts, (Zhang Song) suddenly dropped this letter to the ground, and it was picked up by Zhang Su's attendant.
pmwa1ngqipje6o.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|獻酬之間，忽落此書於地，被肅從人拾得。#1

pmwa1ngqipkhzy.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqipkhzy.gloss: two general DE order CONJ go
pmwa1ngqipkhzy.translation: The two generals received the order and went off.
pmwa1ngqipkhzy.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|二將得令而去。#1

pmwa1ngqjplwp9.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjplwp9.text: 城上聽得是自家軍，即時開關。
pmwa1ngqjplwp9.gloss: wall on hear DE COP own.army, immediately open.pass
pmwa1ngqjplwp9.translation: Those on the city wall heard that it was their own army, and immediately opened the pass gate.
pmwa1ngqjplwp9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|城上聽得是自家軍，即時開關。#1

pmwa1ngqjpmcu3.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpmcu3.text: 大軍一擁而入，兵不血刃，得了涪關。
pmwa1ngqjpmcu3.gloss: great.army surge.together CONJ enter, weapon NEG blood blade, DE PFV Fu.Pass
pmwa1ngqjpmcu3.translation: The great army surged in all together; without bloodying a blade, they took Fu Pass.
pmwa1ngqjpmcu3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|大軍一擁而入，兵不血刃，得了涪關。#1

pmwa1ngqjpntja.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpntja.gloss: one DE one lose, heaven number natural.so
pmwa1ngqjpntja.translation: One gains, one loses — such is the fixed decree of Heaven.
pmwa1ngqjpntja.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|一得一失，天數當然。#1

pmwa1ngqjpolui.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpolui.text: 卻說玄德既得涪水關，與龐統商議進取雒城。
pmwa1ngqjpolui.gloss: meanwhile say Xuande already DE Fu.River.Pass, with Pang.Tong discuss advance.take Luo.City
pmwa1ngqjpolui.translation: Meanwhile, after Xuande had taken the Fu River Pass, he discussed with Pang Tong advancing to seize Luocheng.
pmwa1ngqjpolui.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說玄德既得涪水關，與龐統商議進取雒城。#1

pmwa1ngqjpp4jl.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpp4jl.text: 玄德曰：「老將軍率本部人馬，前至雒城，如取得冷苞、鄧賢營寨，必當重賞。」
pmwa1ngqjpp4jl.gloss: Xuande say: old.general lead own.unit troops, advance.to Luocheng, if obtain DE Leng.Bao, Deng.Xian camp, certainly FUT heavily.reward.
pmwa1ngqjpp4jl.translation: Xuande said: Old General, lead your own troops forward to Luocheng; if you capture Leng Bao's and Deng Xian's camps, I will certainly reward you generously.
pmwa1ngqjpp4jl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德曰：「老將軍率本部人馬，前至雒城，如取得冷苞、鄧賢營寨，必當重賞。」#1

pmwa1ngqjpqa4r.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpqa4r.text: 忽帳下一人出曰：「老將軍年紀高大，如何去得？
pmwa1ngqjpqa4r.gloss: suddenly tent.under one man out say: old.general age tall.great, how DE go?
pmwa1ngqjpqa4r.translation: Suddenly one man came forward from under the tent and said: "The old general is advanced in years and of great age — how can he go?"
pmwa1ngqjpqa4r.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忽帳下一人出曰：「老將軍年紀高大，如何去得？#1

pmwa1ngqjpr22x.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpr22x.text: 恐老將軍擒他不得，豈不誤了主公大事？
pmwa1ngqjpr22x.gloss: fear old general capture 3SG NEG DE, how NEG ruin PFV lord great affair?
pmwa1ngqjpr22x.translation: I fear the old general cannot capture them; would that not ruin the lord's great undertaking?
pmwa1ngqjpr22x.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|恐老將軍擒他不得，豈不誤了主公大事？#1

pmwa1ngqjpso74.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpso74.gloss: win DE NMLZ then go, how.about?
pmwa1ngqjpso74.translation: Whoever wins goes, how about that?
pmwa1ngqjpso74.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|贏得的便去，何如？」#1

pmwa1ngqjpte6u.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpte6u.text: 吾與你二人勸解，休得爭論。」
pmwa1ngqjpte6u.gloss: 1SG with 2SG two.person mediate, PROH DE argue.
pmwa1ngqjpte6u.translation: I will mediate between you two; do not argue.
pmwa1ngqjpte6u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吾與你二人勸解，休得爭論。」#1

pmwa1ngqjpu0ni.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpu0ni.gloss: if first seize DE NMLZ then COP head.merit .
pmwa1ngqjpu0ni.translation: If someone is the first to seize (a camp), that will count as the top merit.
pmwa1ngqjpu0ni.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|如先奪得者便為頭功。」#1

pmwa1ngqjpv7iw.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpv7iw.text: 軍士得令，都飽餐一頓，馬摘鈴，人啣杖，捲旗束甲，暗地去劫寨。
pmwa1ngqjpv7iw.gloss: soldiers DE order, all eat.full one.CLF, horse remove bell, person hold.in.mouth stick, roll banner bind armor, secretly go raid camp.
pmwa1ngqjpv7iw.translation: The soldiers received the order, all ate a hearty meal, removed the bells from the horses, the men held sticks in their mouths, rolled up the banners and fastened their armor, and secretly went to raid the camp.
pmwa1ngqjpv7iw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|軍士得令，都飽餐一頓，馬摘鈴，人啣杖，捲旗束甲，暗地去劫寨。#1

pmwa1ngqjpw4st.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpw4st.text: 到半路，魏延馬上尋思：「只去打鄧賢寨，不顯能處；不如先去打冷苞寨，卻將得勝兵打鄧賢寨。
pmwa1ngqjpw4st.gloss: arrive halfway, Wei.Yan on.horseback think: only go attack Deng.Xian camp, NEG show ability; not.as.good first go attack Leng.Bao camp, then BA DE win troops attack Deng.Xian camp.
pmwa1ngqjpw4st.translation: When they had gone halfway, Wei Yan thought on horseback: 'If I only go attack Deng Xian's camp, it won't show (my) ability; better to first go attack Leng Bao's camp, and then use the victorious troops to attack Deng Xian's camp.'
pmwa1ngqjpw4st.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|到半路，魏延馬上尋思：「只去打鄧賢寨，不顯能處；不如先去打冷苞寨，卻將得勝兵打鄧賢寨。#1

pmwa1ngqjpxy8j.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpxy8j.text: 魏延聽得背後陣腳亂，撇了冷苞，撥馬回走。
pmwa1ngqjpxy8j.gloss: Wei.Yan hear DE behind formation disorder, abandon PFV Leng.Bao, turn horse back ride.
pmwa1ngqjpxy8j.translation: Wei Yan heard the formation behind him fall into disorder, left Leng Bao behind, turned his horse and rode back.
pmwa1ngqjpxy8j.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|魏延聽得背後陣腳亂，撇了冷苞，撥馬回走。#1

pmwa1ngqjpyl3u.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpyl3u.text: 不到十餘合，後面軍馬擁將上來，冷苞只得棄了左寨，引敗軍來投右寨。
pmwa1ngqjpyl3u.gloss: not.reach ten.odd round, behind troops surge P come.up, Leng.Bao only DE abandon PFV left camp, lead defeated troops come seek.refuge right camp.
pmwa1ngqjpyl3u.translation: Before ten-odd bouts were over, the troops behind surged up; Leng Bao had no choice but to abandon the left camp and lead his defeated troops to seek refuge in the right camp.
pmwa1ngqjpyl3u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|不到十餘合，後面軍馬擁將上來，冷苞只得棄了左寨，引敗軍來投右寨。#1

pmwa1ngqjpzfpl.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjpzfpl.text: 令魏延謝黃忠救命之恩，今後毋得相爭。
pmwa1ngqjpzfpl.gloss: order Wei.Yan thank Huang.Zhong save.life GEN favor, from.now.on PROH DE each.other.contend.
pmwa1ngqjpzfpl.translation: He ordered Wei Yan to thank Huang Zhong for the favor of saving his life, and from now on they must not contend with each other.
pmwa1ngqjpzfpl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|令魏延謝黃忠救命之恩，今後毋得相爭。#1

pmwa1ngqjq04h8.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjq04h8.text: 卻說冷苞得回雒城，見劉璝、張任，不說捉去放回，只說被我殺了十餘人，奪得馬匹逃回。
pmwa1ngqjq04h8.gloss: meanwhile say Leng.Bao DE return Luo.City, see Liu.Gui, Zhang.Ren, NEG say capture go release return, only say PASS 1SG kill PFV ten.and.more people, seize DE horses flee.back.
pmwa1ngqjq04h8.translation: Meanwhile, Leng Bao managed to get back to Luocheng; on seeing Liu Gui and Zhang Ren, he did not say that he had been captured, taken away, and released, but only said, “More than ten men were killed by me; I seized horses and fled back.”
pmwa1ngqjq04h8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說冷苞得回雒城，見劉璝、張任，不說捉去放回，只說被我殺了十餘人，奪得馬匹逃回。#1

pmwa1ngqjq1z3l.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjq1z3l.text: 卻說冷苞得回雒城，見劉璝、張任，不說捉去放回，只說被我殺了十餘人，奪得馬匹逃回。
pmwa1ngqjq1z3l.gloss: meanwhile say Leng.Bao DE return Luo.City, see Liu.Gui, Zhang.Ren, NEG say capture go release return, only say PASS 1SG kill PFV ten.and.more people, seize DE horses flee.back.
pmwa1ngqjq1z3l.translation: Meanwhile, Leng Bao managed to get back to Luocheng; on seeing Liu Gui and Zhang Ren, he did not say that he had been captured, taken away, and released, but only said, “More than ten men were killed by me; I seized horses and fled back.”
pmwa1ngqjq1z3l.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說冷苞得回雒城，見劉璝、張任，不說捉去放回，只說被我殺了十餘人，奪得馬匹逃回。#2

pmwa1ngqjq2qlz.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjq2qlz.gloss: Zhang say: DE honored.uncle go best.
pmwa1ngqjq2qlz.translation: Zhang said: "It would be best if my honored uncle went."
pmwa1ngqjq2qlz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|璋曰：「得尊舅去最好。#1

pmwa1ngqjq3cxr.section: 第六十二回　　　取涪關楊高授首　　　攻雒城黃魏爭功
pmwa1ngqjq3cxr.text: 玄德驚曰：「若葭萌關有失，截斷後路，吾進退不得，當如之何？」
pmwa1ngqjq3cxr.gloss: Xuande startled say: if Jiameng.Pass suffer.loss, cut.off rear.route, 1SG advance.retreat NEG DE, should how.deal.with.it?
pmwa1ngqjq3cxr.translation: Xuande said in alarm: “If Jiameng Pass is lost and the retreat route is cut off, I will be unable to advance or retreat—what should be done?”
pmwa1ngqjq3cxr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德驚曰：「若葭萌關有失，截斷後路，吾進退不得，當如之何？」#1

pmwa1ngqjq49q0.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjq49q0.text: 卻說冷苞見當夜風雨大作，引了五千軍，逕循江邊而進，安排決江，只聽得後面喊聲大起。
pmwa1ngqjq49q0.gloss: now.say Leng.Bao see that.night wind.rain greatly.rise, lead PFV five.thousand troops, straight along river.bank CONJ advance, arrange breach river, only hear DE behind shout.sound greatly.rise.
pmwa1ngqjq49q0.translation: Now, Leng Bao saw that the wind and rain were rising greatly that night; he led five thousand troops, advanced straight along the riverbank, and arranged to breach the river; he only heard a great shouting rise behind him.
pmwa1ngqjq49q0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說冷苞見當夜風雨大作，引了五千軍，逕循江邊而進，安排決江，只聽得後面喊聲大起。#1

pmwa1ngqjq511x.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjq511x.text: 乃對玄德曰：「統亦算太乙數，已知罡星在西，應主公合得西川，別不主凶事。
pmwa1ngqjq511x.gloss: thereupon to Xuande say: Tong also calculate Taiyi.calculation, already know Gang.star at west, correspond lord ought DE Xichuan, otherwise NEG portend ominous.matter.
pmwa1ngqjq511x.translation: Thereupon he said to Xuande: 'I, Tong, have also calculated the Taiyi numbers and already know that the Gang star is in the west; this corresponds to my lord being due to obtain Xichuan, and it does not otherwise portend any ill fortune.'
pmwa1ngqjq511x.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|乃對玄德曰：「統亦算太乙數，已知罡星在西，應主公合得西川，別不主凶事。#1

pmwa1ngqjq6laz.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjq6laz.text: 諸公緊守雒城，勿得有失。」
pmwa1ngqjq6laz.gloss: all.gentlemen tightly.guard Luo.City, PROH DE have.loss.
pmwa1ngqjq6laz.translation: You gentlemen guard Luocheng closely; do not let there be any mishap.
pmwa1ngqjq6laz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|諸公緊守雒城，勿得有失。」#1

pmwa1ngqjq7e6u.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjq7e6u.text: 見魏延兵過，張任教儘放過去，休得驚動。
pmwa1ngqjq7e6u.gloss: see Wei.Yan troops pass, Zhang.Ren order all let pass.over, PROH DE disturb
pmwa1ngqjq7e6u.translation: Seeing Wei Yan's troops pass by, Zhang Ren ordered (his men) to let them all pass through and not to raise the alarm.
pmwa1ngqjq7e6u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|見魏延兵過，張任教儘放過去，休得驚動。#1

pmwa1ngqjq8an6.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjq8an6.text: 當日張任射死龐統，漢軍擁塞，進退不得，死者大半。
pmwa1ngqjq8an6.gloss: that.day Zhang.Ren shoot.dead Pang.Tong, Han.army congested, advance.retreat NEG DE, die NMLZ more.than.half.
pmwa1ngqjq8an6.translation: On that day Zhang Ren shot Pang Tong dead; the Han army was jammed and could not advance or retreat, and more than half died.
pmwa1ngqjq8an6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|當日張任射死龐統，漢軍擁塞，進退不得，死者大半。#1

pmwa1ngqjq9rgk.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjq9rgk.text: 魏延忙勒兵欲回，奈山路狹窄，廝殺不得。
pmwa1ngqjq9rgk.gloss: Wei.Yan hurriedly rein.in troops want return, but mountain.road narrow, fight NEG DE
pmwa1ngqjq9rgk.translation: Wei Yan hurriedly reined in his troops, intending to turn back, but the mountain road was narrow and (they) could not fight.
pmwa1ngqjq9rgk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|魏延忙勒兵欲回，奈山路狹窄，廝殺不得。#1

pmwa1ngqjqauo9.gloss: Wei.Yan fight.to.death NEG can DE escape
pmwa1ngqjqauo9.translation: Wei Yan fought desperately but could not break free.
pmwa1ngqjqauo9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|魏延死戰不能得脫。#1

pmwa1ngqjqbt63.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjqbt63.text: 劉璝引兵殺出，卻得玄德在後當住接應。
pmwa1ngqjqbt63.gloss: Liu.Gui lead troops charge.out, but DE Xuande at back hold.off reinforce.
pmwa1ngqjqbt63.translation: Liu Gui led his troops out to attack, but Xuande was behind to hold (them) off and support (him).
pmwa1ngqjqbt63.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|劉璝引兵殺出，卻得玄德在後當住接應。#1

pmwa1ngqjqcktn.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjqcktn.translation: The Shu soldiers won the victory and pursued (them) in a winding line.
pmwa1ngqjqcktn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|蜀兵得勝，迤邐追趕。#1

pmwa1ngqjqd6bk.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjqd6bk.text: 幸得左邊劉封，右邊關平，二將引三萬生力兵截出，殺退張任；還趕二十里，奪回戰馬極多。
pmwa1ngqjqd6bk.gloss: fortunate DE left.side Liu.Feng, right.side Guan.Ping, two general lead thirty.thousand fresh.troops intercept.out, kill.repulse Zhang.Ren; also chase twenty li, seize.back warhorse extremely.many.
pmwa1ngqjqd6bk.translation: Fortunately, Liu Feng on the left and Guan Ping on the right, the two generals, led thirty thousand fresh troops to cut off (the enemy) and beat back Zhang Ren; they also pursued (them) twenty li and recaptured a great many warhorses.
pmwa1ngqjqd6bk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幸得左邊劉封，右邊關平，二將引三萬生力兵截出，殺退張任；還趕二十里，奪回戰馬極多。#1

pmwa1ngqjqevqv.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjqevqv.text: 有落鳳坡逃得性命的軍士，報說：「軍師連人帶馬，被亂箭射死於坡前。」
pmwa1ngqjqevqv.gloss: there.be Fallen.Phoenix.Slope escape DE life ATTR soldier, report say: military.adviser including man and horse, PASS random.arrows shoot dead at slope.front.
pmwa1ngqjqevqv.translation: There were soldiers who had escaped with their lives from Fallen Phoenix Slope, and they reported: 'The military adviser, both he and his horse, was shot dead by a hail of arrows in front of the slope.'
pmwa1ngqjqevqv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|有落鳳坡逃得性命的軍士，報說：「軍師連人帶馬，被亂箭射死於坡前。」#1

pmwa1ngqjqf5dv.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjqf5dv.text: 孔明曰：「既主公在涪關，進退兩難之際，亮不得不去。」
pmwa1ngqjqf5dv.gloss: Kongming say: since lord at Fu.Pass, advance.retreat both.difficult GEN juncture, Liang NEG DE NEG go.
pmwa1ngqjqf5dv.translation: Kongming said, "Since the lord is at Fu Pass, at a juncture where advancing and retreating are both difficult, I, Liang, cannot but go."
pmwa1ngqjqf5dv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明曰：「既主公在涪關，進退兩難之際，亮不得不去。」#1

pmwa1ngqjqgnqv.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjqgnqv.text: 於路戒約三軍，勿得擄掠百姓，以失民心。
pmwa1ngqjqgnqv.gloss: on.the.way restrain three.armies, PROH DE plunder common.people, thereby lose people.heart
pmwa1ngqjqgnqv.translation: On the way, restrain the three armies: do not plunder the common people and thereby lose the people's hearts.
pmwa1ngqjqgnqv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|於路戒約三軍，勿得擄掠百姓，以失民心。#1

pmwa1ngqjqhj6s.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjqhj6s.text: 所到之處，並宜存恤，勿得恣逞鞭撻士卒。
pmwa1ngqjqhj6s.gloss: wherever.arrive place, all should show.compassion, NEG DE willfully.indulge flog soldier.
pmwa1ngqjqhj6s.translation: Wherever (you) arrive, (you) should in all cases show compassion and relief; (you) must not recklessly flog the soldiers.
pmwa1ngqjqhj6s.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|所到之處，並宜存恤，勿得恣逞鞭撻士卒。#1

pmwa1ngqjqi0vt.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjqi0vt.text: 猛然思得一計，教眾軍不要前去搦戰，都結束停當在寨中等候廝殺；卻只教三五十個軍士，直去城下叫罵，引嚴顏軍出來，便與廝殺。
pmwa1ngqjqi0vt.gloss: suddenly think DE one plan, order all.troops NEG want go.forward provoke.battle, all equip.ready at camp.inside wait fight; instead only order thirty.fifty CLF soldier, straight.go city.wall.below shout.insult, lure Yan.Yan army come.out, then with fight
pmwa1ngqjqi0vt.translation: Suddenly (he) thought up a plan: (he) ordered the troops not to go forward and provoke battle, but all to be fully equipped and ready in the camp waiting to fight; instead (he) only ordered thirty or fifty soldiers to go straight under the city wall and shout insults, to lure Yan Yan's army out, and then fight (them).
pmwa1ngqjqi0vt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|猛然思得一計，教眾軍不要前去搦戰，都結束停當在寨中等候廝殺；卻只教三五十個軍士，直去城下叫罵，引嚴顏軍出來，便與廝殺。#1

pmwa1ngqjqj97q.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqjqj97q.text: 這幾日打探得有一條小路，可以偷過巴郡。」
pmwa1ngqjqj97q.gloss: PROX few day scout DE have one CLF small road, can sneak.past Ba.Commandery
pmwa1ngqjqj97q.translation: These past few days (we) have scouted out that there is a small road by which (we) can sneak past Ba Commandery.
pmwa1ngqjqj97q.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|這幾日打探得有一條小路，可以偷過巴郡。」#1

pmwa1ngqkqk5ce.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqkqk5ce.text: 眾應曰：「這幾日卻纔哨探得出。」
pmwa1ngqkqk5ce.gloss: crowd answer say: PROX few day only.just scout DE out.
pmwa1ngqkqk5ce.translation: Everyone answered, "It is only in the last few days that (we) have managed to scout it out."
pmwa1ngqkqk5ce.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾應曰：「這幾日卻纔哨探得出。」#1

pmwa1ngqkqly1a.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqkqly1a.text: 探細小軍，聽得這個消息，盡回城中來，報與嚴顏。
pmwa1ngqkqly1a.gloss: scout.soldier, hear DE this CLF news, all return city.inside come, report.to Yan.Yan.
pmwa1ngqkqly1a.translation: The scouting soldiers heard this news, all returned into the city, and reported (it) to Yan Yan.
pmwa1ngqkqly1a.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|探細小軍，聽得這個消息，盡回城中來，報與嚴顏。#1

pmwa1ngqkqmx9y.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqkqmx9y.text: 顏大喜曰：「我算定這匹夫忍耐不得！
pmwa1ngqkqmx9y.gloss: Yan greatly joy say: 1SG reckon.certain this fellow endure NEG DE!
pmwa1ngqkqmx9y.translation: Yan was overjoyed and said, 'I was sure this fellow could not hold out!'
pmwa1ngqkqmx9y.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|顏大喜曰：「我算定這匹夫忍耐不得！#1

pmwa1ngqkqns6m.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqkqns6m.text: 你偷小路過去，須是糧草輜重在後；我截住後路，你如何得過？
pmwa1ngqkqns6m.gloss: 2SG sneak small.road pass, must.be provisions baggage at rear; 1SG cut.off rear.route, 2SG how DE pass?
pmwa1ngqkqns6m.translation: You sneak through by the small road, but the provisions and baggage must be in the rear; I cut off the rear route—how can you get through?
pmwa1ngqkqns6m.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|你偷小路過去，須是糧草輜重在後；我截住後路，你如何得過？#1

pmwa1ngqkqox9s.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqkqox9s.text: 去不得三四里，背後車仗人馬，陸續進發。
pmwa1ngqkqox9s.gloss: go NEG DE three four li, behind cart.baggage man.horse, successively advance.
pmwa1ngqkqox9s.translation: They had not gone three or four li when behind (them) the baggage carts, men and horses advanced one after another.
pmwa1ngqkqox9s.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|去不得三四里，背後車仗人馬，陸續進發。#1

pmwa1ngqkqpvxt.section: 第六十三回　　　諸葛亮痛哭龐統　　　張翼德義釋嚴顏
pmwa1ngqkqpvxt.text: 嚴顏看得分曉，一齊擂鼓，四下伏兵盡起。
pmwa1ngqkqpvxt.gloss: Yan.Yan see DE clear, together beat drum, four.sides ambush.troops all rise
pmwa1ngqkqpvxt.translation: Yan Yan saw clearly; (his men) beat the drums all together, and the ambush troops on all sides rose up.
pmwa1ngqkqpvxt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|嚴顏看得分曉，一齊擂鼓，四下伏兵盡起。#1

pmwa1ngqkqq9m0.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkqq9m0.text: 張飛聽得，便請玄德分兵兩路，殺去救援。
pmwa1ngqkqq9m0.gloss: Zhang.Fei hear DE, then request Xuande divide troops two CLF, fight go rescue
pmwa1ngqkqq9m0.translation: Zhang Fei heard this, and at once asked Xuande to divide the troops into two columns and charge off to the rescue.
pmwa1ngqkqq9m0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張飛聽得，便請玄德分兵兩路，殺去救援。#1

pmwa1ngqkqrrs6.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkqrrs6.text: 吳蘭、雷同料敵不住，只得將本部軍馬前來投降。
pmwa1ngqkqrrs6.gloss: Wu.Lan, Lei.Tong reckon withstand not.hold, only DE lead own.unit troops come surrender.
pmwa1ngqkqrrs6.translation: Wu Lan and Lei Tong reckoned they could not withstand (the enemy), and had no choice but to lead their own troops forward to surrender.
pmwa1ngqkqrrs6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吳蘭、雷同料敵不住，只得將本部軍馬前來投降。#1

pmwa1ngqkqs3jp.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkqs3jp.text: 吳懿、劉璝曰：「兵勢甚危，不決一死戰，如何得兵退？
pmwa1ngqkqs3jp.gloss: Wu.Yi, Liu.Gui say: army.situation very critical, NEG decide one death.battle, how DE troops retreat?
pmwa1ngqkqs3jp.translation: Wu Yi and Liu Gui said: "The military situation is very critical; if we do not stake everything on a desperate battle, how can (we) get the troops to withdraw?"
pmwa1ngqkqs3jp.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吳懿、劉璝曰：「兵勢甚危，不決一死戰，如何得兵退？#1

pmwa1ngqkqttx9.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkqttx9.text: 吳懿一軍截住，張任引軍復回，把張飛圍在垓心，進退不得。
pmwa1ngqkqttx9.gloss: Wu.Yi one army block, Zhang.Ren lead army again return, BA Zhang.Fei surround at center.of.encirclement, advance.retreat NEG DE.
pmwa1ngqkqttx9.translation: Wu Yi's troops blocked (him); Zhang Ren led his troops back and surrounded Zhang Fei in the center of the encirclement, (so that Zhang Fei) could not advance or retreat.
pmwa1ngqkqttx9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吳懿一軍截住，張任引軍復回，把張飛圍在垓心，進退不得。#1

pmwa1ngqkquh37.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkquh37.text: 孔明驚問曰：「如何得先到？」
pmwa1ngqkquh37.gloss: Kongming startled ask say: how DE first arrive?
pmwa1ngqkquh37.translation: Kongming asked in surprise, "How did (you) get to arrive first?"
pmwa1ngqkquh37.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明驚問曰：「如何得先到？」#1

pmwa1ngqkqvpm1.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkqvpm1.text: 玄德得了雒城，重賞諸將。
pmwa1ngqkqvpm1.gloss: Xuande DE PFV Luo.city, heavy reward all general
pmwa1ngqkqvpm1.translation: Xuande took Luo City and richly rewarded his generals.
pmwa1ngqkqvpm1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德得了雒城，重賞諸將。#1

pmwa1ngqkqwopo.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkqwopo.text: 蜀中降將曰：「止綿竹有重兵守禦，若得綿竹，成都唾手可得。」
pmwa1ngqkqwopo.gloss: Shu.within surrender general say: only Mianzhu have heavy.troops defend, if DE Mianzhu, Chengdu spit.hand can DE.
pmwa1ngqkqwopo.translation: A surrendered general from Shu said, "Only Mianzhu has heavy troops defending it; if we get Mianzhu, Chengdu can be taken with ease."
pmwa1ngqkqwopo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|蜀中降將曰：「止綿竹有重兵守禦，若得綿竹，成都唾手可得。」#1

pmwa1ngqkqxvug.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkqxvug.text: 蜀中降將曰：「止綿竹有重兵守禦，若得綿竹，成都唾手可得。」
pmwa1ngqkqxvug.gloss: Shu.within surrender general say: only Mianzhu have heavy.troops defend, if DE Mianzhu, Chengdu spit.hand can DE.
pmwa1ngqkqxvug.translation: A surrendered general from Shu said, "Only Mianzhu has heavy troops defending it; if we get Mianzhu, Chengdu can be taken with ease."
pmwa1ngqkqxvug.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|蜀中降將曰：「止綿竹有重兵守禦，若得綿竹，成都唾手可得。」#2

pmwa1ngqkqy5d1.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkqy5d1.text: 前蒙遣差結好荊州，不意主公左右不得其人，以致如此。
pmwa1ngqkqy5d1.gloss: Previously receive send.on.a.mission establish.friendly.relations Jingzhou, unexpectedly lord attendants NEG DE 3SG person, lead.to like.this.
pmwa1ngqkqy5d1.translation: Previously (I) was honored to be sent to establish friendly relations with Jingzhou; unexpectedly, my lord, the attendants around you were not the right people, and so it has come to this.
pmwa1ngqkqy5d1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|前蒙遣差結好荊州，不意主公左右不得其人，以致如此。#1

pmwa1ngqkqz7t5.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkqz7t5.text: 淵不得曹操言語，未敢動兵。
pmwa1ngqkqz7t5.gloss: Yuan NEG DE Cao.Cao instructions, NEG dare move troops.
pmwa1ngqkqz7t5.translation: Yuan did not have Cao Cao's instructions, and did not dare to move troops.
pmwa1ngqkqz7t5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|淵不得曹操言語，未敢動兵。#1

pmwa1ngqkr0osj.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkr0osj.gloss: die for loyalty.righteousness, die DE 3.GEN place SFP
pmwa1ngqkr0osj.translation: To die for loyalty and righteousness is to die in the proper place.
pmwa1ngqkr0osj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|死於忠義，死得其所也。#1

pmwa1ngqkr1do7.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkr1do7.text: 姜敘、楊阜如何抵得馬超，大敗而走。
pmwa1ngqkr1do7.gloss: Jiang.Xu, Yang.Fu how resist DE Ma.Chao, badly.defeated CONJ flee.
pmwa1ngqkr1do7.translation: How could Jiang Xu and Yang Fu withstand Ma Chao? They were badly defeated and fled.
pmwa1ngqkr1do7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|姜敘、楊阜如何抵得馬超，大敗而走。#1

pmwa1ngqkr2q56.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkr2q56.text: 原來是夏侯淵得了曹操軍令，正領軍來破馬超。
pmwa1ngqkr2q56.gloss: turn.out COP Xiahou.Yuan DE PFV Cao.Cao military.order, just lead.troops come defeat Ma.Chao.
pmwa1ngqkr2q56.translation: It turned out that Xiahou Yuan had received Cao Cao's military order and was just then leading troops to come and defeat Ma Chao.
pmwa1ngqkr2q56.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|原來是夏侯淵得了曹操軍令，正領軍來破馬超。#1

pmwa1ngqkr30n7.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkr30n7.text: 超如何當得了三路軍馬，大敗奔回，走了一夜。
pmwa1ngqkr30n7.gloss: Chao how withstand DE PFV three.route troops, be.badly.defeated flee.back, flee PFV one night.
pmwa1ngqkr30n7.translation: How could Chao withstand the troops of three routes? He was badly defeated and fled back, running the whole night.
pmwa1ngqkr30n7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|超如何當得了三路軍馬，大敗奔回，走了一夜。#1

pmwa1ngqkr4328.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkr4328.text: 比及平明，到得冀城叫門時，城上亂箭射下。
pmwa1ngqkr4328.gloss: by.the.time dawn, arrive DE Ji.City call gate time, city.top random.arrows shoot.down
pmwa1ngqkr4328.translation: By daybreak, when (he) reached Ji City and called at the gate, a barrage of arrows was shot down from the city wall.
pmwa1ngqkr4328.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|比及平明，到得冀城叫門時，城上亂箭射下。#1

pmwa1ngqkr5qu8.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkr5qu8.text: 前面又撞見姜敘、楊阜，殺了一陣；衝得過去，又撞著尹奉、趙昂，殺了一陣。
pmwa1ngqkr5qu8.gloss: ahead again bump.into Jiang.Xu, Yang.Fu, fight PFV one.bout; charge DE pass.through, again bump.into Yin.Feng, Zhao.Ang, fight PFV one.bout.
pmwa1ngqkr5qu8.translation: Ahead he again ran into Jiang Xu and Yang Fu and fought a bout; he charged through, then again ran into Yin Feng and Zhao Ang and fought a bout.
pmwa1ngqkr5qu8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|前面又撞見姜敘、楊阜，殺了一陣；衝得過去，又撞著尹奉、趙昂，殺了一陣。#1

pmwa1ngqkr660m.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkr660m.text: 零零落落，剩得五六十騎，連夜奔走。
pmwa1ngqkr660m.gloss: scattered.and.straggling, remain DE fifty.sixty rider, overnight flee
pmwa1ngqkr660m.translation: Scattered and straggling, only fifty or sixty riders were left, and they fled overnight.
pmwa1ngqkr660m.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|零零落落，剩得五六十騎，連夜奔走。#1

pmwa1ngqkr7s5n.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkr7s5n.text: 昂妻王氏因在軍中，得免於難。
pmwa1ngqkr7s5n.gloss: Ang wife Wang.clan because at army.mid, DE escape from calamity
pmwa1ngqkr7s5n.translation: Zhao Ang's wife, Lady Wang, because she was in the army camp, was able to escape the calamity.
pmwa1ngqkr7s5n.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|昂妻王氏因在軍中，得免於難。#1

pmwa1ngqkr85ff.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkr85ff.text: 行不得二十里，前面一軍擺開，為首的是楊阜。
pmwa1ngqkr85ff.gloss: travel NEG DE twenty li, ahead one army deploy.open, lead NMLZ COP Yang.Fu.
pmwa1ngqkr85ff.translation: Before (he) had gone twenty li, a body of troops deployed ahead, and the one at their head was Yang Fu.
pmwa1ngqkr85ff.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|行不得二十里，前面一軍擺開，為首的是楊阜。#1

pmwa1ngqkr9aqx.section: 第六十四回　　　孔明定計捉張任　　　楊阜借兵破馬超
pmwa1ngqkr9aqx.text: 張魯大喜，以為得馬超，則西可吞益州，東可以拒曹操，乃商議欲以女招超為婿。
pmwa1ngqkr9aqx.gloss: Zhang.Lu great.rejoice, believe that DE Ma.Chao, then west can swallow Yizhou, east can resist Cao.Cao, so discuss want use daughter invite Ma.Chao as son-in-law.
pmwa1ngqkr9aqx.translation: Zhang Lu was overjoyed, thinking that by gaining Ma Chao, he could annex Yizhou in the west and resist Cao Cao in the east, so he discussed using a daughter to invite Ma Chao to be his son-in-law.
pmwa1ngqkr9aqx.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張魯大喜，以為得馬超，則西可吞益州，東可以拒曹操，乃商議欲以女招超為婿。#1

pmwa1ngqkraz9s.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqkraz9s.text: 孔明曰：「可速進兵取綿竹，如得此處，成都易取矣。」
pmwa1ngqkraz9s.gloss: Kong.Ming say: can swift advance.troops take Mianzhu, if DE this.place, Chengdu easy take SFP
pmwa1ngqkraz9s.translation: Kongming said, “We can swiftly advance our troops and take Mianzhu; if we obtain this place, Chengdu will be easy to take.”
pmwa1ngqkraz9s.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明曰：「可速進兵取綿竹，如得此處，成都易取矣。」#1

pmwa1ngqkrb0yg.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqkrb0yg.gloss: Yide DE already at PROX, can urgent send 3SG.OBJ?
pmwa1ngqkrb0yg.translation: Yide is already here; he can be sent at once.
pmwa1ngqkrb0yg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|翼得已在此，可急遺之。」#1

pmwa1ngqkrcuem.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqkrcuem.text: 若知虛實將軍豈得無事？
pmwa1ngqkrcuem.gloss: if know true.situation general how DE not.have trouble ?
pmwa1ngqkrcuem.translation: If (Cao Cao) had known the real situation, how could you, General, have been unharmed?
pmwa1ngqkrcuem.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若知虛實將軍豈得無事？#1

pmwa1ngqkrd45w.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqkrd45w.text: 渭橋大戰，殺得曹操割鬚棄袍，幾乎喪命，非等閒之比，雲長且未必能勝。」
pmwa1ngqkrd45w.gloss: Wei.Bridge great.battle, kill DE Cao.Cao cut.beard discard.robe, almost lose.life, NEG ordinary GEN compare, Yun.Chang even not.necessarily can win.
pmwa1ngqkrd45w.translation: At the great battle at Wei Bridge, he fought so fiercely that Cao Cao cut off his beard and threw away his robe, and nearly lost his life; he is not comparable to ordinary (men), and even Yun Chang may not necessarily be able to defeat (him).
pmwa1ngqkrd45w.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|渭橋大戰，殺得曹操割鬚棄袍，幾乎喪命，非等閒之比，雲長且未必能勝。」#1

pmwa1ngqkre56u.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqkre56u.text: 飛曰：「我只今便去；如勝不得馬超，甘當軍令！」
pmwa1ngqkre56u.gloss: Fei say: 1SG now then go; if win NEG DE Ma.Chao, willingly bear military.law!
pmwa1ngqkre56u.translation: Fei said: 'I will go right now; if I cannot defeat Ma Chao, I am willing to submit to military law!'
pmwa1ngqkre56u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|飛曰：「我只今便去；如勝不得馬超，甘當軍令！」#1

pmwa1ngqkrf34b.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqkrf34b.text: 原來是張飛初到關上，聽得關前廝殺，便來看時，正見魏延中箭，因驟馬下關，救了魏延。
pmwa1ngqkrf34b.gloss: turn.out COP Zhang.Fei just arrive pass.top, hear DE pass.front fight, then come look time, just see Wei.Yan hit.arrow, thereupon spur.horse descend.pass, rescue PFV Wei.Yan.
pmwa1ngqkrf34b.translation: It turned out to be Zhang Fei, who had just arrived at the pass. Hearing the fighting in front of the pass, he came to look, and just then saw Wei Yan struck by an arrow; thereupon he spurred his horse down from the pass and rescued Wei Yan.
pmwa1ngqkrf34b.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|原來是張飛初到關上，聽得關前廝殺，便來看時，正見魏延中箭，因驟馬下關，救了魏延。#1

pmwa1ngqkrgn26.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqkrgn26.text: 關下馬超單搦張飛出戰，關上張飛恨不得平吞馬超，三五番皆被玄德擋住。
pmwa1ngqkrgn26.gloss: pass below Ma.Chao alone challenge Zhang.Fei out.fight, pass on Zhang.Fei hate NEG DE swallow.whole Ma.Chao, three.five times all PASS Xuande block
pmwa1ngqkrgn26.translation: Below the pass Ma Chao single-handedly challenged Zhang Fei to come out and fight; on the pass Zhang Fei wished he could swallow Ma Chao whole, (but) several times he was blocked by Xuande.
pmwa1ngqkrgn26.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|關下馬超單搦張飛出戰，關上張飛恨不得平吞馬超，三五番皆被玄德擋住。#1

pmwa1ngqkrh3ex.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqkrh3ex.text: 張飛挺槍出馬，大呼：「認得燕人張翼德麼！」
pmwa1ngqkrh3ex.gloss: Zhang.Fei level spear ride.out horse, loudly shout: recognize-DE Yan person Zhang.Yide Q!
pmwa1ngqkrh3ex.translation: Zhang Fei leveled his spear and rode out, shouting loudly: "Do you recognize Zhang Yide of Yan?"
pmwa1ngqkrh3ex.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張飛挺槍出馬，大呼：「認得燕人張翼德麼！」#1

pmwa1ngqkrixjl.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqkrixjl.text: 張飛殺得性起，那裏肯休；大叫曰：「誓死不回！」
pmwa1ngqkrixjl.gloss: Zhang.Fei fight DE ardor.rise, how willing stop; loudly.shout say: swear.die NEG return!
pmwa1ngqkrixjl.translation: Zhang Fei fought until his fighting spirit was aroused; how could he be willing to stop? He shouted loudly, "I swear I will not return (even if I die)!"
pmwa1ngqkrixjl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張飛殺得性起，那裏肯休；大叫曰：「誓死不回！」#1

pmwa1ngqkrjqam.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqkrjqam.text: 張飛性起，向玄德換了坐下馬，搶出陣來，叫曰：「我捉你不得，誓不上關！」
pmwa1ngqkrjqam.gloss: Zhang.Fei temper.flare, with Xuande exchange PFV mount, dash out battle.array come, shout say: 1SG capture 2SG NEG DE, swear NEG go.up pass!
pmwa1ngqkrjqam.translation: Zhang Fei's temper flared; he exchanged mounts with Xuande, dashed out into the battle array, and shouted: 'If I cannot capture you, I swear I will not go up to the pass!'
pmwa1ngqkrjqam.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張飛性起，向玄德換了坐下馬，搶出陣來，叫曰：「我捉你不得，誓不上關！」#1

pmwa1ngqlrkhan.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqlrkhan.text: 超曰：「我勝你不得，誓不回寨！」
pmwa1ngqlrkhan.gloss: Ma.Chao say, 1SG win 2SG NEG DE, vow NEG return camp!
pmwa1ngqlrkhan.translation: Ma Chao said, "I cannot defeat you, I vow not to return to the camp!"
pmwa1ngqlrkhan.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|超曰：「我勝你不得，誓不回寨！」#1

pmwa1ngqlrlmkh.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqlrlmkh.text: 原來馬超見贏不得張飛，心生一計，詐敗佯輸，賺張飛趕來，暗掣銅鎚在手，扭回身覷著張飛便打將來。
pmwa1ngqlrlmkh.gloss: it.turned.out Ma.Chao see win NEG DE Zhang.Fei, heart give.birth one plan, feign.defeat pretend.lose, entice Zhang.Fei chase.come, secretly pull copper.hammer at hand, twist.back body look DUR Zhang.Fei then strike come.
pmwa1ngqlrlmkh.translation: It turned out that Ma Chao, seeing he could not defeat Zhang Fei, conceived a plan: he feigned defeat and pretended to lose, luring Zhang Fei into chasing him; secretly he drew a copper hammer into his hand, twisted his body around, fixed his eyes on Zhang Fei, and then struck at him.
pmwa1ngqlrlmkh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|原來馬超見贏不得張飛，心生一計，詐敗佯輸，賺張飛趕來，暗掣銅鎚在手，扭回身覷著張飛便打將來。#1

pmwa1ngqlrmrge.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqlrmrge.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|如何可得？」#1

pmwa1ngqlrn70w.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqlrn70w.text: 魯曰：「玄德只是左將軍，如何保得我為漢寧王？」
pmwa1ngqlrn70w.gloss: Lu say: Xuande only COP General.of.the.Left, how guarantee DE 1SG be King.of.Hanning?
pmwa1ngqlrn70w.translation: Lu said, "Xuande is only General of the Left; how can he guarantee me as King of Hanning?"
pmwa1ngqlrn70w.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|魯曰：「玄德只是左將軍，如何保得我為漢寧王？」#1

pmwa1ngqlro4tt.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqlro4tt.text: 若依得，使有賞；否則必誅。
pmwa1ngqlro4tt.gloss: if comply DE, cause have reward; otherwise certainly execute.
pmwa1ngqlro4tt.translation: If (you) can comply, (I) will have (you) rewarded; otherwise (you) will certainly be put to death.
pmwa1ngqlro4tt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若依得，使有賞；否則必誅。#1

pmwa1ngqlrpz2o.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqlrpz2o.text: 超大驚曰：「如何變得恁的！」
pmwa1ngqlrpz2o.gloss: Chao greatly.alarm say: how change DE like.this !
pmwa1ngqlrpz2o.translation: Ma Chao was greatly alarmed and said, "How has (it) changed to be like this!"
pmwa1ngqlrpz2o.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|超大驚曰：「如何變得恁的！」#1

pmwa1ngqlrqs7x.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqlrqs7x.gloss: Chao advance.retreat NEG DE, not.have plan can execute.
pmwa1ngqlrqs7x.translation: Chao (Ma Chao) could neither advance nor retreat, and had no plan to carry out.
pmwa1ngqlrqs7x.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|超進退不得，無計可施。#1

pmwa1ngqlrr92i.section: 第六十五回　　　馬超大戰葭萌關　　　劉備自領益州牧
pmwa1ngqlrr92i.text: 孔明曰：「正欲得一人替吾一往。

pmwa1ngqlrr92i.translation: Kongming said, "I was just wanting to get one person to go in my place.
