pmwa1ngqnshmqn.section: 第六十六回　　　關雲長單刀赴會　　　伏皇后為國捐生
pmwa1ngqnshmqn.text: 惇曰：「吳、蜀急未可攻，宜先取漢中張魯，以得勝之兵取蜀，可一鼓而下也。」
pmwa1ngqnshmqn.gloss: Dun say : Wu , Shu hastily NEG can attack , should first take Hanzhong Zhang.Lu , with DE win ATTR troops take Shu , can one drum CONJ down SFP .
pmwa1ngqnshmqn.translation: Dun said, 'Wu and Shu cannot be attacked in haste; it is best first to take Zhang Lu of Hanzhong, and with victorious troops take Shu—(Shu) can be subdued with a single drumbeat.'
pmwa1ngqnshmqn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|惇曰：「吳、蜀急未可攻，宜先取漢中張魯，以得勝之兵取蜀，可一鼓而下也。」#1

pmwa1ngqnsibfg.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqnsibfg.text: 夏侯淵、張郃急上得馬，四下裏大兵擁入，曹兵大敗，退見曹操。
pmwa1ngqnsibfg.gloss: Xiahou.Yuan, Zhang.He hurriedly mount DE horse, all.around great.army swarm.in, Cao.army great.defeated, retreat see Cao.Cao.
pmwa1ngqnsibfg.translation: Xiahou Yuan and Zhang He hurriedly mounted their horses; from all around the great army swarmed in, the Cao troops were badly defeated, and they retreated to see Cao Cao.
pmwa1ngqnsibfg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|夏侯淵、張郃急上得馬，四下裏大兵擁入，曹兵大敗，退見曹操。#1

pmwa1ngqnsjvao.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqnsjvao.text: 徐晃保著曹操奔過山坡，前面又一軍到；看時，卻是夏侯淵、張郃二將，聽得喊聲，故引軍殺來接應。
pmwa1ngqnsjvao.gloss: Xu.Huang protect DUR Cao.Cao rush cross hillside, ahead again one army arrive; look time, actually COP Xiahou.Yuan, Zhang.He two general, hear DE shout sound, therefore lead army attack come reinforce.
pmwa1ngqnsjvao.translation: Xu Huang, protecting Cao Cao, rushed across the hillside; ahead another army arrived. When (they) looked, it turned out to be the two generals Xiahou Yuan and Zhang He, who, having heard the shouting, had therefore led their troops to charge over and reinforce.
pmwa1ngqnsjvao.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|徐晃保著曹操奔過山坡，前面又一軍到；看時，卻是夏侯淵、張郃二將，聽得喊聲，故引軍殺來接應。#1

pmwa1ngqnsklx0.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqnsklx0.text: 於是殺退楊昂、楊任，救得曹操回寨。
pmwa1ngqnsklx0.gloss: thereupon drive.off Yang.Ang, Yang.Ren, rescue DE Cao.Cao return.to.camp.
pmwa1ngqnsklx0.translation: Thereupon (they) drove off Yang Ang and Yang Ren and rescued Cao Cao back to camp.
pmwa1ngqnsklx0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|於是殺退楊昂、楊任，救得曹操回寨。#1

pmwa1ngqnslqqp.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqnslqqp.text: 楊昂聽得曹兵退，請楊任商議，欲乘勢擊之。
pmwa1ngqnslqqp.gloss: Yang.Ang hear DE Cao.soldier retreat, invite Yang.Ren discuss, want take.advantage.of.situation attack 3PL
pmwa1ngqnslqqp.translation: Yang Ang heard that the Cao troops had retreated, so he asked Yang Ren to discuss the matter, intending to seize the opportunity to attack them.
pmwa1ngqnslqqp.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|楊昂聽得曹兵退，請楊任商議，欲乘勢擊之。#1

pmwa1ngqnsm6s1.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqnsm6s1.text: 守寨軍士，聽得馬蹄響，只道是楊昂兵回，開門納之。
pmwa1ngqnsm6s1.gloss: guard stockade soldier, hear DE horse.hoof sound, mistakenly.think COP Yang.Ang troop return, open gate admit 3PL
pmwa1ngqnsm6s1.translation: The soldiers guarding the stockade heard the sound of horse hooves and merely thought it was Yang Ang's troops returning, so they opened the gate and let them in.
pmwa1ngqnsm6s1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|守寨軍士，聽得馬蹄響，只道是楊昂兵回，開門納之。#1

pmwa1ngqnsnex9.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqnsnex9.text: 曹操遂得陽平關並諸寨。
pmwa1ngqnsnex9.gloss: Cao.Cao then DE Yangping.Pass CONJ all camp
pmwa1ngqnsnex9.translation: Cao Cao then gained Yangping Pass and all the camps.
pmwa1ngqnsnex9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操遂得陽平關並諸寨。#1

pmwa1ngqnsok76.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqnsok76.translation: I want to obtain this man.
pmwa1ngqnsok76.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吾欲得此人。#1

pmwa1ngqnspdqk.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqnspdqk.text: 曹操心中大喜，與眾將商議：「如何得此人降？」
pmwa1ngqnspdqk.gloss: Cao.Cao heart.in greatly.rejoice, with all.generals discuss: how DE this.person surrender?
pmwa1ngqnspdqk.translation: Cao Cao was greatly delighted at heart and consulted with his generals: "How can (we) get this man to surrender?"
pmwa1ngqnspdqk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操心中大喜，與眾將商議：「如何得此人降？」#1

pmwa1ngqnsq2zu.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqnsq2zu.gloss: Cao say: what.means DE enter Nan.Zheng?
pmwa1ngqnsq2zu.translation: Cao Cao said, "By what means can (we) get into Nan Zheng?"
pmwa1ngqnsq2zu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操曰：「何由得入南鄭？」#1

pmwa1ngqnsrav5.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqnsrav5.text: 詡曰：「來日交鋒詐敗佯輸棄寨而走，使龐德據我寨，我卻於夤夜引兵劫寨；龐德必退入城，卻選一能言軍士，扮作彼軍，雜在陣中，便得入城。」
pmwa1ngqnsrav5.gloss: Xu say: tomorrow join.battle feign.defeat pretend.lose abandon.camp and flee, cause Pang.De occupy 1PL camp, 1PL then at deep.night lead.troops raid.camp; Pang.De surely retreat enter.city, then select one eloquent soldier, disguise.as their.army, mix at ranks.midst, then DE enter.city.
pmwa1ngqnsrav5.translation: Jia Xu said: "Tomorrow when we join battle, (we) will feign defeat and pretend to be routed, abandon the camp and flee, letting Pang De occupy our camp; then we will lead troops at deep night to raid the camp. Pang De will surely retreat into the city. Then select an eloquent soldier, disguise (him) as one of their troops, mix (him) among the ranks, and (he) will be able to enter the city."
pmwa1ngqnsrav5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|詡曰：「來日交鋒詐敗佯輸棄寨而走，使龐德據我寨，我卻於夤夜引兵劫寨；龐德必退入城，卻選一能言軍士，扮作彼軍，雜在陣中，便得入城。」#1

pmwa1ngqoss0js.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqoss0js.text: 龐德不及提備，只得上馬衝殺出來，望城而走。
pmwa1ngqoss0js.gloss: Pang.De not.in.time prepare, only DE mount horse charge.kill out come, toward city CONJ flee.
pmwa1ngqoss0js.translation: Pang De had no time to prepare, and had no choice but to mount his horse and charge out fighting, fleeing toward the city.
pmwa1ngqoss0js.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|龐德不及提備，只得上馬衝殺出來，望城而走。#1

pmwa1ngqostkyp.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqostkyp.text: 張魯曰：「我向本欲歸命國家，而意未得達；今不得已而出奔，倉廩府庫，國家之有，不可廢也。」
pmwa1ngqostkyp.gloss: Zhang.Lu say: 1SG originally want submit.allegiance state, CONJ intention NEG DE reach; now NEG DE stop CONJ flee, granary storehouse, state GEN have, NEG can destroy SFP.
pmwa1ngqostkyp.translation: Zhang Lu said, 'I originally wanted to submit my allegiance to the state, but my intention had not yet been made known; now I have no choice but to flee. The granaries and storehouses are the state's property; they cannot be destroyed.'
pmwa1ngqostkyp.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張魯曰：「我向本欲歸命國家，而意未得達；今不得已而出奔，倉廩府庫，國家之有，不可廢也。」#1

pmwa1ngqosui09.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqosui09.text: 張魯曰：「我向本欲歸命國家，而意未得達；今不得已而出奔，倉廩府庫，國家之有，不可廢也。」
pmwa1ngqosui09.gloss: Zhang.Lu say: 1SG originally want submit.allegiance state, CONJ intention NEG DE reach; now NEG DE stop CONJ flee, granary storehouse, state GEN have, NEG can destroy SFP.
pmwa1ngqosui09.translation: Zhang Lu said, 'I originally wanted to submit my allegiance to the state, but my intention had not yet been made known; now I have no choice but to flee. The granaries and storehouses are the state's property; they cannot be destroyed.'
pmwa1ngqosui09.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張魯曰：「我向本欲歸命國家，而意未得達；今不得已而出奔，倉廩府庫，國家之有，不可廢也。」#2

pmwa1ngqosvk88.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqosvk88.text: 操得書，親自引兵往巴中。
pmwa1ngqosvk88.gloss: Cao.Cao DE letter, personally lead troops go Bazhong.
pmwa1ngqosvk88.translation: Cao Cao received the letter and personally led troops to Bazhong.
pmwa1ngqosvk88.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操得書，親自引兵往巴中。#1

pmwa1ngqoswl8q.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqoswl8q.text: 妨賢賣主逞奇功，積得金銀總是空。
pmwa1ngqoswl8q.gloss: hinder.worthy betray.lord show.off extraordinary.merit, accumulate DE gold.silver always COP empty.
pmwa1ngqoswl8q.translation: Hindering the worthy and betraying one's lord to flaunt extraordinary merit, the gold and silver one accumulates are always in vain.
pmwa1ngqoswl8q.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|妨賢賣主逞奇功，積得金銀總是空。#1

pmwa1ngqosxp5w.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqosxp5w.translation: Cao Cao had already taken the Eastern Chuan (region).
pmwa1ngqosxp5w.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操已得東川。#1

pmwa1ngqosyly3.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqosyly3.text: 今主公已得漢中，益州震動。
pmwa1ngqosyly3.gloss: now lord already DE Hanzhong, Yizhou shake
pmwa1ngqosyly3.translation: Now that my lord has already gained Hanzhong, Yizhou is shaken.
pmwa1ngqosyly3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今主公已得漢中，益州震動。#1

pmwa1ngqosz49p.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqosz49p.text: 曹操歎曰：「人苦不知足，既得隴，復望蜀耶？」
pmwa1ngqosz49p.gloss: Cao.Cao sigh say: person bitter NEG know sufficient, since DE Long, again hope Shu Q?
pmwa1ngqosz49p.translation: Cao Cao sighed and said: "People's trouble is that they do not know contentment — having already obtained Long, should one again covet Shu?"
pmwa1ngqosz49p.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操歎曰：「人苦不知足，既得隴，復望蜀耶？」#1

pmwa1ngqot0d60.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqot0d60.text: 權回寨，問眾將曰：「如何取得皖城？」
pmwa1ngqot0d60.gloss: Quan return camp, ask all general say: how take DE Wan.City?
pmwa1ngqot0d60.translation: Quan returned to camp and asked the generals, "How can (we) take Wan City?"
pmwa1ngqot0d60.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|權回寨，問眾將曰：「如何取得皖城？」#1

pmwa1ngqot1ovl.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqot1ovl.text: 餘眾多降，得了皖城，方纔辰時。
pmwa1ngqot1ovl.gloss: remaining.troops mostly surrender, DE PFV Wancheng, just.then Chen.hour.
pmwa1ngqot1ovl.translation: Most of the remaining troops surrendered, and (they) took Wancheng; it was just then the chen hour (7–9 a.m.).
pmwa1ngqot1ovl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|餘眾多降，得了皖城，方纔辰時。#1

pmwa1ngqot2i8f.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqot2i8f.text: 孫權在第二隊，聽得前軍得勝，催兵行兵至逍遙津北，忽聞連珠砲響，左邊張遼一軍殺來，右邊李典一軍殺來。
pmwa1ngqot2i8f.gloss: Sun.Quan at second column, hear DE front army DE victory, urge troops march troops arrive Xiaoyao.Ford north, suddenly hear chain.cannon sound, left side Zhang.Liao one army attack come, right side Li.Dian one army attack come.
pmwa1ngqot2i8f.translation: Sun Quan was in the second column. When he heard that the front army had won, he urged the troops forward, and the army advanced to the north of Xiaoyao Ford. Suddenly he heard the sound of chain-fired cannons: Zhang Liao’s army came attacking on the left, and Li Dian’s army came attacking on the right.
pmwa1ngqot2i8f.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孫權在第二隊，聽得前軍得勝，催兵行兵至逍遙津北，忽聞連珠砲響，左邊張遼一軍殺來，右邊李典一軍殺來。#1

pmwa1ngqot35b7.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqot35b7.text: 孫權在第二隊，聽得前軍得勝，催兵行兵至逍遙津北，忽聞連珠砲響，左邊張遼一軍殺來，右邊李典一軍殺來。
pmwa1ngqot35b7.gloss: Sun.Quan at second column, hear DE front army DE victory, urge troops march troops arrive Xiaoyao.Ford north, suddenly hear chain.cannon sound, left side Zhang.Liao one army attack come, right side Li.Dian one army attack come.
pmwa1ngqot35b7.translation: Sun Quan was in the second column. When he heard that the front army had won, he urged the troops forward, and the army advanced to the north of Xiaoyao Ford. Suddenly he heard the sound of chain-fired cannons: Zhang Liao’s army came attacking on the left, and Li Dian’s army came attacking on the right.
pmwa1ngqot35b7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孫權在第二隊，聽得前軍得勝，催兵行兵至逍遙津北，忽聞連珠砲響，左邊張遼一軍殺來，右邊李典一軍殺來。#2

pmwa1ngqot41dc.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqot41dc.text: 凌統手下，止有三百餘騎，當不得曹軍勢如山倒。
pmwa1ngqot41dc.gloss: Ling.Tong subordinate, only have three.hundred more cavalry, withstand NEG DE Cao.army momentum like mountain fall.
pmwa1ngqot41dc.translation: Ling Tong had only a little over three hundred horsemen under his command, and could not withstand the Cao army's momentum, which was like a collapsing mountain.
pmwa1ngqot41dc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|凌統手下，止有三百餘騎，當不得曹軍勢如山倒。#1

pmwa1ngqot5rvo.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqot5rvo.text: 孫權在舟中望見，急令董襲棹舟接之，乃得渡回。
pmwa1ngqot5rvo.gloss: Sun.Quan at boat inside see, urgent order Dong.Xi row boat pick.up 3SG.OBJ, then DE cross back.
pmwa1ngqot5rvo.translation: Sun Quan, from the boat, saw (Ling Tong) and urgently ordered Dong Xi to row the boat to pick him up; only then was (Ling Tong) able to cross back.
pmwa1ngqot5rvo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孫權在舟中望見，急令董襲棹舟接之，乃得渡回。#1

pmwa1ngqot6g0k.section: 第六十七回　　　曹操平定漢中地　　　張遼威震逍遙津
pmwa1ngqot6g0k.text: 這一陣殺得江南人人害怕；聞張遼大名，小兒也不敢夜啼。
pmwa1ngqot6g0k.gloss: PROX one battle kill DE Jiangnan everyone be.afraid; hear Zhang.Liao great.name, little.children also NEG dare cry.at.night
pmwa1ngqot6g0k.translation: This one battle was fought so that everyone in Jiangnan was afraid; hearing Zhang Liao's great name, little children too did not dare cry at night.
pmwa1ngqot6g0k.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|這一陣殺得江南人人害怕；聞張遼大名，小兒也不敢夜啼。#1

pmwa1ngqot75lj.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqot75lj.text: 甘寧見眾人有難色，乃拔劍在手，怒叱曰：「我為上將，且不惜命；汝等何得遲疑！」
pmwa1ngqot75lj.gloss: Gan.Ning see crowd have troubled.expression, then draw sword at hand, angry.scold say: 1SG COP senior.general, moreover NEG spare life; 2PL how DE hesitate!
pmwa1ngqot75lj.translation: Gan Ning saw that everyone looked reluctant, so he drew his sword and held it in his hand, and angrily shouted: "I am a senior general, and I do not even spare my life; how can you hesitate?"
pmwa1ngqot75lj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|甘寧見眾人有難色，乃拔劍在手，怒叱曰：「我為上將，且不惜命；汝等何得遲疑！」#1

pmwa1ngqot8hbb.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqot8hbb.text: 原來中軍人馬，以車仗伏路，穿連圍得鐵桶相似，不能得進。
pmwa1ngqot8hbb.gloss: turn.out central.army troops, use cart.baggage block.road, link.together surround DE iron.bucket similar, cannot DE enter
pmwa1ngqot8hbb.translation: It turned out that the central army’s troops had used carts and baggage to block the road, linking them together and enclosing (the camp) so that it was like an iron bucket; (Gan Ning’s men) could not get in.

pmwa1ngqotajin.text: 槍還未到，只聽得弓弦響處，一箭射中樂進面門，翻身落馬。
pmwa1ngqotajin.gloss: spear still NEG arrive, only hear DE bowstring sound place, one arrow shoot.hit Yue.Jin face, turn.body fall.horse
pmwa1ngqotajin.translation: The spear had not yet arrived when only the sound of a bowstring was heard, and an arrow struck Yue Jin in the face; (Yue Jin) flipped over and fell from his horse.

pmwa1ngqotbl13.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqotbl13.text: 卻說陳武聽得江邊廝殺，引一軍來，正與龐德相遇，兩軍混戰。
pmwa1ngqotbl13.gloss: now Chen.Wu hear DE river.side fight, lead one army come, just with Pang.De meet, two army melee.
pmwa1ngqotbl13.translation: Now, Chen Wu heard the fighting at the riverside and led a body of troops over; he happened to meet Pang De, and the two armies became locked in a melee.
pmwa1ngqotbl13.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說陳武聽得江邊廝殺，引一軍來，正與龐德相遇，兩軍混戰。#1

pmwa1ngqotcx1w.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqotcx1w.text: 孫權在濡須塢中，聽得曹兵殺到江邊，親自與周泰引軍前來助戰。
pmwa1ngqotcx1w.gloss: Sun.Quan at Ruxu.fort inside, hear DE Cao.soldiers fight arrive riverbank, personally with Zhou.Tai lead army come.forward assist.battle
pmwa1ngqotcx1w.translation: Sun Quan was in the Ruxu fort; hearing that Cao soldiers had fought their way to the riverbank, he personally, together with Zhou Tai, led troops and came to join the battle.
pmwa1ngqotcx1w.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孫權在濡須塢中，聽得曹兵殺到江邊，親自與周泰引軍前來助戰。#1

pmwa1ngqotdcm1.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqotdcm1.text: 權曰：「弓弩齊發，不能得出，如何﹖」泰曰：「主公在前，某在後，可以出圍。」
pmwa1ngqotdcm1.gloss: Quan say: bow.crossbow together shoot, NEG can DE get.out, how? Tai say: lord be.at front, 1SG be.at back, can exit encirclement.
pmwa1ngqotdcm1.translation: Quan said, 'The bows and crossbows are all shooting, and (we) cannot get out—what (are we) to do?' Tai said, 'My lord, (go) in front and I (will be) behind; (we) can break out of the encirclement.'
pmwa1ngqotdcm1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|權曰：「弓弩齊發，不能得出，如何﹖」泰曰：「主公在前，某在後，可以出圍。」#1

pmwa1ngqoteirv.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqoteirv.text: 周泰左右遮護，身被數槍，箭透重鎧，救得孫權。
pmwa1ngqoteirv.gloss: Zhou.Tai left right shield.protect, body suffer several spear, arrow penetrate heavy.armor, rescue DE Sun.Quan.
pmwa1ngqoteirv.translation: Zhou Tai shielded (him) on the left and right; his body was struck by several spears and arrows pierced his heavy armor, and he rescued Sun Quan.
pmwa1ngqoteirv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|周泰左右遮護，身被數槍，箭透重鎧，救得孫權。#1

pmwa1ngqotfy0e.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqotfy0e.translation: (I) managed to break out of the heavy encirclement.
pmwa1ngqotfy0e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|得脫重圍。#1

pmwa1ngqotgt5a.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqotgt5a.text: 但徐盛在垓心，如何得脫﹖」周泰曰：「吾再救去。」
pmwa1ngqotgt5a.gloss: but Xu.Sheng at battlefield.center, how DE escape? Zhou.Tai say: 1SG again rescue go.
pmwa1ngqotgt5a.translation: But Xu Sheng is in the center of the battlefield, how can he get out?" Zhou Tai said, "I will go rescue (him) again."
pmwa1ngqotgt5a.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|但徐盛在垓心，如何得脫﹖」周泰曰：「吾再救去。」#1

pmwa1ngqothx0x.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqothx0x.text: 長子曹丕，恐不得立，乃問計於中大夫賈詡。
pmwa1ngqothx0x.gloss: eldest.son Cao.Pi, fear NEG DE be.established, then ask.plan from palace.grand.officer Jia.Xu.
pmwa1ngqothx0x.translation: The eldest son Cao Pi, fearing that he would not be established (as heir), then asked the Grand Master of the Palace Jia Xu for a plan.
pmwa1ngqothx0x.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|長子曹丕，恐不得立，乃問計於中大夫賈詡。#1

pmwa1ngqpti399.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqpti399.text: 如此者數日，忽有天雷震碎石壁，得天書三卷，名曰『遁甲天書』。
pmwa1ngqpti399.gloss: like.this P several day, suddenly exist heavenly.thunder shatter stone.wall, DE heavenly.book three CLF, name.call Dunjia.Heavenly.Book.
pmwa1ngqpti399.translation: This went on for several days, when suddenly a peal of heavenly thunder shattered the stone wall, and (I) obtained three volumes of a heavenly book, named the “Dunjia Heavenly Book.”
pmwa1ngqpti399.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|如此者數日，忽有天雷震碎石壁，得天書三卷，名曰『遁甲天書』。#1

pmwa1ngqptjstp.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqptjstp.text: 操曰：「我亦久思急流勇退，奈朝廷未得其人耳。」
pmwa1ngqptjstp.gloss: Cao.Cao say: 1SG also long think bravely.retreat.from.rapid.current, but court NEG DE DEM person SFP
pmwa1ngqptjstp.translation: Cao Cao said: I too have long thought of bravely retiring at the height of my career, but the court has not yet got the right person (to replace me), that is all.
pmwa1ngqptjstp.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|操曰：「我亦久思急流勇退，奈朝廷未得其人耳。」#1

pmwa1ngqptkz57.section: 第六十八回　　　甘寧百騎劫魏營　　　左慈擲盃戲曹操
pmwa1ngqptkz57.text: 須臾，得紫芽薑滿盆，進上操前。
pmwa1ngqptkz57.gloss: moment, DE purple.sprout.ginger full.basin, present.up Cao.Cao.front.
pmwa1ngqptkz57.translation: In a moment, (he) obtained a basin full of purple-sprout ginger and presented it before Cao Cao.
pmwa1ngqptkz57.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|須臾，得紫芽薑滿盆，進上操前。#1

pmwa1ngqptlf6y.text: 「後有居民郭恩者，兄弟三人，皆得躄疾，請輅卜之。

pmwa1ngqptmkgu.section: 第六十九回　　　卜周易管輅知機　　　討漢賊五臣死節
pmwa1ngqptmkgu.text: 其二曰：『家室倒懸，門戶眾多；藏精育毒，得秋乃化。
pmwa1ngqptmkgu.gloss: its second say: household hang.upside.down, door.window numerous; store essence nurture poison, DE autumn then transform.
pmwa1ngqptmkgu.translation: The second says: 'The household hangs upside down, its doors and windows are numerous; it stores essence and nurtures poison, and when it reaches autumn, it then transforms.'

pmwa1ngqptnr8y.section: 第六十九回　　　卜周易管輅知機　　　討漢賊五臣死節
pmwa1ngqptnr8y.text: 待其飲食畢，汝乃哭拜求壽，必得益算矣。
pmwa1ngqptnr8y.gloss: wait.until 3PL eat.and.drink finish, 2SG then weep.bow seek.longevity, certainly DE extra.lifespan SFP
pmwa1ngqptnr8y.translation: Wait until they have finished eating and drinking; then weep, bow, and beg for longevity, and you will certainly gain extra years of life.

pmwa1ngqpto14b.gloss: if DE joint.conspire, great.affair succeed SFP
pmwa1ngqpto14b.translation: If (we) can get (him) to join the conspiracy, the great undertaking will succeed.
pmwa1ngqpto14b.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若得同謀，大事濟矣。」#1

pmwa1ngqptp9k1.section: 第六十九回　　　卜周易管輅知機　　　討漢賊五臣死節
pmwa1ngqptp9k1.text: 耿紀曰：「奈天數如此，不得不然耳！」
pmwa1ngqptp9k1.gloss: Geng.Ji say: what.do fate thus, NEG DE NEG so SFP!
pmwa1ngqptp9k1.translation: Geng Ji said: "What can be done when Heaven's fate is like this? (We) cannot do otherwise!"
pmwa1ngqptp9k1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|耿紀曰：「奈天數如此，不得不然耳！」#1

pmwa1ngqptqpvt.section: 第六十九回　　　卜周易管輅知機　　　討漢賊五臣死節
pmwa1ngqptqpvt.text: 二子逃竄遠鄉，得免於難。
pmwa1ngqptqpvt.gloss: two son flee distant countryside, DE escape P calamity
pmwa1ngqptqpvt.translation: The two sons fled to a distant region and managed to escape the calamity.
pmwa1ngqptqpvt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|二子逃竄遠鄉，得免於難。#1

pmwa1ngqptrvpw.section: 第六十九回　　　卜周易管輅知機　　　討漢賊五臣死節
pmwa1ngqptrvpw.text: 超責之曰：「汝不得吾令，何故輕敵致敗？」
pmwa1ngqptrvpw.gloss: Chao reprimand 3SG say: 2SG NEG DE 1SG order, why underestimate.enemy cause.defeat?
pmwa1ngqptrvpw.translation: Ma Chao reprimanded him, saying, 'You did not have my order—why did you underestimate the enemy and bring about defeat?'
pmwa1ngqptrvpw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|超責之曰：「汝不得吾令，何故輕敵致敗？」#1

pmwa1ngqptso7q.section: 第六十九回　　　卜周易管輅知機　　　討漢賊五臣死節
pmwa1ngqptso7q.gloss: if DE Baxi, Shu.commandery easy SFP
pmwa1ngqptso7q.translation: If (I) obtain Baxi, Shu commandery will be easy.
pmwa1ngqptso7q.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若得巴西，蜀郡易耳。」#1

pmwa1ngqpttrf2.section: 第七十回　　　　猛張飛智取瓦口隘　　老黃忠計奪天蕩山
pmwa1ngqpttrf2.translation: Fei had no choice but to return to camp.
pmwa1ngqpttrf2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|飛只得還營。#1

pmwa1ngqptuvyo.section: 第七十回　　　　猛張飛智取瓦口隘　　老黃忠計奪天蕩山
pmwa1ngqptuvyo.text: 張郃三寨俱失，只得奔瓦口關去了。
pmwa1ngqptuvyo.gloss: Zhang.He three camp all lose, only DE flee Wakou.Pass go CRS
pmwa1ngqptuvyo.translation: Zhang He had lost all three camps and had no choice but to flee to Wakou Pass.
pmwa1ngqptuvyo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張郃三寨俱失，只得奔瓦口關去了。#1

pmwa1ngqptvjth.section: 第七十回　　　　猛張飛智取瓦口隘　　老黃忠計奪天蕩山
pmwa1ngqptvjth.text: 郃心慌，只得定計，分兩軍去關口前山僻埋伏；分付曰：「我詐敗，張飛必然趕來，汝等就截其歸路。」
pmwa1ngqptvjth.gloss: He flustered, only DE devise.plan, divide two army go pass front remote.mountain ambush; instruct say: 1SG feign.defeat, Zhang.Fei certainly pursue.come, 2PL then cut.off 3SG.GEN return.road.
pmwa1ngqptvjth.translation: Zhang He was flustered and had no choice but to devise a plan: he divided his troops into two forces and sent them to lie in ambush in the remote mountains in front of the pass; he instructed them, saying, 'I will feign defeat; Zhang Fei is certain to come in pursuit; you all then cut off his retreat.'
pmwa1ngqptvjth.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|郃心慌，只得定計，分兩軍去關口前山僻埋伏；分付曰：「我詐敗，張飛必然趕來，汝等就截其歸路。」#1

pmwa1ngqptwow5.section: 第七十回　　　　猛張飛智取瓦口隘　　老黃忠計奪天蕩山
pmwa1ngqptwow5.text: 不想伏兵卻被魏延精兵到，趕入谷口，將車輛截住山路，放火燒車，山谷草木皆著，煙迷其徑，兵不得出。
pmwa1ngqptwow5.gloss: unexpectedly ambush.troops but PASS Wei.Yan elite.soldiers arrive, drive.into valley.mouth, BA cart block mountain.road, set.fire burn.cart, valley grass.and.trees all catch.fire, smoke obscure 3SG.GEN path, soldiers NEG DE exit.
pmwa1ngqptwow5.translation: Unexpectedly, the ambush troops were overtaken by Wei Yan’s elite soldiers arriving; (the elite soldiers) drove (them) into the valley mouth, used the carts to block the mountain road, set fire to the carts, and the grass and trees in the valley all caught fire; the smoke obscured their path, and the soldiers could not get out.
pmwa1ngqptwow5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|不想伏兵卻被魏延精兵到，趕入谷口，將車輛截住山路，放火燒車，山谷草木皆著，煙迷其徑，兵不得出。#1

pmwa1ngqptxjf0.section: 第七十回　　　　猛張飛智取瓦口隘　　老黃忠計奪天蕩山
pmwa1ngqptxjf0.text: 後面張飛追趕甚急，郃棄馬上山，尋逕而逃，方得走脫。
pmwa1ngqptxjf0.gloss: behind Zhang.Fei pursue very urgent, He abandon horse go.up mountain, seek path CONJ flee, only.then DE escape
pmwa1ngqptxjf0.translation: Zhang Fei was pursuing him closely from behind; Zhang He abandoned his horse and went up the mountain, sought a path and fled, and only then managed to escape.

pmwa1ngqptysqi.section: 第七十回　　　　猛張飛智取瓦口隘　　老黃忠計奪天蕩山
pmwa1ngqptysqi.text: 行軍司馬郭淮諫曰：「『三軍易得，一將難求』。

pmwa1ngqptysqi.translation: The marching-army marshal Guo Huai remonstrated, saying: 'An army is easy to get, but a single general is hard to find.'
pmwa1ngqptysqi.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|行軍司馬郭淮諫曰：「『三軍易得，一將難求』。#1

pmwa1ngqptzeox.section: 第七十回　　　　猛張飛智取瓦口隘　　老黃忠計奪天蕩山
pmwa1ngqptzeox.text: 孔明曰：「汝以二人老邁，不能成事，吾料漢中必於此二人手內可得。」
pmwa1ngqptzeox.gloss: Kong.Ming say: 2SG consider two person old.aged, NEG can accomplish matter, 1SG reckon Hanzhong surely at PROX two person hand.inside can DE.
pmwa1ngqptzeox.translation: Kong Ming said, "You consider the two men old and decrepit and unable to accomplish the task; I reckon Hanzhong will surely be obtainable from the hands of these two."
pmwa1ngqptzeox.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明曰：「汝以二人老邁，不能成事，吾料漢中必於此二人手內可得。」#1

pmwa1ngqpu2ttp.text: 封曰：「父親得知將軍數敗，故差某來。」
pmwa1ngqpu2ttp.gloss: Feng say: father DE know general several defeat, therefore send 1SG come
pmwa1ngqpu2ttp.translation: Feng said, "Father has learned that the general has suffered several defeats, and so he sent me here."

pmwa1ngqpu3dba.section: 第七十回　　　　猛張飛智取瓦口隘　　老黃忠計奪天蕩山
pmwa1ngqpu3dba.text: 忠曰：「『不入虎穴，焉得虎子？』」
pmwa1ngqpu3dba.gloss: Zhong say: NEG enter tiger.den, how DE tiger.cub?
pmwa1ngqpu3dba.translation: Zhong said: 'If you do not enter the tiger's den, how can you get the tiger cub?'
pmwa1ngqpu3dba.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忠曰：「『不入虎穴，焉得虎子？』」#1

pmwa1ngqpu4z02.section: 第七十回　　　　猛張飛智取瓦口隘　　老黃忠計奪天蕩山
pmwa1ngqpu4z02.text: 張郃、夏侯尚前後不能相顧，只得棄天蕩山，望定軍山投奔夏侯淵去了。
pmwa1ngqpu4z02.gloss: Zhang.He, Xiahou.Shang front.rear NEG can each.other look.after, only DE abandon Tiandang.Mountain, toward Dingjun.Mountain go.seek.refuge Xiahou.Yuan go CRS.
pmwa1ngqpu4z02.translation: Zhang He and Xiahou Shang could not support each other from front and rear, and had no choice but to abandon Tiandang Mountain and set out for Dingjun Mountain to join Xiahou Yuan.

pmwa1ngqpu5bsd.section: 第七十回　　　　猛張飛智取瓦口隘　　老黃忠計奪天蕩山
pmwa1ngqpu5bsd.text: 但今漢中定軍山，乃南鄭保障，糧草積聚之所；若得定軍山，陽平一路，無足憂矣。
pmwa1ngqpu5bsd.gloss: but now Hanzhong Dingjun.Mountain, COP Nanzheng safeguard, grain.fodder accumulate ATTR place; if DE Dingjun.Mountain, Yangping one.route, not.worth worry SFP.
pmwa1ngqpu5bsd.translation: But now Dingjun Mountain in Hanzhong is the safeguard of Nanzheng and a place where grain and fodder are stored; if we obtain Dingjun Mountain, the Yangping route will be nothing to worry about.
pmwa1ngqpu5bsd.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|但今漢中定軍山，乃南鄭保障，糧草積聚之所；若得定軍山，陽平一路，無足憂矣。#1

pmwa1ngqpu6j68.section: 第七十一回　　　占對山黃忠逸待勞　　據漢水趙雲寡勝眾
pmwa1ngqpu6j68.text: 卻說黃忠與法正屯兵於定軍山口，累次挑戰，夏侯淵堅守不出；欲要進攻，又恐山路危險，難以料敵，只得據守。
pmwa1ngqpu6j68.gloss: now.say Huang.Zhong with Fa.Zheng station.troops at Dingjun.Mountain pass, repeatedly provoke.battle, Xiahou.Yuan firm.defend NEG come.out; want attack, again fear mountain.road dangerous, difficult.to assess.enemy, only DE hold.defend.
pmwa1ngqpu6j68.translation: Now, Huang Zhong and Fa Zheng stationed troops at the Dingjun Mountain pass and repeatedly provoked battle; Xiahou Yuan held firm and did not come out. Wanting to attack, they also feared that the mountain roads were dangerous and that the enemy would be hard to assess, so they could only hold their position.
pmwa1ngqpu6j68.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說黃忠與法正屯兵於定軍山口，累次挑戰，夏侯淵堅守不出；欲要進攻，又恐山路危險，難以料敵，只得據守。#1

pmwa1ngqpu7qm0.translation: Some routed soldiers escaped with their lives and reported back to Huang Zhong, saying that Chen Shi had been captured.
pmwa1ngqpu7qm0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|有敗軍逃得性命，回報黃忠，說陳式被擒。#1

pmwa1ngqqu8agp.text: 將軍若取得此山，定軍山只在掌中也。」
pmwa1ngqqu8agp.gloss: general if obtain DE PROX mountain, Dingjun.Mountain only at palm inside SFP
pmwa1ngqqu8agp.translation: If you, General, can seize this mountain, Mount Dingjun will be right there in the palm of your hand.

pmwa1ngqqu9xdt.text: 當時見黃忠大隊擁上，只得棄山而走。

pmwa1ngqqu9xdt.translation: At that time, seeing Huang Zhong's large force swarming up, (Du Xi) had no choice but to abandon the mountain and flee.

pmwa1ngqqua5hd.section: 第七十一回　　　占對山黃忠逸待勞　　據漢水趙雲寡勝眾
pmwa1ngqqua5hd.text: 忠得了山頂，正與定軍山相對。
pmwa1ngqqua5hd.gloss: Zhong DE PFV mountain.top, just with Dingjun.Mountain face.each.other.
pmwa1ngqqua5hd.translation: Zhong gained the mountain top, which faced Dingjun Mountain directly.
pmwa1ngqqua5hd.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忠得了山頂，正與定軍山相對。#1

pmwa1ngqqubvkj.section: 第七十一回　　　占對山黃忠逸待勞　　據漢水趙雲寡勝眾
pmwa1ngqqubvkj.text: 孔明曰：「今操引大兵至此，恐糧草不敷，故勒兵不進；若得一人深入其境，燒其糧草，奪其輜重，則操之銳氣挫矣。」
pmwa1ngqqubvkj.gloss: Kongming say: now Cao.Cao lead great.army arrive here, fear provisions NEG sufficient, therefore restrain.troops NEG advance; if DE one person go.deep 3SG territory, burn 3SG provisions, seize 3SG baggage, then Cao.Cao GEN sharp.spirit blunt SFP
pmwa1ngqqubvkj.translation: Kongming said, 'Now Cao Cao has led a large army here. Fearing that his provisions are insufficient, he is holding his troops back and not advancing. If we can get one man to go deep into his territory, burn his provisions, and seize his baggage train, then Cao Cao's fighting spirit will be blunted.'
pmwa1ngqqubvkj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明曰：「今操引大兵至此，恐糧草不敷，故勒兵不進；若得一人深入其境，燒其糧草，奪其輜重，則操之銳氣挫矣。」#1

pmwa1ngqqucndd.gloss: if kill DE Zhang.He, surpass kill Xiahou.Yuan ten.times SFP
pmwa1ngqqucndd.translation: If (we) can kill Zhang He, that would be ten times better than killing Xiahou Yuan.
pmwa1ngqqucndd.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若斬得張郃，勝斬夏侯淵十倍也。」#1

pmwa1ngqqud9b6.section: 第七十一回　　　占對山黃忠逸待勞　　據漢水趙雲寡勝眾
pmwa1ngqqud9b6.text: 只聽得後面喊聲大震，鼓角齊鳴，蜀兵趕來。
pmwa1ngqqud9b6.gloss: only hear DE behind shout.sound greatly shake, drum.horn together sound, Shu.soldier hurry.come
pmwa1ngqqud9b6.translation: (They) only heard a great roar of shouting from behind, drums and horns sounding in unison, as the Shu soldiers came in pursuit.
pmwa1ngqqud9b6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只聽得後面喊聲大震，鼓角齊鳴，蜀兵趕來。#1

pmwa1ngqqueysv.section: 第七十一回　　　占對山黃忠逸待勞　　據漢水趙雲寡勝眾
pmwa1ngqqueysv.text: 趙雲占了曹寨，黃忠了糧草，漢水所得軍器無數，大獲勝捷，差人去報玄德。

pmwa1ngqqueysv.translation: Zhao Yun occupied the Cao camp, Huang Zhong [seized] the grain and fodder; the weapons obtained at the Han River were countless; they won a great victory and sent men to report to Xuande.
pmwa1ngqqueysv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|趙雲占了曹寨，黃忠了糧草，漢水所得軍器無數，大獲勝捷，差人去報玄德。#1

pmwa1ngqqufdgf.section: 第七十一回　　　占對山黃忠逸待勞　　據漢水趙雲寡勝眾
pmwa1ngqqufdgf.translation: I reckon (we) will certainly obtain the Han River.
pmwa1ngqqufdgf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|我料必得漢水矣。」#1

pmwa1ngqqugyq4.section: 第七十二回　　　諸葛亮智取漢中　　　曹阿瞞兵退斜谷
pmwa1ngqqugyq4.text: 晃死戰得脫，回營責王平曰：「汝見吾軍勢將危，如何不救？」
pmwa1ngqqugyq4.gloss: Huang fight.to.death DE escape, return.to.camp reproach Wang.Ping say: 2SG see 1SG army.situation FUT be.in.danger, how NEG rescue?
pmwa1ngqqugyq4.translation: Huang fought desperately and got away; returning to camp, he reproached Wang Ping, saying, "You saw that my army's position was about to be in danger—how did you not rescue (me)?"
pmwa1ngqqugyq4.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|晃死戰得脫，回營責王平曰：「汝見吾軍勢將危，如何不救？」#1

pmwa1ngqquhov8.section: 第七十二回　　　諸葛亮智取漢中　　　曹阿瞞兵退斜谷
pmwa1ngqquhov8.text: 玄德大喜曰：「孤得王子均，取漢中無疑矣。」
pmwa1ngqquhov8.gloss: Xuande great joy say: "1SG DE Wang.Zijun, take Hanzhong no.doubt SFP."
pmwa1ngqquhov8.translation: Xuande was greatly delighted and said, "I have gotten Wang Zijun; taking Hanzhong is without doubt."
pmwa1ngqquhov8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德大喜曰：「孤得王子均，取漢中無疑矣。」#1

pmwa1ngqquj2bj.text: 操下令：「捉得劉備，便為西川之王。」

pmwa1ngqqunvlt.translation: So I first packed my baggage, to avoid confusion when the time came to set out.
pmwa1ngqqunvlt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|故先收拾行裝，免得臨行慌亂。」#1

pmwa1ngqquon9w.section: 第七十二回　　　諸葛亮智取漢中　　　曹阿瞞兵退斜谷
pmwa1ngqquon9w.gloss: gate clerk block OBJ, Pi only DE retreat return.
pmwa1ngqquon9w.translation: The gate clerk blocked him, and Pi had no choice but to turn back.
pmwa1ngqquon9w.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|門吏阻之，丕只得退回。#1

pmwa1ngqqup51i.section: 第七十三回　　　玄德進位漢中王　　　雲長攻拔襄陽郡
pmwa1ngqqup51i.text: 玄德曰：「汝等雖欲尊吾為王，不得天子明詔，是僭也。」
pmwa1ngqqup51i.gloss: Xuande say: 2PL although wish honor 1SG as king, NEG DE Son.of.Heaven clear.edict, DEM usurp SFP.
pmwa1ngqqup51i.translation: Xuande said: "Although you all wish to honor me as king, without the Son of Heaven's explicit edict, this is usurpation."
pmwa1ngqqup51i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德曰：「汝等雖欲尊吾為王，不得天子明詔，是僭也。」#1

pmwa1ngqquqnkp.section: 第七十三回　　　玄德進位漢中王　　　雲長攻拔襄陽郡
pmwa1ngqquqnkp.text: 玄德再三推遲不過，只得依允。
pmwa1ngqquqnkp.gloss: Xuande repeatedly decline not.pass, only DE comply agree.
pmwa1ngqquqnkp.translation: Xuande declined again and again but could not get past it, and had no choice but to agree.
pmwa1ngqquqnkp.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|玄德再三推遲不過，只得依允。#1

pmwa1ngqquruvv.section: 第七十三回　　　玄德進位漢中王　　　雲長攻拔襄陽郡
pmwa1ngqquruvv.text: 若應權通變，以寧靜聖朝，雖赴水火，所不得辭。
pmwa1ngqquruvv.gloss: if respond.to.expediency adapt.to.change, in.order.to pacify sage.court, although go.to water.fire, NMLZ NEG DE decline.
pmwa1ngqquruvv.translation: If (I) act expediently and adapt to change in order to pacify the sage court, although (it means) going into water and fire, it is not something (I) can decline.
pmwa1ngqquruvv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若應權通變，以寧靜聖朝，雖赴水火，所不得辭。#1

pmwa1ngqqusjcc.section: 第七十三回　　　玄德進位漢中王　　　雲長攻拔襄陽郡
pmwa1ngqqusjcc.text: 若雲長一動，主公可遣一將，暗取荊州，一舉可得矣。」
pmwa1ngqqusjcc.gloss: if Yun.chang one move, lord can send one general, secretly take Jingzhou, one raise can DE CRS
pmwa1ngqqusjcc.translation: If Yun-chang makes a move, my lord can send a general to secretly seize Jingzhou, and it can be taken in a single stroke.
pmwa1ngqqusjcc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若雲長一動，主公可遣一將，暗取荊州，一舉可得矣。」#1

pmwa1ngqqutwqe.section: 第七十三回　　　玄德進位漢中王　　　雲長攻拔襄陽郡
pmwa1ngqqutwqe.text: 細作人探聽得曹操結連東吳，欲取荊州，即飛報入蜀。
pmwa1ngqqutwqe.gloss: spy person investigate DE Cao.Cao ally connect Eastern.Wu, wish take Jingzhou, immediately fly report enter Shu.
pmwa1ngqqutwqe.translation: The spy, having learned that Cao Cao was joining forces with Eastern Wu and meant to seize Jingzhou, at once sent a flying report into Shu.
pmwa1ngqqutwqe.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|細作人探聽得曹操結連東吳，欲取荊州，即飛報入蜀。#1

pmwa1ngqquuz8l.section: 第七十三回　　　玄德進位漢中王　　　雲長攻拔襄陽郡
pmwa1ngqquuz8l.text: 乃喚武士各杖四十，摘去先鋒印綬，罰糜芳守南郡，傅士仁守公安；且曰：「吾若得勝回來之日，稍有差池，二罪俱罰！」
pmwa1ngqquuz8l.gloss: then call warrior each staff.strike forty, strip.off vanguard seal.ribbon, punish Mi.Fang guard Nan.Commandery, Fu.Shiren guard Gong'an; and say: 1SG if DE win return LNK day, slight have mishap, two crime all punish!
pmwa1ngqquuz8l.translation: Then he summoned the warriors and had each of them given forty strokes of the rod, stripped them of their vanguard seals and ribbons, and punished Mi Fang with guarding Nanjun and Fu Shiren with guarding Gong'an; and he said: "If on the day I return victorious there is the slightest mishap, both crimes will be punished together!"
pmwa1ngqquuz8l.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|乃喚武士各杖四十，摘去先鋒印綬，罰糜芳守南郡，傅士仁守公安；且曰：「吾若得勝回來之日，稍有差池，二罪俱罰！」#1

pmwa1ngqruvvns.section: 第七十三回　　　玄德進位漢中王　　　雲長攻拔襄陽郡
pmwa1ngqruvvns.text: 又追殺二十餘里，忽聽得背後喊聲大震，鼓角齊鳴。
pmwa1ngqruvvns.gloss: again pursue.and.kill twenty.odd li, suddenly hear DE behind shout.sound greatly.quake, drum.horn together.sound.
pmwa1ngqruvvns.translation: (The Cao troops) pursued and killed (them) for another twenty-odd li, when suddenly they heard behind them a great roar of shouting, and drums and horns sounded in unison.
pmwa1ngqruvvns.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|又追殺二十餘里，忽聽得背後喊聲大震，鼓角齊鳴。#1

pmwa1ngqruw9f5.section: 第七十三回　　　玄德進位漢中王　　　雲長攻拔襄陽郡
pmwa1ngqruw9f5.text: 雲長得了襄陽，賞軍撫民。
pmwa1ngqruw9f5.gloss: Yunchang DE PFV Xiangyang, reward army comfort people
pmwa1ngqruw9f5.translation: Yunchang (Guan Yu) took Xiangyang, rewarded the troops and comforted the people.
pmwa1ngqruw9f5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雲長得了襄陽，賞軍撫民。#1

pmwa1ngqruxcbf.section: 第七十三回　　　玄德進位漢中王　　　雲長攻拔襄陽郡
pmwa1ngqruxcbf.text: 王甫曰：「糜芳、傅士仁守二隘口，恐不竭力；必須再得一人以總督荊州。」
pmwa1ngqruxcbf.gloss: Wang.Fu say: Mi.Fang, Fu.Shiren guard two pass, fear NEG exert.effort; must again DE one person in.order.to supervise Jingzhou.
pmwa1ngqruxcbf.translation: Wang Fu said, "Mi Fang and Fu Shiren are guarding the two passes; I fear they will not exert their full effort. We must obtain one more person to take overall charge of Jingzhou."
pmwa1ngqruxcbf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|王甫曰：「糜芳、傅士仁守二隘口，恐不竭力；必須再得一人以總督荊州。」#1

pmwa1ngqruy1f4.section: 第七十四回　　　龐令明擡櫬決死戰　　關雲長放水渰七軍
pmwa1ngqruy1f4.text: 衡曰：「龐德原係馬超手下副將，不得已而降魏；今其故主在蜀，職居『五虎上將』；況其親兄龐柔亦在西川為官；今使他為先鋒，是潑油救火也。
pmwa1ngqruy1f4.gloss: Heng say : Pang.De originally COP Ma.Chao subordinate deputy.general , NEG DE stop CONJ surrender Wei ; now 3SG.GEN former.lord be.at Shu , office hold Five.Tiger.Senior.General ; moreover 3SG.GEN own.elder.brother Pang.Rou also be.at Xichuan be official ; now make 3SG be vanguard , COP pour.oil save.fire SFP .
pmwa1ngqruy1f4.translation: Heng said: Pang De was originally a subordinate deputy general under Ma Chao, and had no choice but to surrender to Wei; now his former lord is in Shu, holding the office of Five Tiger General; moreover his own elder brother Pang Rou is also an official in Xichuan; now to make him vanguard is to pour oil on the fire to put it out.
pmwa1ngqruy1f4.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|衡曰：「龐德原係馬超手下副將，不得已而降魏；今其故主在蜀，職居『五虎上將』；況其親兄龐柔亦在西川為官；今使他為先鋒，是潑油救火也。#1

pmwa1ngqruz54v.section: 第七十四回　　　龐令明擡櫬決死戰　　關雲長放水渰七軍
pmwa1ngqruz54v.gloss: two army each watch DE stupefied CRS
pmwa1ngqruz54v.translation: Both armies each watched until they were stupefied.
pmwa1ngqruz54v.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|兩軍各看得癡呆了。#1

pmwa1ngqrv0csn.section: 第七十四回　　　龐令明擡櫬決死戰　　關雲長放水渰七軍
pmwa1ngqrv0csn.text: 相見畢，禁曰：「聞將軍戰關公，百合之上，未得便宜，何不且退軍避之？」
pmwa1ngqrv0csn.gloss: meet.each.other finish, Jin say: hear general fight Guan.Gong, hundred.round above, NEG DE advantage, why NEG temporarily withdraw.army avoid 3SG?
pmwa1ngqrv0csn.translation: When they had finished greeting each other, Yu Jin said: “I hear that you, General, fought Guan Gong, and after more than a hundred bouts you did not gain the advantage; why not withdraw the troops for the time being and avoid him?”
pmwa1ngqrv0csn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|相見畢，禁曰：「聞將軍戰關公，百合之上，未得便宜，何不且退軍避之？」#1

pmwa1ngqrv1jtl.section: 第七十四回　　　龐令明擡櫬決死戰　　關雲長放水渰七軍
pmwa1ngqrv1jtl.text: 龐德勒回馬輪刀趕來，忽聽得本營鑼聲大震。
pmwa1ngqrv1jtl.gloss: Pang.De rein.back horse brandish.blade come.rushing, suddenly hear DE own.camp gong.sound loudly.resound.
pmwa1ngqrv1jtl.translation: Pang De reined his horse back and, brandishing his blade, came charging up; suddenly he heard the gong of his own camp sounding out loudly.
pmwa1ngqrv1jtl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|龐德勒回馬輪刀趕來，忽聽得本營鑼聲大震。#1

pmwa1ngqrv2afj.section: 第七十四回　　　龐令明擡櫬決死戰　　關雲長放水渰七軍
pmwa1ngqrv2afj.text: 幸得箭射不深，用金瘡藥敷之。
pmwa1ngqrv2afj.gloss: fortunate DE arrow shoot NEG deep, use metal.wound.medicine apply 3SG.
pmwa1ngqrv2afj.translation: Fortunately, the arrow had not penetrated deeply; (he) applied a metal-wound medicine to it.
pmwa1ngqrv2afj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幸得箭射不深，用金瘡藥敷之。#1

pmwa1ngqrv3oms.section: 第七十四回　　　龐令明擡櫬決死戰　　關雲長放水渰七軍
pmwa1ngqrv3oms.text: 忽聽得于禁移七軍於樊城之北下寨，未知其謀，即報知關公。
pmwa1ngqrv3oms.gloss: 忽 suddenly 聽得 hear DE 于禁 Yu.Jin 移 move 七軍 seven.army 於 at 樊城 Fancheng 之 GEN 北 north 下寨 pitch.camp, 未 not 知 know 其 3SG.GEN 謀 plan, 即 immediately 報知 report Lord.Guan
pmwa1ngqrv3oms.translation: Suddenly he heard that Yu Jin had moved the seven armies to pitch camp north of Fancheng, and since he did not know what his plan was, he at once reported it to Lord Guan.
pmwa1ngqrv3oms.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忽聽得于禁移七軍於樊城之北下寨，未知其謀，即報知關公。#1

pmwa1ngqrv4r9a.section: 第七十四回　　　龐令明擡櫬決死戰　　關雲長放水渰七軍
pmwa1ngqrv4r9a.text: 龐德坐在帳中，只聽得萬馬爭奔，征鼙震地。
pmwa1ngqrv4r9a.gloss: Pang.De sit at tent.inside, only hear DE ten.thousand horse contend gallop, war.drum shake earth.
pmwa1ngqrv4r9a.translation: Pang De sat in the tent, and only heard ten thousand horses stampeding and war drums shaking the earth.
pmwa1ngqrv4r9a.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|龐德坐在帳中，只聽得萬馬爭奔，征鼙震地。#1

pmwa1ngqrv52rv.section: 第七十五回　　　關雲長刮骨療毒　　　呂子明白衣渡江
pmwa1ngqrv52rv.text: 眾將見公不肯退兵，瘡又不痊，只得四方訪問名醫。
pmwa1ngqrv52rv.gloss: all.generals see lord NEG willing withdraw.troops, wound also NEG heal, only DE four.directions seek.out famous.physician.
pmwa1ngqrv52rv.translation: The generals saw that the lord was unwilling to withdraw the troops and that the wound still would not heal, so they had no choice but to seek out famous physicians in all directions.
pmwa1ngqrv52rv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾將見公不肯退兵，瘡又不痊，只得四方訪問名醫。#1

pmwa1ngqrv666e.section: 第七十五回　　　關雲長刮骨療毒　　　呂子明白衣渡江
pmwa1ngqrv666e.text: 今孫、劉失好，雲長得志，孫權必不喜。
pmwa1ngqrv666e.gloss: now Sun, Liu lose.friendship, Yunchang DE ambition, Sun.Quan certainly NEG pleased.
pmwa1ngqrv666e.translation: Now that Sun and Liu have fallen out and Yunchang has got his way, Sun Quan is certain not to be pleased.
pmwa1ngqrv666e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今孫、劉失好，雲長得志，孫權必不喜。#1

pmwa1ngqrv7h6e.section: 第七十五回　　　關雲長刮骨療毒　　　呂子明白衣渡江
pmwa1ngqrv7h6e.text: 今一面遣使致書東吳，一面必得一大將以當雲長之銳。」
pmwa1ngqrv7h6e.gloss: now on.one.hand send envoy deliver letter Eastern.Wu, on.other.hand must DE one great general in.order.to withstand Yun.chang GEN sharpness.
pmwa1ngqrv7h6e.translation: Now, on one hand send an envoy to deliver a letter to Eastern Wu; on the other hand, (we) must get a great general to withstand Yun-chang's keen edge.
pmwa1ngqrv7h6e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今一面遣使致書東吳，一面必得一大將以當雲長之銳。」#1

pmwa1ngqrv80dq.section: 第七十五回　　　關雲長刮骨療毒　　　呂子明白衣渡江
pmwa1ngqrv80dq.text: 卻說孫權接得曹操書信，覽畢，欣然應允，即修書發付使者先回，乃聚文武商議。
pmwa1ngqrv80dq.gloss: now Sun.Quan receive DE Cao.Cao letter, read finish, joyfully agree, immediately write.letter dispatch messenger first return, then gather civil.and.military discuss.
pmwa1ngqrv80dq.translation: Now then, Sun Quan received Cao Cao’s letter; having read it through, he joyfully agreed, and at once wrote a reply and sent the messenger back first; then he gathered the civil and military officials to discuss the matter.
pmwa1ngqrv80dq.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說孫權接得曹操書信，覽畢，欣然應允，即修書發付使者先回，乃聚文武商議。#1

pmwa1ngqrv9t1y.section: 第七十五回　　　關雲長刮骨療毒　　　呂子明白衣渡江
pmwa1ngqrv9t1y.text: 徐州守兵無多，往自可克；然其地勢利於陸戰，不利水戰，縱然得之，亦難保守。
pmwa1ngqrv9t1y.gloss: Xu.Province garrison.troops not.many, go naturally can capture; however 3SG.GEN terrain advantageous.for land.warfare, not.advantageous naval.warfare, even.if DE 3SG.OBJ, also difficult defend.
pmwa1ngqrv9t1y.translation: The defending troops of Xu Province are not many; if (we) go, (we) can naturally take it. However, its terrain is advantageous for land warfare and not advantageous for naval warfare; even if (we) obtain it, it will also be difficult to defend.
pmwa1ngqrv9t1y.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|徐州守兵無多，往自可克；然其地勢利於陸戰，不利水戰，縱然得之，亦難保守。#1

pmwa1ngqrvappi.section: 第七十五回　　　關雲長刮骨療毒　　　呂子明白衣渡江
pmwa1ngqrvappi.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卿毋得推辭。」#1

pmwa1ngqrvb6pc.section: 第七十五回　　　關雲長刮骨療毒　　　呂子明白衣渡江
pmwa1ngqrvb6pc.text: 遜大喜，密遣人探得關公果然撤荊州大半兵赴樊城聽調，只待箭瘡痊可，便欲進兵。
pmwa1ngqrvb6pc.gloss: Lu.Xun greatly.rejoice, secretly send person spy.out DE Guan.Gong indeed withdraw Jingzhou most troops go.to Fancheng await orders, only wait arrow wound heal, then want advance troops.
pmwa1ngqrvb6pc.translation: Lu Xun was overjoyed. He secretly sent someone to spy (and) learned that Lord Guan had indeed withdrawn most of Jingzhou's troops and gone to Fancheng to await orders, and that he was only waiting for his arrow wound to heal before intending to advance his troops.
pmwa1ngqrvb6pc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|遜大喜，密遣人探得關公果然撤荊州大半兵赴樊城聽調，只待箭瘡痊可，便欲進兵。#1

pmwa1ngqrvcorn.section: 第七十五回　　　關雲長刮骨療毒　　　呂子明白衣渡江
pmwa1ngqrvcorn.text: 門吏認得是荊州之兵，開了城門。
pmwa1ngqrvcorn.gloss: gate.official recognize-DE COP Jingzhou GEN troop, open PFV city.gate
pmwa1ngqrvcorn.translation: The gate guard recognized that they were Jingzhou troops and opened the city gate.
pmwa1ngqrvcorn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|門吏認得是荊州之兵，開了城門。#1

pmwa1ngqrvdrj7.section: 第七十五回　　　關雲長刮骨療毒　　　呂子明白衣渡江
pmwa1ngqrvdrj7.text: 權謂呂蒙曰：「今荊州已得，但公安傅士仁、南郡糜芳，此二處如何收復？」
pmwa1ngqrvdrj7.gloss: Quan say.to Lü.Meng say: now Jingzhou already DE, but Gong'an Fu.Shiren, Nanjun Mi.Fang, PROX two place how recover?

pmwa1ngqsvtxkv.text: 昔曹操得此人時，封侯賜爵，三日一小宴，五日一大宴；上馬一提金，下馬一提銀：如此恩禮，畢竟留之不住，聽其斬關殺將而去，致使今日反為所逼，幾欲遷都以避其鋒。

pmwa1ngqsvtxkv.translation: In the past, when Cao Cao got this man, he enfeoffed him as a marquis and bestowed rank on him; every three days a small banquet, every five days a great banquet; when he mounted his horse, a measure of gold, when he dismounted, a measure of silver: with such kindness and courtesy, in the end he could not keep him, and let him cut through the passes and kill the generals and leave, so that today (Cao Cao) was instead pressed by him and nearly wished to move the capital to avoid his edge.

pmwa1ngqsw3bff.section: 第七十八回　　　治風疾神醫身死　　　傳遺命奸雄數終
pmwa1ngqsw3bff.text: 操令近侍取平日所藏名香，分賜諸侍妾，且囑曰：「吾死之後，汝等須勤習女工，多造絲履，賣之可以得錢自給。」

pmwa1ngqtw4vec.translation: The assembled ministers said, "The heir prince ought to succeed to the throne, but he has not yet received the Son of Heaven's decree; how can (we) act so hastily?"

pmwa1ngqtw6iva.section: 第七十八回　　　治風疾神醫身死　　　傳遺命奸雄數終
pmwa1ngqtw6iva.text: 原來華歆諂事魏，故草此詔，威逼獻帝降之；帝只得聽從，故下詔即封曹丕為魏王、丞相、冀州牧。

pmwa1ngqtw6iva.translation: It turned out that Hua Xin had flattered and served Wei, and therefore drafted this edict, coercing Emperor Xian into submitting to him; the emperor had no choice but to comply, and so issued an edict forthwith enfeoffing Cao Pi as King of Wei, Chancellor, and Governor of Jizhou.

pmwa1ngqtwb0xr.translation: Only a hundred-odd cavalry remained under Liu Feng’s command; he arrived at Chengdu, went in to see the King of Hanzhong, wept and bowed on the ground, and gave a detailed report of the earlier events.

pmwa1ngqtwevz5.section: 第八十回　　　　曹丕廢帝篡炎劉　　　漢王正位繼大統

pmwa1ngqtwfray.section: 第八十回　　　　曹丕廢帝篡炎劉　　　漢王正位繼大統

Now, by good fortune, Your Majesty possesses the land of the Two Rivers, (and you) have not belied my words of former days.'

pmwa1ngqvwlhfy.section: 第八十一回　　　急兄讎張飛遇害　　　雪弟恨先主興兵

pmwa1ngqvwplj9.gloss: Zhuge.Jin see Former.Lord NEG listen, only DE self return Jiangnan.
pmwa1ngqvwplj9.translation: Zhuge Jin saw that the Former Lord would not listen, and had no choice but to return to Jiangnan himself.

pmwa1ngqvwqpng.gloss: 1SG with Ziyu can.be.said spiritual.communion, NEG outside.word NMLZ DE come.between SFP
pmwa1ngqvwqpng.translation: Ziyu and I can be said to be kindred spirits; no words from outsiders can come between us.

pmwa1ngqvwr09g.section: 第八十二回　　　孫權降魏受九錫　　　先主征吳賞六軍
pmwa1ngqvwr09g.text: 權曰：「姪雖英勇，爭奈年幼；必得一人相助，方可。」
pmwa1ngqvwr09g.gloss: Quan say: nephew although brave.heroic, but.alas young; must DE one person assist, only.then be.all.right.
pmwa1ngqvwr09g.translation: Quan said: Nephew, although brave and heroic, alas is young; (we) must get one person to assist (him), and only then will it be all right.
pmwa1ngqvwr09g.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|權曰：「姪雖英勇，爭奈年幼；必得一人相助，方可。」#1

pmwa1ngqvwssos.section: 第八十二回　　　孫權降魏受九錫　　　先主征吳賞六軍
pmwa1ngqvwssos.text: 哨馬探得蜀兵已至宜都下寨，孫桓引二萬五千軍馬，屯於宜都界口，前後分作三營，以拒蜀兵。
pmwa1ngqvwssos.gloss: scout.cavalry reconnoiter DE Shu.troops already arrive Yidu pitch.camp, Sun.Huan lead two ten.thousand five thousand troops, encamp at Yidu border.pass, front.rear divide.into three camp, in.order.to resist Shu.troops.
pmwa1ngqvwssos.translation: The scouts learned that the Shu troops had already arrived at Yidu and pitched camp; Sun Huan led twenty-five thousand troops and encamped at the border pass of Yidu, dividing (them) into three camps, front and rear, in order to resist the Shu troops.
pmwa1ngqvwssos.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|哨馬探得蜀兵已至宜都下寨，孫桓引二萬五千軍馬，屯於宜都界口，前後分作三營，以拒蜀兵。#1

pmwa1ngqvwtxwp.section: 第八十二回　　　孫權降魏受九錫　　　先主征吳賞六軍
pmwa1ngqvwtxwp.text: 蜀將得勝收兵，只不見了關興。
pmwa1ngqvwtxwp.gloss: Shu general DE victory withdraw.troops, only NEG see CRS Guan.Xing
pmwa1ngqvwtxwp.translation: The Shu generals won the victory and withdrew their troops; only Guan Xing was missing.

pmwa1ngqvwuctu.section: 第八十二回　　　孫權降魏受九錫　　　先主征吳賞六軍
pmwa1ngqvwuctu.text: 方進得城，吳班等追至，將城四面圍定。
pmwa1ngqvwuctu.gloss: just enter DE city, Wu.Ban PL pursue arrive, BA city four.sides surround settle
pmwa1ngqvwuctu.translation: Just as (Sun Huan) entered the city, Wu Ban and the others came up in pursuit and surrounded the city on all four sides.
