pmwa1ngqvwwac3.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqvwwac3.text: 卻說甘寧正在船中養病，聽知蜀兵大至，火急上馬，正遇一彪蠻兵，人皆披髮跣足，皆使弓弩長鎗，搪牌刀斧；為首乃是番王沙摩柯，生得面如噀血，碧眼突出，使一個鐵蒺藜骨朵，腰帶兩張弓，威風抖擻。
pmwa1ngqvwwac3.gloss: meanwhile Gan.Ning just.at boat.inside recuperate.illness, hear.learn Shu.soldier greatly.arrive, frantic.haste mount.horse, just.encounter one.CLF barbarian.soldier, people all loose.hair bare.foot, all wield bow.crossbow long.spear, shield sword.axe; leader COP foreign.king Shamoke, bear DE face like spurted.blood, green.eye protrude, wield one.CLF iron.caltrop mace, waist.carry two.CLF bow, awe spirited.
pmwa1ngqvwwac3.translation: Meanwhile, Gan Ning was in his boat recuperating from illness; when he learned that the Shu troops had arrived in great force, he mounted his horse in frantic haste and just then encountered a troop of barbarian soldiers—all with unbound hair and bare feet, all wielding bows and crossbows, long spears, shields, swords and axes. At their head was the foreign king Shamoke, who had a face like spattered blood and bulging green eyes; he wielded an iron caltrop mace, carried two bows at his waist, and was awe-inspiring and spirited.
pmwa1ngqvwwac3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說甘寧正在船中養病，聽知蜀兵大至，火急上馬，正遇一彪蠻兵，人皆披髮跣足，皆使弓弩長鎗，搪牌刀斧；為首乃是番王沙摩柯，生得面如噀血，碧眼突出，使一個鐵蒺藜骨朵，腰帶兩張弓，威風抖擻。#1

pmwa1ngqvwxml6.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqvwxml6.text: 寧帶箭而走，到得富池口，坐於大樹之下而死。
pmwa1ngqvwxml6.gloss: Ning carry arrow CONJ flee, arrive DE Fuchikou, sit at big tree under CONJ die.
pmwa1ngqvwxml6.translation: Ning fled carrying the arrow; when he reached Fuchikou, he sat beneath a large tree and died.
pmwa1ngqvwxml6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|寧帶箭而走，到得富池口，坐於大樹之下而死。#1

pmwa1ngqvwygfz.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqvwygfz.text: 卻說先主乘勢追殺，遂得猇亭。
pmwa1ngqvwygfz.gloss: meanwhile say Former.Lord seize.momentum pursue.kill, then DE Xiaoting
pmwa1ngqvwygfz.translation: Meanwhile, the Former Lord (Liu Bei) seized the momentum and pursued and killed (the enemy), and so took Xiaoting.
pmwa1ngqvwygfz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說先主乘勢追殺，遂得猇亭。#1

pmwa1ngqwwz7i3.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqwwz7i3.gloss: fortunately DE star moon have light
pmwa1ngqwwz7i3.translation: Fortunately, the stars and moon gave light.
pmwa1ngqwwz7i3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幸得星月有光。#1

pmwa1ngqwx0zmi.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqwx0zmi.text: 興得了父親的青龍偃月刀，卻將潘璋首級，擐於馬項之下，辭了老人，就騎了潘璋的馬，望本營而來。
pmwa1ngqwx0zmi.gloss: Xing DE PFV father GEN Green.Dragon.Crescent.Blade, then BA Pan.Zhang head, hang at horse neck GEN under, take.leave PFV old.man, then ride PFV Pan.Zhang GEN horse, toward own.camp CONJ come.
pmwa1ngqwx0zmi.translation: Xing obtained his father’s Green Dragon Crescent Blade, then took Pan Zhang’s head and hung it beneath the horse’s neck; he took leave of the old man, mounted Pan Zhang’s horse, and came toward his own camp.
pmwa1ngqwx0zmi.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|興得了父親的青龍偃月刀，卻將潘璋首級，擐於馬項之下，辭了老人，就騎了潘璋的馬，望本營而來。#1

pmwa1ngqwx1het.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqwx1het.text: 且說關興行無數里，忽聽得人喊馬嘶，一彪軍到來；為首一將，乃潘璋部將馬忠也。
pmwa1ngqwx1het.gloss: now.say Guan.Xing travel not.many li, suddenly hear DE person shout horse neigh, one CLF troop arrive; at.head one general, COP Pan.Zhang subordinate.general Ma.Zhong SFP.
pmwa1ngqwx1het.translation: Now to speak of Guan Xing: he had traveled not many li when he suddenly heard men shouting and horses neighing, and a body of troops arrived; the general at their head was Ma Zhong, a subordinate general of Pan Zhang.
pmwa1ngqwx1het.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|且說關興行無數里，忽聽得人喊馬嘶，一彪軍到來；為首一將，乃潘璋部將馬忠也。#1

pmwa1ngqwx2gg6.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqwx2gg6.text: 忠見興殺了主將潘璋，將首級擐於馬項之下；青龍刀又被興得了；勃然大怒，縱馬來取關興。
pmwa1ngqwx2gg6.gloss: Zhong see Xing kill PFV chief.general Pan.Zhang, BA head hang at horse neck under; Green.Dragon.blade also PASS Xing DE PFV; suddenly great.angry, gallop horse come attack Guan.Xing.
pmwa1ngqwx2gg6.translation: Zhong saw that Xing had killed the chief general Pan Zhang and hung the head beneath the horse's neck; the Green Dragon blade had also been obtained by Xing; he flew into a rage and galloped his horse forward to attack Guan Xing.
pmwa1ngqwx2gg6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忠見興殺了主將潘璋，將首級擐於馬項之下；青龍刀又被興得了；勃然大怒，縱馬來取關興。#1

pmwa1ngqwx3w06.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqwx3w06.text: 今蜀主所恨者，馬忠耳；何不殺了他，將首級去獻蜀主，告稱：『我等不得已而降吳，今知御駕前來，特地詣營請罪。』」
pmwa1ngqwx3w06.gloss: now Shu.lord NMLZ hate NMLZ, Ma.Zhong SFP; why NEG kill PFV 3SG, take head go present Shu.lord, report say: 1PL NEG DE stop CONJ surrender Wu, now know imperial.carriage come.forward, specially go.to camp ask.for.punishment.
pmwa1ngqwx3w06.translation: Now the one the Lord of Shu hates is Ma Zhong, that is all. Why not kill him, take his head and go present it to the Lord of Shu, and report, saying: 'We had no alternative but to surrender to Wu; now that we know Your Majesty is coming in person, we have specially come to the camp to ask for punishment.'
pmwa1ngqwx3w06.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今蜀主所恨者，馬忠耳；何不殺了他，將首級去獻蜀主，告稱：『我等不得已而降吳，今知御駕前來，特地詣營請罪。』」#1

pmwa1ngqwx42ki.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqwx42ki.text: 次日，到御營中來見先主，獻上馬忠首級，哭告於前曰：「臣等實無反心；被呂蒙詭計，稱言關公已亡，賺開城門，臣等不得已而降。
pmwa1ngqwx42ki.gloss: next.day, arrive imperial.camp in come see Former.Lord, present.up Ma.Zhong head, weep.report at front say: 1PL.HUM truly not.have rebel.heart; PASS Lü.Meng treacherous.scheme, claim.say Lord.Guan already die, trick.open city.gate, 1PL.HUM NEG DE stop CONJ surrender.
pmwa1ngqwx42ki.translation: The next day, they came to the imperial camp to see the Former Lord, presented Ma Zhong’s head, and weeping reported before him: “We truly have no rebellious intentions; we were deceived by Lü Meng’s treacherous scheme: he claimed that Lord Guan was already dead and tricked us into opening the city gate; we had no choice but to surrender.”
pmwa1ngqwx42ki.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|次日，到御營中來見先主，獻上馬忠首級，哭告於前曰：「臣等實無反心；被呂蒙詭計，稱言關公已亡，賺開城門，臣等不得已而降。#1

pmwa1ngqwx5t36.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqwx5t36.text: 遜曰：「吾素知孫安東深得軍心，必能堅守，不必救之。
pmwa1ngqwx5t36.gloss: Xun say: 1SG always know Sun.Andong deeply DE army.heart, certainly can hold.firm, NEG need rescue 3SG.OBJ.
pmwa1ngqwx5t36.translation: Lu Xun said: "I have always known that Sun Andong has deeply won the army's hearts; he will certainly be able to hold firm, and there is no need to rescue him."
pmwa1ngqwx5t36.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|遜曰：「吾素知孫安東深得軍心，必能堅守，不必救之。#1

pmwa1ngqwx6gnm.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqwx6gnm.text: 今彼馳騁於平原廣野之間，正自得志；我堅守不出，彼求戰不得，必移屯於山林樹木間。
pmwa1ngqwx6gnm.gloss: now 3PL gallop in plain broad.field among, just.now DE ambition; 1PL hold.firm NEG come.out, 3PL seek.battle NEG DE, surely move.camp in mountain.forest tree among.
pmwa1ngqwx6gnm.translation: Now they are galloping across the plains and broad fields, just now achieving their ambition; if we hold fast and do not come out, they will seek battle and not get it, and will surely move their camp among the mountains, forests and trees.
pmwa1ngqwx6gnm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今彼馳騁於平原廣野之間，正自得志；我堅守不出，彼求戰不得，必移屯於山林樹木間。#1

pmwa1ngqwx7ur3.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqwx7ur3.text: 今彼馳騁於平原廣野之間，正自得志；我堅守不出，彼求戰不得，必移屯於山林樹木間。
pmwa1ngqwx7ur3.gloss: now 3PL gallop in plain broad.field among, just.now DE ambition; 1PL hold.firm NEG come.out, 3PL seek.battle NEG DE, surely move.camp in mountain.forest tree among.
pmwa1ngqwx7ur3.translation: Now they are galloping across the plains and broad fields, just now achieving their ambition; if we hold fast and do not come out, they will seek battle and not get it, and will surely move their camp among the mountains, forests and trees.
pmwa1ngqwx7ur3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今彼馳騁於平原廣野之間，正自得志；我堅守不出，彼求戰不得，必移屯於山林樹木間。#2

pmwa1ngqwx819t.section: 第八十三回　　　戰猇亭先主得讎人　　守江口書生拜大將
pmwa1ngqwx819t.text: 二人聽得此事，大喜，來見陸遜曰：「目今蜀兵四十餘營，皆移於山林密處，依溪傍澗，就水歇涼。
pmwa1ngqwx819t.gloss: two.people hear DE this.matter, greatly.rejoice, come see Lu.Xun say: at.present Shu.troops forty.odd camp, all move to mountain.forest dense.place, along stream beside ravine, approach water rest.cool
pmwa1ngqwx819t.translation: The two men heard this and were overjoyed; they came to see Lu Xun and said: At present the Shu troops' more than forty camps have all moved to the dense mountain forests, along the streams and beside the ravines, to rest and cool off by the water.
pmwa1ngqwx819t.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|二人聽得此事，大喜，來見陸遜曰：「目今蜀兵四十餘營，皆移於山林密處，依溪傍澗，就水歇涼。#1

pmwa1ngqwx9ac0.section: 第八十四回　　　陸遜營燒七百里　　　孔明巧布八陣圖
pmwa1ngqwx9ac0.text: 備乃世之梟雄，更多智謀，其兵始集，法度精專；今守之久矣，不得我便，兵疲意阻，取之正在今日。」
pmwa1ngqwx9ac0.gloss: Bei COP age GEN fierce.hero, even.more many wisdom.strategy, 3SG troops just assemble, law.discipline refined.focused; now defend 3SG long SFP, NEG DE 1SG advantage, troops weary spirit.blocked, take 3SG exactly at today.
pmwa1ngqwx9ac0.translation: Liu Bei is a fierce hero of the age, and moreover full of wisdom and strategy. His troops have only just assembled, and his discipline is strict and focused; now he has been defending for a long time, he has not gained the advantage over me, his soldiers are weary and their spirits are checked—taking him is exactly (a matter for) today.
pmwa1ngqwx9ac0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|備乃世之梟雄，更多智謀，其兵始集，法度精專；今守之久矣，不得我便，兵疲意阻，取之正在今日。」#1

pmwa1ngqwxaazf.section: 第八十四回　　　陸遜營燒七百里　　　孔明巧布八陣圖
pmwa1ngqwxaazf.text: 丹死戰得脫，背後三路軍趕來。
pmwa1ngqwxaazf.gloss: Dan fight.to.death DE escape, behind three route army pursue.come.
pmwa1ngqwxaazf.translation: Dan fought desperately and managed to escape; three columns of troops came pursuing from behind.
pmwa1ngqwxaazf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|丹死戰得脫，背後三路軍趕來。#1

pmwa1ngqwxbjls.section: 第八十四回　　　陸遜營燒七百里　　　孔明巧布八陣圖
pmwa1ngqwxbjls.text: 先主前到一山，名馬鞍山，張苞、傅彤請先主上得山時，山下喊聲又起：陸遜大隊人馬，將馬鞍山圍住。
pmwa1ngqwxbjls.gloss: First.Ruler advance.to one mountain, called Ma'an.Mountain, Zhang.Bao, Fu.Tong ask First.Ruler ascend DE mountain time, mountain.foot shout.sound again rise: Lu.Xun large.contingent troops, BA Ma'an.Mountain surround.
pmwa1ngqwxbjls.translation: The First Ruler advanced to a mountain called Ma'an Mountain. When Zhang Bao and Fu Tong asked the First Ruler to go up the mountain, shouting again arose at the foot of the mountain: Lu Xun's main force of troops had surrounded Ma'an Mountain.
pmwa1ngqwxbjls.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|先主前到一山，名馬鞍山，張苞、傅彤請先主上得山時，山下喊聲又起：陸遜大隊人馬，將馬鞍山圍住。#1

pmwa1ngqwxc12i.section: 第八十四回　　　陸遜營燒七百里　　　孔明巧布八陣圖
pmwa1ngqwxc12i.text: 先主曰：「朕雖得脫，諸將士將奈何？」
pmwa1ngqwxc12i.gloss: Former.Lord say: 1SG although DE escape, all officers.and.soldiers FUT what.do?
pmwa1ngqwxc12i.translation: The Former Lord said, “Though I have managed to escape, what is to be done about all the officers and soldiers?”
pmwa1ngqwxc12i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|先主曰：「朕雖得脫，諸將士將奈何？」#1

pmwa1ngqwxdy0j.section: 第八十四回　　　陸遜營燒七百里　　　孔明巧布八陣圖
pmwa1ngqwxdy0j.text: 挺槍縱馬，率蜀軍奮力死戰；不下百餘合，往來衝突，不能得脫。
pmwa1ngqwxdy0j.gloss: brandish spear release horse, lead Shu army exert.strength die.fight; NEG go.down hundred more bout, go come charge.clash, NEG can DE escape.
pmwa1ngqwxdy0j.translation: Brandishing his spear and giving his horse its head, he led the Shu troops in a desperate fight to the death; for no fewer than a hundred bouts they charged back and forth, yet (he) could not get free.
pmwa1ngqwxdy0j.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|挺槍縱馬，率蜀軍奮力死戰；不下百餘合，往來衝突，不能得脫。#1

pmwa1ngqwxe5ht.section: 第八十四回　　　陸遜營燒七百里　　　孔明巧布八陣圖
pmwa1ngqwxe5ht.text: 臨危不改平生志，博得聲名萬古香。
pmwa1ngqwxe5ht.gloss: face danger NEG change lifelong resolve, win DE reputation ten.thousand.ages fragrant.
pmwa1ngqwxe5ht.translation: In the face of danger he did not change his lifelong resolve; he won a reputation fragrant for ten thousand ages.
pmwa1ngqwxe5ht.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|臨危不改平生志，博得聲名萬古香。#1

pmwa1ngqwxf46q.section: 第八十四回　　　陸遜營燒七百里　　　孔明巧布八陣圖
pmwa1ngqwxf46q.text: 時吳班、張南久圍彝陵城，忽馮習到，言蜀兵敗，遂引軍來救先主，孫桓方纔得脫。
pmwa1ngqwxf46q.gloss: at.that.time Wu.Ban, Zhang.Nan long besiege Yiling.city, suddenly Feng.Xi arrive, say Shu.troops defeated, then lead troops come rescue former.lord, Sun.Huan only.then DE escape.
pmwa1ngqwxf46q.translation: At that time Wu Ban and Zhang Nan had long been besieging Yiling city. Suddenly Feng Xi arrived and said that the Shu troops had been defeated; thereupon (they) led their troops to rescue the Former Lord, and Sun Huan only then managed to escape.
pmwa1ngqwxf46q.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|時吳班、張南久圍彝陵城，忽馮習到，言蜀兵敗，遂引軍來救先主，孫桓方纔得脫。#1

pmwa1ngqwxgnzl.section: 第八十四回　　　陸遜營燒七百里　　　孔明巧布八陣圖
pmwa1ngqwxgnzl.text: 張南、馮習奮力衝突，不能得脫，死於亂軍之中。
pmwa1ngqwxgnzl.gloss: Zhang.Nan, Feng.Xi exert.strength charge.clash, NEG can DE escape, die at chaotic army GEN midst.
pmwa1ngqwxgnzl.translation: Zhang Nan and Feng Xi fought with all their might to break through, but could not get free, and died amid the scattered troops.
pmwa1ngqwxgnzl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張南、馮習奮力衝突，不能得脫，死於亂軍之中。#1

pmwa1ngqwxhy5k.section: 第八十四回　　　陸遜營燒七百里　　　孔明巧布八陣圖
pmwa1ngqwxhy5k.text: 吳班殺出重圍，又遇吳兵追趕；幸得趙雲接著，救回白帝城去了。
pmwa1ngqwxhy5k.gloss: Wu.Ban fight.out heavy.encirclement, again encounter Wu.soldiers pursue; fortunate DE Zhao.Yun meet, rescue.back Baidi.City go CRS.
pmwa1ngqwxhy5k.translation: Wu Ban fought his way out of the heavy encirclement, and again encountered Wu soldiers in pursuit; fortunately Zhao Yun came to meet him and rescued him back to Baidi City.
pmwa1ngqwxhy5k.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吳班殺出重圍，又遇吳兵追趕；幸得趙雲接著，救回白帝城去了。#1

pmwa1ngqwxisew.section: 第八十四回　　　陸遜營燒七百里　　　孔明巧布八陣圖
pmwa1ngqwxisew.text: 卻說陸遜大獲全功，引得勝之兵，往西追襲。
pmwa1ngqwxisew.gloss: meanwhile say Lu.Xun great obtain complete merit, lead DE victory GEN troop, go west pursue attack.
pmwa1ngqwxisew.translation: Meanwhile, Lu Xun won complete success; leading his victorious troops, he went west in pursuit (of the enemy).
pmwa1ngqwxisew.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說陸遜大獲全功，引得勝之兵，往西追襲。#1

pmwa1ngqwxjcvu.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqwxjcvu.text: 先主曰：「黃權被吳兵隔斷在江北岸，欲歸無路，不得已降魏：是朕負權，非權負朕也。
pmwa1ngqwxjcvu.gloss: Former.Lord say: Huang.Quan PASS Wu troops cut.off at Yangtze.north bank, want return not.have road, NEG DE stop surrender Wei: COP 1SG fail Quan, NEG Quan fail 1SG SFP.
pmwa1ngqwxjcvu.translation: The Former Lord said: Huang Quan was cut off by Wu troops on the north bank of the Yangtze, wanted to return but there was no way, and had no choice but to surrender to Wei: it is I who let Quan down, not Quan who let me down.
pmwa1ngqwxjcvu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|先主曰：「黃權被吳兵隔斷在江北岸，欲歸無路，不得已降魏：是朕負權，非權負朕也。#1

pmwa1ngqwxk5m7.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqwxk5m7.text: 朱桓大勝，得了無數旌旗軍器戰馬。
pmwa1ngqwxk5m7.gloss: Zhu.Huan greatly.win, DE PFV countless banner weapon war.horse.
pmwa1ngqwxk5m7.translation: Zhu Huan won a great victory and obtained countless banners, weapons, and warhorses.
pmwa1ngqwxk5m7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|朱桓大勝，得了無數旌旗軍器戰馬。#1

pmwa1ngqwxlwm7.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqwxlwm7.text: 先主傳旨，請孔明坐於龍榻之側，撫其背曰：「朕自得丞相，幸成帝業；何期智識淺陋，不納丞相之言，自取其敗。
pmwa1ngqwxlwm7.gloss: Former.Lord issue.decree, invite Kongming sit at dragon.couch GEN side, stroke 3SG back say: 1SG since DE Chancellor, fortunately complete imperial.enterprise; how.expect wisdom.insight shallow.mean, NEG accept Chancellor GEN words, self.incur 3SG defeat.
pmwa1ngqwxlwm7.translation: The Former Lord issued an order, inviting Kongming to sit at the side of the dragon couch; he stroked his back and said, 'Since I obtained the Chancellor, I have fortunately completed the imperial enterprise. Who would have expected that my wisdom and insight are so shallow that I did not accept the Chancellor's words and brought this defeat upon myself?'
pmwa1ngqwxlwm7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|先主傳旨，請孔明坐於龍榻之側，撫其背曰：「朕自得丞相，幸成帝業；何期智識淺陋，不納丞相之言，自取其敗。#1

pmwa1ngqwxmpdz.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqwxmpdz.text: 嗣子孱弱，不得不以大事相託。」
pmwa1ngqwxmpdz.gloss: heir weak , NEG DE NEG take great.matter 2SG entrust
pmwa1ngqwxmpdz.translation: The heir is weak and frail; (I) cannot but entrust the great matter to you.
pmwa1ngqwxmpdz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|嗣子孱弱，不得不以大事相託。」#1

pmwa1ngqwxnoc8.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqwxnoc8.text: 朕初得疾，但下痢耳；後轉生雜病，殆不自濟。
pmwa1ngqwxnoc8.gloss: 1SG at.first DE illness, only diarrhea SFP; later turn develop various.illness, probably NEG self.recover.
pmwa1ngqwxnoc8.translation: When I first fell ill, it was only diarrhea; later it turned into various illnesses, and I probably cannot recover.
pmwa1ngqwxnoc8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|朕初得疾，但下痢耳；後轉生雜病，殆不自濟。#1

pmwa1ngqxxor2s.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqxxor2s.text: 董、杜二人，到丞相府前，皆不得入。
pmwa1ngqxxor2s.gloss: Dong, Du two man, arrive chancellor residence front, all NEG DE enter.
pmwa1ngqxxor2s.translation: The two men, Dong and Du, reached the front of the Chancellor's residence, (but) neither of them was able to enter.
pmwa1ngqxxor2s.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|董、杜二人，到丞相府前，皆不得入。#1

pmwa1ngqxxpxzc.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqxxpxzc.gloss: all official anxious, only DE disperse go
pmwa1ngqxxpxzc.translation: The officials were all anxious, and had no choice but to disperse.
pmwa1ngqxxpxzc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾官惶惶，只得散去。#1

pmwa1ngqxxqv3z.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqxxqv3z.text: 只有丞相鈞旨，教擋住百官，勿得輒入。」
pmwa1ngqxxqv3z.gloss: only.have Chancellor honorable.command, order block hundred.officials, PROH DE arbitrarily enter.
pmwa1ngqxxqv3z.translation: There is only the Chancellor's command, ordering (us) to block all officials; (they) must not enter without authorization.
pmwa1ngqxxqv3z.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只有丞相鈞旨，教擋住百官，勿得輒入。」#1

pmwa1ngqxxrgbo.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqxxrgbo.text: 孔明大笑，扶後主入內室坐定，奏曰：「五路兵至，臣安得不知？
pmwa1ngqxxrgbo.gloss: Kong.Ming laugh.loudly, support Later.Lord enter inner.chamber sit.settle, report say: five.route troops arrive, minister how DE not know?
pmwa1ngqxxrgbo.translation: Kongming laughed heartily, helped the Later Lord into the inner chamber and seated him, then reported: 'The five armies have arrived—how could I not know?'
pmwa1ngqxxrgbo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明大笑，扶後主入內室坐定，奏曰：「五路兵至，臣安得不知？#1

pmwa1ngqxxs27u.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqxxs27u.gloss: because not.yet DE 3.GEN person, therefore carefully think 3.OBJ
pmwa1ngqxxs27u.translation: Because I had not yet found the right person, I therefore thought it over carefully.
pmwa1ngqxxs27u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|因未得其人，故熟思之。#1

pmwa1ngqxxtu9n.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqxxtu9n.text: 老臣先知西番國王軻比能，引兵犯西平關；臣料馬超積祖西川人氏，素得羌人之心，羌人以超為神威大將軍；臣已先遣一人，星夜馳檄，令馬超緊守西平關，伏四路奇兵，每日交換，以兵拒之：此一路不必憂矣。
pmwa1ngqxxtu9n.gloss: old.minister beforehand know Western.Barbarian king Kebineng, lead.troops invade Xiping.Pass; minister reckon Ma.Chao for.generations Xichuan native, always DE Qiang.people GEN heart, Qiang.people take Chao as Divine.Might Great.General; minister already ahead send one person, by.night gallop.summon, order Ma.Chao tightly.guard Xiping.Pass, ambush four.route surprise.troops, every.day exchange, with troops resist 3SG: PROX one.route need.not worry SFP
pmwa1ngqxxtu9n.translation: I, your old minister, knew beforehand that Kebineng, king of the Western Barbarians, was leading troops to invade Xiping Pass; I reckon that Ma Chao, whose ancestors for generations were natives of Xichuan, has long won the hearts of the Qiang people, and the Qiang regard Chao as the Great General of Divine Might; I have already sent a man ahead, racing an urgent summons by night, to order Ma Chao to guard Xiping Pass closely and to station four columns of surprise troops in ambush, rotating them every day, using troops to resist them: this one route need not be worried about.
pmwa1ngqxxtu9n.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|老臣先知西番國王軻比能，引兵犯西平關；臣料馬超積祖西川人氏，素得羌人之心，羌人以超為神威大將軍；臣已先遣一人，星夜馳檄，令馬超緊守西平關，伏四路奇兵，每日交換，以兵拒之：此一路不必憂矣。#1

pmwa1ngqxxur28.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqxxur28.text: 但未得說吳之人，臣故躊躇。
pmwa1ngqxxur28.gloss: but not.yet DE persuade Wu GEN person, minister therefore hesitate
pmwa1ngqxxur28.translation: But I have not yet found a person to persuade Wu, and that is why I, your servant, hesitate.
pmwa1ngqxxur28.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|但未得說吳之人，臣故躊躇。#1

pmwa1ngqxxvxop.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqxxvxop.text: 孔明大笑曰：「吾思之久矣，奈未得其人，今日方得也！」
pmwa1ngqxxvxop.gloss: Kongming laugh.loudly say: 1SG think 3SG long CRS, but NEG DE DEM person, today only.then DE SFP!
pmwa1ngqxxvxop.translation: Kongming laughed loudly and said: "I have thought about it for a long time, but have not got the (right) person; only today have I got (him)!"
pmwa1ngqxxvxop.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明大笑曰：「吾思之久矣，奈未得其人，今日方得也！」#1

pmwa1ngqxxw4gh.section: 第八十五回　　　劉先主遺詔託孤兒　　諸葛亮安居平五路
pmwa1ngqxxw4gh.text: 孔明大笑曰：「吾思之久矣，奈未得其人，今日方得也！」
pmwa1ngqxxw4gh.gloss: Kongming laugh.loudly say: 1SG think 3SG long CRS, but NEG DE DEM person, today only.then DE SFP!
pmwa1ngqxxw4gh.translation: Kongming laughed loudly and said: "I have thought about it for a long time, but have not got the (right) person; only today have I got (him)!"
pmwa1ngqxxw4gh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明大笑曰：「吾思之久矣，奈未得其人，今日方得也！」#2

pmwa1ngqxxx8lu.section: 第八十六回　　　難張溫秦宓逞天辯　　破曹丕徐盛用火攻
pmwa1ngqxxx8lu.gloss: if DE Shu.territory, each divide half
pmwa1ngqxxx8lu.translation: If (we) obtain the land of Shu, (we) will each take half.
pmwa1ngqxxx8lu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若得蜀土，各分一半。」#1

pmwa1ngqxxyb1r.section: 第八十六回　　　難張溫秦宓逞天辯　　破曹丕徐盛用火攻
pmwa1ngqxxyb1r.text: 權令人探得西番兵出西平關，見了馬超，不戰自退；南蠻孟獲起兵攻四郡，皆被魏延用疑兵計殺退回洞去了；上庸孟達兵至半路，忽然染病不能行；曹真兵出陽平關，趙子龍拒住各處險道，果然一將守關，萬夫莫開。
pmwa1ngqxxyb1r.gloss: Quan order person scout DE Western.Barbarian troops exit Xiping.Pass, see PFV Ma.Chao, NEG fight self withdraw; Southern.Man Meng.Huo raise troops attack four commandery, all PASS Wei.Yan use decoy.troops stratagem kill retreat return cave go CRS; Shangyong Meng.Da troops arrive halfway, suddenly contract illness NEG can march; Cao.Zhen troops exit Yangping.Pass, Zhao.Zilong hold.off stay each.place dangerous.road, indeed one general guard pass, ten.thousand man none open.
pmwa1ngqxxyb1r.translation: Quan sent men to scout and learned that the Western Barbarian troops had come out of Xiping Pass, and on seeing Ma Chao they withdrew of themselves without fighting; that the Southern Man Meng Huo had raised troops to attack the four commanderies, and all (his men) were slaughtered and driven back to their caves by Wei Yan, who used a stratagem of decoy troops; that Meng Da's troops from Shangyong got halfway and then suddenly contracted illness and could not march; and that Cao Zhen's troops came out of Yangping Pass, where Zhao Zilong held the dangerous roads everywhere — truly, with one general guarding the pass, ten thousand men cannot force it open.
pmwa1ngqxxyb1r.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|權令人探得西番兵出西平關，見了馬超，不戰自退；南蠻孟獲起兵攻四郡，皆被魏延用疑兵計殺退回洞去了；上庸孟達兵至半路，忽然染病不能行；曹真兵出陽平關，趙子龍拒住各處險道，果然一將守關，萬夫莫開。#1

pmwa1ngqxxzxrs.section: 第八十六回　　　難張溫秦宓逞天辯　　破曹丕徐盛用火攻
pmwa1ngqxxzxrs.text: 溫自以為得志，昂然上殿，見後主施禮。
pmwa1ngqxxzxrs.gloss: Zhang.Wen self consider DE ambition, proudly ascend.hall, see Later.Ruler perform.salute.
pmwa1ngqxxzxrs.translation: Zhang Wen considered himself to have achieved his ambition; he ascended the hall proudly and, on seeing the Later Ruler, performed a salute.
pmwa1ngqxxzxrs.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|溫自以為得志，昂然上殿，見後主施禮。#1

pmwa1ngqxy0raf.section: 第八十六回　　　難張溫秦宓逞天辯　　破曹丕徐盛用火攻
pmwa1ngqxy0raf.gloss: Mi say: how DE not.have surname!
pmwa1ngqxy0raf.translation: Mi said, "How could it possibly be without a surname!"
pmwa1ngqxy0raf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|宓曰：「豈得無姓！」#1

pmwa1ngqxy1dsk.section: 第八十六回　　　難張溫秦宓逞天辯　　破曹丕徐盛用火攻
pmwa1ngqxy1dsk.text: 權問鄧芝曰：「若吳、蜀二國同心滅魏，得天下太平，二主分治，豈不樂乎？」
pmwa1ngqxy1dsk.gloss: Quan ask Deng.Zhi say: if Wu, Shu two state same.heart destroy Wei, DE under.heaven great.peace, two ruler divide.rule, how NEG joy Q?
pmwa1ngqxy1dsk.translation: Quan asked Deng Zhi, saying: "If the two states of Wu and Shu, with one heart, destroy Wei and obtain Great Peace under heaven, the two rulers dividing the rule between them, would that not be a joy?"
pmwa1ngqxy1dsk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|權問鄧芝曰：「若吳、蜀二國同心滅魏，得天下太平，二主分治，豈不樂乎？」#1

pmwa1ngqxy27j7.section: 第八十六回　　　難張溫秦宓逞天辯　　破曹丕徐盛用火攻
pmwa1ngqxy27j7.text: 權大喜曰：「如得卿守江南一帶，孤何憂哉？」
pmwa1ngqxy27j7.gloss: Quan greatly rejoice say: if DE you guard Jiangnan area, I what worry SFP?
pmwa1ngqxy27j7.translation: Quan was overjoyed and said, “If I have you guarding the Jiangnan region, what do I have to worry about?”
pmwa1ngqxy27j7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|權大喜曰：「如得卿守江南一帶，孤何憂哉？」#1

pmwa1ngqxy3o0g.section: 第八十六回　　　難張溫秦宓逞天辯　　破曹丕徐盛用火攻
pmwa1ngqxy3o0g.text: 文聘跳上龍舟，負丕下得小舟，奔入河港。
pmwa1ngqxy3o0g.gloss: Wen.Ping jump.onto dragon.boat, carry.on.back Pi descend DE small boat, run enter river.harbor.
pmwa1ngqxy3o0g.translation: Wen Ping jumped onto the dragon boat, carried Pi on his back down into the small boat, and rushed into the river harbor.
pmwa1ngqxy3o0g.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|文聘跳上龍舟，負丕下得小舟，奔入河港。#1

pmwa1ngqxy45j5.section: 第八十六回　　　難張溫秦宓逞天辯　　破曹丕徐盛用火攻
pmwa1ngqxy45j5.text: 丕聽得，大驚失色，便教收軍。
pmwa1ngqxy45j5.gloss: Pi hear DE, greatly.alarmed turn.pale, at.once order withdraw.army.
pmwa1ngqxy45j5.translation: Pi heard (this), was greatly alarmed and turned pale, and immediately ordered the army to withdraw.
pmwa1ngqxy45j5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|丕聽得，大驚失色，便教收軍。#1

pmwa1ngqxy5kxy.section: 第八十六回　　　難張溫秦宓逞天辯　　破曹丕徐盛用火攻
pmwa1ngqxy5kxy.text: 張遼急拍馬來迎，被奉一箭射中其腰，卻得徐晃救了，同保魏主而走；折軍無數。
pmwa1ngqxy5kxy.gloss: Zhang.Liao hurriedly spur.horse come meet, PASS Feng one arrow shoot.hit 3SG.GEN waist, but DE Xu.Huang save PFV, together protect Wei.ruler CONJ flee; lose troops countless.
pmwa1ngqxy5kxy.translation: Zhang Liao hurriedly spurred his horse forward to meet (the enemy); he was hit in the waist by an arrow from Feng (Ding Feng), but was saved by Xu Huang, and together they protected the Wei ruler and fled; countless troops were lost.
pmwa1ngqxy5kxy.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張遼急拍馬來迎，被奉一箭射中其腰，卻得徐晃救了，同保魏主而走；折軍無數。#1

pmwa1ngqxy6gur.section: 第八十六回　　　難張溫秦宓逞天辯　　破曹丕徐盛用火攻
pmwa1ngqxy6gur.text: 背後孫韶、丁奉奪得馬匹、車仗、船隻、器械，不計其數。
pmwa1ngqxy6gur.gloss: behind Sun.Shao, Ding.Feng seize DE horse, cart.conveyance, boat, weapon, NEG.count its number.
pmwa1ngqxy6gur.translation: Behind (them), Sun Shao and Ding Feng seized horses, carts, boats and weapons, too many to count.
pmwa1ngqxy6gur.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|背後孫韶、丁奉奪得馬匹、車仗、船隻、器械，不計其數。#1

pmwa1ngqxy7qm5.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqxy7qm5.text: 近已安痊，打探得東吳讎人已皆誅戮，逕來西川見帝，恰在途中遇見征南之兵，特來投見。」
pmwa1ngqxy7qm5.gloss: recently already recover, inquire DE East.Wu enemy already all execute, straight come West.Sichuan see emperor, happen on.way meet campaign.south LNK troops, specially come submit.see.
pmwa1ngqxy7qm5.translation: I have recently recovered; I have learned that the enemies in Eastern Wu have all been executed. I came straight to Western Sichuan to see the Emperor, and happened to meet the south-conquering army on the way, so I have come specially to submit myself and see (you).
pmwa1ngqxy7qm5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|近已安痊，打探得東吳讎人已皆誅戮，逕來西川見帝，恰在途中遇見征南之兵，特來投見。」#1

pmwa1ngqxy8qyv.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqxy8qyv.text: 禮畢，曰：「如何得鄂煥回也？」
pmwa1ngqxy8qyv.gloss: ceremony finish, say: how DE E.Huan return SFP?
pmwa1ngqxy8qyv.translation: After the ceremony was over, (Yong Kai) said, “How did E Huan get to return?”
pmwa1ngqxy8qyv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|禮畢，曰：「如何得鄂煥回也？」#1

pmwa1ngqxy9vqz.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqxy9vqz.text: 汝這廝不精細，如何做得細作！」
pmwa1ngqxy9vqz.gloss: 2SG this.fellow NEG meticulous, how act DE spy!
pmwa1ngqxy9vqz.translation: You wretch are not careful—how can you act as a spy!
pmwa1ngqxy9vqz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|汝這廝不精細，如何做得細作！」#1

pmwa1ngqxyaq9f.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqxyaq9f.text: 孔明以酒食賜之，修密書一封，付軍士曰：「汝持此書付雍闓，教他早早下手，休得誤事。」
pmwa1ngqxyaq9f.gloss: Kong.Ming with wine.food bestow 3SG.OBJ, compose secret.letter one CLF, hand.to soldier say: 2SG hold PROX letter hand.to Yong.Kai, tell 3SG early.early strike, PROH DE delay matter.
pmwa1ngqxyaq9f.translation: Kongming bestowed wine and food on him, wrote a secret letter, handed it to the soldier and said: "You take this letter and deliver it to Yong Kai; tell him to strike early — do not botch the business."
pmwa1ngqxyaq9f.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明以酒食賜之，修密書一封，付軍士曰：「汝持此書付雍闓，教他早早下手，休得誤事。」#1

pmwa1ngqxybkg0.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqxybkg0.text: 汝若捉得朱褒，方表真心。」
pmwa1ngqxybkg0.gloss: 2SG if capture DE Zhu.Bao, only.then show true.heart.
pmwa1ngqxybkg0.translation: If you capture Zhu Bao, only then will you prove your true sincerity.
pmwa1ngqxybkg0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|汝若捉得朱褒，方表真心。」#1

pmwa1ngqyycivl.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqyycivl.text: 伉曰：「某今日得此郡無危者，皆賴永昌不韋人，姓呂，名凱，字季平。
pmwa1ngqyycivl.gloss: Kang say: 1SG today DE PROX commandery not.have danger NMLZ, all rely.on Yongchang Buxi person, surname Lü, name Kai, courtesy.name Jiping.
pmwa1ngqyycivl.translation: Kang said: 'That I hold this commandery free from danger today is all owing to a man from Buxi in Yongchang, surnamed Lü, named Kai, courtesy name Jiping.'
pmwa1ngqyycivl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|伉曰：「某今日得此郡無危者，皆賴永昌不韋人，姓呂，名凱，字季平。#1

pmwa1ngqyyd457.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqyyd457.text: 獲曰：「今諸葛丞相領大軍來侵我境界，不得不併力敵之。
pmwa1ngqyyd457.gloss: Huo say: now Zhuge chancellor lead great.army come invade 1SG territory, NEG DE NEG join.forces resist 3SG.
pmwa1ngqyyd457.translation: Huo said, 'Now Chancellor Zhuge is leading a great army to invade my territory; (we) have no choice but to join forces and resist him.'
pmwa1ngqyyd457.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|獲曰：「今諸葛丞相領大軍來侵我境界，不得不併力敵之。#1

pmwa1ngqyyec24.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqyyec24.gloss: if DE victory NMLZ, then become cave.chief.
pmwa1ngqyyec24.translation: Whoever wins will then become the cave chief.
pmwa1ngqyyec24.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|如得勝者，便為洞主。」#1

pmwa1ngqyyfs8j.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqyyfs8j.text: 孔明曰：「汝二人只宜小心，休得妄動。」
pmwa1ngqyyfs8j.gloss: Kongming say: you two people only should be.careful, PROH DE act.rashly.
pmwa1ngqyyfs8j.translation: Kongming said, "You two should just be careful, do not act rashly."
pmwa1ngqyyfs8j.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明曰：「汝二人只宜小心，休得妄動。」#1

pmwa1ngqyygoro.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqyygoro.text: 孔明令押過董荼那、阿會喃至帳下，盡去其縛，以酒食衣服賜之，令各自歸洞，勿得助惡。
pmwa1ngqyygoro.gloss: Kong.Ming order escort.over Dong.Tuna, A.Huinan to tent.under, completely remove 3PL bond, with wine.food clothing bestow 3PL, order each.self return cave, PROH DE assist evil.
pmwa1ngqyygoro.translation: Kong Ming ordered (them) to escort Dong Tuna and A Huinan to the tent, remove all their bonds, bestow wine, food and clothing on them, and order each to return to his cave and not to aid the wicked.
pmwa1ngqyygoro.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明令押過董荼那、阿會喃至帳下，盡去其縛，以酒食衣服賜之，令各自歸洞，勿得助惡。#1

pmwa1ngqyyh536.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqyyh536.text: 孟獲引部將死戰得脫，望錦帶山而逃。
pmwa1ngqyyh536.gloss: Meng.Huo lead subordinate.general fight.to.death DE escape, toward Jindai.Mountain CONJ flee.
pmwa1ngqyyh536.translation: Meng Huo led his subordinate generals in a desperate fight and managed to escape, fleeing toward Jindai Mountain.
pmwa1ngqyyh536.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孟獲引部將死戰得脫，望錦帶山而逃。#1

pmwa1ngqyyifms.section: 第八十七回　　　征南寇丞相大興師　　抗天兵蠻王初受執
pmwa1ngqyyifms.text: 孔明早已殺牛宰羊，設宴在寨；卻教帳中排開七重劊子手，刀槍劍戟，燦若霜雪；又執御賜黃金鉞斧，曲柄傘蓋，前後羽葆鼓吹，左右排開御林軍，布列得十分嚴整。
pmwa1ngqyyifms.gloss: Kong.Ming long.since kill ox slaughter sheep, set.banquet at camp; then cause tent inside arrange.open seven layer executioner, saber spear sword halberd, gleam like frost.snow; also hold imperial.bestow gold battle.axe, curved.handle umbrella.canopy, front.back feather.banner drum.and.pipe.music, left.right draw.up imperial.guard, array DE very strict.neat.
pmwa1ngqyyifms.translation: Kong Ming had long since slaughtered oxen and sheep and set up a banquet in the camp; then he had seven rows of executioners drawn up inside the tent, with sabers, spears, swords and halberds gleaming like frost and snow; imperially bestowed golden battle-axes and curved-handled umbrella canopies were also held, with feathered banners and drum-and-pipe music in front and behind, and the imperial guard drawn up on left and right, arrayed very strictly and neatly.
pmwa1ngqyyifms.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明早已殺牛宰羊，設宴在寨；卻教帳中排開七重劊子手，刀槍劍戟，燦若霜雪；又執御賜黃金鉞斧，曲柄傘蓋，前後羽葆鼓吹，左右排開御林軍，布列得十分嚴整。#1

pmwa1ngqyyjqs0.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyyjqs0.text: 獲曰：「蜀人監我在帳中，被我殺死十餘人，乘夜黑而走；正行間，逢著一哨馬軍，亦被我殺之，奪了此馬：因此得脫。」
pmwa1ngqyyjqs0.gloss: Meng.Huo say: Shu.people guard 1SG at tent inside, PASS 1SG kill.dead ten more person, take.advantage.of night dark CONJ flee; just travel interval, encounter PFV one squad cavalry, also PASS 1SG kill 3PL, seize PFV this horse: because this DE escape.
pmwa1ngqyyjqs0.translation: Meng Huo said: 'The men of Shu were guarding me in the tent; I killed more than ten of them, and taking advantage of the dark night I fled. Just as I was on my way, I ran into a squad of cavalry; I killed them too and seized this horse: by this means I got away.'
pmwa1ngqyyjqs0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|獲曰：「蜀人監我在帳中，被我殺死十餘人，乘夜黑而走；正行間，逢著一哨馬軍，亦被我殺之，奪了此馬：因此得脫。」#1

pmwa1ngqyykeja.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyykeja.text: 孟獲使人去請，二人懼怕，只得也引洞兵來。
pmwa1ngqyykeja.gloss: Meng.Huo send person go invite, two person fear, only DE also lead cave.troops come.
pmwa1ngqyykeja.translation: Meng Huo sent someone to go invite them; the two men were afraid, and had no choice but to also lead the cave troops and come.
pmwa1ngqyykeja.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孟獲使人去請，二人懼怕，只得也引洞兵來。#1

pmwa1ngqyylv1q.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyylv1q.text: 時值五月，天氣炎熱，南方之地，分外炎酷，軍馬衣甲，皆穿不得。
pmwa1ngqyylv1q.gloss: time.happen fifth.month, weather hot, south GEN place, exceptionally scorching, troops clothing.armor, all wear NEG DE
pmwa1ngqyylv1q.translation: At that time it was the fifth month; the weather was hot, and in the southern lands it was exceptionally scorching, so that the troops' clothing and armor could not be worn at all.
pmwa1ngqyylv1q.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|時值五月，天氣炎熱，南方之地，分外炎酷，軍馬衣甲，皆穿不得。#1

pmwa1ngqyyman7.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyyman7.translation: Dai said: "How can (we) cut it off?"
pmwa1ngqyyman7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|岱曰：「如何斷得？」#1

pmwa1ngqyyn2kn.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyyn2kn.text: 部內軍有認得是董荼那，說與馬岱如此如此。
pmwa1ngqyyn2kn.gloss: unit.inside troop have recognize-DE COP Dong.Tuna, say to Ma.Dai thus.and.so.
pmwa1ngqyyn2kn.translation: Among the troops in the contingent there were those who recognized that it was Dong Tuna, and they told Ma Dai such and such.
pmwa1ngqyyn2kn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|部內軍有認得是董荼那，說與馬岱如此如此。#1

pmwa1ngqyyochc.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyyochc.text: 今因孟獲勢力相逼，不得已而造反。
pmwa1ngqyyochc.gloss: now because Meng.Huo power press, NEG DE stop CONJ rebel.
pmwa1ngqyyochc.translation: Now, because Meng Huo's power is pressing (us), (we) have no choice but to rebel.
pmwa1ngqyyochc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今因孟獲勢力相逼，不得已而造反。#1

pmwa1ngqyypl03.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyypl03.text: 孔明笑曰：「汝前者有言：但再擒得，便肯降服。
pmwa1ngqyypl03.gloss: Kongming laugh say: 2SG previously have word: only again capture DE, then willing surrender.
pmwa1ngqyypl03.translation: Kongming laughed and said, "You said before: if (I) capture (you) again, (you) will be willing to submit."
pmwa1ngqyypl03.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明笑曰：「汝前者有言：但再擒得，便肯降服。#1

pmwa1ngqyyqkxl.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyyqkxl.text: 若丞相這番再擒得我，那時傾心吐膽歸降，並不敢改移也。」
pmwa1ngqyyqkxl.gloss: if chancellor this.time again capture DE 1SG, that.time wholeheartedly surrender, ADV NEG dare change SFP.
pmwa1ngqyyqkxl.translation: If the Chancellor captures me again this time, then I will sincerely surrender with all my heart, and will not dare to change (my mind).
pmwa1ngqyyqkxl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若丞相這番再擒得我，那時傾心吐膽歸降，並不敢改移也。」#1

pmwa1ngqyyrrkc.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyyrrkc.text: 孔明指孟獲而笑曰：「汝先令汝弟以禮詐降，如何瞞得過吾！
pmwa1ngqyyrrkc.gloss: Kongming point Meng.Huo CONJ laugh say: 2SG first order 2SG younger.brother with gift feign.surrender, how deceive DE pass 1SG!
pmwa1ngqyyrrkc.translation: Kongming pointed at Meng Huo and laughed, saying, 'You first had your younger brother feign surrender with gifts; how could you deceive me!'
pmwa1ngqyyrrkc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明指孟獲而笑曰：「汝先令汝弟以禮詐降，如何瞞得過吾！#1

pmwa1ngqyyspn5.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyyspn5.text: 那時擒得，方纔死心塌地而降。」
pmwa1ngqyyspn5.gloss: that time capture DE, only.then die.heart.sink.earth CONJ surrender
pmwa1ngqyyspn5.translation: If (you) capture (us) at that time, only then will (we) be won over completely and surrender.
pmwa1ngqyyspn5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|那時擒得，方纔死心塌地而降。」#1

pmwa1ngqyytu79.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyytu79.text: 吾今明告汝等，勿得辭勞，可用心報國。」
pmwa1ngqyytu79.gloss: 1SG now clearly tell 2PL, PROH DE decline.toil, can devote.heart serve.country.
pmwa1ngqyytu79.translation: I now tell you all plainly: do not shrink from hardship; you may devote your hearts to serving the country.
pmwa1ngqyytu79.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吾今明告汝等，勿得辭勞，可用心報國。」#1

pmwa1ngqyyub0n.section: 第八十八回　　　渡瀘水再縛番王　　　識詐降三擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqyyub0n.text: 帳下諸將聽得孔明之言，盡皆喜悅。
pmwa1ngqyyub0n.gloss: tent.under various general hear DE Kong.Ming GEN word, all entirely delighted
pmwa1ngqyyub0n.translation: The generals in the tent, hearing Kong Ming's words, were all delighted.
pmwa1ngqyyub0n.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|帳下諸將聽得孔明之言，盡皆喜悅。#1

pmwa1ngqyyvtcy.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqyyvtcy.text: 孟獲只剩得數十個敗殘兵，望山谷中而逃。
pmwa1ngqyyvtcy.gloss: Meng.Huo only remain DE several ten CLF defeated.remnant soldier, toward mountain.valley middle CONJ flee.
pmwa1ngqyyvtcy.translation: Meng Huo had only a few dozen defeated, remnant soldiers left, and fled toward the mountain valley.
pmwa1ngqyyvtcy.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孟獲只剩得數十個敗殘兵，望山谷中而逃。#1

pmwa1ngqyywa1y.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqyywa1y.text: 見南、北、西三處塵頭火光，因此不敢前進，只得望東奔走。
pmwa1ngqyywa1y.gloss: see south, north, west three place dust.cloud fire.light, therefore NEG dare advance, only DE toward east run.flee.
pmwa1ngqyywa1y.translation: Seeing dust clouds and firelight in three places—south, north, and west—he therefore did not dare advance, and had no choice but to flee eastward.
pmwa1ngqyywa1y.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|見南、北、西三處塵頭火光，因此不敢前進，只得望東奔走。#1

pmwa1ngqyyxlo8.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqyyxlo8.text: 受辱三次；今幸得這裏相遇。
pmwa1ngqyyxlo8.gloss: suffer.humiliation three CLF; now fortunate DE here meet
pmwa1ngqyyxlo8.translation: (I) have suffered humiliation three times; now fortunately (I) get to meet (you) here.
pmwa1ngqyyxlo8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|受辱三次；今幸得這裏相遇。#1

pmwa1ngqyyyg3m.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqyyyg3m.text: 於是聚得諸洞壯丁數千人，望南迤邐而行。
pmwa1ngqyyyg3m.gloss: thereupon gather DE various cave able.bodied.man several.thousand person, toward.south winding CONJ go.
pmwa1ngqyyyg3m.translation: Thereupon he gathered several thousand able-bodied men from the various caves and set off southward, winding along.
pmwa1ngqyyyg3m.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|於是聚得諸洞壯丁數千人，望南迤邐而行。#1

pmwa1ngqyyzd2p.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqyyzd2p.text: 若蜀兵到來，令他一人一騎不得還鄉，與諸葛亮皆死於此處！」
pmwa1ngqyyzd2p.gloss: if Shu.soldiers arrive, cause 3SG one.person one.mount NEG DE return.home, with Zhuge.Liang all die at this.place!
pmwa1ngqyyzd2p.translation: If the Shu soldiers come, make it so that not one of them, man or horse, can return home, and that they all die here together with Zhuge Liang!
pmwa1ngqyyzd2p.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若蜀兵到來，令他一人一騎不得還鄉，與諸葛亮皆死於此處！」#1

pmwa1ngqyz0wv3.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqyz0wv3.text: 老叟曰：「老夫久聞大國丞相隆名，幸得拜見。
pmwa1ngqyz0wv3.gloss: old.man say : 1SG.HUM long hear great.state chancellor lofty.name , fortunate DE meet .
pmwa1ngqyz0wv3.translation: The old man said: 'I have long heard of the great state's Chancellor's lofty name, and I am fortunate to get to meet (you).'
pmwa1ngqyz0wv3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|老叟曰：「老夫久聞大國丞相隆名，幸得拜見。#1

pmwa1ngqzz1186.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqzz1186.text: 入山谷小徑，約行二十餘里，但見長松大柏，茂竹奇花，環遶一莊；籬落之中，有數間茅屋，聞得馨香噴鼻。
pmwa1ngqzz1186.gloss: enter mountain.valley small.path, about travel twenty.odd li, only see tall pine big cypress, lush bamboo rare flower, surround one villa; fence GEN inside, have several CLF thatched.hut, smell DE fragrance assail nose.
pmwa1ngqzz1186.translation: Entering a small path in the mountain valley, (they) traveled about twenty-odd li, and saw only tall pines and great cypresses, lush bamboo and rare flowers encircling a villa; within the fence were several thatched huts, and (they) smelled a fragrance that assailed the nose.
pmwa1ngqzz1186.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|入山谷小徑，約行二十餘里，但見長松大柏，茂竹奇花，環遶一莊；籬落之中，有數間茅屋，聞得馨香噴鼻。#1

pmwa1ngqzz2di9.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqzz2di9.text: 隱者曰：「久聞丞相大纛南征，安得不知！」
pmwa1ngqzz2di9.gloss: hermit say: long hear Chancellor great.banner south.campaign, how DE not.know!
pmwa1ngqzz2di9.translation: The hermit said, "I have long heard that the Chancellor is campaigning south with his great banner; how could I not know?"
pmwa1ngqzz2di9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|隱者曰：「久聞丞相大纛南征，安得不知！」#1

pmwa1ngqzz337s.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqzz337s.text: 是夜祝罷，平明視之，皆得滿井甘泉。
pmwa1ngqzz337s.gloss: DEM night pray finish, dawn look.at 3SG, all DE full well sweet.spring.
pmwa1ngqzz337s.translation: That night, after finishing his prayer, at daybreak he looked, and all (the dug places) had obtained wells full of sweet spring water.
pmwa1ngqzz337s.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|是夜祝罷，平明視之，皆得滿井甘泉。#1

pmwa1ngqzz4oah.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqzz4oah.text: 孔明軍馬既得甘泉，遂安然由小徑直入禿龍洞前下寨。
pmwa1ngqzz4oah.gloss: Kong.Ming troops already DE sweet.spring, then safely via small.path straight.enter Tulong.Cave front pitch.camp.
pmwa1ngqzz4oah.translation: Once Kong Ming's troops had obtained the sweet spring, they then safely went straight in along the small path and pitched camp in front of Tulong Cave.
pmwa1ngqzz4oah.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明軍馬既得甘泉，遂安然由小徑直入禿龍洞前下寨。#1

pmwa1ngqzz5ftn.section: 第八十九回　　　武鄉侯四番用計　　　南蠻王五次遭擒
pmwa1ngqzz5ftn.text: 當殺牛宰馬，大賞洞丁，不避水火，直衝蜀寨，方可得勝。」
pmwa1ngqzz5ftn.gloss: should kill cattle slaughter horse, greatly reward cave.troops, NEG avoid water fire, straight charge Shu camp, only.then can DE victory.
pmwa1ngqzz5ftn.translation: (We) should kill cattle and slaughter horses, richly reward the cave troops, avoid neither water nor fire, and charge straight at the Shu camp; only then can (we) win.
pmwa1ngqzz5ftn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|當殺牛宰馬，大賞洞丁，不避水火，直衝蜀寨，方可得勝。」#1

pmwa1ngqzz6ytj.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzz6ytj.text: 眾軍亦不知其意，只得依令預備。
pmwa1ngqzz6ytj.gloss: all.troops also NEG know 3SG intention, only DE follow order prepare
pmwa1ngqzz6ytj.translation: The troops likewise did not know what he meant, and had no choice but to prepare according to the order.
pmwa1ngqzz6ytj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾軍亦不知其意，只得依令預備。#1

pmwa1ngqzz77vq.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzz77vq.text: 孔明取了三江城，所得珍寶，皆賞三軍。
pmwa1ngqzz77vq.gloss: Kong.Ming take PFV Sanjiang.City, NMLZ DE obtain treasure, all reward three.army
pmwa1ngqzz77vq.translation: Kongming took Sanjiang City, and all the treasures obtained (there) he rewarded to the three armies.
pmwa1ngqzz77vq.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明取了三江城，所得珍寶，皆賞三軍。#1

pmwa1ngqzz89jw.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzz89jw.text: 馬忠聽得張嶷被執，急出救時，早被蠻兵捆住。
pmwa1ngqzz89jw.gloss: Ma.Zhong hear DE Zhang.Yi PASS.capture, hurriedly exit rescue time, already PASS barbarian.soldier tie.up
pmwa1ngqzz89jw.translation: Ma Zhong heard that Zhang Yi had been captured, and when he hurried out to rescue (him), he was already bound by the barbarian soldiers.
pmwa1ngqzz89jw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|馬忠聽得張嶷被執，急出救時，早被蠻兵捆住。#1

pmwa1ngqzz97ls.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzz97ls.text: 孔明大笑曰：「量汝些小詭計，如何瞞得過我！
pmwa1ngqzz97ls.gloss: Kong.Ming laugh.loudly say: reckon 2SG trivial trick, how deceive DE pass 1SG!
pmwa1ngqzz97ls.translation: Kong Ming laughed loudly and said, "Considering your petty trick, how can it deceive me!"
pmwa1ngqzz97ls.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明大笑曰：「量汝些小詭計，如何瞞得過我！#1

pmwa1ngqzzaftu.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzzaftu.text: 若得彼相助，擒諸葛亮如利刀破竹也。」
pmwa1ngqzzaftu.gloss: if DE 3SG help, capture Zhuge.Liang like sharp.knife split bamboo SFP
pmwa1ngqzzaftu.translation: If we obtain his assistance, seizing Zhuge Liang will be like a sharp knife splitting bamboo.
pmwa1ngqzzaftu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若得彼相助，擒諸葛亮如利刀破竹也。」#1

pmwa1ngqzzba10.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzzba10.text: 蠻兵哨得，又引眾軍渡過河來戰。
pmwa1ngqzzba10.gloss: barbarian.troops scout DE, again lead all.troops cross.over river come fight.
pmwa1ngqzzba10.translation: The barbarian troops scouted and learned of it, and again led their army across the river to fight.
pmwa1ngqzzba10.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|蠻兵哨得，又引眾軍渡過河來戰。#1

pmwa1ngqzzcnm5.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzzcnm5.gloss: barbarian soldier DE PFV Shu camp
pmwa1ngqzzcnm5.translation: The barbarian troops took the Shu camp.
pmwa1ngqzzcnm5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|蠻兵得了蜀寨。#1

pmwa1ngqzzdo2t.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzzdo2t.text: 將兀突骨並三萬籐甲軍，燒得互相擁抱，死於盤蛇谷中。
pmwa1ngqzzdo2t.gloss: BA Wutugu CONJ thirty.thousand rattan.armor.troops, burn DE each.other embrace, die P Panshe.Valley inside.
pmwa1ngqzzdo2t.translation: (The fire) burned Wutugu along with the thirty thousand rattan-armored troops until they embraced each other and died in Panshe Valley.
pmwa1ngqzzdo2t.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|將兀突骨並三萬籐甲軍，燒得互相擁抱，死於盤蛇谷中。#1

pmwa1ngqzze5yn.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzze5yn.text: 我等皆是本洞之人，不得已而降蜀；今知大王前到，特來助戰。」
pmwa1ngqzze5yn.gloss: 1PL all COP own.cave LNK person, NEG DE stop CONJ surrender Shu; now know great.king arrive, specially come assist battle.
pmwa1ngqzze5yn.translation: We are all people of this cave; we had no choice but to submit to Shu. Now that we know Your Majesty has arrived, we have come specially to help in the battle.

pmwa1ngqzzf28k.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzzf28k.text: 孔明歸到寨中，升帳而坐，謂眾將曰：「吾今此計，不得已而用之，大損陰德。
pmwa1ngqzzf28k.gloss: Kongming return arrive camp middle, ascend tent CONJ sit, say.to all general say: 1SG now this plan, NEG DE stop CONJ use 3SG.OBJ, greatly harm hidden virtue.
pmwa1ngqzzf28k.translation: Kongming returned to the camp, went up into his tent and sat down, and said to the assembled generals: 'This plan of mine today—I have no choice but to use it; it greatly damages (my) hidden virtue.'
pmwa1ngqzzf28k.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明歸到寨中，升帳而坐，謂眾將曰：「吾今此計，不得已而用之，大損陰德。#1

pmwa1ngqzzgwqx.section: 第九十回　　　　驅巨獸六破蠻兵　　　燒藤甲七擒孟獲
pmwa1ngqzzgwqx.text: 獲泣謝曰：「某子子孫孫皆感覆載生成之恩，安得不服！」
pmwa1ngqzzgwqx.gloss: Meng.Huo weep apologize say: my descendants all feel cover.support generate.nurture GEN grace, how DE NEG submit!
pmwa1ngqzzgwqx.translation: Meng Huo wept and apologized, saying: 'My sons and grandsons, all of them, feel the grace of your covering and sustaining, life-giving care; how could I not submit!'

pmwa1ngqzzhu85.section: 第九十一回　　　祭瀘水漢相班師　　　伐中原武侯上表
pmwa1ngqzzhu85.text: 土人告說：「自丞相經過之後，夜夜只聞得水邊鬼哭神號。

pmwa1ngqzzhu85.translation: The local people reported, saying: "Ever since the Chancellor passed through, every night (we) only hear ghosts crying and spirits wailing by the water's edge."

pmwa1ngqzzimzd.section: 第九十一回　　　祭瀘水漢相班師　　　伐中原武侯上表
pmwa1ngqzzimzd.text: 丕先納夫人甄氏，即袁紹次子袁熙之婦，前破鄴城時所得。

pmwa1ngqzzimzd.translation: Cao Pi first took Lady Zhen as his wife; she was the wife of Yuan Xi, Yuan Shao's second son, and (the woman) he had obtained when he previously captured Ye city.

pmwa1ngqzzjxky.section: 第九十一回　　　祭瀘水漢相班師　　　伐中原武侯上表
pmwa1ngqzzjxky.text: 時丕有疾，韜乃詐稱於甄夫人宮中掘得桐木偶人，上書天子年月日時，為魘鎮之事。

pmwa1ngqzzjxky.translation: At that time Pi was ill, so Tao falsely claimed that in Lady Zhen’s palace (someone) had dug up a paulownia-wood puppet, on which were written the emperor’s year, month, day, and hour, for a curse.

pmwa1ngqzzkwid.section: 第九十一回　　　祭瀘水漢相班師　　　伐中原武侯上表
pmwa1ngqzzkwid.text: 愚以為宮中之事，事無大小，悉以咨之，然後施行，必得裨補闕漏，有所廣益。

pmwa1ngqzzkwid.translation: In my humble opinion, in matters of the palace, whether big or small, (Your Majesty) should consult them about every one, and only then carry them out; then you will surely be able to remedy omissions and fill gaps, and there will be some benefit.
pmwa1ngqzzkwid.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|愚以為宮中之事，事無大小，悉以咨之，然後施行，必得裨補闕漏，有所廣益。#1

pmwa1ngqzzl42t.section: 第九十一回　　　祭瀘水漢相班師　　　伐中原武侯上表
pmwa1ngqzzl42t.text: 愚以為營中之事，事無大小，悉以咨之，必能使行陣和穆，優劣得所也。

pmwa1ngqzzl42t.translation: I humbly believe that in the affairs of the camp, no matter whether great or small, (we) should consult him on all of them; he will surely be able to make the ranks harmonious and the superior and inferior each find their proper place.
pmwa1ngqzzl42t.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|愚以為營中之事，事無大小，悉以咨之，必能使行陣和穆，優劣得所也。#1

pmwa1ngqzzmpup.section: 第九十一回　　　祭瀘水漢相班師　　　伐中原武侯上表
pmwa1ngqzzmpup.text: 大丈夫得死於疆場者，幸也，吾何恨焉？

pmwa1ngqzzmpup.translation: For a great man to get to die on the battlefield is a blessing—what would I have to regret?

pmwa1ngqzzn8oe.section: 第九十一回 祭瀘水漢相班師 伐中原武侯上表
pmwa1ngqzzn8oe.text: 孔明曰：「將軍既要為先鋒，須得一人同去。」
pmwa1ngqzzn8oe.gloss: Kongming say: general since want be vanguard, must DE one person together go.
pmwa1ngqzzn8oe.translation: Kongming said, "Since the general wants to be the vanguard, (we) must have one man go along (with you)."
pmwa1ngqzzn8oe.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明曰：「將軍既要為先鋒，須得一人同去。」#1

pmwa1ngr0100uwy.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0100uwy.text: 當日姜維謂馬遵曰：「近聞諸葛亮殺敗夏侯楙，困於南安，水泄不通，安得有人自重圍之中而出？
pmwa1ngr0100uwy.gloss: that.day Jiang.Wei say.to Ma.Zun say: recently hear Zhuge.Liang defeat Xiahou.Mao, trap at Nan.An, water leak NEG through, how DE have person from heavy.siege midst CONJ come.out?
pmwa1ngr0100uwy.translation: On that day Jiang Wei said to Ma Zun: 'Recently I heard that Zhuge Liang defeated Xiahou Mao, and (the latter) was trapped at Nan'an, so that not even water could leak through; how could anyone get out from within the tight siege?'
pmwa1ngr0100uwy.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|當日姜維謂馬遵曰：「近聞諸葛亮殺敗夏侯楙，困於南安，水泄不通，安得有人自重圍之中而出？#1

pmwa1ngr0101dfs.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0101dfs.text: 賺得太守出城，料城中無備，必然暗伏一軍於左近，乘虛而取天水也。」
pmwa1ngr0101dfs.gloss: trick DE governor exit city, reckon in.city not.have preparation, surely secretly.ambush one army at nearby, exploit weakness CONJ seize Tianshui SFP.
pmwa1ngr0101dfs.translation: He tricked the governor into leaving the city; reckoning that the city was unprepared, he must surely have secretly hidden a body of troops nearby, to exploit the weakness and seize Tianshui.

pmwa1ngr0102v3n.section: 第九十三回　　　姜伯約歸降孔明　　　武鄉侯罵死王朗
pmwa1ngr0102v3n.text: 虧得張翼、高翔兩路軍殺出，接應回去。
pmwa1ngr0102v3n.gloss: luckily DE Zhang.Yi, Gao.Xiang two.route army charge.out, support return.go

pmwa1ngr0103bkz.section: 第九十三回　　　姜伯約歸降孔明　　　武鄉侯罵死王朗
pmwa1ngr0103bkz.text: 孔明曰：「目今姜維現守冀州，使人持書來說：『但得駙馬在，我願來降。』
pmwa1ngr0103bkz.gloss: Kong.Ming say: right.now Jiang.Wei now defend Jizhou, send person hold letter come say: only DE Prince.Consort be.present, 1SG willing come surrender.
pmwa1ngr0103bkz.translation: Kongming said: "Right now Jiang Wei is holding Jizhou; he has sent a man with a letter to say: 'If only the Prince Consort were here, I would be willing to come and submit.'"

pmwa1ngr0104vw7.text: 楙得脫出寨，欲尋路而走，奈不知路徑。
pmwa1ngr0104vw7.gloss: Mao DE escape.out camp, want seek road CONJ flee, but NEG know route.
pmwa1ngr0104vw7.translation: Mao managed to break out of the camp; he wanted to find a road and flee, but did not know the route.
pmwa1ngr0104vw7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|楙得脫出寨，欲尋路而走，奈不知路徑。#1

pmwa1ngr01056fh.section: 第九十三回　　　姜伯約歸降孔明　　　武鄉侯罵死王朗
pmwa1ngr01056fh.text: 楙至天水城下叫門，城上人認得是夏侯楙，慌忙開門迎接。

pmwa1ngr01056fh.translation: Mao reached the foot of the walls of Tianshui and called at the gate; the men on the wall recognized that it was Xiahou Mao, and hurriedly opened the gate to welcome (him).

pmwa1ngr0106pn6.section: 第九十三回　　　姜伯約歸降孔明　　　武鄉侯罵死王朗
pmwa1ngr0106pn6.text: 姜維奪得糧草，欲要入城，忽然一彪軍攔住，為首蜀將張翼也。
pmwa1ngr0106pn6.gloss: Jiang.Wei seize DE provisions, want enter city, suddenly one detachment troops block, be.at.head Shu general Zhang.Yi SFP
pmwa1ngr0106pn6.translation: Jiang Wei seized the provisions; wanting to enter the city, he was suddenly blocked by a detachment of troops, at whose head was the Shu general Zhang Yi.

pmwa1ngr01074i5.section: 第九十三回　　　姜伯約歸降孔明　　　武鄉侯罵死王朗
pmwa1ngr01074i5.text: 維殺條路奔天水城，手下尚有十餘騎；又遇張苞殺了一陣，維止剩得匹馬單槍，來到天水城下叫門。

pmwa1ngr01074i5.translation: Wei cut his way through and fled to Tianshui City; he still had more than ten riders under his command. He again encountered Zhang Bao and fought a bout; Wei was left with only a single horse and a single spear, and came to the foot of Tianshui City to call at the gate.
pmwa1ngr01074i5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維殺條路奔天水城，手下尚有十餘騎；又遇張苞殺了一陣，維止剩得匹馬單槍，來到天水城下叫門。#1

pmwa1ngr0108vkp.section: 第九十三回　　　姜伯約歸降孔明　　　武鄉侯罵死王朗
pmwa1ngr0108vkp.text: 維尋思良久，前有孔明，後有關興，又無去路，只得下馬投降。
pmwa1ngr0108vkp.gloss: Wei ponder long.while, front have Kongming, behind have Guan.Xing, also not.have way.out, only DE dismount surrender.
pmwa1ngr0108vkp.translation: Jiang Wei pondered for a long time; ahead was Kongming, behind was Guan Xing, and there was no way out, so he had no choice but to dismount and surrender.

pmwa1ngr0109vji.section: 第九十三回　　　姜伯約歸降孔明　　　武鄉侯罵死王朗
pmwa1ngr0109vji.text: 孔明慌忙下車而迎，執維手曰：「吾自出茅廬以來，遍求賢者，欲傳授平生之學，恨未得其人。

pmwa1ngr0109vji.translation: Kongming hurriedly got down from the carriage to welcome him; holding Jiang Wei's hand, he said: 'Since I left my thatched hut, I have searched everywhere for worthy men, wishing to pass on the learning of my whole life, but I regret that I have not found the right person.'

pmwa1ngr0zp2ql.text: 延願得精兵五千，取路出褒中，循秦嶺以東，當子午谷而投北，不過十日，可到長安。
pmwa1ngr0zp2ql.gloss: Yan wish DE elite.soldiers five.thousand, take.route exit Baozhong, follow Qinling to.east, via Ziwu.Valley CONJ head.north, not.exceed ten.days, can reach Chang'an.
pmwa1ngr0zp2ql.translation: I, Yan, wish to obtain five thousand elite troops, take the road out through Baozhong, follow the Qinling eastward, go via Ziwu Valley and head north; in no more than ten days (we) can reach Chang'an.
pmwa1ngr0zp2ql.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|延願得精兵五千，取路出褒中，循秦嶺以東，當子午谷而投北，不過十日，可到長安。#1

pmwa1ngr0zq0ut.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0zq0ut.text: 魏延又曰：「丞相兵從大路進言，彼必盡起關中之兵，於路迎敵；則曠日持久，何時而得中原？」
pmwa1ngr0zq0ut.gloss: Wei.Yan again say: Chancellor troops via main.road advance say, they surely all mobilize Guanzhong GEN troops, on road meet.enemy; then waste.days prolong.time, when then DE Central.Plains?
pmwa1ngr0zq0ut.translation: Wei Yan said again: “If the Chancellor’s army advances along the main road, as you say, they will surely mobilize all the troops of Guanzhong and meet (us) on the road; then days will be wasted and time prolonged—when will we gain the Central Plains?”
pmwa1ngr0zq0ut.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|魏延又曰：「丞相兵從大路進言，彼必盡起關中之兵，於路迎敵；則曠日持久，何時而得中原？」#1

pmwa1ngr0zrcne.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0zrcne.text: 趙雲深入重地，只聽得四面喊聲大震。
pmwa1ngr0zrcne.gloss: Zhao.Yun deep enter heavy.ground, only hear DE four.side shout sound great shake.
pmwa1ngr0zrcne.translation: Zhao Yun penetrated deep into the enemy's vital ground, and only heard the shouts from all four sides rise in a great din.
pmwa1ngr0zrcne.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|趙雲深入重地，只聽得四面喊聲大震。#1

pmwa1ngr0zs0gk.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0zs0gk.text: 趙雲從辰時殺至酉時，不能得走出，只得下馬少歇，且待月明再戰。
pmwa1ngr0zs0gk.gloss: Zhao.Yun from chen.hour fight until you.hour, NEG can DE walk.out, only DE down horse rest.a.while, for.now wait moon bright again fight.
pmwa1ngr0zs0gk.translation: Zhao Yun fought from the chen hour until the you hour, but could not break out; he had no choice but to dismount and rest a little, and wait for moonlight to fight again.
pmwa1ngr0zs0gk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|趙雲從辰時殺至酉時，不能得走出，只得下馬少歇，且待月明再戰。#1

pmwa1ngr0zte6i.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0zte6i.text: 趙雲從辰時殺至酉時，不能得走出，只得下馬少歇，且待月明再戰。
pmwa1ngr0zte6i.gloss: Zhao.Yun from chen.hour fight until you.hour, NEG can DE walk.out, only DE down horse rest.a.while, for.now wait moon bright again fight.
pmwa1ngr0zte6i.translation: Zhao Yun fought from the chen hour until the you hour, but could not break out; he had no choice but to dismount and rest a little, and wait for moonlight to fight again.
pmwa1ngr0zte6i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|趙雲從辰時殺至酉時，不能得走出，只得下馬少歇，且待月明再戰。#2

pmwa1ngr0zuqwr.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0zuqwr.text: 鄧芝引兵接應，殺得屍橫遍野，血流成河。
pmwa1ngr0zuqwr.gloss: Deng.Zhi lead troops reinforce, kill DE corpse lie.across all.wilderness, blood flow become river.
pmwa1ngr0zuqwr.translation: Deng Zhi led troops to reinforce (them), killing (so that) corpses lay strewn across the countryside and blood flowed to form rivers.
pmwa1ngr0zuqwr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|鄧芝引兵接應，殺得屍橫遍野，血流成河。#1

pmwa1ngr0zvwia.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0zvwia.text: 多官曰：「若不去救，失了南安，送了夏侯駙馬，皆我兩郡之罪也；只得救之。」
pmwa1ngr0zvwia.gloss: many official say: if NEG go rescue, lose PFV Nan'an, lose PFV Xiahou.Imperial.Son-in-Law, all 1PL two commandery GEN fault SFP; only DE rescue OBJ.
pmwa1ngr0zvwia.translation: The assembled officials said: “If we do not go to the rescue, and lose Nan’an and lose the Imperial Son-in-Law Xiahou, it will all be the fault of our two commanderies; we have no choice but to rescue him.”
pmwa1ngr0zvwia.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|多官曰：「若不去救，失了南安，送了夏侯駙馬，皆我兩郡之罪也；只得救之。」#1

pmwa1ngr0zw0aq.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0zw0aq.text: 諒大驚，乃領手下百餘人，往小路死戰得脫，奔回安定。
pmwa1ngr0zw0aq.gloss: Liang greatly.alarmed, then lead subordinate over.a.hundred people, toward side.road fight.to.death DE escape, flee.back Anding.
pmwa1ngr0zw0aq.translation: Liang was greatly alarmed; he then led over a hundred of his men, went by a side road, fought to the death and managed to escape, and fled back to Anding.
pmwa1ngr0zw0aq.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|諒大驚，乃領手下百餘人，往小路死戰得脫，奔回安定。#1

pmwa1ngr0zxs8m.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0zxs8m.text: 原來魏延扮作安定軍，夤夜賺開城門，蜀兵盡入：因此得了安定。
pmwa1ngr0zxs8m.gloss: originally Wei.Yan disguise.as Anding army, deep.night trick.open city.gate, Shu soldiers all enter: therefore DE PFV Anding.
pmwa1ngr0zxs8m.translation: It turned out that Wei Yan had disguised (his men) as Anding troops and in the dead of night tricked (the defenders) into opening the city gate, so that the Shu soldiers all entered; thus he took Anding.
pmwa1ngr0zxs8m.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|原來魏延扮作安定軍，夤夜賺開城門，蜀兵盡入：因此得了安定。#1

pmwa1ngr0zyoyv.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0zyoyv.text: 崔諒見四面皆是蜀兵，不得已遂降，同歸大寨。
pmwa1ngr0zyoyv.gloss: Cui.Liang see four.sides all COP Shu.soldiers, NEG DE stop then surrender, together return main.camp.
pmwa1ngr0zyoyv.translation: Cui Liang saw that all around were Shu soldiers; having no choice, he then surrendered and returned to the main camp together (with them).
pmwa1ngr0zyoyv.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|崔諒見四面皆是蜀兵，不得已遂降，同歸大寨。#1

pmwa1ngr0zzyhg.section: 第九十二回　　　趙子龍力斬五將　　　諸葛亮智取三城
pmwa1ngr0zzyhg.text: 汝等詭計，如何瞞得丞相耶！」
pmwa1ngr0zzyhg.gloss: 2PL treacherous.scheme, how DE deceive chancellor SFP!
pmwa1ngr0zzyhg.translation: Your treacherous scheme — how can it deceive the Chancellor!
pmwa1ngr0zzyhg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|汝等詭計，如何瞞得丞相耶！」#1

pmwa1ngr110e08p.section: 第九十三回　　　姜伯約歸降孔明　　　武鄉侯罵死王朗
pmwa1ngr110e08p.text: 孔明自得三城後，威聲大震，遠近州郡，望風歸降。
pmwa1ngr110e08p.gloss: Kongming since DE three city after, prestige greatly resound, far.near prefecture.commandery, see.wind submit.surrender.
pmwa1ngr110e08p.translation: After Kongming obtained the three cities, his prestige greatly resounded; the prefectures and commanderies far and near surrendered at the news.
pmwa1ngr110e08p.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明自得三城後，威聲大震，遠近州郡，望風歸降。#1

pmwa1ngr110f9ql.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110f9ql.text: 興在垓心，左衝右突，不能得脫；鐵車密圍，就如城池。
pmwa1ngr110f9ql.gloss: Xing at encirclement.center, left charge right dash, cannot DE escape; iron.chariot tightly.surround, just like city.wall.
pmwa1ngr110f9ql.translation: Xing was in the center of the encirclement, charging left and right but unable to break free; the iron chariots surrounded (him) closely, just like city walls.
pmwa1ngr110f9ql.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|興在垓心，左衝右突，不能得脫；鐵車密圍，就如城池。#1

pmwa1ngr110gshi.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110gshi.text: 關興急走到前面，儘力縱馬加鞭，正邁斷澗，只得回馬來戰越吉。
pmwa1ngr110gshi.gloss: Guan.Xing urgent run arrive front, exhaust.strength let.horse.go add.whip, just step broken.ravine, only DE turn.horse come fight Yue.Ji.
pmwa1ngr110gshi.translation: Guan Xing hurried forward, galloped with all his might and whipped his horse on; just as he was crossing the ravine, he had no choice but to turn his horse back and fight Yue Ji.
pmwa1ngr110gshi.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|關興急走到前面，儘力縱馬加鞭，正邁斷澗，只得回馬來戰越吉。#1

pmwa1ngr110hflz.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110hflz.text: 忽聽得一聲響處，背後越吉連人帶馬，平白地倒下水來。
pmwa1ngr110hflz.gloss: suddenly hear DE one CLF sound place, behind Yue.Ji man.and.horse.together, for.no.reason topple down water come.
pmwa1ngr110hflz.translation: Suddenly he heard a sound, and behind (him) Yue Ji, horse and all, toppled into the water for no apparent reason.
pmwa1ngr110hflz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忽聽得一聲響處，背後越吉連人帶馬，平白地倒下水來。#1

pmwa1ngr110iyrx.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110iyrx.text: 關興得了越吉馬，牽到岸上，整頓鞍轡，綽刀上馬。
pmwa1ngr110iyrx.gloss: Guan.Xing get DE PFV Yue.Ji horse, lead arrive bank on, adjust saddle.bridle, seize sword mount horse.
pmwa1ngr110iyrx.translation: Guan Xing got Yue Ji's horse, led it onto the bank, adjusted the saddle and bridle, seized his sword and mounted.
pmwa1ngr110iyrx.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|關興得了越吉馬，牽到岸上，整頓鞍轡，綽刀上馬。#1

pmwa1ngr110jlwt.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110jlwt.text: 看看至近，只見雲霧之中，隱隱有一大將，面如重棗，眉若臥蠶，綠袍金鎧，提青龍刀，騎赤兔馬，手綽美髯；分明認得是父親關公。
pmwa1ngr110jlwt.gloss: soon reach close, only see cloud.mist GEN middle, faintly have one great.general, face like dark.jujube, eyebrow like lying.silkworm, green.robe gold.armor, carry Green.Dragon.blade, ride Red.Hare.horse, hand stroke beautiful.beard; clearly recognize DE COP father Guan.Gong.
pmwa1ngr110jlwt.translation: As (he) drew near, he saw only that amid the clouds and mist there was faintly a great general, with a face like a dark red jujube, eyebrows like reclining silkworms, a green robe and golden armor, carrying the Green Dragon blade, riding the Red Hare, and stroking his beautiful beard with his hand; (he) clearly recognized (him) as his father, Lord Guan.
pmwa1ngr110jlwt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|看看至近，只見雲霧之中，隱隱有一大將，面如重棗，眉若臥蠶，綠袍金鎧，提青龍刀，騎赤兔馬，手綽美髯；分明認得是父親關公。#1

pmwa1ngr110k443.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110k443.text: 羌兵直到寨外觀看，聽得寨內鼓琴之聲，四壁皆空豎旌旗，急回報越吉。
pmwa1ngr110k443.gloss: Qiang soldier straight arrive camp.outside look, hear DE camp.inside play.qin GEN sound, four wall all empty erect banner, hurriedly report.back Yue.Ji.
pmwa1ngr110k443.translation: The Qiang soldiers went straight to the outside of the camp and looked; they heard the sound of qin-playing inside the camp, where the four walls were all empty and banners were planted, and they hurriedly reported back to Yue Ji.
pmwa1ngr110k443.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|羌兵直到寨外觀看，聽得寨內鼓琴之聲，四壁皆空豎旌旗，急回報越吉。#1

pmwa1ngr110ljzx.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110ljzx.text: 忽然一聲響，如山崩地陷，羌兵俱落於坑塹之中；背後鐵車正行得緊溜，急難收止，並擁而來，自相踐踏。
pmwa1ngr110ljzx.gloss: suddenly one CLF sound ring, like mountain collapse earth sink, Qiang soldier all fall P pit trench inside; behind iron cart just move DE swift.smooth, urgent hard stop, together crowd CONJ come, self mutual trample.
pmwa1ngr110ljzx.translation: Suddenly there was a sound, like mountains collapsing and the earth sinking; the Qiang soldiers all fell into the pits and trenches. The iron carts behind were moving swiftly and were hard to halt quickly, and came pressing forward together, trampling one another.
pmwa1ngr110ljzx.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忽然一聲響，如山崩地陷，羌兵俱落於坑塹之中；背後鐵車正行得緊溜，急難收止，並擁而來，自相踐踏。#1

pmwa1ngr110mv8c.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110mv8c.text: 曹真折了兩個先鋒，哀傷不已；只得寫本申朝，乞撥援兵。
pmwa1ngr110mv8c.gloss: Cao.Zhen lose PFV two CLF vanguard.commander, grieve NEG stop; only DE write memorial report court, beg dispatch relief.troops.
pmwa1ngr110mv8c.translation: Cao Zhen had lost two vanguard commanders and grieved endlessly; he had no choice but to write a memorial to report to the court, begging for reinforcements to be dispatched.
pmwa1ngr110mv8c.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹真折了兩個先鋒，哀傷不已；只得寫本申朝，乞撥援兵。#1

pmwa1ngr110n4a3.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110n4a3.text: 豐曰：「昔日孟達降魏，乃不得已也。
pmwa1ngr110n4a3.gloss: Feng say: former.day Meng.Da surrender Wei, COP NEG DE stop SFP.
pmwa1ngr110n4a3.translation: Feng said, "In former days, Meng Da's surrender to Wei was because he had no choice."
pmwa1ngr110n4a3.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|豐曰：「昔日孟達降魏，乃不得已也。#1

pmwa1ngr110o4up.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110o4up.text: 孟達若死，中原不易得也。」
pmwa1ngr110o4up.gloss: Meng.Da if die, central.plains NEG easy DE SFP
pmwa1ngr110o4up.translation: If Meng Da dies, the Central Plains will not be easy to obtain.
pmwa1ngr110o4up.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孟達若死，中原不易得也。」#1

pmwa1ngr110p67k.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110p67k.text: 書略曰：近得書，足知公忠義之心，不忘故舊，吾甚喜慰。
pmwa1ngr110p67k.gloss: letter brief say: recent DE letter, sufficient know lord loyal.righteous ATTR heart, NEG forget old.friend, 1SG very pleased.comforted
pmwa1ngr110p67k.translation: The letter said in brief: “I have recently received your letter, which is enough to show your loyal and righteous heart and that you do not forget old friends; I am very pleased and comforted.”
pmwa1ngr110p67k.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|書略曰：近得書，足知公忠義之心，不忘故舊，吾甚喜慰。#1

pmwa1ngr110qzpj.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110qzpj.text: 諸葛亮兵在祁山，殺得內外人膽落；今天子不得已而幸長安，若旦夕不用吾時，孟達一舉，兩京破矣！
pmwa1ngr110qzpj.gloss: Zhuge.Liang troops be.at Qi.mountain, kill DE inside.outside people gall fall; now Son.of.Heaven NEG DE stop CONJ go.to Chang.an, if morning.evening NEG use 1SG time, Meng.Da one raise, two capital break SFP!
pmwa1ngr110qzpj.translation: Zhuge Liang's troops are at Mount Qi, and he has slaughtered (them) until the courage of everyone inside and outside (the court) has fallen; now the Son of Heaven has no choice but to go to Chang'an. If (you) do not employ me at once, then with one move by Meng Da the two capitals will be destroyed!
pmwa1ngr110qzpj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|諸葛亮兵在祁山，殺得內外人膽落；今天子不得已而幸長安，若旦夕不用吾時，孟達一舉，兩京破矣！#1

pmwa1ngr110rfxu.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110rfxu.text: 諸葛亮兵在祁山，殺得內外人膽落；今天子不得已而幸長安，若旦夕不用吾時，孟達一舉，兩京破矣！
pmwa1ngr110rfxu.gloss: Zhuge.Liang troops be.at Qi.mountain, kill DE inside.outside people gall fall; now Son.of.Heaven NEG DE stop CONJ go.to Chang.an, if morning.evening NEG use 1SG time, Meng.Da one raise, two capital break SFP!
pmwa1ngr110rfxu.translation: Zhuge Liang's troops are at Mount Qi, and he has slaughtered (them) until the courage of everyone inside and outside (the court) has fallen; now the Son of Heaven has no choice but to go to Chang'an. If (you) do not employ me at once, then with one move by Meng Da the two capitals will be destroyed!
pmwa1ngr110rfxu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|諸葛亮兵在祁山，殺得內外人膽落；今天子不得已而幸長安，若旦夕不用吾時，孟達一舉，兩京破矣！#2

pmwa1ngr110ssvx.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110ssvx.text: 其人只得將孔明、孟達往復之事，一一告說。
pmwa1ngr110ssvx.gloss: DEM person only DE BA Kongming, Meng.Da back.and.forth GEN matter, one.by.one tell.
pmwa1ngr110ssvx.translation: The man had no choice but to recount to (Sima Yi), one by one, the matter of the back-and-forth between Kongming and Meng Da.
