pmwa1ngr110tfna.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110tfna.text: 幸得天子有福，獲此消息。
pmwa1ngr110tfna.gloss: fortunate DE emperor have fortune, obtain PROX news.
pmwa1ngr110tfna.translation: Fortunately, the Emperor has good fortune, and (we) obtained this news.
pmwa1ngr110tfna.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幸得天子有福，獲此消息。#1

pmwa1ngr110ulgo.section: 第九十四回　　　諸葛亮乘雪破羌兵　　司馬懿剋日擒孟達
pmwa1ngr110ulgo.text: 次日，孟達登城遍視，只見魏兵四面圍得鐵桶相似。
pmwa1ngr110ulgo.gloss: next day, Meng.Da climb city.wall survey, only see Wei soldier four.side surround DE iron.bucket similar.
pmwa1ngr110ulgo.translation: The next day, Meng Da climbed the city wall and looked all around, and saw only that the Wei troops had surrounded (the city) on all sides so that it was like an iron bucket.
pmwa1ngr110ulgo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|次日，孟達登城遍視，只見魏兵四面圍得鐵桶相似。#1

pmwa1ngr110v372.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr110v372.text: 若吾用兵，先從子午谷逕取長安，早得多時矣。
pmwa1ngr110v372.gloss: if I use.troops, first from Ziwu.Valley directly take Chang'an, early DE much time SFP.
pmwa1ngr110v372.translation: If I were to use troops, first going straight from Ziwu Valley to take Chang'an, (I) would have been much earlier.
pmwa1ngr110v372.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若吾用兵，先從子午谷逕取長安，早得多時矣。#1

pmwa1ngr110wfsw.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr110wfsw.text: 彼若回動，吾提兵於小路擊之，可得全勝；若不歸時，吾卻將諸處小路，盡皆壘斷，俱以兵守之。
pmwa1ngr110wfsw.gloss: 3PL if turn.back, 1SG lead.troops at small.road attack 3PL.OBJ, can DE complete.victory; if NEG return time, 1SG then BA all.places small.road, all block.off, all with troops guard 3PL.OBJ.
pmwa1ngr110wfsw.translation: If they turn back, I will lead troops onto the side roads and attack them, and can gain a complete victory; if they do not return, then I will block off all the side roads everywhere with barricades and guard them all with troops.
pmwa1ngr110wfsw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|彼若回動，吾提兵於小路擊之，可得全勝；若不歸時，吾卻將諸處小路，盡皆壘斷，俱以兵守之。#1

pmwa1ngr110xkcd.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr110xkcd.text: 孔明又思高翔非張郃對手，必得一員大將，屯兵於街亭之右，方可防之！
pmwa1ngr110xkcd.gloss: Kong.Ming again think Gao.Xiang NEG.COP Zhang.He opponent, must DE one CLF great general, station.troops at Jieting GEN right, only.then.can defend 3SG !
pmwa1ngr110xkcd.translation: Kongming further thought that Gao Xiang was no match for Zhang He; (he) must obtain a great general and station troops to the right of Jieting, only then could (he) defend against him!
pmwa1ngr110xkcd.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明又思高翔非張郃對手，必得一員大將，屯兵於街亭之右，方可防之！#1

pmwa1ngr110y55v.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr110y55v.text: 吾自統大軍，由斜谷逕取郿城：若得郿城，長安可破矣。」
pmwa1ngr110y55v.gloss: 1SG self command great.army, from Xie.Valley directly take Mei.City: if DE Mei.City, Chang'an can break SFP
pmwa1ngr110y55v.translation: I myself will command the great army and go from Xie Valley straight to take Mei City: if (we) get Mei City, Chang'an can be taken.
pmwa1ngr110y55v.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吾自統大軍，由斜谷逕取郿城：若得郿城，長安可破矣。」#1

pmwa1ngr110zk85.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr110zk85.text: 待吾破了魏兵，到丞相面前須分不得功！」
pmwa1ngr110zk85.gloss: wait.until 1SG defeat PFV Wei.soldiers, reach chancellor presence surely share NEG DE merit!
pmwa1ngr110zk85.translation: Wait until I have defeated the Wei troops; when (we) come before the Chancellor, you will surely not be able to claim a share of the credit!
pmwa1ngr110zk85.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|待吾破了魏兵，到丞相面前須分不得功！」#1

pmwa1ngr1110uzj.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr1110uzj.text: 眾軍驚懼，只得努力下山來衝魏兵。
pmwa1ngr1110uzj.gloss: crowd army startle fear, only DE exert.effort down mountain come charge Wei troops.
pmwa1ngr1110uzj.translation: The troops were alarmed and frightened, and had no choice but to exert themselves and come down the mountain to charge the Wei soldiers.
pmwa1ngr1110uzj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾軍驚懼，只得努力下山來衝魏兵。#1

pmwa1ngr1111k1d.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr1111k1d.text: 卻說王平見魏兵到，引軍殺來，正遇張郃；戰有數十餘合，平力窮勢孤，只得退去。
pmwa1ngr1111k1d.gloss: Now Wang.Ping see Wei.troop arrive, lead army charge.come, just meet Zhang.He; fight have several.tens.more bout, Ping strength.exhausted situation.isolated, only DE retreat.go.
pmwa1ngr1111k1d.translation: Now, when Wang Ping saw the Wei troops arrive, he led his army to charge over and happened to meet Zhang He; after they had fought for several tens of bouts, Ping’s strength was exhausted and his position isolated, so he had no choice but to retreat.
pmwa1ngr1111k1d.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說王平見魏兵到，引軍殺來，正遇張郃；戰有數十餘合，平力窮勢孤，只得退去。#1

pmwa1ngr1112amm.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr1112amm.text: 魏兵自辰時困至戌時，山上無水，軍不得食，寨中大亂。
pmwa1ngr1112amm.gloss: Wei soldiers from chen.hour besiege until xu.hour, mountain on not.have water, troops NEG DE eat, camp in great.chaos.
pmwa1ngr1112amm.translation: The Wei troops besieged (them) from the hour of Chen to the hour of Xu; there was no water on the mountain, the troops could not eat, and the camp was in great chaos.
pmwa1ngr1112amm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|魏兵自辰時困至戌時，山上無水，軍不得食，寨中大亂。#1

pmwa1ngr1113rtn.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr1113rtn.text: 馬謖料守不住，只得驅殘兵殺下山西逃奔。
pmwa1ngr1113rtn.gloss: Ma.Su reckon defend NEG hold, only DE drive remnant.troops fight down mountain west flee.
pmwa1ngr1113rtn.translation: Ma Su judged that he could not hold (the position), and had no choice but to drive the remnant troops to fight their way down the mountain and flee west.
pmwa1ngr1113rtn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|馬謖料守不住，只得驅殘兵殺下山西逃奔。#1

pmwa1ngr2114o6i.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr2114o6i.text: 魏延左衝右突，不得脫身，折兵大半。
pmwa1ngr2114o6i.gloss: Wei.Yan left charge right dash, NEG DE escape, lose troops more.than.half.
pmwa1ngr2114o6i.translation: Wei Yan charged left and dashed right, but could not break free, and lost more than half his troops.
pmwa1ngr2114o6i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|魏延左衝右突，不得脫身，折兵大半。#1

pmwa1ngr2115lzx.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr2115lzx.gloss: Yan greatly rejoice say: 1SG DE live CRS!
pmwa1ngr2115lzx.translation: Yan was overjoyed and said, "I have survived!"
pmwa1ngr2115lzx.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|延大喜曰：「吾得生矣！」#1

pmwa1ngr21166ex.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr21166ex.text: 二人盡力衝突，不得脫身。
pmwa1ngr21166ex.gloss: two person exhaust.strength break.through, NEG DE escape
pmwa1ngr21166ex.translation: The two men did their utmost to break through, (but) could not get away.
pmwa1ngr21166ex.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|二人盡力衝突，不得脫身。#1

pmwa1ngr21174w2.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr21174w2.text: 忽聽得山坡後喊聲若雷，一彪軍殺入，乃是王平，救了高、魏二人，逕奔列柳城來。
pmwa1ngr21174w2.gloss: suddenly hear DE hillside behind shout.sound like thunder, one.troop army charge enter, COP Wang.Ping, rescue PFV Gao, Wei two.person, straight rush Lieliu.City come
pmwa1ngr21174w2.translation: Suddenly they heard shouts like thunder from behind the hillside, and a body of troops came charging in; it was Wang Ping, who had rescued the two men Gao and Wei and was heading straight for Lieliu City.
pmwa1ngr21174w2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忽聽得山坡後喊聲若雷，一彪軍殺入，乃是王平，救了高、魏二人，逕奔列柳城來。#1

pmwa1ngr2118c7t.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr2118c7t.text: 原來郭淮與曹真商議，恐司馬懿得了全功，乃分淮來取街亭；聞知司馬懿、張郃成了此功，遂引兵逕襲列柳城。
pmwa1ngr2118c7t.gloss: it.turned.out Guo.Huai with Cao.Zhen discuss, fear Sima.Yi DE PFV complete.merit, then dispatch Huai come take Jieting; hear.learn Sima.Yi, Zhang.He achieve PFV this merit, then lead.troops directly attack Lieliu.City.
pmwa1ngr2118c7t.translation: It turned out that Guo Huai and Cao Zhen had discussed the matter: fearing that Sima Yi would gain the entire credit, they sent Guo Huai separately to take Jieting. When (Guo Huai) learned that Sima Yi and Zhang He had achieved this feat, he then led his troops straight to attack Lieliu City.
pmwa1ngr2118c7t.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|原來郭淮與曹真商議，恐司馬懿得了全功，乃分淮來取街亭；聞知司馬懿、張郃成了此功，遂引兵逕襲列柳城。#1

pmwa1ngr211909j.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr211909j.text: 卻說郭淮收了軍馬，乃謂左右曰：「吾雖不得街亭，卻取了列柳城，亦是大功。」
pmwa1ngr211909j.gloss: meanwhile Guo.Huai gather PFV troops, then say.to attendants say: I although NEG DE Jieting, but take PFV Lie.Liu.City, also COP great.merit.
pmwa1ngr211909j.translation: Meanwhile, Guo Huai rallied his troops and said to his attendants, "Although I did not take Jieting, I did take Lieliu City, which is also a great merit."
pmwa1ngr211909j.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說郭淮收了軍馬，乃謂左右曰：「吾雖不得街亭，卻取了列柳城，亦是大功。」#1

pmwa1ngr211ag8j.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr211ag8j.text: 若彼敗走，不可相拒，只宜中途截住，蜀兵輜重，可盡得也。」
pmwa1ngr211ag8j.gloss: if 3PL defeat flee, NEG can each.other resist, only should midway intercept stop, Shu soldiers baggage, can completely DE SFP
pmwa1ngr211ag8j.translation: If they are routed and flee, (you) must not oppose them (head-on); (you) should only block (them) midway, and the Shu army's baggage and supplies can all be captured.
pmwa1ngr211ag8j.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若彼敗走，不可相拒，只宜中途截住，蜀兵輜重，可盡得也。」#1

pmwa1ngr211bhvs.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr211bhvs.gloss: if DE PROX city, three commandery can recover SFP
pmwa1ngr211bhvs.translation: If (we) obtain this city, the three commanderies can be recovered.
pmwa1ngr211bhvs.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若得此城，三郡可復矣。」#1

pmwa1ngr211cks6.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr211cks6.text: 眾官聽得這個消息，盡皆失色。
pmwa1ngr211cks6.gloss: all.official hear DE this CLF news, all lose.color
pmwa1ngr211cks6.translation: When the assembled officials heard this news, they all turned pale.
pmwa1ngr211cks6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾官聽得這個消息，盡皆失色。#1

pmwa1ngr211d2yb.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr211d2yb.text: 吾非行險，蓋因不得已而用之。
pmwa1ngr211d2yb.gloss: 1SG NEG take.risk, CONJ because NEG DE stop CONJ use 3SG.
pmwa1ngr211d2yb.translation: I am not taking a risk; it is simply because I had no choice that I used it.
pmwa1ngr211d2yb.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吾非行險，蓋因不得已而用之。#1

pmwa1ngr211ewxl.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr211ewxl.gloss: DE NEG by Sima.Yi PASS capture Q?
pmwa1ngr211ewxl.translation: Would we not be captured by Sima Yi?
pmwa1ngr211ewxl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|得不為司馬懿所擒乎？」#1

pmwa1ngr211fqxn.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr211fqxn.text: 山谷應聲，不知蜀兵多少；更兼魏軍心疑，不敢久停，只得盡棄輜重而去。
pmwa1ngr211fqxn.gloss: mountain.valley echo sound, NEG know Shu.soldier how.many; moreover Wei.army heart doubt, NEG dare long halt, only DE completely abandon baggage CONJ go.
pmwa1ngr211fqxn.translation: The valleys echoed the sound, and no one knew how many Shu soldiers there were; moreover, the Wei troops were suspicious at heart and did not dare to halt for long, so they had no choice but to abandon all their baggage and flee.
pmwa1ngr211fqxn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|山谷應聲，不知蜀兵多少；更兼魏軍心疑，不敢久停，只得盡棄輜重而去。#1

pmwa1ngr211gfnv.section: 第九十五回　　　馬謖拒諫失街亭　　　武侯彈琴退仲達
pmwa1ngr211gfnv.text: 興、苞二人皆遵將令，不敢追襲，多得軍器糧草而歸。

pmwa1ngr211gfnv.translation: Xing and Bao, the two of them, both obeyed the general's orders and did not dare to pursue and attack; they obtained a great deal of weaponry and provisions and returned.

pmwa1ngr5123j8k.text: 卻說曹真因思前番被司馬懿奪了功勞，因此到洛口分調郭淮、孫禮東西把守；又聽得陳倉口告急，已令王雙去救，聞知王雙斬將立功，大喜，乃令中護軍大將費耀，權攝前部總督，諸將各自把守譯口。

pmwa1ngr512d5pk.text: 安下營寨，孔明聚眾言曰：「吾二出祁山，未得其利；今又到此，吾料魏人必依舊戰之地，與吾相敵。
pmwa1ngr512d5pk.gloss: set.up camp , Kongming gather crowd say : 1SG twice go.out Qishan , not.yet DE its advantage ; now again arrive here , 1SG expect Wei.people certainly rely.on old battle GEN place , with 1SG each.other oppose .
pmwa1ngr512d5pk.translation: After pitching camp, Kongming assembled the troops and said: 'I have twice marched out to Qishan without gaining any advantage; now that we have come here again, I expect the Wei forces will certainly rely on the old battleground to oppose us.'

pmwa1ngr512ey8c.section: 第九十八回　　　追漢軍王雙受誅　　　襲陳倉武侯取勝
pmwa1ngr512ey8c.text: 彼意疑我取雍、郿二處，必以兵拒守；吾觀武都、陰平與漢連接，若得此二郡，亦可分魏兵之勢。

pmwa1ngr512ey8c.translation: They suspect that I am going to take Yong and Mei, and will certainly use troops to defend them; I observe that Wudu and Yinping are connected with Han (Hanzhong). If we obtain these two commanderies, we can also split the Wei army's strength.

pmwa1ngr512ggzy.text: 孔明伏於要路，前後攻殺，因此大敗，棄馬步行，方得逃回。」

pmwa1ngr512ggzy.translation: Kongming lay in ambush at the vital road and attacked (us) from front and rear; because of this (we) were badly defeated, abandoned our horses and went on foot, and only then managed to escape back.

pmwa1ngr512hl7x.translation: Yi again summoned Zhang He and Dai Ling and instructed them, saying: 'Now that Kongming has taken Wudu and Yinping, he will surely soothe the common people to set their hearts at ease, and will not be in the camp.'

pmwa1ngr612mtec.section: 第九十九回　　　諸葛亮大破魏兵　　　司馬懿入寇西蜀

pmwa1ngr612o9hi.section: 第九十九回　　　諸葛亮大破魏兵　　　司馬懿入寇西蜀

pmwa1ngr612qzbz.text: 孔明去了五日，懿方得知，乃長嘆曰：「孔明真有神出鬼沒之計，吾不能及也！」
pmwa1ngr612qzbz.gloss: Kong.Ming leave PFV five day, Yi only.then DE know, then long.sigh say: Kong.Ming truly have god.appear.ghost.vanish ATTR plan, 1SG NEG can match SFP!
pmwa1ngr612qzbz.translation: Kongming had been gone for five days when Yi finally learned (of it); then he gave a long sigh and said, “Kongming truly has schemes as elusive as gods appearing and ghosts vanishing—I cannot match (him)!”
pmwa1ngr612qzbz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|孔明去了五日，懿方得知，乃長嘆曰：「孔明真有神出鬼沒之計，吾不能及也！」#1

pmwa1ngr612rsjx.section: 第九十九回　　　諸葛亮大破魏兵　　　司馬懿入寇西蜀
pmwa1ngr612rsjx.text: 此時孔明病好多時，每日操練人馬，習學八陣之法，盡皆精熟，欲取中原﹔聽得這個消息，遂喚張嶷、王平分付曰：「汝二人先引一千兵去守陳倉故道，以當魏兵﹔吾卻提大兵便來接應。」
pmwa1ngr612rsjx.gloss: this time Kongming illness recover long.time, every day drill troops, practice.learn Eight.Formations GEN method, all completely proficient, want take Central.Plains; hear DE this CLF news, then call Zhang.Yi, Wang.Ping instruct say : 2SG two person first lead one.thousand soldier go guard Chencang old.road, in.order.to resist Wei.troops; 1SG instead lead great.army then come support.
pmwa1ngr612rsjx.translation: By this time Kongming had been recovered from his illness for a long while; every day he drilled the troops and practiced the method of the Eight Formations, becoming thoroughly proficient in all of them, and wished to seize the Central Plains. Hearing this news, he then summoned Zhang Yi and Wang Ping and instructed them, saying: 'You two first lead a thousand soldiers to go guard the old Chencang road, in order to withstand the Wei troops; I on the other hand will lead the main army and come to support you at once.'
pmwa1ngr612rsjx.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|此時孔明病好多時，每日操練人馬，習學八陣之法，盡皆精熟，欲取中原﹔聽得這個消息，遂喚張嶷、王平分付曰：「汝二人先引一千兵去守陳倉故道，以當魏兵﹔吾卻提大兵便來接應。」#1

pmwa1ngr612sd1q.section: 第九十九回　　　諸葛亮大破魏兵　　　司馬懿入寇西蜀
pmwa1ngr612sd1q.text: 陳倉城外，平地水深三尺，軍器盡濕，人不得睡，晝夜不安。

pmwa1ngr612sd1q.translation: Outside the city of Chencang, the water on the flat ground was three chi deep; all the weapons were soaked; people could not sleep, and were restless day and night.

pmwa1ngr612t09i.section: 第九十九回　　　諸葛亮大破魏兵　　　司馬懿入寇西蜀

pmwa1ngr612t09i.translation: (The news) spread to Luoyang; the Wei ruler set up an altar and sought clear weather, but could not obtain it.
pmwa1ngr612t09i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|傳入洛陽，魏主設壇，求晴不得。#1

pmwa1ngr612uo82.section: 第九十九回　　　諸葛亮大破魏兵　　　司馬懿入寇西蜀
pmwa1ngr612uo82.text: 聞曹真發已逾月，而行方半谷，治道功大，戰士悉作；是彼偏得以逸待勞，乃兵家之所憚也。

pmwa1ngr612uo82.translation: I hear Cao Zhen set out more than a month ago, yet his march is only halfway through the valley; the road-building work is great, and the soldiers are all laboring. This means the other side, by contrast, gets to wait at ease for the exhausted—this is what military strategists dread.

pmwa1ngr612w05e.section: 第一百回　　　　漢兵劫寨破曹真　　　武侯鬥陣辱仲達
pmwa1ngr612w05e.text: 吾料魏兵連遭大雨，衣甲皆毀，必然急歸；安得又有埋伏？

pmwa1ngr6131jw4.text: 忽聞喊聲大震，一彪軍殺入，乃是魏延；救了陳式，回到谷中，五千兵只剩得四五百帶傷人馬。

pmwa1ngr6136x46.section: 第一百回　　　　漢兵劫寨破曹真　　　武侯鬥陣辱仲達
pmwa1ngr6136x46.text: 孔明收得勝之兵，回到祁山時，永安城李嚴遣都尉茍安解送糧米，至軍中交割。

pmwa1ngr713af2w.translation: Yang Yi went in and reported to Kongming, saying: “The Wei troops are coming very urgently. Chancellor, you could take the troops due for rotation and keep them for the time being to repel the enemy; wait until the new troops arrive, then replace them.”

pmwa1ngr713b2dg.section: 第一百一回　　　出隴上諸葛妝神　　　奔劍閣張郃中計
pmwa1ngr713b2dg.text: 蜀兵奮力追殺，殺得那雍、涼兵屍橫遍野，血流成渠。
pmwa1ngr713b2dg.gloss: Shu troops with.all.strength pursue.and.kill, kill-DE DEM Yong, Liang soldiers corpse lie.crosswise all.over.wilderness, blood flow become channel.
pmwa1ngr713b2dg.translation: The Shu troops pursued and slaughtered (them) with all their might, killing those Yong and Liang soldiers so that corpses lay strewn across the wilderness and blood flowed in channels.

pmwa1ngr713c19d.translation: Kong Ming came out of the city and gathered the troops who had won the victory; he entered the city and rewarded and comforted them. Suddenly it was reported that Li Yan of Yong'an had sent a letter asking for urgent help.

pmwa1ngr713d234.translation: Zhang He said: "I already know; there is no need to worry."

pmwa1ngr713jsk2.text: 此時王平、張疑不知北原兵敗，直奔到魏營，已有二更天氣，只聽得喊聲四起。

pmwa1ngr713y1am.text: 司馬懿驚得手足無措，乃下馬抱二子大哭曰：「我父子三人皆死於此處矣！」

pmwa1ngr814294i.translation: I humbly hope that Heaven's compassion may deign to look down and hear me, and graciously extend your servant's allotted span, so that I may be enabled above to repay my lord's grace and below to save the people's lives, recover the former realm, and forever prolong the sacrifices of Han.
