pmwa1ngr814dy92.gloss: ruler act head, minister be thigh.arm, survive perish one body, DE lose same 3SG.OBJ
pmwa1ngr814dy92.translation: The ruler is the head, the ministers are the limbs; in survival and ruin they are one body, and in gain and loss they share alike.
pmwa1ngr814dy92.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|君作元首，臣為股肱，存亡一體，得失同之。#1

pmwa1ngr814e8hu.section: 第一百五回　　　武侯預伏錦囊計　　　魏主拆取承露盤
pmwa1ngr814e8hu.text: 毛見叡月餘不入正宮，是日引十餘宮人，來翠花樓上消遺，只聽得樂聲嘹亮，乃問曰：「何處奏樂？」
pmwa1ngr814e8hu.gloss: Mao see Rui month more NEG enter main.palace, this day lead ten more palace.women, come Emerald.Flower.Tower on divert.oneself, only hear DE music.sound loud.and.clear, then ask say: where play.music?
pmwa1ngr814e8hu.translation: Mao saw that Rui had not entered the main palace for over a month. That day she led more than ten palace women and came up to the Emerald Flower Tower to divert herself; she only heard the sound of music loud and clear, and then asked, 'Where is music being played?'
pmwa1ngr814e8hu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|毛見叡月餘不入正宮，是日引十餘宮人，來翠花樓上消遺，只聽得樂聲嘹亮，乃問曰：「何處奏樂？」#1

pmwa1ngr814f0eq.section: 第一百五回　　　武侯預伏錦囊計　　　魏主拆取承露盤
pmwa1ngr814f0eq.text: 叡大怒，即令擒昨日侍奉諸人到，叱曰：「昨遊北園，朕禁左右不許使毛知道，何得又宣露！」
pmwa1ngr814f0eq.gloss: Rui greatly.angry, immediately order seize yesterday attend all.people arrive, rebuke say: "yesterday visit North.Garden, 1SG forbid attendants NEG allow cause Mao know, how DE again divulge!"
pmwa1ngr814f0eq.translation: Rui was furious and at once ordered the men who had attended (him) the day before to be seized and brought before him, and rebuked (them), saying: "When I visited the North Garden yesterday, I forbade my attendants to let Mao know—how did (you) let it out again!"
pmwa1ngr814f0eq.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|叡大怒，即令擒昨日侍奉諸人到，叱曰：「昨遊北園，朕禁左右不許使毛知道，何得又宣露！」#1

pmwa1ngr814gfn5.section: 第一百六回　　　公孫淵兵敗死襄平　　司馬懿詐病賺曹爽
pmwa1ngr814gfn5.text: 眾將得令，次日侵晨，引兵四面圍合，築土山，掘地道，立砲架，裝雲梯，日夜攻打不息，箭如急雨，射入城去。
pmwa1ngr814gfn5.gloss: all.generals DE order, next.day early.dawn, lead troops four.sides surround.close, build earth.mound, dig tunnel, set.up catapult.frame, equip cloud.ladder, day.night attack NEG stop, arrow like urgent.rain, shoot enter city go.
pmwa1ngr814gfn5.translation: The generals received the order; the next day at dawn they led troops to encircle (the city) on all sides, built earthen mounds, dug tunnels, set up catapult frames, and assembled cloud ladders, attacking day and night without cease, arrows like a sudden downpour shooting into the city.
pmwa1ngr814gfn5.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|眾將得令，次日侵晨，引兵四面圍合，築土山，掘地道，立砲架，裝雲梯，日夜攻打不息，箭如急雨，射入城去。#1

pmwa1ngr814hf5w.section: 第一百六回　　　公孫淵兵敗死襄平　　司馬懿詐病賺曹爽
pmwa1ngr814hf5w.text: 行不到十里，忽聽得山上一聲砲響，鼓角齊鳴，一枝兵攔住，中央乃司馬懿也；左有司馬師，右有司馬昭，二人大叫曰：「反賊休走！」
pmwa1ngr814hf5w.gloss: go NEG reach ten li, suddenly hear DE mountain on one CLF cannon boom, drum horn together sound, one CLF troop block, center COP Sima.Yi SFP; left have Sima.Shi, right have Sima.Zhao, two person loud shout say: rebel PROH flee!
pmwa1ngr814hf5w.translation: Before he had gone ten li, he suddenly heard a cannon boom from the mountain, drums and horns sounded all together, and a body of troops blocked (his way); in the center was Sima Yi himself; on the left was Sima Shi, on the right Sima Zhao; the two men shouted loudly, saying: "Rebel, do not flee!"
pmwa1ngr814hf5w.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|行不到十里，忽聽得山上一聲砲響，鼓角齊鳴，一枝兵攔住，中央乃司馬懿也；左有司馬師，右有司馬昭，二人大叫曰：「反賊休走！」#1

pmwa1ngr814ix8q.section: 第一百六回　　　公孫淵兵敗死襄平　　司馬懿詐病賺曹爽
pmwa1ngr814ix8q.text: 早有胡遵兵到；左有夏侯霸、夏侯威，右有張虎、樂綝：四面圍得鐵桶相似。
pmwa1ngr814ix8q.gloss: already have Hu.Zun troops arrive; left have Xiahou.Ba, Xiahou.Wei, right have Zhang.Hu, Yue.Chen: four.sides surround DE iron.bucket similar.
pmwa1ngr814ix8q.translation: Hu Zun’s troops had already arrived; on the left were Xiahou Ba and Xiahou Wei, on the right Zhang Hu and Yue Chen: they surrounded (him) on all sides so that it was like an iron barrel.
pmwa1ngr814ix8q.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|早有胡遵兵到；左有夏侯霸、夏侯威，右有張虎、樂綝：四面圍得鐵桶相似。#1

pmwa1ngr814j9d6.section: 第一百六回　　　公孫淵兵敗死襄平　　司馬懿詐病賺曹爽
pmwa1ngr814j9d6.text: 公孫淵父子，只得下馬納降。
pmwa1ngr814j9d6.gloss: Gongsun.Yuan father.son, only DE dismount horse offer surrender.
pmwa1ngr814j9d6.translation: Gongsun Yuan and his son had no choice but to dismount and surrender.
pmwa1ngr814j9d6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|公孫淵父子，只得下馬納降。#1

pmwa1ngr814k75g.section: 第一百六回　　　公孫淵兵敗死襄平　　司馬懿詐病賺曹爽
pmwa1ngr814k75g.text: 只見毛皇后引數十個宮人哭至座前索命，叡因此得病。
pmwa1ngr814k75g.gloss: only see Mao.Empress lead several.tens CLF palace.woman weep arrive seat.front demand.life , Rui therefore DE illness .
pmwa1ngr814k75g.translation: He saw only Empress Mao leading several dozen palace women, weeping as they came before the throne to demand his life; because of this, Rui fell ill.
pmwa1ngr814k75g.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只見毛皇后引數十個宮人哭至座前索命，叡因此得病。#1

pmwa1ngr814ly77.section: 第一百六回　　　公孫淵兵敗死襄平　　司馬懿詐病賺曹爽
pmwa1ngr814ly77.text: 二人久得曹真之惠，乃保奏曰：「惟曹子丹之子曹爽可也。」
pmwa1ngr814ly77.gloss: two person long DE Cao.Zhen GEN favor, then recommend say: only Cao.Zidan GEN son Cao.Shuang suitable SFP.
pmwa1ngr814ly77.translation: The two men had long enjoyed Cao Zhen's favor, so they recommended (Cao Shuang) to the throne, saying: “Only Cao Zidan's son Cao Shuang will do.”
pmwa1ngr814ly77.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|二人久得曹真之惠，乃保奏曰：「惟曹子丹之子曹爽可也。」#1

pmwa1ngr814mueh.section: 第一百六回　　　公孫淵兵敗死襄平　　司馬懿詐病賺曹爽
pmwa1ngr814mueh.text: 叡曰：「朕惟恐不得見卿；今日得見，死無恨矣。」
pmwa1ngr814mueh.gloss: Rui say: 1SG only.fear NEG DE see 2SG; today DE see, die not.have regret SFP
pmwa1ngr814mueh.translation: Rui said: 'I only feared that I would not get to see you; today, having gotten to see you, I will die without regret.'
pmwa1ngr814mueh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|叡曰：「朕惟恐不得見卿；今日得見，死無恨矣。」#1

pmwa1ngr814n2bd.section: 第一百六回　　　公孫淵兵敗死襄平　　司馬懿詐病賺曹爽
pmwa1ngr814n2bd.text: 叡曰：「朕惟恐不得見卿；今日得見，死無恨矣。」
pmwa1ngr814n2bd.gloss: Rui say: 1SG only.fear NEG DE see 2SG; today DE see, die not.have regret SFP
pmwa1ngr814n2bd.translation: Rui said: 'I only feared that I would not get to see you; today, having gotten to see you, I will die without regret.'
pmwa1ngr814n2bd.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|叡曰：「朕惟恐不得見卿；今日得見，死無恨矣。」#2

pmwa1ngr814okti.section: 第一百六回　　　公孫淵兵敗死襄平　　司馬懿詐病賺曹爽
pmwa1ngr814okti.text: 今日得見龍顏，臣之幸也。」
pmwa1ngr814okti.gloss: today DE see dragon.face, minister GEN fortune SFP.
pmwa1ngr814okti.translation: Today I get to see the imperial countenance; it is my good fortune.
pmwa1ngr814okti.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今日得見龍顏，臣之幸也。」#1

pmwa1ngr814p5rr.section: 第一百六回　　　公孫淵兵敗死襄平　　司馬懿詐病賺曹爽
pmwa1ngr814p5rr.text: 勝曰：「太傅如何病得這等了？」
pmwa1ngr814p5rr.gloss: Sheng say: Grand.Tutor how ill DE this.extent SFP?
pmwa1ngr814p5rr.translation: Sheng said, "How has the Grand Tutor become this ill?"
pmwa1ngr814p5rr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|勝曰：「太傅如何病得這等了？」#1

pmwa1ngr914q8l6.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr914q8l6.translation: The Empress Dowager was afraid, and had no choice but to go along with him.
pmwa1ngr914q8l6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|太后懼怕，只得從之。#1

pmwa1ngr914rkhh.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr914rkhh.text: 正見司馬懿引兵過府前，舉令人亂箭射下，懿不得過。
pmwa1ngr914rkhh.gloss: just see Sima.Yi lead troops pass mansion front, Ju order people random.arrows shoot down, Yi NEG DE pass.
pmwa1ngr914rkhh.translation: (Pan) Ju just saw Sima Yi leading troops past the front of the mansion, so (he) ordered his men to shoot arrows down in a volley, and Yi could not get through.
pmwa1ngr914rkhh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|正見司馬懿引兵過府前，舉令人亂箭射下，懿不得過。#1

pmwa1ngr914s08m.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr914s08m.text: 偏將孫謙在後止之曰：「太傅爲國家大事，休得放箭。」
pmwa1ngr914s08m.gloss: subordinate.general Sun.Qian at rear stop 3SG.OBJ say: Grand.Tutor for state great.affair, PROH DE shoot arrow.
pmwa1ngr914s08m.translation: The subordinate general Sun Qian stopped him from behind, saying: “The Grand Tutor is acting for the great affairs of the state; do not shoot arrows.”
pmwa1ngr914s08m.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|偏將孫謙在後止之曰：「太傅爲國家大事，休得放箭。」#1

pmwa1ngr914t6zu.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr914t6zu.gloss: Si.Fan only DE open gate release out.
pmwa1ngr914t6zu.translation: Si Fan had no choice but to open the gate and let (him) out.
pmwa1ngr914t6zu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|蕃只得開門放出。#1

pmwa1ngr914ul2e.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr914ul2e.text: 臣輒敕主者及黃門令，罷爽、羲、訓吏兵，以侯就第，不得逗遛，以稽車駕；敢有稽留，便以軍法從治，臣輒力疾將兵，屯於洛水浮橋，伺察非常。
pmwa1ngr914ul2e.gloss: minister forthwith order person.in.charge and yellow.gate.director, dismiss Shuang, Xi, Xun official.soldier, as marquis go.to residence, NEG DE linger, in.order.to delay imperial.carriage; dare have detain.delay, then according.to military.law punish, minister forthwith despite.illness lead troops, encamp at Luo.River floating.bridge, watch unusual.
pmwa1ngr914ul2e.translation: I, your servant, have forthwith ordered the officials in charge and the Yellow Gate Director to relieve Shuang, Xi, and Xun of their officials and troops, and to have them go to their residences as marquises, not to linger and thereby delay the imperial carriage; if anyone dares to detain (them), he shall forthwith be dealt with according to military law. I, your servant, have forthwith, despite illness, led troops and encamped at the floating bridge on the Luo River, watching for anything unusual.
pmwa1ngr914ul2e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|臣輒敕主者及黃門令，罷爽、羲、訓吏兵，以侯就第，不得逗遛，以稽車駕；敢有稽留，便以軍法從治，臣輒力疾將兵，屯於洛水浮橋，伺察非常。#1

pmwa1ngr914vilq.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr914vilq.text: 二人告曰：「城中把得鐵桶相似，太傅引兵屯洛水浮橋，勢將不可復歸，宜早定大計。」
pmwa1ngr914vilq.gloss: two person tell say: city.inside guard DE iron.bucket similar, Grand.Tutor lead troops station Luo.River floating.bridge, situation FUT not.can again return, should early settle great.plan.
pmwa1ngr914vilq.translation: The two men reported, saying: The city is guarded so that it is like an iron bucket; the Grand Tutor leads troops and stations them at the floating bridge on the Luo River, and the situation will make it impossible to go back again. You should settle the grand plan early.
pmwa1ngr914vilq.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|二人告曰：「城中把得鐵桶相似，太傅引兵屯洛水浮橋，勢將不可復歸，宜早定大計。」#1

pmwa1ngr914wpds.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr914wpds.text: 傳得聖賢真妙訣，平原管輅相通神。
pmwa1ngr914wpds.gloss: transmit DE sage true wondrous secret, Pingyuan Guan.Lu mutual.commune spirit
pmwa1ngr914wpds.translation: He handed down and grasped the true wondrous secrets of the sages; Guan Lu of Pingyuan communed with the spirits.
pmwa1ngr914wpds.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|傳得聖賢真妙訣，平原管輅相通神。#1

pmwa1ngr914x7nu.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr914x7nu.text: 忽聽得後軍吶喊，霸急回馬時，陳泰引兵殺來。
pmwa1ngr914x7nu.gloss: suddenly hear DE rear army shout, Ba urgently turn horse when, Chen.Tai lead troops kill come
pmwa1ngr914x7nu.translation: Suddenly he heard the rear army shout; as Ba hurriedly wheeled his horse around, Chen Tai led troops in to attack.
pmwa1ngr914x7nu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|忽聽得後軍吶喊，霸急回馬時，陳泰引兵殺來。#1

pmwa1ngr914ykey.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr914ykey.text: 有人報與姜維，維心不信，令人體訪得實，方教入城。
pmwa1ngr914ykey.gloss: someone report to Jiang.Wei, Wei heart NEG believe, order people personally.investigate DE truth, only.then let enter city.
pmwa1ngr914ykey.translation: Someone reported to Jiang Wei; Jiang Wei did not believe it in his heart, and ordered people to investigate personally and ascertain the truth; only then did he let (the messenger) enter the city.
pmwa1ngr914ykey.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|有人報與姜維，維心不信，令人體訪得實，方教入城。#1

pmwa1ngr914zv62.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr914zv62.text: 歆死戰不能出，只得退入城去。
pmwa1ngr914zv62.gloss: Xin fight.to.death not can exit, only DE retreat enter city go
pmwa1ngr914zv62.translation: Xin fought desperately but could not break out, and had no choice but to retreat back into the city.
pmwa1ngr914zv62.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|歆死戰不能出，只得退入城去。#1

pmwa1ngr9150dhx.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr9150dhx.text: 雍州兵四面圍合，歆奮死衝突，方纔得脫；只落得獨自一人，身帶重傷，餘皆沒於亂軍之中。
pmwa1ngr9150dhx.gloss: Yongzhou troops four.sides surround, Xin desperately charge.break.through, only.then DE escape; only end.up DE alone one.person, body carry severe.wound, rest all perish in chaotic.army midst.
pmwa1ngr9150dhx.translation: The Yongzhou troops surrounded him on all sides; Xin desperately charged to break through and only then managed to escape; he ended up all alone, his body bearing severe wounds, while all the rest perished amid the chaotic army.
pmwa1ngr9150dhx.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雍州兵四面圍合，歆奮死衝突，方纔得脫；只落得獨自一人，身帶重傷，餘皆沒於亂軍之中。#1

pmwa1ngr9151gmr.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr9151gmr.text: 雍州兵四面圍合，歆奮死衝突，方纔得脫；只落得獨自一人，身帶重傷，餘皆沒於亂軍之中。
pmwa1ngr9151gmr.gloss: Yongzhou troops four.sides surround, Xin desperately charge.break.through, only.then DE escape; only end.up DE alone one.person, body carry severe.wound, rest all perish in chaotic.army midst.
pmwa1ngr9151gmr.translation: The Yongzhou troops surrounded him on all sides; Xin desperately charged to break through and only then managed to escape; he ended up all alone, his body bearing severe wounds, while all the rest perished amid the chaotic army.
pmwa1ngr9151gmr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|雍州兵四面圍合，歆奮死衝突，方纔得脫；只落得獨自一人，身帶重傷，餘皆沒於亂軍之中。#2

pmwa1ngr9152ibh.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr9152ibh.text: 幸得天降大雪，因此化雪度日。
pmwa1ngr9152ibh.gloss: luckily DE heaven send.down heavy.snow, therefore melt snow pass.days.
pmwa1ngr9152ibh.translation: Fortunately, heavy snow fell from the sky, and so (we) melt the snow to get through the days.
pmwa1ngr9152ibh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幸得天降大雪，因此化雪度日。#1

pmwa1ngr9153d22.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr9153d22.text: 卻說姜維兵至牛頭山，忽聽得前軍發喊，報說魏兵截住去路。
pmwa1ngr9153d22.gloss: now Jiang.Wei troops arrive Niutou.Mountain, suddenly hear DE front.army raise.shout, report.say Wei.troops block way.ahead.
pmwa1ngr9153d22.translation: Now, Jiang Wei's troops arrived at Niutou Mountain; suddenly they heard the vanguard raise a shout, and a report said that Wei troops had blocked the road ahead.
pmwa1ngr9153d22.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說姜維兵至牛頭山，忽聽得前軍發喊，報說魏兵截住去路。#1

pmwa1ngr9154znd.section: 第一百七回　　　魏主政歸司馬氏　　　姜維兵敗牛頭山
pmwa1ngr9154znd.text: 那人生得圓面大耳，方口厚脣，左目下生個黑瘤，瘤上生數十根黑毛，乃司馬懿長子驃騎將軍司馬師也。
pmwa1ngr9154znd.gloss: DEM person have DE round face big ear, square mouth thick lip, left eye under grow CLF black tumor, tumor on grow several.tens CLF black hair, COP Sima.Yi eldest.son cavalry.general Sima.Shi SFP.
pmwa1ngr9154znd.translation: That man had a round face and large ears, a square mouth and thick lips; under his left eye grew a black tumor, and on the tumor grew dozens of black hairs; he was Sima Yi's eldest son, the Cavalry General Sima Shi.
pmwa1ngr9154znd.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|那人生得圓面大耳，方口厚脣，左目下生個黑瘤，瘤上生數十根黑毛，乃司馬懿長子驃騎將軍司馬師也。#1

pmwa1ngr9155g0e.section: 第一百八回　　　丁奉雪中奮短兵　　　孫峻席間施密計
pmwa1ngr9155g0e.text: 師曰：「天道三十年一變，豈得常為鼎峙乎？
pmwa1ngr9155g0e.gloss: Sima.Shi say: heaven.way thirty year one change, how DE always be tripod.standoff Q?
pmwa1ngr9155g0e.translation: Sima Shi said, "The Way of Heaven changes once every thirty years; how can we remain forever in a three-way standoff?"
pmwa1ngr9155g0e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|師曰：「天道三十年一變，豈得常為鼎峙乎？#1

pmwa1ngr9156vsb.section: 第一百八回　　　丁奉雪中奮短兵　　　孫峻席間施密計
pmwa1ngr9156vsb.text: 昶、儉二人受令而去，昭又令胡遵為先鋒，總領三路兵前去，先搭浮橋，取東興大堤；若奪得左右二城，便是大功。
pmwa1ngr9156vsb.gloss: Chang, Jian two person receive order CONJ go, Zhao again order Hu.Zun COP vanguard, command three route troop go.forward, first build pontoon.bridge, take Dongxing great.dike; if capture DE left.right two city, then COP great.merit.
pmwa1ngr9156vsb.translation: Chang and Jian, the two men, received the order and went off. Zhao also ordered Hu Zun to be the vanguard, to command the three columns of troops and advance: first build a pontoon bridge and take the Dongxing dike. If (they) capture the two cities on the left and right, it will be a great achievement.
pmwa1ngr9156vsb.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|昶、儉二人受令而去，昭又令胡遵為先鋒，總領三路兵前去，先搭浮橋，取東興大堤；若奪得左右二城，便是大功。#1

pmwa1ngr9157ztm.section: 第一百八回　　　丁奉雪中奮短兵　　　孫峻席間施密計
pmwa1ngr9157ztm.text: 丁奉得令，即引三千水兵，分作三十隻船，望東興而來。
pmwa1ngr9157ztm.gloss: Ding.Feng DE order, immediately lead three.thousand naval.troops, divide.into thirty CLF boat, toward Dong.Xing CONJ come.
pmwa1ngr9157ztm.translation: Ding Feng received the order, and immediately led three thousand naval troops, divided into thirty boats, and came heading toward Dongxing.
pmwa1ngr9157ztm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|丁奉得令，即引三千水兵，分作三十隻船，望東興而來。#1

pmwa1ngr9158rp0.section: 第一百八回　　　丁奉雪中奮短兵　　　孫峻席間施密計
pmwa1ngr9158rp0.text: 丁奉曰：「魏以新城為總隘口，若先取得此城，司馬昭破膽矣。」
pmwa1ngr9158rp0.gloss: Ding.Feng say: Wei take Xincheng as main.pass, if first take DE this city, Sima.Zhao break.gall SFP.
pmwa1ngr9158rp0.translation: Ding Feng said: 'Wei treats Xincheng as the main choke point; if (we) first take this city, Sima Zhao will be terrified.'
pmwa1ngr9158rp0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|丁奉曰：「魏以新城為總隘口，若先取得此城，司馬昭破膽矣。」#1

pmwa1ngr915978u.section: 第一百八回　　　丁奉雪中奮短兵　　　孫峻席間施密計
pmwa1ngr915978u.text: 待其將走，然後擊之，必得全勝。
pmwa1ngr915978u.gloss: wait 3PL FUT flee, then attack 3PL.OBJ, certainly DE complete.victory.
pmwa1ngr915978u.translation: Wait until they are about to retreat, then attack them, and (we) will certainly obtain a complete victory.
pmwa1ngr915978u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|待其將走，然後擊之，必得全勝。#1

pmwa1ngr915agig.section: 第一百八回　　　丁奉雪中奮短兵　　　孫峻席間施密計
pmwa1ngr915agig.text: 亮曰：「朕見此人，亦甚恐怖；常欲除之，未得其便。
pmwa1ngr915agig.gloss: Liang say: 1SG see DEM person, also very terrified; often want eliminate 3SG.OBJ, NEG DE 3SG.GEN opportunity.
pmwa1ngr915agig.translation: Liang said: 'When I see this man, I am also very frightened; I have often wanted to get rid of him, but have not found the opportunity.'
pmwa1ngr915agig.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|亮曰：「朕見此人，亦甚恐怖；常欲除之，未得其便。#1

pmwa1ngr915b0jr.section: 第一百八回　　　丁奉雪中奮短兵　　　孫峻席間施密計
pmwa1ngr915b0jr.text: 是夜恪睡臥不安，忽聽得正堂中聲響如霹靂。
pmwa1ngr915b0jr.gloss: that.night Ke sleep.lie NEG peaceful, suddenly hear DE main.hall middle sound like thunderclap
pmwa1ngr915b0jr.translation: That night Ke (Zhuge Ke) slept uneasily, when suddenly he heard a sound in the main hall like a thunderclap.
pmwa1ngr915b0jr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|是夜恪睡臥不安，忽聽得正堂中聲響如霹靂。#1

pmwa1ngr915caxa.section: 第一百八回　　　丁奉雪中奮短兵　　　孫峻席間施密計
pmwa1ngr915caxa.text: 且說姜維在成都，接得諸葛恪書，欲求相助伐魏，遂入朝，奏准後主，復起大兵，北伐中原。
pmwa1ngr915caxa.gloss: moreover say Jiang.Wei at Chengdu, receive DE Zhuge.Ke letter, wish seek mutual.help attack Wei, then enter court, memorialize.and.get.approval.from Later.Ruler, again raise great army, north.campaign Central.Plains.
pmwa1ngr915caxa.translation: Now, turning to Jiang Wei: while in Chengdu, he received Zhuge Ke’s letter and wished to seek mutual help in attacking Wei; thereupon he entered the court, memorialized and obtained the Later Ruler’s approval, again raised a great army, and campaigned north against the Central Plains.
pmwa1ngr915caxa.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|且說姜維在成都，接得諸葛恪書，欲求相助伐魏，遂入朝，奏准後主，復起大兵，北伐中原。#1

pmwa1ngr915dn2e.section: 第一百九回　　　困司馬漢將奇謀　　　廢曹芳魏家果報
pmwa1ngr915dn2e.text: 羌王迷當，得了禮物，便起兵五萬，令羌將俄何燒戈為大先鋒，引兵南安來。
pmwa1ngr915dn2e.gloss: Qiang king Midang, receive DE PFV gift, then raise.troops fifty.thousand, order Qiang general Ehe.Shaoge as great.vanguard, lead.troops Nan'an come.
pmwa1ngr915dn2e.translation: The Qiang king Midang, having received the gifts, then raised fifty thousand troops, ordered the Qiang general Ehe Shaoge to be the chief vanguard, and led the troops to come to Nan'an.
pmwa1ngr915dn2e.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|羌王迷當，得了禮物，便起兵五萬，令羌將俄何燒戈為大先鋒，引兵南安來。#1

pmwa1ngr915e8mu.section: 第一百九回　　　困司馬漢將奇謀　　　廢曹芳魏家果報
pmwa1ngr915e8mu.text: 昭四下無路，只得勒兵上鐵籠山據守：原來此山只有一條路，四下皆險峻難上；其上惟有一泉，止彀百人之飲。
pmwa1ngr915e8mu.gloss: Zhao all.around no.way, only DE lead.troops go.up Iron.Cage.Mountain defend: it.turns.out this mountain only have one CLF road, all.around all steep.rugged difficult ascend; on.it only have one spring, only enough hundred people GEN drink.
pmwa1ngr915e8mu.translation: Zhao had no way out on any side, and had no choice but to lead his troops up Iron Cage Mountain to hold it: it turned out that this mountain had only one road, and on all sides it was steep and difficult to climb; on it there was only one spring, just enough for a hundred people to drink.
pmwa1ngr915e8mu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|昭四下無路，只得勒兵上鐵籠山據守：原來此山只有一條路，四下皆險峻難上；其上惟有一泉，止彀百人之飲。#1

pmwa1ngr915f4bt.section: 第一百九回　　　困司馬漢將奇謀　　　廢曹芳魏家果報
pmwa1ngr915f4bt.text: 主簿王韜改曰：「昔日耿恭受困，拜井而得其泉；將軍何不效之？」
pmwa1ngr915f4bt.gloss: registrar Wang.Tao revise say : former.days Geng.Gong suffer.siege , bow well CONJ DE 3SG spring ; general why.not imitate 3SG ?
pmwa1ngr915f4bt.translation: The registrar Wang Tao revised (his words) and said: 'In former days Geng Gong, when besieged, bowed to the well and obtained its spring; why does the general not imitate him?'
pmwa1ngr915f4bt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|主簿王韜改曰：「昔日耿恭受困，拜井而得其泉；將軍何不效之？」#1

pmwa1ngra15gg0n.section: 第一百九回　　　困司馬漢將奇謀　　　廢曹芳魏家果報
pmwa1ngra15gg0n.text: 俄何燒戈驟馬挺槍入寨之時，只叫得一聲苦，連人帶馬，跌在陷坑裏。
pmwa1ngra15gg0n.gloss: Ehe.Shaoge spur.horse level.spear enter camp GEN time, only cry DE one CLF bitter, along.with person bring horse, fall at trap.pit inside.
pmwa1ngra15gg0n.translation: When Ehe Shaoge spurred his horse and leveled his spear to enter the camp, he could only cry out one "Oh no!"—man and horse together fell into the pit.
pmwa1ngra15gg0n.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|俄何燒戈驟馬挺槍入寨之時，只叫得一聲苦，連人帶馬，跌在陷坑裏。#1

pmwa1ngra15hnrg.section: 第一百九回　　　困司馬漢將奇謀　　　廢曹芳魏家果報
pmwa1ngra15hnrg.text: 維手無器械，腰間止有一副弓箭，走得慌忙，箭皆落了，只有空壼。
pmwa1ngra15hnrg.gloss: Jiang.Wei hand not.have weapon, waist only have one.CLF bow.and.arrow, flee DE hurried, arrow all fall CRS, only.have empty quiver.
pmwa1ngra15hnrg.translation: Wei (Jiang Wei) had no weapon in his hands; at his waist there was only one set of bow and arrows; he fled in such haste that all the arrows dropped out, and (he) had only an empty quiver.
pmwa1ngra15hnrg.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維手無器械，腰間止有一副弓箭，走得慌忙，箭皆落了，只有空壼。#1

pmwa1ngra15ic9d.section: 第一百九回　　　困司馬漢將奇謀　　　廢曹芳魏家果報
pmwa1ngra15ic9d.text: 維下手不及，只掣得淮槍而去。
pmwa1ngra15ic9d.gloss: Jiang.Wei act not.have.time, only snatch DE Guo.Huai spear and.go.
pmwa1ngra15ic9d.translation: Jiang Wei had no time to strike; he only snatched Guo Huai’s spear and left.
pmwa1ngra15ic9d.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維下手不及，只掣得淮槍而去。#1

pmwa1ngra15j6g8.section: 第一百九回　　　困司馬漢將奇謀　　　廢曹芳魏家果報
pmwa1ngra15j6g8.text: 髦曰：「吾亦人臣也，安得不答禮乎？」
pmwa1ngra15j6g8.gloss: Mao say: 1SG also subject.minister SFP, how DE NEG return.salute Q?
pmwa1ngra15j6g8.translation: Mao said, "I too am a subject; how can I not return the salute?"
pmwa1ngra15j6g8.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|髦曰：「吾亦人臣也，安得不答禮乎？」#1

pmwa1ngra15ke4f.section: 第一百十回　　　文鴦單騎退雄兵　　　姜維背水破大敵
pmwa1ngra15ke4f.text: 儉曰：「司馬師專權廢主，天地反覆，安得不傷心乎？」
pmwa1ngra15ke4f.gloss: Jian say: Sima.Shi monopolize.power depose.ruler, heaven.earth turn.over, how DE NEG grieve Q?
pmwa1ngra15ke4f.translation: Jian said, 'Sima Shi monopolizes power and deposes the ruler; heaven and earth are overturned—how could one not be grieved?'
pmwa1ngra15ke4f.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|儉曰：「司馬師專權廢主，天地反覆，安得不傷心乎？」#1

pmwa1ngra15li07.section: 第一百十回　　　文鴦單騎退雄兵　　　姜維背水破大敵
pmwa1ngra15li07.text: 淮南之反，非軍民思亂也；皆因毌丘儉勢力所逼，不得已而從之。
pmwa1ngra15li07.gloss: Huainan GEN rebellion, NEG soldier.people think.of disorder SFP; all because Guanqiu.Jian power P coerce, NEG DE stop CONJ follow 3SG.OBJ.
pmwa1ngra15li07.translation: The rebellion in Huainan was not because the soldiers and people wanted disorder; it was entirely because they were coerced by Guanqiu Jian's power, and having no alternative they followed him.
pmwa1ngra15li07.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|淮南之反，非軍民思亂也；皆因毌丘儉勢力所逼，不得已而從之。#1

pmwa1ngra15mtcn.section: 第一百十回　　　文鴦單騎退雄兵　　　姜維背水破大敵
pmwa1ngra15mtcn.text: 鴦直殺到天明，只聽得北邊鼓角喧天。
pmwa1ngra15mtcn.gloss: Yang straight fight arrive dawn, only hear DE north side drum.horn clamor.to.sky.
pmwa1ngra15mtcn.translation: Yang fought straight on until dawn, and only heard drums and horns from the north resounding to the sky.
pmwa1ngra15mtcn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|鴦直殺到天明，只聽得北邊鼓角喧天。#1

pmwa1ngra15nk34.section: 第一百十回　　　文鴦單騎退雄兵　　　姜維背水破大敵
pmwa1ngra15nk34.text: 師遺言曰：「吾今權重，雖欲卸肩，不可得也。
pmwa1ngra15nk34.gloss: Shi leave word say: 1SG now power heavy, though wish unload shoulder, NEG can DE SFP.
pmwa1ngra15nk34.translation: Shi left these parting words: "I now hold great power; though I wish to lay down the burden, it cannot be done.
pmwa1ngra15nk34.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|師遺言曰：「吾今權重，雖欲卸肩，不可得也。#1

pmwa1ngra15ows1.section: 第一百十回　　　文鴦單騎退雄兵　　　姜維背水破大敵
pmwa1ngra15ows1.text: 若得洮西、南安，則諸郡可定。」
pmwa1ngra15ows1.gloss: if DE Tao.West, Nan'an, then all commandery can settle
pmwa1ngra15ows1.translation: If (we) get Tao West and Nan'an, then the various commanderies can be settled.
pmwa1ngra15ows1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若得洮西、南安，則諸郡可定。」#1

pmwa1ngra15ptdn.section: 第一百十回　　　文鴦單騎退雄兵　　　姜維背水破大敵
pmwa1ngra15ptdn.text: 向者兵敗，尚欲進取，縱橫中原；今日洮水一戰，魏人膽裂，吾料狄道唾手可得，汝勿自墮其志也。」
pmwa1ngra15ptdn.gloss: formerly troops defeated, still want advance.take, overrun Central.Plains; today Tao.River one battle, Wei.people gall.split, 1SG reckon Didao spit.hand can DE obtain, 2SG PROH self cast.down 2SG ambition SFP.
pmwa1ngra15ptdn.translation: Formerly, when the army was defeated, I still wanted to advance and overrun the Central Plains; today, in one battle at the Tao River, the Wei men are terrified out of their wits. I reckon Didao can be taken easily; you must not cast down your own resolve.
pmwa1ngra15ptdn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|向者兵敗，尚欲進取，縱橫中原；今日洮水一戰，魏人膽裂，吾料狄道唾手可得，汝勿自墮其志也。」#1

pmwa1ngra15q56u.section: 第一百十回　　　文鴦單騎退雄兵　　　姜維背水破大敵
pmwa1ngra15q56u.text: 艾曰：「洮水得勝，若招羌人之眾，東爭關隴，傳檄四郡，此吾兵之大患也。
pmwa1ngra15q56u.gloss: Deng.Ai say: Tao.River DE win, if recruit Qiang people GEN masses, east contend Guan.Long, circulate call.to.arms four commandery, PROX 1PL army GEN great calamity COP.
pmwa1ngra15q56u.translation: Deng Ai said: "If, having won victory at the Tao River, (they) recruit the hosts of the Qiang, contend eastward for Guan and Long, and send a call to arms around the four commanderies, this will be a great scourge for our army.
pmwa1ngra15q56u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|艾曰：「洮水得勝，若招羌人之眾，東爭關隴，傳檄四郡，此吾兵之大患也。#1

pmwa1ngra15rf3q.section: 第一百十回　　　文鴦單騎退雄兵　　　姜維背水破大敵
pmwa1ngra15rf3q.text: 維自斷後，只聽得背後鼓聲不絕。
pmwa1ngra15rf3q.gloss: Jiang.Wei personally bring.up.rear, only hear DE behind drum.sound NEG cease.
pmwa1ngra15rf3q.translation: Jiang Wei himself brought up the rear, and only heard the drumbeats behind him continue without cease.
pmwa1ngra15rf3q.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維自斷後，只聽得背後鼓聲不絕。#1

pmwa1ngra15suz6.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra15suz6.text: 維曰：「汝等只知魏國地寬人廣，急不可得；卻不知攻魏者有五可勝。」
pmwa1ngra15suz6.gloss: Jiang.Wei said: you.PL only know Wei.state land broad people numerous, urgent NEG can DE; but NEG know attack Wei NMLZ have five can win.
pmwa1ngra15suz6.translation: Jiang Wei said: “You only know that Wei has broad territory and a large population, and that it cannot be taken quickly; but you do not know that in attacking Wei there are five ways to win.”
pmwa1ngra15suz6.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維曰：「汝等只知魏國地寬人廣，急不可得；卻不知攻魏者有五可勝。」#1

pmwa1ngra15tm7w.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra15tm7w.text: 卻說姜維從董亭望南安而來，至武城山前，謂夏侯霸曰：「近南安有一山，名武城山；若先得了，可奪南安之勢。
pmwa1ngra15tm7w.gloss: now.say Jiang.Wei from Dong.Ting toward Nan.An come, arrive Wucheng.Mountain front, say.to Xiahou.Ba say: near Nan.An have one mountain, name Wucheng.Mountain; if first DE PFV, can seize Nan.An GEN strategic.advantage.
pmwa1ngra15tm7w.translation: Now, to speak of Jiang Wei: coming from Dongting toward Nan'an, when he arrived before Wucheng Mountain, he said to Xiahou Ba: Near Nan'an there is a mountain named Wucheng Mountain; if (we) first obtain it, (we) can seize the strategic advantage of Nan'an.
pmwa1ngra15tm7w.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說姜維從董亭望南安而來，至武城山前，謂夏侯霸曰：「近南安有一山，名武城山；若先得了，可奪南安之勢。#1

pmwa1ngra15usk9.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra15usk9.text: 維欲上山衝殺，山上砲石甚嚴，不能得進。
pmwa1ngra15usk9.gloss: Jiang.Wei want ascend mountain charge kill, mountain on catapult.stone very severe, NEG can DE advance.
pmwa1ngra15usk9.translation: Jiang Wei wanted to charge up the mountain and kill (the enemy), but the catapult stones on the mountain were very fierce, and he could not get forward.
pmwa1ngra15usk9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維欲上山衝殺，山上砲石甚嚴，不能得進。#1

pmwa1ngra15vfy9.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra15vfy9.text: 維復引兵退，再與夏侯霸商議曰：「南安未得，不如先取上邽。
pmwa1ngra15vfy9.gloss: Wei again lead troops retreat, again with Xiahou.Ba discuss say: Nan'an not.yet DE, not.as.good first take Shanggui.
pmwa1ngra15vfy9.translation: Jiang Wei again led his troops in retreat, and once more took counsel with Xiahou Ba, saying: “We have not yet obtained Nan’an; it would be better to first take Shanggui.”
pmwa1ngra15vfy9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維復引兵退，再與夏侯霸商議曰：「南安未得，不如先取上邽。#1

pmwa1ngra15wwpo.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra15wwpo.text: 上邽乃南安屯糧之所；若得上邽，南安自危矣。」
pmwa1ngra15wwpo.gloss: Shanggui COP Nan'an store.grain ATTR place; if DE Shanggui, Nan'an self danger CRS.
pmwa1ngra15wwpo.translation: Shanggui is the place where Nan'an stores its grain; if we obtain Shanggui, Nan'an will naturally be in danger.
pmwa1ngra15wwpo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|上邽乃南安屯糧之所；若得上邽，南安自危矣。」#1

pmwa1ngra15xm2y.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra15xm2y.text: 幸得夏侯霸引兵殺到，魏兵方退，救了姜維，欲再往祁山。
pmwa1ngra15xm2y.gloss: fortunately DE Xiahou.Ba lead troops charge.arrive, Wei troops only.then retreat, rescue PFV Jiang.Wei, wish again go Qishan.
pmwa1ngra15xm2y.translation: Fortunately Xiahou Ba led troops and charged in; only then did the Wei troops retreat. (They) rescued Jiang Wei, and (he) wanted to go to Qishan again.
pmwa1ngra15xm2y.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|幸得夏侯霸引兵殺到，魏兵方退，救了姜維，欲再往祁山。#1

pmwa1ngra15y1pt.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra15y1pt.text: 維人馬困乏，左衝右突，不能得出。
pmwa1ngra15y1pt.gloss: Jiang.Wei troops exhausted, left charge right dash, NEG can DE break.out
pmwa1ngra15y1pt.translation: Jiang Wei's troops were exhausted; they charged left and right but could not break out.
pmwa1ngra15y1pt.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維人馬困乏，左衝右突，不能得出。#1

pmwa1ngra15zfwe.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra15zfwe.text: 維得脫重圍，復回漢中；因感張嶷忠勇，歿於王事，乃表贈其子孫。
pmwa1ngra15zfwe.gloss: Wei DE escape heavy.encirclement, again return Hanzhong; because moved Zhang.Yi loyal.brave, die in royal.service, then memorialize bestow 3SG.GEN descendants.
pmwa1ngra15zfwe.translation: Jiang Wei managed to break out of the heavy encirclement and made his way back to Hanzhong; because he was moved by Zhang Yi's loyalty and bravery—(Zhang Yi) having died in the king's service—he submitted a memorial to bestow (benefits) on his descendants.
pmwa1ngra15zfwe.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維得脫重圍，復回漢中；因感張嶷忠勇，歿於王事，乃表贈其子孫。#1

pmwa1ngra160gst.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra160gst.text: 誕字公休，乃瑯琊南陽人，即武侯之族弟也；向事於魏，因武侯在蜀為相，因此不得重用；後武侯身亡，誕在魏歷任重職，封高平侯，總攝兩淮軍馬。
pmwa1ngra160gst.gloss: Dan courtesy.name Gongxiu, COP Langya Nanyang person, COP Marquis.Wu GEN clan.younger.brother SFP; formerly serve at Wei, because Marquis.Wu at Shu act.as chancellor, because.this NEG DE important.use; later Marquis.Wu body die, Dan at Wei successively hold important.post, enfeoff Gaoping.Marquis, command all two.Huai army.horse.
pmwa1ngra160gst.translation: Dan, courtesy name Gongxiu, was a man of Nanyang in Langya, namely a clansman younger brother of Marquis Wu; formerly he served in Wei, but because Marquis Wu was serving as chancellor in Shu, for this reason he was not given important employment; later, after Marquis Wu died, Dan in Wei successively held important posts, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Gaoping, and commanded all the troops of the two Huai regions.
pmwa1ngra160gst.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|誕字公休，乃瑯琊南陽人，即武侯之族弟也；向事於魏，因武侯在蜀為相，因此不得重用；後武侯身亡，誕在魏歷任重職，封高平侯，總攝兩淮軍馬。#1

pmwa1ngra161rs2.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra161rs2.text: 充曰：「誕在淮南，深得人心，久必為患，可速除之。」
pmwa1ngra161rs2.gloss: Chong say: Dan at Huainan, deep DE people.heart, long surely become danger, can quickly remove OBJ.
pmwa1ngra161rs2.translation: Chong said: Dan is in Huainan and has deeply won the people's hearts; in the long run he will surely become a danger. (We) can quickly remove him.
pmwa1ngra161rs2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|充曰：「誕在淮南，深得人心，久必為患，可速除之。」#1

pmwa1ngra1625wz.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra1625wz.text: 誕得了詔書，已知是賈充告變，遂捉來使拷問，使者曰：「此事樂綝知之。」
pmwa1ngra1625wz.gloss: Dan DE PFV edict, already know COP Jia.Chong report.rebellion, then seize incoming.envoy interrogate.under.torture, envoy say: this matter Yue.Lin know 3SG.
pmwa1ngra1625wz.translation: Dan received the edict and already knew that it was Jia Chong who had reported the rebellion, so he seized the envoy who had come and interrogated him under torture. The envoy said, 'Yue Lin knows about this matter.'
pmwa1ngra1625wz.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|誕得了詔書，已知是賈充告變，遂捉來使拷問，使者曰：「此事樂綝知之。」#1

pmwa1ngra163b55.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra163b55.translation: Dan said, "How did he get to know (about this)?"
pmwa1ngra163b55.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|誕曰：「他如何得知？」#1

pmwa1ngra1643kw.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra1643kw.translation: The Empress Dowager was afraid, and had no choice but to go along with it.
pmwa1ngra1643kw.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|太后畏懼，只得從之。#1

pmwa1ngra165yb7.section: 第一百十一回　　鄧士載智取姜伯約　　諸葛誕義討司馬昭
pmwa1ngra165yb7.gloss: Mao fear authority.power, only DE follow 3SG
pmwa1ngra165yb7.translation: Cao Mao feared his authority and power, and had no choice but to comply.
pmwa1ngra165yb7.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|髦畏威權，只得從之。#1

pmwa1ngra1666mu.section: 第一百十二回　　救壽春于詮死節　　　取長城伯約鏖兵
pmwa1ngra1666mu.text: 魏兵不得將令，未敢輕敵，任吳兵入城，乃報知司馬昭。
pmwa1ngra1666mu.gloss: Wei soldier NEG DE general.order, NEG dare underestimate.enemy, allow Wu soldier enter city, then report.inform Sima.Zhao.
pmwa1ngra1666mu.translation: The Wei troops, not having received the general's order, did not dare to underestimate the enemy and allowed the Wu troops to enter the city; then they reported it to Sima Zhao.
pmwa1ngra1666mu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|魏兵不得將令，未敢輕敵，任吳兵入城，乃報知司馬昭。#1

pmwa1ngrb167psh.section: 第一百十二回　　救壽春于詮死節　　　取長城伯約鏖兵
pmwa1ngrb167psh.text: 又責全端子全禕曰：「若退不得魏兵，汝父子休來見我！」
pmwa1ngrb167psh.gloss: again reprimand Quan.Duan son Quan.Yi say: if repel NEG DE Wei troops, 2SG father.son PROH come see 1SG!
pmwa1ngrb167psh.translation: He also reprimanded Quan Duan's son Quan Yi, saying: “If (you) cannot repel the Wei troops, you and your father are not to come see me!”
pmwa1ngrb167psh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|又責全端子全禕曰：「若退不得魏兵，汝父子休來見我！」#1

pmwa1ngrb168z38.section: 第一百十二回　　救壽春于詮死節　　　取長城伯約鏖兵
pmwa1ngrb168z38.text: 懌得禕書，遂與端引數千人開門出降。
pmwa1ngrb168z38.gloss: Quan.Yi DE Quan.Yi letter, then with Duan lead several.thousand people open gate come.out.surrender.
pmwa1ngrb168z38.translation: Quan Yi (the uncle) received the letter from Quan Yi (the nephew), and then, together with Duan, led several thousand men to open the gate and come out to surrender.
pmwa1ngrb168z38.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|懌得禕書，遂與端引數千人開門出降。#1

pmwa1ngrb1696wu.section: 第一百十二回　　救壽春于詮死節　　　取長城伯約鏖兵
pmwa1ngrb1696wu.text: 城中看看糧盡，文欽在小城內與二子堅守，見軍士漸漸餓倒，只得來告誕曰：「糧草盡絕，軍士餓損，不如將北方之兵盡放出城，以省其食。」
pmwa1ngrb1696wu.gloss: city inside soon provisions exhausted, Wen.Qin at small city inside with two sons hold.firm, see soldiers gradually starve.collapse, only DE come tell Dan say: provisions completely.exhausted, soldiers starve.weaken, better BA north GEN troops all release out city, in.order.to save their food.
pmwa1ngrb1696wu.translation: Inside the city, provisions were nearly exhausted. Wen Qin, inside the small city, held firm with his two sons. Seeing the soldiers gradually collapsing from hunger, he had no choice but to come and tell Dan: “The provisions are completely exhausted, and the soldiers are starving and weakened; it would be better to release all the northern troops out of the city, in order to save their food.”
pmwa1ngrb1696wu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|城中看看糧盡，文欽在小城內與二子堅守，見軍士漸漸餓倒，只得來告誕曰：「糧草盡絕，軍士餓損，不如將北方之兵盡放出城，以省其食。」#1

pmwa1ngrb16a24s.section: 第一百十二回　　救壽春于詮死節　　　取長城伯約鏖兵
pmwa1ngrb16a24s.text: 乃擲盔於地，大呼曰：「人生在世，得死於戰場者，幸耳！」
pmwa1ngrb16a24s.gloss: then throw helmet at ground, loudly shout say: person live in world, DE die at battlefield NMLZ, fortunate SFP!
pmwa1ngrb16a24s.translation: Thereupon he threw his helmet to the ground and shouted loudly: “For a person living in this world, to be able to die on the battlefield is fortunate indeed!”
pmwa1ngrb16a24s.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|乃擲盔於地，大呼曰：「人生在世，得死於戰場者，幸耳！」#1

pmwa1ngrb16b463.section: 第一百十二回　　救壽春于詮死節　　　取長城伯約鏖兵
pmwa1ngrb16b463.text: 度沈嶺，直到長城，先燒糧草，然後直取秦川，則中原指日可得矣。」
pmwa1ngrb16b463.gloss: cross Shen.Ridge, straight.to Long.Wall, first burn grain.and.forage, then directly.take Qin.Chuan, CONJ Central.Plain in.a.few.days can DE SFP
pmwa1ngrb16b463.translation: Cross Shen Ridge, go straight to the Long Wall, first burn the grain and forage, then directly take Qinchuan; then the Central Plains can be obtained in a few days.
pmwa1ngrb16b463.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|度沈嶺，直到長城，先燒糧草，然後直取秦川，則中原指日可得矣。」#1

pmwa1ngrb16crdr.section: 第一百十二回　　救壽春于詮死節　　　取長城伯約鏖兵
pmwa1ngrb16crdr.text: 僉故意放慢，等李鵬將近，努力擲真於地，暗製四楞鐵簡在手；鵬趕上舉刀待砍，傅僉偷身回顧，向李鵬面門只一簡，打得眼珠迸出，死於馬下。
pmwa1ngrb16crdr.gloss: Fu.Qian deliberately slow.down, wait Li.Peng about.to near, exert.strength throw Wang.Zhen at ground, secretly prepare four.cornered iron.mace at hand; Li.Peng catch.up raise knife wait chop, Fu.Qian stealthily turn.body look.back, toward Li.Peng face only one mace, hit DE eyeball burst.out, die at horse.under.
pmwa1ngrb16crdr.translation: Fu Qian deliberately slowed down; when Li Peng came near, he exerted himself and flung Wang Zhen to the ground, secretly readying a four-edged iron mace in his hand. Li Peng caught up and raised his sword to strike; Fu Qian stealthily twisted his body to look back, and with just one blow of the mace at Li Peng’s face, struck him so that his eyeballs burst out, and he died beneath his horse.
pmwa1ngrb16crdr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|僉故意放慢，等李鵬將近，努力擲真於地，暗製四楞鐵簡在手；鵬趕上舉刀待砍，傅僉偷身回顧，向李鵬面門只一簡，打得眼珠迸出，死於馬下。#1

pmwa1ngrb16db2i.section: 第一百十二回　　救壽春于詮死節　　　取長城伯約鏖兵
pmwa1ngrb16db2i.text: 只見魏陣中一小將全裝貫帶，挺槍縱馬而出，年約二十餘歲，面如傅粉，脣似抹硃，厲聲大叫曰：「認得鄧將軍否！」
pmwa1ngrb16db2i.gloss: only see Wei formation middle one young.general full.armor belt, level spear gallop horse and out, age about twenty odd year, face like apply powder, lips like smear vermilion, stern.voice loud.shout say: recognize-DE Deng general Q!
pmwa1ngrb16db2i.translation: He saw a young general in the Wei ranks, in full armor and belt, leveling his spear and galloping out on horseback, about twenty-odd years old, face like applied powder, lips like smeared vermilion, shouting loudly in a stern voice: “Do you recognize General Deng?”
pmwa1ngrb16db2i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只見魏陣中一小將全裝貫帶，挺槍縱馬而出，年約二十餘歲，面如傅粉，脣似抹硃，厲聲大叫曰：「認得鄧將軍否！」#1

pmwa1ngrb16eqmu.section: 第一百十二回　　救壽春于詮死節　　　取長城伯約鏖兵
pmwa1ngrb16eqmu.text: 維心中自思：「不用此計，安得勝乎？」
pmwa1ngrb16eqmu.gloss: Wei heart.in self.think: NEG use PROX stratagem, how DE win Q?
pmwa1ngrb16eqmu.translation: Jiang Wei thought to himself: "If I do not use this stratagem, how can I win?"
pmwa1ngrb16eqmu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維心中自思：「不用此計，安得勝乎？」#1

pmwa1ngrb16f94d.section: 第一百十三回　　丁奉定計斬孫綝　　　姜維鬥陣破鄧艾
pmwa1ngrb16f94d.text: 比及平明，吳主孫亮聽得宮門外金鼓大震。
pmwa1ngrb16f94d.gloss: by.the.time dawn, Wu.ruler Sun.Liang hear DE palace.gate.outside gong.drum greatly.resound
pmwa1ngrb16f94d.translation: By the time it was dawn, the Wu ruler Sun Liang heard the gongs and drums outside the palace gate sounding loudly.
pmwa1ngrb16f94d.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|比及平明，吳主孫亮聽得宮門外金鼓大震。#1

pmwa1ngrb16gx4z.section: 第一百十三回　　丁奉定計斬孫綝　　　姜維鬥陣破鄧艾
pmwa1ngrb16gx4z.text: 可憐聰明主，不得蒞朝堂。
pmwa1ngrb16gx4z.gloss: pitiable clever ruler, NEG DE attend court.hall.
pmwa1ngrb16gx4z.translation: Pity the clever ruler, (who) cannot attend the court hall.
pmwa1ngrb16gx4z.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|可憐聰明主，不得蒞朝堂。#1

pmwa1ngrb16hvkh.section: 第一百十三回　　丁奉定計斬孫綝　　　姜維鬥陣破鄧艾
pmwa1ngrb16hvkh.text: 姜維聽得此信，忻然上表，再議出師伐魏。
pmwa1ngrb16hvkh.gloss: Jiang.Wei hear DE this news, joyfully submit.memorial, again discuss send.troops attack.Wei.
pmwa1ngrb16hvkh.translation: Jiang Wei heard this news, joyfully submitted a memorial, and again discussed sending troops to attack Wei.
pmwa1ngrb16hvkh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|姜維聽得此信，忻然上表，再議出師伐魏。#1

pmwa1ngrb16i7h9.section: 第一百十三回　　丁奉定計斬孫綝　　　姜維鬥陣破鄧艾
pmwa1ngrb16i7h9.text: 姜維在帳中聽得左寨中大喊，料道有內應外合之兵，遂急上馬，立於中軍帳前，傳令曰：「如有妄動者斬，便有敵兵到營邊，休要問他，只管以弓弩射之！」
pmwa1ngrb16i7h9.gloss: Jiang.Wei at tent inside hear DE left.camp inside loudly.shout, reckon have inside.respond outside.join ATTR troops, then hastily mount.horse, stand at central.army tent front, issue.order say: if have reckless.act NMLZ behead, even.if have enemy.troops arrive camp.edge, PROH ask 3SG, just with bow.crossbow shoot 3SG!
pmwa1ngrb16i7h9.translation: Jiang Wei, in the tent, heard loud shouting in the left camp and judged that there were troops cooperating from within and without; he then hastily mounted his horse, stood before the central army tent, and issued an order: 'If anyone acts rashly, behead him. Even if enemy troops reach the edge of the camp, do not question them; just shoot them with bows and crossbows!'
pmwa1ngrb16i7h9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|姜維在帳中聽得左寨中大喊，料道有內應外合之兵，遂急上馬，立於中軍帳前，傳令曰：「如有妄動者斬，便有敵兵到營邊，休要問他，只管以弓弩射之！」#1

pmwa1ngrb16jk9g.section: 第一百十三回　　丁奉定計斬孫綝　　　姜維鬥陣破鄧艾
pmwa1ngrb16jk9g.text: 鄧艾收兵回寨，乃歎曰：「姜維深得孔明之法！
pmwa1ngrb16jk9g.gloss: Deng.Ai gather.troops return.camp, then sigh say: Jiang.Wei deeply DE Kongming GEN method!
pmwa1ngrb16jk9g.translation: Deng Ai withdrew his troops and returned to camp, then sighed and said: “Jiang Wei has deeply grasped Kongming’s methods!”
pmwa1ngrb16jk9g.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|鄧艾收兵回寨，乃歎曰：「姜維深得孔明之法！#1

pmwa1ngrb16kgtl.section: 第一百十三回　　丁奉定計斬孫綝　　　姜維鬥陣破鄧艾
pmwa1ngrb16kgtl.text: 只聽得蜀兵齊叫曰：「鄧艾早降！」
pmwa1ngrb16kgtl.gloss: only hear DE Shu.soldiers unison shout say Deng.Ai early surrender!
pmwa1ngrb16kgtl.translation: Only hearing the Shu soldiers shout in unison, "Deng Ai, surrender early!"
pmwa1ngrb16kgtl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只聽得蜀兵齊叫曰：「鄧艾早降！」#1

pmwa1ngrb16lymk.section: 第一百十三回　　丁奉定計斬孫綝　　　姜維鬥陣破鄧艾
pmwa1ngrb16lymk.text: 艾謝曰：「我雖學得陣法，實不知變法。
pmwa1ngrb16lymk.gloss: Ai thank say: 1SG although learn DE formation.method, in.fact NEG know variation.method.
pmwa1ngrb16lymk.translation: Ai thanked (him) and said, "Although I have learned the formation methods, I actually do not know their variations."
pmwa1ngrb16lymk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|艾謝曰：「我雖學得陣法，實不知變法。#1

pmwa1ngrb16mhkh.section: 第一百十三回　　丁奉定計斬孫綝　　　姜維鬥陣破鄧艾
pmwa1ngrb16mhkh.text: 維不知何事，只得班師回朝。
pmwa1ngrb16mhkh.gloss: Wei NEG know what matter, only DE withdraw.troops return court.
pmwa1ngrb16mhkh.translation: Wei did not know what the matter was, and had no choice but to withdraw his troops and return to court.
pmwa1ngrb16mhkh.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維不知何事，只得班師回朝。#1

pmwa1ngrb16nmdf.section: 第一百十四回　　曹髦驅車死南闕　　　姜維棄糧勝魏兵
pmwa1ngrb16nmdf.text: 張翼曰：「蜀人為大將軍連年動兵，皆有怨望；不如乘此得勝之時，收回人馬，以安民心，再作良圖。」
pmwa1ngrb16nmdf.gloss: Zhang.Yi say: Shu.people because Great.General successive.years mobilize.troops, all have resentment; not.as.good.as take.advantage.of PROX win DE victory ATTR time, withdraw troops.and.horses, in.order.to pacify people.heart, then make good.plan.
pmwa1ngrb16nmdf.translation: Zhang Yi said: “The people of Shu all harbor resentment because the Great General has been mobilizing troops year after year; it would be better to take advantage of this victory to withdraw the troops and horses, so as to pacify the people’s hearts, and then make further plans.”
pmwa1ngrb16nmdf.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張翼曰：「蜀人為大將軍連年動兵，皆有怨望；不如乘此得勝之時，收回人馬，以安民心，再作良圖。」#1

pmwa1ngrb16o91k.section: 第一百十四回　　曹髦驅車死南闕　　　姜維棄糧勝魏兵
pmwa1ngrb16o91k.text: 艾歎曰：「姜維深得武侯之法也！」
pmwa1ngrb16o91k.gloss: Ai sigh say: Jiang.Wei deep DE Wu.Hou of method also.
pmwa1ngrb16o91k.translation: Deng Ai sighed and said, "Jiang Wei truly grasps the methods of the Martial Marquis!"
pmwa1ngrb16o91k.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|艾歎曰：「姜維深得武侯之法也！」#1

pmwa1ngrb16pfv9.section: 第一百十四回　　曹髦驅車死南闕　　　姜維棄糧勝魏兵
pmwa1ngrb16pfv9.text: 維曰：「臣已得祁山之寨，正欲收功，不期半途而廢。
pmwa1ngrb16pfv9.gloss: Wei say: 1SG already DE Qi.Mountain GEN camp, just want complete merit, unexpectedly halfway CONJ abandon.
pmwa1ngrb16pfv9.translation: Jiang Wei said: "I have already taken the camp at Qishan and was just about to complete the achievement, but unexpectedly (it) was abandoned halfway."
pmwa1ngrb16pfv9.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維曰：「臣已得祁山之寨，正欲收功，不期半途而廢。#1

pmwa1ngrb16q22i.section: 第一百十四回　　曹髦驅車死南闕　　　姜維棄糧勝魏兵
pmwa1ngrb16q22i.text: 昭厲聲曰：「吾父子兄弟三人有大功於魏，今為晉公，得毋不宜耶？」
pmwa1ngrb16q22i.gloss: Zhao stern.voice say : 1PL father.son brothers three person have great.merit toward Wei , now become Duke.of.Jin , DE NEG NEG fitting Q ?
pmwa1ngrb16q22i.translation: Zhao said in a stern voice: 'We three—my father, my brother, and I—have great merit toward Wei; now that I am Duke of Jin, is there anything improper about it?'
pmwa1ngrb16q22i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|昭厲聲曰：「吾父子兄弟三人有大功於魏，今為晉公，得毋不宜耶？」#1

pmwa1ngrb16rjzb.section: 第一百十四回　　曹髦驅車死南闕　　　姜維棄糧勝魏兵
pmwa1ngrb16rjzb.text: 不旬日，果然伏兵捉得王瓘回報鄧艾下書人來見。
pmwa1ngrb16rjzb.gloss: not ten.days, as.expected ambush.troops capture DE Wang.Guan report.back Deng.Ai messenger come see
pmwa1ngrb16rjzb.translation: Within ten days, sure enough, the ambush troops captured Wang Guan's messenger, who was on his way to report back to Deng Ai, and brought (him) to see (Jiang Wei).
pmwa1ngrb16rjzb.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|不旬日，果然伏兵捉得王瓘回報鄧艾下書人來見。#1

pmwa1ngrb16s6yu.section: 第一百十四回　　曹髦驅車死南闕　　　姜維棄糧勝魏兵
pmwa1ngrb16s6yu.text: 卻說鄧艾得了王瓘書信，大喜，急寫回書，令來人回報。
pmwa1ngrb16s6yu.gloss: now Deng.Ai DE PFV Wang.Guan letter, greatly.rejoice, hurriedly write reply.letter, order messenger report.back.
pmwa1ngrb16s6yu.translation: Now, Deng Ai received Wang Guan's letter and was overjoyed; he hurriedly wrote a reply and ordered the messenger to return and report.
pmwa1ngrb16s6yu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說鄧艾得了王瓘書信，大喜，急寫回書，令來人回報。#1

pmwa1ngrb16te5d.section: 第一百十四回　　曹髦驅車死南闕　　　姜維棄糧勝魏兵
pmwa1ngrb16te5d.text: 只聽得山後吶喊，只道王瓘在山後廝殺。
pmwa1ngrb16te5d.gloss: only hear DE mountain behind battle.cry, assume Wang.Guan at mountain behind fight
pmwa1ngrb16te5d.translation: (He) only heard battle cries behind the mountain, and thought that Wang Guan was fighting behind the mountain.
pmwa1ngrb16te5d.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|只聽得山後吶喊，只道王瓘在山後廝殺。#1

pmwa1ngrb16u9bl.section: 第一百十四回　　曹髦驅車死南闕　　　姜維棄糧勝魏兵
pmwa1ngrb16u9bl.text: 兩勢下蜀兵盡出，殺得魏兵七斷八續，但聞山下山上只叫：「拏住鄧艾的，賞千金，封萬戶侯！」
pmwa1ngrb16u9bl.gloss: both.sides Shu.soldiers all come.out, kill DE Wei.soldiers seven.broken.eight.continued, only hear mountain.foot mountain.top only shout: capture Deng.Ai NMLZ, reward thousand.gold, enfeoff ten.thousand.household.marquis!
pmwa1ngrb16u9bl.translation: The Shu troops all came out from both sides and cut the Wei troops into scattered fragments; all that could be heard was shouting from the foot and the top of the mountain: 'Whoever captures Deng Ai: a reward of a thousand gold, enfeoffment as a marquis of ten thousand households!'
pmwa1ngrb16u9bl.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|兩勢下蜀兵盡出，殺得魏兵七斷八續，但聞山下山上只叫：「拏住鄧艾的，賞千金，封萬戶侯！」#1

pmwa1ngrb16vlgj.section: 第一百十四回　　曹髦驅車死南闕　　　姜維棄糧勝魏兵
pmwa1ngrb16vlgj.text: 嚇得鄧艾棄甲丟盔，撇了坐下馬，雜在步軍之中，爬山越嶺而逃。
pmwa1ngrb16vlgj.gloss: frighten DE Deng.Ai abandon armor throw helmet, cast.aside PFV mount, mingle at infantry GEN middle, climb mountain cross ridge CONJ flee.
pmwa1ngrb16vlgj.translation: Deng Ai was so frightened that he abandoned his armor and threw away his helmet, left his mount, mingled among the infantry, and climbed mountains and crossed ridges to flee.
pmwa1ngrb16vlgj.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|嚇得鄧艾棄甲丟盔，撇了坐下馬，雜在步軍之中，爬山越嶺而逃。#1

pmwa1ngrb16wkpq.section: 第一百十四回　　曹髦驅車死南闕　　　姜維棄糧勝魏兵
pmwa1ngrb16wkpq.text: 姜維、夏侯霸只望馬上為首的逕來捉擒，不想鄧艾步行走脫，維領得勝兵去接王瓘糧車。
pmwa1ngrb16wkpq.gloss: Jiang.Wei, Xiahou.Ba only aim.at on.horseback be.head NMLZ directly come capture, NEG expect Deng.Ai on.foot escape, Wei lead DE victory troops go receive Wang.Guan grain.cart.
pmwa1ngrb16wkpq.translation: Jiang Wei and Xiahou Ba only aimed at the leader on horseback and came straight to capture him; they did not expect that Deng Ai would escape on foot. Wei led the victorious troops to go receive Wang Guan's grain carts.
pmwa1ngrb16wkpq.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|姜維、夏侯霸只望馬上為首的逕來捉擒，不想鄧艾步行走脫，維領得勝兵去接王瓘糧車。#1

pmwa1ngrc16xp3x.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc16xp3x.text: 艾曰：「向者姜維累出吾有糧之地，今洮陽無糧，維必料吾只守祁山，不守洮陽，故逕取洮陽：如得此城，屯糧積草，結連羌人，以圖久計耳。」
pmwa1ngrc16xp3x.gloss: Ai say: previously Jiang.Wei repeatedly go.out 1PL have grain ATTR place, now Taoyang not.have grain, Wei must expect 1PL only defend Qishan, NEG defend Taoyang, therefore directly take Taoyang: if DE this city, store.grain pile.fodder, connect Qiang.people, in.order.to plan long.term.plan SFP
pmwa1ngrc16xp3x.translation: Ai said: 'Previously Jiang Wei repeatedly came out against places where we had grain. Now Taoyang has no grain; Wei will surely reckon that we are only defending Qishan and not defending Taoyang, so he is directly taking Taoyang. If he gets this city, stores grain and piles fodder, and links up with the Qiang people, it is in order to make long-term plans, that is all.'
pmwa1ngrc16xp3x.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|艾曰：「向者姜維累出吾有糧之地，今洮陽無糧，維必料吾只守祁山，不守洮陽，故逕取洮陽：如得此城，屯糧積草，結連羌人，以圖久計耳。」#1

pmwa1ngrc16ysl0.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc16ysl0.text: 諸將曰：「眼見得是空城，只有些小百姓，聽知大將軍兵到，盡棄城而走了。」
pmwa1ngrc16ysl0.gloss: all.generals say : eye.see DE COP empty city , only have some small.commoners , hear.know great.general troops arrive , all abandon city CONJ flee CRS .
pmwa1ngrc16ysl0.translation: All the generals said, “It is plain to see that it is an empty city; there are only some ordinary commoners, and hearing that the Great General’s troops have arrived, they have all abandoned the city and fled.”
pmwa1ngrc16ysl0.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|諸將曰：「眼見得是空城，只有些小百姓，聽知大將軍兵到，盡棄城而走了。」#1

pmwa1ngrc16zkpm.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc16zkpm.text: 維左衝右突，死戰得脫，退二十餘里下寨。
pmwa1ngrc16zkpm.gloss: Wei left charge right dash, fight.to.death DE escape, retreat twenty.odd li pitch.camp.
pmwa1ngrc16zkpm.translation: Jiang Wei charged left and right, fought desperately and managed to escape, retreated more than twenty li, and pitched camp.
pmwa1ngrc16zkpm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維左衝右突，死戰得脫，退二十餘里下寨。#1

pmwa1ngrc170i8p.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc170i8p.text: 是夜二更，姜維正在寨中設計，忽聽得寨外喊聲震地，鼓角喧天：人報鄧艾引三千精兵夜戰，諸將欲出。
pmwa1ngrc170i8p.gloss: that.night second.watch, Jiang.Wei just.at camp inside devise plan, suddenly hear DE camp outside shout sound shake ground, drum horn clamor sky: person report Deng.Ai lead three.thousand elite.soldier night.fight, various general wish go.out.
pmwa1ngrc170i8p.translation: At the second watch that night, Jiang Wei was just in the camp making plans when he suddenly heard shouts outside the camp shaking the ground and drums and horns clamoring to the sky: someone reported that Deng Ai was leading three thousand elite troops to fight at night, and the generals wanted to go out.
pmwa1ngrc170i8p.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|是夜二更，姜維正在寨中設計，忽聽得寨外喊聲震地，鼓角喧天：人報鄧艾引三千精兵夜戰，諸將欲出。#1

pmwa1ngrc17109s.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc17109s.gloss: Wei stop 3SG say: PROH DE act.rashly.
pmwa1ngrc17109s.translation: Jiang Wei stopped them, saying, "Do not act rashly."
pmwa1ngrc17109s.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維止之曰：「勿得妄動。」#1

pmwa1ngrc172t5o.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc172t5o.text: 有司議得：卒非撻妻之人，面非受刑之地：合當棄市。
pmwa1ngrc172t5o.gloss: authorities deliberate DE : soldier not.be flog wife LNK person , face not.be receive.punishment LNK place : ought execute.in.market .
pmwa1ngrc172t5o.translation: The authorities deliberated and concluded: a soldier is not the one to flog a wife, and the face is not the place to receive punishment; (he) ought to be executed in the marketplace.
pmwa1ngrc172t5o.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|有司議得：卒非撻妻之人，面非受刑之地：合當棄市。#1

pmwa1ngrc173957.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc173957.text: 時右將軍閻宇，身無寸功；只因阿附黃皓，遂得重爵；聞姜維統兵在祁山，乃說皓奏後主曰：「姜維屢戰無功，可命閻宇代之。」
pmwa1ngrc173957.gloss: At.that.time Right.General Yan.Yu, self not.have inch.merit; only because flatter.attach Huang.Hao, thus DE high.rank; hear Jiang.Wei command.troops at Qishan, then persuade Hao memorialize Later.Ruler say: Jiang.Wei repeatedly.fight not.have merit, can order Yan.Yu replace 3SG.
pmwa1ngrc173957.translation: At that time the Right General Yan Yu, who himself had not the least merit, only because he fawned on and attached himself to Huang Hao, thus obtained a high rank; when he heard that Jiang Wei was commanding troops at Qishan, he persuaded Huang Hao to memorialize the Later Ruler, saying: "Jiang Wei has fought repeatedly without merit; (you) may order Yan Yu to replace him."
pmwa1ngrc173957.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|時右將軍閻宇，身無寸功；只因阿附黃皓，遂得重爵；聞姜維統兵在祁山，乃說皓奏後主曰：「姜維屢戰無功，可命閻宇代之。」#1

pmwa1ngrc174n9u.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc174n9u.text: 維只得遵命，先令洮陽兵退，次後與張翼徐徐而退。
pmwa1ngrc174n9u.gloss: Jiang.Wei only DE obey order, first order Taoyang troops retreat, afterwards with Zhang.Yi slowly CONJ retreat.
pmwa1ngrc174n9u.translation: Jiang Wei had no choice but to obey the order; first he ordered the Taoyang troops to retreat, and afterwards he slowly withdrew together with Zhang Yi.
pmwa1ngrc174n9u.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|維只得遵命，先令洮陽兵退，次後與張翼徐徐而退。#1

pmwa1ngrc175dxd.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc175dxd.text: 鄧艾在寨中，只聽得一夜鼓角喧天，不知何意。
pmwa1ngrc175dxd.gloss: Deng.Ai at camp inside, only hear DE one.night drum.horn clamor.to.sky, NEG know what meaning.
pmwa1ngrc175dxd.translation: Deng Ai was in the camp and only heard drums and horns resounding to the sky all night; he did not know what it meant.
pmwa1ngrc175dxd.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|鄧艾在寨中，只聽得一夜鼓角喧天，不知何意。#1

pmwa1ngrc176952.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc176952.text: 一者：得麥熟以助軍實；二者，可以盡圖隴右諸郡；三者，魏人不敢正視漢中；四者，將軍在外掌握兵權，人不能圖，可以避禍：此乃保國安身之策也，宜早行之。」
pmwa1ngrc176952.gloss: first: DE wheat ripe in.order.to aid army.supplies; second, can fully scheme Longyou all.commanderies; third, Wei.people NEG dare look.directly.at Hanzhong; fourth, general outside control military.power, people NEG can scheme, can avoid.disaster: this COP protect state secure self ATTR strategy SFP, should early carry.out 3SG.
pmwa1ngrc176952.translation: First: obtain the ripe wheat to aid the army's supplies; second, (we) can fully scheme for all the commanderies of Longyou; third, the Wei people will not dare to look directly at Hanzhong; fourth, with the General outside holding military power, others cannot plot against (you), and (you) can avoid disaster: this is the strategy to protect the state and secure yourself; it should be carried out early.
pmwa1ngrc176952.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|一者：得麥熟以助軍實；二者，可以盡圖隴右諸郡；三者，魏人不敢正視漢中；四者，將軍在外掌握兵權，人不能圖，可以避禍：此乃保國安身之策也，宜早行之。」#1

pmwa1ngrc17789f.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc17789f.text: 賈充曰：「姜維深得孔明傳授，急難退之。
pmwa1ngrc17789f.gloss: Jia.Chong say: Jiang.Wei deeply DE Kongming transmit.teach, in.a.hurry difficult repel 3SG.
pmwa1ngrc17789f.translation: Jia Chong said, "Jiang Wei has deeply received Kong Ming's transmission; he is difficult to repel in a hurry."
pmwa1ngrc17789f.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|賈充曰：「姜維深得孔明傳授，急難退之。#1

pmwa1ngrc178ilx.section: 第一百十五回 詔班師後主信讒 託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc178ilx.text: 須得一智勇之將，往刺殺之，可免動兵之勞。」
pmwa1ngrc178ilx.gloss: must DE one wise.brave ATTR general, go assassinate 3SG, can avoid move.troops ATTR toil
pmwa1ngrc178ilx.translation: We must get a wise and brave general to go and assassinate him (Jiang Wei), and then we can avoid the toil of moving troops.
pmwa1ngrc178ilx.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|須得一智勇之將，往刺殺之，可免動兵之勞。」#1

pmwa1ngrc17901i.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc17901i.text: 荀勗曰：「鄧艾乃世之良材，更得鍾會為副將，大事成矣。」
pmwa1ngrc17901i.gloss: Xun.Xu say: Deng.Ai COP world GEN fine.talent, further DE Zhong.Hui as deputy.general, great.undertaking succeed SFP?
pmwa1ngrc17901i.translation: Xun Xu said, "Deng Ai is a fine talent of the age; if (we) further get Zhong Hui as deputy general, the great undertaking will succeed."
pmwa1ngrc17901i.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|荀勗曰：「鄧艾乃世之良材，更得鍾會為副將，大事成矣。」#1

pmwa1ngrc17at7j.section: 第一百十五回　　詔班師後主信讒　　　託屯田姜維避禍
pmwa1ngrc17at7j.text: 今吾已令鄧艾引關外隴右之兵十餘萬，絆住姜維於沓中，使不得東顧；遣鍾會引關中精兵二三十萬，直抵駱谷：三路以襲漢中。
pmwa1ngrc17at7j.gloss: now 1SG already order Deng.Ai lead outside.the.passes Longyou GEN troops more.than.100000, tie.down Jiang.Wei at Tazhong, cause NEG DE turn.east; dispatch Zhong.Hui lead Guanzhong elite.troops 200000-300000, directly.reach Luogu: three.routes in.order.to attack Hanzhong.
pmwa1ngrc17at7j.translation: Now I have already ordered Deng Ai to lead the more than 100,000 troops of Longyou outside the passes, to tie down Jiang Wei at Tazhong so that he cannot turn east; (I) dispatch Zhong Hui to lead two to three hundred thousand elite troops from Guanzhong straight to Luogu: three routes with which to attack Hanzhong.
pmwa1ngrc17at7j.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今吾已令鄧艾引關外隴右之兵十餘萬，絆住姜維於沓中，使不得東顧；遣鍾會引關中精兵二三十萬，直抵駱谷：三路以襲漢中。#1

pmwa1ngrc17b8r2.section: 第一百十六回　　鍾會分兵漢中道　　　武侯顯聖定軍山
pmwa1ngrc17b8r2.text: 至若魏人得勝思歸，必不從會而反，更不足慮耳。
pmwa1ngrc17b8r2.gloss: as.for Wei.people DE victory think.return, certainly NEG follow Hui CONJ rebel, furthermore NEG worth worry SFP.
pmwa1ngrc17b8r2.translation: As for the Wei soldiers, once victorious they will think of returning home; they will certainly not follow Zhong Hui and rebel; this is even less worth worrying about.
pmwa1ngrc17b8r2.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|至若魏人得勝思歸，必不從會而反，更不足慮耳。#1

pmwa1ngrc17cvvo.section: 第一百十六回　　鍾會分兵漢中道　　　武侯顯聖定軍山
pmwa1ngrc17cvvo.text: 實曰：「破蜀必矣：但恐皆不得還都耳。」
pmwa1ngrc17cvvo.gloss: Shi say, "defeat Shu certain SFP: only fear all NEG DE return capital SFP."
pmwa1ngrc17cvvo.translation: Shi said, "Defeating Shu is certain; I only fear that both (of them) will be unable to return to the capital, that is all."
pmwa1ngrc17cvvo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|實曰：「破蜀必矣：但恐皆不得還都耳。」#1

pmwa1ngrc17dbtk.section: 第一百十六回　　鍾會分兵漢中道　　　武侯顯聖定軍山
pmwa1ngrc17dbtk.text: 僉左衝右突，往來死戰，不能得脫；所領蜀兵，十傷八九。
pmwa1ngrc17dbtk.gloss: Fu.Qian left charge right dash, back.and.forth fight.to.death, cannot DE escape; NMLZ lead Shu troops, ten wounded eight nine.
pmwa1ngrc17dbtk.translation: Fu Qian charged left and right, fighting desperately back and forth, but could not break free; of the Shu troops he commanded, eight or nine out of ten were wounded.
pmwa1ngrc17dbtk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|僉左衝右突，往來死戰，不能得脫；所領蜀兵，十傷八九。#1

pmwa1ngrc17efmo.section: 第一百十六回　　鍾會分兵漢中道　　　武侯顯聖定軍山
pmwa1ngrc17efmo.text: 鍾會得了陽平關，關內所積糧草軍器極多，大喜，遂犒三軍。
pmwa1ngrc17efmo.gloss: Zhong.Hui DE PFV Yangping.Pass, pass inside NMLZ accumulate grain.fodder army.weapon extremely many, great joy, then reward three army.
pmwa1ngrc17efmo.translation: Zhong Hui gained Yangping Pass; the grain, fodder and weapons stored inside the pass were extremely plentiful, so he was overjoyed and rewarded the three armies.
pmwa1ngrc17efmo.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|鍾會得了陽平關，關內所積糧草軍器極多，大喜，遂犒三軍。#1

pmwa1ngrc17fsfu.section: 第一百十六回　　鍾會分兵漢中道　　　武侯顯聖定軍山
pmwa1ngrc17fsfu.text: 姜維驅兵追殺，至二十里，只聽得金鼓齊鳴，一枝兵擺開，旗上大書「隴西太守牽弘」字樣。
pmwa1ngrc17fsfu.gloss: Jiang.Wei urge troops pursue kill, reach twenty li, only hear DE gong drum together sound, one CLF troops deploy.open, flag on big write Longxi administrator Qian.Hong character.form.
pmwa1ngrc17fsfu.translation: Jiang Wei urged his troops on in pursuit and killing; when they had gone twenty li, he only heard gongs and drums sounding together, and a body of troops deployed, with large characters on the banners reading “Administrator of Longxi, Qian Hong.”
pmwa1ngrc17fsfu.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|姜維驅兵追殺，至二十里，只聽得金鼓齊鳴，一枝兵擺開，旗上大書「隴西太守牽弘」字樣。#1

pmwa1ngrc17gb7z.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrc17gb7z.text: 正言間，忽報諸葛緒領兵殺至關下，維大怒，急引五千兵殺下關來，直撞入魏陣中，左衝右突，殺得諸葛緒大敗而走，退數十里下寨。
pmwa1ngrc17gb7z.gloss: just speak interval, suddenly report Zhuge.Xu lead troops attack arrive pass below, Jiang.Wei greatly angry, urgently lead five thousand troops attack down pass come, straight crash enter Wei formation middle, left charge right dash, attack DE Zhuge.Xu greatly defeated CONJ flee, retreat several ten li pitch.camp.
pmwa1ngrc17gb7z.translation: Just as they were speaking, it was suddenly reported that Zhuge Xu was leading troops in an attack to the foot of the pass. Jiang Wei was furious; he quickly led five thousand troops down from the pass to attack, charged straight into the midst of the Wei formation, dashed left and right, and fought until Zhuge Xu was badly defeated and fled, retreating several tens of li and pitching camp.
pmwa1ngrc17gb7z.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|正言間，忽報諸葛緒領兵殺至關下，維大怒，急引五千兵殺下關來，直撞入魏陣中，左衝右突，殺得諸葛緒大敗而走，退數十里下寨。#1

pmwa1ngrc17hgch.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrc17hgch.text: 會怒曰：「吾令汝守把陰平橋頭，以斷姜維歸路，如何失了；今又不得吾令，擅自進兵，以致此敗！」
pmwa1ngrc17hgch.gloss: Zhong.Hui angry say: 1SG order 2SG guard Yinping bridgehead, in.order.to cut Jiang.Wei return.road, how lose PFV; now again NEG DE 1SG order, on.own.initiative advance.troops, cause PROX defeat!
pmwa1ngrc17hgch.translation: Zhong Hui said angrily: I ordered you to guard the Yinping bridgehead in order to cut off Jiang Wei's retreat; how did you lose it? Now again, without my order, you advanced troops on your own initiative and so caused this defeat!
pmwa1ngrc17hgch.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|會怒曰：「吾令汝守把陰平橋頭，以斷姜維歸路，如何失了；今又不得吾令，擅自進兵，以致此敗！」#1

pmwa1ngrc17i1of.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrc17i1of.text: 艾見軍容甚肅，心中不安，乃以言挑之曰：「將軍得了漢中，乃朝廷大幸也，可定策早取劍閣。」
pmwa1ngrc17i1of.gloss: Deng.Ai see army.appearance very solemn, in.heart not.peaceful, then with word probe 3SG say: general DE PFV Hanzhong, COP court great fortune SFP, can settle.plan early take Jiange.
pmwa1ngrc17i1of.translation: Deng Ai saw that the army’s discipline was very strict and was uneasy at heart; thereupon he probed him with words, saying: “General, that you have gained Hanzhong is a great blessing for the court; you may settle your plan and take Jiange early.”
pmwa1ngrc17i1of.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|艾見軍容甚肅，心中不安，乃以言挑之曰：「將軍得了漢中，乃朝廷大幸也，可定策早取劍閣。」#1

pmwa1ngrc17joew.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrc17joew.text: 彼今得漢中，以為莫大之功；若非吾屯沓中絆住姜維，彼安能成功耶！
pmwa1ngrc17joew.gloss: 3SG now DE Hanzhong, consider greatest GEN achievement; if.not 1SG station Tazhong tie.down Jiang.Wei, 3SG how.can succeed Q!
pmwa1ngrc17joew.translation: He has now gained Hanzhong and considers it the greatest achievement; if I had not been stationed at Tazhong and held Jiang Wei back, how could he have succeeded!
pmwa1ngrc17joew.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|彼今得漢中，以為莫大之功；若非吾屯沓中絆住姜維，彼安能成功耶！#1

pmwa1ngrd17kp85.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrd17kp85.text: 乃喚諸軍曰：「『不入虎穴，焉得虎子』？
pmwa1ngrd17kp85.gloss: then summon all.troops say: not enter tiger den, how DE tiger.cub?
pmwa1ngrd17kp85.translation: Then he summoned the troops and said, 'If you do not enter the tiger's den, how can you get the tiger cubs?'
pmwa1ngrd17kp85.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|乃喚諸軍曰：「『不入虎穴，焉得虎子』？#1

pmwa1ngrd17lzme.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrd17lzme.text: 吾與汝等來到此地，若得成功，富貴共之。」
pmwa1ngrd17lzme.gloss: 1SG with 2PL come.arrive PROX place, if DE achieve.success, wealth.honor share 3SG.
pmwa1ngrd17lzme.translation: I and you all have come to this place; if we achieve success, we will share wealth and honor.
pmwa1ngrd17lzme.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|吾與汝等來到此地，若得成功，富貴共之。」#1

pmwa1ngrd17m8kn.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrd17m8kn.text: 卻說鄧艾得馬邈獻地理圖一本，備寫涪城至成都一百六十里，山川道路，關隘險峻，一一分明。
pmwa1ngrd17m8kn.gloss: now.say Deng.Ai DE Ma.Miao present geographical.map one CLF, fully.record Fu.City to Chengdu one.hundred.sixty li, mountain.river road, pass steep.dangerous, one.by.one clear
pmwa1ngrd17m8kn.translation: Now then, Deng Ai obtained a map that Ma Miao presented, one volume, which fully recorded the one hundred sixty li from Fu City to Chengdu; the mountains and rivers, the roads, and the steep and dangerous passes were all clearly set out one by one.
pmwa1ngrd17m8kn.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|卻說鄧艾得馬邈獻地理圖一本，備寫涪城至成都一百六十里，山川道路，關隘險峻，一一分明。#1

pmwa1ngrd17n369.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrd17n369.text: 嚇得師、鄧二人汗流遍身，回顧軍士曰：「原來孔明尚在，我等休矣！」
pmwa1ngrd17n369.gloss: frighten DE Shi, Deng two person sweat flow all.over.body, turn.back look soldier say: originally Kongming still be.here, 1PL be.done.for SFP!
pmwa1ngrd17n369.translation: Shi and Deng were so frightened that sweat streamed all over their bodies; they turned to look at the soldiers and said, 'So Kongming is still here—we are done for!'
pmwa1ngrd17n369.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|嚇得師、鄧二人汗流遍身，回顧軍士曰：「原來孔明尚在，我等休矣！」#1

pmwa1ngrd17ozrr.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrd17ozrr.text: 今後主昏弱，王氣已終，艾奉天子之命，以重兵伐蜀，已皆得其地矣，成都危在旦夕，公何不應天順人，仗義來歸？
pmwa1ngrd17ozrr.gloss: now Latter.Lord dim.weak, royal.aura already end, Ai receive Son.of.Heaven GEN command, with heavy.troops attack Shu, already all DE its land CRS, Chengdu danger at morning.evening, you.HON why NEG comply Heaven accord people, uphold.righteousness come submit?
pmwa1ngrd17ozrr.translation: Now the Latter Lord is dim and weak, and the royal aura has already ended. I, Ai, have received the Son of Heaven’s command and with heavy troops attacked Shu; (I) have already taken all its territory. Chengdu is in imminent danger. Why do you not comply with Heaven and accord with the people, and come submit in righteousness?
pmwa1ngrd17ozrr.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|今後主昏弱，王氣已終，艾奉天子之命，以重兵伐蜀，已皆得其地矣，成都危在旦夕，公何不應天順人，仗義來歸？#1

pmwa1ngrd17pzrm.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrd17pzrm.text: 張遵諫曰：「小將軍勿得輕出。」
pmwa1ngrd17pzrm.gloss: Zhang.Zun remonstrate say: young.general PROH DE rashly go.out.
pmwa1ngrd17pzrm.translation: Zhang Zun remonstrated, saying, "Young general, do not rashly go out."
pmwa1ngrd17pzrm.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|張遵諫曰：「小將軍勿得輕出。」#1

pmwa1ngrd17qdu1.section: 第一百十七回　　鄧士載偷渡陰平　　　諸葛瞻戰死綿竹
pmwa1ngrd17qdu1.text: 蜀兵寡，魏兵眾，三人亦皆戰死，艾因此得了綿竹。
pmwa1ngrd17qdu1.gloss: Shu troops few, Wei troops numerous, three person also all die.in.battle, Ai therefore DE PFV Mianzhu.
pmwa1ngrd17qdu1.translation: The Shu troops were few and the Wei troops numerous; the three men also all died in battle, and Ai thereby took Mianzhu.

pmwa1ngrd17rh34.translation: He has attained his proper death!

pmwa1ngrd17t2h0.translation: Zhao received the letter and looked at it.

pmwa1ngrd17uj2o.section: 第一百十八回　　哭祖廟一王死孝　　　入西川二士爭功
pmwa1ngrd17uj2o.gloss: now Deng.Ai reach here, how DE NEG wild?

pmwa1ngrd17vas7.translation: Zhong Hui entered Chengdu and took complete possession of Deng Ai’s troops and horses; his martial prestige was greatly resounding.

pmwa1ngrd17wqnc.text: 事成則得天下，不成則退西蜀，亦不失作劉備也。」
pmwa1ngrd17wqnc.gloss: matter succeed then DE all.under.heaven, NEG succeed then retreat Western.Shu, also NEG lose become Liu.Bei SFP
pmwa1ngrd17wqnc.translation: If the undertaking succeeds, then I will gain the empire; if it does not succeed, then I will retreat to Western Shu, and I will not fail to be a Liu Bei either.
pmwa1ngrd17wqnc.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|事成則得天下，不成則退西蜀，亦不失作劉備也。」#1

pmwa1ngrd17x4qn.section: 第一百十九回　　假投降巧計成虛話　　再受禪依樣畫葫蘆
pmwa1ngrd17x4qn.text: 眾皆恐懼，只得相從，畫字已畢，會乃困諸將於宮中，嚴兵禁守。
pmwa1ngrd17x4qn.gloss: crowd all fear, only DE go.along, write.character already finish, Hui then confine PL general at palace inside, strict soldier guard.
pmwa1ngrd17x4qn.translation: They were all terrified and had no choice but to go along; when the signing of names was finished, Hui then confined the generals in the palace, with soldiers strictly guarding them.

pmwa1ngrd17y0km.text: 會分付曰：「吾以重事託汝，休得泄漏。」

pmwa1ngrd17y0km.translation: Zhong Hui instructed (him), saying: 'I entrust you with an important matter; do not leak it.'
pmwa1ngrd17y0km.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|會分付曰：「吾以重事託汝，休得泄漏。」#1

pmwa1ngrd17zky1.section: 第一百十九回　　假投降巧計成虛話　　再受禪依樣畫葫蘆
pmwa1ngrd17zky1.text: 護軍田續曰：「昔鄧艾取江油之時，欲殺續，得眾官告免。
pmwa1ngrd17zky1.gloss: army.protector Tian.Xu say: formerly Deng.Ai take Jiangyou GEN time, want kill Xu, DE all.officials plead.exemption.
pmwa1ngrd17zky1.translation: Army Protector Tian Xu said: 'Formerly, when Deng Ai took Jiangyou, he wanted to kill me; I was spared through the various officials' plea for pardon.'
pmwa1ngrd17zky1.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|護軍田續曰：「昔鄧艾取江油之時，欲殺續，得眾官告免。#1

pmwa1ngrd180ctk.section: 第一百十九回　　假投降巧計成虛話　　再受禪依樣畫葫蘆
pmwa1ngrd180ctk.text: 時霍戈探聽得後主受封，遂率部下軍士來降。
pmwa1ngrd180ctk.gloss: at.that.time Huo.Ge find.out DE Later.Ruler receive.enfeoffment, then lead subordinate soldiers come surrender
pmwa1ngrd180ctk.translation: At that time Huo Ge learned that the Later Ruler had been enfeoffed, so he led the soldiers under his command to come and surrender.
pmwa1ngrd180ctk.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|時霍戈探聽得後主受封，遂率部下軍士來降。#1

pmwa1ngrd18162n.section: 第一百十九回　　假投降巧計成虛話　　再受禪依樣畫葫蘆
pmwa1ngrd18162n.text: 昔日太祖武皇帝，東蕩西除，南征北討，非容易得此天下；今天子有德無罪，何故讓與人耶？」
pmwa1ngrd18162n.gloss: formerly Grand.Ancestor.Martial.Emperor, east sweep west eliminate, south campaign north attack, NEG easy DE this realm; today Son.of.Heaven have virtue not.have fault, why yield.to person Q?
pmwa1ngrd18162n.translation: In former days, the Grand Ancestor Emperor Wu swept east and cleared west, campaigned south and attacked north; he did not gain this realm easily. Today the Son of Heaven has virtue and no fault; why yield (it) to someone?
pmwa1ngrd18162n.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|昔日太祖武皇帝，東蕩西除，南征北討，非容易得此天下；今天子有德無罪，何故讓與人耶？」#1

pmwa1ngrd182r14.section: 第一百十九回　　假投降巧計成虛話　　再受禪依樣畫葫蘆
pmwa1ngrd182r14.text: 曹操挾天子以令諸侯，自立魏王，篡奪漢室，吾祖父三世輔魏，得天下者，非曹氏之能，實司馬氏之力也。
pmwa1ngrd182r14.gloss: Cao.Cao coerce Son.of.Heaven in.order.to command feudal.lords, self.establish King.of.Wei, usurp Han.house, 1SG grandfather father three.generation assist Wei, DE empire NMLZ, NEG Cao.clan GEN ability, truly Sima.clan GEN strength SFP.
pmwa1ngrd182r14.translation: Cao Cao coerced the Son of Heaven and used him to command the feudal lords, set himself up as King of Wei, and usurped the Han house. My grandfather and father, for three generations, assisted Wei; the one who gained the empire did so not by the Cao clan's ability but truly by the strength of the Sima clan.
pmwa1ngrd182r14.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|曹操挾天子以令諸侯，自立魏王，篡奪漢室，吾祖父三世輔魏，得天下者，非曹氏之能，實司馬氏之力也。#1

pmwa1ngrd183cen.text: 尚對曰：「陛下筮得吉兆，庚子歲，青蓋當入洛陽。」
pmwa1ngrd183cen.gloss: Shang answer say: Majesty divine DE auspicious omen, Gengzi year, blue canopy FUT enter Luoyang.
pmwa1ngrd183cen.translation: Shang replied: "Your Majesty's divination has obtained an auspicious omen: in the gengzi year, the blue canopy (the imperial carriage) is to enter Luoyang."
pmwa1ngrd183cen.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|尚對曰：「陛下筮得吉兆，庚子歲，青蓋當入洛陽。」#1

pmwa1ngrd18426n.section: 第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統
pmwa1ngrd18426n.text: 陛下可詔都督羊祜率兵拒之，俟其國中有變，乘勢攻取，東吳反掌可得也。」
pmwa1ngrd18426n.gloss: Majesty can edict Governor Yang.Hu lead troops resist 3SG, wait 3SG state.in have change, seize.moment attack.take, Eastern.Wu turn.palm can DE SFP
pmwa1ngrd18426n.translation: Your Majesty may issue an edict to the Governor Yang Hu to lead troops and resist them; wait until there is upheaval within their state, then seize the moment to attack and take it — Eastern Wu can be obtained as easily as turning over one's palm.

pmwa1ngrd185top.gloss: from.then.on Yang.Hu garrison Xiangyang, very DE soldier.people GEN heart.
pmwa1ngrd185top.translation: From then on, Yang Hu garrisoned Xiangyang and greatly won the hearts of the soldiers and people.

pmwa1ngrd186wih.gloss: all general receive DE order, stop at Jin.territory hunt, NEG invade Wu.territory.
pmwa1ngrd186wih.translation: The generals received the order, halted within Jin territory to hunt, and did not encroach on Wu territory.

pmwa1ngre1897tn.translation: Lu Kang said: “Since he has shown me kindness, how could I fail to have something with which to repay him?”
