pmwa1ngre18cl1p.translation: If (we) are fortunate enough to win, Jiangnan will be at peace by itself.
pmwa1ngre18cl1p.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|若幸得勝，江南自安。#1

pmwa1ngre18d33a.section: 第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統
pmwa1ngre18d33a.text: 陶濬奏曰：「臣領戰船皆小，願得二萬兵乘大船以戰，自足破之。」
pmwa1ngre18d33a.gloss: Tao.Jun memorialize say: minister command warship all small, wish DE twenty.thousand soldier ride big ship in.order.to fight, naturally enough defeat 3PL.
pmwa1ngre18d33a.translation: Tao Jun memorialized, saying: "The warships I command are all small; I wish to obtain twenty thousand soldiers to man the large ships and fight; (that force) will naturally be enough to defeat them."
pmwa1ngre18d33a.key: 15th Century CE|Romance of the Three Kingdoms|第一百二十回　　薦杜預老將獻新謀　　降孫皓三分歸一統|陶濬奏曰：「臣領戰船皆小，願得二萬兵乘大船以戰，自足破之。」#1

pmwciwkvk1igh.text: 所以子弟行中，有了潘安般貌，邓通般钱，自然上和下睦，做得烟花寨内的大王，鸳鸯会上的主盟。
pmwciwkvk1igh.gloss: therefore young.man profession among, have-PFV Pan.An like looks, Deng.Tong like money, naturally above and below harmonious, do-DE brothel camp inside ATTR great.king, mandarin.duck meeting on ATTR chief.leader.
pmwciwkvk1igh.translation: So among the young men of that trade, if one has Pan An's looks and Deng Tong's money, he will naturally be on good terms with high and low alike, and can become the king of the pleasure quarter and the leader of the lovers' gatherings.
pmwciwkvk1igh.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|所以子弟行中，有了潘安般貌，邓通般钱，自然上和下睦，做得烟花寨内的大王，鸳鸯会上的主盟。#1

pmwciwkvk2sca.text: 但凡做小娘的，有一分所长，得人衬贴，就当十分。
pmwciwkvk2sca.gloss: any be.courtesan NMLZ, have one part strong.point, DE person bolster, then count.as ten part.
pmwciwkvk2sca.translation: Any girl who works as a courtesan, if she has one part of merit and gets people to bolster it, it counts as ten parts.
pmwciwkvk2sca.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|但凡做小娘的，有一分所长，得人衬贴，就当十分。#1

pmwciwkvk3kx0.text: 只为郑元和识趣知情，善于帮衬，所以亚仙心中舍他不得。
pmwciwkvk3kx0.gloss: only because Zheng.Yuanhe know.mood know.feelings, good.at help.please, therefore Yaxian heart inside part.with 3SG NEG DE.
pmwciwkvk3kx0.translation: It was only because Zheng Yuanhe understood mood and feeling and was good at being agreeable that Yaxian could not bear to part with him in her heart.
pmwciwkvk3kx0.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|只为郑元和识趣知情，善于帮衬，所以亚仙心中舍他不得。#1

pmwciwkvl4drg.text: 以致万民嗟怨，金虏乘之而起，把花锦般一个世界，弄得七零八落。
pmwciwkvl4drg.gloss: result.in all.people sigh.resent, Jin.barbarian take.advantage 3SG CONJ rise, BA flower.brocade-like one CLF world, make-DE scattered.and.shattered.
pmwciwkvl4drg.translation: So that the countless people sighed in resentment; the Jin barbarians seized the occasion and rose up, and a world that was like figured brocade was left smashed to pieces.
pmwciwkvl4drg.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|以致万民嗟怨，金虏乘之而起，把花锦般一个世界，弄得七零八落。#1

pmwciwkvl56z0.text: 直至二帝蒙尘，高宗泥马渡江，偏安一隅，天下分为南北，方得休息。
pmwciwkvl56z0.gloss: until two emperor suffer.dust, Gaozong clay.horse cross.river, take.refuge one corner, realm divide.into south.north, only.then DE rest.
pmwciwkvl56z0.translation: It was not until the two emperors were brought low and Gaozong crossed the river on a clay horse, taking refuge in one corner, and the realm was divided into north and south, that there was finally rest.
pmwciwkvl56z0.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|直至二帝蒙尘，高宗泥马渡江，偏安一隅，天下分为南北，方得休息。#1

pmwciwkvl6f1i.text: 虽则粜米为生，一应麦豆茶酒油盐杂货，无所不备，家道颇颇得过。
pmwciwkvl6f1i.gloss: although sell.rice make.living, all wheat bean tea wine oil salt sundry.goods, not.have NMLZ NEG stock, household.finances quite.quite DE get.by.
pmwciwkvl6f1i.translation: Although they made their living by selling rice, they stocked all manner of wheat, beans, tea, wine, oil, salt, and sundry goods — there was nothing they did not stock — and the household was quite able to get by.
pmwciwkvl6f1i.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|虽则粜米为生，一应麦豆茶酒油盐杂货，无所不备，家道颇颇得过。#1

pmwciwkvl7kcl.text: 自小生得清秀，更且资性聪明。
pmwciwkvl7kcl.gloss: from.childhood be.born DE delicate.pretty, moreover natural.disposition clever.
pmwciwkvl7kcl.translation: From childhood (she) was born delicate and pretty, and moreover was intelligent by nature.
pmwciwkvl7kcl.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|自小生得清秀，更且资性聪明。#1

pmwciwkvl869p.text: 他看见许多逃难的百姓，多背得有包裹，假意呐喊道：“鞑子来了！”
pmwciwkvl869p.gloss: 3SG see many flee.disaster ATTR commoner, most carry DE have bundle, pretend shout say: Tartar come CRS!
pmwciwkvl869p.translation: He saw many commoners fleeing the chaos, most of them carrying bundles on their backs, and shouted in pretense: “The Tartars are coming!”
pmwciwkvl869p.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|他看见许多逃难的百姓，多背得有包裹，假意呐喊道：“鞑子来了！”#1

pmwciwkvl9x25.text: 此时天色将晚，吓得众百姓落荒乱窜，你我不相顾。
pmwciwkvl9x25.gloss: PROX time sky color FUT late, frighten DE crowd common.people flee.into.wilds scurry.wildly, 2SG 1SG NEG each.other look.after
pmwciwkvl9x25.translation: At this moment the sky was growing late, frightening the common people into fleeing helter-skelter into the wilds, with no one looking after another.
pmwciwkvl9x25.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|此时天色将晚，吓得众百姓落荒乱窜，你我不相顾。#1

pmwciwkvlax3b.text: 欲待寻访，又不认得路径，只得望南而行。
pmwciwkvlax3b.gloss: want.to seek, yet NEG recognize-DE route, only DE toward south CONJ go
pmwciwkvlax3b.translation: Wanting to go and search (for her parents), but unable to recognize the route, she had no choice but to head south.
pmwciwkvlax3b.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|欲待寻访，又不认得路径，只得望南而行。#1

pmwciwkvlb0zz.text: 欲待寻访，又不认得路径，只得望南而行。
pmwciwkvlb0zz.gloss: want.to seek, yet NEG recognize-DE route, only DE toward south CONJ go
pmwciwkvlb0zz.translation: Wanting to go and search (for her parents), but unable to recognize the route, she had no choice but to head south.
pmwciwkvlb0zz.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|欲待寻访，又不认得路径，只得望南而行。#2

pmwciwkvlcvcd.text: 听得啼哭之声，慌忙来看。
pmwciwkvlcvcd.gloss: hear DE cry GEN sound, hurriedly come look
pmwciwkvlcvcd.translation: He heard the sound of crying and hurried over to look.
pmwciwkvlcvcd.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|听得啼哭之声，慌忙来看。#1

pmwciwkvldzr1.text: 到了建康府，路上又闻得金兀术四太子，引兵渡江，眼见得建康不得宁息。
pmwciwkvldzr1.gloss: arrive PFV Jiankang.Prefecture, on.road again hear DE Jin.Wuzhu Fourth.Prince, lead.troops cross.river, evidently DE Jiankang NEG DE peace.rest.
pmwciwkvldzr1.translation: When they reached Jiankang Prefecture, on the road they again heard that Jin Wuzhu, the Fourth Prince, had led troops across the Yangtze; it was evident that Jiankang would have no peace.
pmwciwkvldzr1.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|到了建康府，路上又闻得金兀术四太子，引兵渡江，眼见得建康不得宁息。#1

pmwciwkvlef8h.text: 到了建康府，路上又闻得金兀术四太子，引兵渡江，眼见得建康不得宁息。
pmwciwkvlef8h.gloss: arrive PFV Jiankang.Prefecture, on.road again hear DE Jin.Wuzhu Fourth.Prince, lead.troops cross.river, evidently DE Jiankang NEG DE peace.rest.
pmwciwkvlef8h.translation: When they reached Jiankang Prefecture, on the road they again heard that Jin Wuzhu, the Fourth Prince, had led troops across the Yangtze; it was evident that Jiankang would have no peace.
pmwciwkvlef8h.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|到了建康府，路上又闻得金兀术四太子，引兵渡江，眼见得建康不得宁息。#2

pmwciwkvlfd69.text: 到了建康府，路上又闻得金兀术四太子，引兵渡江，眼见得建康不得宁息。
pmwciwkvlfd69.gloss: arrive PFV Jiankang.Prefecture, on.road again hear DE Jin.Wuzhu Fourth.Prince, lead.troops cross.river, evidently DE Jiankang NEG DE peace.rest.
pmwciwkvlfd69.translation: When they reached Jiankang Prefecture, on the road they again heard that Jin Wuzhu, the Fourth Prince, had led troops across the Yangtze; it was evident that Jiankang would have no peace.

pmwciwkvlgmc4.text: 又闻得康王即位，已在杭州驻跸，改名临安，遂趁船到润州。
pmwciwkvlgmc4.gloss: also hear DE Kang.Prince ascend.throne, already at Hangzhou make.imperial.stop, change.name Lin'an, then take.boat to Runzhou.
pmwciwkvlgmc4.translation: They also heard that Prince Kang had ascended the throne and had already made his imperial stop at Hangzhou, which was renamed Lin'an; thereupon they took a boat to Runzhou.
pmwciwkvlgmc4.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|又闻得康王即位，已在杭州驻跸，改名临安，遂趁船到润州。#1

pmwciwkvlha6p.text: 过了苏、常、嘉、湖，直到临安地面，暂且饭店中居住，也亏卜乔，自汴京至临安，三千余里，带那莘瑶琴下来，身边藏下些散碎银两，都用尽了，连身上外盖衣服，脱下准了店钱，止剩得莘瑶琴一件活货，欲行出脱。
pmwciwkvlha6p.gloss: pass PFV Su, Chang, Jia, Hu, straight arrive Lin'an territory, temporarily inn inside reside, also thanks.to Bu.Qiao, from Bianjing to Lin'an, three.thousand more li, bring DEM Xin.Yaoqin down, body.side hide down some loose silver.tael, all use exhaust PFV, even body.on outer.cover clothes, take.off down pledge PFV inn.fee, only remain DE Xin.Yaoqin one CLF live.goods, want proceed sell.
pmwciwkvlha6p.translation: After passing Su, Chang, Jia, and Hu, they went straight to the territory of Lin'an and lodged for the time being in an inn. It was also thanks to Bu Qiao that he brought that Xin Yaoqin all the way from Bianjing to Lin'an, over three thousand li; the loose silver he had hidden on him was all spent, and even the outer garment on his body was taken off and pledged for the inn charges, until only Xin Yaoqin remained, a single piece of living merchandise, which he meant to sell.
pmwciwkvlha6p.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|过了苏、常、嘉、湖，直到临安地面，暂且饭店中居住，也亏卜乔，自汴京至临安，三千余里，带那莘瑶琴下来，身边藏下些散碎银两，都用尽了，连身上外盖衣服，脱下准了店钱，止剩得莘瑶琴一件活货，欲行出脱。#1

pmwciwkvlikwn.text: 访得西湖上烟花王九妈家要讨养女，遂引九妈到店中，看货还钱。
pmwciwkvlikwn.gloss: find.out DE West.Lake on brothel Wang.Jiu.Ma household want take adopted.daughter, then lead Jiu.Ma to inn in, look goods return money.
pmwciwkvlikwn.translation: He found out that at West Lake the brothel household of Wang Jiu Ma wanted to take in an adopted daughter, so he brought Mother Jiu to the inn to inspect the goods and pay the money.
pmwciwkvlikwn.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|访得西湖上烟花王九妈家要讨养女，遂引九妈到店中，看货还钱。#1

pmwciwkvlj2mh.text: 九妈见瑶琴生得标致，讲了财礼五十两。
pmwciwkvlj2mh.gloss: Jiu.Mama see Yaoqin be.born DE pretty, discuss PFV bride.price fifty tael.
pmwciwkvlj2mh.translation: Mother Jiu saw that Yaoqin was pretty, and negotiated a bride-price of fifty taels.
pmwciwkvlj2mh.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|九妈见瑶琴生得标致，讲了财礼五十两。#1

pmwciwkvlk0ys.text: 九妈道：“原来恁地，你是个孤身女儿，无脚蟹，我索性与你说明罢；那姓卜的把你卖在我家，得银五十两去了。
pmwciwkvlk0ys.gloss: Ninth.Mother say: originally like.this, 2SG COP CLF lone girl, without leg crab, 1SG might.as.well to 2SG explain SFP; that surname Bu NMLZ BA 2SG sell at 1SG house, DE silver fifty tael go CRS.
pmwciwkvlk0ys.translation: Ninth Mother said, 'So that is how it is: you are a lone girl, a crab without legs. I might as well explain it plainly to you: that man surnamed Bu sold you into my house, got fifty taels of silver, and went off.'
pmwciwkvlk0ys.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|九妈道：“原来恁地，你是个孤身女儿，无脚蟹，我索性与你说明罢；那姓卜的把你卖在我家，得银五十两去了。#1

pmwciwkvllysy.text: 爱你生得齐整，把做个亲女儿相待。
pmwciwkvllysy.gloss: love 2SG be.born DE neat.pretty, BA as CLF own.daughter treat.
pmwciwkvllysy.translation: I love that you were born so neat and pretty, and I treat you as my own daughter.
pmwciwkvllysy.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|爱你生得齐整，把做个亲女儿相待。#1

pmwciwkvlm9pl.text: 也有爱清标的，闻得他写作俱高，求诗求字的，日不离门。
pmwciwkvlm9pl.gloss: also have love refined.elegance NMLZ, hear DE 3SG writing both high, seek poem seek calligraphy NMLZ, day NEG leave door.
pmwciwkvlm9pl.translation: There were also those who admired her refined elegance; hearing that her writing and calligraphy were both excellent, they sought poems and calligraphy from her and did not leave her door day after day.
pmwciwkvlm9pl.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|也有爱清标的，闻得他写作俱高，求诗求字的，日不离门。#1

pmwciwkvln994.text: 小娘中，谁似得王美儿的标致，又会写，又会画，又会做诗，吹弹歌舞都余事。
pmwciwkvln994.gloss: young.woman among, who match-DE Wang.Mei.er ATTR beauty, also know.how write, also know.how paint, also know.how compose.poetry, blow pluck sing dance all secondary.matter.
pmwciwkvln994.translation: Among the young women, who can match Wang Mei'er's beauty? She can also write, paint, and compose poetry; blowing, plucking, singing, and dancing are all secondary matters.
pmwciwkvln994.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|小娘中，谁似得王美儿的标致，又会写，又会画，又会做诗，吹弹歌舞都余事。#1

pmwciwkvlo0ps.text: 皆因鸨儿爱财，不顾痛苦；那子弟也只专个虚名，不得十分畅快取乐。
pmwciwkvlo0ps.gloss: all because madam love money, NEG care pain; DEM young.man also only seek CLF empty.name, NEG DE fully joyful enjoy
pmwciwkvlo0ps.translation: It is all because the madam loves money and does not care about the pain; those young men, too, are only after a hollow reputation, and cannot enjoy themselves to the full.
pmwciwkvlo0ps.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|皆因鸨儿爱财，不顾痛苦；那子弟也只专个虚名，不得十分畅快取乐。#1

pmwciwkvlptsn.text: 若还有个好好的，羞羞也，如何熬得这些时痒。
pmwciwkvlptsn.gloss: if still have CLF good.good ATTR, shame.shame SFP, how endure DE this.long.time itch?
pmwciwkvlptsn.translation: If (she) still has a good, intact one — shameful as it is — how could (she) have endured the itch all this time?
pmwciwkvlptsn.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|若还有个好好的，羞羞也，如何熬得这些时痒。#1

pmwciwkvlqp1m.text: 王九妈听得这些风声，怕坏了门面，来劝女儿接客。
pmwciwkvlqp1m.gloss: Wang.Jiuma hear DE PROX some wind.sound, fear ruin PFV facade, come urge daughter receive guest.
pmwciwkvlqp1m.translation: When Wang Jiuma heard these rumors, afraid of ruining her establishment’s reputation, she came to urge her daughter to take clients.
pmwciwkvlqp1m.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|王九妈听得这些风声，怕坏了门面，来劝女儿接客。#1

pmwciwkvlrkyh.translation: Only if he (my parent) is willing to take charge will it be acceptable.
pmwciwkvlrkyh.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|他肯做主时，方才使得。”#1

pmwciwkvlsqsh.text: 王九妈心里又恼他，又不里得难为他。
pmwciwkvlsqsh.gloss: Wang.Jiu.Ma heart.inside both be.vexed.at 3SG, also NEG bear-DE make.difficult 3SG.
pmwciwkvlsqsh.translation: Wang Jiuma was both vexed at her in her heart and yet could not bear to make things difficult for her.
pmwciwkvlsqsh.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|王九妈心里又恼他，又不里得难为他。#1

pmwciwkvm1078q.text: 若得他回心转意，大大的烧个利市。
pmwciwkvm1078q.gloss: if DE 3SG change.mind, greatly burn CLF thank.offering.
pmwciwkvm1078q.translation: If (you) can get her to change her mind, (I'll) burn a grand thank-offering.
pmwciwkvm1078q.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|若得他回心转意，大大的烧个利市。#1

pmwciwkvm11zog.text: 刘四妈道：“老身是个女随何，雌陆贾，说得罗汉思情，嫦娥想嫁。
pmwciwkvm11zog.gloss: Liu.Si.aunt say: 1SG COP CLF female.Sui.He, female.Lu.Jia, say DE arhat long.for.love, Chang.E want marry.
pmwciwkvm11zog.translation: Aunt Liu Four said, “I am a female Sui He, a female Lu Jia: I can talk an arhat into longing for love and Chang’e into wanting to marry.
pmwciwkvm11zog.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|刘四妈道：“老身是个女随何，雌陆贾，说得罗汉思情，嫦娥想嫁。#1

pmwciwkvm12jnc.text: 九妈道：“若得如此，做姐的情愿与你磕头。
pmwciwkvm12jnc.gloss: Jiu.Ma say: if DE like PROX, act elder.sister NMLZ willing to 2SG kowtow.
pmwciwkvm12jnc.translation: Ninth Mother said, “If it can be so, I, as your elder sister, am willing to kowtow to you.
pmwciwkvm12jnc.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|九妈道：“若得如此，做姐的情愿与你磕头。#1

pmwciwkvm138eb.text: 你多吃杯茶去，省得说话时口干。”
pmwciwkvm138eb.gloss: 2SG more drink CLF tea go, spare-DE speak time mouth.dry.
pmwciwkvm138eb.translation: Have another cup of tea, so your mouth won’t be dry when you speak.
pmwciwkvm138eb.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|你多吃杯茶去，省得说话时口干。”#1

pmwciwkvm14vjw.text: 美娘听得是四妈声音，便来开门。
pmwciwkvm14vjw.gloss: Meiniang hear DE COP Fourth.Mother voice, then come open door.
pmwciwkvm14vjw.translation: Meiniang heard that it was Fourth Mother’s voice, and came to open the door.
pmwciwkvm14vjw.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|美娘听得是四妈声音，便来开门。#1

pmwciwkvm15lc0.text: 四妈看他桌上铺著一幅细绢，才画得个美人的脸儿，还未曾著色。
pmwciwkvm15lc0.gloss: Fourth.Mother look 3SG table.on spread DUR one CLF fine silk, only paint DE CLF beauty GEN face, still NEG.PRF apply.color
pmwciwkvm15lc0.translation: Fourth Mother looked at her table, where a piece of fine silk was spread; only a beauty's face had been painted, and it had not yet been colored.
pmwciwkvm15lc0.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World|3|四妈看他桌上铺著一幅细绢，才画得个美人的脸儿，还未曾著色。#1

pmwciwkvm161zi.text: 四妈称赞道：“画得好，真是巧手！
pmwciwkvm161zi.gloss: Fourth.Mother praise say: paint DE good, truly COP skillful.hand!
pmwciwkvm161zi.translation: Fourth Mother praised (her), saying, “Painted well! Truly a skilled hand!”

It was also thanks to Bu Qiao that, from Bianjing to Lin'an, over three thousand li, he brought Xin Yaoqin all the way down; the loose silver he had hidden on him was all used up, and even the outer garment on his body he took off and pledged for the inn charges, until only Xin Yaoqin was left, a single piece of living merchandise, which he intended to sell off.

pmwcjcg0381022.text: 若得英雄重展挣，他年奉佛上西方。
pmwcjcg0381022.gloss: if DE hero again struggle, other year serve Buddha go.up Western.Paradise.
pmwcjcg0381022.translation: If he can once again act the hero and struggle free, in a later year he will serve the Buddha and ascend to the Western Paradise.

pmwcjcg0382o30.translation: If he truly manages to escape from the Tathagata's hand, just wait for the Tang dynasty to bring forth a holy monk.

pmwcjf3r284xwi.text: 我与他打了个赌赛，他出不得我手，却将他一把抓住，指化五行山，封压他在那里。
pmwcjf3r284xwi.gloss: 1SG with 3SG make PFV CLF bet, 3SG escape NEG DE 1SG hand, then BA 3SG one.grab seize, point transform Five.Elements.Mountain, seal press 3SG at there.

pmwcjf3r285z8e.text: 怎么得一个有法力的，去东土寻一个善信，教他苦历千山，询经万水，到我处求取真经，永传东土，劝化众生，却乃是个山大的福缘，海深的善庆。
pmwcjf3r285z8e.gloss: how DE one CLF have.magic.power NMLZ, go east.land seek one CLF devout.believer, cause 3SG bitterly.traverse thousand mountain, seek.scripture ten.thousand water, arrive 1SG place seek.obtain true.scripture, forever transmit east.land, persuade.convert sentient.being, yet COP CLF mountain big NMLZ blessing.affinity, sea deep NMLZ good.fortune.
pmwcjf3r285z8e.translation: How can I get someone with magic powers to go to the Eastern Land and find a devout believer, make him bitterly traverse a thousand mountains and seek the scriptures through ten thousand waters, come to my place to seek and obtain the true scriptures, forever transmit them to the Eastern Land, and persuade and convert sentient beings? That would indeed be a blessing as great as a mountain and a good fortune as deep as the sea.

pmwcjf3r286va0.text: 如来见了，心中大喜道：“别个是也去不得。

pmwcjf3r286va0.translation: When Tathagata saw this, he was overjoyed and said: “Others are also unable to go.”
pmwcjf3r286va0.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|8|如来见了，心中大喜道：“别个是也去不得。#1

pmwcjf3r287zrt.text: 须是观音尊者，神通广大，方可去得。”

pmwcjf3r388264.text: 万里相寻自不言，却云谁得意难全。

pmwcjf3r388264.translation: Across ten thousand li I seek (him) without a word myself; yet who can say that attaining one's wish is hard to complete?
pmwcjf3r388264.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|8|万里相寻自不言，却云谁得意难全。#1

pmwcjf3r38a2jl.translation: How could merchants come and go there?

pmwcjf3r38cybi.text: 只杀得昏漠漠，星辰灿烂；雾腾腾，天地朦胧。

pmwcjf3r38kzs8.text: 菩萨道：“姓孙的，你认得我么？”

pmwcjf3r38le7c.text: 大圣睁开火眼金睛，点著头儿高叫道：“我怎么不认得你，你好的是那南海普陀落伽山救苦救难大慈大悲南无观世音菩萨。

You are indeed that Namo Guanshiyin Bodhisattva of Mount Potalaka in the South Sea, who saves from suffering and distress and is greatly compassionate and greatly merciful.
pmwcjf3r38le7c.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji|8|大圣睁开火眼金睛，点著头儿高叫道：“我怎么不认得你，你好的是那南海普陀落伽山救苦救难大慈大悲南无观世音菩萨。#1

pmwcjf3r38mgzs.text: 那菩萨闻得此言，满心欢喜，对大圣道：“圣经云：‘出其言善，则千里之外应之；出其言不善，则千里之外违之。’
